Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch zwei Zahlen durch. Fangen Sie eine mögliche Division durch Null ab und geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den DIVIDE Operator innerhalb eines TRY...CATCH Blocks, um die Ausnahme cx_sy_arithmetic_error zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_with_zero_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_with_zero_check.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_with_zero_check( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_divide( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_method_as_test_delegate(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method_name = 'DIVIDE_WITH_ZERO_CHECK'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_NUMERATOR' value = 10 ) ( name = 'IV_DENOMINATOR' value = 0 ) ) 
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode demonstriert die sichere Division mit dem '/' Operator und das Abfangen der cx_sy_arithmetic_error Ausnahme bei Division durch Null mittels TRY...CATCH. Dies ist der moderne Weg, um Laufzeitfehler zu behandeln, anstatt alte CATCH SYSTEM-EXCEPTIONS zu verwenden.
keywords: DIVIDE, TRY CATCH, Error Handling, Exception, Division by Zero

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle sflights für eine bestimmte Währung.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT mit INTO TABLE, REDUCE für die Summenbildung und DIVIDE für den Durchschnitt. Beachten Sie die Division durch Null, falls keine Flüge gefunden werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT price, curr
      FROM sflight
      WHERE curr = @iv_currency
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0. " No flights found for the currency
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in sflights den prozentualen Anteil seines Preises am Gesamtpreis aller Flüge (für eine bestimmte Währung).
hint: Ermitteln Sie zuerst den Gesamtpreis. Nutzen Sie dann eine FOR-Schleife mit VALUE für die neue Tabelle und den DIVIDE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_percentage,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             percentage TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_percentage.
    TYPES: tt_flight_percentage TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_percentages
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_percentage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_percentages.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
      FROM sflight
      WHERE curr = @iv_currency
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).

    IF lv_total_price = 0. " Avoid division by zero if total price is 0
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_percentages = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
          connid     = ls_flight-connid
          fldate     = ls_flight-fldate
          price      = ls_flight-price
          percentage = ( ls_flight-price / lv_total_price ) * 100 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen gegebenen Wert durch einen Divisor, der basierend auf einer Währung dynamisch bestimmt wird. Fangen Sie dabei eine mögliche Division durch Null ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie den COND-Ausdruck, um den Divisor zu bestimmen, und den DIVIDE-Operator innerhalb eines TRY...CATCH Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_divided_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value   TYPE decfloat34
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_divided_value.
    DATA(lv_divisor) = COND i(
      WHEN iv_currency = 'EUR' THEN 100
      WHEN iv_currency = 'USD' THEN 50
      WHEN iv_currency = 'JPY' THEN 10
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 0 " Default to 0 to trigger error if not handled
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_value / lv_divisor.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_divide_eur FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_usd FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_eur.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_divided_value( iv_value = 1000 iv_currency = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_unknown_currency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_divide( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING

      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_method_as_test_delegate(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method_name = 'GET_DIVIDED_VALUE'

        )
    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den COND-Ausdruck zur dynamischen Bestimmung des Divisors mit dem DIVIDE-Operator und der TRY...CATCH-Fehlerbehandlung. Der WHEN OTHERS-Zweig im COND-Ausdruck stellt sicher, dass ein Standardwert (hier 0) zugewiesen wird, der dann eine Division durch Null auslöst, wenn die Währung nicht bekannt ist. Dies ist ein eleganter Weg, um komplexe bedingte Logik und Fehlerbehandlung zu integrieren.
keywords: DIVIDE, COND, WHEN OTHERS, Conditional Logic, Error Handling, Dynamic

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Werten (z.B. Gramm) in eine andere Einheit (z.B. Kilogramm) durch Division.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Iteration mit VALUE und dem DIVIDE-Operator, um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unit_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_converted_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_grams_to_kilograms
      IMPORTING
        it_grams TYPE tt_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_kilograms) TYPE tt_converted_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_grams_to_kilograms.
    DATA(lv_divisor) = 1000. " 1000 grams in a kilogram

    rt_kilograms = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_gram_value IN it_grams
        ( lv_gram_value / lv_divisor ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_empty_table FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unit_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_grams) = VALUE zcl_unit_converter=>tt_values( ( 1000 ) ( 2500 ) ( 500 ) ).
    DATA(lt_kilograms) = lo_cut->convert_grams_to_kilograms( lt_grams ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_kilograms ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_kilograms[ 1 ] exp = 1.0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_kilograms[ 2 ] exp = 2.5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_kilograms[ 3 ] exp = 0.5 ).

    DATA(lt_grams) = VALUE zcl_unit_converter=>tt_values( ).
    DATA(lt_kilograms) = lo_cut->convert_grams_to_kilograms( lt_grams ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_kilograms ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung einer FOR-Iteration in Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, deren Elemente das Ergebnis einer Division sind. Der DIVIDE-Operator wird hier direkt in der VALUE-Expression für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle angewendet, was eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Art der Datenumwandlung darstellt.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie einen generischen Eingabewert basierend auf seinem Typ und haben Sie einen Fall für alle anderen Typen, die nicht explizit behandelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie CASE TYPE OF oder eine CASE-Anweisung mit WHEN OTHERS, um verschiedene Datentypen oder Werte zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    CASE cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_input )->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        rv_output = |Integer: { iv_input }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
        rv_output = |Character: { iv_input }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_output = |Unhandled Type: { cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_input )->get_relative_name( ) }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit cl_abap_typedescr, um den Typ eines generischen Eingabewertes zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Die CASE-Anweisung mit WHEN OTHERS fängt alle nicht explizit behandelten Typen ab und demonstriert, wie man flexibel auf verschiedene Datentypen reagieren kann, ohne für jeden einzelnen Typ eine separate IF-Bedingung schreiben zu müssen.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, CASE, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Handling

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus sflights basierend auf verschiedenen Kriterien (z.B. Summe der Preise pro Währung), wobei ein Standardfall für nicht übereinstimmende Kriterien existiert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie REDUCE mit einem CASE-Ausdruck, der WHEN OTHERS enthält, um die Aggregationslogik zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_agg_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_sum,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_currency_sum.
    TYPES: tt_currency_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_prices_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_currency_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_prices_by_currency.
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM it_sflights
                                 WHERE ( curr = 'EUR' OR curr = 'USD' ).

    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_sflights
      GROUP BY ( currency = ls_flight-curr ) 
      ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group)
      ( currency = ls_group-currency
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum = sum + 
            CASE ls_grouped_flight-curr
              WHEN 'EUR' THEN ls_grouped_flight-price
              WHEN 'USD' THEN ls_grouped_flight-price * 1.1 " USD gets a 10% bonus
              WHEN OTHERS THEN 0 " Other currencies are ignored in sum
            END 
        ) 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_aggregation_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_agg_others( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 curr = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 curr = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = 50  curr = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 curr = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 curr = 'GBP' ) TO lt_sflights_test.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_prices_by_currency( lt_sflights_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ currency = 'EUR' ]-total_price exp = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ currency = 'USD' ]-total_price exp = 165 ). " 50*1.1 + 100*1.1 = 55 + 110 = 165
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_aggregation_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_agg_others( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_prices_by_currency( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Aggregation mit GROUP BY und REDUCE. Innerhalb des REDUCE-Ausdrucks wird ein CASE-Statement verwendet, um den Preis basierend auf der Währung unterschiedlich zu behandeln. Der WHEN OTHERS-Zweig stellt sicher, dass Währungen, die nicht explizit aufgeführt sind, mit einem Standardwert (hier 0) in die Summe eingehen, was eine flexible und robuste Aggregationslogik ermöglicht.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert zu, der von mehreren Bedingungen abhängt, und definieren Sie einen Standardwert für alle anderen Fälle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Ausdruck mit WHEN OTHERS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_with_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_categorized_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_with_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_value.
    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input < 0 THEN 'Negative'
      WHEN iv_input = 0 THEN 'Zero'
      WHEN iv_input > 0 AND iv_input <= 100 THEN 'Small Positive'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Large Positive or Uncategorized'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der COND-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu verschachtelten IF-Anweisungen für die bedingte Wertzuweisung. Die Verwendung von WHEN OTHERS innerhalb von COND ermöglicht es, einen Standardwert oder eine Standardlogik zu definieren, wenn keine der vorhergehenden Bedingungen erfüllt ist, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, COND, Conditional Logic, Data Manipulation, Default Value

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus sflights basierend auf komplexen Kriterien, wobei ein Standardfall für nicht übereinstimmende Kriterien existiert, der das Element ausschließt.
hint: Nutzen Sie FILTER mit einem COND-Ausdruck, der WHEN OTHERS enthält, um die Filterbedingung zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_complex_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_complex_criteria.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE ( COND abap_bool(
        WHEN carrid = 'LH' AND price > 200 THEN abap_true
        WHEN carrid = 'AA' AND curr = 'USD' THEN abap_true
        WHEN OTHERS THEN abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_others( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 curr = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 curr = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_test. " Match 1
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = 50  curr = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights_test. " Match 2
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 curr = 'GBP' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 curr = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_test.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_complex_criteria( lt_sflights_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_others( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 curr = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_complex_criteria( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_others( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_complex_criteria( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug zur Selektion von Zeilen aus internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er mit einem COND-Ausdruck kombiniert, um komplexe Filterbedingungen zu definieren. Der WHEN OTHERS-Zweig im COND-Ausdruck, der abap_false zurückgibt, stellt sicher, dass alle Zeilen, die nicht explizit einer der definierten Bedingungen entsprechen, automatisch aus der gefilterten Tabelle ausgeschlossen werden. Dies ist eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Art des Filterns.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, FILTER, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Filtering, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in zwei Teile basierend auf einer dynamisch berechneten Position. Fangen Sie dabei Fehler ab, wenn die Position ungültig ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie den DIVIDE-Operator zur Positionsberechnung und String-Templates für die Ausgabe. Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für Fehler bei der String-Manipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_dynamic_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_string_at_dynamic_pos
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_divisor      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_dynamic_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_string_at_dynamic_pos.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    IF lv_length = 0 OR iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_val.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_split_pos) = lv_length / iv_divisor.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_part1) = iv_input_string(0) && lv_split_pos.
        DATA(lv_part2) = iv_input_string+lv_split_pos.
        rv_output_string = |Part 1: '{ lv_part1 }', Part 2: '{ lv_part2 }'|.
      CATCH cx_sy_strg_par_val.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_val
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_strg_par_val=>invalid_offset_length.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_split_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_split_invalid_pos FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_dynamic_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->split_string_at_dynamic_pos( iv_input_string = 'ABCDEFGH' iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Part 1: 'ABCDE', Part 2: 'FGH'' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_split_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_dynamic_divide( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'CX_SY_STRG_PAR_VAL'
      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_method_as_test_delegate(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method_name = 'SPLIT_STRING_AT_DYNAMIC_POS'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_INPUT_STRING' value = 'TEST' ) ( name = 'IV_DIVISOR' value = 0 ) ) 
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_split_invalid_pos.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_dynamic_divide( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'CX_SY_STRG_PAR_VAL'
      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_method_as_test_delegate(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method_name = 'SPLIT_STRING_AT_DYNAMIC_POS'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_INPUT_STRING' value = 'ABC' ) ( name = 'IV_DIVISOR' value = 1 ) ) " Split pos 3, length 3, invalid offset
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Berechnung einer String-Split-Position mittels des DIVIDE-Operators. Die String-Manipulation erfolgt mit modernen String-Templates und Offset/Length-Zugriffen. Eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH fängt die Ausnahme cx_sy_strg_par_val ab, die bei ungültigen Offset- oder Längenangaben auftritt, und verhindert so Laufzeitfehler.
keywords: DIVIDE, String Processing, Dynamic, Error Handling, String Templates

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Methode aus und fangen Sie alle möglichen Ausnahmen generisch ab, wenn der Methodenaufruf fehlschlägt oder eine unerwartete Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Nutzen Sie dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit CALL METHOD und fangen Sie Ausnahmen mit CATCH cx_root ab, um WHEN OTHERS für Ausnahmen zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _dummy_method_success.
    METHODS _dummy_method_error RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lx_root  TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_class TYPE (iv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD lo_class->(iv_method_name).
        rv_message = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' of class '{ iv_class_name }' executed successfully.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO lx_root.
        rv_message = |Error creating object: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO lx_root.
        rv_message = |Error calling method dynamically: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_root. " Generic catch, equivalent to WHEN OTHERS for exceptions
        rv_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _dummy_method_success.
    " Do nothing, just succeed
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _dummy_method_error.
    DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
    DATA(lv_result) = 1 / lv_zero. " Trigger division by zero error
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_specific_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_unknown_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call_others( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CALL_OTHERS' iv_method_name = '_DUMMY_METHOD_SUCCESS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Method ''_DUMMY_METHOD_SUCCESS'' of class ''ZCL_DYNAMIC_CALL_OTHERS'' executed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_specific_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call_others( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CALL_OTHERS' iv_method_name = '_DUMMY_METHOD_ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'An unexpected error occurred: Division by zero' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_unknown_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call_others( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Error creating object: Class ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS cannot be created' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert dynamische Methodenaufrufe, eine fortgeschrittene Technik in ABAP. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über einen TRY...CATCH-Block, der spezifische Ausnahmen für dynamische Aufrufe abfängt und einen generischen CATCH cx_root-Block verwendet, um alle anderen unerwarteten Ausnahmen zu behandeln. Dies ist das Äquivalent zu WHEN OTHERS im Kontext der Ausnahmebehandlung und sorgt für eine robuste Laufzeitumgebung bei dynamischen Operationen.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, TRY CATCH, Dynamic Programming, Error Handling, CALL METHOD, CX_ROOT

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und weisen Sie jedem Flug eine Priorität basierend auf verschiedenen Kriterien zu. Wenn keine der definierten Kriterien zutrifft, soll eine Standardpriorität zugewiesen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Iteration mit VALUE und einem COND-Ausdruck, der WHEN OTHERS enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_priority DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_priority,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             priority   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_priority.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_priority TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_priority WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_flight_priorities
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_prioritized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_priority.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_priority IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_flight_priorities.
    rt_prioritized_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
          connid   = ls_flight-connid
          fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
          priority = COND string(
            WHEN ls_flight-price > 1000 AND ls_flight-curr = 'EUR' THEN 'High Priority'
            WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc < 50 THEN 'Low Occupancy'
            WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Standard Priority' ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_high_priority FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_low_occupancy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_standard_priority FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_priority.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_priority( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 1200 curr = 'EUR' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->assign_flight_priorities( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-priority exp = 'High Priority' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_low_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_priority( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 curr = 'USD' seatsocc = 30 ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->assign_flight_priorities( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-priority exp = 'Low Occupancy' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_standard_priority.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_priority( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 500 curr = 'GBP' seatsocc = 70 ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->assign_flight_priorities( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-priority exp = 'Standard Priority' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_priority( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->assign_flight_priorities( lt_sflights_test ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine FOR-Iteration mit dem VALUE-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, die jedem Flug eine Priorität zuweist. Die Prioritätszuweisung erfolgt über einen COND-Ausdruck, der verschiedene Bedingungen prüft. Der WHEN OTHERS-Zweig im COND-Ausdruck stellt sicher, dass eine Standardpriorität zugewiesen wird, wenn keine der spezifischen Bedingungen erfüllt ist, was den Code sehr prägnant und leicht verständlich macht.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, COND, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von numerischen Werten in eine String-Repräsentation, wobei bestimmte Werte spezielle Bezeichnungen erhalten und alle anderen als 'Unbekannt' markiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck mit WHEN OTHERS für die Wertzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_numbers_to_labels
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_labels) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_numbers_to_labels.
    rt_labels = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
        ( SWITCH string(
            WHEN lv_number = 1 THEN 'One'
            WHEN lv_number = 2 THEN 'Two'
            WHEN lv_number = 3 THEN 'Three'
            WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unknown' ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_known_values FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_known_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_value_to_string=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_labels) = lo_cut->convert_numbers_to_labels( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_labels ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_labels[ 1 ] exp = 'One' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_labels[ 2 ] exp = 'Two' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_labels[ 3 ] exp = 'Three' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_value_to_string=>tt_numbers( ( 99 ) ).
    DATA(lt_labels) = lo_cut->convert_numbers_to_labels( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_labels[ 1 ] exp = 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_value_to_string=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_labels) = lo_cut->convert_numbers_to_labels( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_labels ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der SWITCH-Ausdruck ist eine weitere moderne Möglichkeit, bedingte Wertzuweisungen kompakt zu formulieren. In diesem Beispiel wird er innerhalb einer FOR-Iteration mit VALUE verwendet, um eine Liste von Zahlen in beschreibende Strings umzuwandeln. Der WHEN OTHERS-Zweig im SWITCH-Ausdruck ist entscheidend, um einen Standard-Label für alle Zahlen zu vergeben, die nicht explizit behandelt werden, was die Robustheit der Funktion erhöht.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, SWITCH, FOR, VALUE, Data Manipulation, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und stellen Sie diese als HTML-Tabelle im ABAP-Browser dar. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung und HTML-Generierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`, `FOR` für die Schleife und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation des HTML-Inhalts. String-Templates sind ideal für die HTML-Struktur.
solution:

hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` und die Methode `GET_FIXED_VALUES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_domain_fixed_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low  TYPE ddtext,
             text TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_fixed_values
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.

CLASS zcl_domain_fixed_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( 'S_CARR_ID' ).
    DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).

    rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( 
      FOR fixed_value IN lt_fixed_values_raw
      ( low = fixed_value-low text = fixed_value-ddtext )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_domain_fixed_values( ).

    " Check for a known fixed value, e.g., 'AA' for American Airlines

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Fluggesellschafts-Code (`S_CARR_ID`) ein gültiger Festwert der Domäne `S_CARR_ID` ist. Nutzen Sie dabei die Klasse `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` und den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Holen Sie sich die Festwerte und verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf der Ergebnistabelle, um die Existenz des Wertes zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_domain_value_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_carrier_id
      IMPORTING iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_domain_value_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_carrier_id.
    DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( 'S_CARR_ID' ).
    DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_values) = FILTER #( 
      lt_fixed_values_raw USING KEY primary_key WHERE low = iv_carrier_id
    ).

    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN lines( lt_filtered_values ) > 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_valid_carrier_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_domain_value_validation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'AA sollte gültig sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_carrier_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_domain_value_validation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'XX sollte ungültig sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Funktion, um interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. CLASS zcl_domain_text_language DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_language   TYPE sy-langu DEFAULT 'EN'

CLASS zcl_domain_text_language IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_text_in_lang.
    DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( 'S_CARR_ID' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 50 (einschließlich).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife und prüfen Sie auf Duplikate, bevor Sie die Zahl zur Tabelle hinzufügen. Nutzen Sie `COLLECT` oder `INSERT` in einer `SORTED TABLE` oder `HASHED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
                iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
                iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 50
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = iv_min p_max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    WHILE lines( lt_temp_numbers ) < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_unique_numbers = CORRESPONDING #( lt_temp_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should generate 5 unique numbers' ).

    DATA(lt_check_unique) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_check_unique.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_num low = 1 high = 10 msg = 'Number out of range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_unique ) exp = 5 msg = 'Numbers should be unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `HASHED TABLE`, um die Eindeutigkeit der generierten Zufallszahlen effizient zu gewährleisten. Die `WHILE`-Schleife läuft, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist. `CORRESPONDING #` wird verwendet, um die Hashed Table in eine Standardtabelle zu kopieren.
keywords: RANDOM, UNIQUE, INTERNAL TABLES, HASHED TABLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen in `sflights` und generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex zwischen 1 und der Zeilenanzahl. Verwenden Sie dann `READ TABLE INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING   cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_sflight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_sflight) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-carrid msg = 'Flight carrier should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_tolerance_none operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_not_equal ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-connid msg = 'Flight connection should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_tolerance_none operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_not_equal ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'No sflight data found or error reading random entry' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle auswählt. Zuerst werden Daten aus `sflight` gelesen. Dann wird die Anzahl der Zeilen ermittelt, um den Bereich für den Zufallsindex zu definieren. `cl_abap_random_int` generiert den Index, und `READ TABLE INDEX` holt den entsprechenden Eintrag. Fehlerbehandlung für leere Tabellen ist ebenfalls enthalten.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die ursprünglichen Daten und einen zufälligen Sortierschlüssel enthält. Sortieren Sie diese neue Tabelle nach dem Zufallsschlüssel und extrahieren Sie dann die ursprünglichen Daten in der neuen Reihenfolge. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shuffle_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffled.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING it_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 1000000 ). " Large range for good randomness

    DATA(lt_sflights_with_key) = VALUE tt_sflight_shuffled(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next(
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price = ls_sflight-price
      ) )
    ).

    SORT lt_sflights_with_key BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_shuffled IN lt_sflights_with_key
      ( carrid = ls_shuffled-carrid
        connid = ls_shuffled-connid
        fldate = ls_shuffled-fldate
        price = ls_shuffled-price
      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lt_original_sflights) TYPE zcl_shuffle_sflight=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lines( lt_original_sflights ) < 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip( msg = 'Not enough sflight data for shuffle test' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shuffle_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sflights) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Shuffled table size mismatch' ).

    " Check if all original elements are present (order doesn't matter for this check)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original_sflights.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled_sflights.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted msg = 'Elements mismatch after shuffle' ).

    " It's hard to assert randomness directly, but we can check if it's *likely* shuffled
    " For a small table, there's a chance it's not shuffled, but for larger tables, it's highly probable.
    " This is a weak check, but better than nothing for unit testing randomness.
    IF lt_original_sflights = lt_shuffled_sflights.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Table was not shuffled (unlikely for random data)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine zufällige Mischung (Shuffle) einer internen Tabelle. Es wird eine temporäre Tabelle erstellt, die jede Zeile der Originaltabelle zusammen mit einem zufällig generierten Schlüssel enthält. Diese temporäre Tabelle wird dann nach dem Zufallsschlüssel sortiert, wodurch die ursprünglichen Zeilen effektiv gemischt werden. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR` und `VALUE` wird für die Transformation der Tabellen verwendet.
keywords: RANDOM, SHUFFLE, INTERNAL TABLES, SORT, FOR, VALUE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Simulieren Sie 10 Würfelwürfe und geben Sie die Ergebnisse als Liste von Zahlen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für den Bereich 1 bis 6 in einer Schleife und sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS roll_dice
      IMPORTING iv_rolls TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_roller IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 6 ).

CLASS zcl_xco_time_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_diff IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Zeitstempel in das benutzerdefinierte Format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (TZ)', wobei TZ die Zeitzonen-ID ist (z.B. 'CET').

CLASS zcl_xco_time_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                iv_timezone  TYPE timezone
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_timestamp_custom.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_utc( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_timezone) = xco_cp_time=>time_zone->for_id( iv_timezone ).
    DATA(lo_local_timestamp) = lo_timestamp->to_time_zone( lo_timezone ).

    DATA(lv_date) = lo_local_timestamp->get_date( )->value( ).
    DATA(lv_time) = lo_local_timestamp->get_time( )->value( ).

    rv_formatted_string = |{ lv_date(4) }-{ lv_date+4(2) }-{ lv_date+6(2) } { lv_time(2) }:{ lv_time+2(2) }:{ lv_time+4(2) } ({ iv_timezone })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Zeitstempel in der Vergangenheit liegt (bezogen auf den aktuellen UTC-Zeitstempel).
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_utc` und vergleichen Sie mit `xco_cp_time=>timestamp->now_utc` unter Verwendung der Vergleichsoperatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_past DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_timestamp_in_past
      IMPORTING iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_past) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_past IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_timestamp_in_past.
    DATA(lo_given_ts) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_utc( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_current_ts) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->now_utc( ).

    IF lo_given_ts->is_before( lo_current_ts ).
      rv_is_past = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_past = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timestamp_in_past FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timestamp_in_past.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_time_past( ).

    " Test with a timestamp in the past (e.g., 1 hour ago)
    DATA(lv_past_ts) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->now_utc( )->subtract( xco_cp_time=>duration->for_hours( 1 ) )->value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_past_ts ) msg = 'Timestamp 1 hour ago should be in past' ).

    " Test with a timestamp in the future (e.g., 1 hour from now)
    DATA(lv_future_ts) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->now_utc( )->add( xco_cp_time=>duration->for_hours( 1 ) )->value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_future_ts ) msg = 'Timestamp 1 hour from now should not be in past' ).

    " Test with current timestamp (should not be in past, but depends on exact execution time)
    DATA(lv_current_ts) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->now_utc( )->value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_current_ts ) msg = 'Current timestamp should not be in past' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO Time API bietet Methoden zum Vergleich von Zeitstempeln. `is_before()` ist eine intuitive Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein Zeitstempel vor einem anderen liegt. Dies ist eine saubere und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen String-Vergleichen von Zeitstempeln.
keywords: XCO, TIME, TIMESTAMP, PAST, COMPARE, XCO_CP_TIME

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife und eine Hash-Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_5_to_20 RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_5_to_20.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = 20
    ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO 5 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_number INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
          " Duplicate found, try again in the next iteration
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.
    rt_unique_numbers = CORRESPONDING #( lt_temp_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen und generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      " Handle case where no flights are found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_max_index
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Zufallszahlengenerator, der mit einem extern bereitgestellten Seed initialisiert werden kann, um reproduzierbare Zufallssequenzen zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `create_from_seed`-Methode von `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_seeded_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sequence
      IMPORTING
        iv_seed TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_seeded_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sequence.
    DATA(lo_random) = COND #(
      WHEN iv_seed IS SUPPLIED
        THEN cl_abap_random_int=>create_from_seed(
               seed = iv_seed
               low  = 1
               high = 100
             )
      ELSE cl_abap_random_int=>create(
               low  = 1
               high = 100
             )
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND lo_random->get_next( ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_seeded_randomness FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unseeded_randomness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_seeded_randomness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_seeded_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_seq1) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( iv_seed = 123 ).
    DATA(lt_seq2) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( iv_seed = 123 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_seq1 exp = lt_seq2
                                      iv_msg = 'Sequences with same seed should be identical' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unseeded_randomness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_seeded_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_seq1) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( ).
    DATA(lt_seq2) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( ).

    " This assertion might fail if the system clock is the same, but generally should pass
    " for different calls without explicit seed. For robust testing, one might mock the clock.
    " For this example, we assume different calls yield different sequences.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_seq1 exp = lt_seq2
                                       iv_msg = 'Sequences without seed should generally differ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_int=>create_from_seed` zur Erzeugung reproduzierbarer Zufallszahlenfolgen. Dies ist entscheidend für Unit-Tests oder Simulationen, bei denen die Ergebnisse konsistent sein müssen. Die `COND #` Syntax (Conditional Expression) ist eine moderne Art, die Instanziierung des Zufallsgenerators basierend auf dem Vorhandensein eines Seeds zu steuern.
keywords: Zufallszahl, cl_abap_random_int, Seed, Reproduzierbarkeit, COND #, Conditional Expression

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen) aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `create_matcher` in Kombination mit `find_all` oder `find_next`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre(
      pattern = '\d+' " Matches one or more digits
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      DATA(lv_number_str) = lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ).
      APPEND CONV i( lv_number_str ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_delimiter_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_multi_delimiter_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie ein Passwort, das mindestens 8 Zeichen lang sein muss, mindestens einen Großbuchstaben, einen Kleinbuchstaben, eine Ziffer und ein Sonderzeichen enthalten muss.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `cl_abap_regex` Instanzen oder eine komplexe Regex mit Lookaheads.
solution:
CLASS zcl_password_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_password TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_password_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_password.
    " Mindestens 8 Zeichen
    DATA(lo_len_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre( pattern = '.{8,}' ).
    IF lo_len_regex->match( iv_password ) = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Mindestens ein Großbuchstabe
    DATA(lo_upper_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre( pattern = '[A-Z]' ).
    IF lo_upper_regex->match( iv_password ) = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Mindestens ein Kleinbuchstabe
    DATA(lo_lower_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre( pattern = '[a-z]' ).
    IF lo_lower_regex->match( iv_password ) = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Mindestens eine Ziffer
    DATA(lo_digit_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre( pattern = '\d' ).
    IF lo_digit_regex->match( iv_password ) = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Mindestens ein Sonderzeichen (hier: nicht alphanumerisch)
    DATA(lo_special_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre( pattern = '[^A-Za-z0-9]' ).
    IF lo_special_regex->match( iv_password ) = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.

    rv_is_valid = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_tag_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_tag_name    TYPE string

        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_html_tag_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_tag_content.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = |<{ iv_tag_name }>([^<]+)</{ iv_tag_name }>|.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre(
      pattern = lv_pattern
      case_sensitive = abap_false " Tags are often case-insensitive
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_html_string ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      " Group 1 contains the content between the tags
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ) TO rt_content.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges Datum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' enthält und extrahieren Sie es.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Gruppen und `get_submatch` für die Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_date_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_from_string.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre(
      pattern = '\b(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\b'
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rv_date_string = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Kommentare im Stil von `// Kommentar` und `/* Kommentar */` aus einem Code-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit der `replace`-Methode und geeigneten Regex-Mustern für einzeilige und mehrzeilige Kommentare.
solution:
CLASS zcl_comment_remover DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_comments
      IMPORTING
        iv_code_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_clean_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_comment_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_comments.
    DATA(lv_temp_code) = iv_code_string.

    " Entferne einzeilige Kommentare // ... bis zum Zeilenende
    DATA(lo_single_line_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre(
      pattern = '//.*'
    ).
    lv_temp_code = lo_single_line_regex->replace(
      text    = lv_temp_code
      new_sub = ''
    ).

    " Entferne mehrzeilige Kommentare /* ... */
    " Der Modifikator 's' (DOTALL) lässt '.' auch Newlines matchen
    DATA(lo_multi_line_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pcre(
      pattern = '/\*.*?\*/'
      options = 's'
    ).
    rv_clean_code = lo_multi_line_regex->replace(
      text    = lv_temp_code
      new_sub = ''
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_single_line_comment FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multi_line_comment FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_comments FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_comments FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_comments_with_code FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_line_comment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_comment_remover( ).
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->remove_comments( 'CODE // This is a comment' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'CODE '
                                      iv_msg = 'Should remove single line comment' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multi_line_comment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_comment_remover( ).
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->remove_comments( 'CODE /* Multi-line\ncomment */ MORE CODE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'CODE  MORE CODE'
                                      iv_msg = 'Should remove multi-line comment' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_comments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_comment_remover( ).
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->remove_comments( 'LINE1 // C1\nLINE2 /* C2 */\nLINE3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'LINE1 \nLINE2 \nLINE3'
                                      iv_msg = 'Should remove mixed comments' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_comments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_comment_remover( ).
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->remove_comments( 'Just code here.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'Just code here.'
                                      iv_msg = 'Should not change code without comments' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_comments_with_code.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_comment_remover( ).
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->remove_comments( 'DATA(lv_var) = 1. // Init var\nIF lv_var = 1. /* Check */ ENDIF.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'DATA(lv_var) = 1. \nIF lv_var = 1.  ENDIF.'
                                      iv_msg = 'Should remove comments while preserving code' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Entfernen von Kommentaren aus einem Code-String mithilfe von zwei `cl_abap_regex`-Instanzen und der `replace`-Methode. Für mehrzeilige Kommentare ist der `options = 's'` (DOTALL) Modifikator entscheidend, damit der Punkt `.` auch Zeilenumbrüche matcht. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik zur Code-Bereinigung oder -Analyse.
keywords: Regex, cl_abap_regex, replace, Kommentare entfernen, String Processing, Code-Analyse, DOTALL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Flugnummer und den Preis enthält, wobei der Preis um 10% erhöht ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                                        price  = ls_flight-price * '1.10' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-price  = '100.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-price  = '200.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_transformed) = zcl_itb_for_value=>transform_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-price exp = '220.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` zu schreiben, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus den Elementen der Quelltabelle konstruiert, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, CLASS-METHODS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise einer gegebenen internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp erstellt und mit einigen Daten füllt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit einem Typ-Handle und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    CREATE DATA rr_table_ref TYPE HANDLE ir_type_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.

      " Fill with first row
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 100. ENDIF.
      INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

      " Fill with second row
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'Value B'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 200. ENDIF.
      INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_standard(
        p_line_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>get(
            VALUE #( ( name = 'FIELD1' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) )
                     ( name = 'FIELD2' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) ) ) ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = zcl_dyn_table_create=>create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lo_table_descr ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field1> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Value A' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field2> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Datenobjekten, insbesondere von internen Tabellen, ist ein mächtiges Feature in ABAP. Mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und der Verwendung von Feld-Symbolen kann zur Laufzeit auf unbekannte Strukturen und Tabellen zugegriffen und diese manipuliert werden. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Frameworks und Tools.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugdauer (in Tagen) für Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die in einem bestimmten Zeitraum liegen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT`, `FOR`, `REDUCE` und `CL_RECA_DATE` für die Datumsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_days) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_duration.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dates,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             arrdate TYPE sflight-arrdate,
           END OF ty_flight_dates.
    TYPES tt_flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_dates WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_flight_dates) = VALUE tt_flight_dates(
      FOR ls_sflight IN
        ( SELECT fldate, arrdate FROM sflight
          WHERE fldate BETWEEN @iv_start_date AND @iv_end_date
          AND arrdate IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY fldate UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( fldate = ls_sflight-fldate, arrdate = ls_sflight-arrdate ) ).

    IF lt_flight_dates IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_days = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_days) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_dates IN lt_flight_dates
      NEXT sum = sum + cl_reca_date=>get_days_between_dates( iv_date1 = ls_dates-fldate iv_date2 = ls_dates-arrdate ) ).

    rv_avg_days = lv_total_days / lines( lt_flight_dates ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_duration FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_duration_empty FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_duration.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_end) = '20231231'.

    DATA(lv_avg_days) = lo_calculator->calculate_average_duration( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end ).

    " Assert that the average duration is a reasonable positive number
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_avg_days >= 0
      msg = 'Average duration should be non-negative' ).
    " Further assertions would require mocking SFLIGHTS or knowing its exact content
    " For now, we just check if it's calculated and not zero if data exists.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_avg_days > 0
      msg = 'Average duration should be greater than zero for existing flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_duration_empty.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_duration( ).
    " Choose a date range with no flights in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_start) = '19000101'.
    DATA(lv_end) = '19000101'.

    DATA(lv_avg_days) = lo_calculator->calculate_average_duration( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_avg_days
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Average duration should be 0 for no flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert moderne ABAP-Features: `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für effizientes Datenlesen, `VALUE #(...) FOR ...` für die Transformation von Datenbankergebnissen in eine interne Tabelle und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der berechneten Flugdauern. Die `CL_RECA_DATE=>GET_DAYS_BETWEEN_DATES` Methode sorgt für korrekte Datumsarithmetik. Dies ist ein funktionaler und lesbarer Ansatz für komplexe Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Field Catalog-Struktur für ein ALV Grid dynamisch basierend auf einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_alv_fcat_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcato.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_fcat_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_field_catalog.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_fcat = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
                         ( fieldname = ls_comp-name
                           coltext   = ls_comp-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_alv_fcat_creator=>tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'Test1' field2 = 10 )
      ( field1 = 'Test2' field2 = 20 ) ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = lo_creator->create_field_catalog( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'Second fieldname incorrect' ).

Mit der `FOR` Iteration und `VALUE #(...)` wird dann dynamisch ein Field Catalog (`LVC_T_FCAT`) für das ALV Grid erstellt. Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS basierend auf einem Kriterium und bereiten Sie diese für ein ALV Grid auf, wobei nur relevante Felder angezeigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT`, `FILTER` und `MAP` für die Datenverarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_filtered_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_filtered_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN
        ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight
          WHERE price > @iv_min_price
          ORDER BY carrid, connid UP TO 50 ROWS )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    rt_flights = lt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, unter Berücksichtigung eines einfachen Wochenendmodells (Samstag/Sonntag).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_RECA_DATE` und eine Schleife mit `GET_DAY_OF_WEEK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d,
          lv_weekday      TYPE i.

    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      lv_weekday = cl_reca_date=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday. Working days are Monday to Friday (1-5)
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5.
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = cl_reca_date=>add_days( iv_date = lv_current_date iv_days = 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
