Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit definierten Strukturtyp und fülle sie mit Daten.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Erzeugung. `ASSIGN` ist notwendig, um auf die dynamischen Daten zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          ls_component    TYPE abap_compdescr.

    " Dynamische Strukturdefinition
    ls_component-name = 'FIELD1'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO DATA(lt_components).

    ls_component-name = 'FIELD2'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    " Dynamische Tabelle erzeugen
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_row>   TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_row) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_row->* TO <ls_dynamic_row>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field2> = sy-index * 10.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 3 msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen falsch' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_row> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_row>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <ls_row> msg = 'Zweite Zeile nicht gefunden' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Value 2' msg = 'Feldwert FIELD1 falsch' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 20 msg = 'Feldwert FIELD2 falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Struktur einer Tabelle erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist oder flexibel gestaltet werden muss, z.B. in generischen Tools oder Schnittstellen. Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name als String vorliegt, und ändere dessen Wert.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE (structure) TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_value_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data      TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    cs_data = is_data.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <lv_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <lv_field> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String, der eine Uhrzeit in einem externen Format enthält (z.B. '13:45:00'), in das interne ABAP-Uhrzeitformat (`t`) unter Verwendung des Funktionsbausteins `SABP_CONVERT`.
hint: Der Funktionsbaustein `SABP_CONVERT` kann für generische Datentypkonvertierungen verwendet werden. Beachten Sie, dass dies ein älterer Ansatz ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sabp_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_external_time_to_internal
      IMPORTING
        iv_external_time TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_internal_time) TYPE tims
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sabp_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_external_time_to_internal.
    DATA: lv_value_in  TYPE string,
          lv_value_out TYPE tims.

    lv_value_in = iv_external_time.

    CALL FUNCTION 'SABP_CONVERT'
      EXPORTING
        i_value_in  = lv_value_in
        i_datatype  = 'TIMS'
      IMPORTING
        e_value_out = lv_value_out
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS      = 1.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler bei der Konvertierung mit SABP_CONVERT'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_internal_time = lv_value_out.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '134500' msg = 'Konvertierung erfolgreich erwartet' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_time_fail.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_external_time_to_internal( 'INVALID_TIME' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Fehler erwartet bei ungültigem Zeitformat' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung des Funktionsbausteins `SABP_CONVERT` zur Konvertierung eines externen Zeit-Strings in das interne ABAP-Format. Obwohl `SABP_CONVERT` ein älterer Funktionsbaustein ist, wird er in vielen Bestandssystemen noch verwendet. Für neue Entwicklungen sind oft modernere Klassen wie `cl_abap_datfm` oder `cl_abap_timefm` in Kombination mit `CONVERT` Anweisungen vorzuziehen, aber `SABP_CONVERT` erfüllt die Anforderung der generischen Konvertierung.
keywords: SABP_CONVERT, Zeitformat, Conversion, Intermediate, Funktionsbaustein

Instructions: Gruppiere eine Liste von Flugzeiten (aus `SFLIGHT`) nach Stundenbereichen und formatiere die Stunden dynamisch für die Ausgabe.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_timefm` für die Formatierung des Gruppierungsschlüssels. Die Stunde kann direkt aus dem `TIMS`-Feld extrahiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_time,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid  TYPE sflight-connid,
             deptime TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_flight_time.
    TYPES tt_flight_time TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_time WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_time,
             time_group TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_time.
    TYPES tt_grouped_time TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_time WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_hour
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_times) TYPE tt_grouped_time.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_hour.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_time.

    SELECT carrid, connid, deptime
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_time_formatter) = cl_abap_timefm=>get_instance( ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( time_hour = ls_flight-deptime(2) )
                                             ASCENDING
                                             ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<group_key>).
      DATA(lv_formatted_hour) = lo_time_formatter->format_time( iv_time = <group_key>-time_hour && '0000' format = 'HH' ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_time( time_group = |Stunde { lv_formatted_hour }| flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_times.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights_by_hour FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_hour.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_times) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_hour( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped_times msg = 'Gruppierte Zeiten sollten nicht leer sein' ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob eine Gruppe existiert und die Zählung plausibel ist
    DATA(ls_first_group) = lt_grouped_times[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_group-time_group msg = 'Gruppenname sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_group-flight_count > 0 msg = 'Fluganzahl sollte größer Null sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax mit `cl_abap_timefm` zur dynamischen Formatierung des Gruppierungsschlüssels. Es zeigt, wie man Daten effizient nach Zeitkriterien aggregieren und die Ergebnisse benutzerfreundlich aufbereiten kann. Die Extraktion der Stunde mittels `ls_flight-deptime(2)` ist eine einfache Möglichkeit, den Stundenwert zu erhalten, der dann formatiert wird.

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Parameter akzeptiert und deren Zeilenanzahl zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze RTTI (`cl_abap_typedescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) um den Typ der übergebenen Tabelle zu ermitteln und dann dynamisch darauf zuzugreifen. `DESCRIBE TABLE` kann auch verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_line_count
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_line_count.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    IF ir_table IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Referenz zeigt nicht auf eine Tabelle'.
    ENDIF.

    DESCRIBE TABLE <lt_any_table> LINES rv_line_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_table_line_count_filled FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_table_line_count_filled.
    DATA: lt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_test_table.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_test_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_line_count) = lo_cut->get_table_line_count( REF #( lt_test_table ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_line_count exp = 2 msg = 'Zeilenanzahl für gefüllte Tabelle falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_table_line_count_empty.
    DATA: lt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_line_count) = lo_cut->get_table_line_count( REF #( lt_test_table ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_line_count exp = 0 msg = 'Zeilenanzahl für leere Tabelle falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_table_line_count_initial_ref.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_analyzer( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_table_line_count( lr_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception erwartet bei initialer Referenz' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Exception erfolgreich abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI und Field-Symbols die Zeilenanzahl einer internen Tabelle ermittelt, deren Typ zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist. Die Methode akzeptiert eine generische Datenreferenz (`REF TO data`), weist sie einem generischen Field-Symbol (`ANY TABLE`) zu und verwendet dann `DESCRIBE TABLE`, um die Zeilen zu zählen. Dies ist essenziell für generische Frameworks oder Tools, die mit beliebigen Tabellentypen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: DYNAMIC, RTTI, Internal Tables, Advanced, DESCRIBE TABLE

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any_field>     TYPE any.

    IF ir_structure IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <ls_any_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Referenz zeigt nicht auf eine Struktur'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_structure> TO <lv_any_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur gefunden|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <lv_any_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Prozentsatz von `value` zu `total`. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass `total` Null ist, indem Sie 0 zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_math_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittswert einer Liste von Ganzzahlen. Wenn die Liste leer ist, soll 0 zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE` Expression, um die Summe zu bilden, und anschließend den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    rv_average = COND #( WHEN lv_count = 0 THEN 0
                            ELSE lv_sum / lv_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` das Verhältnis von belegten Sitzen zu maximalen Sitzen (`OCCUPANCY_RATE`) enthält. Flüge ohne maximale Sitzplatzkapazität sollen einen Wert von 0 erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
        carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate         TYPE s_date,
        occupancy_rate TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_rates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_rates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            ( carrid         = flight-carrid
                              connid         = flight-connid
                              fldate         = flight-fldate
                              occupancy_rate = COND #( WHEN flight-seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                                                       ELSE ( flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / flight-seatsmax ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_rates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_rates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_rates( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_occupancy ).
    " Test with specific data if available, otherwise check general structure
    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_occupancy) WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_occupancy-occupancy_rate ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression wird verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen, indem über die Zeilen der `sflights`-Tabelle iteriert wird. Für jede Zeile wird die Belegungsrate mit dem `DIVIDE` Operator berechnet, wobei `COND` eine Division durch Null verhindert. Dies ist ein funktionaler und effizienter Weg, Daten zu transformieren, der oft in RAP-Behavior-Implementierungen genutzt wird.
keywords: DIVIDE, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, sflights, Functional Programming, cl_abap_behavior_handler

                          ELSE 'NORMAL' ).

Instructions: Mappen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur auf eine Zielstruktur, wobei einige Felder unterschiedliche Namen haben.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        id      TYPE i,
        name    TYPE string,
        value   TYPE decfloat16,

        item_id TYPE i,
        title   TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.

    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING item_id = id

    rs_target-status = 'PROCESSED'. " Add a default value
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge von `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine maximale Anzahl von Zeilen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        cityfrom TYPE s_city,
        cityto TYPE s_city,
      END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES:
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_limited
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_limited.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flights_limited FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_zero_rows FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_limited( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_max_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should return 5 rows' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_zero_rows.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_limited( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_max_rows = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Syntax `INTO TABLE @DATA()` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Ziel-Tabelle, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. `UP TO N ROWS` ist effizient, um nur eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen zu lesen. Diese Muster sind grundlegend für die Datenbeschaffung in RAP-Behavior-Implementierungen, wo oft nur die für die aktuelle Operation benötigten Daten geladen werden.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE @DATA(), UP TO N ROWS, Database Access, sflights, RAP, cl_abap_behavior_handler

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`TOTAL_SEATS_OCCUPIED`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_occupancy,
        carrid               TYPE s_carr_id,
        total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
      END OF ty_grouped_occupancy.
    TYPES:
      tt_grouped_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_occ) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_occupancy( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                         total_seats_occupied = lv_total_occ ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->get_grouped_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped ).
    " Example: Check if 'AA' exists and has a positive total
    READ TABLE lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_aa_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_group-total_seats_occupied > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können Aggregationen für jede Gruppe effizient berechnet werden. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die in komplexen RAP-Behavior-Implementierungen zur Datenanalyse und -zusammenfassung eingesetzt werden kann.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming, RAP, cl_abap_behavior_handler

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält.

CLASS zcl_distinct_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_distinct_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carrids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN lt_sflights ( carrid ) ).

In RAP-Behavior-Implementierungen kann dies verwendet werden, um Kernlogik oder Utility-Klassen vor Änderungen zu schützen, die die Stabilität des Systems beeinträchtigen könnten, ähnlich wie die Basisklasse `cl_abap_behavior_handler` selbst eine feste Schnittstelle bietet.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Integern, wobei leere Strings als 0 behandelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CONV` Operator innerhalb eines `FOR` Ausdrucks mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_strings_to_ints
      IMPORTING
        iv_string_table TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_int_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_ints.
    rt_int_table = VALUE #( FOR <fs_string> IN iv_string_table
                            ( CONV i( COND #( WHEN <fs_string> IS INITIAL THEN 0 ELSE <fs_string> ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_string_to_int( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( '10' ) ( '20' ) ( '30' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected_ints) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual_ints) = lo_cut->convert_strings_to_ints( lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_ints exp = lt_expected_ints ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_string_to_int( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( '1' ) ( '' ) ( '3' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected_ints) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 0 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual_ints) = lo_cut->convert_strings_to_ints( lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_ints exp = lt_expected_ints ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV` Operator wird hier in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `VALUE` verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle von Strings effizient in eine Tabelle von Integern umzuwandeln. Die `COND` Expression behandelt leere Strings als 0, was eine robuste Konvertierung ermöglicht. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu transformieren.
keywords: CONV, VALUE, FOR, COND, Type Conversion, Internal Tables

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur, wobei einige Felder umbenannt und der Preis in eine Währung mit 2 Dezimalstellen umgewandelt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `CONV` für die Feldkonvertierung und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             price_eur TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2, " Price in EUR with 2 decimals
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES ty_sflight_reduced_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS convert_sflight_to_reduced
          IMPORTING
            it_sflight TYPE sflight_tt
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_reduced_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_reduced_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_reduced.
    rt_reduced_sflight = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN it_sflight
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( sflight_line MAPPING
                                                      carrier_id = carrid\                                                      connection_num = connid
                                                      flight_date = fldate
                                                      price_eur = CONV p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2( sflight_line-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_input) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1234.56' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '789.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_output) = VALUE ty_sflight_reduced_tt(
      ( carrier_id = 'LH' connection_num = '0400' flight_date = '20250101' price_eur = '1234.56' )
      ( carrier_id = 'AA' connection_num = '0017' flight_date = '20250102' price_eur = '789.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_output) = lo_cut->convert_sflight_to_reduced( lt_sflight_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_output ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_output[ 1 ]-price_eur exp = lt_expected_output[ 1 ]-price_eur ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_output[ 2 ]-price_eur exp = lt_expected_output[ 2 ]-price_eur ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_output exp = lt_expected_output ). " Full table comparison
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` mit dem `CONV` Operator. Es ermöglicht die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur, wobei Felder umbenannt und gleichzeitig Typkonvertierungen (hier `price` zu `p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2`) in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung durchgeführt werden. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und effizienter als traditionelle `LOOP` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Anweisungen.
keywords: CONV, CORRESPONDING, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Structure Conversion, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation, die für den binären Datentransfer geeignet ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>FILL_CONTAINER_X`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_container_table_to_x DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_table_to_x IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_value    = it_sflight
          IMPORTING
            ex_container = rv_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_buffer_overflow.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_error
            message = 'Buffer overflow during XSTRING conversion'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_error
            message = 'Conversion error during XSTRING conversion'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_to_xstring FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_to_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_container_table_to_x( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_input) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1234.56' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_table_to_xstring( lt_sflight_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = xstrlen( lv_xstring ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_container_table_to_x( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_input) = VALUE sflight_tt( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_table_to_xstring( lt_sflight_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_xstring ). " Empty table should result in empty xstring
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `FILL_CONTAINER_X` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` bietet eine standardisierte und effiziente Möglichkeit, beliebige ABAP-Datenobjekte, insbesondere interne Tabellen, in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation zu serialisieren. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen Daten binär übertragen oder gespeichert werden müssen, z.B. in Datenbankfeldern vom Typ RAWSTRING oder bei der Kommunikation mit externen Systemen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier wichtig.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES, XSTRING, Serialization, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING-Repräsentation von Flugdaten zurück in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>READ_CONTAINER_X`.

explanation: Die Methode `READ_CONTAINER_X` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` ist das Gegenstück zu `FILL_CONTAINER_X`. Sie ermöglicht die Deserialisierung einer XSTRING-Repräsentation zurück in das ursprüngliche ABAP-Datenobjekt, hier eine interne Tabelle. Dies ist entscheidend, um zuvor serialisierte Daten wieder in einem verwendbaren Format zu erhalten. Die Robustheit wird durch die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` gewährleistet.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Strings und konvertieren Sie jeden String in einen Integer, speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen Tabelle. Behandeln Sie nicht-numerische Strings als 0.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO` und den `CONV` Operator mit `TRY` für die Fehlerbehandlung bei der Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_loop_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_elements
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_loop_string_to_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_elements.
    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      DATA(lv_integer) = 0.
      TRY.
          lv_integer = CONV i( lv_string ).
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Non-numeric string, lv_integer remains 0
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND lv_integer TO rt_integers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_loop_string_to_int( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( '100' ) ( '200' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 100 ) ( 200 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->convert_table_elements( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_loop_string_to_int( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( '50' ) ( 'ABC' ) ( '75' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 50 ) ( 0 ) ( 75 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->convert_table_elements( lt_input ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von einfachen Strings in eine einzelne STRING-Repräsentation, die durch ein Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma) getrennt ist, ähnlich einem CSV-Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>FILL_CONTAINER_C` und anschließend `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_container_table_to_c DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_string
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_delimiter TYPE string DEFAULT ','
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_table_to_c IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_string.
    DATA lv_container TYPE string.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_c(
          EXPORTING
            im_value    = it_strings
          IMPORTING
            ex_container = lv_container
        ).
        " The container utility serializes the table, but not necessarily with a simple delimiter.
        " For a CSV-like format, we need to join the elements.
        " This example focuses on the container utility itself.
        " For actual CSV, use CL_RSAN_UT_CSV or custom logic.
        " Here, we just demonstrate the container utility's output structure.
        " For a simple join, we can use REDUCE or CONCATENATE LINES OF.
        rv_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR <fs_string> IN it_strings NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_string> ELSE s && iv_delimiter && <fs_string> ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_buffer_overflow.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_error
            message = 'Buffer overflow during STRING conversion'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_error
            message = 'Conversion error during STRING conversion'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, die ein Datumsfeld als STRING enthalten, in eine neue Tabelle, in der das Datumsfeld korrekt als DATS-Typ vorliegt. Ungültige Datums-Strings sollen zu einem Initialdatum ('00000000') konvertiert werden.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_string,
             id TYPE i,
             date_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_string.
    TYPES ty_data_string_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_dats,
             id TYPE i,
             date_dats TYPE dats,
           END OF ty_data_dats.
    TYPES ty_data_dats_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_dats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_dats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS convert_date_strings
          IMPORTING
            it_data_string TYPE ty_data_string_tt
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_data_dats) TYPE ty_data_dats_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_dats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_date_strings.
    rt_data_dats = VALUE #( FOR ls_string IN it_data_string
                              ( id = ls_string-id
                                date_dats = COND dats( LET lv_dats = ls_string-date_str IN
                                                        TRY CONV dats( lv_dats ) CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error = dats( '00000000' ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine XSTRING und deserialisieren Sie diese anschließend in eine interne Tabelle mit einer leicht abweichenden Struktur, wobei der Preis in eine Währung mit 2 Dezimalstellen umgewandelt wird. Demonstrieren Sie einen Roundtrip mit Typkonvertierung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>FILL_CONTAINER_X`, `READ_CONTAINER_X` und `CONV` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             price_eur TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES ty_sflight_reduced_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_container_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS serialize_and_deserialize
          IMPORTING
            it_sflight_original TYPE sflight_tt
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_sflight_converted) TYPE ty_sflight_reduced_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_and_deserialize.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA lt_sflight_temp TYPE sflight_tt.

    TRY.
        " 1. Serialize original table to XSTRING
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_value    = it_sflight_original
          IMPORTING
            ex_container = lv_xstring
        ).

        " 2. Deserialize XSTRING back to a temporary table of original type
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_container = lv_xstring
          IMPORTING
            ex_value     = lt_sflight_temp
        ).

        " 3. Convert temporary table to target structure with CONV and CORRESPONDING
        rt_sflight_converted = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_temp
                                        ( CORRESPONDING #( sflight_line MAPPING
                                                            carrier_id = carrid
                                                            connection_num = connid
                                                            flight_date = fldate
                                                            price_eur = CONV p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2( sflight_line-price ) ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_buffer_overflow cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_error
            message = 'Error during serialization/deserialization with type conversion'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_container_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_input) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1234.56' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '789.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_output) = VALUE ty_sflight_reduced_tt(
      ( carrier_id = 'LH' connection_num = '0400' flight_date = '20250101' price_eur = '1234.56' )
      ( carrier_id = 'AA' connection_num = '0017' flight_date = '20250102' price_eur = '789.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_output) = lo_cut->serialize_and_deserialize( lt_sflight_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_output exp = lt_expected_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_container_roundtrip( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_output exp = lt_expected_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Der `CONV`-Operator kann auch für die Zuweisung von Strukturen verwendet werden, wenn die Feldnamen und -typen kompatibel sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_target,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_target.

    METHODS convert_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_s_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_s_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_structure.
    rs_target = CONV #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_struct_conversion.
    DATA ls_source TYPE zcl_conv_struct=>ty_s_source.
    ls_source-field1 = 10.
    ls_source-field2 = 'Hello'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->convert_structure( ls_source ).

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) und modifizieren Sie dynamisch ein bestimmtes numerisches Feld (z.B. 'SEATSMAX'), indem Sie seinen Wert verdoppeln. Verwenden Sie dabei FIELD-SYMBOLS und eine FOR-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer `FOR ... IN ...` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS double_field_value
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD double_field_value.
    rt_data = it_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT rt_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> IS INITIAL = abap_false.
        IF <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
          <fs_field> = <fs_field> * 2.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_double_seatsmax FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_double_seatsmax.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_update=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_update=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-seatsmax = 100.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '001'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-seatsmax = 200.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_update( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->double_field_value( it_data = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'SEATSMAX' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO ls_sflight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-seatsmax exp = 200 msg = 'First flight seatsmax should be doubled' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO ls_sflight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-seatsmax exp = 400 msg = 'Second flight seatsmax should be doubled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_update=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_update=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-seatsmax = 100.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_update( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->double_field_value( it_data = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO ls_sflight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-seatsmax exp = 100 msg = 'Seatsmax should remain unchanged for invalid field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit, was besonders nützlich ist, wenn der Feldname nicht fest codiert werden kann. In Kombination mit der `FOR`-Schleife (oder `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`) ist dies eine effiziente Methode zur Bearbeitung interner Tabellen, da keine unnötigen Datenkopien entstehen.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gespeichert ist. Lesen Sie den Wert dieser Komponente in eine String-Variable.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found or not assigned'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines dynamisch angegebenen numerischen Feldes in einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff und die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_sum.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR <fs_line> IN it_data
                       LET lv_current_value = 0 IN
                         ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
                         IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
                           lv_current_value = <fs_field>.
                         ENDIF.
                         NEXT sum = sum + lv_current_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) basierend auf einem dynamischen Feldnamen und einem dynamischen Vergleichswert. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Operator und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.

CLASS zcl_fs_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data USING KEY primary_key
                                 WHERE ( LET lv_field_value = '' IN
                                           ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE table_line TO <fs_field>.
                                           IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                                             lv_field_value = <fs_field>.
                                           ENDIF.
                                           lv_field_value = iv_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf einem Objekt auf, das durch ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` referenziert wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object_ref)` oder `CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(lv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_callable.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_callable.
  METHODS get_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_version RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE string.

    ASSIGN io_object TO <fs_object>.

    IF <fs_object> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = <fs_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ELSE.
            rv_result = 'Method call failed or no string result'.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          rv_result = 'Dynamic method call error'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Object not assigned'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dynamisch definierten Spalten (z.B. basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff auf die dynamisch erstellten Zeilen und Felder.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und -befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
        it_data_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lv_index) = 0.
      DATA(lv_field_count) = lines( it_field_names ).
      DATA(lv_data_count) = lines( it_data_values ).

      WHILE lv_index < lv_data_count.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.
        IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
            DATA(lv_field_index) = sy-tabix - 1.
            DATA(lv_data_value_index) = lv_index + lv_field_index.
            IF lv_data_value_index < lv_data_count.
              READ TABLE it_data_values INDEX lv_data_value_index INTO DATA(lv_value).
              FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_field> = lv_value.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.
        lv_index = lv_index + lv_field_count.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_fs_dynamic_table=>tt_field_names( ( 'COL1' ) ( 'COL2' ) ( 'COL3' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 'A1' ) ( 'B1' ) ( 'C1' ) ( 'A2' ) ( 'B2' ) ( 'C2' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_field_names = lt_field_names it_data_values = lt_data_values ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Dynamic table should have 2 rows' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_col1> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_col1> exp = 'A1' msg = 'First row, COL1 should be A1' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_col2> exp = 'B2' msg = 'Second row, COL2 should be B2' ).

CLASS zcl_cts_write_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. TYPES tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY. METHODS format_file_content IMPORTING it_lines TYPE tt_lines iv_header TYPE string OPTIONAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_file_content) TYPE string. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_cts_write_content IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD format_file_content. " In einem realen Szenario würde der zurückgegebene String an " cl_cts_language_file_io=>write_file_content übergeben werden. DATA(lv_newline) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf. rv_file_content = REDUCE string( INIT result = COND string( WHEN iv_header IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ iv_header }{ lv_newline }| ELSE '' ) FOR line IN it_lines NEXT result = |{ result }{ line }{ lv_newline }| ). " Remove trailing newline if present IF rv_file_content IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_file_content+
( strlen( rv_file_content ) - strlen( lv_newline ) ) = lv_newline. rv_file_content = rv_file_content( strlen( rv_file_content ) - strlen( lv_newline ) ). ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie simulierten Sprachdateiinhalte (z.B. eine Properties-Datei im Format `KEY=VALUE`) und extrahieren Sie Schlüssel-Wert-Paare in eine `HASHED TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `SPLIT` und `CONDENSE`, um Zeilen in eine `HASHED TABLE` zu parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_parse_properties DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_property,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_property.
    TYPES tt_properties TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_property WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS parse_properties
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_properties) TYPE tt_properties.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_parse_properties IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_properties.
    DATA(lv_newline) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    rt_properties = VALUE tt_properties(
      FOR <line> IN SPLIT iv_file_content AT lv_newline
      LET lv_line = CONV string( <line> ) IN
      WHERE ( lv_line IS NOT INITIAL AND NOT lv_line CS '#' AND lv_line CS '=' )
      LET lv_key = CONDENSE( SUBSTRING( val = lv_line len = find( val = lv_line sub = '=' ) ) ),
          lv_value = CONDENSE( SUBSTRING( val = lv_line off = find( val = lv_line sub = '=' ) + 1 ) ) IN
      ( key = lv_key value = lv_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_uppercase
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_lines) TYPE tt_lines.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_uppercase.
    DATA(lv_newline) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lt_all_lines) = VALUE tt_lines(
      FOR <line> IN SPLIT iv_file_content AT lv_newline
      ( CONV string( <line> ) ) ).

    rt_processed_lines = VALUE tt_lines(
      FOR <line> IN FILTER tt_lines(
        lt_all_lines WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL AND NOT table_line CS '#' ) )
      ( TO UPPER( <line> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_robust_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS read_file_robustly
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data.

CLASS zcl_cts_robust_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_robustly.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file_content aufgerufen werden.
    " Für den Unit-Test wird der Inhalt direkt übergeben.

    IF iv_file_content IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_data=>cx_abap_invalid_data
          previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = 'File content is empty' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate some processing that might fail
    IF iv_file_content CS 'ERROR_FORMAT'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_data=>cx_abap_invalid_data
          previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = 'File content has unexpected format' ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_processed_content = |Processed: { iv_file_content }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine simulierte Sprachdatei (als String) eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen enthält, die mit einem gegebenen Präfix beginnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT` mit einer `FOR`-Expression und `STARTS WITH`.

CLASS zcl_cts_line_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_lines_with_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content TYPE string
        iv_prefix       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_line_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_lines_with_prefix.
    DATA(lv_newline) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    rv_count = COUNT #( FOR <line> IN SPLIT iv_file_content AT lv_newline
                         WHERE ( CONV string( <line> ) STARTS WITH iv_prefix ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_replace_case_insens DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cts_replace_case_insens IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_text_case_insensitive.
    rv_modified_content = iv_file_content.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_text IN rv_modified_content
            IGNORING CASE
            WITH iv_new_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer simulierten Sprachdatei, der als `XSTRING` vorliegt, in einen `STRING` und umgekehrt. Dies ist relevant, wenn `cl_cts_language_file_io` Binärdaten verarbeitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` für die Konvertierung zwischen `XSTRING` und `STRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_xstring_string_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_xstring_string_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD xstring_to_string.
    TRY.
        rv_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( iv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        rv_string = 'Conversion Error'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        " Handle error
        rv_xstring = xstring_from_string( 'Conversion Error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Schnittstelle für das Lesen von Dateiinhalten, die von verschiedenen Implementierungen (z.B. für verschiedene Dateitypen oder Quellen) genutzt werden kann. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung mit einer Klasse, die simulierten Sprachdateiinhalte liest.
hint: Verwenden Sie Interfaces und Polymorphie, um eine flexible Architektur für das Lesen von Dateien zu schaffen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_file_reader.
  METHODS read_content
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
    RAISING
      cx_abap_file_io.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_cts_language_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_file_reader.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulated_content TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_simulated_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_language_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_simulated_content = iv_simulated_content.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_file_reader~read_content.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file_content aufgerufen werden.
    " Für diese Demo wird der simulierte Inhalt zurückgegeben.
    IF mv_simulated_content IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_file_io=>cx_abap_file_io
          previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = 'Simulated file content is empty' ).
    ENDIF.
    rv_content = mv_simulated_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit aus, inklusive deren Namen und Typen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data()` und die Methode `get_components()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
             decimals  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_comp-type ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name      = ls_comp-name
        type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
        length    = lo_elem_descr->length
        decimals  = lo_elem_descr->decimals
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

             field1 TYPE string,

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD1' INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD2' INTO DATA(ls_comp2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp2-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int4 ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD3' INTO DATA(ls_comp3).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp3-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp3-decimals exp = 2 ).

Jede Komponente enthält einen Typdeskriptor, der weiter gecastet werden kann, um spezifische Informationen wie `type_kind`, `length` und `decimals` zu extrahieren. Dies ist essenziell für generische Datenverarbeitung oder die Implementierung von Frameworks. Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` und `APPEND VALUE ... TO` sind moderne ABAP-Konstrukte.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Variable eines bestimmten elementaren Typs und Länge zur Laufzeit und weisen Sie ihr einen Wert zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name()` oder `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind_and_length()` und `create_data()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_elem_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_set_elem
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1 " e.g., 'C', 'I', 'P', 'g' (string)
        iv_length    TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_decimals  TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_elem_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_elem.
    DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    TRY.
        IF iv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        ELSEIF iv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_xstring.
          lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_xstring( ).
        ELSE.
          lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind_and_length(
            p_type_kind = iv_type_kind
            p_length    = iv_length
            p_decimals  = iv_decimals
          ).
        ENDIF.

        DATA(dref) = lo_elem_descr->create_data( ).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs_data>.

        IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_data> = iv_value.
          rv_result = <fs_data>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur basierend auf einer Liste von Komponentenbeschreibungen (Name, Typ, Länge).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` mit einer Tabelle von `abap_componentdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_comp_def,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
             decimals  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_comp_def.
    TYPES: tt_comp_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_comp_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_structure
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_comp_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_structure.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.
      IF ls_comp_def-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ELSEIF ls_comp_def-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_xstring.
        lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_xstring( ).
      ELSE.
        lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind_and_length(
          p_type_kind = ls_comp_def-type_kind
          p_length    = ls_comp_def-length
          p_decimals  = ls_comp_def-decimals
        ).
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE abap_componentdescr(
        name = ls_comp_def-name
        type = lo_elem_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    rr_data = lo_struct_descr->create_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Eine Tabelle von `abap_componentdescr` wird aufgebaut, wobei jeder Eintrag den Namen und den Typdeskriptor einer Komponente definiert. Diese Typdeskriptoren werden wiederum dynamisch mit `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind_and_length()` erzeugt. Anschließend wird `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` verwendet, um einen Strukturdeskriptor zu erhalten, aus dem dann mit `create_data()` eine dynamische Strukturinstanz erzeugt wird. Der Zugriff auf die Komponenten erfolgt über Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Diese Technik ist für hochflexible Anwendungen und Metadaten-gesteuerte Prozesse unerlässlich.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem bestimmten Zeilentyp und Tabellentyp (z.B. Standardtabelle von Strings).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` mit einem Zeilentyp-Deskriptor und `abap_tablekind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1 " e.g., 'C', 'I', 'g' (string)
        iv_line_length    TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_line_decimals  TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_table_kind     TYPE c LENGTH 1 " e.g., 'S' (Standard), 'A' (Sorted), 'H' (Hashed)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_line_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    IF iv_line_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
      lo_line_type_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    ELSEIF iv_line_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_xstring.
      lo_line_type_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_xstring( ).
    ELSEIF iv_line_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      " For structures, you'd need a struct descriptor here, e.g., from cl_abap_structdescr=>create()
      " For simplicity, this example focuses on elementary line types.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING text = 'Structure line types not supported in this example'.
    ELSE.
      lo_line_type_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind_and_length(
        p_type_kind = iv_line_type_kind
        p_length    = iv_line_length
        p_decimals  = iv_line_decimals
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_line_type_descr
      p_table_kind = iv_table_kind
    ).

    rr_data = lo_table_descr->create_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol dynamisch eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen/ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT <component_name> OF STRUCTURE <structure> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_comp_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id     TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value  TYPE i,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure    TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        cs_structure    TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_comp_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.

    IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Component '{ iv_component_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_structure TO <fs_component>.

    IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine grundlegende RTTI-Technik, die es ermöglicht, generische Routinen zu schreiben, die mit beliebigen Strukturen und deren Feldern interagieren können, ohne deren genaue Definition zur Entwicklungszeit zu kennen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist hierbei zentral. String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit bei der String-Formatierung.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob zwei Variablen vom gleichen Typ sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data()` für beide Variablen und vergleichen Sie die resultierenden Typdeskriptoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_identical
      IMPORTING
        iv_data1 TYPE any
        iv_data2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_identical.
    DATA(lo_type_descr1) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_type_descr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).

    IF lo_type_descr1->type_kind = lo_type_descr2->type_kind AND
       lo_type_descr1->length    = lo_type_descr2->length AND
       lo_type_descr1->decimals  = lo_type_descr2->decimals.
      rb_identical = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_identical = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lv_str1 TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_ddic_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_ddic_structure.
    DATA: lo_data_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_ddic_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

        lo_data_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
        lo_ddic_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_ddic_name ).

        IF lo_data_descr->get_relative_name( ) = lo_ddic_descr->get_relative_name( ).
          rb_is_ddic = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rb_is_ddic = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " If describe_by_name fails (e.g., DDIC type not found), it's not the DDIC type.
        rb_is_ddic = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data()` für den Zeilentyp und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` für die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        is_template_struct TYPE any STRUCTURE
        it_raw_data        TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data)     TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_template_struct ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
    ).

    rr_data = lo_table_descr->create_data( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any structure.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_raw_data INTO DATA(lv_raw_line).
      CREATE DATA dref_line LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN dref_line->* TO <fs_line>.

      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
      DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
          DATA(lv_comp_value) = lv_raw_line+lv_offset(ls_comp-type->length).
          <fs_component> = lv_comp_value.
        ENDIF.
        lv_offset = lv_offset + ls_comp-type->length.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird der Typdeskriptor der Vorlagenstruktur (`is_template_struct`) ermittelt. Dieser wird dann als Zeilentyp für die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle verwendet. Die Rohdaten (`it_raw_data`) werden zeilenweise verarbeitet. Für jede Zeile wird dynamisch eine neue Strukturzeile erstellt, deren Komponenten wiederum dynamisch über `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `lv_raw_line+lv_offset(length)` befüllt werden. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik für die Verarbeitung von Daten, deren Struktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Import von CSV-Dateien in dynamisch erzeugte Tabellen.
