Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll keine Parameter haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_message_provider.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_message_provider.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = mv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lv_method_name_upper TYPE string.
    lv_method_name_upper = to_upper( iv_method_name ).

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name_upper) OF io_object.
        rv_success = abap_true.
        mv_message = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' called successfully.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        mv_message = |Error calling method '{ iv_method_name }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

        rv_message = mv_last_called_method.
      ENDMETHOD.

      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD method_b.
        mv_last_called_method = 'Method B was called'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_test_obj
      iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_test_obj->if_message_provider~get_message() exp = 'Method A was called' ).

    lv_success = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_test_obj
      iv_method_name = 'method_b'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_test_obj->if_message_provider~get_message() exp = 'Method B was called' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_fail.
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_test_obj
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' act = lo_cut->if_message_provider~get_message() ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Attribute (Instanzvariablen) einer Klasse zur Laufzeit und deren Typinformationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name()` und `get_attributes()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
             decimals  TYPE i,
             read_only TYPE abap_bool,
             is_static TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

        LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr).
          DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.
          IF ls_attr-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
            lo_elem_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ).
          ELSEIF ls_attr-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_xstring.
            lo_elem_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_xstring( ) ).
          ELSEIF ls_attr-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct OR
                 ls_attr-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
            " Handle complex types if needed, for simplicity, only elementary info is extracted here
            CONTINUE.
          ELSE.
            lo_elem_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_attr-type ).
          ENDIF.

          APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
            name      = ls_attr-name
            type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
            length    = lo_elem_descr->length
            decimals  = lo_elem_descr->decimals
            read_only = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_attr-read_only = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
            is_static = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_attr-is_static = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
          ) TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Methoden einer Klasse zur Laufzeit, inklusive deren Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name()` und `get_methods()`. Für Parameter `get_parameters()` des Methodendeskriptors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
             kind      TYPE c LENGTH 1, " I, E, C, R
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES: tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             is_static  TYPE abap_bool,
             is_abstract TYPE abap_bool,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameter_info,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method).
          DATA(ls_method_info) = VALUE ty_method_info(
            name      = ls_method-name
            is_static = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_method-is_static = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
            is_abstract = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_method-is_abstract = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
          ).

          DATA(lo_method_descr) = CAST cl_abap_methdescr( ls_method-type ).
          DATA(lt_parameters) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

          LOOP AT lt_parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
            DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.
            IF ls_param-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
              lo_elem_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ).
            ELSEIF ls_param-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_xstring.
              lo_elem_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_xstring( ) ).
            ELSEIF ls_param-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct OR
                   ls_param-type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
              " Handle complex types if needed, for simplicity, only elementary info is extracted here
              CONTINUE.
            ELSE.
              lo_elem_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_param-type ).
            ENDIF.

            APPEND VALUE ty_parameter_info(
              name      = ls_param-name
              type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
              length    = lo_elem_descr->length
              kind      = ls_param-kind
            ) TO ls_method_info-parameters.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND ls_method_info TO rt_methods.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_ddic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtm_reduce_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_reduce_operation RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_rtm_reduce_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_reduce_operation.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50000 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DATA(lv_total_distance) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                         NEXT sum = sum + flight-distance ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    rv_runtime_ms = ( lv_end_time - lv_start_time ) / 1000. " Convert microseconds to milliseconds
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer nach `CARRID` gruppierten `REDUCE`-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, price
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.
    ENDIF.

    rt_summary = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      LET total_flights = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
          total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                           total_flights = total_flights
                                           total_price = total_price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_fae_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    SORT rt_sflights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_sflights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_all_flights = it_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_all_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( FILTER #( mt_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ) ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_eur_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_eur_flights.
    DATA lt_initial_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_initial_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_initial_flights WHERE fldate > sy-datum AND currency = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             price    TYPE s_price,

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_transform_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_all_flights = it_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_prices.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_all_flights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        new_price = ls_flight-price * '1.10' ) 
    ).

    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_optimized_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_connids TYPE tt_carrid_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_optimized IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_optimized_flights.
    DATA lt_unique_carrid_connids TYPE tt_carrid_connid.

    lt_unique_carrid_connids = it_carrid_connids.
    SORT lt_unique_carrid_connids BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_carrid_connids COMPARING carrid connid.

    IF lt_unique_carrid_connids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_unique_carrid_connids
        WHERE carrid = @lt_unique_carrid_connids-carrid
          AND connid = @lt_unique_carrid_connids-connid
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_table_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_table_components.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).
        lr_struct_descr ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          " In a real scenario, you might write to ALV, log, or return a structured result
          WRITE: / 'Component Name:', ls_component-name, 'Type:', ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ).
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_abap_invalid_table_param.
        " Handle error: not a table or invalid reference
        WRITE: / 'Error: Input is not a valid internal table reference.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie zwei aufeinanderfolgende `FOR ALL ENTRIES`-Abfragen, um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` zu verknüpfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_join_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_scarr.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrname
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE tt_sflight_scarr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_join_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrname.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      " 1. Get flights based on input carrids
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

      " 2. Get carrier names for the selected flights
      IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
        " Ensure lt_sflights is sorted and unique for FAE on SCARR
        SORT lt_sflights BY carrid.
        DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_sflights COMPARING carrid.

        SELECT carrid, carrname
          FROM scarr
          FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_sflights
          WHERE carrid = @lt_sflights-carrid
          INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Combine data
    rt_flights_with_name = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET ls_scarr = lt_scarr[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] IN
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        carrname = ls_scarr-carrname,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        price    = ls_flight-price,
        currency = ls_flight-currency ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        zcx_flight_not_found.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rs_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ). " Assuming AA 0017 exists

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

CLASS zcl_fae_update_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_updated_price
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
        iv_percentage_increase TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_update_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_updated_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        price    = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage_increase / 100 ),
        currency = ls_flight-currency ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_above_average
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_average.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_average_price) = lv_total_price / lines( lt_all_flights ).

      rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE price > lv_average_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_flight_input FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_above_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_functional_sflights=>tt_carrid(
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_average( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).

    " Verify that all returned flights have a price above the calculated average
    DATA lt_all_flights_for_avg TYPE zcl_functional_sflights=>tt_sflight.
    IF lt_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @lt_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights_for_avg.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights_for_avg
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
    DATA(lv_average_price) = COND #( WHEN lines( lt_all_flights_for_avg ) > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lines( lt_all_flights_for_avg ) ELSE 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price > lv_average_price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_functional_sflights=>tt_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_average( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_flight_input.

    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_functional_sflights=>tt_carrid(
      ( carrid = 'AZ' ) " Assuming AZ has at least one flight
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Es zeigt, wie Zwischenergebnisse (Durchschnittspreis) berechnet und dann für weitere Filterungen verwendet werden können.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_get_name.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    " Annahme: cl_clb_parse_json hat eine Methode parse_json, die einen JSON-String

          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            cs_target_data = ls_data
        ).
        rv_name = ls_data-name.
      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_name = 'ERROR'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle, basierend auf einem oder mehreren Schlüsselfeldern. Die Tabelle muss vorher sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...` nach einer `SORT`-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message_type TYPE char1,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_log_entries TYPE tt_log_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_logs) TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_logs = it_log_entries.
    " Für DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES muss die Tabelle sortiert sein.
    SORT rt_unique_logs BY timestamp message_type.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_logs COMPARING timestamp message_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts1 message_type = 'W' message = 'Warning 1' ) TO lt_logs.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts2 message_type = 'I' message = 'Info 2' ) TO lt_logs.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts2 message_type = 'I' message = 'Info 2' ) TO lt_logs. " Duplicate

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deleter->remove_adjacent_duplicates( lt_logs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),

    ).

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_logs TYPE zcl_itab_delete_duplicates=>tt_log_entries.
    DATA(lv_ts1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_datetime( iv_date = '20231120' iv_time = '100000' ).
    DATA(lv_ts2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_datetime( iv_date = '20231120' iv_time = '100001' ).

    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts1 message_type = 'I' message = 'Info 1' ) TO lt_logs.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts2 message_type = 'W' message = 'Warning 1' ) TO lt_logs.

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deleter->remove_adjacent_duplicates( lt_logs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),

    ).

  METHOD test_all_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_logs TYPE zcl_itab_delete_duplicates=>tt_log_entries.
    DATA(lv_ts1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_datetime( iv_date = '20231120' iv_time = '100000' ).

    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts1 message_type = 'I' message = 'Info 1' ) TO lt_logs.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts1 message_type = 'I' message = 'Info 1' ) TO lt_logs.
    APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = lv_ts1 message_type = 'I' message = 'Info 1' ) TO lt_logs.

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deleter->remove_adjacent_duplicates( lt_logs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist effizient, um direkt aufeinanderfolgende, identische Zeilen zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die interne Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur benachbarte Duplikate berücksichtigt.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, Duplicates, SORT

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_active_products
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_active_products.
    rt_active_products = FILTER #( it_all_products WHERE is_active = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_some.
    DATA: lt_products TYPE zcl_itab_delete_filter=>tt_products.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Product A' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_products.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Product B' is_active = abap_false ) TO lt_products.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'Product C' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_products.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_filter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = 2,

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-name,
      exp = 'Product A',

  METHOD test_filter_none.
    DATA: lt_products TYPE zcl_itab_delete_filter=>tt_products.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Product A' is_active = abap_false ) TO lt_products.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_active_products( lt_products ).

Instructions: Löschen Sie Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die aus einem JSON-String geparst wurden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` zum Parsen einer Liste von IDs und `DELETE FROM DATABASE ... WHERE IN (...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_db_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_flights_from_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_carrids TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_db_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_from_json.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE tt_carrids.
    TRY.
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_carrids
          CHANGING
            cs_target_data = lt_carrids
        ).

        IF lt_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
          DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrids.
          rv_deleted_count = sy-dbcnt.
        ELSE.
          rv_deleted_count = 0.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_deleted_count = -1. " Fehlerindikator
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die in einem JSON-Array von IDs enthalten sind, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `CONDENSE`.
hint: Parsen Sie das JSON-Array in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dann einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `CONDENSE` oder `EXCEPT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_for_condense DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_items_by_json_ids
      IMPORTING
        it_all_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_json_ids TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_for_condense IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_items_by_json_ids.
    DATA: lt_ids_to_delete TYPE tt_ids.
    TRY.
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_ids
          CHANGING
            cs_target_data = lt_ids_to_delete
        ).

        " Moderne Art, Zeilen zu filtern (d.h. zu 'löschen'), die NICHT in der Liste der zu löschenden IDs sind.
        rt_remaining_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_all_items
                                      WHERE ( id IS NOT IN lt_ids_to_delete )
                                      ( ls_item ) ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Im Fehlerfall alle Items zurückgeben oder Fehlerbehandlung anpassen
        rt_remaining_items = it_all_items.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String und behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler während des Parsens. Geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück, wenn das Parsen fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die `cx_clb_json_error` (hypothetisch) abzufangen und einen Fallback-Wert zu liefern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config,
             setting1 TYPE string,
             setting2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_config.
    METHODS get_config_from_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_from_json.
    " Standardkonfiguration als Fallback
    rs_config = VALUE #( setting1 = 'Default' setting2 = 0 ).

    TRY.
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            cs_target_data = rs_config
        ).
      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehler beim Parsen, Standardkonfiguration bleibt erhalten.
        " Optional: Fehler protokollieren (z.B. mit cl_abap_logger).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, und transformieren Sie diese in eine interne Tabelle, wobei Sie nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und umbenennen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` zum Parsen und dann einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und Feldzuweisungen für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_transform_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             old_id TYPE string,
             old_name TYPE string,
             old_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES: tt_source_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             new_identifier TYPE string,
             new_description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES: tt_target_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_json_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_target_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transform_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_json_to_table.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE tt_source_items.
    TRY.
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            cs_target_data = lt_source_data
        ).

        rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN lt_source_data
                                       ( new_identifier = ls_source-old_id,
                                         new_description = ls_source-old_name ) ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Leere Tabelle zurückgeben oder Fehler protokollieren
        CLEAR rt_transformed_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_scores.
    rt_top_scores = it_all_scores.

    IF lines( rt_top_scores ) > iv_n AND iv_n >= 0.
      DELETE rt_top_scores FROM iv_n + 1.
    ELSEIF iv_n < 0.
      CLEAR rt_top_scores. " Ungültiges N, alles löschen
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, dessen Struktur zur Laufzeit variieren kann, und extrahieren Sie dynamisch Werte. Nehmen Sie an, dass 'cl_clb_parse_json' eine Methode 'parse_to_data_ref' besitzt, die einen Datenreferenz zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_to_data_ref` und Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_value.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any TABLE, <fs_struct> TYPE any, <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        " Annahme: parse_to_data_ref parst in eine Datenreferenz
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_to_data_ref(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          IMPORTING
            eo_data_ref = lr_data
        ).

        IF lr_data IS BOUND.
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_data> IS NOT INITIAL.
            " Annahme: JSON ist ein Array von Objekten, wir nehmen das erste Element
            ASSIGN <fs_data>[ 1 ] TO <fs_struct>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                rv_value = <fs_field>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_value = 'ERROR_PARSING'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und geben Sie die gelöschten Zeilen zurück, während die Originaltabelle unverändert bleibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die zu löschenden Zeilen zu identifizieren, und einen weiteren `FILTER`-Operator, um die verbleibenden Zeilen zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_and_return DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_entry,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_entry.
    TYPES: tt_data_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_and_get_deleted
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE tt_data_entries
        iv_value_threshold TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        et_deleted_entries TYPE tt_data_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_entries) TYPE tt_data_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_and_return IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_get_deleted.
    " Identifiziere die zu löschenden Einträge
    et_deleted_entries = FILTER #( it_original_table WHERE value_field > iv_value_threshold ).

    " Erstelle eine neue Tabelle mit den verbleibenden Einträgen
    rt_remaining_entries = FILTER #( it_original_table WHERE value_field <= iv_value_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_and_return( ).
    DATA(lt_deleted) TYPE zcl_itab_delete_and_return=>tt_data_entries.
    DATA(lt_remaining) = lo_processor->delete_and_get_deleted(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine funktionale Herangehensweise an das 'Löschen' von Daten. Anstatt Zeilen direkt aus einer Tabelle zu entfernen, werden zwei neue Tabellen erstellt: eine mit den zu 'löschenden' Zeilen und eine mit den 'verbleibenden' Zeilen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn man die gelöschten Elemente für weitere Verarbeitung benötigt oder die Originaltabelle unverändert lassen möchte. Der `FILTER`-Operator macht dies sehr elegant.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Benutzern enthält, und validieren Sie, ob alle Benutzer die erforderlichen Felder besitzen. Geben Sie nur die gültigen Benutzer zurück.
hint: Parsen Sie das JSON in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dann einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `COND`- oder `SWITCH`-Anweisung zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_validate_users DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user_raw,
             id TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             email TYPE string,
             age TYPE i,
           END OF ty_user_raw.
    TYPES: tt_user_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_user_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user_valid,
             id TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             email TYPE string,
           END OF ty_user_valid.
    TYPES: tt_user_valid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_user_valid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_and_get_users
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_users) TYPE tt_user_valid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_validate_users IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_and_get_users.
    DATA: lt_raw_users TYPE tt_user_raw.
    TRY.
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            cs_target_data = lt_raw_users
        ).

        rt_valid_users = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_users
                                   WHERE ( ls_raw-id IS NOT INITIAL AND
                                           ls_raw-name IS NOT INITIAL AND
                                           ls_raw-email IS NOT INITIAL AND
                                           ls_raw-age > 0 ) " Beispiel-Validierung
                                   ( id = ls_raw-id,
                                     name = ls_raw-name,
                                     email = ls_raw-email ) ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        CLEAR rt_valid_users.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen inline-Tabellentyp für Flugverbindungen (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer) und füllen Sie diesen Typ mit Daten aus der Tabelle `sflight` unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `IN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES: tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ... WITH EMPTY KEY` und `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_typ_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES: tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connections RETURNING VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE tt_connections.

CLASS zcl_typ_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_connections = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_typ_range_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_typ_range_of( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_typ_range_of=>tr_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten in einer ALV-Liste an und machen Sie die Spalte 'CARRID' anklickbar (Hotspot). Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler, der bei Klick auf den Hotspot eine Meldung ausgibt.
hint: Setzen Sie die Spalte als Hotspot und registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `link_click`-Ereignis von `cl_salv_events_list`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_hotspot_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_hotspot.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING r_salv_column
                value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_hotspot_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_hotspot.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_data    = lt_sflights ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column_carrid->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ).

        DATA(lo_events) = lo_alv->get_event_manager( ).
        SET HANDLER me->handle_link_click FOR lo_events.

        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_link_click.
    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Hotspot geklickt für Wert:' value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_controller_metadata` oder eine ähnliche Klasse, um Metadaten eines ALV-Berichts zu manipulieren, z.B. um die Sichtbarkeit einer Spalte zu ändern, ohne die Spalte direkt über `cl_salv_column` zu beeinflussen.
hint: Die Klasse `cl_salv_controller_metadata` ist eher für interne ALV-Steuerung gedacht. Für die Sichtbarkeit von Spalten ist `cl_salv_column` der direkte Weg. Eine indirekte Manipulation wäre über Layout-Varianten oder dynamische Feldkataloge, aber das ist komplexer. Für dieses Beispiel nutzen wir `cl_salv_column` als direkteste und modernste Methode, da `cl_salv_controller_metadata` nicht direkt für Endanwender-Manipulationen gedacht ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_metadata_manip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_hide_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_metadata_manip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_hide_column.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_data    = lt_sflights ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_planetype) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PLANETYPE' ).
        lo_column_planetype->set_visible( abap_false ).

        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE` und `RECEIVING RESULTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string,
      set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    IF iv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_VALUE'.
      ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_importing.
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS INTO rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_get FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_set FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_get.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'GET_VALUE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'SET_VALUE'
      iv_param_value = 'New Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_value( ) exp = 'New Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE ... RECEIVING RESULTS INTO ...`. Dies ist eine mächtige Funktion für generische Frameworks und erfordert oft RTTI, um die Methodensignatur zu überprüfen und Parameter dynamisch zu binden.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Method Call, CALL METHOD, abap_parmbind_tab, Reflection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs empfängt und den Wert einer bestimmten Spalte (Name als String) für jede Zeile ausliest und in einer neuen Tabelle sammelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr` und Feldsymbole (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_column_values
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_column_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val
        EXPORTING
          component_name = iv_column_name.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_column_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field1 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field2 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_column EXPECTED EXCEPTION cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field1.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_generic_read=>ty_t_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 )
      ( field1 = 'B' field2 = 2 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_column_values( it_source_table = lt_data iv_column_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_field2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_generic_read=>ty_t_data(
      ( field1 = 'X' field2 = 10 )
      ( field1 = 'Y' field2 = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_column_values( it_source_table = lt_data iv_column_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '20' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_column.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_generic_read=>ty_t_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 )
    ).
    lo_cut->get_column_values( it_source_table = lt_data iv_column_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert RTTI mit Feldsymbolen, um dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur innerhalb einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen. `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_value>` ist der Schlüssel für diesen dynamischen Zugriff. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Testdaten ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: RTTI, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Access, Internal Tables, Generic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Feldkatalog einer ALV-Instanz (basierend auf einer internen Tabelle) dynamisch ausliest und die technischen Feldnamen zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>create_for_data()` und `get_columns()`, `get_column()`, `get_fieldname()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_field_catalog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_names
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_field_catalog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_names.
    DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>create_for_data( EXPORTING t_table = it_data ).
    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lt_column_list) = lo_columns->get_column_list( ).

    rt_field_names = VALUE #( FOR fieldname IN lt_column_list ( lo_columns->get_column( fieldname )->get_fieldname( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_theme FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_theme.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ui5_theme_info( ).
    DATA(lv_theme) = lo_cut->get_active_ui5_theme( ).
    " In a real system, this would return a theme like 'sap_fiori_3' or 'sap_horizon'.
    " For unit testing, we can only assert it's not initial or matches a known default/expected value.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_theme msg = 'Theme name should not be initial in a UI5 context, but might be in isolated test' ).
    " A more robust test would involve setting up a UI5 context or mocking the utility class.
    " For demonstration, we assert it's not initial, assuming a default theme is always returned.
    " If running in a non-UI5 context, it might be initial, so this assertion might fail.
    " For this example, we'll assert it's not initial, assuming a valid context.
    " If it's initial, it means no theme is set or the context is not UI5.
    IF lv_theme IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_theme msg = 'Theme name should not be initial' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_theme msg = 'Theme name is initial, likely due to non-UI5 test context' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist und die einen String als Parameter akzeptiert und einen String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference) PARAMETER-TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE string.
    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming the method parameter is named IV_INPUT
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    DATA(lr_result) = NEW cl_abap_typedescr( )->get_p( 'STRING' )->get_initial_value( ).
    GET REFERENCE OF lr_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'. " Assuming the method return parameter is named RV_OUTPUT
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

    rv_result = lr_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic call demonstration
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( io_object      = lo_target
                                                      iv_method_name = 'PROCESS_STRING'
                                                      iv_param_value = 'Hello Dynamic' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Hello Dynamic' msg = 'Dynamic method call failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( io_object      = lo_target
                                                                              iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
                                                                              iv_param_value = 'Test' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference) PARAMETER-TABLE ...` ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, Methoden aufzurufen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was für generische Frameworks oder Plugin-Architekturen unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von `PARAMETER-TABLE` erlaubt die dynamische Übergabe von Parametern.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, RTTI, Reflection, Dynamic Call

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und deren Ziel 'JFK' ist, und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             deptime TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             fromcity TYPE sflight-fromcity,
             tocity TYPE sflight-tocity,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_specific_route_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_full

        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_specific_route_flights.
    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                           WHERE ( fromcity = 'FRANKFURT' AND tocity = 'NEW YORK' )
                           ( flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Interface-Referenzen und Polymorphie mit einer einfachen Berechnung.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode und implementieren Sie es in mehreren Klassen. Verwenden Sie dann eine Interface-Referenz.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculator.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      iv_value1 TYPE i
      iv_value2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_value1 + iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiplier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiplier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_value1 * iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        io_calculator TYPE REF TO zif_calculator
        iv_val1       TYPE i
        iv_val2       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = io_calculator->calculate( iv_value1 = iv_val1 iv_value2 = iv_val2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_addition FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiplication FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_addition.
    DATA(lo_adder) = NEW zcl_adder( ).
    DATA(lo_polymorphic_calc) = NEW zcl_polymorphic_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_polymorphic_calc->perform_calculation( io_calculator = lo_adder
                                                                 iv_val1       = 5
                                                                 iv_val2       = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 msg = 'Addition should be 8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiplication.
    DATA(lo_multiplier) = NEW zcl_multiplier( ).
    DATA(lo_polymorphic_calc) = NEW zcl_polymorphic_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_polymorphic_calc->perform_calculation( io_calculator = lo_multiplier
                                                                 iv_val1       = 5
                                                                 iv_val2       = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 msg = 'Multiplication should be 15' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kernprinzipien der Objektorientierung: Interfaces und Polymorphie. Durch die Verwendung einer Interface-Referenz (`zif_calculator`) kann der `perform_calculation`-Methode von `zcl_polymorphic_calc` jede Klasse übergeben werden, die dieses Interface implementiert. Dies ermöglicht flexiblen und erweiterbaren Code, da neue Berechnungstypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die aufrufende Logik ändern zu müssen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Polymorphism, Class, Method

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit dem `GROUP SIZE` Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_group.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_carrier_count TYPE ty_carrier_count.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      ls_carrier_count-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_carrier_count-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_carrier_count TO rt_carrier_counts.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_group.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '003'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '004'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '005'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 groups' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First group should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'LH should have 3 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second group should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'AA should have 1 flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third group should be UA' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitzplätze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('UA') aus `sflights` unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `INIT` Wert und der Formel `SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_free_seats_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_instance->calculate_free_seats( 'UA' ).
    out->write( |Gesamtzahl freier Sitze für UA: { lv_sum }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_free_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_free_seats_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Annahme: Für 'AZ' gibt es Flüge mit bekannten Sitzplatzdaten
    " Beispielwerte für AZ: 0001 (255-250=5), 0002 (255-250=5) -> Summe 10
    " Dies muss an die tatsächlichen Daten in SFLIGHTS angepasst werden.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0. " Calculate expected sum based on your SFLIGHTS data for 'AZ'
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax - seatsocc ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AZ' INTO @lv_expected_sum.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` für die Fluggesellschaft 'LH', die eine freie Sitzplatzkapazität von mehr als 100 haben. Nutzen Sie die `FILTER` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf einer internen Tabelle, die zuvor mit `SELECT` gefüllt wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_high_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_instance->get_high_capacity_flights( 'LH' ).
    out->write( |Anzahl Flüge mit >100 freien Sitzen für LH: { lines( lt_flights ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |Flug { ls_flight-connid }: { ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc } freie Sitze| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_high_capacity_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE seatsmax - seatsocc > 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_fday) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_weekday( iv_date ). " 1=Montag, 7=Sonntag

      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit den Namen und den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts (z.B. einer internen Tabelle) unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( )` und die Methoden der Typbeschreibungsklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_data_object_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_rtti_example( ).

    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hallo Welt'.
    out->write( lo_instance->get_data_object_info( REF #( lv_string ) ) ).

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    out->write( lo_instance->get_data_object_info( REF #( lt_sflights ) ) ).

    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    out->write( lo_instance->get_data_object_info( REF #( ls_sflight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data_object_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    rv_info = |Datenobjekt: { lo_descr->get_name( ) } (Typ: { lo_descr->type_kind_name }| ).

    CASE lo_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
        DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        rv_info = rv_info && |; Zeilentyp: { lo_line_descr->get_name( ) }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
        rv_info = rv_info && |; Anzahl Komponenten: { lines( lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ) }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Do nothing
    ENDCASE.
    rv_info = rv_info && |).|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Spalte vom Typ `string` und fügen Sie einen Eintrag hinzu. Geben Sie den Inhalt der Tabelle aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( )` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab( ).
    out->write( lo_instance->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    " 1. Elementtyp beschreiben (z.B. STRING)
    lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).

    " 2. Tabellentyp beschreiben (Standardtabelle des Elementtyps)
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_elem_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
    ).

    " 3. Interne Tabelle dynamisch erzeugen
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Zeile hinzufügen
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_elem_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
    <ls_dynamic_line> = 'Dynamischer Eintrag 1'.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    <ls_dynamic_line> = 'Dynamischer Eintrag 2'.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Inhalt ausgeben
    rv_output = |Inhalt der dynamischen Tabelle: |.
    LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      rv_output = rv_output && |'{ <ls_dynamic_line> }' |.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_number TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2

             absolute_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             rounded_value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_math_results.

CLASS zcl_math_functions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_math_functions( ).
    DATA(ls_res1) = lo_instance->calculate_and_round( '-123.45' ).
    out->write( |Absolutwert von -123.45: { ls_res1-absolute_value }, Gerundet: { ls_res1-rounded_value }| ).

    DATA(ls_res2) = lo_instance->calculate_and_round( '123.78' ).
    out->write( |Absolutwert von 123.78: { ls_res2-absolute_value }, Gerundet: { ls_res2-rounded_value }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_and_round.
    rs_results-absolute_value = abs( iv_number ).
    rs_results-rounded_value = round( val = iv_number dec = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_single_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.

CLASS zcl_mod_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_single_flight_price.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.

    DATA(ls_flight_to_update) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = '20250101'
    ).

    READ TABLE rt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_old_flight)
      WITH KEY carrid = ls_flight_to_update-carrid
               connid = ls_flight_to_update-connid
               fldate = ls_flight_to_update-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight_to_update-price = ls_old_flight-price * '1.1'.
      MODIFY TABLE rt_updated_flights FROM ls_flight_to_update.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'UA' in einer internen Tabelle `sflights` um 5% und setzen Sie gleichzeitig den `CONNID` auf '9999' für Flüge mit `CARRID` 'AA'. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL ... WHERE ...` für die effiziente Bearbeitung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_loop_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_loop_fs
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_loop_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_loop_fs.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = 'UA'.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.05'.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      <fs_flight>-connid = '9999'.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_insert_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS insert_or_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        io_existing_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_insert_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_or_update_flights.
    rt_result_flights = io_existing_flights.

    MODIFY TABLE rt_result_flights FROM VALUE #( FOR new_flight IN it_new_flights
                                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( new_flight ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) TO lt_existing.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 110 ) TO lt_new. " Update
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 ) TO lt_new. " Insert

CLASS zcl_mod_for_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
