Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem `CARRID` und `CONNID` eines Fluges eine spezielle Bearbeitungslogik auswählt. Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `CASE` Anweisungen oder eine Kombination aus `CASE` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `CASE` oder `CASE` mit `COND` für komplexere Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_processing_logic
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_logic_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_processing_logic.
    CASE is_flight_key-carrid.
      WHEN 'LH'.
        CASE is_flight_key-connid.
          WHEN '0400'.
            rv_logic_id = 'LH_SPECIAL_0400'.
          WHEN '0401'.
            rv_logic_id = 'LH_SPECIAL_0401'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_logic_id = 'LH_STANDARD'.
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN 'AA'.
        rv_logic_id = COND string(
          WHEN is_flight_key-connid = '0001' THEN 'AA_SPECIAL_0001'
          ELSE 'AA_STANDARD'
        ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_logic_id = 'DEFAULT_LOGIC'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_processing_logic( VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0005' ) ) exp = 'DEFAULT_LOGIC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_mod_transporting_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS reset_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_transporting_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reset_price_for_carrier.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
      <fs_flight>-price = 0.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 ) TO lt_flights.

ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL ... WHERE ...` erreicht. Das Feldsymbol ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeile, die der `WHERE`-Bedingung entspricht, was einer `MODIFY` Operation gleichkommt.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle `sflights` ein, falls sie noch nicht existiert. Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `INDEX 1` und `TRANSPORTING` für eine spezifische Aktualisierung, falls die Zeile bereits existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING comp1` in Kombination mit `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_insert_or_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS insert_or_update_flight_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight
        io_existing_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_insert_or_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_or_update_flight_entry.
    rt_result_flights = io_existing_flights.

    DATA(lv_tabix) = 0.
    READ TABLE rt_result_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY carrid = is_flight_data-carrid
               connid = is_flight_data-connid
               fldate = is_flight_data-fldate
      INTO lv_tabix. " Get index if found

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Update existing line, e.g., only price
      MODIFY TABLE rt_result_flights FROM is_flight_data TRANSPORTING price.
    ELSE.
      " Insert new line
      INSERT is_flight_data INTO TABLE rt_result_flights.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_insert_update_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_update_entry.
    DATA lt_existing TYPE zcl_mod_insert_or_update=>ty_sflight_tab.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) TO lt_existing.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mod_insert_or_update( ).

    " Update existing
    DATA(ls_update_data) = VALUE zcl_mod_insert_or_update=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->insert_or_update_flight_entry( is_flight_data = ls_update_data io_existing_flights = lt_existing ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_updated INTO DATA(ls_res_update) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_update-price exp = 150 ).

    " Insert new
    DATA(ls_insert_data) = VALUE zcl_mod_insert_or_update=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ).
    DATA(lt_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_or_update_flight_entry( is_flight_data = ls_insert_data io_existing_flights = lt_updated ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_inserted ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_inserted INTO DATA(ls_res_insert) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_insert-price exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die klassische Logik für 'UPSERT' (Update oder Insert) in internen Tabellen. Zuerst wird versucht, die Zeile zu lesen. Wenn sie gefunden wird, wird sie mit `MODIFY TABLE FROM wa TRANSPORTING` aktualisiert, andernfalls wird sie mit `INSERT` hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber wichtige Anwendung von `MODIFY`.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, INSERT, READ TABLE, UPSERT

CLASS zcl_case_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_case_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_message = CASE abap_true.

          WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' THEN 'Flug LH existiert.'
          ELSE 'Flug existiert.'

      WHEN OTHERS THEN

    ENDCASE.

Es ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Bedingungen zu prüfen und Werte zuzuweisen, insbesondere wenn die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle ein Kriterium ist.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `PRICE` aller Flüge in der `sflights` Tabelle, die einen `CARRID` aus einer Liste von 'Premium'-Fluggesellschaften haben, um 15%. Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `FOR` und `IN` Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_for_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_premium_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.

CLASS zcl_mod_for_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_premium_flights.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.

    DATA(lt_premium_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'SQ' ) ).

    MODIFY TABLE rt_updated_flights FROM VALUE #( FOR flight IN rt_updated_flights
                                                  WHERE ( carrid IN @lt_premium_carriers )
                                                  ( VALUE #( flight WITH price = flight-price * '1.15' ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie einen Flug basierend auf seinem `CARRID` und `PRICE` in 'Budget', 'Standard' oder 'Premium'. Nutzen Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` Bedingungen, die logische Ausdrücke enthalten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_case_logical_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS classify_flight_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_logical_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_flight_by_criteria.
    CASE abap_true.
      WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' AND iv_price > 500. rv_category = 'Premium'.
      WHEN iv_carrid = 'AA' AND iv_price < 200. rv_category = 'Budget'.
      WHEN iv_price BETWEEN 200 AND 500. rv_category = 'Standard'.
      WHEN OTHERS. rv_category = 'Unklassifiziert'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_flight_by_criteria( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_price = 150 ) exp = 'Budget' ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = 75 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_carrier_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-price exp = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_xx-price exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` zum Entfernen spezifischer Zeilen und `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM wa` zum Einfügen oder Aktualisieren einer einzelnen Zeile. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu manipulieren, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel für `DELETE` eine moderne und effiziente Filterung ermöglicht.
keywords: MODIFY, DELETE, Internal Tables, WHERE, VALUE #

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Flugdatums aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE <result_var> FOR <element> IN <source_table> NEXT <result_var> = <expression>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( fldate = iv_fldate )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251123' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_sflights.

    lv_total = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_fldate = '20251123' ).

Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulationslogik anwendet. CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid

        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    rb_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                                               connid = iv_connid
                                                               fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).

ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251123' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).

explanation: Tabellenexpressionen (`itab[ key = value ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle über ihre Schlüssel. In Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` kann sehr effizient geprüft werden, ob eine Zeile mit bestimmten Schlüsselwerten existiert, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `READ TABLE` Anweisungen.
keywords: Table Expressions, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Full', 'Almost Full', 'Available') basierend auf der Auslastung (belegte Sitze / Gesamtkapazität) unter Verwendung einer `COND`-Expression. 'Full' bei >= 90%, 'Almost Full' bei >= 70%, sonst 'Available'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN <condition> THEN <value> ... ELSE <value> )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_occupancy_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percentage) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seats_max > 0 THEN ( iv_seats_occupied / iv_seats_max ) * 100 ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = COND string( WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 90 THEN 'Full'
                              WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 70 THEN 'Almost Full'
                              ELSE 'Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_status) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 90 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 75 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Almost Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 50 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Available' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 0 iv_seats_max = 0 ) exp = 'Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Blöcken für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die nacheinander aufgerufen werden können (Method Chaining), um eine Zeichenkette zu manipulieren (z.B. trimmen, in Großbuchstaben umwandeln, Präfix hinzufügen).
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    CONDENSE mv_string NO-GAPS.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_string = iv_prefix && mv_string.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_string_builder( '  hello world  ' ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->trim( )->to_upper( )->add_prefix( 'ABAP: ' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP: HELLOWORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile verkettet werden können. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode `ME` (eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz) zurückgibt.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, String Processing, Fluent Interface, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) in einen JSON-String und deserialisieren Sie diesen String anschließend zurück in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klassen `cl_abap_json_serializer` und `cl_abap_json_parser`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_flight_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights_to_json
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_json_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_flight_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights_to_json.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW cl_abap_json_serializer( ).
    TRY.
        lo_serializer->serialize( EXPORTING data = it_sflights IMPORTING json = rv_json_string ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Handle error
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_json_to_flights.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_abap_json_parser( iv_json_string ).
    TRY.
        lo_parser->parse( IMPORTING data = rt_sflights ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Handle error
        " For simplicity, returning empty table on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_json_serialization_deserialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_serialization_deserialization.
    DATA: lt_original_flights TYPE zcl_json_flight_converter=>tt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251122' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_original_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251123' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' seatsmax = 80 seatsocc = 20 ) TO lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_json_flight_converter( ).

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_converter->serialize_flights_to_json( lt_original_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check for no error during serialization
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).

    DATA(lt_deserialized_flights) = lo_converter->deserialize_json_to_flights( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check for no error during deserialization

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deserialized_flights ) exp = lines( lt_original_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deserialized_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = lt_original_flights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deserialized_flights[ 2 ]-cityto exp = lt_original_flights[ 2 ]-cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klassen `cl_abap_json_serializer` und `cl_abap_json_parser` bieten eine standardisierte und effiziente Möglichkeit, ABAP-Datenstrukturen in JSON-Strings umzuwandeln und umgekehrt. Dies ist essenziell für die Integration mit externen Systemen und modernen Web-Anwendungen.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, Deserialization, SFLIGHTS, `cl_abap_json_serializer`, `cl_abap_json_parser`, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_random_number_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i DEFAULT 1

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie die neue Syntax für dynamische Feldzugriffe.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Syntax `(lv_field_name)` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    TRY.
        rv_value = SWITCH string(
          iv_field_name
          WHEN 'FIELD1' THEN is_data-field1
          WHEN 'FIELD2' THEN |{ is_data-field2 }|
          ELSE THROW cx_sy_dyn_src_error( textid = cx_sy_dyn_src_error=>cx_sy_dyn_src_error ) ).

        " Alternative using dynamic component access (requires 7.50+ for direct assignment)
        " DATA(lv_component_name) = iv_field_name.
        " rv_value = is_data-(lv_component_name).
        " The SWITCH expression is more robust for type conversion and error handling here.

    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_value = |Error: Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found or invalid type.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_reader=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_reader->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_reader->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_value_invalid) = lo_reader->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'Error' act = lv_value_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Feldzugriff mit der Syntax `(lv_field_name)` ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit auf Komponenten von Strukturen oder Objekten zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst dynamisch ermittelt werden. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Programme oder Frameworks. Die `SWITCH`-Expression wird hier verwendet, um eine typsichere und robuste Abbildung der dynamischen Feldnamen auf die tatsächlichen Feldwerte zu gewährleisten, inklusive Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Dynamic Field Access, SWITCH, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der belegten Sitze. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result,
           tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_results) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_connid.
    rt_grouped_results = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                             connid = ls_group-connid )
                                  ASCENDING
                                  ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                    connid = ls_group-connid
                                    total_seats_occupied = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                                     FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights_by_carrier_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_carrier_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251122' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251123' seatsocc = 70 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251122' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251122' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier_connid( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_result_lh0400) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh0400-total_seats_occupied exp = 120 ).

    DATA(ls_result_aa0010) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa0010-total_seats_occupied exp = 80 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`-Expression ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature ab ABAP 7.55, das eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von internen Tabellen ermöglicht. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe können komplexe Aggregationen in einer einzigen, gut lesbaren Anweisung durchgeführt werden. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>) GROUP BY ...`.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit und geben Sie dessen Typnamen zurück. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data()` und `get_name()`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_type_name.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    rv_type_name = lo_descr->get_name( ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data_type_name.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Test',
          lv_int    TYPE i VALUE 123,
          lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).

    DATA(lv_type_string) = lo_analyzer->get_data_type_name( REF #( lv_string ) ).

Instructions: Füge der Tabelle `sflights` ein neues Feld `RANDOM_ID` hinzu und befülle es mit Zufallszahlen zwischen 1000 und 9999.
hint: Nutze `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` oder eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und `BASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_random,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             random_id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_random.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_random TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_random WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS assign_random_ids RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights_with_id) TYPE tt_sflight_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_random_ids.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1000 p_max = 9999 ).

    rt_sflights_with_id = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight
                                                      MAPPING random_id = lo_random->get_next( ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_assign_random_ids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_random_ids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight_id( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_with_id) = lo_cut->assign_random_ids( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_sflights_with_id IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_with_id INTO DATA(ls_sflight_random).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_sflight_random-random_id >= 1000 AND ls_sflight_random-random_id <= 9999 ) msg = 'Random ID out of range' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_sflight_random-carrid IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Carrid should be filled' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die einfache Transformation von Strukturen oder internen Tabellen. Hier wird ein neues Feld `RANDOM_ID` hinzugefügt und mit einer Zufallszahl befüllt, während andere Felder übernommen werden.
keywords: Random, CORRESPONDING, VALUE, Internal Table, sflights, MAPPING, cl_abap_random_int

Instructions: Zeige Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einem ALV Grid an, das über das Control Framework verwaltet wird. (Hinweis: Dies ist ein Beispiel für die Struktur, da GUI-Tests nicht direkt ausführbar sind).

CLASS zcl_alv_sflight_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflight_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    " In a real scenario, this would be called from a screen PBO or similar.
    " For demonstration, we just instantiate.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '9000'. " Placeholder for a screen number

    " Create a custom container on a screen
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = 'CONTAINER_FOR_ALV'
      dynpro_program = lv_repid
      dynpro_number  = lv_dynnr
    ).

    " Create ALV grid instance
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    " Fetch data using modern ABAP SQL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Display data in ALV
    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " This would typically be followed by CALL SCREEN and PAI logic
    " cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " To ensure GUI updates
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_display_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_sflights.
    " GUI-related code cannot be fully tested in a unit test environment.
    " We can only test the instantiation and data retrieval part.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_sflight_display( ).
    " The method itself will try to create GUI objects, which might fail in a non-GUI context.
    " For a real test, one would mock GUI dependencies or run integration tests.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflights( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true msg = 'Method executed without dump (partial test)' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Method raised an exception (expected in non-GUI context)' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Liste von 10 Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 50 und filtere alle Zahlen heraus, die kleiner als 25 sind.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR` mit `FILTER` in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_random_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 50 ).

    DATA(lt_all_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 10
                                            ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

    rt_filtered_numbers = FILTER #( lt_all_numbers WHERE table_line >= 25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(lv_number).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_number >= 25 AND lv_number <= 50 ) msg = 'Filtered number out of range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Assert that there are some numbers, but exact count is random

Instructions: Berechne die Summe von 10 Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 10.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_random_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 10 ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR j = 1 UNTIL j > 10
                       NEXT sum = sum + lo_random->get_next( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Minimum sum: 10 * 1 = 10

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_sum >= 10 AND lv_sum <= 100 ) msg = 'Sum out of expected range' ).

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Füge eine Zufallszahl als Gruppen-ID hinzu.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `cl_abap_random_int` für die ID.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seats   TYPE f,
             group_id    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_flights_with_random_id RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_with_random_id.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 1000 ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                  ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                                    avg_seats = REDUCE f( INIT s = 0.0 cnt = 0
                                                          FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                          NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc
                                                               cnt = cnt + 1
                                                          FINALLY = s / cnt )
                                    group_id  = lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_random( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_with_random_id( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_grouped IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Grouped table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_group-carrid IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Carrid should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_group-avg_seats >= 0 ) msg = 'Average seats should be non-negative' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_group-group_id >= 1 AND ls_group-group_id <= 1000 ) msg = 'Group ID out of range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Gruppierung von Tabelleneinträgen mit `REDUCE` zur Berechnung von Aggregatwerten (Durchschnitt) und `cl_abap_random_int` zur Zuweisung einer eindeutigen Zufalls-ID pro Gruppe. Dies demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Ausdrücke für komplexe Datenmanipulationen.
keywords: Grouping, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, sflights, cl_abap_random_int, Aggregation

Instructions: Generiere eine Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 3. Basierend auf dieser Zahl, gib einen Text zurück, der 'Eins', 'Zwei' oder 'Drei' lautet.
hint: Nutze den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.

CLASS zcl_random_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_random_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_text.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_text = COND string(
                WHEN lv_number = 1 THEN 'Eins'
                WHEN lv_number = 2 THEN 'Zwei'
                WHEN lv_number = 3 THEN 'Drei'
                ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit Zufallszahlen und zeige sie in einem ALV Grid an. Die Anzahl der Spalten und Zeilen soll dynamisch sein. (Konzeptionelles Beispiel).
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `cl_abap_random_int` für die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_cols TYPE i DEFAULT 3
        iv_num_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '9000'. " Placeholder for a screen number

    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = 'DYNAMIC_ALV_CONTAINER'
      dynpro_program = lv_repid
      dynpro_number  = lv_dynnr
    ).

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    " Dynamically create structure and table type
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    DO iv_num_cols TIMES.
      ls_component-name = |COL_{ sy-index }|.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 100 ).

    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      DO iv_num_cols TIMES.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT |COL_{ sy-index }| OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <lv_field> = lo_random->get_next( ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = lo_struct_descr->get_relative_name( )
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = <lt_dynamic_table>
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_alv_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein `cl_gui_calendar` Objekt (über ein Interface) verwendet, um einen Datumsbereich im Kalender zu markieren. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax, um die Datentabelle zu befüllen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_SELECTED_DATES` und befüllen Sie die Tabelle `t_date_table` mit `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calendar_mock.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
           date_low  TYPE d,
           date_high TYPE d,
         END OF ty_date_range.
  TYPES tt_date_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS set_selected_dates IMPORTING it_dates TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table.
  METHODS get_selected_dates RETURNING VALUE(rt_dates) TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table.
  METHODS set_date IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d. " Keep for interface completeness
  METHODS get_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d. " Keep for interface completeness

CLASS zcl_cal_set_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock OPTIONAL.
    METHODS set_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_low  TYPE d
        iv_date_high TYPE d.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_set_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_calendar = io_calendar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_date_range.
    DATA(lt_dates) = VALUE cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table(
      ( date = iv_date_low )
      ( date = iv_date_high )
    ).
    IF mo_calendar IS BOUND.
      mo_calendar->set_selected_dates( lt_dates ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_get_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
             date_low  TYPE d,
             date_high TYPE d,
           END OF ty_date_range.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock OPTIONAL.
    METHODS get_selected_date_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_range) TYPE ty_date_range.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_get_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_calendar = io_calendar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_selected_date_range.
    IF mo_calendar IS BOUND.
      DATA(lt_selected_dates) = mo_calendar->get_selected_dates( ).
      IF lt_selected_dates IS NOT INITIAL.
        SORT lt_selected_dates BY date ASCENDING.
        rs_date_range-date_low = lt_selected_dates[ 1 ]-date.
        rs_date_range-date_high = lt_selected_dates[ lines( lt_selected_dates ) ]-date.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` abruft und diese Daten in einem `cl_gui_calendar` Objekt (über ein Interface) hervorhebt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` und die Methode `SET_HIGHLIGHTED_DATES`. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Transformation der Daten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calendar_mock.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
           date_low  TYPE d,
           date_high TYPE d,
         END OF ty_date_range.
  TYPES tt_date_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS set_selected_dates IMPORTING it_dates TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table.

CLASS zcl_cal_highlight_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock OPTIONAL.
    METHODS highlight_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_highlight_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_calendar = io_calendar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD highlight_flight_dates.
    DATA lt_flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT DISTINCT fldate
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_flight_dates.
    ELSE.
      SELECT DISTINCT fldate
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_flight_dates.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_cal_dates) = VALUE cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table(
      FOR ls_fldate IN lt_flight_dates (
        date = ls_fldate
      )
    ).

    IF mo_calendar IS BOUND.
      mo_calendar->set_highlighted_dates( lt_cal_dates ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_DISABLED_DATES` und `FILTER` um eine Liste von Daten zu erstellen, die deaktiviert werden sollen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calendar_mock.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
           date_low  TYPE d,
           date_high TYPE d,
         END OF ty_date_range.
  TYPES tt_date_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_cal_disable_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock OPTIONAL.
    METHODS disable_weekend_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_month TYPE sy-monat
        iv_year  TYPE sy-jahr.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO zif_calendar_mock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_disable_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_calendar = io_calendar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD disable_weekend_dates.
    DATA lt_all_dates TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table.
    DATA lv_date TYPE d.
    DATA lv_day_of_week TYPE n1.

    " Generate all dates for the given month/year
    lv_date = |{ iv_year }{ iv_month }01|. " First day of the month
    DO.
      APPEND VALUE #( date = lv_date ) TO lt_all_dates.
      lv_date = lv_date + 1.
      IF lv_date+0(6) <> |{ iv_year }{ iv_month }|. " Check if still in the same month
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Filter out only weekend dates (Saturday = 6, Sunday = 7)
    DATA(lt_weekend_dates) = FILTER cl_gui_calendar=>t_date_table(
      lt_all_dates WHERE ( date_to_day( date ) = 6 OR date_to_day( date ) = 7 )
    ).

    IF mo_calendar IS BOUND.
      mo_calendar->set_disabled_dates( lt_weekend_dates ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Nachrichtenbehandlung mit der Hilfsklasse `cl_message_helper`. Sammeln Sie mehrere Nachrichten unterschiedlicher Typen und geben Sie diese anschließend aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` und `cl_message_helper=>get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_helper_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_collected_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_helper_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( ).

    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '001'
        iv_msgty = 'E'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Input'
        iv_msgv2 = 'is initial'
      ).
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ELSEIF iv_input = 'WARNING'.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '002'
        iv_msgty = 'W'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Processing'
        iv_msgv2 = 'with warning'
      ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '003'
        iv_msgty = 'S'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Data'
        iv_msgv2 = 'processed successfully'
      ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_collected_messages.
    rt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit modernen ABAP-Ausnahmen (`TRY...CATCH`) und einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahmeklasse.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahmeklasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_error_code TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_error_code TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_error_code = iv_error_code.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.

    METHODS handle_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_num TYPE i
        iv_den TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text
          iv_error_code = 100.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_division.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_num iv_denominator = iv_den ).
        rv_output = |Division successful: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_output = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) } (Code: { lx_error->mv_error_code })|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_output = |Unexpected error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_custom_error.
    METHODS test_handle_division_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_custom_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->mv_error_code exp = 100 ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_handle_division_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_cut->handle_division( iv_num = 10 iv_den = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = 'Error: Division by zero' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = 'Code: 100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Fehlerbehandlung basiert auf klassenbasierten Ausnahmen (`CLASS-BASED EXCEPTIONS`). Durch die Definition eigener Ausnahmeklassen, die von `cx_static_check` (oder `cx_dynamic_check`) erben und das Interface `if_t100_message` implementieren, können spezifische Fehlerzustände mit aussagekräftigen Texten und zusätzlichen Attributen (wie `mv_error_code`) modelliert werden. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Ausgabe ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.
keywords: Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION, Custom Exception, Class-Based Exceptions, S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS

CLASS zcx_detailed_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_object_type TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_object_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_severity TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_object_type TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_object_id TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_severity TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_detailed_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_object_type = iv_object_type.
    me->mv_object_id = iv_object_id.
    me->mv_severity = iv_severity.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_detailed_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
        iv_id   TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_detailed_error.

    METHODS process_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
        iv_id   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_detailed_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_entry.
    IF iv_type IS INITIAL OR iv_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_detailed_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_detailed_error=>default_text
          iv_object_type = iv_type
          iv_object_id = iv_id
          iv_severity = 'HIGH'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_entry.
    TRY.
        validate_entry( iv_type = iv_type iv_id = iv_id ).
        rv_status = |Entry '{ iv_id }' of type '{ iv_type }' successfully validated.|.
      CATCH zcx_detailed_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_status = |Validation failed for object '{ lx_error->mv_object_id }' (Type: '{ lx_error->mv_object_type }', Severity: '{ lx_error->mv_severity }'): { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie `cl_message_helper` mit der Auslösung einer Ausnahme. Sammeln Sie Fehlermeldungen im Message Helper und werfen Sie dann eine Ausnahme, die auf das Vorhandensein von Fehlern hinweist.
hint: Prüfen Sie vor dem Auslösen der Ausnahme, ob Fehler im `cl_message_helper` vorhanden sind.

CLASS zcx_messages_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcx_messages_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_exc_combo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        zcx_messages_exist.

    METHODS get_all_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_exc_combo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( ).
    lo_msg_helper->clear_messages( ). " Ensure a clean start

    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF lv_item IS INITIAL.
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
          iv_msgno = '001'
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Empty item found'
        ).
      ELSEIF lv_item = 'INVALID'.
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
          iv_msgno = '002'
          iv_msgty = 'W'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Invalid item'
          iv_msgv2 = lv_item
        ).
      ELSE.
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
          iv_msgno = '003'
          iv_msgty = 'S'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Item processed'
          iv_msgv2 = lv_item
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lo_msg_helper->has_messages_of_type( iv_msgty = 'E' ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_messages_exist
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_messages_exist=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_messages.
    rt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Diese Kombination ist ein gängiges Muster in der ABAP-Entwicklung: Während eines Verarbeitungslaufs werden alle aufgetretenen Nachrichten (Fehler, Warnungen, Informationen) in `cl_message_helper` gesammelt. Am Ende des Laufs wird geprüft, ob kritische Fehler (z.B. vom Typ 'E') aufgetreten sind. Ist dies der Fall, wird eine Ausnahme ausgelöst, um den aufrufenden Prozess über den Fehlschlag zu informieren. Die Ausnahme selbst muss keine detaillierten Fehlerinformationen enthalten, da diese bereits im `cl_message_helper` verfügbar sind und bei Bedarf ausgelesen werden können. Dies trennt die Fehlerprotokollierung von der Fehlerbehandlung und ermöglicht eine flexible Reaktion auf Fehler.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `COND` für bedingte Logik. Erzeugen Sie dabei Nachrichten mit `cl_message_helper` für bestimmte Fälle (z.B. ungültige Daten).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `COND type = WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ...` für kompakten Code. `cl_message_helper` kann innerhalb der Schleife verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_msg_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE ty_t_flights.

    METHODS get_collected_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_msg_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( ).
    lo_msg_helper->clear_messages( ).

    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    LET lv_status = COND string(
                                                      WHEN ls_flight-price <= 0 THEN 'INVALID_PRICE'
                                                      WHEN ls_flight-currency IS INITIAL THEN 'MISSING_CURRENCY'
                                                      ELSE 'OK' )
                                    IN
                                    ( COND #( WHEN lv_status = 'OK' THEN ls_flight
                                              ELSE
                                                ( lo_msg_helper->add_message(
                                                    iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
                                                    iv_msgno = '004'
                                                    iv_msgty = 'W'
                                                    iv_msgv1 = lv_status
                                                    iv_msgv2 = ls_flight-carrid
                                                    iv_msgv3 = ls_flight-connid
                                                  ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_collected_messages.
    rt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->clear_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_msg_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_cond_msg_demo=>ty_t_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = 0.00 currency = 'USD' ) " Invalid price
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' price = 200.00 currency = '' ) " Missing currency
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0005' fldate = '20251204' price = 150.00 currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_processed_flights) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed_flights ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-message exp = 'INVALID_PRICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-message exp = 'MISSING_CURRENCY' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Iteratoren und `COND`-Ausdrücken ermöglicht eine extrem kompakte und funktionale Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Hier wird für jeden Flug in der Eingabetabelle ein Status (`lv_status`) basierend auf den Feldern `price` und `currency` ermittelt. Abhängig vom Status wird entweder der ursprüngliche Flug in die Ergebnistabelle übernommen oder eine Warnmeldung über `cl_message_helper` hinzugefügt. Dies demonstriert, wie man komplexe bedingte Logik und Nebenwirkungen (wie das Hinzufügen von Nachrichten) elegant in einem einzigen Ausdruck handhaben kann, was den Code sehr modern und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator. Behandeln Sie dabei potenzielle Fehler (z.B. ungültige numerische Werte) durch Ausnahmen, die während der Aggregation ausgelöst werden.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block enthalten, um Ausnahmen während der Iteration abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_value DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_exc_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_value.

    METHODS safe_calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_exc_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR ls_data IN it_data
                       LET lv_num_value = 0 IN
                       ( TRY.
                           lv_num_value = CONV i( ls_data-value ).
                           sum = sum + lv_num_value.
                         CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
                           RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_value
                             EXPORTING
                               textid = zcx_invalid_value=>default_text
                               iv_value = ls_data-value.
                         ENDTRY ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_calculate_sum.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_sum) = calculate_sum( it_data ).
        rv_result_text = |Total sum: { lv_sum }|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid).
        rv_result_text = |Error: Invalid value '{ lx_invalid->mv_value }' found. { lx_invalid->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result_text = |Unexpected error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das die Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, lesbaren Ausdruck ermöglicht. Die Integration von `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcken innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster, um Fehler, die während der Iteration auftreten (z.B. Konvertierungsfehler bei ungültigen Daten), direkt abzufangen und in eine spezifische Ausnahme umzuwandeln. Dies gewährleistet, dass die Aggregation robust ist und Fehler präzise gemeldet werden, ohne die Lesbarkeit des funktionalen Ausdrucks zu beeinträchtigen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dem `FILTER`-Operator. Protokollieren Sie dabei die Elemente, die herausgefiltert wurden, mithilfe von `cl_message_helper`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )` und eine separate Methode oder einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Nachrichten für die herausgefilterten Elemente zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_msg_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_product,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_product.
    TYPES ty_t_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_products
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE ty_t_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_products) TYPE ty_t_products.

    METHODS get_collected_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_msg_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_products.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( ).
    lo_msg_helper->clear_messages( ).

    rt_active_products = FILTER #( it_products WHERE active = abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_inactive_products) = FILTER #( it_products WHERE active = abap_false ).

    LOOP AT lt_inactive_products INTO DATA(ls_inactive_product).
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '005'
        iv_msgty = 'I'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Product inactive'
        iv_msgv2 = ls_inactive_product-id
        iv_msgv3 = ls_inactive_product-name
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_collected_messages.
    rt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In diesem Beispiel wird die Tabelle zunächst nach aktiven Produkten gefiltert. Anschließend wird eine zweite Filterung durchgeführt, um die inaktiven Produkte zu identifizieren. Für jedes inaktive Produkt wird dann eine Informationsnachricht über `cl_message_helper` hinzugefügt. CLASS zcl_test_with_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '008'
        iv_msgty = 'S'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Value is positive'

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_positive_value_succeeds FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->clear_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_value_fails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_test_with_messages( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->perform_check( -5 ).

    IF lv_is_valid = abap_false.
      DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_all_messages( ).
      DATA(lv_fail_message) TYPE string VALUE 'Test failed. Collected messages:'.
      LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
        lv_fail_message = lv_fail_message && |\n- { ls_message-msgty }: { ls_message-message }|.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lv_fail_message ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_positive_value_succeeds.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_test_with_messages( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->perform_check( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_all_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: In Unit Tests ist es oft nicht ausreichend zu wissen, dass ein Test fehlgeschlagen ist. Detaillierte Informationen über den Grund des Fehlschlags sind entscheidend für die Fehlersuche. Durch die Kombination von `cl_message_helper` mit `cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail` kann man die während der Ausführung gesammelten Nachrichten abrufen und als Teil der Fehlermeldung des Unit Tests ausgeben. Dies liefert einen reichhaltigeren Kontext und beschleunigt die Analyse, da alle relevanten Nachrichten direkt im Testergebnis sichtbar sind, anstatt sie manuell debuggen oder protokollieren zu müssen.
keywords: Unit Test, cl_message_helper, assert_fail, Message Handling, Debugging, Test Automation

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` für Ausnahmen, die nach dem Abfangen die Programmausführung fortsetzen können.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahmeklasse mit dem Zusatz `RESUMABLE` und verwenden Sie `RESUME` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_problem_item TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_problem_item TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_warning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_problem_item = iv_problem_item.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_exc_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_list
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE string_table.

    METHODS get_log_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_exc_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA mt_log_messages TYPE string_table.

  METHOD process_list.
    CLEAR mt_log_messages.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(lv_item).
      TRY.
          IF lv_item = 'PROBLEM'.
            RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_warning
              EXPORTING
                textid = zcx_resumable_warning=>default_text
                iv_problem_item = lv_item.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lv_item TO rt_processed_data.
        CATCH zcx_resumable_warning INTO DATA(lx_warning).
          APPEND |Warning: Item '{ lx_warning->mv_problem_item }' skipped. { lx_warning->get_text( ) }| TO mt_log_messages.
          RESUME.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_messages.
    rt_messages = mt_log_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RESUMABLE EXCEPTION`) sind ein spezielles Feature der ABAP-Fehlerbehandlung, das es ermöglicht, die Programmausführung nach dem Abfangen einer Ausnahme fortzusetzen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für nicht-kritische Fehler oder Warnungen, bei denen der Prozess nicht vollständig abgebrochen werden muss, sondern nur der fehlerhafte Teil übersprungen oder protokolliert werden soll. Der `RESUME`-Befehl im `CATCH`-Block signalisiert, dass die Ausführung an der Stelle fortgesetzt werden soll, an der die Ausnahme ausgelöst wurde. Dies führt zu einer robusteren und fehlertoleranteren Verarbeitung, insbesondere in Massenverarbeitungsszenarien.
keywords: Exception Handling, RESUMABLE EXCEPTION, RESUME, TRY CATCH, S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper` in Kombination mit `MESSAGE ... RAISING ...` um Nachrichten zu sammeln und gleichzeitig eine Ausnahme auszulösen, die auf die gesammelten Nachrichten verweist.
hint: Die `MESSAGE ... RAISING ...`-Anweisung kann eine Ausnahme auslösen, die dann abgefangen werden kann. Die Nachrichten können zuvor im `cl_message_helper` gesammelt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcx_message_raising_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_message_raising_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_raising_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_message_raising_error.

    METHODS execute_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_all_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_raising_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( ).
    lo_msg_helper->clear_messages( ).

    IF iv_value < 0.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '006'
        iv_msgty = 'E'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Negative value detected'
        iv_msgv2 = iv_value
      ).
      MESSAGE ID 'ZMSG_DEMO' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '006' WITH 'Negative value detected' iv_value RAISING zcx_message_raising_error.
    ELSEIF iv_value = 0.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '007'
        iv_msgty = 'W'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Value is zero'
      ).
    ELSE.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO'
        iv_msgno = '008'
        iv_msgty = 'S'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Value is positive'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_process.
    TRY.
        process_value( iv_value ).
        rv_status = 'Process completed successfully.'.
      CATCH zcx_message_raising_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        DATA(lt_messages) = get_all_messages( ).
        DATA(lv_error_detail) TYPE string VALUE 'Process failed. Messages: '.
        LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_msg).
          lv_error_detail = lv_error_detail && | { ls_msg-msgty }:{ ls_msg-message }|.
        ENDLOOP.
        rv_status = lv_error_detail.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status = |Unexpected error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_messages.
    rt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_value_raises_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_message_raising_error.
    METHODS test_negative_value_handled FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_value_raises_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_raising_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_value( -10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_message_raising_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_message_raising_error.
        DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_all_messages( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'E' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-message exp = 'Negative value detected -10' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_value_handled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_raising_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->execute_process( -20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_status exp = 'Process failed. Messages:  E:Negative value detected -20' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_positive_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_raising_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->execute_process( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Process completed successfully.' ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_all_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `MESSAGE ... RAISING ...`-Anweisung ist ein älteres, aber immer noch relevantes Feature, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen, die mit einer Systemnachricht verknüpft ist. In modernen Szenarien kann dies mit `cl_message_helper` kombiniert werden: Zuerst wird die Nachricht explizit zum Message Helper hinzugefügt, um sie zentral zu verwalten. Dann wird die `MESSAGE ... RAISING ...`-Anweisung verwendet, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen, die den Prozessfluss unterbricht. Der aufrufende Code kann die Ausnahme abfangen und die detaillierten Nachrichten aus dem `cl_message_helper` abrufen, um eine umfassende Fehlerinformation zu erhalten. Dies bietet eine Brücke zwischen der traditionellen Nachrichtenbehandlung und der modernen klassenbasierten Ausnahmebehandlung.
keywords: MESSAGE RAISING, cl_message_helper, Exception Handling, Message Handling, S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Utility-Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Nachrichten (`cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages`) in ein einfaches String-Format für die Anzeige oder Protokollierung konvertiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und String-Templates, um die Nachrichten zu formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
