Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Ausnahme basierend auf einem übergebenen Klassennamen auslöst. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme dann generisch ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit dem Zusatz `TYPE` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` mit der erstellten Ausnahmeinstanz. Fangen Sie mit `CATCH cx_root` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcx_dynamic_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_dynamic_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS raise_dynamic_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_exception_class_name TYPE clike
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.

    METHODS handle_dynamic_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_exception_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_dynamic_exception.
    DATA lo_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_exception TYPE (iv_exception_class_name).
    RAISE EXCEPTION lo_exception.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_dynamic_exception.
    TRY.
        raise_dynamic_exception( iv_exception_class_name ).
        rv_status = 'No exception raised (unexpected)'.
      CATCH zcx_dynamic_error INTO DATA(lx_dynamic).
        rv_status = |Caught custom dynamic error: { lx_dynamic->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status = |Caught generic exception: { lx_root->get_text( ) } (Type: { cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( lx_root ) })|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Dynamisches Auslösen von Ausnahmen ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das in Szenarien nützlich sein kann, in denen der Typ der Ausnahme zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden muss (z.B. basierend auf Konfigurationen oder Metadaten). Mit `CREATE OBJECT lo_exception TYPE (iv_exception_class_name)` kann eine Instanz einer beliebigen Ausnahmeklasse dynamisch erzeugt werden. Diese Instanz kann dann mit `RAISE EXCEPTION lo_exception` ausgelöst werden. Das Abfangen mit `CATCH cx_root` ermöglicht eine generische Fehlerbehandlung, während spezifischere `CATCH`-Blöcke (z.B. für `zcx_dynamic_error`) eine feinere Steuerung erlauben. Dies ist ein mächtiges, aber auch komplexes Feature, das mit Bedacht eingesetzt werden sollte.
keywords: Exception Handling, Dynamic Programming, CREATE OBJECT, RAISE EXCEPTION, CATCH CX_ROOT, S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Utility-Methode, die einen String sicher kürzt und am Ende '...' hinzufügt, wenn der String die maximale Länge überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `substring` und `strlen` oder String-Templates mit `(length=...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_truncator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS truncate_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_max_length   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_truncated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_truncator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD truncate_string.
    IF strlen( iv_input_string ) > iv_max_length AND iv_max_length > 3.
      rv_truncated_string = |{ substring( val = iv_input_string len = iv_max_length - 3 ) }...|.
    ELSE.
      rv_truncated_string = iv_input_string.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_count_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_flight_count_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_group_result TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_by_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_capacity RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_capacity) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_by_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_total_seats = lv_total_seats + ls_member-seatsmax.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group( carrid = group_key-carrid connid = group_key-connid total_seatsmax = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_grouped_capacity.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_grouped_capacity FOR TESTING.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' act = ls_first_group-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Total seats should not be initial' act = ls_first_group-total_seatsmax ).

Die innere Schleife `LOOP AT GROUP group_key` iteriert über die Elemente der aktuellen Gruppe, um die Summe zu bilden. `VALUE` wird verwendet, um die Ergebnisstruktur direkt zu füllen.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermittle für jede Gruppe die maximale Passagierkapazität (`seatsmax`) und die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwende die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_result)` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_capacity_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_capacity_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_max_seats) = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax( INIT max_s = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP group_key WHERE ( seatsmax > max_s ) NEXT max_s = ls_member-seatsmax ).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = group_key-carrid max_seats = lv_max_seats flight_count = lv_flight_count ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermittle für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Passagierkapazität (`seatsmax`) und die Anzahl der Flüge, die eine Mindestkapazität von 150 überschreiten. Verwende die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Kombiniere `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_filtered_cap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seats   TYPE f,
             filtered_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_stats.
    TYPES: tt_flight_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statistics RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_flight_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_filtered_cap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statistics.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax(
        INIT sum_s = 0
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum_s = sum_s + ls_member-seatsmax
      ).
      DATA(lv_group_size) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_avg_seats) = COND #( WHEN lv_group_size > 0 THEN lv_total_seats / lv_group_size ELSE 0 ).

      DATA(lv_filtered_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR ls_member IN FILTER #( group_key WHERE ( seatsmax > 150 ) )
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_stats(
        carrid       = group_key-carrid
        avg_seats    = lv_avg_seats
        filtered_count = lv_filtered_count
      ) TO rt_stats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flight_statistics FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_statistics.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_filtered_cap( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_first_stats) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_first_stats-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average seats should be non-negative' act = ( ls_first_stats-avg_seats >= 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Filtered count should be non-negative' act = ( ls_first_stats-filtered_count >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `FILTER`. `REDUCE` wird verwendet, um die Summe der Sitze zu berechnen, und `FILTER` wird innerhalb von `REDUCE` eingesetzt, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität zu zählen. `COND` ermöglicht eine konditionale Zuweisung. Alle Variablen werden inline mit `DATA` deklariert, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und dem Monat des Flugdatums. Sammle die Passagierkapazität (`seatsmax`) für jede Gruppe. Verwende die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Erstelle einen temporären Gruppierungsschlüssel mit `carrid` und dem Monat des `fldate`. Nutze `COLLECT` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_by_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_month_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             month    TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             total_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_month_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_month_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_month_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_capacity RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_month_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_by_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid month = ls_flight-fldate+4(2) ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(ls_group_data) = VALUE ty_flight_month_summary(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        month  = group_key-month
      ).
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        ls_group_data-total_seatsmax = ls_group_data-total_seatsmax + ls_member-seatsmax.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_group_data TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_first_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Month should not be initial' act = ls_first_entry-month ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative' act = ( ls_first_entry-total_seatsmax >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Gruppieren nach einem berechneten Feld (Monat aus `fldate`) innerhalb des `GROUP BY`-Schlüssels. `DATA(group_key)` deklariert den dynamischen Gruppierungsschlüssel inline. Die Aggregation der `seatsmax` erfolgt durch Iteration über die Gruppenelemente. Dies ist eine flexible Methode, um Daten nach komplexeren Kriterien zu gruppieren.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugzeugtyp (`planetype`). Für jede Gruppe soll eine Liste der Flugnummern (`connid`) gesammelt werden. Verwende die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `FOR ... IN GROUP` mit `VALUE` für die Liste der Flugnummern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connid_by_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_connids,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             connids   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group_connids.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_connids RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_connids) TYPE tt_flight_group_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connid_by_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, planetype, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid planetype = ls_flight-planetype ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lt_connids_in_group) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid(
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP group_key
        ( ls_member-connid )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group_connids(
        carrid    = group_key-carrid
        planetype = group_key-planetype
        connids   = lt_connids_in_group
      ) TO rt_grouped_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_grouped_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_first_group) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_first_group-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Planetype should not be initial' act = ls_first_group-planetype ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connids list should not be empty' act = ( lines( ls_first_group-connids ) > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird ein `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle von Flugnummern zu erstellen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, Listen von gruppierten Elementen zu sammeln.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight1 TYPE tt_sflight_key
        it_sflight2 TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie nur die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight_data` an eine Zieltabelle an, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_future_flights.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > lv_current_date ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_filtered_flights TO rt_future_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_yesterday) = sy-datum - 1.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_append_lines_filter=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = lv_yesterday price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum     price = '200' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = lv_tomorrow  price = '300' )

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle Flüge von mehreren Carriern in einer einzigen Zieltabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Tabelle iterativ zu füllen, indem Sie `LINES OF` nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_lines_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_flights_from_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
        it_carriers    TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_collected_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_flights_from_carriers.
    rt_collected_flights = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_key( )
      FOR carrier IN it_carriers
      LET filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = carrier ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight_key( BASE result ( LINES OF filtered_flights ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_collect_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_lines_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_append_lines_reduce=>tt_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->collect_flights_from_carriers(
      it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
      it_carriers    = lt_carriers
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` mit Tabellenausdrücken (`FILTER` und `VALUE #(... LINES OF ...)`). Es ermöglicht das Sammeln von Daten aus mehreren Quellen in einer einzigen Zieltabelle auf eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Weise, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, REDUCE, FILTER, Table Expressions, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol einen Wert zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend wieder auf. Überprüfen Sie, ob das Feldsymbol danach initial ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN iv_value TO <fs_int>.
    " <fs_int> ist jetzt zugewiesen und zeigt auf iv_value

    UNASSIGN <fs_int>.
    " <fs_int> ist jetzt nicht mehr zugewiesen

    IF <fs_int> IS INITIAL.
      rv_is_initial = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_initial = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `UNASSIGN` wird verwendet, um die Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols explizit aufzuheben. Dies ist wichtig, um sicherzustellen, dass das Feldsymbol nicht mehr auf einen Speicherbereich zeigt, insbesondere wenn der referenzierte Speicherbereich nicht mehr gültig ist oder um Ressourcen freizugeben. Nach `UNASSIGN` ist das Feldsymbol initial und kann mit `IS INITIAL` überprüft werden.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, ändern Sie deren Wert und heben Sie anschließend die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS modify_component_dynamically
      CHANGING
        cs_data TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_component_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        TRY.
            <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
            " Typkonflikt, Wert kann nicht zugewiesen werden
            " Hier könnte eine Fehlerbehandlung erfolgen
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Zuweisung aufheben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_component_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_dynamic( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_unassign_dynamic=>ty_data( field1 = 10 field2 = 'Old Value' ).

    lo_cut->modify_component_dynamically(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
      IMPORTING iv_component_name = 'FIELD1'
                iv_new_value      = '20'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 20 ).

    lo_cut->modify_component_dynamically(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
      IMPORTING iv_component_name = 'FIELD2'
                iv_new_value      = 'New Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 'New Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_component_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_dynamic( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_unassign_dynamic=>ty_data( field1 = 10 field2 = 'Old Value' ).

    lo_cut->modify_component_dynamically(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
      IMPORTING iv_component_name = 'FIELD1'
                iv_new_value      = 'ABC'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der dynamischen Programmierung ist es üblich, Feldsymbole zu verwenden, um zur Laufzeit auf Komponenten von Strukturen oder Tabellen zuzugreifen. Nach der Verwendung ist es gute Praxis, die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols mit `UNASSIGN` aufzuheben, um die Referenz zu lösen und potenzielle Fehler oder unerwünschte Seiteneffekte zu vermeiden, falls das Feldsymbol später wiederverwendet wird oder der referenzierte Speicherbereich ungültig wird.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, Structures

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle mit einem Feldsymbol, verarbeiten Sie jede Zeile und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols nach der Schleife auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` und `UNASSIGN` nach der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.
    rv_processed_count = 0.

    LOOP AT it_items ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
      " Verarbeite die Zeile
      <fs_item>-text = |Processed { <fs_item>-text }|.
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_item>. " Zuweisung des Feldsymbols nach der Schleife aufheben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_test_items) = VALUE zcl_unassign_loop=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_items( it_items = lt_test_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob das Feldsymbol nach der Methode nicht mehr zugewiesen ist
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE zcl_unassign_loop=>ty_item.
    " Hier kann man nicht direkt auf <fs_item> zugreifen, da es lokal ist.
    " Der Test konzentriert sich auf die Funktionalität und die korrekte Verwendung innerhalb der Methode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen in `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` ist eine performante Methode zur Verarbeitung interner Tabellen, da keine Daten kopiert werden. Das explizite Aufheben der Zuweisung mit `UNASSIGN` nach der Schleife ist eine gute Praxis, um die Lebensdauer der Zuweisung zu kontrollieren und sicherzustellen, dass das Feldsymbol keine unerwünschten Referenzen mehr hält.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, LOOP AT, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um dynamisch eine interne Tabelle zu erstellen, füllen Sie diese mit Daten und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols für die Tabelle auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` mit `ASSIGN` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_table_created) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_UNASSIGN_RTTI=>TY_SFLIGHT_KEY' ).
    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_typedescr ).

    CREATE DATA REF TO lo_tabledescr->get_table_type( ) ASSIGNING <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN <fs_table>->* TO <fs_table>.
      " Füllen der dynamischen Tabelle
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
        <fs_line>-connid = '0400'.
        <fs_line>-fldate = '20250101'.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_line>.

      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_line>-carrid = 'AA'.
        <fs_line>-connid = '0017'.
        <fs_line>-fldate = '20250102'.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_line>.

      rv_table_created = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_table>. " Zuweisung der dynamischen Tabelle aufheben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_rtti( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true ).

    " Hier kann nicht direkt auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle zugegriffen werden,
    " da sie lokal in der Methode deklariert und unassigned wurde.
    " Der Test bestätigt, dass der Prozess erfolgreich war.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) zur dynamischen Erstellung von internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit. Feldsymbole sind hier unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erzeugten Datenstrukturen zuzugreifen. `UNASSIGN` ist entscheidend, um die Referenzen auf die dynamisch erzeugten Objekte nach ihrer Verwendung sauber zu lösen und Speicherlecks zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Referenz auf eine lokale Variable, weisen Sie diese einem Feldsymbol zu, verwenden Sie das Feldsymbol und heben Sie die Zuweisung auf, bevor die lokale Variable den Gültigkeitsbereich verlässt.
hint: Achten Sie auf die Lebensdauer der Referenz und des Feldsymbols. `UNASSIGN` ist hier wichtig, um Dangling Pointers zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_ref_unassign
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_ref_unassign.
    DATA lv_local_var TYPE string VALUE 'Hello World'.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_string> TYPE string.

    ASSIGN lv_local_var TO <fs_string>.

    IF <fs_string> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Feldsymbol verwenden
      <fs_string> = 'Modified Value'.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_string>. " Zuweisung aufheben

    " Hier ist lv_local_var noch gültig, aber <fs_string> zeigt nicht mehr darauf.
    " Dies verhindert einen 'Dangling Pointer', falls lv_local_var später freigegeben würde.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_ref_unassign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ref_unassign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_ref( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->demonstrate_ref_unassign( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht die Bedeutung von `UNASSIGN` im Kontext der Speicherverwaltung und der Vermeidung von 'Dangling Pointern'. Wenn ein Feldsymbol auf eine lokale Variable zugewiesen wird, ist es gute Praxis, die Zuweisung explizit mit `UNASSIGN` aufzuheben, sobald das Feldsymbol nicht mehr benötigt wird. Dies stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol keine ungültige Referenz hält, selbst wenn die referenzierte Variable ihren Gültigkeitsbereich verlässt oder freigegeben wird.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, ASSIGN, Memory Management, Dangling Pointer

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle an eine Zieltabelle an, wobei die Quelltabelle eine generische Tabelle ist, die über ein Feldsymbol referenziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` für die generische Tabelle und dann `APPEND LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_lines_generic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_from_generic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data " Generische Referenz auf eine Tabelle
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_generic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_from_generic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <fs_source_table>.

    IF <fs_source_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Hier wird angenommen, dass die generische Tabelle den gleichen Zeilentyp hat
      " wie rt_target_table oder kompatibel ist.
      APPEND LINES OF <fs_source_table> TO rt_target_table.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_source_table>. " Zuweisung aufheben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_generic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_generic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_lines_generic( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_append_lines_generic=>tt_data(
      ( key = 'K1' value = 'Value 1' )
      ( key = 'K2' value = 'Value 2' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_source_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_source INTO lr_source_ref.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->append_from_generic_table( ir_source_table = lr_source_ref ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key exp = 'K1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `APPEND LINES OF` mit einer generisch referenzierten internen Tabelle. Durch die Zuweisung der Referenz auf ein Feldsymbol (`ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <fs_source_table>`) kann der Inhalt der generischen Tabelle effizient an eine typisierte Zieltabelle angehängt werden. `UNASSIGN` sorgt für eine saubere Freigabe der Feldsymbol-Zuweisung.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, Field Symbols, Generic Programming, Internal Tables, UNASSIGN

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen beliebigen Tabellennamen als String akzeptiert, die Tabelle dynamisch liest und die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgibt. Heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols nach der Verwendung auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(TABLE_NAME)') TO <FS_TABLE>` und `LINES()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_lines.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    DATA(lv_full_table_name) = |({ iv_table_name })|.

    ASSIGN (lv_full_table_name) TO <fs_any_table>.

    IF <fs_any_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_line_count = lines( <fs_any_table> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_line_count = -1. " Tabelle nicht gefunden oder nicht zugreifbar
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_any_table>. " Zuweisung aufheben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_lines FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_lines_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_lines.
    DATA: lt_sflight_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_test UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_lines( 'LT_SFLIGHT_TEST' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_table_lines_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_lines( 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Zuweisung einer internen Tabelle mittels ihres Namens als String (`ASSIGN ('(TABLE_NAME)') TO <FS>`). Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in der dynamischen Programmierung. Nach dem Zugriff auf die Tabelle und dem Ermitteln der Zeilenanzahl wird das Feldsymbol mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben, um die Referenz zu lösen und eine saubere Codeausführung zu gewährleisten.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN, LINES

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Zeilen einer internen Tabelle an eine andere an, die denselben Zeilentyp hat, aber einen anderen Tabellentyp (z.B. von Standard zu Sorted).
hint: `APPEND LINES OF` funktioniert auch zwischen verschiedenen Tabellentypen, solange der Zeilentyp kompatibel ist.
solution:

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Attribut eines Objekts zu, ändern Sie dessen Wert und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(OBJECT_REF)->ATTRIBUTE_NAME') TO <FS>` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_object_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS modify_attribute_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_object_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_attribute_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute> TYPE any.
    DATA(lv_full_path) = |(ME)->{ iv_attribute_name }|.

    ASSIGN (lv_full_path) TO <fs_attribute>.

    IF <fs_attribute> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_attribute> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Typkonflikt
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_attribute>. " Zuweisung aufheben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_attribute FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_attribute_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_attribute.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_object_attr( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value exp = 100 ).

    lo_cut->modify_attribute_dynamically( iv_attribute_name = 'MV_VALUE' iv_new_value = '200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_attribute_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_object_attr( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value exp = 100 ).

    " Versuch, einen String in ein Integer-Attribut zu schreiben
    lo_cut->modify_attribute_dynamically( iv_attribute_name = 'MV_VALUE' iv_new_value = 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value exp = 100 ). " Wert sollte unverändert bleiben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Feldsymbole verwendet werden können, um dynamisch auf Attribute eines Objekts zuzugreifen und diese zu ändern. Die Syntax `ASSIGN ('(OBJECT_REF)->ATTRIBUTE_NAME') TO <FS>` ist hierbei entscheidend. Nach der Bearbeitung des Attributs ist es wichtig, die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols mit `UNASSIGN` aufzuheben, um die Referenz zu lösen und eine saubere Objektverwaltung zu gewährleisten.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, ASSIGN

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_sum_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                         NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_sum.

    METHODS get_seats_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid
                               total_seats_occ = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                           FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                           NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Check for a specific carrier if known data exists

    " This requires more complex mocking or known test data.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_sum).

    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_display_messages.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    " Simulate some operations that might issue messages

    " Display collected messages
    LOOP AT lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      WRITE: / ls_message-msgty, ls_message-msgid, ls_message-msgno,

    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input

          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.

    TRY.
        process_value( iv_value = 10 ).
        process_value( iv_value = -5 ). " This will raise an exception
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        WRITE: / 'Caught custom exception: Invalid input detected!'.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne die Summe der belegten Sitze für jede Gruppe.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der `SUM`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrier_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_seats_sum RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_seats_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_seats) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_sum_seats = lv_sum_seats + ls_group_member-seatsocc.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_sum( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                   total_seats_occ = lv_sum_seats ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_seats_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_seats_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_seats_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has some flights, check if its sum is non-negative
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_sum).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_sum-total_seats_occ >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in modernem ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Berechnungen durchzuführen, ohne temporäre Hash-Tabellen oder komplexe Logik.
keywords: SUM, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Table, Grouping, sflights

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und die dabei ausgelöste Standardausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` abfängt.
hint: Verwende `TRY...CATCH` und fange `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zero_divide_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
    METHODS run_demo.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zero_divide_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run_demo.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i VALUE 10,
          lv_den TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_res TYPE f.

    TRY.
        lv_res = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = lv_num iv_denominator = lv_den ).
        WRITE: / 'Result:', lv_res.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero_divide).
        WRITE: / 'Caught CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE: Division by zero detected!'.
        WRITE: / 'Error message:', lx_zero_divide->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        WRITE: / 'Caught generic exception:', lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    lv_den = 2.
    TRY.
        lv_res = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = lv_num iv_denominator = lv_den ).
        WRITE: / 'Result:', lv_res.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        WRITE: / 'Unexpected exception:', lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_zero_division_exception FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_zero_division_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zero_divide_handler( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_exception_assert(
        exception_class = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE'
        method_call = 'lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 )'
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zero_divide_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Abfangen von Standardausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` ist entscheidend für die Robustheit von ABAP-Programmen. Es ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf Laufzeitfehler und verhindert Programmabbrüche.
keywords: S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS, Class-Based Exceptions, TRY...CATCH, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Error Handling

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier )
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming 'LH' has some flights with seatsocc > 0
    DATA(lv_lh_sum) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sum( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lh_sum >= 0 ) ).

    " Test with a non-existent carrier, should be 0
    DATA(lv_non_existent_sum) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sum( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_non_existent_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führe eine Operation aus, die Nachrichten sammelt. Wenn eine Fehlermeldung auftritt, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die die gesammelten Nachrichten enthält.
hint: Verwende `cl_message_helper` und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, die eine Referenz auf den Message Helper aufnehmen kann.
solution:
CLASS zcx_operation_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message. " For message handling
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        !textid         LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        !previous       LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        !io_msg_helper  TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mo_message_helper = io_msg_helper.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_with_msg_exc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_operation_failed.
    METHODS run_demo.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_with_msg_exc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    " Simulate an operation that might produce messages
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgty = 'I' ).

    IF iv_input < 0.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgv1 = 'Input' iv_msgv2 = 'negative' ).
    ENDIF.

    IF lo_msg_helper->has_errors( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_operation_failed
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_operation_failed=>default_text
          io_msg_helper = lo_msg_helper.
    ENDIF.

    WRITE: / 'Operation successful for input:', iv_input.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run_demo.
    TRY.
        perform_risky_operation( iv_input = 10 ).
        perform_risky_operation( iv_input = -5 ). " This will raise an exception
      CATCH zcx_operation_failed INTO DATA(lx_op_failed).
        WRITE: / 'Caught ZCX_OPERATION_FAILED: Operation failed!'.
        WRITE: / 'Error message:', lx_op_failed->get_text( ).
        IF lx_op_failed->mo_message_helper IS BOUND.
          WRITE: / 'Collected messages:'.
          LOOP AT lx_op_failed->mo_message_helper->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
            WRITE: / ls_message-msgty, ls_message-msgid, ls_message-msgno, ls_message-msgv1, ls_message-msgv2.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        WRITE: / 'Caught generic exception:', lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_failed_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_operation_failed.
    METHODS test_operation_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_failed_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_operation_with_msg_exc( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_exception_assert(
        exception_class = 'ZCX_OPERATION_FAILED'
        method_call = 'lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( iv_input = -1 )'
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_operation_with_msg_exc( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( iv_input = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true ).
      CATCH zcx_operation_failed.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected ZCX_OPERATION_FAILED exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `cl_message_helper` und einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme, die den Message Helper als Attribut enthält, ermöglicht eine detaillierte Fehlerbehandlung. Die Ausnahme signalisiert das Scheitern der Operation, während der Message Helper alle relevanten Nachrichten für eine umfassende Analyse bereitstellt.

Instructions: Demonstriere die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP` zur Sicherstellung, dass Ressourcen auch im Fehlerfall korrekt freigegeben werden.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt und nicht lokal abgefangen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation.
    PRIVATE SECTION.
      METHODS _open_resource.
      METHODS _close_resource.
      DATA mv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD _open_resource.
    WRITE: / 'Resource opened.'.
    mv_resource_open = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _close_resource.
    IF mv_resource_open = abap_true.
      WRITE: / 'Resource closed.'.
      mv_resource_open = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        _open_resource( ).
        WRITE: / 'Performing critical operation...'.
        " Simulate an error condition
        IF sy-uzeit IS NOT INITIAL. " Always true, just to trigger exception
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        WRITE: / 'Critical operation finished.'.
        _close_resource( ). " This line will not be reached if exception occurs
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        WRITE: / 'Caught arithmetic error:', lx_arith_error->get_text( ).
        " No local cleanup here, let CLEANUP handle it
      CLEANUP.
        WRITE: / 'Entering CLEANUP block.'.
        _close_resource( ). " Resource is closed here, regardless of local CATCH
    ENDTRY.
    WRITE: / 'Exiting perform_operation.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    " We expect an exception to be raised and caught internally,
    " but the cleanup block should still execute.
    " Verifying output is tricky in unit tests, but we can check internal state if exposed.
    " For this example, we'll rely on the logic that cleanup is always called.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_operation( ).
        " If the operation completes without an unhandled exception, it's a success.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Unexpected exception: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block in `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP` stellt sicher, dass bestimmte Aktionen (z.B. das Freigeben von Ressourcen) immer ausgeführt werden, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, unabhängig davon, ob sie lokal abgefangen wird oder nicht. Dies ist entscheidend für die Stabilität und Ressourcenschonung.
keywords: S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS, Class-Based Exceptions, TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP, Error Handling, Resource Management

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der belegten Sitze für Flüge, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Flugdatum in der Zukunft), und gib die Summe pro Fluggesellschaft aus. Verwende dabei eine Kombination aus `FOR`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verschachtele `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_complex_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_future_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_future_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_future_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrier_future_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_future_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_seats_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_future_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_complex_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid
                               total_future_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                               FOR future_flight IN FILTER #( GROUP flight WHERE fldate > sy-datum )
                                                               NEXT sum = sum + future_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_seats_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_seats_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_complex_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Assuming 'LH' might have future flights, check its sum
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_future_sum).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_future_sum-total_future_seats >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP durch die Verschachtelung von `FOR GROUPS OF`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Es ermöglicht komplexe Datenaggregationen und -filterungen in einer einzigen, hochgradig lesbaren und effizienten Anweisung.
keywords: SUM, FOR GROUPS OF, FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Table, Grouping, Conditional Logic, sflights

Instructions: Sammle Nachrichten mit `cl_message_helper` und gib nur die Fehlermeldungen formatiert aus.
hint: Verwende `cl_message_helper->get_messages` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_error_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_error_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_error_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgv1 = 'Info' ).
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgv1 = 'Warning' ).
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgv1 = 'Error' ).
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgty = 'A' iv_msgv1 = 'Abort' ).

    rt_errors = VALUE #( FOR ls_msg IN FILTER #( lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ) WHERE msgty = 'E' OR msgty = 'A' )
                             ( |{ ls_msg-msgty } { ls_msg-msgid } { ls_msg-msgno }: { ls_msg-msgv1 }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_error_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_error_messages( ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_cut->get_formatted_error_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ] exp = 'E SFLIGHT 003: Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 2 ] exp = 'A SFLIGHT 004: Abort' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `cl_message_helper->get_messages()` mit `FILTER` und einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor kann man Nachrichtenlisten effizient filtern und direkt in ein gewünschtes Format transformieren. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: cl_message_helper, Message Processing, FILTER, VALUE, String Templates

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Operation ausführt und bei einem Fehler eine Ausnahme auslöst. Die Ausnahme soll eine Kette von Ursachenausnahmen (`previous exception`) enthalten.
hint: Verwende den `PREVIOUS` Parameter im Konstruktor der Ausnahme, um eine Ausnahme zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcx_inner_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_inner_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_outer_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_outer_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chain_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS inner_operation RAISING zcx_inner_error.
    METHODS outer_operation RAISING zcx_outer_error.
    METHODS run_demo.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chain_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inner_operation.
    " Simulate an error
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_inner_error
      EXPORTING
        textid = zcx_inner_error=>default_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD outer_operation.
    TRY.
        inner_operation( ).
      CATCH zcx_inner_error INTO DATA(lx_inner).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_outer_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_outer_error=>default_text
            previous = lx_inner. " Chain the exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run_demo.
    TRY.
        outer_operation( ).
      CATCH zcx_outer_error INTO DATA(lx_outer).
        WRITE: / 'Caught outer exception:', lx_outer->get_text( ).
        IF lx_outer->previous IS BOUND.
          WRITE: / '  Previous exception:', lx_outer->previous->get_text( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        WRITE: / 'Caught generic exception:', lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_chaining FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_outer_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_chain_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->outer_operation( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected ZCX_OUTER_ERROR exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_outer_error INTO DATA(lx_outer).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_outer IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_outer->previous IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_outer->previous->get_class_name( ) exp = 'ZCX_INNER_ERROR' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Verketten von Ausnahmen (`exception chaining`) mit dem `PREVIOUS`-Parameter im Konstruktor ist eine moderne Praxis, um den vollständigen Kontext eines Fehlers zu bewahren. Es ermöglicht, die ursprüngliche Ursache eines Problems nachzuvollziehen, selbst wenn es durch mehrere Schichten der Fehlerbehandlung propagiert wird.
keywords: S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS, Class-Based Exceptions, Exception Chaining, Error Handling, PREVIOUS

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der belegten Sitze für jeden Flug, aber nur für Flüge, die noch nicht voll sind (seatsocc < seatsmax).
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `COND` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_cond_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_for_not_full_flights RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_cond_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_for_not_full_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( flight-seatsocc < flight-seatsmax )
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_not_full_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_not_full_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_cond_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_sum_for_not_full_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total >= 0 ) ).
    " A more precise test would involve mocking sflights data
    " For example, if we know there's one flight with seatsocc=50, seatsmax=100
    " and another with seatsocc=100, seatsmax=100, the sum should be 50.
    " For this example, a non-negative check is sufficient.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks in Kombination mit `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine direkte Filterung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Möglichkeit, Daten zu verarbeiten, ohne explizite `IF`-Bedingungen oder temporäre Tabellen.
keywords: SUM, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Table, Conditional Logic, sflights

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine gegebene Dateierweiterung einem bekannten Bild-MIME-Typ entspricht, indem Sie Konstanten aus `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung oder einen `COND`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` Konstanten wie `S_IMAGE_JPEG`, `S_IMAGE_PNG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_image_mime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_image_extension
      IMPORTING iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_image) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_image_mime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_image_extension.
    rv_is_image = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_extension = 'jpg' OR iv_extension = 'jpeg' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_jpeg IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
      WHEN iv_extension = 'png' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_png IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
      WHEN iv_extension = 'gif' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_gif IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
      WHEN iv_extension = 'bmp' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_bmp IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_image_extension FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_image_extension.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_check_image_mime( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_image_extension( 'jpg' ) msg = 'JPG should be an image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_image_extension( 'png' ) msg = 'PNG should be an image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_image_extension( 'txt' ) msg = 'TXT should not be an image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_image_extension( 'pdf' ) msg = 'PDF should not be an image' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung des `COND`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingter Logik. Die direkten Vergleiche mit den Konstanten von `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` stellen sicher, dass die Prüfung auf standardisierte MIME-Typen erfolgt.
keywords: MIME, Conditional, COND, CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES, String Processing

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Dateinamen und ihren entsprechenden MIME-Typen, wobei Sie `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` für gängige Typen verwenden. Nicht erkannte Typen sollen 'application/octet-stream' erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einer `CASE`-Anweisung, um Dateierweiterungen auf MIME-Typen abzubilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_map_file_mime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             file_name TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_info.
    TYPES: tt_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_files_to_mime
      IMPORTING it_file_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_file_mime_info) TYPE tt_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_map_file_mime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_files_to_mime.
    rt_file_mime_info = VALUE #( FOR file_name IN it_file_names
                                 LET extension = to_lower( substring_after( val = file_name sep = '.' ) ) IN
                                 ( file_name = file_name,
                                   mime_type = CASE extension
                                                 WHEN 'txt' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_plain
                                                 WHEN 'pdf' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_application_pdf
                                                 WHEN 'jpg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_jpeg
                                                 WHEN 'png' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_png
                                                 WHEN 'xml' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_xml
                                                 WHEN 'html' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_html
                                                 ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_application_octet_stream
                                               END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_files_to_mime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_files_to_mime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_map_file_mime( ).
    DATA(lt_file_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'document.pdf' ) ( 'image.jpg' ) ( 'report.txt' ) ( 'unknown.xyz' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_files_to_mime( lt_file_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).

    UNION ALL

hint: Führen Sie zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen mit `UNION ALL` aus, um die Daten zu erhalten. Verarbeiten Sie dann die Ergebnisse in ABAP mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung und `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` Konstanten.

CLASS zcl_flight_mime_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_mime_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflights-fldate,
             fltype    TYPE sflights-fltype,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_mime_info.

    METHODS get_flights_with_mime
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_mime_info) TYPE tt_flight_mime_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mime_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_mime.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @lt_raw_flights.

    rt_flight_mime_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
                                   ( carrid    = ls_raw_flight-carrid,
                                     connid    = ls_raw_flight-connid,
                                     fldate    = ls_raw_flight-fldate,
                                     fltype    = ls_raw_flight-fltype,
                                     mime_type = CASE ls_raw_flight-fltype
                                                   WHEN 'P' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_application_pdf
                                                   WHEN 'X' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_xslfo_supplementary
                                                   WHEN 'T' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_plain
                                                   ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_application_octet_stream
                                                 END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sind zwei interne Tabellen: eine mit Dateinamen und eine mit Dokumenttypen. Kombinieren Sie diese zu einer einzigen Tabelle. Bestimmen Sie dann für jeden Eintrag, ob der Dokumenttyp ein bekannter Bildtyp ist, indem Sie `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` Konstanten verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` um die Tabellen zu kombinieren und dann `COND` oder `CASE` mit `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` Konstanten zur Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_combine_and_check_mime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_doc_type,
             file_name   TYPE string,
             document_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_doc_type.
    TYPES: tt_file_doc_type TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_doc_type WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_info,
             file_name   TYPE string,
             document_type TYPE string,
             is_image    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_combined_info.
    TYPES: tt_combined_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_and_check
      IMPORTING it_file_names TYPE string_table
                it_doc_types  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined) TYPE tt_combined_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_combine_and_check_mime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_and_check.
    DATA(lt_temp_combined) = VALUE tt_file_doc_type( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( it_file_names )
                                                    ( file_name = it_file_names[ i ]
                                                      document_type = it_doc_types[ i ] ) ).

    rt_combined = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_temp_combined
                           ( file_name   = ls_entry-file_name,
                             document_type = ls_entry-document_type,
                             is_image    = COND abap_bool(
                                             WHEN ls_entry-document_type = 'JPG' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_jpeg IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
                                             WHEN ls_entry-document_type = 'PNG' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_png IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
                                             WHEN ls_entry-document_type = 'GIF' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_gif IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true
                                             ELSE abap_false
                                           ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_combine_and_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_and_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_combine_and_check_mime( ).
    DATA(lt_file_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'pic1.jpg' ) ( 'doc.pdf' ) ( 'logo.png' ) ( 'text.txt' ) ).
    DATA(lt_doc_types)  = VALUE string_table( ( 'JPG' ) ( 'PDF' ) ( 'PNG' ) ( 'TXT' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_and_check( it_file_names = lt_file_names it_doc_types = lt_doc_types ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_image msg = 'JPG should be image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_image msg = 'PDF should not be image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-is_image msg = 'PNG should be image' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-is_image msg = 'TXT should not be image' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_handler_factory IMPLEMENTATION.

    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_text_files IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_text_files_by_mime.
    rt_text_files = FILTER #( it_file_names USING KEY default WHERE
                               ( to_lower( substring_after( val = table_line sep = '.' ) ) = 'txt' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_plain IS NOT INITIAL ) OR
                               ( to_lower( substring_after( val = table_line sep = '.' ) ) = 'html' AND cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_html IS NOT INITIAL ) OR

hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT DISTINCT ... UNION ... EXCEPT (SELECT ... INTERSECT ...)` oder `UNION` mit einer komplexeren `WHERE`-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_union_xor_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK'
    EXCEPT
    ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid
        FROM sflights
        WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      INTERSECT
      SELECT DISTINCT carrid
        FROM sflights
        WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_xor_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_carrids_xor_cities( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_carrids IS INITIAL msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).

Es kombiniert die Ergebnisse von zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen mit `UNION` und subtrahiert dann die Schnittmenge (`INTERSECT`) dieser beiden Mengen mit `EXCEPT`. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und effiziente Methode, um komplexe Mengenoperationen direkt auf der Datenbankebene durchzuführen, was zu einer erheblichen Leistungsverbesserung gegenüber ABAP-basierter Logik führen kann.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTC-Timestamp in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit unter Berücksichtigung einer Zeitzone mit der XCO Time API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>timestamp->convert_to_local`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_timestamp_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_local_datetime,
             date TYPE d,
             time TYPE t,
           END OF ty_local_datetime.

    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_timezone  TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_dt) TYPE ty_local_datetime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_timestamp_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lo_local_time) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->convert_to_local(
      iv_timestamp
    )->at_timezone(
      iv_timezone
    )->value( ).

    rs_local_dt-date = lo_local_time->get_date( ).
    rs_local_dt-time = lo_local_time->get_time( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
