    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_timestamp_conv( ).
    DATA(ls_local_dt) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( iv_timestamp = '20250101100000.0000000' iv_timezone = 'CET' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-date exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-time exp = '110000' ). " CET is UTC+1

    ls_local_dt = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( iv_timestamp = '20250101000000.0000000' iv_timezone = 'PST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-date exp = '20241231' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-time exp = '160000' ). " PST is UTC-8
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Arbeitstagen nach einem Startdatum liegt, unter Berücksichtigung eines Fabrikkalenders (simuliert).
hint: Die XCO Time API kann mit Fabrikkalendern umgehen. Hier wird eine vereinfachte Logik verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_workday_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_after_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_workdays   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_workday_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_after_workdays.
    " XCO Time API has factory calendar integration, but for a simple example
    " and testability without full calendar setup, we simulate.
    " A real implementation would use xco_cp_time=>date->add_workdays(...).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_days_added) = 0.

    WHILE lv_days_added < iv_workdays.
      lv_current_date = xco_cp_time=>date->add_days( lv_current_date )->amount( 1 )->value( ).
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = xco_cp_time=>date->get_day_of_week( lv_current_date )->value( ).
      " Simulate workday: Monday (1) to Friday (5)
      IF lv_day_of_week >= 1 AND lv_day_of_week <= 5.
        lv_days_added = lv_days_added + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_end_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_workday_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workday_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_workday_calc( ).
    " Start on a Monday, add 5 workdays -> next Monday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_date_after_workdays( iv_start_date = '20250106' iv_workdays = 5 ) exp = '20250113' ).
    " Start on a Friday, add 1 workday -> next Monday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_date_after_workdays( iv_start_date = '20250110' iv_workdays = 1 ) exp = '20250113' ).
    " Start on a Saturday, add 1 workday -> next Monday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_date_after_workdays( iv_start_date = '20250111' iv_workdays = 1 ) exp = '20250113' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert die Berechnung eines Datums nach einer bestimmten Anzahl von Arbeitstagen unter Verwendung der XCO Time API für Datumsmanipulationen. Die XCO API bietet auch direkte Unterstützung für Fabrikkalender, was in einer vollständigen Implementierung genutzt werden sollte.
keywords: XCO, Date, Workdays, Factory Calendar, Time API, 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur von SFLIGHTS und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Zeigen Sie die Daten anschließend in einem einfachen ALV an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` und `cl_salv_table=>factory`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_alv          TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        " 1. Get structure description for SFLIGHTS
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

        " 2. Create dynamic internal table
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_sflights>.

        " 3. Fill dynamic table with data
        SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE <lt_sflights> UP TO 10 ROWS.

        " 4. Display data in ALV
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_sflights> ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei der ALV-Anzeige oder Typbeschreibung' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_display_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_sflights( ).
    " Since ALV display is interactive, we can only test if the method executes without dump.
    " A real test would involve mocking CL_SALV_TABLE or checking system messages.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflights( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_act = '' " No dump occurred
                                            iv_msg = 'ALV display should not dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'ALV display caused a dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das Flexibilität bei der Laufzeitgestaltung von Datenstrukturen bietet. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Feldkatalog für eine ALV-Ausgabe basierend auf der Struktur der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fieldcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_catalog RETURNING VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fieldcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_field_catalog(
          EXPORTING
            i_struct_descr = lo_struct_descr

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie diese mit `cl_salv_table` an, wobei der Feldkatalog ebenfalls dynamisch generiert wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die Tabelle und den Feldkatalog mit `cl_salv_table` für die Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_fieldcat     TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv          TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        " 1. Get structure description for SFLIGHTS
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

        " 2. Create dynamic internal table
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " 3. Fill dynamic table with data
        SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> UP TO 5 ROWS.

        " 4. Create dynamic field catalog
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_field_catalog(
          EXPORTING
            i_struct_descr = lo_struct_descr
          IMPORTING
            e_field_catalog = lt_fieldcat ).

        " 5. Display data in ALV
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table> ).

        lo_alv->set_screen_status( pfstatus = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN' report = sy-repid ).
        lo_alv->get_columns( )->set_optimize( abap_true ).
        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei der ALV-Anzeige oder Typbeschreibung' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die nur die Felder CARRID, CONNID und FLDATE aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS enthält, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Erstellen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Feldkatalog und nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_subset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_subset_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_subset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_subset_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fcat     TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    " 1. Define custom field catalog for selected fields
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fcat-inttype   = 'C'.
    ls_fcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fcat-inttype   = 'N'.
    ls_fcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fcat-inttype   = 'D'.
    ls_fcat-intlen    = 8.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table based on custom field catalog
    TRY.
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
          EXPORTING
            i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
          IMPORTING
            e_table_descr  = lo_table_descr
          CHANGING
            c_table        = ro_data ).

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " 3. Fill dynamic table with data from SFLIGHTS
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> UP TO 5 ROWS.

      CATCH cx_alv_table_create.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei der dynamischen Tabellenerstellung' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion zum Hochladen einer Textdatei vom Frontend auf den Applikationsserver. Der Benutzer soll den Dateipfad auswählen können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_file IMPORTING iv_app_server_path TYPE string
                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_file.
    DATA: lv_frontend_file TYPE string,
          lt_file_content  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Open file dialog for user to select file
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            i_multiselection = abap_false
            i_cdfilter       = '*.txt'
          CHANGING
            c_frontend_file  = lv_frontend_file
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS           = 1 ).

        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_frontend_file IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Keine Datei ausgewählt oder Fehler beim Dialog.' TYPE 'I'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Upload file content
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_frontend_file
            filetype                = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_file_content
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS                  = 1 ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Save to application server (example: write to internal table)
          " In a real scenario, you would write lt_file_content to a file on the app server.
          MESSAGE 'Datei erfolgreich hochgeladen.' TYPE 'S'.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei.' TYPE 'E'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        MESSAGE 'Frontend-Service nicht verfügbar oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upload_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_upload( ).
    " Unit test for GUI_UPLOAD is problematic as it requires user interaction.
    " We can only test if the method call itself doesn't dump and returns a specific error if no file is selected.
    " For a true test, mocking CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES would be necessary.
    TRY.
        " Simulate no file selected (user cancels dialog)
        DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->upload_file( '/tmp/test_upload.txt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success
                                            exp = abap_false
                                            iv_msg = 'Upload should fail if no file selected' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Upload method caused a dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie ist Teil der GUI-Klassen und erfordert eine aktive SAP GUI-Verbindung. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist eine moderne Praxis, um robuste Anwendungen zu entwickeln.

CLASS zcl_fes_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights_data.
    DATA: lv_frontend_file TYPE string,
          lt_sflights_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    " Get some SFLIGHTS data
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_data UP TO 5 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights_data IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten zum Herunterladen gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " Open file dialog for user to select save path
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            i_cdfilter       = '*.txt'
            i_default_extension = 'txt'
            i_default_file_name = 'sflights_data.txt'
          CHANGING
            c_frontend_file  = lv_frontend_file
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS           = 1 ).

        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_frontend_file IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Kein Speicherort ausgewählt oder Fehler beim Dialog.' TYPE 'I'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Download file content
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_frontend_file
            filetype                = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_sflights_data
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS                  = 1 ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE 'Datei erfolgreich heruntergeladen.' TYPE 'S'.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei.' TYPE 'E'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        MESSAGE 'Frontend-Service nicht verfügbar oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_exist(

          EXCEPTIONS

          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Überprüfen der Datei.' TYPE 'E'.
          rv_exists = abap_false.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        MESSAGE 'Frontend-Service nicht verfügbar oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'E'.

    ENDTRY.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_existence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_file_exist( ).

    " Test with a path that likely doesn't exist
    DATA(lv_exists_false) = lo_cut->check_file_existence( 'C:\non_existent_file_12345.txt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_false
                                        exp = abap_false
                                        iv_msg = 'Non-existent file should return false' ).

    " Test with an empty path
    DATA(lv_exists_empty) = lo_cut->check_file_existence( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_empty

CLASS zcl_fes_get_gui_ver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fes_get_gui_ver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_gui_version.
    DATA: lv_major TYPE i, lv_minor TYPE i, lv_patch TYPE i, lv_build TYPE i.

        cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_sapgui_version(

            major_version = lv_major

            patch_version = lv_patch

        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Ermitteln der SAP GUI Version.' TYPE 'E'.
          CLEAR rv_version.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        MESSAGE 'Frontend-Service nicht verfügbar oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'E'.
        CLEAR rv_version.

Instructions: Verbergen Sie die Spalten 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' in einem ALV für SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_column()` und `set_technical( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>false )` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_hide_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS hide_sflight_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_columns_to_hide TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_alv_table) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_hide_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD hide_sflight_columns.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflight
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = ro_alv_table->get_columns( ).
        LOOP AT it_columns_to_hide INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
          TRY.
              DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name ).
              lo_column->set_technical( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>false ). " Hides the column
            CATCH cx_salv_msg.
              " Column not found, ignore or log
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_hide_columns( ).
    DATA(lt_hide) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).
    DATA(lo_alv) = lo_cut->hide_sflight_columns( lt_hide ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = lo_alv
      msg = 'ALV instance should be created'
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lo_connid_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
    DATA(lo_fldate_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'FLDATE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_connid_column->is_technical( )
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'CONNID column should be technical (hidden)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_fldate_column->is_technical( )
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'FLDATE column should be technical (hidden)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `get_items()` und rekursive Verarbeitung für Untermenüs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_get_fcode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_complex_menu RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
    METHODS get_all_fcodes
      IMPORTING
        io_menu TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcodes) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_fcodes_recursive
      IMPORTING
        io_menu TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu
      CHANGING
        ct_fcodes TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_get_fcode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_complex_menu.
    ro_menu = cl_ctmenu=>create_menu( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'MAIN_FNC1' text = 'Hauptfunktion 1' ).
    ro_menu->add_separator( ).

    DATA(lo_submenu) = cl_ctmenu=>create_menu( ).
    lo_submenu->add_function( fcode = 'SUB_FNC_A' text = 'Unterfunktion A' ).
    lo_submenu->add_function( fcode = 'SUB_FNC_B' text = 'Unterfunktion B' ).
    ro_menu->add_submenu( fcode = 'SUBMENU' text = 'Untermenü' submenu = lo_submenu ).

    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'MAIN_FNC2' text = 'Hauptfunktion 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_fcodes.
    get_fcodes_recursive( EXPORTING io_menu = io_menu CHANGING ct_fcodes = rt_fcodes ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_fcodes_recursive.
    LOOP AT io_menu->get_items( ) INTO DATA(ls_item).
      IF ls_item-type = cl_ctmenu=>item_type_function.
        APPEND ls_item-fcode TO ct_fcodes.
      ELSE IF ls_item-type = cl_ctmenu=>item_type_submenu.
        get_fcodes_recursive( EXPORTING io_menu = ls_item-submenu CHANGING ct_fcodes = ct_fcodes ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_count
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count.
    DATA: ls_grouped_entry TYPE ty_grouped_result.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_entry-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_entry-count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_grp_count_flights=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum_price.
    DATA: ls_grouped_entry TYPE ty_grouped_result.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_entry-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      SUM. "Sums numeric fields of the group into the work area ls_flight

      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_data.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und sammeln Sie die Details jedes Fluges in einer separaten internen Tabelle pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine `FOR ... GROUP BY ...` Expression mit `VALUE #`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `VALUE #` für die Konstruktion der Ergebnisstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_into_table
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_detail
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_into_table.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS carrid
      ( 
        carrid = carrid,
        flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight ( ls_member ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_for_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression innerhalb der `FOR ... GROUP BY` Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation des Durchschnitts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_result,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_avg_price_result.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_avg_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_avg_price.
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS carrid
      ( 
        carrid = carrid,
        avg_price = REDUCE decfloat34(
          INIT sum_price = 0
               count     = 0
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT
            sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price
            count     = count + 1
          RESULT
            COND decfloat34( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_price / count ELSE 0 )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Flugnummer (connid) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Passagiere (seatsocc) pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine moderne LOOP AT ... GROUP BY Anweisung mit mehreren Schlüsselfeldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY ( carrid = ... connid = ... )` und `SUM` für die Passagieranzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_multi_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_by_multiple_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_multi_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_multiple_fields.
    DATA: ls_grouped_entry TYPE ty_grouped_result.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ).
      ls_grouped_entry-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_entry-connid = ls_flight-connid.
      SUM.
      ls_grouped_entry-passengers_count = ls_flight-seatsocc.
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem String und extrahieren Sie zusätzlich die Submatches (Teilmuster) jedes Vorkommens.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX ... IN ... RESULTS ... SUBMATCHES ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_regex_submatches DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_find_result,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_find_result.
    TYPES: tt_find_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_find_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_submatches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_full_match,
             main_match TYPE ty_find_result,
             submatches TYPE tt_submatches,
           END OF ty_full_match.
    TYPES: tt_full_matches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_full_match WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_regex_with_submatches
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_full_matches) TYPE tt_full_matches.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_regex_submatches IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_regex_with_submatches.
    DATA: lt_main_results TYPE tt_find_results.
    DATA: lt_submatches_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF match_result_tab WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_main_results
      SUBMATCHES lt_submatches_raw.

    LOOP AT lt_main_results INTO DATA(ls_main_result).
      DATA(ls_full_match) = VALUE ty_full_match(
        main_match = ls_main_result
      ).
      READ TABLE lt_submatches_raw INTO DATA(ls_submatch_raw) INDEX sy-tabix.
      LOOP AT ls_submatch_raw-submatches INTO DATA(ls_submatch_entry).
        APPEND iv_text+ls_submatch_entry-offset(ls_submatch_entry-length) TO ls_full_match-submatches.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_full_match TO rt_full_matches.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_find_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD highlight_word.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN iv_sentence RESULTS DATA(ls_result).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_highlighted_sentence = |{ iv_sentence(ls_result-offset) }**{ iv_sentence+ls_result-offset(ls_result-length) }**{ iv_sentence+ls_result-offset+ls_result-length }|.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe, ob mindestens ein Flug einen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert hat. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit einer `COND` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `COND` mit `LINE_EXISTS` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_cond_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_check_result,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             has_high_price TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_grouped_check_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_check_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_check_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_check_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_cond_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_high_price_flights.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS carrid
      ( 
        carrid = carrid,
        has_high_price = COND abap_bool(
          WHEN LINE_EXISTS( GROUP ls_flight[ price > iv_price_threshold ] ) THEN abap_true
          ELSE abap_false
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_extract_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_find_extract_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA: lt_find_results TYPE match_result_tab.
    CONSTANTS: lc_email_pattern TYPE string VALUE '\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b'.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und filtern Sie innerhalb jeder Gruppe nur die Flüge heraus, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an belegten Sitzen (seatsocc) haben. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit einer `FILTER` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `FILTER` für die selektive Auswahl von Gruppenelementen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_filter_members DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_filtered_flights,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE tt_flights,
           END OF ty_grouped_filtered_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_filtered_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_filter_members
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_min_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_filter_members IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_filter_members.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS carrid
      ( 
        carrid = carrid,
        flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_member IN FILTER tt_flights( GROUP ls_flight WHERE seatsocc >= iv_min_seatsocc ) ( ls_member ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_raise_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS find_word_or_raise
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_raise_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_word_or_raise.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN iv_text.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_strg_not_found=>cx_sy_strg_not_found
          text   = |Das Wort '{ iv_word }' wurde im Text nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_success.
    " Sollte keine Ausnahme auslösen
    zcl_find_raise_exception=>find_word_or_raise( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_word = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Prüfen, ob sy-subrc 0 ist
  ENDMETHOD.

    " Sollte eine Ausnahme auslösen

        zcl_find_raise_exception=>find_word_or_raise( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_word = 'SAP' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Es sollte eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.' ).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Flugnummern (connid) für jede Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` zum Verketten von Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_concat_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connids,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_connids.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_concat_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_concat_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_concat_connids.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS carrid
      ( 
        carrid = carrid,
        connids = REDUCE string(
          INIT lv_connids = ''
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT
            lv_connids = COND string(
              WHEN lv_connids IS INITIAL THEN ls_member-connid
              ELSE |{ lv_connids }, { ls_member-connid }|
            )
          RESULT lv_connids
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem Text dynamisch nach einem Muster, das zur Laufzeit als regulärer Ausdruck übergeben wird. Wenn das Muster gefunden wird, geben Sie den gefundenen Text zurück. Wenn nicht, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX ... IN ... MATCH OFFSET ... MATCH LENGTH ...` und eine `COND` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_dynamic_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_dynamic_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
        iv_default TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_dynamic_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_dynamic_pattern.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX iv_pattern IN iv_text
      MATCH OFFSET lv_offset
      MATCH LENGTH lv_length.

    rv_found_text = COND string(
      WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN iv_text+lv_offset(lv_length)
      ELSE iv_default
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_validate_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS validate_date_format

        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_find_validate_format IMPLEMENTATION.

    CONSTANTS: lc_date_pattern TYPE string VALUE '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

CLASS zcl_group_by_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL " For testability
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Passagiersitze pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ts_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_capacities) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP group_key WHERE ( seatsocc IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid total_capacity = lv_total_capacity ) TO rt_carrier_capacities.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,

CLASS zcl_group_by_collect IMPLEMENTATION.

      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

      DATA ls_carrier_conns LIKE LINE OF rt_carrier_conns.

        APPEND ls_member-connid TO ls_carrier_conns-connids.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Flugdaten (Flugdatum und belegte Sitze) als Liste enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `GROUP BY`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ts_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ts_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_for
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_for.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_group-carrid
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
          ( fldate = ls_member-fldate seatsocc = ls_member-seatsocc )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_cond_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_high_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             has_high_capacity TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ts_carrier_high_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_high_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_high_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_high_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_high_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_cond_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_high_capacity_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_has_high_capacity) = COND abap_bool(

CLASS zcl_group_by_string_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_conns_string,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids_string TYPE string,
           END OF ts_carrier_conns_string.
    TYPES tt_carrier_conns_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_conns_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_string_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_conns_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_string_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_string_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_connids_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR member IN GROUP group_key NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ member-connid }| ELSE |{ s }, { member-connid }| ) ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid connids_string = lv_connids_string ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_count TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_group_by_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflights WHERE ( fldate > iv_min_fldate ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Passagiersitze pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_avg_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_capacity TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ts_carrier_avg_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_avg_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_capacity_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_capacities) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE TYPE zcl_group_by_avg=>ts_carrier_avg_capacity(
        INIT sum = 0 count = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP group_key WHERE ( seatsocc IS NOT INITIAL )
        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc
             count = count + 1
        FINALLY
          carrid = group_key-carrid
          average_capacity = COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 )
      ).
      APPEND ls_aggregation TO rt_avg_capacities.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` innerhalb von `GROUP BY`, um komplexere Aggregationen wie den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Durch die Initialisierung mehrerer Variablen (`sum`, `count`) und die Verwendung der `FINALLY`-Klausel kann das Endergebnis (Durchschnitt) nach der Iteration über alle Gruppenmitglieder berechnet werden. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.

CLASS zcl_group_by_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_dynamic_group_count,
             group_key_value TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_dynamic_group_count.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_group_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_dynamic_group_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE string
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_dynamic_group_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) GROUP BY ( <fs_sflight>-* ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_group_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Handle error: field not found
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( group_key_value = <fs_group_field> flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Excel-Dokument (XLSX) mit einer Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Flugdaten aus `sflight`.

CLASS zcl_openxml_excel_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_excel_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_excel.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_header TYPE string.
    DATA lv_row TYPE string.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_sflights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights. " Limit for example
    ENDIF.

    " Create header row
    lv_header = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY'.
    APPEND lv_header TO lt_excel_data.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_row = |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }|.
      APPEND lv_row TO lt_excel_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Generate XLSX from CSV-like data using CL_OPENXML_HELPER
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_openxml_helper=>s_ooxml_cross(
          i_data_tab = lt_excel_data
          i_separator = ';' " Semicolon as separator
          i_file_type = 'XLSX' " Output as XLSX
        ).
      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml_helper).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_helper->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine gefilterte interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE ty_sflights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                            WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                            ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                              connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                              fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                              price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_sflight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'LH' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für LH mit Preisen, die summiert werden können.
    " Hier müsste ein bekannter Wert aus Testdaten verwendet werden.
    " Für diesen Beispieltest nehmen wir an, dass die Summe > 0 ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total_price msg = 'Total price should not be initial for LH' ).

    " Um einen exakten Wert zu testen, müsste man die Testdaten kontrollieren.
    " Beispiel: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '1234.56' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einer WHERE-Klausel kann man direkt über gefilterte Daten iterieren und eine Summe bilden, ohne explizite Schleifen oder temporäre Variablen.
keywords: REDUCE, SUM, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) sowie die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY und anschließend REDUCE für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES ty_grouped_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_sums
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_results) TYPE ty_grouped_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_sums.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE ty_sflights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                            ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                              connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                              fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                              price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    rt_grouped_results = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights
                                    GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                                    ( carrid      = ls_group-carrid
                                      total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                                               FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price )
                                      flight_count = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0
                                                                FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                                  NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_sums FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_sums.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflight_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_grouped_sums( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_results ) msg = 'Results table should not be empty' ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob LH in den Ergebnissen ist und eine Summe hat.
    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = ls_lh_result msg = 'LH should be in results' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_lh_result-total_price msg = 'Total price for LH should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_lh_result-flight_count msg = 'Flight count for LH should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Innerhalb der Gruppen können dann weitere Aggregationen, wie die Summe (REDUCE) oder die Anzahl der Elemente, elegant und effizient durchgeführt werden.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, SUM, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) zu erhalten, die nach einem bestimmten Datum (FLDATE) stattfinden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE ty_sflights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                                ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                  connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                                  fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                                  price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für LH nach dem 20250101.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_results ) msg = 'Filtered results should not be empty' ).

    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect CARRIER in filtered results' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > '20250101' ) msg = 'Incorrect FLDATE in filtered results' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf beliebigen Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den passenden Einträgen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Selection

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Status-Text zu, basierend auf dem Preis eines Fluges: 'Günstig' (< 200), 'Standard' (200-500), 'Teuer' (> 500). Nutzen Sie den COND-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_price_status.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN iv_price >= 200 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN 'Standard'
      ELSE 'Teuer'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_status( '250.00' ) exp = 'Standard' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_status( '500.00' ) exp = 'Standard' ).

keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und geben Sie einen deutschen Namen zurück. Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie SWITCH #( ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) und die Funktion `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday_name( iv_date ).

    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string(
      lv_weekday
      WHEN 'Monday'    THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 'Tuesday'   THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 'Thursday'  THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 'Friday'    THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 'Saturday'  THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 'Sunday'    THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_weekday_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_expression_demo( ).

    " 2025-11-22 ist ein Samstag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251122' ) exp = 'Samstag' ).
    " 2025-11-24 ist ein Montag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251124' ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    " 2025-11-23 ist ein Sonntag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251123' ) exp = 'Sonntag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der SWITCH-Ausdruck ist eine Erweiterung des COND-Ausdrucks und ermöglicht eine noch kompaktere und übersichtlichere bedingte Zuweisung, wenn der Wert von einer einzelnen Variablen oder einem Ausdruck abhängt. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit im Vergleich zu verschachtelten IF-Anweisungen oder CASE-Blöcken.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expression, Date/Time

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die verkettet aufgerufen werden können (Method Chaining), um eine Konfiguration schrittweise aufzubauen.
hint: Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (ME) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_param1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining_demo.
    METHODS set_param2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining_demo.
    METHODS get_config_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_config) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    mv_param1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    mv_param2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config_string.
    rv_config = |Param1: { mv_param1 }, Param2: { mv_param2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_config) = NEW zcl_method_chaining_demo( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_config->set_param1( 'Wert A' )->set_param2( 'Wert B' )->get_config_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Param1: Wert A, Param2: Wert B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu kombinieren. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren, lesbareren Code, der oft als 'Fluent Interface' bezeichnet wird. Jede verkettbare Methode muss dabei eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (ME) zurückgeben.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Nutzen Sie dabei den SUM-Operator in Kombination mit der Zeilenanzahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE für die Summe und LINES für die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE ty_sflights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                            WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                            ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                              connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                              fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                              price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " Alle Felder als String
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any table line.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

      " Beispiel: Füllen mit Daten
      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_field> = |{ lv_field_name }_Value1|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_field> = |{ lv_field_name }_Value2|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_rtti( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_rtti=>tt_field_names( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD2' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_names ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 INTO <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = <ls_line> msg = 'First line should be readable' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field1> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'FIELD1_Value1' msg = 'Value of FIELD1 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) ermöglicht die dynamische Erstellung von Datentypen und Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme oder Schnittstellen, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` ist der moderne Weg, um Typbeschreibungen zu erstellen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Named Parameters und Optional Parameters in einer Methode.
hint: Deklarieren Sie Parameter mit `OPTIONAL` und rufen Sie die Methode mit `parameter_name = value` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_named_optional_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_required_param TYPE string
        iv_optional_param TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_another_param  TYPE i      OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_named_optional_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rv_result = |Required: { iv_required_param }|.

    IF iv_optional_param IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_result = rv_result && |; Optional String: { iv_optional_param }|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_another_param IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_result = rv_result && |; Optional Integer: { iv_another_param }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_required_only.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_named_optional_params( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_data(

    ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null verursachen könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` um arithmetische Fehler abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung bei Division durch Null oder anderen arithmetischen Fehlern
        MESSAGE lx_arith_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_result = 0. " Standardwert im Fehlerfall
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Sie ermöglicht es, Laufzeitfehler (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` ist die spezifische Klasse für arithmetische Fehler.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die es ermöglicht, Text in einem `cl_gui_abapedit`-Control zu setzen und den aktuell im Editor befindlichen Text auszulesen. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einem Beispielcode.
hint: Nutzen Sie `set_text_as_r3table` zum Setzen und `get_text_as_r3table` zum Auslesen des Textes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_text_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS set_editor_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_code_string TYPE string.

    METHODS get_editor_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_code_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_abapedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_text_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_abapedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_editor_text.
    DATA(lt_code_table) = VALUE string_table( ( iv_code_string ) ).
    mo_abapedit->set_text_as_r3table( lt_code_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_editor_text.
    DATA lt_code_table TYPE string_table.
    mo_abapedit->get_text_as_r3table( IMPORTING table = lt_code_table ).
    rv_code_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN lt_code_table
      CONCATENATE s <line> INTO s SEPARATED BY cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_text_io FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_text_io.
    DATA lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.

    DATA(lv_initial_code) = 'REPORT z_test. DATA: lv_var TYPE i. lv_var = 10.'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_text_io( io_container = lo_container ).

    lo_cut->set_editor_text( lv_initial_code ).
    DATA(lv_read_code) = lo_cut->get_editor_text( ).

    " The get_editor_text method adds CR_LF, so we need to adjust the expected string
    DATA(lv_expected_code_with_crlf) = REPLACE( val = lv_initial_code regex = `\.` with = `.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    " Remove trailing CR_LF if present from the last line
    IF lv_expected_code_with_crlf ENDS WITH cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
      lv_expected_code_with_crlf = lv_expected_code_with_crlf( 0 TO strlen( lv_expected_code_with_crlf ) - strlen( cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) - 1 ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_read_code exp = lv_initial_code msg = 'Read code should match set code' ).

    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Setzen und Auslesen von Text im ABAP Editor Control. Die `REDUCE`-Operation wird verwendet, um die interne Tabelle der Codezeilen effizient zu einem einzelnen String zu konkatenieren, getrennt durch Zeilenumbrüche (`cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf`). Dies ist ein modernes und funktionales Muster für die String-Manipulation.
keywords: cl_gui_abapedit, set_text_as_r3table, get_text_as_r3table, REDUCE, String Concatenation, GUI
