Instructions: Ändern Sie dynamisch die Eigenschaft `editable` eines `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`-Controls.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_READ_ONLY_MODE` von `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS set_editable_mode
      IMPORTING
        iv_editable TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS free_control.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_editable_mode.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->set_read_only_mode(
        EXPORTING
          read_only_mode = COND #( WHEN iv_editable = abap_true THEN 0 ELSE 1 ) " 0 = editable, 1 = read-only
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1
      ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_control.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_textedit->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_textedit.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_editable_mode FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_editable_mode.
    DATA(lo_textedit_props) = NEW zcl_gui_textedit_props( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_textedit_props->mo_textedit ).

    TRY.
        lo_textedit_props->set_editable_mode( abap_false ).
        " In a real GUI, this would make the control read-only.
        " We can only assert that the method call completed without error.
        lo_textedit_props->set_editable_mode( abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_gui_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_GUI_ERROR occurred when setting editable mode.' ).
    ENDTRY.
    lo_textedit_props->free_control( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Anpassung von Control-Eigenschaften ist ein Kernaspekt der interaktiven GUI-Programmierung. Die Methode `SET_READ_ONLY_MODE` von `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` (die auf dem `CL_GUI_CFW` basiert) ermöglicht es, den Bearbeitungsstatus eines Textfeldes zur Laufzeit zu ändern. Die Verwendung des `COND`-Operators für die Umwandlung von `abap_bool` in den erwarteten Integer-Wert ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: GUI, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, Properties, Dynamic, CL_GUI_CFW

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER` und teilen Sie ihn in zwei Bereiche, in denen jeweils ein `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`-Control platziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER` und `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_textedit1 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_textedit2 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS set_text_in_pane
      IMPORTING
        iv_pane_id TYPE i
        iv_text    TYPE string.

    METHODS free_control.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = mo_container
        rows    = 1
        columns = 2
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS  = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit1
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit2
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_text_in_pane.
    CASE iv_pane_id.
      WHEN 1.
        IF mo_textedit1 IS BOUND.
          mo_textedit1->set_text_as_stream( text = iv_text ).
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 2.
        IF mo_textedit2 IS BOUND.
          mo_textedit2->set_text_as_stream( text = iv_text ).
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_control.
    IF mo_textedit1 IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_textedit1->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. CLEAR mo_textedit1.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_textedit2 IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_textedit2->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. CLEAR mo_textedit2.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_splitter IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_splitter->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. CLEAR mo_splitter.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_splitter_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_text_in_panes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_splitter_creation.
    DATA(lo_splitter_demo) = NEW zcl_gui_splitter_demo( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_splitter_demo->mo_splitter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_splitter_demo->mo_textedit1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_splitter_demo->mo_textedit2 ).
    lo_splitter_demo->free_control( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_text_in_panes.
    DATA(lo_splitter_demo) = NEW zcl_gui_splitter_demo( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lv_text1) = `Text im linken Bereich.`.
    DATA(lv_text2) = `Text im rechten Bereich.`.

    lo_splitter_demo->set_text_in_pane( iv_pane_id = 1 iv_text = lv_text1 ).
    lo_splitter_demo->set_text_in_pane( iv_pane_id = 2 iv_text = lv_text2 ).

    DATA lv_retrieved_text TYPE string.
    lo_splitter_demo->mo_textedit1->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_retrieved_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_retrieved_text exp = lv_text1 ).

    lo_splitter_demo->mo_textedit2->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_retrieved_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_retrieved_text exp = lv_text2 ).

    lo_splitter_demo->free_control( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER` ist ein leistungsstarkes Control, das auf dem `CL_GUI_CFW` basiert und es ermöglicht, einen Bildschirmbereich in mehrere, in der Größe veränderbare Unterbereiche zu unterteilen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` und fügen Sie einen Button hinzu. Demonstrieren Sie die Event-Behandlung für den Toolbar-Button.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` und `SET HANDLER` für das `BUTTON_CLICK` Event.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_button_clicked TYPE abap_bool.
    CONSTANTS: gc_button_id TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>function VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.

    METHODS free_control.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = gc_button_id
      icon  = icon_ok
      text  = 'Mein Button'
      quickinfo = 'Klicken Sie hier'
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    IF fcode = gc_button_id.
      mv_button_clicked = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_control.
    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_toolbar->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. CLEAR mo_toolbar.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_toolbar_button_click FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_toolbar_button_click.
    DATA(lo_toolbar_demo) = NEW zcl_gui_toolbar_demo( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_toolbar_demo->mo_toolbar ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_toolbar_demo->mv_button_clicked ).

    " Simulate button click event
    CALL METHOD lo_toolbar_demo->handle_button_click
      EXPORTING

Instructions: Verwalten Sie die Lebensdauer von GUI-Controls explizit, indem Sie `CL_GUI_CFW=>FLUSH` verwenden, um Änderungen sofort an das Frontend zu senden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_CFW=>FLUSH` nach GUI-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_flush_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Registrieren Sie einen globalen Event-Handler für das `LIFETIME_REQUEST`-Event des `CL_GUI_CFW`, um die Lebensdauer von Controls zu verwalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_CFW=>SET_LIFETIME_HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA mv_lifetime_requested TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS constructor.

    CLASS-METHODS handle_lifetime_request FOR EVENT lifetime_request OF cl_gui_cfw
      IMPORTING
        sender.

    CLASS-METHODS register_handler.
    CLASS-METHODS unregister_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialisierung, falls benötigt
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_lifetime_request.
    mv_lifetime_requested = abap_true.
    " In einer echten Anwendung würde hier die Freigabe von Controls erfolgen
    " z.B. durch Aufruf von FREE für alle erstellten Controls.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD register_handler.
    SET HANDLER handle_lifetime_request FOR cl_gui_cfw.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD unregister_handler.
    SET HANDLER handle_lifetime_request FOR cl_gui_cfw ACTIVATION abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_lifetime_handler_registration FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_lifetime_request_simulation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lifetime_handler_registration.
    zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>register_handler( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>mv_lifetime_requested IS INITIAL ). " Should be initial before event
    zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>unregister_handler( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_lifetime_request_simulation.
    zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>mv_lifetime_requested = abap_false.
    zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>register_handler( ).

    " Simulate the event call directly for testing purposes
    CALL METHOD zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>handle_lifetime_request
      EXPORTING
        sender = cl_gui_cfw.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>mv_lifetime_requested ).
    zcl_gui_cfw_lifetime=>unregister_handler( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `LIFETIME_REQUEST`-Event des `CL_GUI_CFW` ist ein zentraler Mechanismus zur Verwaltung der Lebensdauer von GUI-Controls. Durch die Registrierung eines globalen Event-Handlers mit `SET HANDLER FOR CL_GUI_CFW` kann die Anwendung auf das Signal reagieren, dass Controls freigegeben werden sollen (z.B. beim Verlassen eines Dynpros). CLASS zcl_sha256_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hashwert einer internen Tabelle. Die Tabelle soll zuerst serialisiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>serialize_table` um die Tabelle in ein XSTRING zu wandeln, bevor Sie `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_table_sha256
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_table_sha256.
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_table( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_xstring( lv_xstring_data ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_hash_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) TYPE zcl_table_hasher=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_hash1) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_sflight ).

    DATA(lt_sflight2) TYPE zcl_table_hasher=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflight2.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflight2.

    DATA(lv_hash2) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_sflight2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_hash1
      exp = lv_hash2
      msg = 'Gleiche Tabelleninhalte sollten den gleichen Hash ergeben'
    ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_sflight2.
    DATA(lv_hash3) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_sflight2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lv_hash1
      exp = lv_hash3
      msg = 'Unterschiedliche Tabelleninhalte sollten unterschiedliche Hashes ergeben'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_table_same_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_a) TYPE zcl_table_hasher=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '1234' fldate = '20250301' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflight_a.

    DATA(lt_sflight_b) TYPE zcl_table_hasher=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '1234' fldate = '20250301' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflight_b.

    DATA(lv_hash_a) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_sflight_a ).
    DATA(lv_hash_b) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_sflight_b ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_hash_a
      exp = lv_hash_b
      msg = 'Zwei separate Tabellen mit identischem Inhalt sollten den gleichen Hash haben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_sflight) TYPE zcl_table_hasher=>ty_t_sflight.
    DATA(lv_hash_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_empty_sflight ).
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_empty_xstring) = XSTRING( '' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_xstring( lv_empty_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_expected_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_hash_empty
      exp = lv_expected_hash_hex
      msg = 'Hashwert für leere Tabelle sollte korrekt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine interne Tabelle in ein XSTRING um und anschließend wieder zurück in eine identische Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>serialize_table` und `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>deserialize_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_serialized_data) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS deserialize_table
      IMPORTING
        ix_serialized_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_deserialized_data) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_table.
    rx_serialized_data = cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_table( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_table.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>deserialize_table(
          EXPORTING
            iv_container = ix_serialized_data
          IMPORTING
            et_table     = rt_deserialized_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_deserialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_original.

    DATA(lx_serialized) = lo_cut->serialize_table( lt_original ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized) = lo_cut->deserialize_table( lx_serialized ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_deserialized )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_deserialized[ 2 ]-price
      exp = lt_original[ 2 ]-price
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile PRICE sollte übereinstimmen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_serializer( ).
    DATA(lt_original) TYPE zcl_table_serializer=>ty_t_sflight. " Empty table

    DATA(lx_serialized) = lo_cut->serialize_table( lt_original ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized) = lo_cut->deserialize_table( lx_serialized ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_deserialized
      msg = 'Deserialisierte Tabelle sollte leer sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_serializer( ).
    DATA(lx_invalid_data) TYPE xstring VALUE '0000000000000000'. " Invalid XSTRING

    DATA(lt_deserialized) = lo_cut->deserialize_table( lx_invalid_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_deserialized
      msg = 'Deserialisierung von ungültigen Daten sollte leere Tabelle ergeben'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen eindeutigen ID-Hash für einen Datensatz, indem Sie ausgewählte Felder des Datensatzes kombinieren und hashen.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `REDUCE` oder `CONCATENATE` um die Felder zu einem String zu verbinden, bevor Sie den Hash berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_record_id_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS generate_record_hash
      IMPORTING
        is_record_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_unique_id_hash) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_record_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_record_hash.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR comp IN COMPONENT TABLE OF is_record_key
      NEXT s = s && |{ comp }|
    ).

    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_concatenated_string ).
    rv_unique_id_hash = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_record2 = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).

  METHOD test_different_data_different_hash.

    DATA(ls_record1) TYPE zcl_record_id_generator=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_record1 = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).

      exp = lv_hash2
      msg = 'Unterschiedliche Datensätze sollten unterschiedliche Hashes ergeben'

Instructions: Speichern Sie ein gehashtes Passwort und überprüfen Sie ein eingegebenes Passwort gegen den gespeicherten Hash.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` für die Hash-Berechnung und eine private Instanzvariable zum Speichern des Hashs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_password_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_password TYPE string.

    METHODS verify_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_password TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_hashed_password TYPE string.
    METHODS calculate_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_password_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_hashed_password = calculate_hash( iv_initial_password ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD verify_password.
    DATA(lv_input_hash) = calculate_hash( iv_input_password ).
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_input_hash = mv_hashed_password THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_hash.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( iv_input_string ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Erkennung eines MIME-Typs basierend auf einer Dateierweiterung in einem String.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Operationen wie `FIND` oder `ENDS WITH` und `CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD detect_mime_type.
    DATA(lv_extension) = |
      { COND string(
          WHEN iv_filename CS '.' THEN
            iv_filename+find( val = iv_filename sub = '.' occ = -1 ) + 1
          ELSE
            ''
        ) }
    |.

    CASE to_lower( lv_extension ).
      WHEN 'txt'.
        rv_mime_type = 'text/plain'.
      WHEN 'pdf'.
        rv_mime_type = 'application/pdf'.
      WHEN 'jpg' OR 'jpeg'.
        rv_mime_type = 'image/jpeg'.
      WHEN 'png'.
        rv_mime_type = 'image/png'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_mime_type = 'application/octet-stream'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, serialisieren Sie diese und berechnen Sie einen Hashwert für die gesamte Datenmenge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE`, `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>serialize_table` und `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_data_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data_hash
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data_hash) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data_hash.
    DATA lt_sflight_data TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_table( lt_sflight_data ).
      DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
      DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_xstring( lv_xstring_data ).
      rv_data_hash = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen kombinierten Hash für ein komplexes Objekt, das mehrere interne Tabellen und Attribute enthält, um eine digitale Signatur zu simulieren.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die einzelnen Komponenten des Objekts und kombinieren Sie deren Hashes oder die serialisierten XSTRINGs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_object_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_detail,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
           END OF ty_booking_detail.
    TYPES: ty_t_booking_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_complex_object,
             header_id      TYPE string,
             creation_date  TYPE sy-datum,
             segments       TYPE ty_t_flight_segments,
             booking_info   TYPE ty_t_booking_details,
           END OF ty_complex_object.

    METHODS calculate_object_hash
      IMPORTING
        is_complex_object TYPE ty_complex_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_combined_hash) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_hash_for_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_object_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_object_hash.
    DATA(lv_header_string) = |{ is_complex_object-header_id }{ is_complex_object-creation_date }|.
    DATA(lx_segments) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_table( is_complex_object-segments ).
    DATA(lx_booking_info) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_table( is_complex_object-booking_info ).

    DATA(lv_hash_header) = get_hash_for_xstring( cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( lv_header_string )->get_xstring( ) ).
    DATA(lv_hash_segments) = get_hash_for_xstring( lx_segments ).
    DATA(lv_hash_booking) = get_hash_for_xstring( lx_booking_info ).

    DATA(lv_combined_string) = |{ lv_hash_header }{ lv_hash_segments }{ lv_hash_booking }|.
    rv_combined_hash = get_hash_for_xstring( cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( lv_combined_string )->get_xstring( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_hash_for_xstring.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_xstring( ix_data ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_object_hash FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_object_change_detection FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_object_hash.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_object_hasher( ).
    DATA(ls_object) TYPE zcl_complex_object_hasher=>ty_complex_object.
    ls_object-header_id = 'ORDER_123'.
    ls_object-creation_date = sy-datum.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO ls_object-segments.
    APPEND VALUE #( bookid = '0001' custtype = 'B' ) TO ls_object-booking_info.

    DATA(lv_hash1) = lo_cut->calculate_object_hash( ls_object ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_hash1 msg = 'Hash sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    DATA(ls_object2) = ls_object.
    DATA(lv_hash2) = lo_cut->calculate_object_hash( ls_object2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hash1 exp = lv_hash2 msg = 'Identische Objekte sollten gleichen Hash haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_object_change_detection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_object_hasher( ).
    DATA(ls_object) TYPE zcl_complex_object_hasher=>ty_complex_object.
    ls_object-header_id = 'ORDER_123'.
    ls_object-creation_date = sy-datum.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO ls_object-segments.
    APPEND VALUE #( bookid = '0001' custtype = 'B' ) TO ls_object-booking_info.

    DATA(lv_hash_original) = lo_cut->calculate_object_hash( ls_object ).

    " Change a segment
    ls_object-segments[1]-connid = '0500'.
    DATA(lv_hash_changed) = lo_cut->calculate_object_hash( ls_object ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lv_hash_original
      exp = lv_hash_changed
      msg = 'Geändertes Objekt sollte unterschiedlichen Hash haben'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Hashes für komplexe Datenstrukturen berechnet, die aus mehreren Komponenten (Strings, internen Tabellen) bestehen. Jede Komponente wird einzeln serialisiert und gehasht, und die resultierenden Hashes werden dann kombiniert und erneut gehasht. Dies simuliert eine digitale Signatur für die Integrität eines gesamten Objekts.
keywords: COMPLEX OBJECT, HASH, DIGITAL SIGNATURE, SERIALIZATION, OBJECT ORIENTATION, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von einem Typ in einen anderen, indem Sie sie serialisieren und dann in den neuen Typ deserialisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>serialize_table` und `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>deserialize_table` mit unterschiedlichen Tabellentypen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_type_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             f1 TYPE string,
             f2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_type
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE ty_t_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE ty_t_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_type_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_type.
    DATA(lx_serialized_data) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_table( it_source_data ).

    TRY.
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>deserialize_table(
          EXPORTING
            iv_container = lx_serialized_data
          IMPORTING
            et_table     = rt_target_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_deserialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von XSTRINGs (z.B. Dateiblöcke) hasht und die Hashes in einer internen Tabelle zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST=>calculate_hash_for_xstring` in einer `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_list_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_xstring TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_t_hashes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hashes_for_xstrings
      IMPORTING
        it_xstrings TYPE ty_t_xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashes) TYPE ty_t_hashes.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_hash_for_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_list_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hashes_for_xstrings.
    rt_hashes = VALUE #( FOR ls_xstring IN it_xstrings ( get_hash_for_xstring( ls_xstring ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_hash_for_xstring.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_xstring( ix_data ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_single_xstring FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_xstrings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_list_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_xstrings) TYPE zcl_xstring_list_hasher=>ty_t_xstring.
    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( 'Block 1' )->get_xstring( ) TO lt_xstrings.
    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( 'Block 2' )->get_xstring( ) TO lt_xstrings.
    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( 'Block 3' )->get_xstring( ) TO lt_xstrings.

    DATA(lt_hashes) = lo_cut->calculate_hashes_for_xstrings( lt_xstrings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashes ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Hashes zurückgegeben werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_hashes[1] msg = 'Erster Hash sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_hashes[1] exp = lt_hashes[2] msg = 'Hashes sollten unterschiedlich sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_list_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_xstrings) TYPE zcl_xstring_list_hasher=>ty_t_xstring.

    DATA(lt_hashes) = lo_cut->calculate_hashes_for_xstrings( lt_xstrings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_hashes msg = 'Leere Liste sollte leere Hash-Liste ergeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_list_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_xstrings) TYPE zcl_xstring_list_hasher=>ty_t_xstring.
    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( 'Single Block' )->get_xstring( ) TO lt_xstrings.

    DATA(lt_hashes) = lo_cut->calculate_hashes_for_xstrings( lt_xstrings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashes ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es sollte ein Hash zurückgegeben werden' ).
    DATA(lo_digest_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring_exp) = lo_digest_exp->calculate_hash_for_xstring( cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create_utf8( 'Single Block' )->get_xstring( ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring_exp )->get_string( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Hashwert eines dynamisch erzeugten Strings, der aus einer Liste von Werten besteht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um den dynamischen String zu erstellen, und dann `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_string_hash
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE ty_t_value
        iv_separator TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_string_hash.
    DATA(lv_final_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR value IN it_values
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN value ELSE s && iv_separator && value ) ).

    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_final_string ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring )->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_string_hash.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_string_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_values) TYPE zcl_dynamic_string_hasher=>ty_t_value.
    APPEND 'Part1' TO lt_values.
    APPEND 'Part2' TO lt_values.
    APPEND 'Part3' TO lt_values.

    DATA(lv_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_string_hash( it_values = lt_values iv_separator = '-' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_hash msg = 'Hash sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Part1-Part2-Part3'.
    DATA(lo_digest_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring_exp) = lo_digest_exp->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_expected_string ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring_exp )->get_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hash exp = lv_expected_hash_hex msg = 'Hash sollte korrekt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_string_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_values) TYPE zcl_dynamic_string_hasher=>ty_t_value.

    DATA(lv_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_string_hash( it_values = lt_values iv_separator = ',' ).
    DATA(lo_digest_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring_exp) = lo_digest_exp->calculate_hash_for_string( '' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( lv_hash_xstring_exp )->get_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hash exp = lv_expected_hash_hex msg = 'Hash für leere Liste sollte korrekt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_separator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_string_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_values) TYPE zcl_dynamic_string_hasher=>ty_t_value.
    APPEND 'A' TO lt_values.
    APPEND 'B' TO lt_values.

    DATA(lv_hash_comma) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_string_hash( it_values = lt_values iv_separator = ',' ).
    DATA(lv_hash_pipe) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_string_hash( it_values = lt_values iv_separator = '|' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_hash_comma exp = lv_hash_pipe msg = 'Unterschiedliche Separatoren sollten unterschiedliche Hashes ergeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der resultierende String wird dann gehasht. Dies ist eine flexible Methode, um Hashes für variable Datenstrukturen zu generieren.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) basierend auf einem dynamisch erstellten 'RANGES'-Selektionskriterium für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `FILTER` und einer `RANGES`-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid(
      FOR <carrid> IN it_carrids
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <carrid> )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING lr_carrid WHERE carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle für Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS-FLDATE), die alle Flugdaten eines bestimmten Jahres ausschließt, und verwenden Sie diese in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die `RANGES`-Tabelle und die Option 'NB' (Not Between) oder 'NE' (Not Equal).
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_exclude_year DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_excluding_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_year TYPE sy-datum(4)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_exclude_year IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_excluding_year.
    DATA(lv_date_from) = iv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_date_to)   = iv_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lr_fldate) = VALUE ranges of sflight-fldate(
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'BT' low = lv_date_from high = lv_date_to )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE fldate IN @lr_fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei `RANGES`-Tabellen für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und Flugnummern (CONNID) und wenden Sie diese auf eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten an. Die Kombination soll Flüge von 'LH' mit CONNID '0400' ODER Flüge von 'AA' mit CONNID '0017' einschließen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `COND` und `FILTER` für die komplexe Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_complex_ranges
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_complex_ranges.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lr_carrid_lh) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_connid_0400) = VALUE ranges of sflight-connid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0400' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_carrid_aa) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_connid_0017) = VALUE ranges of sflight-connid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0017' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid IN lr_carrid_lh AND connid IN lr_connid_0400 )
         OR ( carrid IN lr_carrid_aa AND connid IN lr_connid_0017 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_complex_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_complex_ranges( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #(
      WHEN line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false
    ), 'LH 0400 should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #(
      WHEN line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false
    ), 'AA 0017 should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( COND #(
      WHEN line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false
    ), 'LH 0017 should not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    " To test no match, we would need to ensure no data exists for the specific criteria.
    " For SFLIGHT, it's likely some data exists. This test focuses on the logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_complex_ranges( ).
    " If SFLIGHT has no data for these specific combinations, this test might fail.
    " Assuming SFLIGHT has at least one entry for LH 0400 and AA 0017.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise (PRICE) für Flüge, die in einer gegebenen `RANGES`-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) enthalten sind, unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Iteration über die gefilterten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_for_range
      IMPORTING
        ir_carrids TYPE ranges of sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_for_range.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING ir_carrids WHERE carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_reduce_sum( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_for_range( lr_carrids ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_multiple_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_reduce_sum( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_empty_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lr_carrids) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_for_range( lr_carrids ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_for_range( lr_carrids ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime        TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime        TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             flight_duration TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext,
           tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_with_duration.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_catalog
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_duration.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_sflights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_sflights_ext TYPE tt_sflight_ext.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    lt_sflights_ext = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid          = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid          = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate          = ls_sflight-fldate,
        deptime         = ls_sflight-deptime,
        arrtime         = ls_sflight-arrtime,
        flight_duration = cl_abap_tims_utl=>get_diff_in_seconds(
                            iv_timestamp1 = cl_abap_tims_utl=>create_timestamp( iv_date = ls_sflight-fldate iv_time = ls_sflight-deptime )
                            iv_timestamp2 = cl_abap_tims_utl=>create_timestamp( iv_date = ls_sflight-fldate iv_time = ls_sflight-arrtime ) ) / 60
      )
    ).

    DATA(lt_field_catalog) = get_field_catalog( ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_field_catalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_sflights_ext.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->display_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    rt_field_catalog = VALUE #(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'DEPTIME'  seltext_l = 'Departure Time' )
      ( fieldname = 'ARRTIME'  seltext_l = 'Arrival Time' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_DURATION' seltext_l = 'Duration (min)' datatype = 'NUMC' outputlen = 5 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein `cl_gui_alv_grid` mit Event-Handling für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile, um die Details der ausgewählten Zeile in einem Dialogfenster anzuzeigen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_events.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_display,
           tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS handle_double_click
          FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_row
            e_column.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD handle_double_click.
        DATA: ls_selected_row TYPE ty_sflight_display.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_outtab> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

        CHECK e_row-index IS NOT INITIAL.

        mo_alv->get_frontend_fieldcatalog( IMPORTING et_fieldcatalog = DATA(lt_fcat) ).
        mo_alv->get_frontend_fic_data( IMPORTING e_outtab = <fs_outtab> ).

        READ TABLE <fs_outtab> INDEX e_row-index INTO ls_selected_row.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE i-208(00) WITH 'Selected Flight:' ls_selected_row-carrid ls_selected_row-connid ls_selected_row-fldate DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_events.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lt_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight_display,
          lo_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_EVENT_HANDLER=>TY_SFLIGHT_DISPLAY'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_event_handler.
    SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv->display_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_field,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             label     TYPE lvc_s_fcat-seltext_l,
           END OF ty_config_field,
           tt_config_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic_fcat
      IMPORTING
        it_config_fields TYPE tt_config_fields.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_sflights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_full_fcat) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = lo_container
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
      CHANGING
        t_table     = lt_sflights
    )->get_columns( )->get_column_list( ).

    DATA(lt_dynamic_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR ls_config IN it_config_fields
      FOR ls_fcat IN lt_full_fcat WHERE ( fieldname = ls_config-fieldname )
      ( VALUE #( BASE ls_fcat fieldname = ls_config-fieldname seltext_l = ls_config-label ) )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_dynamic_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->display_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_row_highlight IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_alv_editable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_editable_sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS handle_data_changed
          FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_fieldname
            e_row_id
            e_data_changed.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD handle_data_changed.
        DATA: ls_modified_cell TYPE lvc_s_modi.

        LOOP AT e_data_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modified_cell.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_modified_cell-fieldname OF STRUCTURE mt_sflights[ ls_modified_cell-row_id ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_value> = ls_modified_cell-value.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Hier könnten die Änderungen in der Datenbank gespeichert werden
        " UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE mt_sflights.
        MESSAGE i-208(00) WITH 'Data changed and updated in internal table!' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_editable IMPLEMENTATION.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_field_catalog) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flight Date' )

    ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_field_catalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = mt_sflights.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_event_handler.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LVC_T_FCAT` für den Feldkatalog, aber initialisieren Sie ihn mit `SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_slis_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_slis_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_slis_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_slis_fcat.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_sflights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_slis_fcat TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv,
          ls_slis_fcat TYPE slis_fieldcat_alv,
          lt_lvc_fcat  TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Manuelle SLIS-Feldkatalog-Definition
    CLEAR ls_slis_fcat.
    ls_slis_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_slis_fcat-seltext_l = 'Airline Code'.
    APPEND ls_slis_fcat TO lt_slis_fcat.

    CLEAR ls_slis_fcat.
    ls_slis_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_slis_fcat-seltext_l = 'Flight Number'.
    APPEND ls_slis_fcat TO lt_slis_fcat.

    CLEAR ls_slis_fcat.
    ls_slis_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_slis_fcat-seltext_l = 'Flight Date'.
    APPEND ls_slis_fcat TO lt_slis_fcat.

    CLEAR ls_slis_fcat.
    ls_slis_fcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'.
    ls_slis_fcat-seltext_l = 'Price'.
    APPEND ls_slis_fcat TO lt_slis_fcat.

    " Konvertierung von SLIS zu LVC (falls nötig, hier direkt LVC verwenden)
    " Für cl_gui_alv_grid wird LVC_T_FCAT erwartet.
    " Die SLIS-Strukturen sind eher für REUSE_ALV_GRID_DISPLAY relevant.
    " Hier wird gezeigt, wie man einen LVC-Feldkatalog mit VALUE aus SLIS-ähnlichen Daten aufbauen könnte.
    lt_lvc_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR ls_slis IN lt_slis_fcat
      ( fieldname = ls_slis-fieldname
        seltext_l = ls_slis-seltext_l ) ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_lvc_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv->display_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` an und verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu zählen und diese Information in einer separaten ALV-Anzeige darzustellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` zur Aggregation und ein zweites ALV-Grid zur Anzeige der aggregierten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_count,
           tt_sflight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_counts.
    DATA: lo_container_main TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_container_count TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_main       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lo_alv_count      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_sflights       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_flight_counts  TYPE tt_sflight_count.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container_main
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_MAIN'. " Muss in einem Dynpro existieren

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container_count
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_COUNT'. " Muss in einem Dynpro existieren

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_main
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container_main.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_count
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container_count.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    lt_flight_counts = REDUCE #(
      INIT counts TYPE tt_sflight_count
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_index = line_index( counts[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT counts = COND #(
        WHEN lv_index IS NOT INITIAL
        THEN VALUE #(
          BASE counts
          ( counts[ lv_index ]-flight_count = counts[ lv_index ]-flight_count + 1 )
        )
        ELSE VALUE #(
          BASE counts
          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid flight_count = 1 )
        )
      )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_main->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_count->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_REDUCE_COUNT=>TY_SFLIGHT_COUNT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_flight_counts.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_main->display_grid.
    CALL METHOD lo_alv_count->display_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und Division durch die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices).

    IF lt_prices IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR price_entry IN lt_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + price_entry
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_sum_prices / lines( lt_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_price( ).

    " Annahme: sflights enthält Daten und der Durchschnitt ist nicht 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Average price should not be initial for non-empty table' act = lv_avg exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Average price should not be 0 for non-empty table' act = lv_avg exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    " Temporär sflights leeren oder eine Mock-Tabelle verwenden
    " Für diesen Test wird angenommen, dass die Methode 0 zurückgibt, wenn keine Flüge vorhanden sind.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    " In einem echten Szenario müsste man die Datenbank mocken oder eine leere Tabelle simulieren.
    " Hier wird der Test vereinfacht, indem wir wissen, dass sflights selten leer ist.
    " Wenn sflights leer wäre, sollte 0 zurückgegeben werden.
    " Da sflights in der Regel nicht leer ist, ist dieser Test eher konzeptionell.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price should be 0 for empty table' act = lo_cut->get_average_price( ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für den modernen Datenzugriff. Die Aggregation der Preise erfolgt effizient mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, der eine Schleife und Summenbildung in einer Zeile zusammenfasst. Die Division durch `lines()` ermittelt den Durchschnitt. Eine `IF`-Bedingung behandelt den Fall einer leeren Tabelle, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
keywords: AVERAGE, REDUCE, sflights, Internal Tables, Modern Open SQL

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
           tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight_entry IN lt_flights
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = flight_entry-carrid )
                                ( carrid    = flight_entry-carrid,
                                  avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                                INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR member IN GROUP
                                                NEXT sum = sum + member-price
                                              ) / lines( GROUP ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_avg_prices ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen Sie den Durchschnitt für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(ls_avg_lh) = VALUE zcl_avg_price_by_carrier=>ty_avg_price_by_carrier(
      carrid = 'LH'
      avg_price = 0 " Platzhalter, muss mit echtem Wert verglichen werden
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices INTO ls_avg_lh WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Hier müsste der erwartete Wert aus Testdaten oder einer Berechnung kommen
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price for LH is incorrect' act = ls_avg_lh-avg_price exp = 420.00 ). " Beispielwert
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig ohne Mocking der Datenbank. Erwartet wird eine leere Tabelle.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty for no flights' act = lt_avg_prices ).

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv,
           tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_alv_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        et_flights        TYPE tt_sflight_alv
        et_fieldcatalog   TYPE lvc_t_fcat
        es_layout         TYPE lvc_s_layo.

    METHODS display_alv
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_alv_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @et_flights.

    " Dynamische Erstellung des Feldkatalogs (vereinfacht)
    et_fieldcatalog = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Flugges.' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Verbindung' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    coltext = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' coltext = 'Währung' )
      ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Flugzeugtyp' )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSMAX' coltext = 'Max. Sitze' )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Belegte Sitze' )
    ).

    es_layout-zebra = abap_true.
    es_layout-colwidth_opt = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv.
    DATA: lt_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_alv,
          lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_layout       TYPE lvc_s_layo.

    prepare_alv_data(
      IMPORTING
        et_flights      = lt_flights
        et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
        es_layout       = ls_layout
    ).

    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_field   = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER' " Beispiel für ein Dynpro-Feld
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      MESSAGE 'Container konnte nicht erstellt werden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        is_layout       = ls_layout
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_flights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.

    " Um das ALV sichtbar zu machen, müsste dies in einem Dynpro-Flow aufgerufen werden.
    " Für einen reinen Klassen-Test konzentrieren wir uns auf die Daten- und Katalogvorbereitung.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für Flüge, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen.
hint: Nutze `SELECT WHERE` für die Filterung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_ny DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_to_ny RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_ny IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_to_ny.
    SELECT price FROM sflights WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices_ny).

    IF lt_prices_ny IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR price_entry IN lt_prices_ny
      NEXT sum = sum + price_entry
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_sum_prices / lines( lt_prices_ny ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_average_price_ny.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_ny( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge nach NEW YORK und der Durchschnitt ist nicht 0

    " Hier müsste der erwartete Wert aus Testdaten oder einer Berechnung kommen

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_ny( ).
    " In einem echten Szenario müsste man die Datenbank mocken oder eine leere Tabelle simulieren.

Anschließend wird der `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um die Preise der gefilterten Flüge zu summieren und den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_alv.

    CLASS ltcl_event_receiver DEFINITION FOR LOCAL TYPES.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_row     TYPE lvc_s_row
            e_column  TYPE lvc_s_col
            es_row_no TYPE lvc_s_roid.
        DATA mo_parent TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_event_handler.
    ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD prepare_alv_with_event.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @et_flights.

    et_fieldcatalog = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Flugges.' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Verbindung' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    coltext = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' coltext = 'Währung' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_with_event.
    DATA: lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    prepare_alv_with_event(
      EXPORTING
        et_flights      = mt_flights
        et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
    ).

    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name

      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 4

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Container konnte nicht erstellt werden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
    ).

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW ltcl_event_receiver( ).
    lo_event_receiver->mo_parent = me.

    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = mt_flights.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.

    METHOD handle_double_click.
      DATA: ls_flight_detail TYPE zcl_alv_event_handler=>ty_sflight_alv.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flugdetails:' ls_flight_detail-carrid ls_flight_detail-connid ls_flight_detail-price.
      ENDIF.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge anbieten.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR GROUPS OF` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_filtered_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
           tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices_filtered RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_filtered_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices_filtered.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight_entry IN lt_flights
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = flight_entry-carrid )
                                WHERE ( lines( GROUP ) > 5 ) " Filtert Gruppen mit weniger als 6 Flügen
                                ( carrid    = flight_entry-carrid,
                                  avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                                INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR member IN GROUP
                                                NEXT sum = sum + member-price
                                              ) / lines( GROUP ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filtered_average_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_average_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_filtered_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_prices_filtered( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_avg_prices ).

    " Überprüfen, ob nur Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als 5 Flügen enthalten sind
    LOOP AT lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_avg_price).
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @ls_avg_price-carrid INTO @DATA(lv_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier should have more than 5 flights' act = ( lv_count > 5 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_carriers.
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig ohne Mocking der Datenbank. Erwartet wird eine leere Tabelle.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_filtered_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_prices_filtered( ).
    " Wenn keine Carrier die Bedingung erfüllen, sollte die Tabelle leer sein.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty if no carriers match filter' act = lt_avg_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Gruppierung und Filterung mit `FOR GROUPS OF`. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `GROUP BY`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht es, Gruppen basierend auf einer Bedingung (hier: Anzahl der Flüge in der Gruppe) zu filtern, bevor die Aggregation mit `REDUCE` erfolgt. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Syntax für komplexe Datenmanipulationen auf internen Tabellen.
keywords: AVERAGE, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS OF, FILTER, REDUCE, sflights, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechne die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzauslastung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) über alle Flüge.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `LET` für Zwischenberechnungen und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_occupancy_rate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_occupancy_rate RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_rate) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_occupancy_rate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy_rate.
    SELECT seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_seats).

    IF lt_seats IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_rate = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_occupancy_rate) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum_rates = 0.0
      FOR ls_seat IN lt_seats
      LET lv_current_rate = COND f(
                              WHEN ls_seat-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_seat-seatsocc / ls_seat-seatsmax
                              ELSE 0.0
                            ) IN
      NEXT sum_rates = sum_rates + lv_current_rate
    ).

    rv_avg_rate = lv_total_occupancy_rate / lines( lt_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_occupancy_rate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_seatsmax FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_occupancy_rate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_occupancy_rate( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_rate) = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy_rate( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Average occupancy rate should not be initial' act = lv_avg_rate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average occupancy rate should be between 0 and 1' act = ( lv_avg_rate >= 0 AND lv_avg_rate <= 1 ) ).
    " Hier müsste der erwartete Wert aus Testdaten oder einer Berechnung kommen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average occupancy rate is incorrect' act = lv_avg_rate exp = 0.75 ). " Beispielwert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_occupancy_rate( ).
    " In einem echten Szenario müsste man die Datenbank mocken oder eine leere Tabelle simulieren.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average occupancy rate should be 0 for empty table' act = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy_rate( ) exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_seatsmax.
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig ohne Mocking der Datenbank, um spezifische Daten zu injizieren.
    " Die Logik in der Lösung behandelt seatsmax = 0 mit 0.0 Rate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_occupancy_rate( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_rate) = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy_rate( ).
    " Der Test würde hier prüfen, ob die Methode bei Daten mit seatsmax=0 nicht abstürzt
    " und ein sinnvolles Ergebnis liefert (z.B. nicht NaN oder Infinity).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial even with zero seatsmax' act = lv_avg_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung eines Durchschnitts über einen abgeleiteten Wert. Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird verwendet, um die Summe der Auslastungsraten zu bilden. Innerhalb von `REDUCE` wird die `LET`-Anweisung genutzt, um eine temporäre Variable `lv_current_rate` für die Berechnung der individuellen Auslastungsrate zu definieren. Die `COND`-Expression stellt sicher, dass keine Division durch Null erfolgt, wenn `seatsmax` 0 ist. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen.
