CLASS zcl_alv_avg_integrated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alv_data_and_average.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @et_flights.

    et_fieldcatalog = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Flugges.' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Verbindung' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    coltext = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' coltext = 'Währung' )
    ).

    IF et_flights IS INITIAL.
      ev_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight_entry IN et_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight_entry-price
    ).

    ev_average_price = lv_sum_prices / lines( et_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_with_average.
    DATA: lt_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_alv,
          lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lv_average_price TYPE sflight-price.

    get_alv_data_and_average(
      EXPORTING
        et_flights        = lt_flights
        et_fieldcatalog   = lt_fieldcatalog
        ev_average_price  = lv_average_price
    ).

    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_field   = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Container konnte nicht erstellt werden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_flights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.

    " Anzeige des Durchschnittspreises (z.B. in der Statusleiste oder einem separaten Textfeld)
    " Für diesen Beispielcode wird eine einfache Nachricht verwendet.
    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Durchschnittlicher Flugpreis:' lv_average_price.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Sitzplatz (`PRICE / SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge, bei denen `SEATSMAX` größer als Null ist.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `LET` für die Berechnung des Einzelpreises pro Sitzplatz und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Beachte die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_per_seat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_per_seat RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price_per_seat) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_per_seat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_per_seat.
    SELECT price, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price_per_seat = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price_per_seat) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum_pps = 0.0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      LET lv_pps = COND f(
                     WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_flight-price / ls_flight-seatsmax
                     ELSE 0.0
                   ) IN
      NEXT sum_pps = sum_pps + lv_pps
    ).

    DATA(lv_valid_flights) = FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE seatsmax > 0 ).
    IF lv_valid_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price_per_seat = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_avg_price_per_seat = lv_total_price_per_seat / lines( lv_valid_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price per seat is incorrect' act = lv_avg exp = 5.00 ). " Beispielwert
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_per_seat( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price per seat should be 0 for empty table' act = lo_cut->get_average_price_per_seat( ) exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_only_zero_seatsmax.
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig ohne Mocking der Datenbank, um spezifische Daten zu injizieren.
    " Die Logik in der Lösung behandelt seatsmax = 0 mit 0.0 Rate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_per_seat( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_price_per_seat( ).
    " Wenn alle Flüge seatsmax = 0 hätten, sollte der Durchschnitt 0 sein.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel berechnet einen komplexeren Durchschnitt, nämlich den Preis pro Sitzplatz. Es verwendet `REDUCE` mit einer `LET`-Anweisung, um die individuelle Rate (`price / seatsmax`) zu berechnen, wobei `COND` eine Division durch Null verhindert. Anschließend wird die Liste der Flüge mit `FILTER` auf solche eingeschränkt, die eine gültige `seatsmax` haben, um den Durchschnitt nur über diese zu bilden. CLASS zcl_alv_pfstatus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv,
           tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_alv_pfstatus
      EXPORTING
        et_flights        TYPE tt_sflight_alv
        et_fieldcatalog   TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS display_alv_pfstatus
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_alv.

    CLASS ltcl_event_receiver DEFINITION FOR LOCAL TYPES.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS handle_toolbar_button_click FOR EVENT toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.
        DATA mo_parent TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_pfstatus.
    ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_pfstatus IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD prepare_alv_pfstatus.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @et_flights.

    et_fieldcatalog = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Flugges.' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Verbindung' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    coltext = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' coltext = 'Währung' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_pfstatus.
    DATA: lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    prepare_alv_pfstatus(
      EXPORTING
        et_flights      = mt_flights
        et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
    ).

    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_field   = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Container konnte nicht erstellt werden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
    ).

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW ltcl_event_receiver( ).
    lo_event_receiver->mo_parent = me.

    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->handle_toolbar_button_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = mt_flights.

    " Setzen eines benutzerdefinierten PF-Status (muss im Repository existieren)
    " Für diesen Beispielcode wird ein Dummy-Status verwendet.
    " In einem echten System müsste ein PF-Status mit dem Namen 'Z_ALV_STATUS' und einer 'REFRESH'-Funktion (FCode 'REFRESH') existieren.
    mo_alv_grid->set_pfstatus( EXPORTING i_pfstatus = 'STANDARD' i_repid = sy-repid ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.

  CLASS ltcl_event_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD handle_toolbar_button_click.
      CASE e_ucomm.
        WHEN 'REFRESH'. " Annahme: FCode 'REFRESH' ist im PF-Status definiert
          mo_parent->prepare_alv_pfstatus(
            EXPORTING
              et_flights      = mo_parent->mt_flights
              et_fieldcatalog = DATA(lt_fcat_dummy) " Wird hier nicht benötigt, aber Methode erfordert es
          ).
          mo_parent->mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
          MESSAGE 'ALV refreshed!' TYPE 'S'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Weitere Funktionen behandeln
      ENDCASE.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

           END OF ty_carrier_stats,
           tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_carrier_stats RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_multi_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carrier_stats.
    SELECT carrid, price, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight_entry IN lt_flights
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = flight_entry-carrid )
                                LET lv_avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                                     INIT sum_p = 0
                                                     FOR member IN GROUP
                                                     NEXT sum_p = sum_p + member-price
                                                   ) / lines( GROUP ) IN
                                WHERE ( lv_avg_price > 400 ) " Filtert Gruppen basierend auf dem berechneten Durchschnittspreis
                                ( carrid        = flight_entry-carrid,
                                  avg_price     = lv_avg_price,
                                  avg_occupancy = REDUCE f(
                                                    INIT sum_o = 0.0
                                                    FOR member IN GROUP
                                                    LET lv_rate = COND f(
                                                                    WHEN member-seatsmax > 0 THEN member-seatsocc / member-seatsmax
                                                                    ELSE 0.0
                                                                  ) IN
                                                    NEXT sum_o = sum_o + lv_rate
                                                  ) / lines( GROUP ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_multi_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average occupancy should be between 0 and 1' act = ( ls_stat-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_stat-avg_occupancy <= 1 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Wenn keine Carrier die Bedingung erfüllen, sollte die Tabelle leer sein.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine sehr fortgeschrittene Datenaggregation und -filterung. Es verwendet `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY`, um Daten nach Fluggesellschaften zu gruppieren. Innerhalb der Gruppierung wird `LET` verwendet, um den durchschnittlichen Preis zu berechnen, der dann direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel der Gruppierung verwendet wird, um nur relevante Gruppen zu filtern. Anschließend werden sowohl der durchschnittliche Preis als auch die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzauslastung mit `REDUCE` berechnet. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Operatoren für komplexe analytische Aufgaben.

Instructions: Zeige `sflights` in einem ALV Grid an, wobei der Feldkatalog vollständig dynamisch aus der Struktur der internen Tabelle generiert wird und auch die Spaltenüberschriften aus den Data Dictionary-Texten (`DDIC`) stammen.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_table=>factory` oder `cl_abap_structdescr` in Kombination mit `cl_salv_controller_metadata` für DDIC-Texte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_ddic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv,
           tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_alv_ddic_fcat
      EXPORTING
        et_flights        TYPE tt_sflight_alv
        et_fieldcatalog   TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS display_alv_ddic
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_ddic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_alv_ddic_fcat.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @et_flights.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( et_flights ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    et_fieldcatalog = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR comp IN lt_components
      LET lv_ddic_text = cl_salv_controller_metadata=>get_ddic_fieldname_text(
                               i_fieldname = comp-name
                               i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS' " Oder die tatsächliche Struktur
                               i_text_type = if_salv_c_ddic_text=>medium
                             ) IN
      ( fieldname = comp-name coltext = COND string( WHEN lv_ddic_text IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_ddic_text ELSE comp-name ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_ddic.
    DATA: lt_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_alv,
          lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    prepare_alv_ddic_fcat(
      EXPORTING
        et_flights      = lt_flights
        et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
    ).

    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_field   = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Container konnte nicht erstellt werden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcatalog
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = lt_flights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_alv_ddic_fcat FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_alv_ddic_fcat.
    DATA: lt_flights      TYPE zcl_alv_ddic_fcat=>tt_sflight_alv,
          lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_ddic_fcat( ).
    lo_cut->prepare_alv_ddic_fcat(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Field catalog should not be empty' act = lt_fieldcatalog ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of fields in catalog is incorrect' act = lines( lt_fieldcatalog ) exp = 5 ).

    " Überprüfen, ob DDIC-Texte verwendet wurden (z.B. für CARRID)
    DATA(ls_fcat_carrid) = VALUE lvc_s_fcat( ).
    READ TABLE lt_fieldcatalog INTO ls_fcat_carrid WITH KEY fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'DDIC text for CARRID is incorrect' act = ls_fcat_carrid-coltext exp = 'Airline' ). " Erwarteter DDIC-Text

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Generierung eines Feldkatalogs für ein ALV Grid, wobei die Spaltenüberschriften aus den Data Dictionary-Texten (DDIC) bezogen werden. Es kombiniert RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) zur Strukturanalyse mit `cl_salv_controller_metadata=>get_ddic_fieldname_text`, um die Feldtexte aus dem DDIC abzurufen. Dies gewährleistet konsistente und sprachabhängige Spaltenüberschriften, ohne sie manuell pflegen zu müssen. Die `LET`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um den DDIC-Text vor der Zuweisung zu ermitteln.

Instructions: Berechne die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) über alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_seatsmax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_seats_max RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_seats_max) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_seatsmax IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_seats_max.
    SELECT seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_seats_max).

    IF lt_seats_max IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_seats_max = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_seats) = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR seats_entry IN lt_seats_max
      NEXT sum = sum + seats_entry
    ).

    rv_avg_seats_max = lv_sum_seats / lines( lt_seats_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Flugobjekten (`sflights`) mit `VALUE` und `FOR`. Filtern Sie anschließend diese Liste, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` für die Initialisierung und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' )

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( flight ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: `REDUCE` ist ideal, um eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_passengers,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             passmax  TYPE s_max_pax,
           END OF ty_sflight_passengers.
    TYPES tt_sflight_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_passengers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' passmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' passmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' passmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' passmax = 220 )
    ).

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-passmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 750 ). " 150 + 200 + 180 + 220
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für Aggregationen. Sie ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem sie über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`s mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: VALUE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn ein Flugpreis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, soll der Status 'Teuer' sein, ansonsten 'Normal'. Verwenden Sie hierfür `VALUE` und `COND`.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assignment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_price TYPE s_price
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assignment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price > iv_threshold THEN 'Teuer'

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_structure_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_full_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,

             flight_date TYPE s_date,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_structure_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flight_data.
    rs_basic_flight = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_full_flight MAPPING airline = carrid
                      flight_no = connid
                      flight_date = fldate
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in einen CSV-String und anschließend in ein XSTRING-Format, um sie als E-Mail-Anhang zu versenden.
hint: Erstellen Sie zuerst den CSV-String mit String-Templates und `REDUCE`, dann verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_csv,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_csv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_csv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'Airline;FlightNo;Date;Price;Currency'.

    DATA(lt_csv_lines) = VALUE string_table(
      ( lv_csv_header )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( |{ flight-carrid };{ flight-connid };{ flight-fldate };{ flight-price };{ flight-currency }| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN lt_csv_lines NEXT s = s && line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).

    rv_csv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string = lv_csv_string
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        iv_add_bom = abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_attachment( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_csv_attachment=>tt_sflight_csv(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = lo_cut->generate_csv_xstring( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string( lv_csv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Airline;FlightNo;Date;Price;Currency' in = lv_csv_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'LH;0400;20250101;100.00;EUR' in = lv_csv_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'AA;0017;20250102;250.50;USD' in = lv_csv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird `cl_bcs_convert` verwendet, um diesen String in ein XSTRING zu konvertieren, was die Standardmethode für die Bereitstellung von Dateianhängen (z.B. CSV-Dateien) in E-Mails ist.

Instructions: Greifen Sie mit einer Tabellenexpression auf ein Element einer internen Tabelle zu, die mit `VALUE` initialisiert wurde, und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass das Element nicht gefunden wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Datumsbereichen unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und berechnen Sie die Dauer in Tagen für jeden Bereich.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Initialisierung und die Datumsarithmetik für die Dauer.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
             duration   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_date_range.
    TYPES tt_date_ranges TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_durations RETURNING VALUE(rt_ranges) TYPE tt_date_ranges.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_durations.
    rt_ranges = VALUE #( 
      ( start_date = '20250101' end_date = '20250110' )
      ( start_date = '20250215' end_date = '20250220' )
    ).

    LOOP AT rt_ranges ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_range>).
      <fs_range>-duration = <fs_range>-end_date - <fs_range>-start_date.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_ranges ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ranges[ 1 ]-duration exp = 9 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ranges[ 2 ]-duration exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine klare und effiziente Methode zur Handhabung von Datumsbereichen.

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings zu einem einzigen Satz unter Verwendung von String-Templates und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der String-Liste.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) und `REDUCE` für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_words RETURNING VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_words.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Hallo' )
      ( 'moderne' )
      ( 'ABAP' )
      ( 'Welt' )
    ).

    rv_sentence = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR word IN lt_words NEXT s = s && |{ word } | ).
    " Entferne das letzte Leerzeichen
    IF rv_sentence IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_sentence = rv_sentence(1, strlen( rv_sentence ) - 1).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) und verwenden Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY` um Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft zu zählen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... )` für die Gruppierung.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' )
    ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights BY flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Objekten (z.B. einem Flug und einem Dokument) und überprüfen Sie deren Existenz. Verwenden Sie generische Business-Objekt-Typen für die Demonstration.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_BINARY_RELATION` und deren Methoden `CREATE_LINK` und `CHECK_LINK` mit generischen Business-Objekt-Typen wie 'BUS2000111' (Flug) und 'MESSAGE' (Dokument).
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_check_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_a_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_a_key  TYPE sibfkey
        iv_object_b_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_b_key  TYPE sibfkey
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfreltyp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_link_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_check_link.
    DATA(lo_bor_object_a) = cl_binary_relation=>get_business_object(
                               i_object_type = iv_object_a_type
                               i_object_key  = iv_object_a_key ).

    DATA(lo_bor_object_b) = cl_binary_relation=>get_business_object(
                               i_object_type = iv_object_b_type
                               i_object_key  = iv_object_b_key ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          i_object_a      = lo_bor_object_a
          i_object_b      = lo_bor_object_b
          i_relation_type = iv_relation_type ).

        rv_link_exists = cl_binary_relation=>check_link(
                           i_object_a      = lo_bor_object_a
                           i_object_b      = lo_bor_object_b
                           i_relation_type = iv_relation_type ).

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_br).
        rv_link_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Create a dummy document and link it for testing purposes

                               i_object_type = 'MESSAGE'

        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(

            object_type = ls_link-object_b_type
            object_key  = ls_link-object_b_key ) TO rt_documents.

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Preis (PRICE) aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugnummer (CONNID) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um über die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = REDUCE #( " Ab ABAP 7.40
        INIT max_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
        NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > max_price THEN ls_sflight-price ELSE max_price ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    " Assert against a known maximum price for LH 0400 (adjust if SFLIGHT data changes)
    " For a robust test, one would insert specific test data into a local temporary table.
    IF lv_max_price > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_max_price > 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den maximalen Sitzplatzverbrauch (OCCUPANCY) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, wobei OCCUPANCY als `(BOOKED / CAPACITY)` berechnet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Belegung zu berechnen, und dann `REDUCE` für das Maximum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_occupancy) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_occupancies) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 ( " Ab ABAP 7.40
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
        WHERE ls_sflight-seatsocc > 0 AND ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0
        ( CONV decfloat16( ls_sflight-seatsocc ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) ).

      IF lt_occupancies IS NOT INITIAL.
        rv_max_occupancy = REDUCE #( " Ab ABAP 7.40
          INIT max_val = 0.00 TYPE decfloat16
          FOR lv_occupancy IN lt_occupancies
          NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN lv_occupancy > max_val THEN lv_occupancy ELSE max_val ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lv_max_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_max_occupancy( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Assuming some data exists and max occupancy is between 0 and 1.
    IF lv_max_occupancy IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_max_occupancy >= 0 AND lv_max_occupancy <= 1 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_occupancy exp = 0.00 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert eine `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit berechneten Werten zu erstellen, und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um den Maximalwert aus dieser neuen Tabelle zu ermitteln. Dies demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Programmierkonzepte in modernem ABAP für Datenmanipulation und Aggregation.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, DECFLOAT16

Instructions: Löschen Sie eine spezifische binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Objekten und überprüfen Sie, ob die Verknüpfung erfolgreich gelöscht wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `DELETE_LINK` der Klasse `CL_BINARY_RELATION` und anschließend `CHECK_LINK` zur Verifizierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_specific_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_a_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_a_key  TYPE sibfkey
        iv_object_b_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_b_key  TYPE sibfkey
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfreltyp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_specific_link.
    DATA(lo_bor_object_a) = cl_binary_relation=>get_business_object(
                               i_object_type = iv_object_a_type
                               i_object_key  = iv_object_a_key ).

    DATA(lo_bor_object_b) = cl_binary_relation=>get_business_object(
                               i_object_type = iv_object_b_type
                               i_object_key  = iv_object_b_key ).

    TRY.
        " Ensure link exists before trying to delete (for testability)
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          i_object_a      = lo_bor_object_a
          i_object_b      = lo_bor_object_b
          i_relation_type = iv_relation_type ).

        " Delete the link
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          i_object_a      = lo_bor_object_a
          i_object_b      = lo_bor_object_b
          i_relation_type = iv_relation_type ).

        " Check if it's actually deleted
        rv_deleted = NOT cl_binary_relation=>check_link(
                           i_object_a      = lo_bor_object_a
                           i_object_b      = lo_bor_object_b
                           i_relation_type = iv_relation_type ).

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_br).
        rv_deleted = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_document_guid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).

                              iv_object_b_type = 'MESSAGE'
                              iv_object_b_key  = lv_document_guid

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden sollen, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) )` um die Daten zu mappen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_source,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             extra_field TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_target,
           tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_tables_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_tables_corresponding.
    rt_target = VALUE #( " Ab ABAP 7.40
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source ) ) ). " Ab ABAP 7.50 für FOR-Expression mit CORRESPONDING
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_tables FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corresponding_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_corresponding_demo=>tt_source(
      ( field1 = 1 field2 = 'Text A' field3 = 'Value1' )
      ( field1 = 2 field2 = 'Text B' field3 = 'Value2' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_tables_corresponding( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field2 exp = 'Text A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-extra_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Expression und `CORRESPONDING`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und effiziente Transformation von internen Tabellen. Es werden automatisch Felder mit gleichen Namen gemappt, was den Code kompakter und weniger fehleranfällig macht als manuelle Zuweisungen.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info,
           tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).

    IF lo_data_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_data_descr ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      rt_components = VALUE #( " Ab ABAP 7.40
        FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
        ( name = ls_comp-name
          type = ls_comp-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_flight_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_status DEFAULT IGNORE
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_flight_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = 'Status unbekannt (Standardimplementierung)'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_lufthansa DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_operations.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
    DATA mv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
    METHODS zif_flight_operations~get_status REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_lufthansa IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_seatsocc = iv_seatsocc.
    mv_seatsmax = iv_seatsmax.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_flight_operations~get_status.
    IF mv_seatsocc = mv_seatsmax.
      rv_status = 'Ausgebucht (Lufthansa)'.
    ELSEIF mv_seatsocc > mv_seatsmax / 2.
      rv_status = 'Stark gebucht (Lufthansa)'.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Verfügbar (Lufthansa)'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` zum Sammeln der Preise und `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und Zählung, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( " Ab ABAP 7.40
        INIT sum_price = 0.00 TYPE decfloat16
             count_flights = 0 TYPE i
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
             count_flights = count_flights + 1 ).

      IF ls_aggregation-count_flights > 0.
        rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_price( ).
    DATA(lv_average_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Assuming some data exists for LH
    IF lv_average_price IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average_price >= 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average_price exp = 0.00 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Expression und `REDUCE`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Aggregationen wie die Durchschnittsberechnung durchzuführen. Sie ermöglicht es, Summen und Zähler in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu verwalten, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Math, Average, Internal Tables

ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_dyn_table_access IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_component_value. FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE. FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE ANY. FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY. CREATE DATA DATA(lr_table) TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name). ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>. IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF. CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_target IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_greeting. rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS get_structure_components IMPORTING is_structure TYPE ANY RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE string_table RAISING cx_sy_rtti_error. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_structure_components. DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr, lr_data_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr. FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE ANY. TRY. lr_data_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ). lr_struct_descr ?= lr_data_descr. " Downcast CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error). CLASS zcl_hcmfab_employee_api DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. CLASS-DATA gt_employees TYPE ty_employee_t. METHODS constructor. METHODS get_employee_by_id IMPORTING iv_employee_id TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_employee) TYPE ty_employee_s RAISING zcx_odata_error. METHODS filter_employees IMPORTING iv_department TYPE string OPTIONAL RETURNING VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE ty_employee_t RAISING zcx_odata_error. METHODS update_employee IMPORTING is_employee TYPE ty_employee_s RETURNING VALUE(rs_updated_employee) TYPE ty_employee_s RAISING zcx_odata_error. METHODS simulate_error RAISING zcx_odata_error. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_hcmfab_employee_api IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD constructor. IF gt_employees IS INITIAL. gt_employees = VALUE #( ( employee_id = 'EMP001' first_name = 'John' last_name = 'Doe' department = 'IT' salary = '50000.00' ) ( employee_id = 'EMP002' first_name = 'Jane' last_name = 'Smith' department = 'HR' salary = '60000.00' ) ( employee_id = 'EMP003' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Jones' department = 'IT' salary = '55000.00' ) ). RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_odata_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_odata_error=>default_text. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. METHOD filter_employees. METHOD update_employee. DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix. READ TABLE gt_employees WITH KEY employee_id = is_employee-employee_id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS. IF sy-subrc <> 0. CLASS zcl_odata_read_employee IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD read_employee_data. DATA(lo_api) = NEW zcl_hcmfab_employee_api( ). rs_employee = lo_api->get_employee_by_id( iv_employee_id = iv_employee_id ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_odata_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_odata_error=>default_text. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. METHOD filter_employees. IF iv_department IS SUPPLIED AND iv_department IS NOT INITIAL. rt_employees = FILTER #( gt_employees WHERE department = iv_department ). ELSE. rt_employees = gt_employees. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die innerhalb eines bestimmten Datumsbereichs liegen, wobei der Bereich dynamisch über `cl_abap_datfm` ermittelt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datfm` zur Datumsberechnung und `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date_str TYPE string
        iv_end_date_str   TYPE string
        iv_country        TYPE land1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_date_range.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>create( iv_country = iv_country ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = lo_datfm->convert_to_date( iv_external_date = iv_start_date_str ).
    DATA(lv_end_date) = lo_datfm->convert_to_date( iv_external_date = iv_end_date_str ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate GE lv_start_date AND fldate LE lv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `RANGE`-Tabelle für die Selektion von Business Partnern basierend auf vordefinierten Konstanten aus `if_fsbp_const_range` (konzeptuell).
hint: Nutzen Sie die Konstanten der Interface `if_fsbp_const_range` und die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bp_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_bp_data,
             partner TYPE bu_partner,
             name_org1 TYPE bu_name_org1,
           END OF ty_bp_data.
    TYPES tt_bp_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_bp_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_bp_by_range_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_range_type TYPE string " e.g., 'ALL_ACTIVE_BPS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bp_data) TYPE tt_bp_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bp_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_bp_by_range_type.
    DATA: lr_partner TYPE RANGE OF bu_partner.

    CASE iv_range_type.
      WHEN 'ALL_ACTIVE_BPS'.
        " Conceptual: In a real scenario, if_fsbp_const_range would provide
        " methods or constants to build this range.
        " For demonstration, we simulate a range.
        lr_partner = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0000000001' high = '9999999999' ) ).
      WHEN 'SPECIFIC_BPS'.
        lr_partner = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0000000001' )
                              ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0000000002' ) ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lt_but000) = VALUE tt_bp_data(
      ( partner = '0000000001' name_org1 = 'SAP AG' )
      ( partner = '0000000002' name_org1 = 'IBM Corp' )
      ( partner = '0000000003' name_org1 = 'Microsoft' )
    ).

    rt_bp_data = FILTER #( lt_but000 WHERE partner IN lr_partner ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Datum und geben Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Datum aus, wobei das Datum länderspezifisch formatiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_datfm`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             formatted_date TYPE string,
             flight_count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_country TYPE land1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_date.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>create( iv_country = iv_country ).

    SELECT fldate, carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
                                                      ASCENDING
                                                      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        formatted_date = lo_datfm->format( ls_group_key-fldate )
        flight_count   = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT`-Anweisung auf `sflight` aus, die einen dynamischen Datumsbereich verwendet, der mit `cl_abap_datfm` berechnet wurde.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_calculated_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_days_offset TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_calculated_range.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_end_date) = lo_datfm->add_days( iv_date = iv_start_date iv_days = iv_days_offset ).

    DATA: lr_fldate TYPE RANGE OF sflight-fldate.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = iv_start_date high = lv_end_date ) TO lr_fldate.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate IN @lr_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `RANGE`-Tabelle für `CARRID` aus `sflight` basierend auf einer Liste von Werten, die aus einer 'Konstanten'-Quelle stammen (konzeptuell `if_fsbp_const_range`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expressions und eine Schleife, um die `RANGE`-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_list
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE string_table " e.g., from FS_BP_AL_GENERIC_SERVICES constants
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_list.
    DATA: lr_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    lr_carrid = VALUE #( FOR <carrier> IN it_carriers
                           ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <carrier> ) ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Datumsstring in einem bestimmten länderspezifischen Format gültig ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datfm` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_abap_datfm_invalid_date` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_date_string_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
        iv_country TYPE land1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_date_string_valid.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>create( iv_country = iv_country ).
    TRY.
        lo_datfm->convert_to_date( iv_external_date = iv_date_string ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_invalid_date.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Datumsangaben für die nächsten N Tage, beginnend mit einem Startdatum, und formatieren Sie diese länderspezifisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR`-Expression mit `cl_abap_datfm` und `add_days`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_list_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_formatted_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_formatted_date_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_num_days   TYPE i
        iv_country    TYPE land1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_date_list) TYPE tt_formatted_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_list_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_formatted_date_list.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>create( iv_country = iv_country ).

    rt_date_list = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 UP TO iv_num_days - 1
                              LET lv_current_date = lo_datfm->add_days( iv_date = iv_start_date iv_days = i ) IN
                              ( lo_datfm->format( lv_current_date ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die einen Sitzplatzverbrauch von über 80% aufweisen und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Fügen Sie diese Flüge einer neuen internen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FILTER`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #` und einer `IF`-Bedingung für das Datum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_occupancy_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_flight-seatsmax ) > 80 AND
                                           ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum )
                                   ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                     fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                     seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc,

INTERFACE zif_shape.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = 3 * mv_radius * mv_radius. " Simplified Pi for example
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_side TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shape_result,
             shape_type TYPE string,
             area       TYPE i,
           END OF ty_shape_result.
    TYPES tt_shape_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shape_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_shape_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      IF lo_shape IS INSTANCE OF zcl_circle.
        DATA(lo_circle) = CAST zcl_circle( lo_shape ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_shape_result( shape_type = 'Circle'
                                      area       = lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area() ) TO rt_results.
      ELSE IF lo_shape IS INSTANCE OF zcl_square.
        DATA(lo_square) = CAST zcl_square( lo_shape ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_shape_result( shape_type = 'Square'
                                      area       = lo_square->zif_shape~get_area() ) TO rt_results.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für jeden Carrier aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und einer `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_high_value_totals
      IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_high_value_totals.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_totals = REDUCE tt_carrier_totals(
      INIT totals = VALUE tt_carrier_totals( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET current_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                  INIT sum_price = 0
                                  FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                  IF ls_group_flight-price > iv_price_threshold
                                    NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_group_flight-price
                                  ELSE
                                    NEXT sum_price = sum_price
                                ) IN
      NEXT totals = VALUE #( totals
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                               total_price = current_total_price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus einer Liste von Flugdaten nur diejenigen heraus, die im aktuellen Monat liegen oder in den nächsten 30 Tagen stattfinden. Fügen Sie diese Daten einer neuen Liste hinzu.

CLASS zcl_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_relevant_dates
      IMPORTING it_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dats WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_dates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dats WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_relevant_dates.
    DATA(lv_current_month_start) = sy-datum.
    lv_current_month_start+6(2) = '01'. " Erster Tag des aktuellen Monats
    DATA(lv_next_month_start) = lv_current_month_start + 31. " Vereinfacht, besser CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>ADD_MONTHS
    lv_next_month_start+6(2) = '01'.
    DATA(lv_current_month_end) = lv_next_month_start - 1.

    DATA(lv_date_plus_30_days) = sy-datum + 30.

    rt_filtered_dates = VALUE #( FOR ld_date IN it_dates
                                   IF ( ld_date GE lv_current_month_start AND ld_date LE lv_current_month_end ) OR
                                      ( ld_date > sy-datum AND ld_date LE lv_date_plus_30_days )
                                   ( ld_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl durch Null geteilt werden soll, fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler in einer internen Tabelle. Fügen Sie die Ergebnisse der erfolgreichen Operationen ebenfalls einer Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung und `APPEND` für die Protokollierung und Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             input_value TYPE i,
             result      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES tt_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_log,
             input_value TYPE i,
             error_msg   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error_log.
    TYPES tt_error_logs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      EXPORTING et_results TYPE tt_results
                et_error_logs TYPE tt_error_logs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA lv_divisor TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      TRY.
          " Simulate a division by zero for specific input
          IF lv_number = 0.
            lv_divisor = 0.
          ELSE.
            lv_divisor = 1.
          ENDIF.
          DATA(lv_calculated_result) = lv_number / lv_divisor.
          APPEND VALUE ty_result( input_value = lv_number
                                  result      = lv_calculated_result ) TO et_results.
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
          APPEND VALUE ty_error_log( input_value = lv_number
                                      error_msg   = lx_arith_error->get_text( ) ) TO et_error_logs.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_processor( ).
    DATA lt_input_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_input_numbers.
    APPEND 5 TO lt_input_numbers.
    APPEND 0 TO lt_input_numbers. " This will cause an error
    APPEND 20 TO lt_input_numbers.

    DATA lt_results TYPE zcl_math_processor=>tt_results.
    DATA lt_error_logs TYPE zcl_math_processor=>tt_error_logs.

    lo_cut->process_numbers( EXPORTING et_results = lt_results
                              et_error_logs = lt_error_logs
                              IMPORTING it_numbers = lt_input_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[1]-result exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[2]-result exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[3]-result exp = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_error_logs ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_logs[1]-input_value exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_error_logs[1]-error_msg needle = 'Division by zero' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`. Innerhalb des `LOOP` wird jede Operation in einem `TRY`-Block ausgeführt. Tritt eine `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` auf (z.B. Division durch Null), wird diese abgefangen und die Fehlermeldung mit `APPEND VALUE #` in eine separate Fehlerprotokoll-Tabelle geschrieben. Erfolgreiche Ergebnisse werden ebenfalls mit `APPEND VALUE #` gesammelt. Die `IF`-Bedingung wird hier verwendet, um die Division durch Null zu simulieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf optionalen Eingabeparametern. Fügen Sie nur Bedingungen hinzu, wenn die entsprechenden Parameter nicht initial sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `IF`-Bedingungen, um die `WHERE`-Klausel schrittweise aufzubauen. Sammeln Sie die Bedingungen in einer internen Tabelle und joinen Sie diese.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
                iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamically.
    DATA lt_where_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |carrid = '{ iv_carrid }'| TO lt_where_conditions.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |connid = '{ iv_connid }'| TO lt_where_conditions.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_min_price IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |price >= { iv_min_price }| TO lt_where_conditions.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR condition IN lt_where_conditions
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN condition ELSE s && ' AND ' && condition ) ).

    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        { IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL THEN |WHERE { lv_where_clause }| ELSE '' }
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
    |.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle SQL error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Aufbau dynamischer SQL-Abfragen mit modernen ABAP-Features. Die einzelnen `WHERE`-Bedingungen werden mit `IF`-Anweisungen nur dann einer internen Tabelle (`lt_where_conditions`) hinzugefügt, wenn die entsprechenden Eingabeparameter nicht initial sind. Anschließend werden diese Bedingungen mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates zu einer vollständigen `WHERE`-Klausel zusammengefügt. Die `EXEC SQL` Anweisung ermöglicht die Ausführung des dynamischen SQL. Dies ist eine flexible und sichere Methode für dynamische Abfragen.
keywords: Dynamic SQL, String Templates, IF, APPEND, REDUCE, EXEC SQL, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid). Für jede Gruppe, die mehr als 5 Flüge enthält, ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und fügen Sie diese Information einer Ergebnistabelle hinzu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_group_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      IF lv_group_count > iv_min_flights.
        APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Produktpreisen. Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt von 10% für alle Preise über 100 EUR. Fügen Sie sowohl den Originalpreis als auch den rabattierten Preis (falls zutreffend) einer neuen Ergebnistabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit einer `IF`-Bedingung für die Rabattberechnung und `APPEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_info,
             original_price TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
             discounted_price TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_price_info.
    TYPES tt_price_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_discounts
      IMPORTING it_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2 WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_price_infos) TYPE tt_price_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounts.
    rt_price_infos = VALUE #( FOR lv_price IN it_prices
                               LET lv_discounted_price = COND #( IF lv_price > 100 THEN lv_price * '0.90' ELSE lv_price ) IN
                               ( original_price = lv_price,
                                 discounted_price = lv_discounted_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-discounted_price exp = '108.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-original_price exp = '200.00' ).

explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression wird verwendet, um die Preise zu iterieren. Innerhalb der `FOR`-Expression kommt eine `LET`-Anweisung zum Einsatz, die eine lokale Variable `lv_discounted_price` definiert. Der Wert dieser Variablen wird mit einer `COND #`-Expression (`IF`-ähnlich) bestimmt: Wenn der Preis über 100 liegt, wird ein Rabatt angewendet, ansonsten bleibt der Originalpreis. Die Ergebnisse werden direkt in die Ergebnistabelle aufgenommen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der bedingten Berechnung und Datentransformation.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine flache Liste von Flugsegmenten (carrid, connid, fldate) in eine hierarchische Struktur, die nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugnummer gruppiert ist. Fügen Sie die Flugdaten als Unterelemente hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `APPEND` in Kombination mit `VALUE #` für die hierarchische Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections TYPE tt_connections,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights_to_hierarchy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE tt_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_to_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_carrid) GROUP BY ls_flight_carrid-carrid.
      DATA(ls_carrier) = VALUE ty_carrier( carrid = ls_flight_carrid-carrid ).

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight_carrid INTO DATA(ls_flight_connid) GROUP BY ls_flight_connid-connid.
        DATA(ls_connection) = VALUE ty_connection( connid = ls_flight_connid-connid ).

        LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight_connid INTO DATA(ls_flight_detail).
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_detail( fldate = ls_flight_detail-fldate ) TO ls_connection-flights.
        ENDLOOP.

        APPEND ls_connection TO ls_carrier-connections.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND ls_carrier TO rt_hierarchy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_hierarchy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_hierarchy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_hierarchy) = lo_cut->transform_flights_to_hierarchy( ).

    " Dieser Test ist abhängig von den Daten in SFLIGHT.
    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten, z.B. für 'LH' und '0400'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_hierarchy ).

    DATA(ls_lh_carrier) = lt_hierarchy[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_carrier ).

    DATA(ls_lh_conn_0400) = ls_lh_carrier-connections[ connid = '0400' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_conn_0400 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_conn_0400-flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( ls_lh_conn_0400-flights ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisungen, um eine hierarchische Datenstruktur zu erstellen. Die äußere Schleife gruppiert nach `carrid`, die innere nach `connid`. Innerhalb der innersten Schleife werden die einzelnen Flugdaten mit `APPEND VALUE #` zu den `flights`-Tabellen der `connections`-Struktur hinzugefügt. Die `connections` werden dann der `carrier`-Struktur hinzugefügt, und diese wiederum der finalen Hierarchie. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur Transformation flacher Daten in komplexe, verschachtelte Strukturen.
keywords: LOOP GROUP BY, APPEND, VALUE, Data Transformation, Hierarchical Data, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl gerade ist, fügen Sie sie einer Liste 'Gerade Zahlen' hinzu. Wenn sie ungerade ist, fügen Sie sie einer Liste 'Ungerade Zahlen' hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP`-Anweisung mit einer `IF`-Bedingung und dem Modulo-Operator (`MOD`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_classifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS classify_numbers
      IMPORTING it_input_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      EXPORTING et_even_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
                et_odd_numbers TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_classifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_numbers.
    LOOP AT it_input_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number MOD 2 = 0.
        APPEND lv_number TO et_even_numbers.
      ELSE.
        APPEND lv_number TO et_odd_numbers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_classify_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_number_classifier( ).
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_number_classifier=>tt_numbers.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_input.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_input.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_input.
    APPEND 4 TO lt_input.
    APPEND 5 TO lt_input.

    DATA lt_even TYPE zcl_number_classifier=>tt_numbers.
    DATA lt_odd TYPE zcl_number_classifier=>tt_numbers.

    lo_cut->classify_numbers( EXPORTING et_even_numbers = lt_even
                              et_odd_numbers = lt_odd
                              IMPORTING it_input_numbers = lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_even ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_even needle = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_even needle = 4 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_odd ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_odd needle = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_odd needle = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_odd needle = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `LOOP` und `IF` in modernem ABAP. Der Modulo-Operator (`MOD`) wird verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob eine Zahl gerade oder ungerade ist. Basierend auf dieser `IF`-Bedingung wird die Zahl mit `APPEND` der entsprechenden Ergebnistabelle hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine klare und effiziente Methode zur bedingten Verteilung von Daten.
keywords: LOOP, IF, APPEND, MOD, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und eine Liste von Flugnummern. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die alle Kombinationen von Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern enthält, aber nur, wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist oder die Flugnummer '0017' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Expressions mit `IF`-Bedingungen und `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_combiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_combination,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_combination.
    TYPES tt_flight_combinations TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_combination WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_combinations
      IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
                it_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combinations) TYPE tt_flight_combinations.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_combiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_combinations.
    rt_combinations = VALUE #( FOR lv_carrid IN it_carriers
                                 FOR lv_connid IN it_connections
                                 IF lv_carrid = 'LH' OR lv_connid = '0017'
                                 ( carrid = lv_carrid,
                                   connid = lv_connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
