Instructions: Gegeben ist ein String, der durch Kommas getrennte Werte enthält. Extrahieren Sie alle Werte, die numerisch sind und fügen Sie diese einer Liste von Zahlen hinzu. Ignorieren Sie nicht-numerische Werte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und eine `IF`-Bedingung mit `IS NUMERIC` oder `TRY CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_to_num_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_numeric_values
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_numeric_values) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_to_num_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_numeric_values.
    DATA lt_parts TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    LOOP AT lt_parts INTO DATA(lv_part).
      lv_part = cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim( lv_part ). " Trim whitespace
      IF lv_part IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_part CO '0123456789-+' AND lv_part CN '.,'. " Basic numeric check
        TRY.
            DATA(lv_number) = CONV i( lv_part ).
            APPEND lv_number TO rt_numeric_values.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Ignore conversion errors for non-numeric strings
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_numeric_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_numeric_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_to_num_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = '10, ABC, 20, -5, Hello, 30.5, 40'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_numeric_values( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = -5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = 40 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Eingabestring wird zunächst mit `SPLIT` in einzelne Teile zerlegt. Eine `LOOP`-Anweisung iteriert über diese Teile. Eine `IF`-Bedingung prüft grob, ob der String numerisch aussehen könnte (enthält nur Ziffern, Vorzeichen). Anschließend wird `TRY CONV` verwendet, um eine sichere Konvertierung in eine Zahl zu versuchen. Bei Erfolg wird die Zahl mit `APPEND` der Ergebnistabelle hinzugefügt. `cx_sy_conversion_error` wird abgefangen, um nicht-numerische Strings zu ignorieren. `cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim` wird für die Bereinigung der Strings verwendet.
keywords: SPLIT, LOOP, IF, CONV, TRY CATCH, String Processing, Internal Tables, APPEND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren Flugnummer (connid) mit '0' beginnt und deren Fluggesellschaft (carrid) nicht 'AA' ist. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit einer `IF`-Bedingung und `CP` (Contains Pattern).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_specific_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_specific_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                           IF ls_flight-connid CP '0*' AND ls_flight-carrid <> 'AA'
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                             connid = ls_flight-connid,
                             fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_specific_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_specific_flights( ).

    " Dieser Test ist abhängig von den Daten in SFLIGHT.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge, die mit '0' beginnen und nicht von 'AA' sind.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-connid CP '0*' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-carrid <> 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression wird verwendet, um die `sflights`-Tabelle zu durchlaufen. Eine `IF`-Bedingung mit dem `CP`-Operator (Contains Pattern) prüft, ob die Flugnummer mit '0' beginnt, und eine weitere Bedingung schließt Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus. Die passenden Flüge werden direkt in die Ergebnistabelle aufgenommen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Methode zur bedingten Filterung und Transformation von Daten.
keywords: FOR, IF, CP, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, APPEND, VALUE

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Bestellpositionen mit Mengen und Preisen. Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis für jede Position. Wenn der Gesamtpreis über 1000 liegt, markieren Sie die Position als 'High Value'. Fügen Sie die Positionen mit dem Gesamtpreis und der Markierung einer neuen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `LET` für die Berechnung und `COND` für die bedingte Markierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item_in,
             item_id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_order_item_in.
    TYPES tt_order_items_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item_out,
             item_id TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
             value_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_order_item_out.
    TYPES tt_order_items_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_order_items
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_order_items_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_order_items_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_order_items.
    rt_processed_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_items
                                   LET lv_total_price = ls_item-quantity * ls_item-unit_price IN
                                   ( item_id = ls_item-item_id,
                                     total_price = lv_total_price,
                                     value_category = COND string( WHEN lv_total_price > 1000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_order_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_order_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_order_processor( ).
    DATA lt_input_items TYPE zcl_order_processor=>tt_order_items_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 1 quantity = 10 unit_price = '50.00' ) TO lt_input_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 2 quantity = 5 unit_price = '300.00' ) TO lt_input_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 3 quantity = 20 unit_price = '60.00' ) TO lt_input_items.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_order_items( lt_input_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

Instructions: Konkateniere alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carrids.
    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      seen_carrids = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      LET current_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
      NEXT result = COND string(
                       WHEN line_exists( seen_carrids[ table_line = current_carrid ] ) THEN result
                       WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN current_carrid
                       ELSE result && ',' && current_carrid )
           seen_carrids = VALUE string_table( ( seen_carrids ) ( current_carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF <fs_flight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary(
                       ( result )
                       ( carrid       = <key>-carrid
                         flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                         total_price  = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                          INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP
                                          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_flight>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-price = 200. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-price = 300. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_aggregate( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_price exp = 250 ).

Es aggregiert Daten nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnet für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge (`GROUP SIZE`) und den Gesamtpreis (mittels eines weiteren `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks über die Gruppenelemente).

Instructions: Implementiere eine Funktion, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen (z.B. 10) ab einem bestimmten Offset (z.B. nach den ersten 20) aus `sflights` liest, um Paging zu ermöglichen. Nutze hierfür `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR`.
hint: Verwende `OPEN CURSOR` mit `OFFSET` und `UP TO`, dann `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_paging DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_size TYPE i
        iv_offset    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_paging IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_page.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF iv_offset > 0.
      " Skip records for offset
      DO iv_offset TIMES.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_dummy) PACKAGE SIZE 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE rt_sflights PACKAGE SIZE iv_page_size.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_paging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_paging.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_paging( ).

    " Test first page (e.g., 5 records, offset 0)
    DATA(lt_page1) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_page_size = 5 iv_offset = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_page1 ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_page1 ).

    " Test second page (e.g., 5 records, offset 5)
    DATA(lt_page2) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_page_size = 5 iv_offset = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_page2 ) exp = 5 ).
    " Assert that page 2 is different from page 1 (assuming enough data in sflight)
    IF lines( lt_page1 ) = 5 AND lines( lt_page2 ) = 5.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_page1[1]-carrid exp = lt_page2[1]-carrid ). " Simple check
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` ist die klassische Methode für Paging-Szenarien, insbesondere wenn `OFFSET` und `LIMIT` nicht direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung verfügbar sind oder komplexere Cursor-Operationen erforderlich sind. `PACKAGE SIZE` optimiert den Datentransfer.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, OPEN CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, Paging, Database Access, Cursor

CLASS zcl_reduce_fetch_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fetch_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_of_top_n.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO iv_count ROWS
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen und verarbeite jedes Paket. Demonstriere die Verwendung von `FETCH NEXT` mit `PACKAGE SIZE`.
hint: Nutze `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM sflight ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_sflights_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.

      " Simulate processing of the package
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + lines( lt_sflights_package ).

      CLEAR lt_sflights_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_total_sflights).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = lv_total_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lv_processed exp = 0 ). " Assumes sflight is not empty
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lese die ersten 5 Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und gib für jede Fluggesellschaft den Gesamtpreis dieser Top-5-Flüge aus.
hint: Kombiniere `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_fetch_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_top_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_top_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_top_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_top_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_per_carrier_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_top_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_fetch_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_per_carrier_summary.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    " Fetch all flights, then group and take top N per group in ABAP
    " (Direct SQL for 'top N per group' is more complex and not standard ABAP Open SQL)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_carrier_top_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_top_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_top_summary(
                       ( result )
                       ( carrid      = <key>-carrid
                         total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                         INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
                                         NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_flight>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_n_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_fetch_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_per_carrier_summary( 2 ).

    " Assuming sflight has at least 2 carriers with at least 2 flights each
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_group_fetch_reduce=>ty_carrier_top_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_summary-total_price ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = VALUE zcl_group_fetch_reduce=>ty_carrier_top_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_aa_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_summary-total_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR GROUPS` mit einem inneren `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, der `UP TO N ROWS` verwendet, um die ersten N Elemente jeder Gruppe zu verarbeiten. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um komplexe Aggregationen und Top-N-Analysen pro Gruppe direkt im ABAP-Code durchzuführen, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder aufwendige Schleifen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, UP TO N ROWS, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping, Top N per Group

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), bei denen die maximale Kapazität (MAX_SEATS) unter einem bestimmten Wert (z.B. 150) liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `DELETE` Anweisung mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_sflights_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_by_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflights_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_by_max_seats.
    rt_filtered_sflights = it_sflights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_sflights WHERE max_seats < iv_min_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_by_max_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_by_max_seats.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflights_seats( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_by_max_seats( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_min_seats = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ] OPTIONAL
      msg = 'Der Eintrag mit 100 Sitzen sollte gelöscht sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Einträge enthält, die den Kriterien entsprechen (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und maximale Kapazität > 200). Nutzen Sie dabei funktionale Programmierung mit `FILTER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Einträgen zu erstellen, was implizit die 'Löschung' der unerwünschten Einträge aus der Perspektive der neuen Tabelle darstellt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_functional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_functional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_functional( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230102' seatsmax = 180 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1
      msg = 'Es sollte 1 Eintrag übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsmax exp = 250
      msg = 'Maximale Sitze sollten 250 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Art, eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen zu erstellen. Dies ist oft lesbarer und effizienter als explizite Schleifen und `DELETE` Anweisungen, wenn das Ziel eine gefilterte Kopie ist.

Instructions: Löschen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), basierend auf den Feldern Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugnummer (CONNID).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM itab COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_sflights = it_sflights.
    SORT rt_unique_sflights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_sflights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_adjacent_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230103' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( it_sflights = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 eindeutige Einträge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist der Standardweg, um aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, damit alle Duplikate nebeneinander liegen und erkannt werden können.
keywords: Internal Tables, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Duplicates, SORT

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights_by_criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflights_db( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'XX',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date    VALUE '20240101'.

    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate )

Instructions: Löschen Sie eine spezifische Sprachdatei, die einem Transportauftrag zugeordnet ist, unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `DELETE_FILE` der Klasse `cl_cts_language_file_io` und geben Sie den Dateinamen sowie den Transportauftrag an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_file_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
        iv_trkorr   TYPE trkorr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_file_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_language_file.
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>delete_file(
          i_filename = iv_filename
          i_trkorr   = iv_trkorr
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_cts_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: In einem realen Szenario würde hier eine detailliertere Protokollierung oder Fehlerbehandlung erfolgen.
        " Für dieses Beispiel geben wir nur 'false' zurück.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_language_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_language_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cts_file_deleter( ).
    DATA: lv_filename TYPE string VALUE 'DUMMY_LANG_FILE.XML',
          lv_trkorr   TYPE trkorr VALUE 'DUMMYK900001'.

    " HINWEIS: cl_cts_language_file_io interagiert mit dem CTS-System.
    " Ein echter Unit-Test würde hier ein Mocking-Framework benötigen, um die Abhängigkeit zu isolieren.
    " Dieser Test prüft lediglich, ob der Aufruf ohne Syntaxfehler oder ungehandelte Ausnahmen erfolgt.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->delete_language_file( iv_filename = lv_filename iv_trkorr = lv_trkorr ).

    " Da wir keine echte CTS-Umgebung haben, können wir den Erfolg nicht wirklich verifizieren.
    " Wir können aber prüfen, ob keine unerwartete Ausnahme aufgetreten ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true
      msg = 'Methode sollte ohne unerwartete Ausnahme aufrufbar sein' ).
    " Optional: Wenn wir wüssten, dass der Aufruf fehlschlagen MUSS (z.B. Datei existiert nicht), könnten wir assert_false prüfen.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success
    "   msg = 'Löschen sollte fehlschlagen, da Datei nicht existiert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_cts_language_file_io` ist eine spezialisierte Klasse für den Zugriff auf Sprachdateien im Kontext des Change and Transport Systems (CTS). Die Methode `DELETE_FILE` ermöglicht das gezielte Löschen solcher Dateien, wobei der Transportauftrag als Kontext dient. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: CTS, File System, DELETE, cl_cts_language_file_io, Transport Request, Exception Handling

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights_cross_client.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_cross_client( ).
    DATA: lv_target_client TYPE sy-mandt VALUE '800',
          lv_carrid        TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'ZZ'.

    " Testdaten für den Zielmandanten einfügen
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( mandt = lv_target_client carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20240101' )

keywords: Database, DELETE, Open SQL, CLIENT SPECIFIED, MANDT, Cross-Client

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Dateien auf dem Applikationsserver, die einem bestimmten Namensmuster entsprechen (z.B. temporäre Log-Dateien in einem Verzeichnis).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_file_list` zum Auflisten und `OPEN DATASET ... FOR DELETING` zum Löschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_server_file_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_pattern_files
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory TYPE string
        iv_pattern   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_server_file_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_pattern_files.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_file_names.
    DATA: lv_full_path TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_file_name TYPE string.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_file_list(
      EXPORTING
        i_directory = iv_directory
        i_pattern   = iv_pattern
      IMPORTING
        e_file_names = lt_files
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_files INTO lv_file_name.
      lv_full_path = |{ iv_directory }/{ lv_file_name }|.
      OPEN DATASET lv_full_path FOR DELETING IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CLOSE DATASET lv_full_path.
        rv_deleted_count = rv_deleted_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: In einem realen Szenario würde hier eine detailliertere Protokollierung erfolgen.
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Fehler beim Löschen von Datei: { lv_full_path }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_pattern_files FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_pattern_files.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_server_file_deleter( ).
    DATA: lv_test_dir TYPE string VALUE '/tmp/abap_test_files',
          lv_pattern  TYPE string VALUE 'temp_*.log'.

    " HINWEIS: Dieser Test interagiert mit dem Dateisystem des Applikationsservers.
    " In einer echten Testumgebung müssten die Dateisystemoperationen gemockt werden.
    " Hier wird versucht, Dateien zu erstellen und zu löschen, was Berechtigungen erfordert.

    " Testverzeichnis erstellen (falls nicht vorhanden)
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( i_directory = lv_test_dir ).

    " Dummy-Dateien erstellen
    OPEN DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/temp_001.log| FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'Testinhalt 1' TO |{ lv_test_dir }/temp_001.log|.
    CLOSE DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/temp_001.log|.

    OPEN DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/temp_002.log| FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'Testinhalt 2' TO |{ lv_test_dir }/temp_002.log|.
    CLOSE DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/temp_002.log|.

    OPEN DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/other_file.txt| FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'Anderer Inhalt' TO |{ lv_test_dir }/other_file.txt|.
    CLOSE DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/other_file.txt|.

    DATA(lv_deleted_count) = lo_cut->delete_pattern_files( iv_directory = lv_test_dir iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted_count exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Dateien gelöscht werden' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Dateien wirklich gelöscht wurden
    DATA: lt_remaining_files TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_file_names.
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_file_list(
      EXPORTING
        i_directory = lv_test_dir
        i_pattern   = lv_pattern
      IMPORTING
        e_file_names = lt_remaining_files
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_remaining_files
      msg = 'Es sollten keine Dateien mit dem Muster mehr existieren' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die andere Datei noch existiert
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_file_list(
      EXPORTING
        i_directory = lv_test_dir
        i_pattern   = 'other_file.txt'
      IMPORTING
        e_file_names = lt_remaining_files
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_remaining_files ) exp = 1
      msg = 'Die andere Datei sollte noch existieren' ).

    " Aufräumen: Testverzeichnis und verbleibende Dateien löschen
    DELETE DATASET |{ lv_test_dir }/other_file.txt|.
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( i_directory = lv_test_dir ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Löschen von Dateien auf dem Applikationsserver. Die Klasse `cl_abap_file_utilities` (ABAP 7.40+) bietet moderne Methoden zum Auflisten von Dateien. Die eigentliche Löschung erfolgt über die klassische `OPEN DATASET ... FOR DELETING` Anweisung, die in einer Schleife für jede zu löschende Datei aufgerufen wird. Dies ist der Standardweg für Dateisystemoperationen auf dem Applikationsserver.
keywords: File System, DELETE, Application Server, OPEN DATASET, cl_abap_file_utilities, Pattern Matching

Instructions: Löschen Sie Flugverbindungen aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights`, die keine zugehörigen Einträge in der Tabelle `sbook` (Flugbuchungen) haben, unter Verwendung eines Subqueries.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM dbtab WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT ... )`.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflights_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_flights_without_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflights_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_without_bookings.
    DELETE FROM sflights AS sf
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT * FROM sbook AS sb
          WHERE sb~carrid = sf~carrid
            AND sb~connid = sf~connid
            AND sb~fldate = sf~fldate
      ).
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights_without_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflights_subquery( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid_booked TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'B1',
          lv_carrid_unbooked TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'U1',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20240101'.

    " Testdaten einfügen: Flüge mit und ohne Buchungen
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_booked connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_unbooked connid = '0002' fldate = lv_fldate )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_booked connid = '0003' fldate = lv_fldate )
    ) ).
    INSERT sbook FROM TABLE @( VALUE sbook_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_booked connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate bookid = '00000001' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_booked connid = '0003' fldate = lv_fldate bookid = '00000002' )
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flights_without_bookings( ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 1
      msg = 'Es sollte 1 Flug ohne Buchungen gelöscht werden' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der ungebuchte Flug gelöscht wurde
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_unbooked AND connid = '0002' INTO @DATA(lv_count_unbooked).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_unbooked exp = 0
      msg = 'Der ungebuchte Flug sollte gelöscht sein' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_booked exp = 2
      msg = 'Die gebuchten Flüge sollten noch existieren' ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_booked OR carrid = lv_carrid_unbooked.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_booked.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von Subqueries in der `WHERE`-Klausel von `DELETE` Anweisungen (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht komplexe Löschbedingungen, die auf der Existenz oder Nicht-Existenz von Datensätzen in anderen Tabellen basieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Geschäftsobjekte, die eine Methode zur Protokollierung von Nachrichten in einem Anwendungslog (BAL) bereitstellt. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Unterklasse, die diese Protokollierungsfunktion nutzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und die Standard-BAL-Klassen (`CL_BAL_LOG_...`) zur Protokollierung. Beachten Sie, dass `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` eine spezifische Wrapper-Klasse sein könnte; hier wird die Standard-BAL-API verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_logger DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_msg_type TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty
        iv_msg_id   TYPE bal_s_msg-msgid
        iv_msg_no   TYPE bal_s_msg-msgno
        iv_msg_v1   TYPE bal_s_msg-msgv1 OPTIONAL
        iv_msg_v2   TYPE bal_s_msg-msgv2 OPTIONAL
        iv_msg_v3   TYPE bal_s_msg-msgv3 OPTIONAL
        iv_msg_v4   TYPE bal_s_msg-msgv4 OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = iv_msg_type
                           msgid = iv_msg_id
                           msgno = iv_msg_no
                           msgv1 = iv_msg_v1
                           msgv2 = iv_msg_v2
                           msgv3 = iv_msg_v3
                           msgv4 = iv_msg_v4
                         )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_business_obj DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_logger FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_business_obj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    " Simulate some processing
    log_message( iv_msg_type = 'I' iv_msg_id = 'ZMSG' iv_msg_no = '001' iv_msg_v1 = 'Processing started' ).
    " Simulate an error
    log_message( iv_msg_type = 'E' iv_msg_id = 'ZMSG' iv_msg_no = '002' iv_msg_v1 = 'Error during step X' ).
    log_message( iv_msg_type = 'S' iv_msg_id = 'ZMSG' iv_msg_no = '003' iv_msg_v1 = 'Processing finished' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_logging.
    DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_concrete_business_obj( ).
    lo_obj->process_data( ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_obj->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Log handle should not be initial' act = lv_log_handle IS INITIAL ).

    " Check if messages were added (simplified check)
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_bal_log_read=>get_messages( i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 messages in log' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_logger` stellt eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle und Implementierung für die Protokollierung von Nachrichten in einem Anwendungslog bereit. Konkrete Geschäftsobjekte können diese Klasse erben und die Protokollierungsfunktionalität direkt nutzen, ohne die BAL-Implementierungsdetails wiederholen zu müssen. Dies fördert Wiederverwendbarkeit und Konsistenz. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Struktur `bal_s_msg` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature. `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` ist hier als Keyword genannt, da es eine ähnliche Funktion wie ein Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler erfüllt, auch wenn die konkrete Implementierung die Standard-BAL-API nutzt.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CLASS, INHERITING FROM, CL_BAL_LOG, Error Handling, Logging, Object Orientation, VALUE, cl_s_aut_bal_log S_AUT Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein neues Format. Wenn ein Flugpreis negativ ist, protokollieren Sie eine Fehlermeldung mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD` und überspringen Sie den Eintrag.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Transformation und `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD` für die Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_transformed,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_flight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_transformed.

    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-price >= 0 )
      ( 
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = ls_flight-price
        currency = ls_flight-currency
      )
    ).

    " Log errors for negative prices
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_original_flight) WHERE price < 0.
      cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
          i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                             msgty = 'E'
                             msgid = 'ZMSG'
                             msgno = '004'
                             msgv1 = ls_original_flight-carrid
                             msgv2 = ls_original_flight-connid
                             msgv3 = |Negative price found: { ls_original_flight-price }|
                           )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für eine Operation. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren. Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer dieser Klassen basierend auf einem Benutzereingabeparameter auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CREATE OBJECT` mit Typ `REF TO DATA` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_input + 10.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation_type TYPE string
        iv_input          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_operation TYPE REF TO zif_operation.
    DATA: lv_class_name TYPE string.

    CASE iv_operation_type.
      WHEN 'ADD'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_ADD_OPERATION'.
      WHEN 'MULTIPLY'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_MULTIPLY_OPERATION'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>call_method_not_found
            method = iv_operation_type.
    ENDCASE.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_operation TYPE (lv_class_name).
    rv_result = lo_operation->execute( iv_input = iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Auswahl der konkreten Implementierung erfolgt zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem String-Parameter. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Architekturen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `Predicate`, die eine abstrakte Methode `evaluate` definiert. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Predicate-Klassen (z.B. `IsExpensive`, `IsLongFlight`). Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer Instanz dieser Predicate-Klassen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und eine abstrakte Klasse für den Predicate.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_predicate DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS evaluate ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_expensive_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_predicate FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS evaluate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_expensive_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate.
    IF is_flight-price > 500.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_long_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_predicate FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS evaluate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_long_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate.
    " Assuming a long flight has a connection ID > 1000 (example logic)
    IF is_flight-connid > '1000'.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        io_predicate TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_predicate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING io_predicate->evaluate( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme-Klasse. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block ab und protokollieren Sie die Ausnahmeinformationen mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
hint: `CLASS ... INHERITING FROM CX_STATIC_CHECK`, `TRY...CATCH`, `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.

    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text
          previous = NEW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( ).
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate successful processing
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'S'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '005'
                           msgv1 = |Value { iv_value } processed successfully|
                         )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse für verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien (z.B. Preisberechnung). Eine Kontextklasse soll die Strategie zur Laufzeit austauschen können.
hint: `ABSTRACT CLASS`, Polymorphie, Dependency Injection.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_calculation DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_calculation FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_value1 + iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_calculation FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_value1 * iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation.

    METHODS set_strategy
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation.

    METHODS execute_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_strategy.
    me->mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_calculation.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_strategy->calculate( iv_value1 = iv_value1 iv_value2 = iv_value2 ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle error or default behavior
      rv_result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Eine Kontextklasse (`zcl_calculator_context`) hält eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Strategie und kann diese zur Laufzeit austauschen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die mehrere String-Operationen (z.B. Trimmen, Großschreibung) in einer Kette ausführen kann. Protokollieren Sie jede Operation und deren Ergebnis mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
hint: Verwenden Sie Method Chaining und `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.

    METHODS trim
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.

    METHODS to_upper
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_string TYPE string.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process.
    me->mv_current_string = iv_input.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '007'
                           msgv1 = |Initial string: '{ iv_input }'|
                         )
    ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_current_string = |{ mv_current_string ALPHA = OUT }|.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '008'
                           msgv1 = |Trimmed string: '{ mv_current_string }'|
                         )
    ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_current_string TO UPPER CASE.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '009'
                           msgv1 = |Uppercase string: '{ mv_current_string }'|
                         )
    ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_operations.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_string_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process( '  hello world  ' )->trim( )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLO WORLD' ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_processor->get_log_handle( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_bal_log_read=>get_messages( i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 messages in log' ).

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und protokollieren Sie Fälle, in denen keine Daten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft gefunden wurden, mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ( 'XX' ) ). " All possible carriers

    LOOP AT lt_all_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      DATA(lt_flights_for_carrier) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrier ).

      IF lt_flights_for_carrier IS INITIAL.
        cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                               msgty = 'W'
                               msgid = 'ZMSG'
                               msgno = '010'
                               msgv1 = |No flight data found for carrier { lv_carrier }|
                             )
        ).
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_flights_for_carrier INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
        DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          total_flights = GROUP SIZE
          total_price = REDUCE s_price(
            INIT sum = 0
            FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
            NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
          )
        ).
        APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation_with_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_with_logging.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 300 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 carrier summaries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_flights exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price exp = 300 ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_aggregator->get_log_handle( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_bal_log_read=>get_messages( i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 warning message for missing carrier' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv3 exp = 'XX' msg = 'Expected warning for carrier XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können komplexe Aggregationen kompakt und lesbar formuliert werden. Fehlende Daten für bestimmte Gruppierungskriterien werden mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD` protokolliert. `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` ist hier als Keyword genannt, da es eine ähnliche Funktion wie ein Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler erfüllt, auch wenn die konkrete Implementierung die Standard-BAL-API nutzt.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template-Methoden-Muster. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse definiert den Algorithmus-Skelett mit abstrakten Schritten, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden.
hint: `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `ABSTRACT METHODS`, `REDEFINITION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_report_template DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_content) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS process_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS format_report ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_processed_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_content) TYPE string.

    METHODS log_step
      IMPORTING
        iv_step_name TYPE string
        iv_message   TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_report_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD generate_report.
    log_step( iv_step_name = 'Start' iv_message = 'Report generation started' ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_data( ).
    log_step( iv_step_name = 'Get Data' iv_message = |{ lines( lt_raw_data ) } lines of data retrieved| ).

    DATA(lt_processed_data) = process_data( lt_raw_data ).
    log_step( iv_step_name = 'Process Data' iv_message = |{ lines( lt_processed_data ) } lines of data processed| ).

    rv_report_content = format_report( lt_processed_data ).
    log_step( iv_step_name = 'Format Report' iv_message = 'Report formatted' ).
    log_step( iv_step_name = 'End' iv_message = 'Report generation finished' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_step.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '011'
                           msgv1 = iv_step_name
                           msgv2 = iv_message
                         )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_text_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_report_template FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_report REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_text_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    APPEND 'Line 1: Sample Data' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Line 2: More Data' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    rt_processed_data = VALUE #( FOR line IN it_data ( |Processed: { line }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_report.
    rv_report_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = '--- Simple Report ---
'
      FOR line IN it_processed_data
      NEXT s = s && line && |
|
    ).
    rv_report_content = rv_report_content && '--- End Report ---'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simple_text_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_text_report.
    DATA(lo_report) = NEW zcl_simple_text_report( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_report->generate_report( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_content msg = 'Report content should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_content exp = '--- Simple Report ---' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_content exp = 'Processed: Line 1: Sample Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_content exp = '--- End Report ---' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template-Methoden-Muster wird hier durch die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_report_template` implementiert. Diese Klasse definiert das Skelett eines Algorithmus (`generate_report`) und delegiert bestimmte Schritte an abstrakte Methoden (`get_data`, `process_data`, `format_report`), die von konkreten Unterklassen implementiert werden müssen. Dies gewährleistet die Struktur des Algorithmus, während die Details der Implementierung flexibel bleiben. Jede Schrittausführung wird zudem protokolliert. `ABSTRACT` ist hier das zentrale Konzept.
keywords: Template Method, Design Patterns, Object Orientation, ABSTRACT, REDEFINITION, FOR, REDUCE, CL_BAL_LOG, cl_s_aut_bal_log S_AUT Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `Shape` mit einer abstrakten Methode `calculate_area`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Unterklassen `Circle` und `Rectangle`, die diese Methode implementieren. Berechnen Sie die Fläche für eine Liste von `Shape`-Objekten.
hint: `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `ABSTRACT METHODS`, Polymorphie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_math_constants=>pi * ( mv_radius ** 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_length = iv_length.
    me->mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_area
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_area.
    rv_total_area = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR lo_shape IN it_shapes
      NEXT sum = sum + lo_shape->calculate_area( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_area FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_area.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_shape.
    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '10' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '5' iv_width = '4' ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_shape_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_area) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_area( lt_shapes ).

    " Expected: Circle (100 * PI) + Rectangle (20) = 314.1592653589793 + 20 = 334.1592653589793
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_area exp = '334.1592653589793' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Polymorphie und abstrakte Klassen. Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_shape` definiert eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle (`calculate_area`) für verschiedene Formen. Konkrete Unterklassen (`zcl_circle`, `zcl_rectangle`) implementieren diese Methode spezifisch. Eine Liste von `Shape`-Objekten kann dann durchlaufen werden, und die korrekte `calculate_area`-Implementierung wird zur Laufzeit aufgerufen. `REDUCE` wird für die Summenbildung verwendet. `ABSTRACT` ist hier das zentrale Konzept.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, REDUCE, DECFLOAT16

INTERFACE zif_data_access DEFINITION PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Event-Handling-Szenario. Eine Klasse löst ein Ereignis aus, das von einer anderen Klasse behandelt wird. Protokollieren Sie das Ereignis mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
hint: `EVENTS`, `FOR EVENT`, `RAISE EVENT`, `SET HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_value) TYPE i.

    METHODS change_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD change_data.
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING iv_new_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_publisher TYPE REF TO zcl_event_publisher.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_publisher IMPORTING iv_new_value.

    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
    ENDIF.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_data_changed FOR io_publisher.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '012'
                           msgv1 = |Event 'data_changed' received with new value: { iv_new_value }|
                         )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling_with_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling_with_logging.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_event_handler( lo_publisher ).

    lo_publisher->change_data( 123 ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_handler->get_log_handle( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_bal_log_read=>get_messages( i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 log message for event' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = '123' msg = 'Expected log message to contain new value' ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Singleton-Muster für eine Konfigurationsklasse. Stellen Sie sicher, dass nur eine Instanz der Klasse existieren kann und protokollieren Sie den Zugriff auf die Instanz mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
hint: `CLASS-METHODS GET_INSTANCE`, `PRIVATE SECTION` für Konstruktor, `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_config.

    METHODS get_setting
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_setting
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_config.
    DATA mt_settings TYPE string_table WITH HEADER LINE.
    CLASS-DATA mo_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialize default settings
    APPEND 'DEFAULT_VALUE=100' TO mt_settings.
    APPEND 'APP_NAME=MyApplication' TO mt_settings.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '013'
                           msgv1 = 'Singleton instance created' 
                         )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT go_instance.
      IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
        mo_log_handle = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log_handle( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    cl_bal_log_message_add=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                           msgty = 'I'
                           msgid = 'ZMSG'
                           msgno = '014'
                           msgv1 = 'Singleton instance accessed' 
                         )
    ).
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_setting.
    READ TABLE mt_settings WITH KEY table_line CS iv_key INTO DATA(lv_setting).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SPLIT lv_setting AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_key) DATA(lv_value).
      rv_value = lv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_setting.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT mt_settings INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE table_line CS iv_key.
      lv_line = |{ iv_key }={ iv_value }|.
      MODIFY mt_settings FROM lv_line.
      lv_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lv_found = abap_false.
      APPEND |{ iv_key }={ iv_value }| TO mt_settings.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_singleton_instance FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_singleton_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_instance.
    DATA(lo_config1) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_config2) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_config1 exp = lo_config2 msg = 'Instances should be identical' ).

    lo_config1->set_setting( iv_key = 'NEW_SETTING' iv_value = 'TEST' ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_config2->get_setting( 'NEW_SETTING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'TEST' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_singleton_logging.
    " Clear previous log messages if any from other tests
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_log_handle( ).
    IF lv_log_handle IS BOUND.
      cl_bal_log_delete=>delete_log( i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_config) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_config_again) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).

    lv_log_handle = zcl_singleton_config=>get_log_handle( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_bal_log_read=>get_messages( i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 log messages (create + 2 access)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Singleton instance created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Singleton instance accessed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 3 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Singleton instance accessed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Muster stellt sicher, dass von einer Klasse nur eine einzige Instanz existiert und bietet einen globalen Zugriffspunkt darauf. Dies wird durch einen privaten Konstruktor und eine öffentliche Klassenmethode (`get_instance`) erreicht, die die Instanz bei Bedarf erzeugt. Jeder Zugriff auf die Instanz wird mit `CL_BAL_LOG_MESSAGE_ADD` protokolliert. `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` ist hier als Keyword genannt, da es eine ähnliche Funktion wie ein Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler erfüllt, auch wenn die konkrete Implementierung die Standard-BAL-API nutzt.
keywords: Singleton Pattern, Object Orientation, CLASS-METHODS, CREATE PRIVATE, CL_BAL_LOG, cl_s_aut_bal_log S_AUT Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler

CLASS zcl_xml_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_name TYPE string
        iv_node_name TYPE string
        iv_node_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = iv_root_name
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
    ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = iv_node_name
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
    ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_node ).
    lo_node->set_value( iv_node_value ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_child_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_parent_xpath TYPE string
        iv_new_node_name TYPE string
        iv_new_node_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_child_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_string( iv_xml_string ).
        DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_parent_xpath ).
        IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.

          lo_parent_node->append_child( lo_new_node ).
          lo_new_node->set_value( iv_new_node_value ).
        ENDIF.
        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_modified_xml ).
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_itab_avg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer lokalen internen Tabelle von Flugdaten mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`, um Daten zu gruppieren und dann den Durchschnitt innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_avg_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE f,
           END OF ty_avg_result.
    TYPES tt_avg_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_per_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_results) TYPE tt_avg_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_avg_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_per_airline.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE s_price,
          lv_count TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      CLEAR: lv_sum, lv_count.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_grouped_flight-price.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_avg_result(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          avg_price = lv_sum / lv_count
        ) TO rt_avg_results.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
