Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnitt von Werten in einer internen Tabelle, wobei jeder Wert ein entsprechendes Gewicht hat.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`, um (Wert * Gewicht) zu summieren und Gewichte separat zu summieren, und teilen Sie dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_data,
             value  TYPE f,
             weight TYPE f,
           END OF ty_weighted_data.
    TYPES tt_weighted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_weighted_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_average.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_products) = REDUCE f( INIT s = 0.0 FOR <fs> IN it_data NEXT s = s + ( <fs>-value * <fs>-weight ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum_weights) = REDUCE f( INIT w = 0.0 FOR <fs> IN it_data NEXT w = w + <fs>-weight ).

    IF lv_sum_weights > 0.
      rv_weighted_average = lv_sum_products / lv_sum_weights.
    ELSE.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.0. " Oder Fehlerbehandlung, je nach Anforderungen
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt eines dynamisch angegebenen numerischen Feldes aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole oder Datenreferenzen mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oder `GET REFERENCE` innerhalb eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE f,
             field3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_generic_data.
    TYPES tt_generic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_generic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_generic_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_average.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0.0
      FOR <fs> IN it_data
      LET dr_field = REF #( <fs> ) IN
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE dr_field->* TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        s = s + <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
      NEXT s = s
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_data ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_filtered_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_above_threshold.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER zcl_filtered_avg=>tt_flights(
      FROM it_flights
      WHERE price > iv_threshold
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN lt_filtered_flights NEXT s = s + <fs>-price ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_xml_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_complex_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_name TYPE string
        iv_item_name TYPE string
        iv_item_value TYPE string
        iv_item_attr_name TYPE string
        iv_item_attr_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_xml_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_complex_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = iv_root_name
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
    ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_item_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = iv_item_name
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
    ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_item_node ).
    lo_item_node->set_value( iv_item_value ).
    lo_item_node->set_attribute(
      name = iv_item_attr_name
      value = iv_item_attr_value
    ).

    DATA(lo_sub_item_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'SubItem'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
    ).
    lo_item_node->append_child( lo_sub_item_node ).
    lo_sub_item_node->set_value( 'SubValue' ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und entfernen Sie einen spezifischen Knoten basierend auf seinem XPath.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xml_document`, `get_node_by_path` und `remove_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_node_remover DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_node_by_xpath
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_node_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_node_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_string( iv_xml_string ).
        DATA(lo_node_to_remove) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_xpath ).
        IF lo_node_to_remove IS BOUND.
          DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_node_to_remove->get_parent( ).
          IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
            lo_parent_node->remove_child( lo_node_to_remove ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_modified_xml ).
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.

                       ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer Schleife, die eine interne Tabelle füllt, mit Hilfe der Klasse CL_ABAP_RUNTIME.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RUNTIME=>GET_RUNTIME() vor und nach dem zu messenden Codeblock.

CLASS zcl_runtime_measurement DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_loop_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i. "Runtime in microseconds
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_measurement IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_loop_performance.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      APPEND sy-index TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_runtime_measurement( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_loop_performance( 10000 ). "Measure for 10,000 iterations

    " Assert that runtime is non-negative (it should always be)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'Runtime should be non-negative' ).
    " For a short loop, it might be very small, but for 10k iterations, it should be > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_runtime > 0 ) msg = 'Runtime should be greater than 0 for 10k iterations' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte maximale Kapazität überschreiten, und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen FOR-Ausdruck mit einer WHERE-Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... IN ... WHERE ( condition ) für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-max_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                   WHERE ( max_seats > iv_min_capacity )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                     connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_capacity( 200 ). "Example: flights with more than 200 seats

    " Assert that some flights are found (assuming SFLIGHT has data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Should find some flights' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze (OCCUP_SEATS) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität (MAX_SEATS) haben. Verwenden Sie hierfür den REDUCE-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE ... FOR ... NEXT ... IF ... für die bedingte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_conditional_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_occupied_seats) TYPE sflight-occup_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_occupied_seats = REDUCE sflight-occup_seats(
                                INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                WHERE ( max_seats >= iv_min_max_seats )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-occup_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum( 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result >= 0 ) msg = 'Sum should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum( 99999 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Should be 0 if no flights match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Die integrierte WHERE-Klausel erlaubt es, die Aggregation nur auf Elemente anzuwenden, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Conditional, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance des Füllens einer internen Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen mittels einer klassischen DO-Schleife und mittels eines modernen FOR-Ausdrucks. Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_RUNTIME für die Messung.
hint: Messen Sie beide Codeblöcke separat und vergleichen Sie die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_performance_result,
             method TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_performance_result.
    TYPES: tt_performance_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_performance_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_filling
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_performance_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_filling.
    DATA: lt_data_do TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lt_data_for TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i.

    " Measure DO loop
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      APPEND sy-index TO lt_data_do.
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    APPEND VALUE ty_performance_result( method = 'DO Loop' runtime_us = ( lv_end_time - lv_start_time ) ) TO rt_results.

    " Measure FOR expression
    CLEAR lt_data_for. " Ensure table is empty for fair comparison
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lt_data_for = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_iterations ( i ) ).
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    APPEND VALUE ty_performance_result( method = 'FOR Expression' runtime_us = ( lv_end_time - lv_start_time ) ) TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_performance_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_performance_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_runtime_comparison( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->compare_table_filling( 10000 ). "Use fewer iterations for quick test

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 results' ).

    DATA(ls_do_result) = lt_results[ method = 'DO Loop' ].
    DATA(ls_for_result) = lt_results[ method = 'FOR Expression' ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_do_result-runtime_us >= 0 ) msg = 'DO Loop runtime non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_for_result-runtime_us >= 0 ) msg = 'FOR Expression runtime non-negative' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_do_result-runtime_us > 0 ) msg = 'DO Loop runtime > 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_for_result-runtime_us > 0 ) msg = 'FOR Expression runtime > 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von CL_ABAP_RUNTIME können verschiedene Implementierungsansätze objektiv auf ihre Performance hin verglichen werden. Dies ist entscheidend für die Optimierung von ABAP-Anwendungen. Der FOR-Ausdruck ist oft, aber nicht immer, performanter als eine klassische Schleife, insbesondere bei komplexeren Transformationen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, Performance, Comparison, FOR, DO, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_value_conditional_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_conditional_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initialized_data.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit eines SELECT-Statements auf die Tabelle SFLIGHT mit Hilfe von CL_ABAP_RUNTIME.

CLASS zcl_runtime_db_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_select_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i. "Runtime in microseconds
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_db_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_select_performance.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_if_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck, um basierend auf dem Wochentag (1-7) einen deutschen Namen des Tages zurückzugeben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_weekday_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_weekday_to_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_weekday TYPE i " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_weekday_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_weekday_to_name.
    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string(
                        iv_weekday
                        WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
                        WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
                        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                        WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                        WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                        WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                        WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer sortierten Tabelle von Flugdaten unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                               iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_reduce=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 80 ) ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( it_flights = lt_initial_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( it_flights = lt_initial_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( it_flights = lt_initial_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_ua exp = 80 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen über interne Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariablen in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu formulieren, was den Code kürzer und funktionaler macht. Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb des `FOR` Ausdrucks filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen effizient.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf einen Eintrag in einer sortierten Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Schlüssel, und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke `itab[ key = value ]` in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                         iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
                                         iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
                                         iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
                               RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
                               RAISING   cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_access( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_access=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' ) ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                                  iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                                  iv_connid  = '0400'
                                                  iv_fldate  = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-planetype exp = 'A320' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_access( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_access=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' ) ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                    iv_carrid  = 'XX'
                                    iv_connid  = '0000'
                                    iv_fldate  = '20250101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found was expected.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke bieten einen direkten und prägnanten Weg, auf Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. Bei sortierten Tabellen ist dieser Zugriff besonders effizient. Wenn ein Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, löst das System die Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` aus, die mit `TRY...CATCH` behandelt werden kann.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Exception Handling, Dynamic Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die transformierte Daten (nur Flugnummer und Datum) aus einer sortierten Tabelle von Flugdaten enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit transformierten Zeilen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                          ( flight_id = |{ flight-carrid }{ flight-connid }|
                            flight_date = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft des ersten Eintrags einer sortierten Tabelle eine Region (z.B. 'Europa', 'Amerika', 'Asien') mit dem COND-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_region_for_first_flight IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_region) TYPE string
                                        RAISING   cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_region_for_first_flight.
    DATA(ls_first_flight) = it_flights[ 1 ].

    rv_region = COND string(
      WHEN ls_first_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_first_flight-carrid = 'BA' THEN 'Europa'
      WHEN ls_first_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_first_flight-carrid = 'UA' THEN 'Amerika'
      WHEN ls_first_flight-carrid = 'SQ' OR ls_first_flight-carrid = 'JL' THEN 'Asien'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS direkt in eine sortierte interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_table) ORDER BY ...` mit der Syntax für sortierte Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_from_db RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_open_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_db.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_from_db FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_from_db.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_open_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_db( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).

    " Verify sorting (assuming SFLIGHTS has data)
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      DATA(ls_prev_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_current_flight) FROM 2.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_current_flight-carrid GE ls_prev_flight-carrid ).
        IF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_prev_flight-carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_current_flight-connid GE ls_prev_flight-connid ).
          IF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_prev_flight-carrid AND ls_current_flight-connid = ls_prev_flight-connid.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_current_flight-fldate GE ls_prev_flight-fldate ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        ls_prev_flight = ls_current_flight.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können Daten direkt aus der Datenbank in eine sortierte interne Tabelle gelesen werden. Die `ORDER BY` Klausel im `SELECT` Statement stellt sicher, dass die Daten bereits sortiert sind, was die Performance beim Einfügen in eine sortierte Tabelle optimiert. Die Inline-Deklaration `INTO TABLE @rt_flights` ist eine moderne und prägnante Syntax.
keywords: SORTED, Open SQL, Internal Tables, Database Access

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag in einer sortierten Tabelle von Flugdaten existiert, ohne eine Ausnahme auszulösen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_flight_exists IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                          iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
                                          iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
                                          iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
                                RETURNING VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rb_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_line_exists=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->check_flight_exists( it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                                                   iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                                                   iv_connid  = '0400'
                                                                   iv_fldate  = '20250101' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_line_exists=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->check_flight_exists( it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                                                    iv_carrid  = 'XX'
                                                                    iv_connid  = '0000'

explanation: Die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit einem Tabellenausdruck ist der moderne und sichere Weg, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen. Im Gegensatz zum direkten Tabellenausdruck löst `LINE_EXISTS` keine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Zeile nicht gefunden wird, sondern gibt `abap_false` zurück. Dies vereinfacht die Fehlerbehandlung erheblich.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, Table Expressions

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus einer sortierten Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY ...` für die Gruppierung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                  flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group_by=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' ) ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_initial_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'UA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group_by=>tt_sflight_sorted( ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_grouped ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion ab ABAP 7.50, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Er ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... AT NEW` Konstrukte und macht den Code viel deklarativer und lesbarer. `GROUP SIZE` ist eine vordefinierte Aggregationsfunktion, die die Anzahl der Elemente in einer Gruppe zurückgibt.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdaten in eine sortierte Tabelle ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung und Eindeutigkeit des Schlüssels erhalten bleibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF` oder `VALUE #( ... FOR ... )` mit einer sortierten Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_new_flights IMPORTING it_existing_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                      it_new_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_flights.
    rt_combined_flights = it_existing_flights.
    INSERT LINES OF it_new_flights INTO TABLE rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_new_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flights FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_line_duplicate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_new_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' ) ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' ) ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->add_new_flights( it_existing_flights = lt_existing it_new_flights = lt_new ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Verify sorting
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' ) ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' ) ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->add_new_flights( it_existing_flights = lt_existing it_new_flights = lt_new ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_table_line_duplicate was expected.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_duplicate.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_table_line_duplicate for duplicate entry.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `INSERT LINES OF` ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen. Bei sortierten Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel wird die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehalten und Duplikate führen zu einer Ausnahme `cx_sy_table_line_duplicate`. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Art, Tabellen zu mergen.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, INSERT LINES OF, Duplicate Handling

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

                                            is_update  TYPE ty_sflight
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_occupancy.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.
    MODIFY TABLE rt_updated_flights FROM is_update TRANSPORTING seatsocc.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen JSON-String mit der Utility-Klasse `cl_clb_parse_json` und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes.
hint: Nehmen Sie an, `cl_clb_parse_json` hat eine Methode `parse_json`, die einen JSON-String akzeptiert und ein Objekt zurückgibt, von dem Werte extrahiert werden können. Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oder eine ähnliche Methode zur Feldextraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_name_from_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

" Mock-Implementierung für cl_clb_parse_json, da es eine benutzerdefinierte Klasse ist.
" In einem realen Szenario wäre diese Klasse bereits vorhanden.
CLASS cl_clb_parse_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS parse_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_json_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_clb_parse_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json.
    DATA: lv_xjson TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lo_json_reader TYPE REF TO cl_sxml_string_reader.
    DATA: lo_json_node TYPE REF TO if_sxml_node.
    DATA: lv_name TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Konvertiere String zu XString für Transformation
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
          EXPORTING
            text     = iv_json_string
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
          IMPORTING
            buffer   = lv_xjson.

        " Verwende iXML-Bibliothek für einfaches Parsen
        lo_json_reader = cl_sxml_string_reader=>create_from_xstring( lv_xjson ).
        lo_json_node = lo_json_reader->read_next_node( ).

        " Einfache Struktur für das Beispiel
        TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_json_data,
                 name TYPE string,
               END OF ty_json_data.
        DATA: ls_json_data TYPE ty_json_data.

        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE XML iv_json_string
          RESULT json ls_json_data.

        CREATE DATA ro_json_data LIKE ls_json_data.
        ASSIGN ls_json_data TO CAST ty_json_data( ro_json_data ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_codepage_error.
      CATCH cx_st_deserialization_error INTO DATA(lx_deserialization_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_deserialization_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_name_from_json.
    DATA: lo_json_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_name> TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_json_data = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json( iv_json_string ).

        ASSIGN lo_json_data->* TO <ls_data>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_name>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_name = <lv_name>.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_field_not_found.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid
            previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung einer angenommenen Utility-Klasse `cl_clb_parse_json` zum Parsen eines einfachen JSON-Strings. Die Extraktion des Feldwertes erfolgt dynamisch über Field-Symbols, was Flexibilität bietet. Die `cl_clb_json_error` ist eine angenommene Ausnahme für JSON-Fehler. Die Mock-Implementierung von `cl_clb_parse_json` verwendet `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` für die eigentliche Deserialisierung, da dies der Standardweg in modernem ABAP ist, wenn keine spezielle Parser-Klasse zur Verfügung steht.
keywords: JSON, cl_clb_parse_json, parse, Field-Symbols, Dynamic Programming

hint: Verwenden Sie einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block um die Ausnahme abzufangen, die von `cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json` ausgelöst wird (z.B. `cx_clb_json_error`).

CLASS zcl_json_parse_error_hndl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string

" Annahme: cx_clb_json_error ist eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme-Klasse.
" Für dieses Beispiel wird eine einfache Definition bereitgestellt.
CLASS cx_clb_json_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF json_parse_error,
                 msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG_CLB_JSON',
                 msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '001',
                 attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'TEXTID',
                 attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'PREVIOUS',
                 attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'MSGV1',
                 attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'MSGV2',
               END OF json_parse_error.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF json_field_not_found,
                 msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG_CLB_JSON',
                 msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '002',
                 attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'TEXTID',
                 attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'PREVIOUS',
                 attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'MSGV1',
                 attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'MSGV2',
               END OF json_field_not_found.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        !textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        !previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        !msgv1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
        !msgv2 TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_clb_json_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->msgv1 = msgv1.
    me->msgv2 = msgv2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_error_hndl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lo_json_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_name> TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_json_data = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json( iv_json_string ).

        ASSIGN lo_json_data->* TO <ls_data>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_name>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = <lv_name>.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Fehler: Feld "name" nicht gefunden.'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler beim Parsen des JSON-Strings: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_multi_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_item_from_json.
    DATA: lo_json_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_data> TYPE ty_item.

    TRY.
        lo_json_data = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json( iv_json_string ).

        CREATE DATA rs_item.
        ASSIGN rs_item TO <ls_data>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error.
        ENDIF.

        " Da cl_clb_parse_json in der Mock-Implementierung bereits in ty_json_data parst,
        " können wir hier direkt zuweisen, wenn die Struktur passt.
        " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier ggf. dynamisch mappen oder casten.
        ASSIGN lo_json_data->* TO <ls_data>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid
            previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_clb_parse_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json.
    DATA: lv_xjson TYPE xstring.

    " Für dieses Beispiel wird eine generische Struktur verwendet, die verschachtelte Objekte und Arrays simulieren kann.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_dyn,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_dyn.
    TYPES: tt_items_dyn TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_dyn WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_dyn,
             items TYPE tt_items_dyn,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_dyn.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_root_dyn,
             data TYPE ty_data_dyn,
           END OF ty_root_dyn.

    DATA: ls_root_dyn TYPE ty_root_dyn.

    TRY.
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
          EXPORTING
            text     = iv_json_string
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
          IMPORTING
            buffer   = lv_xjson.

        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE XML iv_json_string
          RESULT json ls_root_dyn.

        CREATE DATA ro_json_data LIKE ls_root_dyn.
        ASSIGN ls_root_dyn TO CAST ty_root_dyn( ro_json_data ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_codepage_error.
      CATCH cx_st_deserialization_error INTO DATA(lx_deserialization_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_deserialization_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_by_path.
    DATA: lo_json_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_current_node> TYPE any.
    DATA: lt_path_segments TYPE string_table.
    DATA: lv_segment TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_component_name TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_json_data = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json( iv_json_string ).
        ASSIGN lo_json_data->* TO <fs_current_node>.

        SPLIT iv_path AT '/' INTO TABLE lt_path_segments.

        LOOP AT lt_path_segments INTO lv_segment.
          IF lv_segment IS INITIAL.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

          IF lv_segment CA '['.
            " Array-Zugriff
            DATA(lv_array_name) = lv_segment( sy-fdpos ).
            DATA(lv_index_str) = lv_segment+sy-fdpos+1( strlen( lv_segment ) - sy-fdpos - 2 ).
            lv_index = lv_index_str.

            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_array_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_current_node> TO <fs_current_node>.
            IF sy-subrc <> 0.
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_field_not_found msgv1 = lv_segment.
            ENDIF.

            " Zugriff auf Array-Element
            ASSIGN <fs_current_node>[ lv_index ] TO <fs_current_node>.
            IF sy-subrc <> 0.
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_field_not_found msgv1 = lv_segment.
            ENDIF.

          ELSE.
            " Objekt-Zugriff
            lv_component_name = lv_segment.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_current_node> TO <fs_current_node>.
            IF sy-subrc <> 0.
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_field_not_found msgv1 = lv_segment.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_value = <fs_current_node>.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid
            previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_loop_throw IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data_table.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` mit der Option `SOURCE ABAP` und `RESULT XML` (oder `RESULT JSON` für direkte JSON-Ausgabe, wenn verfügbar und konfiguriert).
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_data,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product_data.

    METHODS serialize_product_to_json
      IMPORTING
        is_product TYPE ty_product_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_product_to_json.
    DATA: lv_xjson TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE product = is_product
          RESULT XML lv_xjson.

        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
          EXPORTING
            buffer        = lv_xjson
            encoding      = 'UTF-8'
          IMPORTING
            text          = rv_json_string
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS        = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error msgv1 = 'XString to String conversion failed'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid
            previous = lx_json_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_transformation_error INTO DATA(lx_trans_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_trans_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String mit `cl_clb_parse_json`, der ein Array von Zahlen enthält, filtern Sie diese Zahlen (z.B. nur gerade Zahlen) und summieren Sie die gefilterten Zahlen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nach dem Parsen des JSON-Arrays in eine interne Tabelle, verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die gewünschten Elemente auszuwählen und `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numbers_root,
             numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_numbers_root.

    METHODS process_json_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_even) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

" Angepasste Mock-Implementierung für cl_clb_parse_json, um eine generischere Struktur zu unterstützen.
" In einem realen Szenario würde diese Klasse bereits vorhanden sein und dies handhaben.
CLASS cl_clb_parse_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS parse_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_json_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_clb_parse_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json.
    DATA: lv_xjson TYPE xstring.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numbers_root_local,
             numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_numbers_root_local.
    DATA: ls_numbers_root_local TYPE ty_numbers_root_local.

    TRY.
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
          EXPORTING
            text     = iv_json_string
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
          IMPORTING
            buffer   = lv_xjson.

        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE XML iv_json_string
          RESULT json ls_numbers_root_local.

        CREATE DATA ro_json_data LIKE ls_numbers_root_local.
        ASSIGN ls_numbers_root_local TO CAST ty_numbers_root_local( ro_json_data ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_codepage_error.
      CATCH cx_st_deserialization_error INTO DATA(lx_deserialization_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error
            previous = lx_deserialization_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_json_numbers.
    DATA: lo_json_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_numbers_root> TYPE ty_numbers_root.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TRY.
        lo_json_data = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse_json( iv_json_string ).
        ASSIGN lo_json_data->* TO <ls_numbers_root>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error EXPORTING textid = cx_clb_json_error=>json_parse_error.
        ENDIF.

        lt_numbers = <ls_numbers_root>-numbers.

        " Filtern und Summieren mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxen
        rv_sum_even = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR num IN FILTER #( lt_numbers WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + num ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_clb_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid
            previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Inline-Deklaration und füllen Sie diese mit Daten unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(...) = VALUE ... ( FOR ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city TYPE s_from_cit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_city.
    " Simulierte Daten für sflights
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEWYORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEWYORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' cityfrom = 'NEWYORK' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' cityfrom = 'LONDON' cityto = 'NEWYORK' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).

    " Filtern mit FOR-Ausdruck
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_city )
      ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Services), um die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und deren Werte auszulesen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_structure_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
             city TYPE string,
           END OF ty_person.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_structure_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components ( ls_comp-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_component_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    ls_person-name = 'John Doe'.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( ls_person ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 msg = 'Sollte 3 Komponenten finden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'NAME' msg = 'Erste Komponente sollte NAME sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_structure_info( ).
    DATA(ls_person) TYPE zcl_rtti_structure_info=>ty_person.
    ls_person-name = 'Jane Doe'.
    ls_person-age = 25.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Jane Doe' msg = 'Wert von NAME sollte korrekt sein' ).

    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->get_component_value( ir_data = REF #( ls_person ) iv_component = 'AGE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = '25' msg = 'Wert von AGE sollte korrekt sein' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Services) in ABAP. Mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` kann die Typbeschreibung einer Datenreferenz zur Laufzeit ermittelt werden. `get_components` liefert eine Liste der Strukturkomponenten. Der Zugriff auf die Werte der Komponenten erfolgt dynamisch über Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr

CLASS zcl_json_parser_error IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten (z.B. eine Liste von Produkten mit ID und Name) enthält. Konvertieren Sie dieses Array in eine ABAP-interne Tabelle, wobei Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte wie `FOR` verwenden, um die Daten zu mappen.
hint: Iterieren Sie über das JSON-Array mit `cl_clb_parse_json=>get_array_size()` und `get_object()`, und verwenden Sie dann `FOR` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_obj_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product,
           ty_products_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_product_array
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products) TYPE ty_products_tt
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_obj_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_product_array.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_clb_parse_json=>create( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lv_array_size) = lo_json_parser->get_array_size( '/' ).

    rt_products = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= lv_array_size
      LET lo_product_node = lo_json_parser->get_object( |/[{ i }]| ) IN
      ( id   = lo_product_node->get_string( '/id' )
        name = lo_product_node->get_string( '/name' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[1]-id   exp = 'P001' msg = 'First product ID should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[1]-name exp = 'Laptop' msg = 'First product name should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[3]-name exp = 'Keyboard' msg = 'Last product name should match' ).

Die `LET`-Anweisung innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks verbessert die Lesbarkeit, indem sie temporäre Variablen für die JSON-Objekt-Nodes definiert.     " Für GUI-Controls ist ein direkter Unit-Test der visuellen Darstellung nicht möglich.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (z.B. aus `sflights`) vor und stellen Sie sich vor, diese Daten in den 3D-Viewer zu laden, um Flugrouten oder -objekte darzustellen. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR` für die Transformation der Daten in ein Format, das der Viewer verarbeiten könnte.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_data_load DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS load_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_viewer_data) TYPE string_table. " Simplified: returns string table for viewer
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_data_load IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_flight_data.
    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS und SPFLI mit moderner Syntax lesen
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE s~fldate BETWEEN @sy-datum AND @( sy-datum + 30 )
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    " Daten für den Viewer aufbereiten (vereinfacht als String-Tabelle)
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier eine spezifische API des Viewers genutzt
    " z.B. mo_3d_viewer->add_object( ... )
    rt_viewer_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                               ( |Flight { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }: { ls_flight-cityfrom } to { ls_flight-cityto } on { ls_flight-fldate }| ) ).

    " Hier würde die tatsächliche Übergabe an den 3D-Viewer erfolgen
    " mo_3d_viewer->load_data( i_data = ... ). " Beispielhafte Methode
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den 3D-Viewer dynamisch aktualisiert, indem sie die Farbe eines Objekts basierend auf einem externen Status ändert. (Hinweis: Dies ist ein konzeptionelles Beispiel).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Methode wie `set_object_property` (hypothetisch) des Viewers und moderne ABAP-Logik für die Statusprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS update_object_color
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id TYPE string
        iv_status    TYPE c LENGTH 1. " 'G' for Green, 'R' for Red
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_object_color.
    DATA(lv_color) = SWITCH string(
      iv_status
      WHEN 'G' THEN 'GREEN'
      WHEN 'R' THEN 'RED'
      ELSE 'BLUE' " Default-Farbe
    ).

    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier eine Methode des 3D-Viewers aufgerufen werden,
    " um die Farbe eines Objekts zu ändern. Beispielhaft:
    " mo_3d_viewer->set_object_property(
    "   i_object_id = iv_object_id,
    "   i_property  = 'COLOR',
    "   i_value     = lv_color
    " ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Object '{ iv_object_id }' color set to '{ lv_color }' based on status '{ iv_status }'.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die JSON-Parsing-Fähigkeiten mit dem 3D-Viewer: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der 3D-Objektdefinitionen (ID, Position, Farbe) enthält, und bereiten Sie diese Daten für die Anzeige im 3D-Viewer vor. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte für beide Schritte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` für das Parsing und `FOR` für die Transformation der geparsten Daten in ein Viewer-spezifisches Format.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_json_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_def,
             id       TYPE string,
             position TYPE string, " z.B. 'X,Y,Z'
             color    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_3d_object_def,
           ty_3d_objects_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_3d_object_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS load_3d_objects_from_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_viewer_commands) TYPE string_table " Vereinfacht: Liste von Befehlen
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_json_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_3d_objects_from_json.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_clb_parse_json=>create( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lv_array_size) = lo_json_parser->get_array_size( '/' ).

    DATA(lt_object_defs) = VALUE ty_3d_objects_tt(
      FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= lv_array_size
      LET lo_obj_node = lo_json_parser->get_object( |/[{ i }]| ) IN
      ( id       = lo_obj_node->get_string( '/id' )
        position = lo_obj_node->get_string( '/position' )
        color    = lo_obj_node->get_string( '/color' ) )
    ).

    " Transformation in Viewer-spezifische Befehle (vereinfacht)
    rt_viewer_commands = VALUE #( FOR ls_obj IN lt_object_defs
                                  ( |ADD_OBJECT ID={ ls_obj-id } POS={ ls_obj-position } COLOR={ ls_obj-color }| ) ).

    " Hier würde die tatsächliche Übergabe an den 3D-Viewer erfolgen
    " mo_3d_viewer->add_objects( i_commands = rt_viewer_commands ). " Beispielhafte Methode
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_load_objects_from_json.
    DATA lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_json_integration( io_container = lo_mock_container ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[
          {"id": "Cube1", "position": "10,20,30", "color": "Red"},
          {"id": "Sphere2", "position": "-5,0,15", "color": "Blue"}
        ]`.
    DATA(lt_commands) = lo_cut->load_3d_objects_from_json( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_commands ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should generate 2 commands' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'ID=Cube1' in = lt_commands[1] msg = 'First command should contain Cube1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'COLOR=Blue' in = lt_commands[2] msg = 'Second command should contain Blue' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_json_array.
    DATA lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_json_integration( io_container = lo_mock_container ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[]`.
    DATA(lt_commands) = lo_cut->load_3d_objects_from_json( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_commands msg = 'Should return empty commands for empty array' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es nutzt `cl_clb_parse_json` und den `FOR`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.55+) zur effizienten Extraktion und Transformation von strukturierten 3D-Objektdefinitionen aus einem JSON-String in ein Format, das vom 3D-Viewer verarbeitet werden kann. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hilfsklasse, die die Initialisierung des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` kapselt und eine Methode zur Freigabe des Controls bereitstellt, um Ressourcen sauber zu verwalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `constructor` für die Initialisierung und eine `cleanup`-Methode mit `FREE OBJECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS get_viewer
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_viewer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
    METHODS cleanup.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_viewer.
    ro_viewer = mo_3d_viewer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup.
    IF mo_3d_viewer IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_3d_viewer->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
      ENDIF.
      FREE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
      ENDIF.
      FREE OBJECT mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_viewer_lifecycle FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_viewer_lifecycle.
    DATA lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_container.

    DATA(lo_helper) = NEW zcl_3d_viewer_helper( io_container = lo_mock_container ).
    DATA(lo_viewer) = lo_helper->get_viewer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_viewer msg = 'Viewer should be bound after creation' ).

    lo_helper->cleanup( ).

    " Nach dem Cleanup sollten die Objekte nicht mehr gebunden sein.
    " Direkte Prüfung auf UNBOUND ist bei GUI-Controls schwierig, da FREE nur die Referenz löscht,
    " aber nicht unbedingt den Objektzustand sofort ändert. Man würde eher auf keine Dumps prüfen.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Cleanup should execute without error' ).
    CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception during cleanup' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Hilfsklasse kapselt die Lebenszyklusverwaltung des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` und des `cl_gui_custom_container`. Der Konstruktor initialisiert die Controls, während die `cleanup`-Methode für die ordnungsgemäße Freigabe der GUI-Ressourcen mittels `FREE` und `FREE OBJECT` sorgt. Dies ist eine Best Practice für die Arbeit mit GUI-Controls, um Speicherlecks und Systemressourcenprobleme zu vermeiden.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.

    mo_container = io_container.

  METHOD initialize_viewer_conditionally.
    IF iv_enable_3d = abap_true.
      IF mo_3d_viewer IS NOT BOUND.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
        cl_demo_output=>display( '3D Viewer initialisiert.' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_demo_output=>display( '3D Viewer bereits initialisiert.' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>display( '3D Viewer Initialisierung übersprungen.' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von 3D-Objektdefinitionen basierend auf einem Kriterium (z.B. nur Objekte einer bestimmten Farbe) und bereiten Sie die gefilterten Daten für den 3D-Viewer vor. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um die interne Tabelle zu reduzieren, bevor Sie die Daten für den Viewer aufbereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_def,
             id       TYPE string,
             position TYPE string,
             color    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_3d_object_def,
           ty_3d_objects_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_3d_object_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS filter_and_prepare_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_all_objects TYPE ty_3d_objects_tt
        iv_filter_color TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_viewer_commands) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_and_prepare_objects.
    DATA(lt_filtered_objects) = FILTER ty_3d_objects_tt(
      it_all_objects
      WHERE color = iv_filter_color
    ).

    rt_viewer_commands = VALUE #( FOR ls_obj IN lt_filtered_objects
                                  ( |ADD_OBJECT ID={ ls_obj-id } POS={ ls_obj-position } COLOR={ ls_obj-color }| ) ).

    " Hier würde die tatsächliche Übergabe an den 3D-Viewer erfolgen
    " mo_3d_viewer->update_objects( i_commands = rt_viewer_commands ). " Beispielhafte Methode
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check count for LH' act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 400 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
