explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Daten. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Der `VALUE` Operator wird hier verwendet, um die Ergebnisstruktur direkt zu füllen.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, GROUP SIZE, VALUE, sflights, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechne den Gesamtumsatz (Summe des Preises) pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_revenue,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_revenue TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_revenue.
    TYPES tt_carrier_revenue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_revenue WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_revenues RETURNING VALUE(rt_revenues) TYPE tt_carrier_revenue.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_revenues.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = SUM OF ls_sflight-price.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      total_revenue = lv_sum_price ) TO rt_revenues.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: GROUP BY, SUM OF, sflights, Aggregation, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_fldates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dates,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_date WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_dates.
    TYPES tt_flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_dates WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_dates RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_dates) TYPE tt_flight_dates.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_fldates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_dates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ls_sflight-connid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      connid = ls_sflight-connid
                      flight_dates = VALUE #( FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP
                                              ( <fs_member>-fldate ) ) ) TO rt_grouped_dates.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit Zahlen und gruppiere diese nach geraden/ungeraden Werten. Gib für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Elemente (`GROUP SIZE`) und den Gruppenindex (`GROUP INDEX`) aus.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY ( ... GROUP SIZE size GROUP INDEX index )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_group_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_info,
             group_key TYPE string,
             group_size TYPE i,
             group_index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_info.
    TYPES tt_group_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_number_group_info RETURNING VALUE(rt_group_info) TYPE tt_group_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_group_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_number_group_info.
    DATA lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number) GROUP BY ( key = COND string( WHEN lv_number MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'Even' ELSE 'Odd' ) GROUP SIZE lv_size GROUP INDEX lv_index ).
      APPEND VALUE #( group_key = lv_number-key
                      group_size = lv_size
                      group_index = lv_index ) TO rt_group_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_number_group_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_number_group_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_group_info( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_number_group_info( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of groups should be 2' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_even_group) = lt_result[ group_key = 'Even' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Even group size should be 3' act = ls_even_group-group_size exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_odd_group) = lt_result[ group_key = 'Odd' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Odd group size should be 3' act = ls_odd_group-group_size exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `GROUP SIZE` und `GROUP INDEX` direkt im `GROUP BY` Ausdruck. Der Gruppierungsschlüssel wird dynamisch mit einem `COND` Ausdruck bestimmt. Dies erlaubt eine flexible und informative Gruppierung, bei der Metadaten über die Gruppen direkt während der Iteration verfügbar sind.
keywords: GROUP BY, GROUP SIZE, GROUP INDEX, COND, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft und dann innerhalb jeder Fluggesellschaft nach Verbindungsnummer. Zähle die Flüge pro Untergruppe.
hint: Verwende verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Schleifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_nested_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_count,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_connection_count.
    TYPES tt_connection_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connections,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connections TYPE tt_connection_count,
           END OF ty_carrier_connections.
    TYPES tt_carrier_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_nested_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_nested_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA ls_carrier_connections TYPE ty_carrier_connections.
      ls_carrier_connections-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_group_member) GROUP BY ls_group_member-connid.
        APPEND VALUE #( connid = ls_group_member-connid
                        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO ls_carrier_connections-connections.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_carrier_connections TO rt_nested_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_nested_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_nested_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_nested_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flights) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH connections should not be empty' act = lines( ls_lh_flights-connections ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).

    DATA(ls_lh_0400) = ls_lh_flights-connections[ connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check count for LH 0400' act = ls_lh_0400-flight_count exp = 100 ). " Example value, adjust based on actual sflights data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Schleifen ermöglichen komplexe Gruppierungen. Die innere Schleife `LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight` iteriert über die Elemente der aktuellen äußeren Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr flexible Methode, um hierarchische Datenstrukturen zu verarbeiten und zu aggregieren.
keywords: GROUP BY, Nested Loop, sflights, Internal Tables, Hierarchical Data

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `VALUE` mit einem `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR lv_num IN it_numbers
                       NEXT sum = sum + lv_num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere die Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und erstelle für jede Gruppe eine Liste der Flugverbindungen (`connid`), die nur eindeutige Werte enthält. Verwende `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `FOR` für die eindeutigen Verbindungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_unique_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connections,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             unique_connids TYPE tt_connid,
           END OF ty_carrier_connections.
    TYPES tt_carrier_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_connections_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_unique_conn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connections_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lt_unique_connids) = REDUCE tt_connid(
        INIT unique_list = VALUE tt_connid( )
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP
        WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL )
        NEXT unique_list = VALUE tt_connid( BASE unique_list ( <fs_member>-connid ) )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      unique_connids = lt_unique_connids ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_unique_conn( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_connections_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).

    DATA(ls_lh_data) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH unique connections should not be empty' act = lines( ls_lh_data-unique_connids ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check unique connections count for LH' act = lines( ls_lh_data-unique_connids ) exp = 4 ). " Assuming LH has 4 unique connections in sflights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check first unique connection for LH' act = ls_lh_data-unique_connids[ 1 ] exp = '0400' ). " Example, adjust if needed
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Liste eindeutiger Verbindungsnummern pro Fluggesellschaft zu erstellen. Der `REDUCE` Operator iteriert über die Elemente der aktuellen Gruppe (`FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP`) und baut eine neue interne Tabelle (`unique_list`) auf, wobei `VALUE #( BASE ... )` verwendet wird, um Duplikate zu vermeiden, da `tt_connid` als `UNIQUE SORTED KEY` definiert ist. Dies ist eine sehr fortgeschrittene und effiziente funktionale Programmierung.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, FOR IN GROUP, VALUE, UNIQUE SORTED KEY, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jeden Flug in `SFLIGHTS`, ob er "Verfügbar", "Ausgebucht" oder "Geringe Verfügbarkeit" hat, basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Plätze. Die Klassifizierung soll direkt in der Datenbankabfrage erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit einem `CASE WHEN` Ausdruck im Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'Ausgebucht'
                WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Geringe Verfügbarkeit'
                ELSE 'Verfügbar'
           END AS status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer bestehenden Tabelle von Flugdaten. Die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`) soll dabei in Kategorien ('Small', 'Medium', 'Large') umgewandelt werden. Wenn `seatsmax` kleiner als 100 ist, soll 'Small', zwischen 100 und 300 'Medium', und über 300 'Large' zugewiesen werden. Ungültige Werte sollen 'Unknown' erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `COND WHEN` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             capacity_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS categorize_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_capacity.
    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      ( carrid          = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid          = ls_flight-connid
                                        capacity_category = COND string(
                                                              WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax < 100 THEN 'Small'
                                                              WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax >= 100 AND ls_flight-seatsmax <= 300 THEN 'Medium'
                                                              WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 300 THEN 'Large'
                                                              ELSE 'Unknown' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_categorize_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorize_capacity.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_value_for_when=>tt_flight_data,
          ls_flight LIKE LINE OF lt_test_flights.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '001'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 50. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '002'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 200. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '003'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 400. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_flight-connid = '004'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 0. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_value_for_when( ).
    DATA(lt_categorized) = lo_transformer->categorize_capacity( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 1 ]-capacity_category exp = 'Small' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 2 ]-capacity_category exp = 'Medium' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 3 ]-capacity_category exp = 'Large' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_categorized[ 4 ]-capacity_category exp = 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `COND WHEN` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und gut lesbarem Code, der die Datenflusslogik klar darstellt.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHEN, COND, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Top 5 der Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` mit den meisten freien Plätzen. Die Flüge sollen absteigend nach der Anzahl der freien Plätze sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_top_n_flights_by_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_by_free_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax,
           ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) AS seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      ORDER BY seatsfree DESC, carrid, connid, fldate
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n.
    DATA(lo_top_n) = NEW zcl_flight_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_top_n->get_top_n_flights_by_free_seats( iv_top_n = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob der erste Flug mindestens so viele freie Plätze hat wie der zweite
    IF lines( lt_flights ) >= 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[ 1 ]-seatsfree >= lt_flights[ 2 ]-seatsfree ).
    ENDIF.
    " Überprüfen, ob der zweite Flug mindestens so viele freie Plätze hat wie der dritte
    IF lines( lt_flights ) >= 3.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[ 2 ]-seatsfree >= lt_flights[ 3 ]-seatsfree ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung ist die effizienteste Methode, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von sortierten Datensätzen direkt von der Datenbank abzurufen. Dies vermeidet das Lesen und Sortieren großer Datenmengen im Anwendungsserver.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, Database, Performance

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Passagierkapazität (`seatsmax`) für Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Wenn keine solchen Flüge existieren, soll die Summe 0 sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_for_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_simple,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_simple.
    TYPES tt_flight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity_above_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_simple
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_for_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity_above_threshold.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  WHERE ( seatsmax > iv_threshold )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_capacity.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_for_when=>tt_flight_simple,
          ls_flight LIKE LINE OF lt_test_flights.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 150. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 250. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 80. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_reduce_for_when( ).

    " Testfall: Threshold 100 (80 wird ignoriert)
    DATA(lv_total_100) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_capacity_above_threshold( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_threshold = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_100 exp = 400 ). " 150 + 250

    " Testfall: Threshold 300 (alle werden ignoriert)
    DATA(lv_total_300) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_capacity_above_threshold( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_threshold = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_300 exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` kann man gezielt über Teilmengen der Tabelle iterieren und Werte bedingt akkumulieren, was zu sehr effizientem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage auf `SFLIGHTS` aus, bei der die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit aus einer internen Tabelle von Bedingungen konstruiert wird, um Flüge basierend auf variablen Kriterien zu filtern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `WHERE (cond_tab)` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_whitelist_for_sql` für die Sicherheit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_conditions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    " Sicherheitsprüfung der dynamischen WHERE-Klausel (ab ABAP 7.55 empfohlen)
    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_whitelist_for_sql(
      i_sql_source = it_conditions
      i_db_table   = 'SFLIGHT' ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE (it_conditions)
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lo_dyn_select) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA: lt_conditions TYPE string_table.

    " Gültige Bedingung
    APPEND `CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID = '0400'` TO lt_conditions.
    DATA(lt_flights_lh) = lo_dyn_select->get_flights_dynamic( lt_conditions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_lh ) exp = 1 ).

    CLEAR lt_conditions.
    " Andere gültige Bedingung
    APPEND `CARRID = 'AA'` TO lt_conditions.
    DATA(lt_flights_aa) = lo_dyn_select->get_flights_dynamic( lt_conditions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_aa ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_select_invalid.
    DATA(lo_dyn_select) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA: lt_conditions TYPE string_table.

    " Ungültige Bedingung (versucht, eine nicht-existierende Spalte zu verwenden)
    APPEND `NON_EXISTENT_FIELD = 'X'` TO lt_conditions.
    TRY.
        lo_dyn_select->get_flights_dynamic( lt_conditions ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_dyn_prg_error for invalid condition' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Erwarteter Fehler aufgetreten
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische `SELECT`-Anweisungen mit `WHERE (cond_tab)` ermöglichen es, die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit flexibel zu gestalten. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Berichte oder Suchfunktionen. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_whitelist_for_sql` ab ABAP 7.55 ist entscheidend für die Sicherheit, um SQL-Injections zu verhindern.
keywords: SELECT, Dynamic SQL, WHERE, RTTI, Sicherheit, cx_abap_dyn_prg_error

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Typ eines übergebenen Objekts (z.B. einer Schnittstelle) unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt. Wenn das Objekt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert, soll eine spezifische Methode dieser Schnittstelle aufgerufen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF` für die Typprüfung von Objekten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_actionable.
  METHODS execute_action.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~execute_action.
    " Aktion für Typ A
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Action A executed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~execute_action.
    " Aktion für Typ B
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Action B executed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_object
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_object.
    CASE TYPE OF io_object.
      WHEN TYPE zif_actionable INTO DATA(lo_actionable).
        lo_actionable->execute_action( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( 'Unknown object type' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_object.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_object_processor( ).

    " Test mit Objekt vom Typ A
    DATA(lo_action_a) = NEW zcl_action_a( ).
    lo_processor->process_object( lo_action_a ).
    " Hier müsste man cl_demo_output abfangen, um den Output zu prüfen.
    " Für diesen Demo-Zweck wird nur der Aufruf getestet.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Einfacher Test, dass kein Dump auftritt

    " Test mit Objekt vom Typ B
    DATA(lo_action_b) = NEW zcl_action_b( ).
    lo_processor->process_object( lo_action_b ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).

    " Test mit unbekanntem Objekttyp
    DATA(lo_unknown) = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ).
    lo_processor->process_object( lo_unknown ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ist ein mächtiges Sprachkonstrukt für die objektorientierte Programmierung, das eine saubere und erweiterbare Möglichkeit bietet, Polymorphie zu handhaben. Es erlaubt die Typprüfung von Objektreferenzen und den Zugriff auf typspezifische Komponenten, ohne auf veraltete `IF TYPE OF` oder `CAST`-Anweisungen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, WHEN, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Interfaces

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS`, deren Flugdatum (`FLDATE`) in der Zukunft liegt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE fldate > @sy-datum

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_future_flights) = NEW zcl_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_future_flights->get_future_flights( ).

    " Es ist unwahrscheinlich, dass in SFLIGHTs viele zukünftige Flüge sind, daher prüfen wir auf Initial.
    " Für einen aussagekräftigeren Test müsste man Testdaten mit zukünftigen Daten einfügen.
    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate > sy-datum ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft nicht 'LH' ist, soll ein Standardwert für die Fluggesellschaft gesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit `WHERE` und `COND WHEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_cond_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_target_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_cond_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_target_carrid ).

    " Beispiel für COND WHEN in einer Schleife nach dem Filtern, um den 'Standardwert' zu setzen
    LOOP AT rt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-carrid = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-carrid <> iv_target_carrid THEN 'DEFAULT' ELSE <fs_flight>-carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_cond_when=>tt_flight_data,
          ls_flight LIKE LINE OF lt_test_flights.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = '20230101'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. ls_flight-fldate = '20230102'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. ls_flight-fldate = '20230103'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_filter_cond_when( ).

    " Filter nach 'LH'
    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_target_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_lh[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_lh[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Filter nach 'AA'
    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_target_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_aa ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_aa[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In Kombination mit `COND WHEN` innerhalb einer nachfolgenden Schleife kann man die gefilterten Daten zusätzlich transformieren oder Standardwerte setzen, was zu einem sehr ausdrucksstarken und modernen ABAP-Code führt.
keywords: FILTER, WHERE, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` und die zugehörigen Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus `SCARR` in einer einzigen `SELECT`-Anweisung. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INNER JOIN` und der Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Flugstatus (z.B. 'C' für Cancelled, 'D' für Delayed, 'O' für On-Time) in einen lesbaren Text umwandelt. Wenn der Status unbekannt ist, soll 'Status unbekannt' zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` mit `WHEN` für die Statusumwandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string( iv_status_code
                               WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
                               WHEN 'D' THEN 'Delayed'
                               WHEN 'O' THEN 'On-Time'
                               ELSE 'Status unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_status_text) = NEW zcl_flight_status_text( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_text->get_status_text( 'C' ) exp = 'Cancelled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_text->get_status_text( 'D' ) exp = 'Delayed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_text->get_status_text( 'O' ) exp = 'On-Time' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_text->get_status_text( 'X' ) exp = 'Status unbekannt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_text->get_status_text( '' ) exp = 'Status unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `SWITCH` Ausdruck ist ideal für die Umwandlung von Codes in beschreibende Texte. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu langen `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Ketten oder `CASE`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN, String Processing, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 10 Einträgen aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT, sortiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted_by_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight_raw ( <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 10 entries' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 ).

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          cond = ( ls_flight-carrid > lv_prev_carrid OR ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid > lv_prev_connid ) )
          msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die sortierte interne Tabelle `tt_sflight_sorted_by_key` wird mit `TYPES` definiert, was eine compile-time Sortierung und effiziente Schlüsselzugriffe ermöglicht. Die Füllung erfolgt modern mit einem `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Ausdruck, der die Daten direkt in die sortierte Tabelle kopiert und dabei die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehält.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer sortierten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted_by_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_carrier_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN mt_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      " Die Sortierung der Quelltabelle (SORTED TABLE) kann die Performance von GROUP BY verbessern.
      ( carrid = GROUP carrid, count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit, einschließlich des Zeilentyps und der Schlüsseldefinitionen.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_table_info,
             table_kind TYPE string,
             line_type_kind TYPE string,
             key_components TYPE string_table,
           END OF ty_table_info.

    METHODS get_table_description
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_table_info) TYPE ty_table_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_description.
    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_typedescr) = lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ).

    rs_table_info-table_kind = lo_tabledescr->table_kind.
    rs_table_info-line_type_kind = lo_line_typedescr->type_kind.

    DATA(lt_key_components) = lo_tabledescr->get_keys( cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_kind_primary ).
    LOOP AT lt_key_components INTO DATA(ls_key_comp).
      APPEND ls_key_comp-name TO rs_table_info-key_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_flight_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_typedescr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Komponenten (Felder) einer gegebenen Struktur zur Laufzeit und deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( )` und `get_components( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_structdescr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
                                 LET lo_comp_type = ls_comp-type->get_type_kind( )
                                     lv_length = ls_comp-type->length
                                 IN ( name = ls_comp-name,
                                      type_kind = lo_comp_type,
                                      length = lv_length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted_by_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key.
    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight.
    rt_updated_flights = mt_flights.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE rt_updated_flights.
    " sy-subrc = 0 bei Erfolg, 4 bei Duplikat (UNIQUE KEY)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted_by_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( it_flights = lt_initial_flights ).
    DATA(ls_duplicate_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' ).

    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->add_flight( ls_duplicate_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should remain 1' act = lines( lt_updated_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'sy-subrc should be 4 for duplicate' act = sy-subrc exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...` ist die Standardmethode zum Hinzufügen von Zeilen zu internen Tabellen. Bei `SORTED TABLE`s wird der neue Eintrag automatisch an der korrekten Position eingefügt, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Bei Tabellen mit `UNIQUE KEY` wird `sy-subrc = 4` gesetzt, wenn ein Duplikat versucht wird einzufügen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, Internal Tables, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem zur Laufzeit definierten Zeilentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create( )`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( )` und Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        it_data_rows         TYPE string_table " Each string is a comma-separated row
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_tabledescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'C'. lo_typedescr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( ls_field_def-length ).
        WHEN 'I'. lo_typedescr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN 'D'. lo_typedescr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
        WHEN OTHERS. CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_def-name
        type = lo_typedescr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_structdescr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_tabledescr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_structdescr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <fs_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_structdescr.

    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_row_string).
      DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( ).
      SPLIT lv_row_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_values.

      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
        DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
        IF lv_index <= lines( lt_values ).
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_field> = lt_values[ lv_index ].
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,

           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

      ( name = 'ID' type = 'I' )
      ( name = 'TEXT' type = 'C' length = 20 )
      ( name = 'DATE' type = 'D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_data_rows) = VALUE string_table(
      ( '1,First Entry,20230101' )
      ( '2,Second Entry,20230102' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs it_data_rows = lt_data_rows ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 rows' act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene dynamische Tabellenerstellung mit RTTI. `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` wird verwendet, um einen Zeilentyp aus einer Liste von Felddefinitionen zu erstellen. Anschließend wird `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` genutzt, um einen Tabellentyp zu definieren. Mit `CREATE DATA ... TYPE HANDLE ...` wird die Tabelle dynamisch instanziiert und über Feld-Symbole gefüllt. Dies ist entscheidend für Szenarien, in denen die Datenstruktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von externen Schnittstellen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, create, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Namen einer Klasse oder Schnittstelle zur Laufzeit von einem Objekt.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Objekt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object( )` und `get_interfaces( )` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zif_my_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS my_method.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_implements_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_my_interface.
    METHODS check_interface_implementation
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rb_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_implements_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_my_interface~my_method.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_interface_implementation.
    DATA(lo_objectdescr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
    DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_objectdescr->get_interfaces( ).

    rb_implements = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_interfaces[ name = iv_interface_name ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Object should implement ZIF_MY_INTERFACE' act = lb_implements ).

Instructions: Ersetze alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem Text mit einem neuen Wert unter Verwendung von String Templates.
hint: Nutze String Templates mit der `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_old_value     TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_text.
    rv_new_text = |{ iv_original_text REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_value IN iv_original_text WITH iv_new_value }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_simple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replace FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_template( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_original_text = 'Hello World' iv_old_value = 'World' iv_new_value = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello ABAP' msg = 'Simple replacement failed' ).

  METHOD test_replace_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_template( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Universe Universe' msg = 'Multiple replacement failed' ).

explanation: String Templates bieten eine kompakte und lesbare Syntax für String-Operationen. Die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Syntax innerhalb eines String Templates ermöglicht es, Ersetzungen direkt im Ausdruck vorzunehmen, ohne temporäre Variablen zu benötigen.
keywords: REPLACE, String Templates, String Processing

Instructions: Ersetze in einer internen Tabelle in einer bestimmten Spalte alle Vorkommen eines Substrings. Nutze dabei eine `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und die `REPLACE` Anweisung.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für effiziente In-Place-Modifikation und die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_replace_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_in_table
      CHANGING
        ct_data      TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_value TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_replace_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_in_table.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_value IN <fs_data>-text WITH iv_new_value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_in_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_change FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_in_table.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_itab_replace_loop=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Hello World' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Another World' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 text = 'Just Text' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_replace_loop( ).
    lo_cut->replace_in_table( CHANGING ct_data = lt_test_data IMPORTING iv_old_value = 'World' iv_new_value = 'Universe' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Hello Universe' msg = 'First line replacement failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Another Universe' msg = 'Second line replacement failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 3 ]-text exp = 'Just Text' msg = 'Third line should not change' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_change.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_itab_replace_loop=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Hello' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_replace_loop( ).
    lo_cut->replace_in_table( CHANGING ct_data = lt_test_data IMPORTING iv_old_value = 'World' iv_new_value = 'Universe' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Hello' msg = 'No change expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist die performanteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zeilenweise zu modifizieren, da keine unnötigen Datenkopien entstehen. Die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Anweisung ist hier direkt auf das Feld-Symbol anwendbar.
keywords: REPLACE, Internal Tables, Field-Symbol, LOOP

Instructions: Überprüfe die digitale Signatur eines XML-Dokuments mit der Klasse `cl_secxml_helper`. Das Beispiel soll die grundlegende Verwendung der Verifizierung demonstrieren.
hint: Verwende die Methode `VERIFY_SIGNATURE` der Klasse `cl_secxml_helper`. Für den Test muss ein gültiges signiertes XML und ein passendes Zertifikat simuliert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_verify_signature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_xml_signature
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data      TYPE xstring
        iv_certificate   TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_verify_signature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_xml_signature.
    DATA(lo_secxml_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->verify_signature(
          EXPORTING
            i_xml_data    = iv_xml_data
            i_certificate = iv_certificate
        ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_secxml_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_signature FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_signature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_signature.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_verify_signature( ).
    " Simulate a valid signed XML and certificate
    DATA(lv_signed_xml) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( '<?xml version="1.0"?><data><item>Test</item></data>' ). " Placeholder
    DATA(lv_certificate) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( 'dummy_cert_data' ). " Placeholder

    " In a real scenario, you would generate a signed XML and a certificate.
    " For this unit test, we assume a successful verification for a dummy input.
    " A real test would involve actual cryptographic operations.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->verify_xml_signature( iv_xml_data = lv_signed_xml iv_certificate = lv_certificate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true msg = 'Valid signature verification failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_signature.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_verify_signature( ).
    DATA(lv_unsigned_xml) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( '<?xml version="1.0"?><data><item>Modified</item></data>' ).
    DATA(lv_certificate) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( 'dummy_cert_data' ).

    " Simulate an invalid signature (e.g., modified XML or wrong cert)
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->verify_xml_signature( iv_xml_data = lv_unsigned_xml iv_certificate = lv_certificate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false msg = 'Invalid signature should not pass' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `VERIFY_SIGNATURE` ist entscheidend, um die Integrität und Authentizität von XML-Dokumenten zu gewährleisten, indem sie die digitale Signatur überprüft. Instructions: Führe mehrere Ersetzungen auf einem String in einer einzigen Anweisung aus, indem du `REPLACE` Operationen in einem String Template verkettetest.
hint: Nutze die Möglichkeit, `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mehrfach innerhalb eines String Templates zu verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_chained DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_multiple
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_old_value1    TYPE string
        iv_new_value1    TYPE string
        iv_old_value2    TYPE string
        iv_new_value2    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_chained IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_multiple.
    rv_new_text = |{ iv_original_text
                      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_value1 IN iv_original_text WITH iv_new_value1
                      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_value2 IN iv_original_text WITH iv_new_value2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chained_replace FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlapping_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_chained( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_multiple(
      iv_original_text = 'Hello World, how are you?'
      iv_old_value1    = 'World'
      iv_new_value1    = 'Universe'
      iv_old_value2    = 'you'
      iv_new_value2    = 'everyone'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello Universe, how are everyone?' msg = 'Chained replacement failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlapping_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_chained( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_multiple(
      iv_original_text = 'ABAP is great'
      iv_old_value1    = 'ABAP'
      iv_new_value1    = 'SAP'
      iv_old_value2    = 'SAP'
      iv_new_value2    = 'ERP'
    ).
    " Note: The replacements happen sequentially on the *original* string for each REPLACE clause.
    " So 'ABAP' -> 'SAP', then 'SAP' (from original) -> 'ERP'. The first replacement's result is not input to the second.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ERP is great' msg = 'Overlapping replacement logic failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verkettung von `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Operationen innerhalb eines String Templates ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Methode, um mehrere Ersetzungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu definieren. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass jede `REPLACE` Operation auf dem *ursprünglichen* String ausgeführt wird, nicht auf dem Ergebnis der vorherigen Ersetzung im selben Template.
keywords: REPLACE, String Templates, Chaining, String Processing

Instructions: Ersetze einen spezifischen Abschnitt eines Strings, der durch einen Offset und eine Länge definiert ist, mit einem neuen Wert.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_section DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS replace_part_of_string

CLASS zcl_str_replace_section IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_new_text = iv_original_text.
    REPLACE SECTION OFFSET iv_offset LENGTH iv_length OF rv_new_text WITH iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformiere eine Liste von Strings, indem du in jedem String ein bestimmtes Muster ersetzt, und sammle die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Nutze hierfür `FOR` mit `VALUE` und die `REPLACE` Funktion.
hint: Verwende eine `FOR` Iteration innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstrukts und die eingebaute `REPLACE` Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_func_replace_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_original_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_old_value        TYPE string
        iv_new_value        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_func_replace_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_strings.
    rt_transformed_strings = VALUE #( FOR s IN it_original_strings
                                      ( REPLACE( val = s old = iv_old_value new = iv_new_value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_transform_all FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_some FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_func_replace_for( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_func_replace_for=>tt_strings( ( 'Item A' ) ( 'Item B' ) ( 'Item C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_func_replace_for=>tt_strings( ( 'Product A' ) ( 'Product B' ) ( 'Product C' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_strings(
      it_original_strings = lt_input

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_func_replace_for=>tt_strings( ( 'Orange' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Orange Pie' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_strings(
      it_original_strings = lt_input
      iv_old_value        = 'Apple'
      iv_new_value        = 'Orange'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Some items transformation failed' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_func_replace_for( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_func_replace_for=>tt_strings( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_func_replace_for=>tt_strings( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_strings(

      iv_old_value        = 'Grape'

explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` Iterationen mit `VALUE` Konstruktoren ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code. Sie ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, wobei die `REPLACE` Funktion direkt auf jedes Element angewendet wird, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: REPLACE, FOR, VALUE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Ersetze mehrere verschiedene Substrings in einem Text mit unterschiedlichen neuen Werten, indem du die `REPLACE` Funktion verschachtelst.
hint: Nutze die `REPLACE` Funktion mehrfach, wobei das Ergebnis einer Ersetzung als Eingabe für die nächste dient.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS replace_nested_values

CLASS zcl_str_replace_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_nested_values.
    rv_new_text = REPLACE( val = REPLACE( val = iv_original_text old = iv_old_value1 new = iv_new_value1 ) old = iv_old_value2 new = iv_new_value2 ).

explanation: Die Verschachtelung der `REPLACE` Funktion ermöglicht es, komplexe Ersetzungslogik in einer einzigen Ausdruckskette zu definieren. Im Gegensatz zu den `REPLACE` Operationen in String Templates, bei denen jede Ersetzung auf dem Originalstring basiert, wird bei verschachtelten Funktionen das Ergebnis der inneren Funktion als Eingabe für die äußere Funktion verwendet, was eine sequentielle Transformation ermöglicht.
keywords: REPLACE, String, Nested Functions, String Processing

Instructions: Ersetze einen Teil eines Strings nur, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist. Nutze hierfür eine Kombination aus `COND` und der `REPLACE` Funktion.
hint: Verwende `COND string( WHEN ... THEN REPLACE(...) ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS conditional_replace
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_condition     TYPE abap_bool
        iv_old_value     TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD conditional_replace.
    rv_new_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_condition = abap_true
      THEN REPLACE( val = iv_original_text old = iv_old_value new = iv_new_value )
      ELSE iv_original_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetze einen Wert in einer internen Tabelle, wenn eine Zeile mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel existiert. Nutze hierfür `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` in Kombination mit der `REPLACE` Funktion.
hint: Verwende `VALUE #( FOR ... ( ... COND string( WHEN ... THEN REPLACE(...) ELSE ... ) ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_cond_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS replace_value_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_original_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key_to_find   TYPE string
        iv_old_value     TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_cond_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_value_by_key.
    rt_modified_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_orig IN it_original_data
                                  ( key = ls_orig-key
                                    value = COND string(
                                              WHEN ls_orig-key = iv_key_to_find
                                              THEN REPLACE( val = ls_orig-value old = iv_old_value new = iv_new_value )
                                              ELSE ls_orig-value
                                            ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_case_insens DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Kombiniere eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz, wobei bestimmte Wörter während der Aggregation ersetzt werden. Nutze hierfür `REDUCE` mit der `REPLACE` Funktion.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR w IN ... NEXT s = s && REPLACE(...) && ' ' )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_sentence_with_replace
      IMPORTING
        it_words         TYPE tt_words
        iv_word_to_find  TYPE string
        iv_replacement   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sentence_with_replace.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string( INIT s = ''
                                  FOR w IN it_words
                                  NEXT s = s && REPLACE( val = w old = iv_word_to_find new = iv_replacement ) && ' ' ).
    " Remove trailing space if any
    IF rv_sentence IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_sentence = rv_sentence(1, strlen( rv_sentence ) - 1).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_verify_x509 IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_carrier_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_carrier_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    rt_unique_carriers = VALUE #( FOR carrid IN it_all_carriers ( carrid ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode zur Berechnung eines Wertes hat. Fügen Sie eine `CLASS-METHODS FOR TESTING` hinzu, um interne Zustände oder private Methoden für Unit-Tests zugänglich zu machen, ohne die öffentliche Schnittstelle zu ändern.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_internal_factor RETURNING VALUE(rv_factor) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS for_testing
      FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_internal_factor.
    rv_factor = 10. " Beispiel interne Logik
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD for_testing.
    " Diese Methode ist nur für Testklassen sichtbar und kann geschützte/private Mitglieder zugänglich machen
    " Zum Beispiel, um get_internal_factor direkt zu testen:
    " DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    " DATA(lv_factor) = lo_calc->get_internal_factor( ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_factor exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_internal_factor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_internal_factor.
    " Zugriff auf geschützte Methode über einen Test Seam (CLASS-METHODS FOR TESTING)
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_factor) = lo_calc->get_internal_factor( ). " Dieser Aufruf ist erlaubt, da ltcl_test eine Testklasse ist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_factor exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CLASS-METHODS FOR TESTING` (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, spezielle Methoden zu definieren, die nur von Testklassen aufgerufen werden können. Dies schafft "Test Seams", um private oder geschützte Logik zu testen, ohne die Kapselung der Produktivklasse zu verletzen.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS FOR TESTING, Unit Testing, Test Seams, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit statischen Methoden, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem String ermöglichen (z.B. Trimmen, Großschreibung, Ersetzen), wobei jede Methode das Ergebnis der vorherigen als Eingabe verwendet.
hint: Jede statische Methode nimmt einen String entgegen und gibt einen modifizierten String zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_pipeline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS trim
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS replace_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_old   TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new   TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_pipeline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim.
    rv_output = condense( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_char.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old IN iv_input WITH iv_new.
    rv_output = iv_input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_pipeline FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_pipeline.
    DATA(lv_initial) = '  hello world  '.
    DATA(lv_processed) = zcl_string_pipeline=>replace_char(
                                 iv_input = zcl_string_pipeline=>to_upper(
                                                iv_input = zcl_string_pipeline=>trim( lv_initial )
                                            )
                                 iv_old   = 'O'
                                 iv_new   = 'X'
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 'HELLX WXRLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie statische Methoden für eine funktionale Kette von Operationen genutzt werden können. Jede Methode nimmt einen Wert entgegen, transformiert ihn und gibt das Ergebnis zurück, das direkt als Eingabe für die nächste Methode dienen kann. Dies fördert einen deklarativen und lesbaren Stil.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Functional Chaining, String Processing, condense, to_upper, replace

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 enthält. Fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'PRICE_CATEGORY' hinzu, die 'Premium' ist, wenn der Preis über 1000 liegt, ansonsten 'Standard'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit einer COND-Anweisung für die neue Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate       TYPE s_date,
             price        TYPE s_price,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                           WHERE ( price > 500 )
                           ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
                             connid       = ls_flight-connid
                             fldate       = ls_flight-fldate
                             price        = ls_flight-price
                             price_category = COND string(
                                                WHEN ls_flight-price > 1000 THEN 'Premium'
                                                ELSE 'Standard'
                                              )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_categorization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_categorizer( ).
    DATA(lt_categorized_flights) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_categorized_flights ). " Expecting some data from SFLIGHT

    LOOP AT lt_categorized_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > 1000.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Premium' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Standard' ).
      ENDIF.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE # ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen. Die COND-Anweisung innerhalb des FOR-Ausdrucks erlaubt es, neue Felder basierend auf Bedingungen zu berechnen, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht. Die WHERE-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten effizient.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, ELSE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) für eine grafische Darstellung vor. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft, die Verbindungsnummer und eine 'SALES_VOLUME_CATEGORY' enthält. Die Kategorie soll 'High' sein, wenn der Preis über 800 liegt, 'Medium' zwischen 300 und 800, und 'Low' ansonsten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit einer verschachtelten COND-Anweisung zur Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             carrid             TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid             TYPE s_conn_id,
             sales_volume_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_sales_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_prepared_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_sales_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_prepared_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid              = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid              = ls_flight-connid
                                   sales_volume_category = COND string(
                                                             WHEN ls_flight-price > 800 THEN 'High'
                                                             WHEN ls_flight-price >= 300 THEN 'Medium'
                                                             ELSE 'Low'
                                                           )
                                 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
