CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_preparation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_sales_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data ). " Expecting some data from SFLIGHT

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
      " Test logic for categories (assuming SFLIGHT data is diverse enough)
      IF ls_item-sales_volume_category = 'High'.
        " Cannot assert price directly here, but can check if category is valid
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_item-sales_volume_category = 'High' OR
                                                  ls_item-sales_volume_category = 'Medium' OR
                                                  ls_item-sales_volume_category = 'Low' ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Logik ist direkt in der Zuweisung eingebettet, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht als traditionelle LOOP- und IF-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch, die potenziell zu einer Division durch Null führen kann. Fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab und geben Sie im Fehlerfall einen Standardwert von 0 zurück, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Ausnahmebehandlung und die ELSE-Logik im CATCH-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safely.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " If an arithmetic error (like division by zero) occurs, return 0.
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safely( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safely( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die TRY...CATCH-Struktur ist der moderne Weg zur Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, Laufzeitfehler abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Der CATCH-Block fungiert hier als 'ELSE'-Pfad, der nur ausgeführt wird, wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt, und stellt sicher, dass ein definierter Zustand (hier: Rückgabe von 0) erreicht wird.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exceptions, Error Handling, Division by Zero, ELSE (implicit)

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu. Wenn die angeforderte Komponente nicht existiert, soll ein Standardwert (z.B. 'Komponente nicht gefunden') zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT mit FIELD-SYMBOLS und prüfen Sie die Zuweisung mit IF ... IS ASSIGNED ELSE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Komponente nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_existing_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_component FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_component.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_accessor=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Hello' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_component.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_accessor=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Komponente nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Programmierung mit FIELD-SYMBOLS und ASSIGN COMPONENT ist mächtig, erfordert aber eine sorgfältige Fehlerbehandlung. Die IF ... IS ASSIGNED ELSE ...-Struktur ist hier entscheidend, um zu prüfen, ob die Zuweisung erfolgreich war. Der ELSE-Zweig stellt einen Fallback-Mechanismus bereit, wenn die dynamisch angeforderte Komponente nicht gefunden wird, was die Robustheit des Codes erhöht.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, IF IS ASSIGNED, ELSE

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Substrings in einem Text. Wenn der Substring nicht gefunden wird, soll der Originaltext unverändert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Ausdruck in Kombination mit der REPLACE-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        iv_old_sub    TYPE string
        iv_new_sub    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring_cond.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_text CA iv_old_sub THEN
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_sub IN iv_text WITH iv_new_sub
      ELSE
        iv_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring_cond( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_old_sub = 'World' iv_new_sub = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring_cond( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_old_sub = 'SAP' iv_new_sub = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring_cond( iv_text = 'ABAP ABAP' iv_old_sub = 'ABAP' iv_new_sub = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'SAP SAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus COND-Ausdruck und der eingebauten REPLACE-Funktion bietet eine sehr elegante und moderne Möglichkeit, bedingte String-Operationen durchzuführen. Anstatt einer traditionellen IF-Anweisung mit FIND und dann REPLACE, wird die gesamte Logik in einem einzigen Ausdruck gekapselt. Die 'CA'-Operation prüft effizient, ob der Substring im Text enthalten ist, und die ELSE-Klausel sorgt für den Fallback.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, COND, ELSE, String Expressions

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS). Wenn ein bestimmter Fluggesellschaftscode ('LH') als Filterkriterium angegeben wird, sollen nur Flüge dieser Gesellschaft zurückgegeben werden. Andernfalls (ELSE) sollen alle Flüge mit einem Preis über 1000 zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Ausdruck mit einer WHERE-Klausel, die einen COND-Ausdruck enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_flights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE ( COND log_exp(
                                     WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     ELSE ( price > 1000 )
                                   ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_by_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ). " Expecting some data from SFLIGHT

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_by_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ). " No carrid, so filter by price

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ). " Expecting some data from SFLIGHT

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 1000 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die deklarative Filterung interner Tabellen. Durch die Einbettung eines COND-Ausdrucks in die WHERE-Klausel kann die Filterlogik dynamisch und flexibel gestaltet werden. Dies ermöglicht es, verschiedene Filterkriterien basierend auf Eingabeparametern oder anderen Bedingungen zu definieren, ohne explizite IF-Anweisungen oder separate Schleifen zu verwenden. Die ELSE-Klausel im COND-Ausdruck definiert den Standardfilter, wenn keine spezifischen Kriterien zutreffen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, COND, ELSE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Strukturieren Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in das spezifische Format, das von `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE` für ein Liniendiagramm erwartet wird. Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle für die Datenpunkte und eine für die Beschriftungen.
hint: Recherchieren Sie die Typen `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE=>T_DATA` und `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE=>T_TEXT` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_chart_data_for_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid     TYPE s_conn_id
      EXPORTING
        et_data       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data
        et_text       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_text.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_chart_data_for_sflight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i VALUE 1.

    SELECT fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid
      ORDER BY fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      " Data points for the chart
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data(
        index = lv_index
        value = ls_sflight-price
        series = 1 " Assuming one series for price
      ) TO et_data.

      " Text labels for the chart (e.g., dates on X-axis)
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_text(
        index = lv_index
        text = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|
        type = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_text_type_x_axis_label
      ) TO et_text.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lines( et_data ) = 0.
      " Handle case where no data is found, e.g., provide default/empty data
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten für das Diagramm gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_data_structuring FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_data_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_structuring.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data,
          lt_text TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_struct( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in SFLIGHT for testing purposes
    lo_cut->get_chart_data_for_sflight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400'
                                        IMPORTING et_data = lt_data et_text = lt_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = lines( lt_text ) ).

    " Check first entry (if exists)
    READ TABLE lt_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_data_entry).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data_entry-index exp = 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_data_entry-value > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_data_found.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data,
          lt_text TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_struct( ).

    " Use non-existent flight to test no data scenario
    lo_cut->get_chart_data_for_sflight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999'
                                        IMPORTING et_data = lt_data et_text = lt_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle (SFLIGHT) in die spezifischen internen Tabellentypen (`T_DATA`, `T_TEXT`) umgewandelt werden, die von der `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE` für die Diagrammerstellung erwartet werden. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Datumsformatierung und `VALUE #` für die Befüllung der Tabellen ist modern. Die explizite Handhabung des Falls, dass keine Daten gefunden werden, erhöht die Robustheit. Dies ist ein entscheidender Schritt, um Daten für die Visualisierung mit der Chart Engine vorzubereiten.
keywords: CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE, Data Structures, UI, Graphics, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz des ABAP Edit Controls und setzen Sie einen Beispielcode. Beachten Sie, dass für die tatsächliche Anzeige ein Dynpro-Container erforderlich ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` für `cl_gui_abapedit` und die Methode `set_text_as_stream`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_set_code DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_example_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_editor) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_set_code IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_example_code.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    " In a real scenario, lo_container would be a custom control on a screen.
    " For this example, we simulate a container (though it won't be visible).
    " This part would typically be handled in a PBO module of a screen.
    TRY.
        lo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle exception if container cannot be created (e.g., no GUI environment)
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    ro_editor = NEW cl_gui_abapedit(
      parent = lo_container
    ).

    ro_editor->set_text_as_stream( iv_code ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_set_code FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_code.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_set_code( ).
    DATA(lv_test_code) = 'REPORT z_test_report. WRITE: / ''Hello World!''.' ##NO_TEXT.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_editor) = lo_cut->set_example_code( lv_test_code ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Editor object should be created' act = lo_editor IS NOT INITIAL ).

        " Attempt to read back the text to verify (requires a valid GUI context for full functionality)
        DATA(lv_read_code) = ``.
        lo_editor->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_read_code ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Code should match' act = lv_read_code exp = lv_test_code ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'GUI exception occurred, test cannot run in non-GUI context.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Instanziierung des `cl_gui_abapedit` Controls und das Setzen von Code mittels `set_text_as_stream`. Die Verwendung von `NEW` für die Objekterstellung ist moderner ABAP-Stil. Beachten Sie, dass GUI-Controls eine aktive GUI-Umgebung benötigen und Unit-Tests in einer reinen Backend-Umgebung eingeschränkt sind.
keywords: cl_gui_abapedit, GUI, Control, Text Editor, Object Orientation

Instructions: Lesen Sie den aktuell im ABAP Edit Control angezeigten Code aus. Beachten Sie, dass für die tatsächliche Anzeige ein Dynpro-Container erforderlich ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `get_text_as_stream`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_get_code DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_editor_code
      IMPORTING
        io_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit
      RETURNING

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und transformieren Sie diese in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Abflugort enthält, unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `VALUE #( FOR ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflights
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                   connid   = <fs_flight>-connid
                                   cityfrom = <fs_flight>-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'First entry should not be initial' act = lt_summary[1]-carrid IS INITIAL ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise (PRICE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `sflights` Daten und einer `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                     NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    " Manuelle Berechnung für 'LH' (Beispielwerte, anpassen falls sflights variiert)
    DATA: lv_expected_price TYPE s_price.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_price.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for LH should match' act = lv_total_price_lh exp = lv_expected_price ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_price.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for AA should match' act = lv_total_price_aa exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf funktionale Weise. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariablen zu schreiben, kann die Logik kompakt in einem Ausdruck formuliert werden, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, sflights, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft sowie den durchschnittlichen Preis, unter Verwendung von `FOR GROUPS OF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` für Aggregationen innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_stats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_stats) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_stats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid       = <fs_group>-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                   avg_price    = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                                                  FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <fs_group>
                                                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-price
                                                                       count = count + 1
                                                                  RESULT sum / count ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_stats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_test_grouped_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_stats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Grouped stats should not be empty' act = lt_stats IS INITIAL ).

    " Überprüfen Sie die Anzahl der Gruppen (mindestens 2, da LH und AA existieren sollten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Expected at least 2 groups' act = lines( lt_stats ) >= 2 ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen Sie die Statistik für 'LH'
    DATA(ls_lh_stats) = VALUE zcl_group_flights=>ty_flight_group( ).
    READ TABLE lt_stats INTO ls_lh_stats WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH stats should be found' act = sy-subrc <> 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flight count should be positive' act = ls_lh_stats-flight_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH average price should be positive' act = ls_lh_stats-avg_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck (ABAP 7.50+) ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, Gruppen zu definieren und dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe weitere Operationen (hier `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` für den Durchschnitt) durchzuführen, alles in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` für die Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " All fields as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Füllen mit Beispieldaten
    CREATE DATA REF TO (lo_struct_descr->get_relative_name( )) INTO DATA(lo_line_ref).
    ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

    DO 2 TIMES.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = |{ ls_component-name }_Value_{ sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Werktags (Montag bis Freitag) ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` oder manuelle Datumsarithmetik mit `sy-daywk`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_working_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_working_day
      IMPORTING
        id_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rd_next_working_day) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_working_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_working_day.
    DATA: ld_current_date TYPE sy-datum VALUE id_date.

    DO.
      ld_current_date = ld_current_date + 1.
      " sy-daywk: 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, ..., 7=Sunday
      IF sy-daywk( ld_current_date ) >= 1 AND sy-daywk( ld_current_date ) <= 5.
        rd_next_working_day = ld_current_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_next_working_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_working_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_next_working_day( ).

    " Freitag -> Montag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Friday to Monday' act = lo_cut->get_next_working_day( '20251121' ) exp = '20251124' ).
    " Samstag -> Montag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Saturday to Monday' act = lo_cut->get_next_working_day( '20251122' ) exp = '20251124' ).
    " Sonntag -> Montag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sunday to Monday' act = lo_cut->get_next_working_day( '20251123' ) exp = '20251124' ).
    " Mittwoch -> Donnerstag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wednesday to Thursday' act = lo_cut->get_next_working_day( '20251119' ) exp = '20251120' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine einfache Datumsarithmetik zur Bestimmung des nächsten Werktags. Obwohl es keine spezifische 'neue' ABAP-Syntax verwendet, ist die Kapselung in einer Klasse und die klare, funktionale Methode ein moderner Ansatz. Für komplexere Datumsberechnungen gibt es auch Klassen wie `cl_abap_date_helper`.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zurückgibt, unter Verwendung von `CASE TYPE OF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTATION`, `CASE TYPE OF` und `NEW`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS print_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_printer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_printer~print_message.
    WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_printer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_printer~print_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log file or system log
    DATA(lv_log_entry) = |Log: { iv_message }|.
    WRITE: / lv_log_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_printer_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_printer_type,
             console TYPE char1 VALUE 'C',
             log     TYPE char1 VALUE 'L',
           END OF ty_printer_type.

    CLASS-METHODS create_printer
      IMPORTING
        iv_printer_type TYPE ty_printer_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_printer) TYPE REF TO zif_printer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_printer_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_printer.
    CASE iv_printer_type.
      WHEN ty_printer_type-console.
        ro_printer = NEW zcl_console_printer( ).
      WHEN ty_printer_type-log.
        ro_printer = NEW zcl_log_printer( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default or error handling
        ro_printer = NEW zcl_console_printer( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_printer_factory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_printer_factory.
    DATA(lo_console_printer) = zcl_printer_factory=>create_printer( zcl_printer_factory=>ty_printer_type-console ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Console printer should be created' act = lo_console_printer IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Console printer should be of type ZCL_CONSOLE_PRINTER' act = ( lo_console_printer IS INSTANCE OF zcl_console_printer ) ).

    DATA(lo_log_printer) = zcl_printer_factory=>create_printer( zcl_printer_factory=>ty_printer_type-log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Log printer should be created' act = lo_log_printer IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Log printer should be of type ZCL_LOG_PRINTER' act = ( lo_log_printer IS INSTANCE OF zcl_log_printer ) ).

    " Test default case
    DATA(lo_default_printer) = zcl_printer_factory=>create_printer( 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Default printer should be Console printer' act = ( lo_default_printer IS INSTANCE OF zcl_console_printer ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern mit modernen ABAP-Features. Es verwendet Interfaces für Polymorphie, `NEW` für die Objekterstellung und `CASE TYPE OF` (ABAP 7.55+) zur Unterscheidung der zu erstellenden Implementierung. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Interface, Polymorphism, NEW, CASE TYPE OF

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu, wobei fehlende Felder automatisch aus einer anderen Zeile übernommen werden (CORRESPONDING mit BASE).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( BASE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_data_with_base
      IMPORTING
        it_existing_data TYPE tt_data
        is_new_data      TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_data_with_base.
    rt_updated_data = it_existing_data.

    DATA(ls_base_entry) = VALUE ty_data( id = 999 name = 'Default Name' value = 'Default Value' ).

    APPEND CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ls_base_entry ) is_new_data ) TO rt_updated_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_base.
    DATA: lt_initial_data TYPE zcl_corresponding_base=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Entry 1' value = 'Val A' ) TO lt_initial_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_base( ).

    " Neue Zeile mit nur ID und Name, Value soll vom BASE übernommen werden
    DATA(ls_new_entry1) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_base=>ty_data( id = 2 name = 'Entry 2' ).
    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->add_data_with_base( it_existing_data = lt_initial_data is_new_data = ls_new_entry1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 rows' act = lines( lt_result1 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of new entry should be from BASE' act = lt_result1[2]-value exp = 'Default Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name of new entry should be from new data' act = lt_result1[2]-name exp = 'Entry 2' ).

    " Neue Zeile mit allen Feldern
    DATA(ls_new_entry2) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_base=>ty_data( id = 3 name = 'Entry 3' value = 'Specific Value' ).
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->add_data_with_base( it_existing_data = lt_initial_data is_new_data = ls_new_entry2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of new entry should be from new data' act = lt_result2[2]-value exp = 'Specific Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht das einfache Füllen einer Struktur oder internen Tabelle, wobei fehlende Felder aus einer Basisstruktur übernommen werden. Dies ist nützlich, um Standardwerte zu setzen und gleichzeitig spezifische Werte aus einer anderen Quelle zu übernehmen, was den Code für Datenzuweisungen vereinfacht.
keywords: Internal Tables, CORRESPONDING, BASE, Data Assignment, Expressions

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in ein JSON-Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_abap` und `add_abap_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_abap( ).
    lo_json_writer->set_pretty_print( abap_true ).
    lo_json_writer->add_abap_data( is_sflight ).
    rv_json = lo_json_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    METHODS test_serialize_sflight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_single( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE zcl_json_serialize_single=>ty_sflight_data(
      carrid   = 'AA'
      connid   = '0017'
      fldate   = '20250101'
      price    = '100.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflight( ls_sflight ).
    DATA(lv_expected_json) = |{{\n  "CARRID": "AA",\n  "CONNID": "0017",\n  "FLDATE": "20250101",\n  "PRICE": "100.00",\n  "CURRENCY": "EUR"\n}}|. "Beachten Sie die Großschreibung der Feldnamen im JSON
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = lv_expected_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_fdt_json` bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, ABAP-Datenstrukturen in JSON-Strings zu serialisieren. Die Methode `create_json_from_abap` initialisiert einen Writer, `add_abap_data` fügt die Daten hinzu und `get_json_string` liefert das Ergebnis. `set_pretty_print` verbessert die Lesbarkeit. Beachten Sie, dass ABAP-Feldnamen standardmäßig in Großbuchstaben im JSON erscheinen.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, cl_fdt_json, ABAP 7.50, Data Conversion

        ( bookid = '00000001' seat = 1 )
        ( bookid = '00000002' seat = 2 )
      )
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_flight_booking( ls_flight_booking ).
    DATA(lv_expected_json) =
      |{{\n  "CARRID": "AA",\n  "CONNID": "0017",\n  "FLDATE": "20250101",\n  "BOOKINGS": [\n    {{\n      "BOOKID": "00000001",\n      "SEAT": 1\n    }},\n    {{\n      "BOOKID": "00000002",\n      "SEAT": 2\n    }}\n  ]\n}}|. 
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = lv_expected_json ).

explanation: `cl_fdt_json` ist intelligent genug, um auch komplexe, geschachtelte ABAP-Datenstrukturen, die interne Tabellen enthalten, korrekt in entsprechende JSON-Objekte mit verschachtelten Arrays zu serialisieren. Dies macht die Abbildung komplexer Datenmodelle auf JSON sehr einfach.
keywords: JSON, Nested Structure, Serialization, cl_fdt_json, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der eine komplexe, geschachtelte Struktur (Kopfdaten mit interner Tabelle von Positionsdaten) repräsentiert, zurück in eine ABAP-Struktur.
hint: Die ABAP-Zielstruktur muss die gleiche Schachtelungstiefe und Feldnamen wie der JSON-String aufweisen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CONNID) von Flügen enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Iteration mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `VALUE` für die Konstruktion der neuen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_price_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_connids.
    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price ) ( ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_high_price_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_high_price_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = zcl_itab_for_value=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_high_price_connids( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_price = '90.00' ).
    DATA(lt_expected_connids) = zcl_itab_for_value=>tt_connid( ( '0017' ) ( '0400' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[1] exp = lt_expected_connids[1] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[2] exp = lt_expected_connids[2] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen basierend auf den Elementen einer anderen Tabelle. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Elemente, und der Ausdruck in Klammern definiert, welche Felder in die neue Tabelle übernommen werden. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und wartungsfreundlicher als klassische Schleifen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, ABAP 7.40, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Währung haben, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert und einer Schleife über die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_currency TYPE s_curcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE s_price
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_eur) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lv_total_usd) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_currency = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_eur exp = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_usd exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Operator, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Er ist ideal für Summierungen, Zählungen oder das Finden von Min/Max-Werten. Die Syntax ist sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeidet explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen, was den Code kürzer und fehlerresistenter macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, ABAP 7.40, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der Flugdetails (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates.

Formatierungsoptionen wie `DATE = USER` können direkt im Template angewendet werden, was den Code sauberer und kürzer macht als die Verwendung von `CONCATENATE` oder `WRITE TO`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie eine Methode auf, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten zurückgibt, unter Verwendung des `NEW`-Operators und Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_my_class( )` und `DATA(lt_result) = lo_object->get_data( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_all_sflights
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 2 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Beispiel für die Verwendung:

Er macht den Code kürzer und vermeidet die explizite Deklaration einer Referenzvariablen vor der Instanziierung. Dies fördert einen flüssigeren, funktionaleren Programmierstil.

CLASS zcl_db_select_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdatensätzen nach Flügen, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = zcl_itab_filter=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_aa ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_aa[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_lh[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die den Bedingungen der `WHERE`-Klausel entsprechen. Dies ist eine deklarative Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, ABAP 7.50, Functional Programming

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, die teilweise unterschiedliche Feldnamen hat, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( target = ls_target SOURCE ls_source )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             common TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             new_field1 TYPE string,
             field2     TYPE i,
             common     TYPE string,
             extra      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING new_field1 = field1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_struct=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 123
      common = 'Common Text'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-new_field1 exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-common exp = 'Common Text' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-extra ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zum Zuweisen von Werten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen. Er kopiert Felder mit identischen Namen automatisch. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel können Sie Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zuordnen. Dies ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` und bietet mehr Kontrolle.
keywords: Data Manipulation, CORRESPONDING, ABAP 7.40, Structure Assignment

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere durch, wobei die Felder umbenannt und nur relevante Daten übernommen werden, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `CORRESPONDING` für die Feldzuordnung innerhalb des `VALUE`-Konstruktors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_source_flight,
           tt_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_flight_info,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_nr  TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_target_flight_info,
           tt_target_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_info) TYPE tt_target_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source_flights
                               ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING airline_id = carrid flight_nr = connid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = zcl_for_corresponding=>tt_source_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_source ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = zcl_for_corresponding=>tt_target_flight_info(
      ( airline_id = 'AA' flight_nr = '0017' flight_date = '20250101' )
      ( airline_id = 'LH' flight_nr = '0400' flight_date = '20250102' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-airline_id exp = lt_expected[1]-airline_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[2]-flight_nr exp = lt_expected[2]-flight_nr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-flight_date exp = lt_expected[1]-flight_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors. Sie ermöglicht eine zeilenweise Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei Felder umbenannt und nur die benötigten Daten übertragen werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode für Datenmapping und -transformation, die den Code extrem kompakt hält.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, die bei der Deserialisierung eines ungültigen JSON-Strings mittels `cl_fdt_json` auftritt, und geben Sie eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurück.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS deserialize_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_json TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_json_error.
    METHODS deserialize_with_catch
      IMPORTING
        iv_json TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_safe.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_abap_from_json( iv_json ).
    lo_json_reader->get_abap_data( IMPORTING abap_data = rs_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_with_catch.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_data) = deserialize_safe( iv_json ).
        rv_message = |Erfolgreich deserialisiert: { ls_data-field }|.
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler bei JSON-Deserialisierung: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Funktionsbaustein auf, der Ausnahmen auslösen kann, und behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler auf moderne Weise, anstatt `sy-subrc` zu prüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL FUNCTION ... EXCEPTIONS ...` in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fm_call_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_fm_with_exception RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fm_call_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_fm_with_exception.
    DATA lv_text TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL FUNCTION 'RFC_PING'
          EXCEPTIONS
            system_failure        = 1
            communication_failure = 2
            OTHERS                = 3.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. " This sy-subrc check is still needed for non-class-based exceptions
          CASE sy-subrc.
            WHEN 1. lv_text = 'System Failure'.
            WHEN 2. lv_text = 'Communication Failure'.
            WHEN 3. lv_text = 'Other Error'.
          ENDCASE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_message_fault
            EXPORTING
              text = lv_text.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = 'RFC_PING successful'.
      CATCH cx_sy_message_fault INTO DATA(lx_message_fault).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_message_fault->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Unexpected Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_fm_with_exception( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Result should not be initial' ).
    " Depending on system configuration, RFC_PING might fail.
    " A more robust test would mock the RFC call or assert for specific success/failure messages.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'successful' msg = 'RFC_PING should be successful or report an error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Während `sy-subrc` bei Funktionsbaustein-Aufrufen, die keine klassenbasierten Ausnahmen auslösen, immer noch relevant ist, zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man den `sy-subrc`-Wert in eine moderne, klassenbasierte Ausnahme umwandelt und diese dann mit `TRY...CATCH` behandelt. Dies fördert eine konsistentere Fehlerbehandlung im gesamten System.

CLASS zcl_cond_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE i,
             val TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_value_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE i
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_cond.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data( key = iv_key ).
    READ TABLE it_data INTO ls_data WITH KEY key = iv_key.

    rv_result = COND string(
                  WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_data-val
                  ELSE |Key { iv_key } not found|
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_throw_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_throw_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    rv_result = SWITCH string( iv_value
      WHEN 0 THEN THROW zcx_custom_error( textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text )
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Value is one'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Value is other'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität in der Business Class haben, ohne eine explizite `LOOP` und `IF sy-subrc` zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_bclmax
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_bclmax TYPE s_bcl_max
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_bclmax.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Beispiel: Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE bclmax >= iv_min_bclmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Should find flights with BCLMAX >= 50' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-bclmax >= 50 ) msg = 'All filtered flights must meet criteria' ).

WHERE ...` Struktur und macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer, indem er die Filterlogik direkt in den Ausdruck integriert. Die Notwendigkeit, `sy-subrc` nach jedem `READ TABLE` oder `LOOP` zu prüfen, entfällt.

Instructions: Fügen Sie der ALV-Symbolleiste einen benutzerdefinierten Button 'Refresh' hinzu und implementieren Sie eine leere Ereignisbehandlung dafür.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID->SET_TOOLBAR_INTERACTIVE` und das Ereignis `TOOLBAR`. Definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse als Event-Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_toolbar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    METHODS handle_toolbar_event FOR EVENT toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_object
        e_salv_function.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_toolbar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_toolbar.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_parent_container
    ).
    eo_alv_grid = mo_alv_grid.

    " Ereignis-Handler registrieren
    SET HANDLER me->handle_toolbar_event FOR mo_alv_grid.

    " ALV anzeigen
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights
    ).

    " Toolbar interaktiv machen und Button hinzufügen
    DATA ls_toolbar_button TYPE stb_button.
    ls_toolbar_button = VALUE #( function = 'REFRESH' icon = icon_refresh text = 'Refresh' tooltip = 'Daten aktualisieren' ).
    mo_alv_grid->add_button( is_button = ls_toolbar_button ).
    mo_alv_grid->set_toolbar_interactive( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar_event.
    " Hier würde die Logik für den Refresh-Button implementiert werden
    IF e_salv_function = 'REFRESH'.
      " Beispiel: Daten neu laden und ALV aktualisieren
      " DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
      " SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.
      " mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

    DATA lo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_toolbar( ).

    lo_cut->display_alv_with_toolbar(
      iv_parent_name = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    = lo_alv_grid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_alv_grid msg = 'ALV Grid should be bound' ).
    " Überprüfung des Event-Handlers ist komplexer und würde Mocking erfordern.
    " Hier wird nur die erfolgreiche Erstellung des ALV und die Registrierung des Handlers geprüft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = xsdbool( lo_alv_grid->is_event_registered( 'TOOLBAR' ) ) msg = 'TOOLBAR event should be registered' ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_2x2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_2x2_splitter
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_splitter    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_2x2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_2x2_splitter.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    eo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_parent_container
      rows    = 2
      columns = 2
    ).

    " Panes mit Platzhalter-Containern füllen
    LOOP AT VALUE #( ( row = 1 col = 1 ) ( row = 1 col = 2 )
                     ( row = 2 col = 1 ) ( row = 2 col = 2 ) ) INTO DATA(ls_pane_coord).
      DATA(lo_pane) = eo_splitter->get_container( row = ls_pane_coord-row column = ls_pane_coord-col ).
      NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_pane ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine ALV-Liste der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle an. Färben Sie die Zeile rot, wenn der PRICE über 500 liegt.
hint: Fügen Sie dem internen Datentyp ein Feld für die Zeilenfarbe hinzu (z.B. `LINE_COLOR` vom Typ `LVC_S_SCOL`) und füllen Sie es bedingt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cell_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             line_color TYPE lvc_s_scol,
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_colored
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cell_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_colored.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw UP TO 50 ROWS.

    " Daten vorbereiten und Zeilenfarbe setzen
    DATA(lt_sflights_colored) = VALUE ty_sflights_colored(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
        line_color = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN VALUE lvc_s_scol( fname = 'PRICE' color = '1' int = '0' ) ELSE VALUE lvc_s_scol( ) ) )
    ).

    " Feldkatalog für die Farbinformation anpassen
    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR comp IN CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_ALV_CELL_COLOR=>TY_SFLIGHT_COLORED' ) )->get_components( )
      WHERE ( comp-name <> 'LINE_COLOR' )
      ( fieldname = comp-name ) 
    ).

    " Farbfeld im Feldkatalog hinzufügen
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'LINE_COLOR' no_out = abap_true hotspot = abap_true ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    eo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_parent_container
    ).

    eo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcat      = lt_fieldcat
        is_layout        = VALUE lvc_s_layo( cwidth_opt = abap_true col_opt = abap_true info_fname = 'LINE_COLOR' )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights_colored
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_alv_cell_color FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_cell_color.
    DATA lo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_cell_color( ).

    lo_cut->display_alv_colored(
      iv_parent_name = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    = lo_alv_grid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_alv_grid msg = 'ALV Grid should be bound' ).
    " Um die Farbzuweisung zu testen, müsste man die interne Tabelle vor der Übergabe prüfen.
    " Hier wird nur die erfolgreiche Erstellung des ALV geprüft.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_sflights_colored_test) = VALUE zcl_alv_cell_color=>ty_sflights_colored(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
        line_color = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN VALUE lvc_s_scol( fname = 'PRICE' color = '1' int = '0' ) ELSE VALUE lvc_s_scol( ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lv_red_lines) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls_item IN lt_sflights_colored_test WHERE ( ls_item-line_color IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lv_red_lines > 0 ) msg = 'At least one line should be colored red' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Zeilen in einer ALV-Liste basierend auf Datenwerten einfärbt. Es wird ein erweiterter interner Tabellentyp mit einem `LINE_COLOR`-Feld verwendet. Die Datenvorbereitung nutzt `FOR` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung der Farbe, was sehr modern und ausdrucksstark ist. Der Feldkatalog wird dynamisch erstellt und die Layout-Struktur (`is_layout-info_fname`) wird auf das Farbfeld gesetzt.
keywords: ALV Grid, Cell Coloring, Conditional Formatting, CL_GUI_ALV_GRID, FOR, COND, VALUE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Haupt-Splitter-Container (horizontal) und platzieren Sie in dessen rechtem Bereich einen weiteren, verschachtelten Splitter-Container (vertikal).
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` als Parent für den inneren Splitter, der sich wiederum in einem Pane des äußeren Splitters befindet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_nested_splitter
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_outer_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container
        eo_inner_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_splitter.
    DATA(lo_main_parent) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    " Äußerer Splitter (horizontal)
    eo_outer_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_main_parent
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    DATA(lo_outer_left_pane)  = eo_outer_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_outer_right_pane) = eo_outer_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Platzhalter im linken Pane
    NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_outer_left_pane ).

    " Inneren Splitter im rechten Pane des äußeren Splitters erstellen
    " Der Parent des inneren Splitters ist der Pane-Container des äußeren Splitters
    eo_inner_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_outer_right_pane
      rows    = 2
      columns = 1
    ).

    " Panes des inneren Splitters mit Platzhalter-Containern füllen
    DATA(lo_inner_top_pane)    = eo_inner_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_inner_bottom_pane) = eo_inner_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).
    NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_inner_top_pane ).
    NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_inner_bottom_pane ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_nested_splitter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_splitter.
    DATA: lo_outer_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
          lo_inner_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_splitter_nested( ).

    lo_cut->create_nested_splitter(
      iv_parent_name = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXPORTING
        eo_outer_splitter = lo_outer_splitter
        eo_inner_splitter = lo_inner_splitter
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_outer_splitter msg = 'Outer splitter should be bound' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_inner_splitter msg = 'Inner splitter should be bound' ).

    DATA(lo_outer_right_pane) = lo_outer_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_inner_splitter->get_parent( ) exp = lo_outer_right_pane msg = 'Inner splitter parent should be outer right pane' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung verschachtelter Splitter-Container, eine fortgeschrittene Technik für komplexe GUI-Layouts. Ein `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER` wird in einem Pane eines anderen `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER` platziert. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität der GUI-Container-Hierarchie.
keywords: Splitter Container, Nested GUI, CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER, Layout

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine ALV-Liste der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle an, aber filtern Sie die Daten vor der Anzeige, sodass nur Flüge mit CARRID = 'LH' und PRICE < 300 angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` oder `FOR` mit `WHERE` Klausel für die Datenvorbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_filtered
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_filtered.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    " Daten filtern mit FOR und WHERE
    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND price < 300 )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    eo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_parent_container
    ).

    eo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING

      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights_filtered
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_alv_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_filter.
    DATA lo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_filter( ).

    lo_cut->display_alv_filtered(
      iv_parent_name = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    = lo_alv_grid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_alv_grid msg = 'ALV Grid should be bound' ).

    " Testen der Filterlogik separat
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = 250 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' price = 550 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' price = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered_test) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND price < 300 )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_filtered_test ) exp = 1 msg = 'Only one flight should match filter' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_filtered_test[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' msg = 'Correct flight should be filtered' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Datenfilterung mit `FOR` und `WHERE` vor der Übergabe an die ALV-Liste. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Datenmengen zu reduzieren und die Performance zu verbessern, anstatt die Filterung der ALV-Komponente zu überlassen.
keywords: ALV Grid, Data Filtering, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Liste, die Daten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Implementieren Sie eine Ereignisbehandlung für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile, die die CARRID der geklickten Zeile in einer Meldung ausgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Ereignis `DOUBLE_CLICK` von `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` und die Methode `GET_CURRENT_CELL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_double_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_double_click
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_double_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_double_click.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_parent_container
    ).
    eo_alv_grid = mo_alv_grid.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) INDEX e_row.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i~'Fluggesellschaft: { ls_sflight-carrid }' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'. " String Template
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_alv_double_click FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_splitter_vertical DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS create_vertical_splitter

CLASS zcl_splitter_vertical IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_vertical_splitter.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

      parent  = lo_parent_container

      columns = 1

    DATA(lo_bottom_pane) = eo_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

    NEW cl_gui_custom_container( parent = lo_bottom_pane ).

      unit   = cl_gui_splitter_container=>unit_percent

    eo_splitter->set_row_height(
      id     = 2
      height = 100 - iv_top_height_percent

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Liste mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS. Fügen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Spalte hinzu, die den Text 'High Price' anzeigt, wenn der Flugpreis über 1000 liegt, ansonsten 'Standard Price'.
hint: Erweitern Sie die interne Tabelle um ein Feld für die neue Spalte und füllen Sie dieses Feld mit `COND` oder `CASE`.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
