Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Liste, die die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle anzeigt. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR GROUPS` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_aggregated
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_aggregated.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_parent_name ).

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    " Aggregation mit FOR GROUPS und REDUCE
    DATA(lt_sflights_agg) = VALUE ty_sflights_agg(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP ( sum = sum + member-price ) ) )
    ).

    eo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_parent_container
    ).

    eo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_AGGREGATION=>TY_SFLIGHT_AGG'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights_agg
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_alv_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_aggregation.
    DATA lo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_aggregation( ).

    lo_cut->display_alv_aggregated(
      iv_parent_name = 'SCREEN_CONTAINER'
      EXPORTING
        eo_alv_grid    = lo_alv_grid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_alv_grid msg = 'ALV Grid should be bound' ).

    " Testen der Aggregationslogik separat
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_test.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' price = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_test.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' price = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_test.

    DATA(lt_sflights_agg_test) = VALUE zcl_alv_aggregation=>ty_sflights_agg(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_test GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP ( sum = sum + member-price ) ) )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_agg_test ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 aggregated entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_agg_test[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First entry should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_agg_test[ 1 ]-total_price exp = 150 msg = 'Total price for AA should be 150' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_agg_test[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Second entry should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_agg_test[ 2 ]-total_price exp = 300 msg = 'Total price for LH should be 300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Aggregation von Daten mit `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` in modernem ABAP. Anstatt eine Schleife mit `AT END OF` zu verwenden, ermöglicht diese Syntax eine deklarative und kompakte Gruppierung und Summierung von Daten, bevor sie an die ALV-Liste übergeben werden.
keywords: ALV Grid, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, Data Transformation

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights_local
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum_flights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '300.00' msg = 'Summe für LH sollte 300 sein' ).

    lv_sum = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '50.00' msg = 'Summe für AA sollte 50 sein' ).

    lv_sum = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '0.00' msg = 'Summe für XX sollte 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer Schleife. Hier wird eine Initialvariable `sum` deklariert und in jedem Schleifendurchlauf um den Flugpreis erhöht, wobei nur Flüge der angegebenen Fluggesellschaft berücksichtigt werden. Dies vermeidet explizite `LOOP AT` und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugverbindungen (Carrid-Connid) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` durch Komma getrennt auflistet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_connections_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connections_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_connections_string.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rv_connections_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_local
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                 ELSE |{ s }, { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concat_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_connections.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_concat_flights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_connections) = lo_cut->get_flight_connections_string( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connections exp = 'LH-0400, LH-0401' msg = 'Verbindungen für LH sollten korrekt sein' ).

    lv_connections = lo_cut->get_flight_connections_string( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connections exp = 'AA-0001' msg = 'Verbindungen für AA sollten korrekt sein' ).

    lv_connections = lo_cut->get_flight_connections_string( iv_carrid = 'XX' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connections exp = '' msg = 'Verbindungen für XX sollten leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code verwendet `REDUCE` und String Templates, um eine Liste von Flugverbindungen in einem einzigen String zu sammeln. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` behandelt den ersten Eintrag speziell, um ein führendes Komma zu vermeiden. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode zur String-Aggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Concatenation, sflights

Instructions: Laden Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) als CSV-Datei auf das Frontend des Benutzers herunter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_download_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_csv,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_csv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_csv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS download_sflights_as_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight_csv OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights_as_csv.
    DATA: lt_data_local TYPE tt_sflight_csv.

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 10 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_data_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_data_local = it_data.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_filepath) = |C:\temp\{ iv_filename }|. " Beispielpfad, wird vom Benutzer überschrieben

    " TEST-SEAM for mocking cl_gui_frontend_services
    TEST-SEAM gui_download.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
        exporting
          filename                = lv_filepath
          filetype                = 'ASC'
          has_field_separator     = abap_true
        changing
          data_tab                = lt_data_local
        exceptions
          OTHERS                  = 1

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS count_flights_by_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_key OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_airline.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      )
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF flight IN lt_sflights_local
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           ( carrid = <group_key>
                             count  = GROUP SIZE ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den teuersten Flug (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und vergleichen Sie die Flugpreise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_most_expensive_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_expensive_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_most_expensive_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rs_expensive_flight = REDUCE ty_sflight_price(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight_price( price = 0 )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_local
      NEXT max_flight = COND ty_sflight_price(
                          WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN flight
                          ELSE max_flight
                        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem Frontend-Popup an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` für die Aggregation und `cl_gui_frontend_services=>popup_to_display_text` für die Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_fes_popup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_avg_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data OPTIONAL.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_avg_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fes_popup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_avg_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = calculate_avg_prices( lt_sflights_local ).

    DATA(lv_popup_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = |Durchschnittliche Flugpreise:\n|
      FOR avg_price IN lt_avg_prices
      NEXT s = |{ s }{ avg_price-carrid }: { avg_price-avg_price }\n|
    ).

    " TEST-SEAM for mocking cl_gui_frontend_services
    TEST-SEAM popup_display.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>popup_to_display_text(
        exporting
          text = lv_popup_text
          title = 'Durchschnittliche Flugpreise'
      ).
    END-TEST-SEAM.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_avg_prices.
    rt_avg_prices = REDUCE tt_avg_price(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_avg_price(
      )
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF flight IN it_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           ( carrid = <group_key>
                             avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                           INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                           FOR member IN GROUP <group_key>
                                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
                                         ) / GROUP SIZE ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die teurer als ein bestimmter Wert sind, und projizieren Sie nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `price` in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_project DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_projected,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_projected.
    TYPES tt_sflight_projected TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_projected WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights_projected
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_full OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_projected.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_project IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights_projected.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_full.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight_projected(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_projected(
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_local
      WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid
                             connid = flight-connid
                             price  = flight-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_filter_project=>tt_sflight_full.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-price = '500.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0100'. <fs_flight>-price = '250.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = '120.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_project( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights_projected( iv_min_price = '150.00' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge gefiltert werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Erster Flug sollte AA sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '500.00' msg = 'Preis sollte 500.00 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' msg = 'Zweiter Flug sollte BA sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'Preis sollte 250.00 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife filtert die Einträge, und die `VALUE`-Konstruktion innerhalb von `REDUCE` projiziert die gewünschten Felder in eine neue Struktur. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenmanipulation in ABAP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge enthält, die entweder von 'FRA' abfliegen oder nach 'JFK' fliegen, und deren Preis unter 300 liegt. Verwenden Sie `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und komplexeren `WHERE`-Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filter,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             deptime   TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime   TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             fromcity  TYPE sflight-fromcity,
             tocity    TYPE sflight-tocity,
           END OF ty_sflight_filter.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_filter OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_filter.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight_filter(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_filter(
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_local
      WHERE ( ( flight-fromcity = 'FRANKFURT' OR flight-tocity = 'NEW YORK' ) AND flight-price < iv_max_price )
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result ( flight ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` in eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel sowie verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             tocity TYPE sflight-tocity,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_airline_summary.
    TYPES tt_airline_summary TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_airline_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_ny_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_full OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_airline_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_full.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, price, tocity
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_airline_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_airline_summary(
      )
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF flight IN lt_sflights_local
      WHERE ( tocity = 'NEW YORK' )
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           ( carrid = <group_key>
                             flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                             total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                             INIT sum_p = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                             FOR member IN GROUP <group_key>
                                             NEXT sum_p = sum_p + member-price
                                           ) ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'NEW YORK'.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'NEW YORK'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0002'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'LONDON'. " Should be filtered out
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0100'. <fs_flight>-price = '250.00'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'NEW YORK'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'LH sollte 2 Flüge haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price exp = '300.00' msg = 'LH Gesamtpreis sollte 300 sein' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'BA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'BA sollte 1 Flug haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'BA' ]-total_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'BA Gesamtpreis sollte 250 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst werden Flüge nach 'NEW YORK' gefiltert und dann nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird ein weiterer `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um den Gesamtpreis zu summieren. Dies demonstriert die hohe Ausdruckskraft und Effizienz moderner ABAP-Syntax für Datenaggregation und -transformation.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` ein neues Feld 'is_expensive' (ABAP_TRUE, wenn Preis > 500, sonst ABAP_FALSE) enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `COND` zur bedingten Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_add_flag DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.
    TYPES tt_sflight_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_flagged,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             is_expensive TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_sflight_flagged.
    TYPES tt_sflight_flagged TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_flagged WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_expensive_flag
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_base OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flagged_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_flagged.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_add_flag IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_expensive_flag.
    DATA: lt_sflights_local TYPE tt_sflight_base.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_local.
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_local = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flagged_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight_flagged(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_flagged(
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_local
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid
                             connid = flight-connid
                             price  = flight-price
                             is_expensive = COND abap_bool(
                                              WHEN flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN abap_true
                                              ELSE abap_false
                                            ) ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_add_flag=>tt_sflight_base.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-price = '600.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0100'. <fs_flight>-price = '450.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_add_flag( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_expensive_flag( iv_price_threshold = '500.00' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_expensive exp = abap_false msg = 'LH sollte nicht teuer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_expensive exp = abap_true msg = 'AA sollte teuer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-is_expensive exp = abap_false msg = 'BA sollte nicht teuer sein' ).

Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine prägnante bedingte Zuweisung des Booleschen Werts basierend auf dem Flugpreis. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art der Datentransformation.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Docking Container am unteren Bildschirmrand und zeigen Sie darin einen Text an. Die Implementierung erfolgt in einer Methode, die in einem Report aufgerufen werden könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_docking_container` und `cl_gui_textedit`. Beachten Sie, dass GUI-Elemente einen Bildschirmkontext benötigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dock_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_docking_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_docking_container.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde diese Methode von einem PBO-Modul eines Dynpros aufgerufen.
    " Für die Demonstration wird der Container erstellt, aber nicht direkt angezeigt, da dies einen Dynpro-Flow erfordert.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '0100'. " Beispiel-Dynpro-Nummer

    " Docking Container am unteren Rand erstellen
    DATA(lo_docking_container) = NEW cl_gui_docking_container(
      parent = cl_gui_container=>screen
      repid  = lv_repid
      dynnr  = lv_dynnr
      side   = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
      ratio  = 50 " 50% der Bildschirmhöhe
    ).

    " Ein einfaches Textedit-Control im Docking Container erstellen
    DATA(lo_text_edit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_docking_container
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_fixed_position
      wordwrap_position = 255
    ).
    lo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'Hallo von Docking Container!' ).

    " Um dies sichtbar zu machen, müsste ein Dynpro 0100 aufgerufen werden.
    " Beispiel: CALL SCREEN '0100'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS display_alv_in_docking_container.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer Codepage in eine andere und fangen Sie dabei mögliche Konvertierungsfehler (z.B. bei nicht darstellbaren Zeichen) ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahmen `cx_abap_conv_codepage` und `cx_abap_conv_init`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp     TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp     TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lv_xstring_temp) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " String (Unicode) -> XSTRING (Source Codepage)
        DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
          encoding = iv_source_cp
        ).
        lo_conv_out->convert(
          EXPORTING data = iv_source_string
          IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring_temp
        ).

        " XSTRING (Source Codepage) -> XSTRING (Target Codepage) - (simuliert durch erneute Konvertierung)
        " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier direkt von Source-XSTRING zu Target-XSTRING konvertieren,
        " oder den XSTRING-Buffer direkt mit dem create_in-Objekt der Zielcodepage verarbeiten.
        " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, lv_xstring_temp ist bereits in der Zielcodepage.

        " XSTRING (Target Codepage) -> String (Unicode)
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
          encoding = iv_target_cp
        ).
        lo_conv_in->convert(
          EXPORTING buffer = lv_xstring_temp
          IMPORTING data = rv_target_string
        ).

    CATCH cx_abap_conv_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_conv_error(
          text = |Codepage-Fehler: { lx_codepage->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    CATCH cx_abap_conv_init INTO DATA(lx_init).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_conv_error(
          text = |Initialisierungsfehler: { lx_init->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce INTO DATA(lx_ce). " Character Error
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_conv_error(
          text = |Zeichen-Konvertierungsfehler: { lx_ce->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_source_string = 'Test'
      iv_source_cp     = '1100' " Latin-1
      iv_target_cp     = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Test' msg = 'Erfolgreiche Konvertierung fehlgeschlagen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    " Versuch, ein Zeichen zu konvertieren, das in der Zielcodepage nicht existiert
    " Hier wird ein Unicode-Zeichen verwendet, das nicht in CP1100 darstellbar ist.
    " ABAP String ist intern Unicode, daher muss der Fehler beim Konvertieren in die Source-XSTRING auftreten.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW cx_abap_conv_error(
      )
      msg = 'Fehlerbehandlung bei ungültigen Zeichen fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
    lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_source_string = '€uro'
      iv_source_cp     = '1100' " Latin-1 (Euro-Zeichen nicht enthalten)
      iv_target_cp     = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die robuste Konvertierung von Daten unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_obj` und integrierter Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`. Spezifische Ausnahmen wie `cx_abap_conv_codepage`, `cx_abap_conv_init` und `cx_abap_conv_ce` werden abgefangen, um Probleme bei der Codepage-Initialisierung oder der Zeichenkonvertierung zu behandeln. Der Unit Test prüft sowohl erfolgreiche Konvertierungen als auch das korrekte Auslösen von Ausnahmen bei Fehlern.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie binäre Daten (XSTRING) von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage, ohne den Umweg über einen ABAP-String zu gehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in` und `create_out` in Kombination, um XSTRING direkt zu konvertieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstr_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_cp      TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp      TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage
        cx_abap_conv_init
        cx_abap_conv_ce.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstr_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = iv_source_cp
    ).
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = iv_target_cp
    ).

    " XSTRING (Source CP) -> ABAP String (Unicode)
    lo_conv_in->convert(
      EXPORTING buffer = iv_source_xstring
      IMPORTING data   = DATA(lv_unicode_string)
    ).

    " ABAP String (Unicode) -> XSTRING (Target CP)
    lo_conv_out->convert(
      EXPORTING data   = lv_unicode_string
      IMPORTING buffer = rv_target_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstr_xstr( ).
    " 'äöü' in Latin-1 (CP1100) ist 'E4F6FC'X

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Datei mit einer spezifischen Codepage (z.B. UTF-8) und schreiben Sie ihn in eine andere Datei mit einer anderen Codepage (z.B. Latin-1).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` mit `cl_abap_file_utilities` oder `OPEN DATASET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_file_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_file_encoding
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_file TYPE string
        iv_target_file TYPE string
        iv_source_cp   TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp   TYPE abap_codepage
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io
        cx_abap_conv_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_file_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_file_encoding.
    DATA(lv_source_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_target_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_unicode_string) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Datei binär lesen
        OPEN DATASET iv_source_file FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_file_io( text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Quelldatei { iv_source_file }| ).
        ENDIF.
        READ DATASET iv_source_file INTO lv_source_xstring.
        CLOSE DATASET iv_source_file.

        " XSTRING (Source CP) -> ABAP String (Unicode)
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
          encoding = iv_source_cp
        ).
        lo_conv_in->convert(
          EXPORTING buffer = lv_source_xstring
          IMPORTING data   = lv_unicode_string
        ).

        " ABAP String (Unicode) -> XSTRING (Target CP)
        DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
          encoding = iv_target_cp
        ).
        lo_conv_out->convert(
          EXPORTING data   = lv_unicode_string
          IMPORTING buffer = lv_target_xstring
        ).

        " Datei binär schreiben
        OPEN DATASET iv_target_file FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_file_io( text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Zieldatei { iv_target_file }| ).
        ENDIF.
        TRANSFER lv_target_xstring TO iv_target_file.
        CLOSE DATASET iv_target_file.

    CATCH cx_abap_conv_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_conv_error( text = |Codepage-Fehler: { lx_codepage->get_text( ) }| ).
    CATCH cx_abap_conv_init INTO DATA(lx_init).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_conv_error( text = |Initialisierungsfehler: { lx_init->get_text( ) }| ).
    CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce INTO DATA(lx_ce).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_conv_error( text = |Zeichen-Konvertierungsfehler: { lx_ce->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_string_table TYPE string_table
        iv_codepage     TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_line_break   TYPE string DEFAULT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage
        cx_abap_conv_init
        cx_abap_conv_ce.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = iv_codepage
    ).
    DATA(lv_line_break_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Zeilenumbruch in Zielcodepage konvertieren
    lo_conv_out->convert(
      EXPORTING data = iv_line_break
      IMPORTING buffer = lv_line_break_xstring
    ).

    LOOP AT it_string_table INTO DATA(lv_line).
      DATA(lv_line_xstring) TYPE xstring.
      lo_conv_out->convert(
        EXPORTING data = lv_line
        IMPORTING buffer = lv_line_xstring
      ).
      rv_xstring = rv_xstring && lv_line_xstring && lv_line_break_xstring.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING-Repräsentation, die mehrere Zeilen in einer bestimmten Codepage enthält, zurück in eine interne Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in` und splitten Sie den resultierenden ABAP-String anhand des Zeilenumbruchs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstr_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_string_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring      TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage     TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_line_break   TYPE string DEFAULT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_string_table) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage
        cx_abap_conv_init
        cx_abap_conv_ce.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstr_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_string_table.
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = iv_codepage
    ).
    DATA(lv_unicode_string) TYPE string.

    " XSTRING (Source CP) -> ABAP String (Unicode)
    lo_conv_in->convert(
      EXPORTING buffer = iv_xstring
      IMPORTING data   = lv_unicode_string
    ).

    " ABAP String in Zeilen splitten
    SPLIT lv_unicode_string AT iv_line_break INTO TABLE rt_string_table.

    " Leere letzte Zeile entfernen, falls der String mit Zeilenumbruch endet
    IF NOT rt_string_table IS INITIAL AND rt_string_table[ lines( rt_string_table ) ] IS INITIAL.
      DELETE rt_string_table INDEX lines( rt_string_table ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle öffentlichen Attribute einer gegebenen Klasse (z.B. `cl_salv_table`) und deren Typen.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr).
      IF ls_attr-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
        APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
          name = ls_attr-name
          type = ls_attr-type_descr->get_name( )
        ) TO rt_attributes.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle Parameter einer Methode einer gegebenen Klasse (z.B. `cl_salv_table=>display`) und deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name`, `get_methods` und `get_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES: tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_method_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parameters) TYPE tt_parameter_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    READ TABLE lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method) WITH KEY name = iv_method_name.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Method { iv_method_name } not found in class { iv_class_name }|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_method_descr) = CAST cl_abap_methdescr( ls_method-type_descr ).
    DATA(lt_parameters) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

    LOOP AT lt_parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
      APPEND VALUE ty_parameter_info(
        name = ls_param-name
        kind = SWITCH string( ls_param-parameter_kind
                 WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_kind_importing THEN 'IMPORTING'
                 WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_kind_exporting THEN 'EXPORTING'
                 WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_kind_changing THEN 'CHANGING'
                 WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_kind_returning THEN 'RETURNING'
                 ELSE 'UNKNOWN' )
        type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_parameters.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur dynamisch sortiert, wobei der Sortierfeldname als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und `SORT` mit dynamischem Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid table reference'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).
    READ TABLE lt_components TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY name = iv_sort_field.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error EXPORTING text = |Sort field '{ iv_sort_field }' not found in table line type.|.
    ENDIF.

    SORT <lt_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer URL wie 'https://example.com/path?param1=value1&param2=value2' die Query-Parameter und deren Werte in eine Hash-Tabelle (String-String-Map).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>parse_url` und den `FOR` Ausdruck, um die Parameter in eine Hash-Tabelle zu überführen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_query_param,
         name  TYPE string,
         value TYPE string,
       END OF ty_query_param.
TYPES: tt_query_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_query_param WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: ty_param_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

CLASS zcl_url_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_query_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_param_map) TYPE ty_param_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_query_params.
    DATA: ls_url_components TYPE cl_http_utility=>ty_url_components.
    DATA: lt_query_params   TYPE tt_query_params.

    cl_http_utility=>parse_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url       = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_components = ls_url_components
    ).

    IF ls_url_components-query IS NOT INITIAL.
      SPLIT ls_url_components-query AT '&' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_raw_params).
      lt_query_params = VALUE #( FOR lv_raw_param IN lt_raw_params
                                   LET lv_pos = find( val = lv_raw_param sub = '=' )
                                   IN ( name  = COND string( WHEN lv_pos > 0 THEN lv_raw_param(lv_pos-1) ELSE lv_raw_param ) 
                                        value = COND string( WHEN lv_pos > 0 THEN lv_raw_param+lv_pos+1 ELSE '' ) ) ).

      rt_param_map = VALUE #( FOR ls_param IN lt_query_params ( ls_param-name = ls_param-value ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mat_group_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_special_mat_groups
      IMPORTING
        it_material_groups TYPE tt_material_groups
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_analysis_result) TYPE string.

    CLASS-DATA gt_special_mat_groups TYPE SORTED TABLE OF mmpur_material_group WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.

CLASS zcl_mat_group_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    " Hypothetische spezielle Materialgruppen, die in cl_mmpur_constants definiert sein könnten
    gt_special_mat_groups = VALUE #( (
      'ROH' ) "Rohstoffe
      ( 'HALB' ) "Halbfertigprodukte
      ( 'FERT' ) "Fertigprodukte
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD analyze_special_mat_groups.
    DATA(lv_found_special) = REDUCE abap_bool(
      INIT lv_found = abap_false
      FOR lv_mat_group IN it_material_groups
      WHERE ( LINE_EXISTS( gt_special_mat_groups WHERE table_line = lv_mat_group ) )
      NEXT lv_found = abap_true
    ).

    rv_analysis_result = COND string(
      WHEN lv_found = abap_true THEN 'Spezielle Materialgruppen gefunden.'
      ELSE 'Keine speziellen Materialgruppen gefunden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine JSON-Konfiguration von einer URL ab, die eine Liste von Einkaufsbelegarten enthält. Validieren Sie jede Belegart in der JSON gegen die gültigen Konstanten aus `cl_mmpur_constants`. Geben Sie eine Liste der ungültigen Belegarten zurück.
hint: `cl_http_utility` für den HTTP-Aufruf, `cl_abap_unit_test_utility` zum Mocken des HTTP-Aufrufs, `cl_json_parser` für JSON, `cl_mmpur_constants` für die Validierung, `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücke.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_data,
         document_types TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mmpur_doc_type WITH EMPTY KEY,
       END OF ty_config_data.
TYPES: tt_invalid_doc_types TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mmpur_doc_type WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_config_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_doc_types_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_invalid_doc_types) TYPE tt_invalid_doc_types
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_valid_mmpur_doc_types TYPE SORTED TABLE OF mmpur_doc_type WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    gt_valid_mmpur_doc_types = VALUE #( (
      cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_doc_type_nb ) "Standardbestellung
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_doc_type_ub ) "Umlagerungsbestellung
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_doc_type_fo ) "Rahmenbestellung
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_doc_type_wk ) "Wertkontrakt
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_doc_type_an ) "Anfrage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_doc_types_from_url.
    DATA: lv_json_content TYPE string.
    DATA: ls_config       TYPE ty_config_data.

    TRY.
        " Fetch JSON content from URL
        lv_json_content = NEW zcl_http_fetch( )->fetch_url_content( iv_url ).

        " Parse JSON
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_json_content
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          CHANGING
            data        = ls_config
        ).

        " Validate document types using FILTER and LINE_EXISTS
        rt_invalid_doc_types = FILTER #( ls_config-document_types
                                         WHERE NOT LINE_EXISTS( gt_valid_mmpur_doc_types WHERE table_line = table_line ) ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON-Parse-Fehler: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_config FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_config FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_http_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_json_error FOR TESTING.

    " Helper to mock HTTP response
    CLASS-METHODS mock_http_response
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        iv_content  TYPE string
        iv_status   TYPE i DEFAULT 200
        iv_error_msg TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mock_http_response.
    DATA: lo_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_response) = lo_client->response.
    lo_response->set_status( code = iv_status reason = iv_error_msg ).
    lo_response->set_cdata( iv_content ).
    lo_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_config.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_config_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://mock.example.com/valid_config.json'.
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"document_types":["NB","FO"]}'.
    mock_http_response( iv_url = lv_url iv_content = lv_json ).

    DATA(lt_invalid) = lo_cut->validate_doc_types_from_url( lv_url ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_invalid msg = 'Expected no invalid document types' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_config.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_config_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://mock.example.com/invalid_config.json'.
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"document_types":["NB","XX","FO","YY"]}'.
    mock_http_response( iv_url = lv_url iv_content = lv_json ).

    DATA(lt_invalid) = lo_cut->validate_doc_types_from_url( lv_url ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_invalid ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 invalid document types' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_invalid[1] exp = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_invalid[2] exp = 'YY' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_http_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_config_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://mock.example.com/error_url'.
    " Simulate HTTP error by not mocking a successful response
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_doc_types_from_url( lv_url ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_static_check for HTTP error' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'HTTP-Fehler' msg = 'Expected HTTP error message' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_json_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_config_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://mock.example.com/malformed_json.json'.
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"document_types":["NB","FO"'. " Malformed JSON
    mock_http_response( iv_url = lv_url iv_content = lv_json ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_doc_types_from_url( lv_url ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_static_check for JSON parse error' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'JSON-Parse-Fehler' msg = 'Expected JSON parse error message' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_http_utility` (indirekt über `zcl_http_fetch`) für den Abruf von Daten, `cl_json` für die JSON-Deserialisierung und `cl_mmpur_constants` für die Validierung von Geschäftsdaten. Der `FILTER` Ausdruck wird verwendet, um ungültige Einträge effizient zu identifizieren. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für HTTP- und JSON-Fehler macht die Lösung robust und modern.

TYPES: tt_urls TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_validation_result,
         url       TYPE string,

         error_msg TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_url_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_url_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_urls.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR lv_url IN it_urls
                           LET lv_is_valid = abap_true
                               lv_error_msg = ''
                           IN ( url       = lv_url
                                is_valid  = COND abap_bool( WHEN cl_http_utility=>check_url( lv_url ) = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
                                error_msg = COND string( WHEN cl_http_utility=>check_url( lv_url ) = abap_false THEN 'Invalid URL format' ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_all_valid_urls.

    DATA(lt_urls) = VALUE zcl_url_validator=>tt_urls(
      ( 'https://www.google.com' )
      ( 'http://www.bing.com' )

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen HTTP-GET-Request und extrahieren Sie einen spezifischen Header-Wert aus der Antwort. Nutzen Sie `cl_http_client` und `cl_http_utility` (indirekt) sowie String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` zum Senden des Requests und zum Zugriff auf die Antwort-Header. String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_header_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_response_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_url       TYPE string
        iv_header_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_header_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_header_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_response_header.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_status_code TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_reason_phrase TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to send HTTP request'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to receive HTTP response'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        lv_reason_phrase = lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason_phrase }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_header_value = lo_http_client->response->get_header_field( iv_header_name ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_error INTO DATA(lx_http_dest_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_dest_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. aus `sflights`). Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach ihrer Währung (`CURRENCY`) und berechnen Sie für jede Währung die Summe der Flugpreise (`PRICE`). Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
         price    TYPE sflight-price,
         currency TYPE sflight-currency,
       END OF ty_flight_data.
TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_total,
         currency TYPE sflight-currency,
         total_price TYPE sflight-price,
       END OF ty_currency_total.
TYPES: tt_currency_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_flights_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_currency_totals) TYPE tt_currency_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_currency.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-currency ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(lv_currency_group).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP lv_currency_group
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_currency_total( currency = lv_currency_group
                                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_currency_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Reduziere den Lagerbestand für bestimmte Produkte in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Entnahmen.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `SUBTRACT`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_stock,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_product_stock.
    TYPES ty_product_stocks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_stock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_withdrawal,
             product_id TYPE string,
             amount     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_withdrawal.
    TYPES ty_withdrawals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_withdrawal WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_subtract_stock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS adjust_stock
          IMPORTING
            it_current_stock TYPE ty_product_stocks
            it_withdrawals   TYPE ty_withdrawals
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_adjusted_stock) TYPE ty_product_stocks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_stock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_stock.
    rt_adjusted_stock = it_current_stock. " Start with current stock

    LOOP AT it_withdrawals INTO DATA(ls_withdrawal).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_stock> LIKE LINE OF rt_adjusted_stock.
      READ TABLE rt_adjusted_stock ASSIGNING <fs_stock>
        WITH KEY product_id = ls_withdrawal-product_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SUBTRACT ls_withdrawal-amount FROM <fs_stock>-quantity.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_net_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_net_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_gross_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_discount_pct TYPE p DECIMALS 2 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_subtract_net_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_price.
    rv_net_price = iv_gross_price.
    IF iv_discount_pct IS SUPPLIED AND iv_discount_pct > 0.
      DATA(lv_discount_amount) = iv_gross_price * iv_discount_pct / 100.
      SUBTRACT lv_discount_amount FROM rv_net_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gegeben sind zwei interne Tabellen mit Produktmengen (z.B. Soll- und Ist-Bestand). Berechne die Differenz für jedes Produkt und speichere sie in einer neuen Tabelle. Produkte, die nur in einer der Tabellen vorkommen, sollen ebenfalls mit ihrer Menge (oder negativer Menge) berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `SUBTRACT` oder arithmetischen Ausdrücken.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_quantity,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_product_quantity.
    TYPES ty_product_quantities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_quantity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_difference,
             product_id TYPE string,
             difference TYPE i,
           END OF ty_product_difference.
    TYPES ty_product_differences TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_difference WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_mix_subtract_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_stock_difference
          IMPORTING
            it_expected_stock TYPE ty_product_quantities
            it_actual_stock   TYPE ty_product_quantities
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_differences) TYPE ty_product_differences.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_subtract_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_stock_difference.
    DATA(lt_all_products) = VALUE ty_product_quantities(
      BASE it_expected_stock
      FOR ls_actual IN it_actual_stock WHERE product_id NOT IN it_expected_stock
      ( product_id = ls_actual-product_id quantity = 0 ) " Add products only in actual stock
    ).

    rt_differences = VALUE ty_product_differences(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_product IN lt_all_products GROUP BY ls_product-product_id ASCENDING
      ( product_id = ls_product-product_id
        difference = REDUCE i(
          INIT lv_diff = 0
          FOR ls_expected IN it_expected_stock WHERE ( product_id = ls_product-product_id )
          NEXT lv_diff = lv_diff + ls_expected-quantity
          FOR ls_actual IN it_actual_stock WHERE ( product_id = ls_product-product_id )
          NEXT lv_diff = lv_diff - ls_actual-quantity
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den Lagerbestand in einer Zieltabelle, indem du die verkauften Mengen aus einer Verkaufstabelle abziehst. Verwende dabei die Feldnamen-Korrespondenz und den `MAP`-Operator.
hint: Nutze `MAP` in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` und arithmetischen Ausdrücken.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stock_item,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_stock_item.
    TYPES ty_stock_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_stock_item WITH UNIQUE KEY material.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             material TYPE string,
             sold_qty TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES ty_sales_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_mix_update_stock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS update_stock_from_sales
          IMPORTING
            it_initial_stock TYPE ty_stock_table
            it_sales         TYPE ty_sales_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_updated_stock) TYPE ty_stock_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_update_stock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_stock_from_sales.
    rt_updated_stock = it_initial_stock.

    rt_updated_stock = MAP ty_stock_table FROM rt_updated_stock
      USING it_sales AS sales_tab
      FOR ls_stock IN rt_updated_stock
      LET ls_sales = sales_tab[ KEY material = ls_stock-material DEFAULT quantity = 0 ] IN
      ( CORRESPONDING ty_stock_item( ls_stock )
        quantity = ls_stock-quantity - ls_sales-sold_qty
      ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mix_update_stock( ).
    DATA(lt_updated_stock) = lo_cut->update_stock_from_sales(
      it_initial_stock = lt_initial_stock

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `MAP`-Operators, um eine interne Tabelle basierend auf Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle zu aktualisieren. Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator wird implizit verwendet, um die Felder der Zeilen zu initialisieren, während die `quantity` mit einem arithmetischen Ausdruck (`ls_stock-quantity - ls_sales-sold_qty`) aktualisiert wird. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode zur Tabellenbearbeitung.
keywords: SUBTRACT, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, MAP, Arithmetic, Update

Instructions: Berechne für jeden Flug in der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle den Gewinn, indem du die Kosten von den Einnahmen abziehst. Speichere das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und den Gewinn enthält.
hint: Verwende `SELECT` mit `CORRESPONDING` und arithmetischen Ausdrücken direkt in Open SQL.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_profit,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             profit   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_profit.
    TYPES ty_flight_profits TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_profit WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_mix_sflights_profit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_flight_profits
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_profits) TYPE ty_flight_profits.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_sflights_profit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_profits.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           ( price - paymentsum ) AS profit
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_profits.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_calculate_profits.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mix_sflights_profit( ).

  METHOD test_profit_calculation.

Instructions: Berechne die verbleibende Kapazität für eine Liste von Containern, indem du die bereits belegte Kapazität von der maximalen Kapazität abziehst. Verwende `SUBTRACT` innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `SUBTRACT` für die Berechnung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_container_data,
             container_id TYPE string,
             max_capacity TYPE i,
             used_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_container_data.
    TYPES ty_container_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_container_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_container_remaining,
             container_id TYPE string,
             remaining_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_container_remaining.
    TYPES ty_container_remaining_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_container_remaining WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_mix_container_cap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_remaining_capacity
          IMPORTING
            it_containers TYPE ty_container_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_remaining) TYPE ty_container_remaining_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_container_cap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_capacity.
    rt_remaining = VALUE ty_container_remaining_table(
      FOR ls_container IN it_containers
      LET lv_remaining = ls_container-max_capacity IN
        ( container_id = ls_container-container_id,
          remaining_capacity = lv_remaining - ls_container-used_capacity )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Übertrage Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Wenn ein Feld in der Zielstruktur einen Wert 'X' hat, ziehe einen festen Betrag von einem korrespondierenden numerischen Feld ab.
hint: Kombiniere `CORRESPONDING` mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für bedingte Subtraktion.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_config,
             item_id TYPE string,
             base_value TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             flag_discount TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source_config.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_processed,
             item_id TYPE string,
             final_value TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             flag_discount TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_processed.

    CLASS zcl_mix_corr_cond_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CONSTANTS gc_discount_amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '5.00'.

        METHODS process_config
          IMPORTING
            is_source TYPE ty_source_config
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_corr_cond_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_config.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING final_value = base_value ).

    IF rs_target-flag_discount = 'X'.
      SUBTRACT gc_discount_amount FROM rs_target-final_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Eintrag einer Quelltabelle den `net_amount` berechnet, indem `tax_amount` von `gross_amount` abgezogen wird. Verwende dabei den `FOR`-Ausdruck und den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING` und einem arithmetischen Ausdruck für die Subtraktion.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gross_data,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             gross_amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             tax_amount  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_gross_data.
    TYPES ty_gross_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gross_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_net_data,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             net_amount  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_net_data.
    TYPES ty_net_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_net_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_mix_for_corr_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_net_amounts
          IMPORTING
            it_gross_data TYPE ty_gross_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_net_data) TYPE ty_net_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_for_corr_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_amounts.
    rt_net_data = VALUE ty_net_table(
      FOR ls_gross IN it_gross_data
      ( CORRESPONDING ty_net_data( ls_gross )
        net_amount = ls_gross-gross_amount - ls_gross-tax_amount )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination des `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit dem `CORRESPONDING`-Operator. Für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle wird eine neue Zeile in der Zieltabelle erstellt. `CORRESPONDING ty_net_data( ls_gross )` initialisiert die neue Zeile mit den korrespondierenden Feldern, und `net_amount = ...` überschreibt dann den Wert mit dem Ergebnis der Subtraktion. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Methode zur Transformation von Tabellen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, FOR, Arithmetic, Data Transformation, Functional

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen den Tabellen SFLIGHT und SCARR durch, um Fluggesellschaften und ihre Flüge zu verknüpfen. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flügen, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... WHERE ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
