Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (SCARR) und die durchschnittliche Flugdauer (SFLIGHT) für alle Flüge. Verwenden Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN, um auch Fluggesellschaften ohne Flüge anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... GROUP BY ... AVG(...) COUNT(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_duration TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_stats RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( s~connid ) AS flight_count, AVG( s~fltime ) AS avg_duration
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_stats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_stats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_stats msg = 'Statistiken sollten gefunden werden.' ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob Lufthansa (LH) Flüge hat
    DATA(ls_lh_stats) = VALUE #( lt_stats[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_stats IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_stats-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben.' ).
    END IF.

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob eine Fluggesellschaft ohne Flüge (falls vorhanden) korrekt angezeigt wird
    DATA(lv_found_zero_flights) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_stats INTO DATA(ls_stat).
      IF ls_stat-flight_count = 0.
        lv_found_zero_flights = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_zero_flights msg = 'Es sollte mindestens eine Fluggesellschaft ohne Flüge geben (abhängig von Testdaten).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen LEFT OUTER JOIN, um alle Fluggesellschaften anzuzeigen, auch wenn sie keine zugehörigen Flüge in SFLIGHT haben. Aggregationsfunktionen wie `COUNT()` und `AVG()` werden zusammen mit `GROUP BY` verwendet, um Statistiken pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Die `VALUE #()`-Syntax wird für den Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen verwendet.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, Aggregation, GROUP BY, SFLIGHT, SCARR, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Zeitstempel, der 3 Stunden und 30 Minuten in der Zukunft liegt, basierend auf dem aktuellen System-Zeitstempel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>ADD_SECONDS()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_arithmetic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_timestamp RETURNING VALUE(rv_future_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_arithmetic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_system_time( ).
    " 3 Stunden * 3600 Sekunden/Stunde + 30 Minuten * 60 Sekunden/Minute
    DATA(lv_seconds_to_add) = 3 * 3600 + 30 * 60.
    rv_future_tstmp = lv_current_tstmp->add_seconds( lv_seconds_to_add )->get_timestamp( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen gegebenen Zeitstempel in ein benutzerdefiniertes String-Format, z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (TZ)'. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei eine bestimmte Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE_FROM_TIMESTAMP_UTCLONG()` und `GET_TIMESTAMP_AS_STRING()` mit Formatierungsoptionen.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_timestamp_custom
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_tzone     TYPE timezone DEFAULT 'CET'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_tstmp) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_timestamp_custom.
    DATA(lo_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestamp_utclong( iv_timestamp ).

    " Konvertierung in die gewünschte Zeitzone
    DATA(lo_tstmp_local) = lo_tstmp->convert_to_tzone( iv_tzone ).

    " Manuelle Formatierung für volle Kontrolle
    DATA(lv_date) = lo_tstmp_local->get_date( ).
    DATA(lv_time) = lo_tstmp_local->get_time( ).

    rv_formatted_tstmp = |{ lv_date(4) }-{ lv_date+4(2) }-{ lv_date+6(2) } { lv_time(2) }:{ lv_time+2(2) }:{ lv_time+4(2) } ({ iv_tzone })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Zeitstempel und bestimmen Sie, welcher der frühere ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Vergleichsoperatoren direkt auf `TIMESTAMPL`-Variablen oder die Methoden von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_earlier_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_timestamps.
    IF iv_tstmp1 < iv_tstmp2.
      rv_earlier_tstmp = iv_tstmp1.
    ELSE.
      rv_earlier_tstmp = iv_tstmp2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_timestamps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_compare( ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp_earlier) = '20230101120000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_later)   = '20230101130000.0000000'.

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_earlier iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_later ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = lv_tstmp_earlier msg = 'Der frühere Zeitstempel sollte zurückgegeben werden.' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_later iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_earlier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = lv_tstmp_earlier msg = 'Der frühere Zeitstempel sollte auch bei vertauschten Argumenten zurückgegeben werden.' ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp_equal) = '20230101120000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_earlier iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = lv_tstmp_earlier msg = 'Bei gleichen Zeitstempeln sollte einer zurückgegeben werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeitstempel vom Typ `TIMESTAMPL` können direkt mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `=`, usw.) verglichen werden, was eine einfache und intuitive Methode für den Vergleich bietet. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber wichtige Funktion für die Arbeit mit Zeitdaten.
keywords: Timestamp, Comparison, TIMESTAMPL, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (SCARR) die Anzahl der Flüge (SFLIGHT) und die Anzahl der Routen (SPFLI). Zeigen Sie nur Fluggesellschaften an, die sowohl Flüge als auch Routen haben. Verwenden Sie `COUNT(DISTINCT ...)` für Routen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN`s und `GROUP BY` mit `COUNT()` und `COUNT(DISTINCT ...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_complex_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             route_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_complex_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( DISTINCT s~connid ) AS flight_count, COUNT( DISTINCT p~connid ) AS route_count
      FROM scarr AS c
      INNER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON c~carrid = p~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT s~connid ) > 0 AND COUNT( DISTINCT p~connid ) > 0
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_complex_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'Zusammenfassung sollte nicht leer sein.' ).

    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'Fluganzahl muss > 0 sein.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_summary-route_count > 0 ) msg = 'Routenanzahl muss > 0 sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere `INNER JOIN`s mit Aggregationsfunktionen (`COUNT(DISTINCT ...)`), um eindeutige Zählungen zu erhalten. Die `HAVING`-Klausel filtert die Ergebnisse nach der Aggregation, um nur Fluggesellschaften anzuzeigen, die sowohl Flüge als auch Routen haben. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für Datenbankabfragen.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, SELECT, Aggregation, COUNT DISTINCT, GROUP BY, HAVING, SFLIGHT, SCARR, SPFLI

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTC-Zeitstempel in die lokale Zeitzone des Benutzers (SY-ZONLO) und geben Sie das Datum und die Uhrzeit zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE_FROM_TIMESTAMP_UTCLONG()` und `CONVERT_TO_TZONE()` mit `SY-ZONLO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_local_tzone DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_local_datetime,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
             time TYPE sy-uzeit,
           END OF ty_local_datetime.

      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_datetime) TYPE ty_local_datetime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_local_tzone IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_local_datetime.
    DATA(lo_tstmp_utc) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestamp_utclong( iv_utc_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_tstmp_local) = lo_tstmp_utc->convert_to_tzone( sy-zonlo ).

    rs_local_datetime-date = lo_tstmp_local->get_date( ).
    rs_local_datetime-time = lo_tstmp_local->get_time( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_local_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_local_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_local_tzone( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231027100000.0000000'. " 10:00:00 UTC

    " Annahme: System-Zeitzone ist CET (UTC+1)
    " Wenn SY-ZONLO = 'CET', dann sollte die lokale Zeit 11:00:00 sein.
    DATA(ls_local_dt) = lo_cut->get_local_datetime( iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_tstmp ).

    " Dieser Test ist abhängig von der System-Zeitzone (SY-ZONLO).
    " Für CET (UTC+1) sollte das Ergebnis 20231027 110000 sein.
    IF sy-zonlo = 'CET'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-date exp = '20231027' msg = 'Lokales Datum für CET fehlerhaft.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-time exp = '110000' msg = 'Lokale Uhrzeit für CET fehlerhaft.' ).
    ELSEIF sy-zonlo = 'EST'. " Beispiel für EST (UTC-5)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-date exp = '20231027' msg = 'Lokales Datum für EST fehlerhaft.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-time exp = '050000' msg = 'Lokale Uhrzeit für EST fehlerhaft.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung von UTC-Zeitstempeln in eine spezifische Zeitzone ist ein häufiges Szenario. `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE_FROM_TIMESTAMP_UTCLONG()` erstellt ein Zeitstempelobjekt aus einem UTC-Zeitstempel, und `convert_to_tzone( sy-zonlo )` passt es an die lokale Zeitzone des Benutzers an. Dies gewährleistet eine korrekte Anzeige der Zeit, unabhängig vom Standort des Benutzers.
keywords: CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Timezone, UTC, SY-ZONLO, Date/Time

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Sekunden zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln und geben Sie diese als Ganzzahl zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>GET_TOTAL_SECONDS()` oder die Subtraktionsmethode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_timestamp_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_diff_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_timestamp_difference.
    DATA(lo_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestamp_utclong( iv_tstmp1 ).
    DATA(lo_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestamp_utclong( iv_tstmp2 ).

    " Die Differenzmethode gibt ein neues TSTMP-Objekt zurück, das die Differenz darstellt
    DATA(lo_diff) = lo_tstmp1->subtract( lo_tstmp2 ).
    rv_diff_seconds = lo_diff->get_total_seconds( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_timestamp_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_timestamp_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_diff( ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp_start) = '20230101100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_end)   = '20230101100530.0000000'. " 5 Minuten und 30 Sekunden später

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->get_timestamp_difference( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_end iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_start ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 330 msg = 'Differenz sollte 330 Sekunden sein.' ).

    DATA(lv_diff_negative) = lo_cut->get_timestamp_difference( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_start iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_end ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_negative exp = -330 msg = 'Differenz sollte -330 Sekunden sein.' ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp_same) = '20230101100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_diff_zero) = lo_cut->get_timestamp_difference( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_same iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_same ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_zero exp = 0 msg = 'Differenz sollte 0 Sekunden sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `subtract()` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` ist die moderne und korrekte Art, die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln zu berechnen. Sie gibt ein neues `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`-Objekt zurück, das die Zeitspanne darstellt, aus der dann die Gesamtzahl der Sekunden mit `get_total_seconds()` extrahiert werden kann. Dies ist präziser als die manuelle Subtraktion von `TIMESTAMPL`-Werten.
keywords: CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Difference, Subtract, Date/Time, get_total_seconds

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_upcoming_flight.
    TYPES tt_upcoming_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_upcoming_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_upcoming_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_upcoming_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_tstmp_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_system_time( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date)  = lo_current_tstmp->get_date( ).
    DATA(lv_future_date)   = lo_current_tstmp->add_days( 7 )->get_date( ).

    SELECT connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
        AND fldate BETWEEN @lv_current_date AND @lv_future_date
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Es ist schwierig, einen genauen Assert für die Anzahl der Flüge zu machen, da die SFLIGHT-Daten statisch sind

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Zeitstempel in der Vergangenheit liegt (bezogen auf den aktuellen System-Zeitstempel).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE_FROM_TIMESTAMP_UTCLONG()` und vergleichen Sie mit `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE_FROM_SYSTEM_TIME()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_past DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_timestamp_in_past
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_past) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_past IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_timestamp_in_past.
    DATA(lo_given_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestamp_utclong( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_system_time( ).

    IF lo_given_tstmp->get_timestamp( ) < lo_current_tstmp->get_timestamp( ).
      rv_is_past = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_past = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_timestamp_in_past FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_timestamp_in_past.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_is_past( ).

    " Zeitstempel in der Vergangenheit
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = '20200101120000.0000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_past_tstmp ) msg = 'Vergangener Zeitstempel sollte als Vergangenheit erkannt werden.' ).

    " Zeitstempel in der Zukunft (oder sehr nah an jetzt)
    DATA(lo_future_tstmp_obj) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_system_time( )->add_seconds( 60 ).
    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = lo_future_tstmp_obj->get_timestamp( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_future_tstmp ) msg = 'Zukünftiger Zeitstempel sollte nicht als Vergangenheit erkannt werden.' ).

    " Aktueller Zeitstempel (sollte nicht als Vergangenheit gelten)
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_system_time( )->get_timestamp( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_current_tstmp ) msg = 'Aktueller Zeitstempel sollte nicht als Vergangenheit erkannt werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert den Vergleich eines beliebigen Zeitstempels mit dem aktuellen System-Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, ob er in der Vergangenheit liegt. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für beide Zeitstempel gewährleistet einen konsistenten und korrekten Vergleich, da sie die zugrunde liegenden UTC-Werte verwendet.
keywords: CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Comparison, Past, Date/Time, abap_bool

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und die dabei auftretende Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` abfängt. Die Methode soll im Fehlerfall eine vordefinierte Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie die spezifische Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division successful: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Error: Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_exception_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Division successful: 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_exception_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Division by zero is not allowed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` zur Behandlung einer spezifischen, vordefinierten Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`). Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie String-Templates (`|...|`) wird für die Ausgabe verwendet.
keywords: CATCH, EXCEPTION, TRY, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Zeichenkette in eine Zahl umwandelt. Fangen Sie sowohl die Ausnahme für ungültige Zahlenformate (`CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER`) als auch die Division durch Null (`CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`) ab, falls eine weitere Operation durchgeführt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke in einem `TRY`-Block, um verschiedene Ausnahmen zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string_and_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_divisor      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string_and_divide.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_number = iv_input_string. " May raise CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER
        DATA(lv_division_result) = lv_number / iv_divisor. " May raise CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
        rv_result = |Calculation successful: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number.
        rv_result = |Error: Input '{ iv_input_string }' is not a valid number.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Error: Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Operation ausführt, die verschiedene Ausnahmen auslösen kann. Fangen Sie eine spezifische Ausnahme ab und alle anderen Ausnahmen mit `CATCH OTHERS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH OTHERS` als letzten `CATCH`-Block, um alle nicht explizit behandelten Ausnahmen abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE i.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a conversion error
        IF iv_value = 'ERROR'.
          lv_number = 'ABC'. " This will raise CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER
        ELSEIF iv_value = 'DIVIDE_BY_ZERO'.
          lv_number = 10 / 0. " This will raise CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
        ELSE.
          lv_number = iv_value.
          rv_message = |Operation successful with value: { lv_number }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        rv_message = |Specific Error: Invalid number format - { lx_conv->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH OTHERS INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_message = |General Error: An unexpected error occurred - { lx_other->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_specific_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_success.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_catch_others( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Operation successful with value: 123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_specific_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_catch_others( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 'ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Specific Error: Invalid number format' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_catch_others( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 'DIVIDE_BY_ZERO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'General Error: An unexpected error occurred - Division by zero' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CATCH OTHERS` ist eine Best Practice, um sicherzustellen, dass keine Ausnahme unbehandelt bleibt. Es sollte immer als letzter `CATCH`-Block verwendet werden, um spezifischere Behandlungen nicht zu überschreiben. `GET_TEXT()` wird verwendet, um die Fehlermeldung der Ausnahme zu erhalten.
keywords: CATCH OTHERS, EXCEPTION, TRY, GET_TEXT

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Ressourcennutzung (z.B. eine temporäre Datei oder eine Datenbankverbindung), die im Fehlerfall oder nach erfolgreicher Ausführung bereinigt werden muss. Verwenden Sie den `CLEANUP`-Block, um die Ressource freizugeben.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor die Ausnahme an den aufrufenden Kontext weitergegeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_resource_open) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        " Simulate opening a resource
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        rv_message = 'Resource opened.'.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Simulate an error
        ENDIF.

        rv_message = rv_message && ' Data processed successfully.'.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_message = rv_message && ' Error during data processing.'.
      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulate closing the resource
          rv_message = rv_message && ' Resource closed in CLEANUP.'.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_success_with_cleanup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_with_cleanup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_success_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_demo->process_data( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Resource opened. Data processed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_demo->process_data( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Resource opened. Error during data processing. Resource closed in CLEANUP.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist entscheidend für die Gewährleistung der Ressourcenfreigabe, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, sei es durch eine Ausnahme oder durch normalen Programmfluss. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine simulierte Ressource zu schließen.
keywords: CLEANUP, EXCEPTION, TRY, RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse `ZCX_INVALID_INPUT`. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die diese Ausnahme auslöst, wenn eine bestimmte Eingabebedingung nicht erfüllt ist, und fangen Sie diese benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... INHERITING FROM CX_STATIC_CHECK` für die Definition der Ausnahme und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` zum Auslösen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS handle_process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_message = |Value { iv_value } processed successfully.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_process_value.
    TRY.
        rv_message = me->process_value( iv_value ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_message = |Caught custom exception: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden (z.B. `add`, `subtract`). Implementieren Sie eine zentrale Methode, die dynamisch eine dieser Methoden aufruft, basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name)` für den dynamischen Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param1      TYPE i
        iv_param2      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_dynamic_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    rv_result = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_descr_class TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_descr_method TYPE REF TO cl_abap_mtddescr.

    TRY.
        lo_descr_class ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALL' ).
        lo_descr_method ?= lo_descr_class->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

        " Create parameter table for dynamic call
        DATA(lt_parameters) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
          ( name = 'IV_VAL1' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_importing value = REF #( iv_param1 ) )
          ( name = 'IV_VAL2' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_importing value = REF #( iv_param2 ) )
        ).
        DATA(lt_return) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
          ( name = 'RV_RESULT' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_returning )
        ).

        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF me
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING PARAMETER-TABLE lt_return.

        " Extract result from return table
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_return_param>) INDEX 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_dynamic_result = <fs_return_param>-value->* .
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_dyn_call.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_dynamic_add FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_add.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'ADD' iv_param1 = 5 iv_param2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_subtract.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'SUBTRACT' iv_param1 = 10 iv_param2 = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 6 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    TRY.
        lo_caller->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'MULTIPLY' iv_param1 = 2 iv_param2 = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR for invalid method.' ).

Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über `PARAMETER-TABLE` mit `abap_parmbind_tab`. RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_MTDDESCR`) können zur Validierung der Methode vor dem Aufruf verwendet werden.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) empfängt und den Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes für jede Zeile ausliest und zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_field_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE tt_field_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight_data,
                   <fs_field_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field_value> }| TO rt_field_values.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.| TO rt_field_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitung oder Reporting. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols (`<fs_field_value>`) ermöglicht den Zugriff auf den dynamischen Inhalt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentypnamen erzeugt und mit Beispieldaten füllt. Die Methode soll die gefüllte Tabelle als generischen Daten-Pointer zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_create_data_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    " Populate with dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
    IF iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_sflight_line) TYPE sflight.
      ASSIGN lr_sflight_line->* TO <fs_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = '0400'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = '0017'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle liest. Der Tabellenname und die WHERE-Klausel sollen zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden. Die Ergebnisse sollen in einer generischen internen Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM (table_name) WHERE (where_clause) INTO TABLE @DATA(result_table)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_where_clause TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    DATA(lv_sql_statement) = |SELECT * FROM { iv_table_name }|.
    IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_sql_statement = lv_sql_statement && | WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_table_name).
        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_sql_statement } INTO TABLE :<fs_table>
        ENDEXEC.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl außerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs liegt, soll eine Ausnahme `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` ausgelöst und abgefangen werden. Die Verarbeitung soll für die restlichen Zahlen fortgesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb einer Schleife, um Ausnahmen pro Element zu behandeln und die Schleife fortzusetzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_exception_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers_with_range_check
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min     TYPE i
        iv_max     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_exception_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers_with_range_check.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      TRY.
          IF lv_number < iv_min OR lv_number > iv_max.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND |Number { lv_number } is within range.| TO rt_results.
        CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
          APPEND |Number { lv_number } is out of range [{ iv_min }, { iv_max }].| TO rt_results.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mixed_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_all_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_all_out_of_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mixed_numbers.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_range_exception_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 5 ) ( 15 ) ( 25 ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_numbers_with_range_check( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Number 5 is out of range [10, 20].' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Number 15 is within range.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = 'Number 25 is out of range [10, 20].' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_in_range.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_range_exception_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 15 ) ( 20 ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_numbers_with_range_check( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Number 10 is within range.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Number 15 is within range.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = 'Number 20 is within range.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_out_of_range.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_range_exception_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_numbers_with_range_check( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Number 1 is out of range [10, 20].' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Number 30 is out of range [10, 20].' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb einer Schleife, um Ausnahmen für einzelne Elemente zu behandeln, ohne die gesamte Schleifenverarbeitung zu unterbrechen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Verarbeitung fehlerhafter Elemente übersprungen oder protokolliert werden soll, während die Verarbeitung gültiger Elemente fortgesetzt wird.
keywords: CATCH, EXCEPTION, TRY, LOOP, CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Kette von Funktionsaufrufen durchführt, wobei jeder Aufruf eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Verwenden Sie `RESUME` im `CATCH`-Block, um die Verarbeitung nach einer Ausnahme fortzusetzen, falls dies sinnvoll ist.
hint: Die `RESUME`-Anweisung ist nur für resumable Exceptions (`CX_STATIC_CHECK` mit `RESUMABLE` Zusatz) relevant. Sie ermöglicht die Fortsetzung der Verarbeitung nach dem `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS step_one
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_resumable_error.
    METHODS step_two
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS execute_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error_step1 TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD step_one.
    IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_resumable_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_message = 'Step One completed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD step_two.
    rv_message = 'Step Two completed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_process.
    DATA(lv_log) = 'Process started: '.
    TRY.
        lv_log = lv_log && me->step_one( iv_trigger_error_step1 ) && ' '.
        lv_log = lv_log && me->step_two( ) && ' '.
        rv_final_message = lv_log && 'Process finished successfully.'.
      CATCH zcx_resumable_error INTO DATA(lx_resumable).
        lv_log = lv_log && |Caught resumable error: { lx_resumable->get_text( ) } |.
        RESUME.
        " Code after RESUME will be executed if the exception is resumable
        lv_log = lv_log && 'Resumed after error. '.
        lv_log = lv_log && me->step_two( ) && ' '.
        rv_final_message = lv_log && 'Process finished with recovery.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `READ TABLE` Anweisung generiert und anwendet. Die Felder und Werte für die Bedingung sollen als interne Tabelle von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ('(field_name)') = (value)` oder dynamische Field-Symbols für die `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_condition,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_condition.
    TYPES: tt_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_condition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_data
        it_conditions   TYPE tt_conditions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_entry) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_key_field>    TYPE any.

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = VALUE string_table( ).

    LOOP AT it_conditions INTO DATA(ls_condition).
      APPEND |{ ls_condition-field_name } = '{ ls_condition-field_value }'| TO lv_where_clause.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_dynamic_key) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR w IN lv_where_clause
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN w ELSE s && ' AND ' && w ) ).

    IF lv_dynamic_key IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_read_table_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        READ TABLE it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line> WITH KEY (lv_dynamic_key).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rs_found_entry = <fs_source_line>.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_table_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_read_table_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_read_table_error INTO DATA(lx_read_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_read_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen dynamisch sortiert. Der Sortierfeldname und die Sortierrichtung (aufsteigend/absteigend) sollen zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT ... BY (field_name) ASCENDING/DESCENDING` mit dynamischen Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sort_data.
    TYPES: tt_sort_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sort_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sort_data
        iv_sort_field   TYPE string
        iv_direction    TYPE string " 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_table) TYPE tt_sort_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_table = it_source_table.

    DATA(lv_sort_statement) = |BY { iv_sort_field }|.
    IF iv_direction = 'DESCENDING'.
      lv_sort_statement = lv_sort_statement && ' DESCENDING'.
    ELSEIF iv_direction <> 'ASCENDING'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sort_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_sort_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SORT rt_sorted_table (lv_sort_statement).
      CATCH cx_sy_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_sort_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sort_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle filtert. Die Filterbedingung soll als String übergeben werden, der einen gültigen ABAP-Ausdruck darstellt (z.B. 'ID > 5 AND NAME = ''Test''').

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl verfügbarer Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_seats )
        ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) )
      msg = 'Should contain flights for LH'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect airline' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 100 )
        msg = 'Not enough free seats'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht eine deklarative Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile. In Kombination mit `VALUE #` wird eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Filterkriterien erstellt, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, VALUE #, Internal Tables, Filtering, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Flugnummer validiert. Wenn die Flugnummer leer ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_abap_behv_message=>t_textid OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_abap_behv_message~m_attributes = VALUE #(
        BASE if_abap_behv_message~m_attributes
        ( name = 'FLIGHT_NUMBER' value = '' )
    ).
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_abap_behv_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '001' msgty = 'E' ). "Example message: 'Flight number is initial'
    ELSE.
      if_abap_behv_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_flight_number TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF iv_flight_number IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_number
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '002' msgty = 'E' ). "Example message: 'Flight number &1 is invalid'
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count  = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) )
      msg = 'Should contain counts for LH'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count-carrid msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ls_count-count > 0 )
        msg = 'Flight count should be positive'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #` und `REDUCE` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... AT END OF` oder `COLLECT`-Anweisungen durch eine deklarative Syntax.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein Datum validiert. Wenn das Datum ungültig ist (z.B. '00000000'), soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DATFM` oder eine einfache Prüfung und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE CX_SY_DATE_IS_INITIAL` / `CX_SY_DATE_IS_INVALID`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RAISING
        cx_sy_date_is_initial
        cx_sy_date_is_invalid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_date.
    IF iv_date IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_date_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
    " Simple check for invalid date format (e.g., '20230230')
    " CL_ABAP_DATFM can be used for more robust validation, but a simple check is sufficient here.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_year)  = iv_date(4).
        DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).
        DATA(lv_day)   = iv_date+6(2).
        CHECK lv_year BETWEEN '0001' AND '9999'.
        CHECK lv_month BETWEEN '01' AND '12'.
        CHECK lv_day BETWEEN '01' AND '31'. "Simplified, not checking days per month
        " More robust check:
        DATA(lv_date_obj) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
        lv_date_obj = iv_date. "This will raise CX_SY_DATE_IS_INVALID if format is wrong
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error. "Catch if date string cannot be converted
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_date_is_invalid.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds. "Catch if date string is too short/long
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_date_is_invalid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft angeboten werden und deren Flugnummer in einer Liste von bevorzugten Flugnummern enthalten ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE`-Klauseln und `COND #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_nested_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_matching_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_preferred_connids TYPE tt_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_matching_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_nested_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_matching_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_matching_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
        ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_preferred_connids[ table_line = ls_sflight-connid ] )
                  THEN VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ) )
    ).
    DELETE rt_matching_flights WHERE carrid IS INITIAL. "Remove initial lines from COND #
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_nested_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_preferred) = VALUE zcl_for_nested_sflights=>tt_connid( ( '0400' ) ( '0017' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_matching_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_preferred_connids = lt_preferred ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ) )
      msg = 'Should contain LH 0400'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' ] ) )
      msg = 'Should contain LH 0017'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_nested_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_preferred) = VALUE zcl_for_nested_sflights=>tt_connid( ( '9999' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_matching_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_preferred_connids = lt_preferred ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `FOR`-Expressions sind zwar möglich, aber hier wurde eine effizientere Methode mit `FOR ... WHERE` und `COND #` verwendet, um die Existenz in der zweiten Tabelle zu prüfen. Dies ist oft performanter als echte verschachtelte Schleifen und führt zu kompakterem Code.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, COND #, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob eine Fluggesellschaft existiert. Wenn nicht, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die die fehlende Fluggesellschaft angibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme und einem Attribut für die Fluggesellschaft.
solution:
CLASS zcx_carrier_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_abap_behv_message=>t_textid OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_carrier_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->if_abap_behv_message~m_attributes = VALUE #(
        BASE if_abap_behv_message~m_attributes
        ( name = 'CARRID' value = iv_carrid )
    ).
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_abap_behv_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '003' msgty = 'E' ). "Example message: 'Airline &1 not found'
    ELSE.
      if_abap_behv_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_carrier_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RAISING
        zcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_carrier_exists.
    DATA lv_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO @lv_exists.

    IF lv_exists = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_carrier_not_found
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid
          textid = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '003' msgty = 'E' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Zahlen von 1 bis 10.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit einem numerischen Bereich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_range_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_numbers_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_end   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_range_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_numbers_in_range.
    rt_numbers = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = iv_start THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_end
      ( i )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 1 msg = 'First element incorrect' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die versucht, auf einen ungültigen Index einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen. Fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_element_at_index
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_index   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_element) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_at_index.
    " Accessing an element by index can raise CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND
    " if the index is out of bounds.
    " This is implicitly handled by the runtime, but we can explicitly check
    " or let the exception propagate.
    " For demonstration, we'll let it propagate if not found.
    rv_element = it_numbers[ iv_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_index_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_index_access RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_index_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_access( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_itab_access=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_element) = lo_cut->get_element_at_index( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_index = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_element exp = 20 msg = 'Incorrect element retrieved' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Valid index access raised unexpected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

    " Expected to raise cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_access( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_itab_access=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ).
    lo_cut->get_element_at_index( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_index = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Invalid index access did not raise expected exception' ).

Wenn der Index ungültig ist, wird automatisch die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` ausgelöst, was eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht, ohne manuelle Indexprüfungen durchführen zu müssen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie dann eine Liste der Flugnummern dieser Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, die sowohl filtert als auch die gewünschten Felder extrahiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
        ( ls_sflight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          value     = iv_percentage.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Vokale in einem gegebenen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um über die Zeichen des Strings zu iterieren, und `REDUCE` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_string_iterate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_vowels
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_vowel_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_string_iterate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_vowels.
    DATA(lv_vowels) = 'AEIOUaeiou'.
    rv_vowel_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR char IN iv_text
      WHERE ( lv_vowels CS char ) "CS checks if char is contained in lv_vowels
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Konfiguration aus einer Tabelle liest. Wenn ein obligatorischer Konfigurationswert nicht gefunden wird, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme, die den fehlenden Schlüssel angibt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_config_missing DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA mv_config_key TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_abap_behv_message=>t_textid OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_config_key TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_config_missing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_config_key = iv_config_key.
    me->if_abap_behv_message~m_attributes = VALUE #(
        BASE if_abap_behv_message~m_attributes
        ( name = 'CONFIG_KEY' value = iv_config_key )
    ).
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_abap_behv_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '005' msgty = 'E' ). "Example message: 'Configuration key &1 is missing'
    ELSE.
      if_abap_behv_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_entry.
    TYPES tt_config_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS get_config_value
      IMPORTING
        it_config_data TYPE tt_config_table
        iv_key         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_config_missing.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_value.
    DATA(ls_config_entry) = it_config_data[ KEY key COMPONENTS key = iv_key ].
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_config_missing
        EXPORTING
          iv_config_key = iv_key
          textid = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '005' msgty = 'E' ).
    ENDIF.
    rv_value = ls_config_entry-value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_config_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_missing_config_key RAISING zcx_config_missing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_config_key.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_config_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE zcl_config_reader=>tt_config_table(
      ( key = 'SETTING_A' value = 'ValueA' )
      ( key = 'SETTING_B' value = 'ValueB' )
    ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_value) = lo_reader->get_config_value( it_config_data = lt_config iv_key = 'SETTING_A' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'ValueA' msg = 'Incorrect config value retrieved' ).
      CATCH zcx_config_missing.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Existing config key raised unexpected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_missing_config_key.
    " Expected to raise zcx_config_missing
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_config_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE zcl_config_reader=>tt_config_table(
      ( key = 'SETTING_A' value = 'ValueA' )
    ).
    lo_reader->get_config_value( it_config_data = lt_config iv_key = 'SETTING_C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Missing config key did not raise expected exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `RAISE EXCEPTION` mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme für fehlende Konfigurationseinträge ist ein klares Muster zur Fehlerbehandlung. Der direkte Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über `KEY COMPONENTS` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, die bei Nicht-Finden `sy-subrc <> 0` setzt, was dann zur Ausnahme führt. (Hinweis: ZMSG-Nachrichten müssen in SE91 angelegt werden.)
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Custom Exception, Configuration, Error Handling, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu und ändern Sie dessen Wert. Nach der Bearbeitung soll das Feldsymbol explizit freigegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE sflight
        iv_field   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_structure.
    rs_result = is_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE rs_result TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Beispiel: Wert ändern (hier nur für numerische Felder sinnvoll)
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
        <fs_field> = <fs_field> + 10.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Explizite Freigabe
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->process_structure( is_data = ls_sflight iv_field = 'SEATSOCC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-seatsocc exp = 110 ).

    DATA(ls_result_no_change) = lo_cut->process_structure( is_data = ls_sflight iv_field = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_no_change-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder zur Laufzeit, was in generischen Programmen nützlich ist. `UNASSIGN` stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch freigegeben wird, was gute Praxis für die Speicherverwaltung und zur Vermeidung unbeabsichtigter Referenzen ist.
keywords: UNASSIGN, ASSIGN COMPONENT, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Structure

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein Feldsymbol zugewiesen ist, und es gegebenenfalls freigibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IS ASSIGNED` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_check_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        ir_field_symbol TYPE REF TO data. " Generic reference for demonstration
    METHODS is_assigned_status
      IMPORTING
        ir_field_symbol TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_assigned) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_check_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_field_symbol->* TO <fs_any>. " Assign the content of the reference

    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_assigned_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_field_symbol->* TO <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_is_assigned = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_assigned = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_any>. " Always unassign after use
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_unassign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_unassign.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE i VALUE 10.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN lv_value TO <fs_int>.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_check_unassign( ).
    DATA(lr_value) = REF #( lv_value ).

    " Check initially assigned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_assigned_status( lr_value ) ).

    " Unassign
    lo_cut->check_and_unassign( lr_value ).

    " Check unassigned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_assigned_status( lr_value ) ).

    " Test with an unassigned field symbol (should not cause dump)
    UNASSIGN <fs_int>. " Ensure it's unassigned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_assigned_status( lr_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `IS ASSIGNED` zur Überprüfung des Status eines Feldsymbols und `UNASSIGN` zur expliziten Freigabe. Dies ist wichtig, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden und die Kontrolle über Referenzen zu behalten.
keywords: UNASSIGN, IS ASSIGNED, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch verarbeitet, indem sie auf eine bestimmte Spalte zugreift und deren Werte ändert. Das Feldsymbol für die Zeile und die Spalte sollen nach jeder Iteration bzw. nach Abschluss der Verarbeitung freigegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer Schleife, gefolgt von `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table   TYPE REF TO data " Generic internal table
        iv_field   TYPE string
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_table_type
        invalid_field_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE invalid_table_type.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        UNASSIGN <fs_line>. " Unassign line before raising exception
        RAISE invalid_field_name.
      ENDIF.

      " Beispiel: Wert ändern (hier nur für numerische Felder sinnvoll)
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
        <fs_field> = <fs_field> * 2.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Unassign field symbol for component
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_table>. " Unassign table field symbol
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.  " Unassign line field symbol (if loop finished without error)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_itab_process( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = REF #( lt_sflight ).

    lo_cut->process_table( ir_table = lr_table iv_field = 'SEATSOCC' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflight INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_sflight1).
