CLASS zcl_fs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS assign_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE sflight
        iv_field   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_message = |Fehler: Feld '{ iv_field }' nicht in Struktur gefunden.|.
      " <fs_field> ist hier nicht zugewiesen, UNASSIGN ist nicht zwingend, aber gute Praxis
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Feld '{ iv_field }' erfolgreich zugewiesen.|.
      " Hier könnte man mit <fs_field> arbeiten
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Nach Gebrauch freigeben
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft und dabei ein Feldsymbol für den Rückgabewert verwendet. Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach dem Aufruf freigegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `RECEIVING` in Verbindung mit einem Feldsymbol und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object   TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method) RECEIVING r = <fs_result>.
        IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_result_string = |Method '{ iv_method }' called. Result: { <fs_result> }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result_string = |Method '{ iv_method }' called. No result assigned.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result_string = |Error calling method '{ iv_method }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
    UNASSIGN <fs_result>. " Explizite Freigabe
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflight`-Datensätzen, wobei die `SEATSOCC`-Werte zufällig zwischen 0 und der `SEATSMAX`-Kapazität liegen.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_sflights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    " Beispielhafte Flugdaten für die Generierung
    DATA(lt_base_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0987' seatsmax = 180 )
    ).

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_count
                             LET ls_base = lt_base_sflights[ ( i MOD lines( lt_base_sflights) ) + 1 ] IN
                             ( carrid = ls_base-carrid
                               connid = ls_base-connid
                               fldate = sy-datum + i
                               seatsmax = ls_base-seatsmax
                               seatsocc = CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * ls_base-seatsmax ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_field   TYPE string
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_table_type
        invalid_field_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE invalid_table_type.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if field exists (optional, but good practice)
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line_type) LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_line_type->* TO <fs_line>.
    IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_dummy>).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
        RAISE invalid_field_name.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_dummy>.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.

    SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field).

    " After sort, any previously assigned line field symbol is invalid
    " and should be unassigned if it was assigned within this scope.
    " In this case, <fs_line> was only used for type check and unassigned.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie `sflight`-Datensätze nach `CARRID` und wählen Sie für jede Gruppe einen zufälligen `CONNID` aus den vorhandenen Verbindungen der Gruppe aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_random_float` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_group_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             random_connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_grouped_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_random_connid_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_group_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_random_connid_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_grouped_data = REDUCE tt_grouped_sflights(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_grouped_sflights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid)
      LET lt_connids = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY (
                         FOR sflight_in_group IN GROUP ls_sflight ( sflight_in_group-connid ) )
          lv_index = CONV i( lo_random->get_next( ) * lines( lt_connids ) ) + 1 IN
      ( carrid = lv_carrid
        random_connid = lt_connids[ lv_index ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle dynamisch filtert, indem sie auf ein Feld zugreift und dessen Wert mit einem Vergleichswert abgleicht. Das Feldsymbol für die Zeile soll nach der Filterung freigegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen Feldsymbol und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_table   TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field   TYPE string
        iv_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_field_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Create a copy to filter, as FILTER cannot directly modify a generic table reference
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_temp_table) LIKE it_table.
    ASSIGN lr_temp_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    <fs_table> = it_table.

    " Check if field exists
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line_type) LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_line_type->* TO <fs_line>.
    IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
        UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
        RAISE invalid_field_name.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.

    " Dynamic filtering using a loop and conditional check
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> = iv_value.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_filtered_table.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige Ganzzahl innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_float`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und konvertieren Sie das Ergebnis in eine Ganzzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_integer_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_val TYPE i
        iv_max_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_int) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_integer_in_range.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_base_random) = lo_random->get_next( ). " [0, 1)

    " Scale and convert to integer. Add 1 to max_val to make it inclusive.
    rv_random_int = CONV i( iv_min_val + ( lv_base_random * ( iv_max_val - iv_min_val + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Zeilen in der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf Daten aus einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie die `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Syntax verwenden. Erhöhen Sie den Preis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um 10%.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @(internal_table)` mit einer internen Tabelle, die die zu aktualisierenden Felder enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_flights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
      ENDLOOP.

      UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_flights FOR TESTING.

    DATA mv_original_price TYPE sflights-price.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0400'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20250101'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Save original data
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Insert dummy data if not exists
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 1000 ) ).
      mv_original_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original data
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_corr( ).
    lo_cut->update_flights_by_carrid( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_percentage = 10 ).

    DATA lv_new_price TYPE sflights-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_price exp = mv_original_price * 1.1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @(internal_table)` Syntax ermöglicht das Aktualisieren mehrerer Datenbankzeilen in einem einzigen Statement, wobei die Daten aus einer internen Tabelle stammen. Die Verwendung von Host-Variablen (dem `@`-Präfix) ist ein Merkmal von Open SQL mit erweiterter Syntax (ABAP 7.40+), was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, Internal Table, Host Variables, Open SQL

      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.

Der `VALUE`-Operator wird hier nicht direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel für die Selektion verwendet, sondern implizit durch die Übergabe von Werten an die Methode. Die moderne Syntax erlaubt es, Variablen direkt mit `@` zu referenzieren, was den Code sauberer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als die alte `INTO ... WHERE field = variable` Syntax.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights`, ändern Sie ein Feld (z.B. den Preis) und aktualisieren Sie ihn dann mit `MODIFY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` um den Datensatz zu lesen und `MODIFY sflights FROM @(work_area)` zum Aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_modify_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_price_increase TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_modify_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight-price = ls_flight-price + iv_price_increase.
      MODIFY sflights FROM @ls_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_flight FOR TESTING.

    DATA mv_original_price TYPE sflights-price.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

      mv_original_price = 750.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_modify_single( ).
    DATA(lv_price_increase) = 50.
    lo_cut->modify_flight_price( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate iv_price_increase = lv_price_increase ).

explanation: Das `MODIFY`-Statement wird verwendet, um einen einzelnen Datensatz in der Datenbank zu aktualisieren oder einzufügen. Wenn ein Datensatz mit dem angegebenen Primärschlüssel existiert, wird er aktualisiert; andernfalls wird ein neuer Datensatz eingefügt. In diesem Beispiel wird es nach einem `SELECT SINGLE` verwendet, um einen bestehenden Datensatz zu ändern. Die Verwendung von Host-Variablen (`@`) ist hier ebenfalls Standard für modernen Open SQL.
keywords: MODIFY, Database, SELECT SINGLE, Open SQL

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis von Flügen in `sflights` basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. erhöhen Sie den Preis für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften um 10% und für andere um 5%), indem Sie den `CASE` Ausdruck direkt in der `SET` Klausel verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... SET field = CASE WHEN condition THEN value1 ELSE value2 END ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_prices_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_high_increase TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrid_low_increase TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_conditionally.
    UPDATE sflights SET
      price = CASE carrid
                WHEN @iv_carrid_high_increase THEN price * 1.10
                WHEN @iv_carrid_low_increase  THEN price * 1.05
                ELSE price
              END
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid_high_increase OR carrid = @iv_carrid_low_increase.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conditional_update FOR TESTING.

    DATA mv_original_price_lh TYPE sflights-price.
    DATA mv_original_price_aa TYPE sflights-price.
    DATA mv_carrid_lh TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA mv_carrid_aa TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0400'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20250404'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price_lh
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_lh AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid_lh connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 1000 ) ).
      mv_original_price_lh = 1000.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price_aa
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_aa AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid_aa connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 500 ) ).
      mv_original_price_aa = 500.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price_lh
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_lh AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price_aa
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_aa AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conditional_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_case( ).
    lo_cut->update_prices_conditionally( iv_carrid_high_increase = mv_carrid_lh iv_carrid_low_increase = mv_carrid_aa ).

    DATA lv_updated_price_lh TYPE sflights-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_updated_price_lh
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_lh AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    DATA lv_updated_price_aa TYPE sflights-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_updated_price_aa
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_aa AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price_lh exp = mv_original_price_lh * 1.10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price_aa exp = mv_original_price_aa * 1.05 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CASE`-Ausdruck in der `SET`-Klausel eines `UPDATE`-Statements (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, feldabhängige Aktualisierungen direkt in der Datenbank durchzuführen, ohne die Daten vorher in den Anwendungsserver laden zu müssen. Dies ist besonders effizient für komplexe, bedingte Aktualisierungen und reduziert den Datentransfer zwischen Datenbank und Anwendungsserver.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, CASE, Open SQL, Conditional Update

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis von Flügen in `sflights` basierend auf dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge derselben Fluggesellschaft, der über eine korrelierte Unterabfrage ermittelt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... SET field = ( SELECT ... WHERE ... ) WHERE ...` mit einer korrelierten Unterabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price_by_avg_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_by_avg_carrid.
    UPDATE sflights AS a SET
      price = ( SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = a~carrid )
      WHERE a~carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_with_subquery FOR TESTING.

    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'UA'.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA mv_avg_price TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Save original data for the carrier
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_original_flights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.
    IF lines( mt_original_flights ) = 0.
      " Insert dummy data if not exists
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20250501' price = 100 ) ).
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20250502' price = 200 ) ).
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0003' fldate = '20250503' price = 300 ) ).
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_original_flights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
    SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflights INTO @mv_avg_price WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original data
    LOOP AT mt_original_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      UPDATE sflights FROM @<fs_flight>.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_with_subquery.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_subquery( ).
    lo_cut->update_price_by_avg_carrid( iv_carrid = mv_carrid ).

    DATA lt_updated_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_updated_flights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_updated_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_updated_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated_flight>-price exp = mv_avg_price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.52 können Unterabfragen direkt in der `SET`-Klausel eines `UPDATE`-Statements verwendet werden. Dies ermöglicht es, komplexe Aktualisierungslogik direkt in der Datenbank auszuführen, ohne die Daten in den Anwendungsserver laden zu müssen. Eine korrelierte Unterabfrage bezieht sich auf die äußere Abfrage (hier `sflights AS a`), was eine zeilenweise Berechnung des Durchschnittspreises für jede Fluggesellschaft ermöglicht.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, Subquery, Open SQL, Correlated Subquery

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie spezifische Zeilen einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer Bedingung, indem Sie moderne Schleifen- und Modifikationssyntax verwenden. Erhöhen Sie den Preis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) WHERE ...` für die effiziente In-Place-Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_update_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_internal_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_update_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_internal_flights.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_internal_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_internal_table.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250601' price = 1000 ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250602' price = 1200 ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250603' price = 500 ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_update_loop( ).
    lo_cut->update_internal_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_percentage = 10 ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_lh1>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_lh1>-price exp = 1100 ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_lh2>) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_lh2>-price exp = 1320 ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_aa>) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_aa>-price exp = 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) WHERE ...` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zu durchlaufen und direkt zu modifizieren. Der Field-Symbol (`<fs>`) zeigt direkt auf die Zeile in der internen Tabelle, sodass Änderungen an `<fs>` automatisch die entsprechende Zeile in der Tabelle aktualisieren, ohne dass ein explizites `MODIFY TABLE` Statement erforderlich ist. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen direkt in der Schleife.
keywords: Internal Tables, LOOP AT, Field-Symbols, In-Place Modification

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `CLOSE` Event eines `cl_gui_docking_container`, um eine Meldung auszugeben, wenn der Container geschlossen wird.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler mit `SET HANDLER` und definieren Sie eine Methode `FOR EVENT CLOSE OF cl_gui_docking_container`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_docking_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA go_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container READ-ONLY.

    METHODS create_docking_container
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid DEFAULT sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr DEFAULT sy-dynnr.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_close FOR EVENT close OF cl_gui_docking_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_docking_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_docking_container.
    CREATE OBJECT go_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid = iv_repid
        dynnr = iv_dynnr
        side  = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right
        extension = 200
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SET HANDLER handle_close FOR go_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_close.
    " In einem echten GUI-Kontext würde hier eine Meldung erscheinen.
    " Für den Unit-Test simulieren wir dies durch eine Protokollierung.
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Docking Container wurde geschlossen!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_handler_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler_registration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_docking_events( ).
    lo_cut->create_docking_container( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->go_docking_container ).
    " Eine direkte Überprüfung, ob der Event-Handler tatsächlich registriert ist und feuert,
    " ist in einem isolierten Unit-Test schwierig, da GUI-Events eine aktive GUI-Umgebung erfordern.
    " Dieser Test stellt sicher, dass die Instanziierung und die SET HANDLER-Anweisung fehlerfrei durchlaufen werden.
    " Die Funktionalität des Handlers selbst müsste in einem Integrationstest mit aktiver GUI geprüft werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Event-Behandlung in ABAP Objects ist ein mächtiges Konzept, um auf Benutzerinteraktionen oder Systemereignisse zu reagieren. Für GUI-Controls wie `cl_gui_docking_container` können Events wie `CLOSE` abonniert werden. Die Methode `SET HANDLER` registriert eine lokale oder globale Methode als Event-Handler. Die Event-Handler-Methode muss mit `FOR EVENT <event_name> OF <class_name>` deklariert werden. In Unit-Tests kann die Registrierung überprüft werden, das tatsächliche Feuern des Events und die Ausführung des Handlers erfordern jedoch eine aktive GUI-Umgebung.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, Events, Event Handler, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, ABAP Objects

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis von Flügen in `sflights` für Fluggesellschaften, die in der Tabelle `scarr` eine bestimmte Währung (`CURRCODE`) verwenden, indem Sie einen `JOIN` in der `FROM` Klausel des `UPDATE`-Statements nutzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_currcode TYPE s_currcode
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices_by_currency.
    UPDATE sflights AS a SET price = a~price * ( 1 + @iv_percentage / 100 )
      FROM sflights AS a
      INNER JOIN scarr AS b ON a~carrid = b~carrid
      WHERE b~currcode = @iv_currcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_with_join FOR TESTING.

    DATA mv_carrid_eur TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA mv_carrid_usd TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0400'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20250701'.
    DATA mv_original_price_eur TYPE sflights-price.
    DATA mv_original_price_usd TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure SCARR entries exist for test carriers
    INSERT scarr FROM @( VALUE scarr( carrid = mv_carrid_eur carrname = 'Lufthansa' currcode = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT scarr FROM @( VALUE scarr( carrid = mv_carrid_usd carrname = 'American Airlines' currcode = 'USD' ) ).

    " Save original SFLIGHTS data
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price_eur
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_eur AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid_eur connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 1000 ) ).
      mv_original_price_eur = 1000.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price_usd
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_usd AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid_usd connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 500 ) ).
      mv_original_price_usd = 500.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original SFLIGHTS data
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price_eur
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_eur AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price_usd
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_usd AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    " Clean up SCARR entries
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_eur OR carrid = @mv_carrid_usd.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_with_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_join( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_prices_by_currency( iv_currcode = 'USD' iv_percentage = 15 ).

    DATA lv_updated_price_eur TYPE sflights-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_updated_price_eur
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_eur AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    DATA lv_updated_price_usd TYPE sflights-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_updated_price_usd
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid_usd AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price_eur exp = mv_original_price_eur ). " Should not change
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price_usd exp = mv_original_price_usd * 1.15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können `JOIN`-Ausdrücke direkt in der `FROM`-Klausel eines `UPDATE`-Statements verwendet werden. Dies ermöglicht es, Aktualisierungen in einer Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen oder Werten aus einer oder mehreren anderen Tabellen durchzuführen, ohne dass separate `SELECT`-Statements oder interne Tabellen erforderlich sind. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke Funktion für komplexe Datenbankaktualisierungen, die die Performance verbessern kann, indem sie den Datentransfer minimiert.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, JOIN, Open SQL, Multi-Table Update

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status von Flügen in `sflights` auf 'BOOKED' nur für diejenigen Flüge, für die mindestens eine Buchung in der Tabelle `sbook` existiert, indem Sie eine `EXISTS` Unterabfrage verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM other_table WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_status_if_booked.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status_if_booked.
    UPDATE sflights SET status = 'BOOKED'
      WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT * FROM sbook
          WHERE sbook~carrid = sflights~carrid
            AND sbook~connid = sflights~connid
            AND sbook~fldate = sflights~fldate
      ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_with_exists FOR TESTING.

    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AZ'.
    DATA mv_connid_booked TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0001'.
    DATA mv_connid_unbooked TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0002'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20250801'.
    DATA mv_original_status_booked TYPE sflights-status.
    DATA mv_original_status_unbooked TYPE sflights-status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Insert test data into SFLIGHTS
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_status_booked
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid_booked AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid_booked fldate = mv_fldate status = 'OPEN' ) ).
      mv_original_status_booked = 'OPEN'.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_status_unbooked
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid_unbooked AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid_unbooked fldate = mv_fldate status = 'OPEN' ) ).
      mv_original_status_unbooked = 'OPEN'.
    ENDIF.

    " Insert booking for one flight
    INSERT sbook FROM @( VALUE sbook( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid_booked fldate = mv_fldate bookid = '00000001' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original SFLIGHTS status
    UPDATE sflights SET status = @mv_original_status_booked
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid_booked AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    UPDATE sflights SET status = @mv_original_status_unbooked
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid_unbooked AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    " Clean up SBOOK entries
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid_booked AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_with_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_exists( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_status_if_booked( ).

    DATA lv_status_booked TYPE sflights-status.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @lv_status_booked
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid_booked AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    DATA lv_status_unbooked TYPE sflights-status.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @lv_status_unbooked
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid_unbooked AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_booked exp = 'BOOKED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_unbooked exp = mv_original_status_unbooked ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `EXISTS`-Unterabfrage in der `WHERE`-Klausel eines `UPDATE`-Statements (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine effiziente Methode, um Zeilen in einer Tabelle nur dann zu aktualisieren, wenn entsprechende Einträge in einer anderen Tabelle vorhanden sind. Dies vermeidet das Laden großer Datenmengen in den Anwendungsserver und führt die Prüfung direkt auf Datenbankebene durch, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen erheblich verbessern kann.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, EXISTS, Subquery, Open SQL, Conditional Update

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Währungscode (`CURRCODE`) in der Tabelle `sflights` für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie den Wert aus der Tabelle `scarr` beziehen und dabei die `FROM` Klausel mit einem `INNER JOIN` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... SET ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ...` um den Währungscode aus `scarr` zu übernehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_from_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_currency_from_scarr
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_from_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_currency_from_scarr.
    UPDATE sflights AS a SET currcode = b~currcode
      FROM sflights AS a
      INNER JOIN scarr AS b ON a~carrid = b~carrid
      WHERE a~carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten in einer Tabelle basierend auf Informationen aus einer verknüpften Tabelle zu aktualisieren, da die gesamte Operation auf Datenbankebene stattfindet.

Instructions: Setzen Sie den Status aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in `sflights` auf 'CANCELLED', wenn deren Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE ... AND ...`.

CLASS zcl_db_update_simple_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflights-price.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und geben Sie eine entsprechende Nachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN` für verschiedene Wochentage. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday_for_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_message.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday_for_date( iv_date ).

    rv_message = SWITCH string( lv_weekday
                               WHEN 1 THEN 'Es ist Sonntag.'
                               WHEN 2 THEN 'Es ist Montag.'
                               WHEN 3 THEN 'Es ist Dienstag.'
                               WHEN 4 THEN 'Es ist Mittwoch.'
                               WHEN 5 THEN 'Es ist Donnerstag.'
                               WHEN 6 THEN 'Es ist Freitag.'
                               WHEN 7 THEN 'Es ist Samstag.'
                               WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Ungültiger Wochentag.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und weisen Sie jedem Flug einen Status zu (z.B. 'Langstrecke', 'Kurzstrecke') basierend auf der Entfernung, wobei Sie den `CASE`-Ausdruck verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `SWITCH` für die Zuweisung in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             distance   TYPE s_distance,
             distid     TYPE s_unit,
             flight_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_analyzed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, distance, distid
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_analyzed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                     distance = ls_sflight-distance,
                                     distid   = ls_sflight-distid,
                                     flight_type = SWITCH string( ls_sflight-distance
                                                                 WHEN < 1000 THEN 'Kurzstrecke'
                                                                 WHEN < 4000 THEN 'Mittelstrecke'
                                                                 WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Langstrecke' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->analyze_flights( 'AA' ). " Assuming 'AA' has some flights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ). " Check if table is not empty

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].

          WHEN 'Mittelstrecke'.
            lv_medium_haul_count = lv_medium_haul_count + 1.
          WHEN 'Langstrecke'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_medium_haul_count >= 0 ).

    ENDIF.

        iv_booking_class TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_priority) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_priority_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_priority_code.
    rv_priority = SWITCH string( iv_flight_status
                                WHEN 'X' THEN SWITCH string( iv_booking_class
                                                            WHEN 'C' THEN 'P1' " New, Business
                                                            WHEN 'Y' THEN 'P2' " New, Economy
                                                            WHEN OTHERS THEN 'P3' ) " New, Other
                                WHEN 'C' THEN SWITCH string( iv_booking_class
                                                            WHEN 'C' THEN 'P4' " Cancelled, Business
                                                            WHEN 'Y' THEN 'P5' " Cancelled, Economy
                                                            WHEN OTHERS THEN 'P6' ) " Cancelled, Other
                                WHEN OTHERS THEN 'P7' ). " Other status
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer Zeichenkodierung in eine andere (z.B. von UTF-8 nach Latin-1).
hint: `cl_abap_char_utilities` bietet Methoden für die Zeichenkonvertierung, z.B. `convert_string_to_code_page` und `convert_code_page_to_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_encoding_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_latin1
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latin1_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS convert_latin1_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_latin1_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_encoding_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_latin1.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( 
      EXPORTING
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      RECEIVING
        conv     = DATA(lo_conv_out_utf8) ).
    lo_conv_out_utf8->write( EXPORTING data = iv_utf8_string IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( 
      EXPORTING
        encoding = '1100' " Latin-1
      RECEIVING
        conv     = DATA(lo_conv_in_latin1) ).
    lo_conv_in_latin1->read( EXPORTING buffer = lv_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_latin1_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_latin1_to_utf8.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( 
      EXPORTING
        encoding = '1100' " Latin-1
      RECEIVING
        conv     = DATA(lo_conv_out_latin1) ).
    lo_conv_out_latin1->write( EXPORTING data = iv_latin1_string IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( 
      EXPORTING
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      RECEIVING
        conv     = DATA(lo_conv_in_utf8) ).
    lo_conv_in_utf8->read( EXPORTING buffer = lv_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_utf8_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_encoding_converter( ).

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie Zeilenumbrüche aus einem String.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_trimmer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string_and_newlines
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_trimmer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string_and_newlines.
    rv_trimmed_string = iv_input_string.
    " Führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernen
    CONDENSE rv_trimmed_string NO-GAPS.
    " Zeilenumbrüche entfernen
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf IN rv_trimmed_string WITH space.
    " Erneut kondensieren, falls durch das Ersetzen neue Leerzeichen entstanden sind
    CONDENSE rv_trimmed_string NO-GAPS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Dynamisch eine interne Tabelle filtern und die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle sammeln, wobei der Feldzugriff über `FIELD-SYMBOLS` erfolgt. Die Methode soll eine generische Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptieren und eine Referenz auf eine gefilterte generische Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff innerhalb einer `LOOP` Iteration. Die Rückgabe sollte ein `REF TO DATA` sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Return a reference to a generic table

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a new internal table with the same type as the input table
    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_data LIKE <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> = iv_filter_value.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle und modifizieren Sie bestimmte Zeilenwerte direkt im Loop mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator zur Initialisierung.

CLASS zcl_itab_modify_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             flag TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_modify_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_items.
    rt_modified_items = it_items. " Copy for modification

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    LOOP AT rt_modified_items ASSIGNING <fs_item> WHERE id MOD 2 = 0. " Modify items with even IDs
      <fs_item>-flag = abap_true.
      <fs_item>-name = <fs_item>-name && '_MODIFIED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_fs_declaration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_products
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_fs_declaration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_products.
    rt_processed_products = it_products.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_product> LIKE LINE OF rt_processed_products.

    LOOP AT rt_processed_products ASSIGNING <fs_product>.
      " Example: Apply a discount to products with 'A' in their ID
      IF <fs_product>-id CA 'A'.
        <fs_product>-price = <fs_product>-price * '0.9'. " 10% discount
        <fs_product>-name = <fs_product>-name && ' (Discounted)'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle als `CHANGING` Parameter akzeptiert und diese über ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` modifiziert. Die Methode soll alle String-ähnlichen Einträge der Tabelle in Großbuchstaben umwandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CHANGING <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE` und `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>`. Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` für die Typanalyse der Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_param_passing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_text_data.
    TYPES tt_text_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_text_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_uppercase
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE. " Generic table for demonstration
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_param_passing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_uppercase.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      " Iterate over components of the line (assuming simple structure for demo)
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        " Only convert string-like components
        IF cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data(<fs_component>)->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data(<fs_component>)->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
          TRANSLATE <fs_component> TO UPPER CASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_uppercase_conversion FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uppercase_conversion.
    DATA(lt_initial_data) = VALUE zcl_fs_param_passing=>tt_text_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'hello world' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'abap is great' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_param_passing( ).
    DATA(lt_modified_data) = lt_initial_data. " Copy for changing parameter
    lo_cut->convert_table_to_uppercase( CHANGING ct_any_table = lt_modified_data ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dem `FILTER` Operator und verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in der `WHERE` Bedingung, um auf dynamische Felder zuzugreifen. Sammeln Sie die gefilterten Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_with_fs
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_with_fs.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    rt_filtered_table = FILTER #( it_source_table USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      ( LET lv_result = abap_false IN
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE table_line TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> = iv_filter_value. lv_result = abap_true. ENDIF.
          lv_result ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feld, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und den `GROUP BY` Zusatz im `LOOP`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY (...) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_dynamic_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_data,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_data.
    TYPES tt_sales_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sales_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_data
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_dynamic_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sales_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sales_line> TYPE ty_sales_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_field> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_sales_data ASSIGNING <fs_sales_line> GROUP BY (
      key = ( LET lv_key = '' IN
                ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_sales_line> TO <fs_group_field>.
                IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_key = <fs_group_field>. ENDIF.
                lv_key ) )
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(ls_result_line) = VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        group_key = ls_group_key-key
        total_amount = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-amount )
        count = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ) ).

      APPEND ls_result_line TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` als Eingabe nimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `CONDENSE` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Iteration und `CONDENSE` für die String-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_condense_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             formatted_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_price    TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_condense_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_connid> TYPE sflight-connid.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight_data
                                    WHERE ( <fs_sflight>-price > iv_min_price )
                                    ( LET lv_info = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid } { <fs_sflight>-connid }| IN
                                        carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid,
                                        connid = <fs_sflight>-connid,
                                        formatted_info = CONDENSE( lv_info ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung des `FOR` Operators in Kombination mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und dem `CONDENSE` Statement. Der `FOR` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte Iteration und Filterung einer internen Tabelle. Durch die Zuweisung jeder Zeile zu einem `FIELD-SYMBOL` (`<fs_sflight>`) kann direkt auf die Komponenten zugegriffen werden. Innerhalb der `FOR` Schleife wird `CONDENSE` verwendet, um einen String aus den Flugdaten zu formatieren, indem führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernt und mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes ersetzt werden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als `CHANGING` Parameter akzeptiert und alle numerischen Felder in jeder Zeile um einen bestimmten Wert erhöht. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CHANGING <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE`, `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` zur Typanalyse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_numeric_increment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numeric_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_numeric_data.
    TYPES tt_numeric_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_numeric_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increment_numeric_fields
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      IMPORTING
        iv_increment_by TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_numeric_increment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increment_numeric_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data(<fs_component>).

        IF lo_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
           lo_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float OR
           lo_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
           lo_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat.
          <fs_component> = <fs_component> + iv_increment_by.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mixed1-amount exp = '110.00' ).

User Registration

Instructions: Aktivieren oder deaktivieren Sie die Interaktion des Benutzers mit dem 3D Viewer (z.B. Rotation, Zoom).
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `SET_INTERACTION_MODE` von `CL_GUI_ECL_3DVIEWER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dviewer_interaction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_user_interaction
      IMPORTING
        io_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
        iv_enabled TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_ecl_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_interaction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_user_interaction.
    IF iv_enabled = abap_true.
      io_viewer->set_interaction_mode( i_mode = cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer=>c_mode_standard ).
    ELSE.
      io_viewer->set_interaction_mode( i_mode = cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer=>c_mode_none ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enable_interaction FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_disable_interaction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enable_interaction.
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dviewer_interaction( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_user_interaction( io_viewer = lo_viewer iv_enabled = abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
      CATCH cx_ecl_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_ECL_ERROR caught when enabling interaction.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD lo_dummy_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_disable_interaction.
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dviewer_interaction( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_user_interaction( io_viewer = lo_viewer iv_enabled = abap_false ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
      CATCH cx_ecl_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_ECL_ERROR caught when disabling interaction.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD lo_dummy_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `SET_INTERACTION_MODE` des `CL_GUI_ECL_3DVIEWER` ermöglicht die Steuerung der Benutzerinteraktion mit dem 3D-Modell. Dies ist nützlich, um bestimmte Ansichten zu fixieren oder die Interaktion in bestimmten Phasen einer Anwendung zu unterbinden. Die Verwendung von Konstanten der Klasse (`C_MODE_STANDARD`, `C_MODE_NONE`) ist eine moderne und lesbare Praxis.
keywords: GUI, 3DVIEWER, INTERACTION, MODE, CL_GUI_ECL_3DVIEWER

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von UTF-8 nach ISO-8859-1 (Latin-1) und umgekehrt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_CE für die Zeichenkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_latin1
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latin1_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS convert_latin1_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_latin1_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_latin1.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj_ce=>create_out(
      encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      endian = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv->write( data = iv_utf8_string ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_latin1_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_latin1_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj_ce=>create_in(
      encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      endian = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv->write( data = iv_latin1_string ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_utf8_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_char_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_original_utf8) = `Grüße aus München`.
    DATA(lv_latin1) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_latin1( lv_original_utf8 ).
    DATA(lv_converted_back_utf8) = lo_converter->convert_latin1_to_utf8( lv_latin1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_back_utf8
      exp = lv_original_utf8
      msg = 'UTF-8 to Latin-1 and back conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_CE (oder CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ) ist die Standardklasse für Zeichenkonvertierungen in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht die flexible Handhabung verschiedener Encodings und Endian-Formate, was in modernen, globalisierten Anwendungen unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von DATA(...) für die Inline-Deklaration macht den Code kompakter.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ, Encoding, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, String, Conversion

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID) und Flugverbindungen (CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, bei denen die maximale Kapazität (SEATSMAX) größer als 200 ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie die VALUE-Operator und eine FOR-Expression, um die neue Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( seatsmax > 200 )
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_large_capacity_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty for SFLIGHT data'
      cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einer FOR-Expression ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die WHERE-Klausel innerhalb der FOR-Expression filtert die Quelldaten direkt, was zu sehr lesbarem und effizientem Code führt. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax, die Schleifen und explizite APPEND-Anweisungen überflüssig macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Table, SFLIGHT, Declarative, Filtering

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller belegten Sitze (SEATSOCC) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_total
      msg = 'Total occupied seats should be greater than 0'
      cond = ( lv_total > 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Iteratoren. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen durch eine deklarative Syntax, die den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. INIT definiert den Startwert des Akkumulators, FOR iteriert über die Daten und NEXT definiert die Aggregationslogik.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Sum, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT, um nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) anzuzeigen, die am 01.01.2025 stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lufthansa_flights_on_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lufthansa_flights_on_date.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate = iv_flight_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = '20250101'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lufthansa_flights_on_date( lv_test_date ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Carrier ID is not LH'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-fldate
        exp = lv_test_date
        msg = 'Flight date is incorrect'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und DELETE oder APPEND zu verwenden, kann man deklarativ eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Einträgen erstellen. Die Angabe eines Schlüssels (USING KEY primary_key) kann die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, SFLIGHT, Declarative, Key

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Logger) über ihren Konstruktor erhält. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Constructor Injection.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Konstruktor mit einem IMPORTING-Parameter für die Abhängigkeit.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.

ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS process_flight_data

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

Dies macht den Code flexibler und einfacher zu warten und zu testen. Die Verwendung von Interfaces (zif_logger) für Abhängigkeiten ist eine Best Practice.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Syntax CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.
    lv_method_name = iv_method_name.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input_value
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_methods( ).
    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A'
      iv_input_value = 'Test A'
    ).
    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_method_name = 'METHOD_B'
      iv_input_value = 'Test B'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_a
      exp = 'Method A processed: Test A'
      msg = 'Dynamic call to METHOD_A failed'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_b
      exp = 'Method B processed: Test B'
      msg = 'Dynamic call to METHOD_B failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_methods( ).
    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
      iv_input_value = 'Error Test'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result_error
      exp = 'Error: Method'
      msg = 'Error handling for non-existent method failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf (CALL METHOD (lv_method_name)) ist ein mächtiges Feature für Szenarien, in denen der Methodenname zur Laufzeit variieren kann, z.B. bei der Implementierung von Frameworks oder generischen Verarbeitungslogiken. Die Verwendung von TRY...CATCH ist hierbei essenziell, um Laufzeitfehler bei ungültigen Methodennamen abzufangen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Dynamic Call, Reflection, Error Handling

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von TRY...CATCH mit der CLEANUP-Block-Funktionalität, um Ressourcen auch im Fehlerfall ordnungsgemäß freizugeben.
hint: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt, bevor der CATCH-Block erreicht wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Simulate opening a resource
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        " Simulate an error (e.g., division by zero)
        IF iv_value = 0.
          DATA(lv_result) = 10 / iv_value.
        ENDIF.
        " Simulate successful operation
        " ...
      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulate closing the resource
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " Handle the specific error
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_cleanup( ).
    " Expecting an exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcl_error_cleanup( )->process_data( 0 )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
      msg = 'Division by zero should raise CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_cleanup( ).
    " No exception expected
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = abap_false
          msg = 'No error expected for valid input'
          cond = abap_true
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected arithmetic error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CLEANUP-Block in einer TRY...CATCH-Struktur ist ein wichtiges Feature für die robuste Fehlerbehandlung. Er stellt sicher, dass Ressourcen (z.B. Datenbankverbindungen, Dateihandles) auch dann ordnungsgemäß freigegeben oder aufgeräumt werden, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt, bevor der entsprechende CATCH-Block die Kontrolle übernimmt. Dies verhindert Ressourcenlecks und sorgt für eine konsistente Systemzustandswiederherstellung.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Datumsangaben unter Verwendung der modernen Datums-/Zeitfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP für die Datumsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_day_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d
        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_day_difference.
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date = iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date = iv_date2 ).

    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = lv_timestamp1 tstmp2 = lv_timestamp2 ).

    rv_days = lv_seconds_diff / ( 24 * 60 * 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus SFLIGHT enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die mehr als 100 belegte Sitze haben. Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator für die Zuweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit einer MAPPING-Klausel, um Felder selektiv zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_busy_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_busy_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_busy_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_busy_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( seatsocc > 100 )
                                ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
