ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_busy_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty for SFLIGHT data'
      cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = ls_summary-carrid
        msg = 'CARRID should not be initial'
        cond = ( ls_summary-carrid IS NOT INITIAL )
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = ls_summary-connid
        msg = 'CONNID should not be initial'
        cond = ( ls_summary-connid IS NOT INITIAL )
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = ls_summary-seatsocc
        msg = 'SEATSOCC should not be initial'
        cond = ( ls_summary-seatsocc > 100 )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING-Operator ist ideal, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) gleichen Feldnamen zuzuweisen. In Kombination mit VALUE #(...) und FOR-Expression ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Transformation und Filterung von Daten, ohne explizite Feldzuweisungen für jedes Feld schreiben zu müssen.

explanation: Polymorphie ist ein Kernkonzept der objektorientierten Programmierung, das es ermöglicht, Objekte verschiedener Klassen über eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle (hier: die abstrakte Basisklasse zcl_aircraft_base) zu behandeln. Die abstrakte Klasse definiert eine gemeinsame Struktur, während die konkreten Unterklassen (zcl_passenger_aircraft, zcl_cargo_aircraft) die Methoden spezifisch implementieren (REDEFINITION). Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts (z.B. einer internen Tabelle oder einer Struktur) und geben Sie dessen Komponentennamen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Klassen CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
      lo_structdescr ?= lo_typedescr.
      lt_components = lo_structdescr->get_components( ).

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rtti_non_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_inspector( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA ls_test_struct TYPE ty_test_struct.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( ls_test_struct ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of components' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'FIELD1' msg = 'First component name incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ] exp = 'FIELD2' msg = 'Second component name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rtti_non_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_inspector( ).
    DATA lv_test_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( lv_test_string ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_components ) msg = 'Non-structure should return empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Die Klassen CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR sind zentrale Bestandteile, um Informationen über Strukturen, interne Tabellen und andere Datentypen dynamisch abzurufen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme, Frameworks oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, Dynamic, Type Information, Reflection

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (SEATSOCC).
hint: Verwenden Sie die GROUP BY-Klausel in einer FOR-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seatsocc TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                ( carrid = GROUP ls_flight-carrid
                                  total_seatsocc = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty for SFLIGHT data'
      cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 )
    ).

    " Example: Check if LH exists and has a positive sum
    DATA(ls_lh_group) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_by=>ty_flight_group( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_group WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = ls_lh_group-total_seatsocc
        msg = 'Total seats for LH should be positive'
        cond = ( ls_lh_group-total_seatsocc > 0 )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die GROUP BY-Klausel innerhalb einer FOR-Expression ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature ab ABAP 7.55, um interne Tabellen deklarativ zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit AT NEW/END OF-Konstrukten und macht den Code wesentlich lesbarer und wartbarer. In Kombination mit REDUCE können komplexe Aggregationen pro Gruppe einfach ausgedrückt werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, FOR, REDUCE, SFLIGHT, Grouping

Instructions: Eine simulierte Liste von ArchiveLink-Dokumenten (ID, Typ, Größe) soll in ein neues Format (Dokumenten-URL und Größe) umgewandelt werden. Die URL soll aus ID und Typ bestehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE`-Operator und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_al_doc_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document_raw,
             id   TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_document_raw.
    TYPES: tt_document_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document_formatted,
             url  TYPE string,
             size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_document_formatted.
    TYPES: tt_document_formatted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document_formatted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_documents
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_documents TYPE tt_document_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_documents) TYPE tt_document_formatted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_al_doc_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_documents.
    rt_formatted_documents = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_documents
                                      ( url  = |https://archive.example.com/{ ls_raw-type }/{ ls_raw-id }|
                                        size = ls_raw-size ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_al_doc_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_docs) = VALUE zcl_al_doc_transform=>tt_document_raw(
      ( id = 'DOC001' type = 'PDF' size = 1024 )
      ( id = 'DOC002' type = 'JPG' size = 2048 )

    DATA(lt_formatted_docs) = lo_cut->transform_documents( lt_raw_docs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_formatted_docs ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted_docs[ 1 ]-url exp = 'https://archive.example.com/PDF/DOC001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted_docs[ 1 ]-size exp = 1024 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted_docs[ 2 ]-url exp = 'https://archive.example.com/JPG/DOC002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen. String Templates (`|...|`) vereinfachen die String-Konkatenation erheblich.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Dokumenten-URL basierend auf dem Dokumententyp (z.B. 'PDF', 'JPG', 'TXT'). Für unbekannte Typen soll eine Standard-URL zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_al_dynamic_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_document_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id   TYPE string
        iv_doc_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_al_dynamic_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_url.
    rv_url = SWITCH string(
      iv_doc_type
      WHEN 'PDF' THEN |https://archive.example.com/pdf/{ iv_doc_id }.pdf|
      WHEN 'JPG' THEN |https://archive.example.com/img/{ iv_doc_id }.jpg|
      WHEN 'TXT' THEN |https://archive.example.com/txt/{ iv_doc_id }.txt|
      ELSE            |https://archive.example.com/unknown/{ iv_doc_id }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_url FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_url.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_al_dynamic_url( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_document_url( iv_doc_id = '123' iv_doc_type = 'PDF' ) exp = 'https://archive.example.com/pdf/123.pdf' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_document_url( iv_doc_id = '456' iv_doc_type = 'JPG' ) exp = 'https://archive.example.com/img/456.jpg' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_document_url( iv_doc_id = '789' iv_doc_type = 'DOC' ) exp = 'https://archive.example.com/unknown/789' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Implementierung von bedingter Logik, die mehrere `WHEN`-Fälle abdeckt und einen `ELSE`-Fall für Standardwerte bietet. Dies ersetzt lange `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF`-Konstrukte.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, String Templates, ArchiveLink

CLASS zcl_al_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_document_retrieval
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_al_error.

    METHODS handle_retrieval
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_al_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_document_retrieval.
    IF iv_doc_id = 'ERROR_DOC'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_al_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_al_error=>default_text.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Document { iv_doc_id } retrieved successfully.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_retrieval.
    TRY.
        rv_message = simulate_document_retrieval( iv_doc_id ).
      CATCH zcx_al_error INTO DATA(lx_al_error).
        rv_message = |Error retrieving document { iv_doc_id }: { lx_al_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtgröße aller Dokumente in einer simulierten ArchiveLink-Dokumentenliste. Die Liste enthält Dokument-IDs und deren Größen.

CLASS zcl_al_doc_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document,
             id   TYPE string,
             size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_document.
    TYPES: tt_document TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_size
      IMPORTING
        it_documents TYPE tt_document
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_size) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_al_doc_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_size.
    rv_total_size = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR ls_doc IN it_documents
                              NEXT sum = sum + ls_doc-size ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hcm_data_fetcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_employee_data.
    TYPES: tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_employee_flights
      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employee_flights) TYPE tt_employee_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hcm_data_fetcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_flights.
    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_employee_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        UP TO 10 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @rt_employee_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen zur simulierten Verarbeitung von Mitarbeiterdaten (Filtern nach Abteilung, dann Formatieren des Namens).
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hcm_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id        TYPE string,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
             department TYPE string,
             full_name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES: tt_employee TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_employees TYPE tt_employee.

    METHODS filter_by_department
      IMPORTING
        iv_department TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_hcm_processor.

    METHODS format_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_hcm_processor.

    METHODS get_processed_employees
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employee.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_employees TYPE tt_employee.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hcm_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_employees = it_initial_employees.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_department.
    mt_employees = FILTER #( mt_employees WHERE department = iv_department ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_names.
    mt_employees = VALUE #( FOR ls_emp IN mt_employees
                              ( ls_emp WITH full_name = |{ ls_emp-last_name }, { ls_emp-first_name }| ) ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_processed_employees.
    rt_employees = mt_employees.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lt_initial_employees) = VALUE zcl_hcm_processor=>tt_employee(
      ( id = 'E001' first_name = 'Max' last_name = 'Mustermann' department = 'IT' )
      ( id = 'E002' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'HR' )
      ( id = 'E003' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Müller' department = 'IT' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_hcm_processor( lt_initial_employees ).

    DATA(lt_processed_employees) = lo_processor->filter_by_department( 'IT' )->format_names( )->get_processed_employees( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed_employees ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed_employees[ 1 ]-full_name exp = 'Mustermann, Max' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed_employees[ 2 ]-full_name exp = 'Müller, Peter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem Methoden so konzipiert werden, dass sie eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Operationen sequenziell auf demselben Objekt auszuführen, ohne temporäre Variablen zu benötigen. In Kombination mit `FILTER` und `VALUE` wird der Code sehr ausdrucksstark.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, FILTER, VALUE, Employee

Instructions: Finden Sie den Mitarbeiter mit dem höchsten Gehalt in einer simulierten Liste von Mitarbeiterdaten. Verwenden Sie `sflights` als Datenquelle und 'price' als Gehalt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um den Maximalwert zu finden.

CLASS zcl_hcm_max_salary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_salary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             salary TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_employee_salary.
    TYPES: tt_employee_salary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_salary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_employee_with_max_salary
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employee_salary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_employee) TYPE ty_employee_salary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hcm_max_salary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_with_max_salary.
    rs_employee = REDUCE ty_employee_salary(
      INIT max_emp = VALUE ty_employee_salary( salary = -1 )
      FOR ls_emp IN it_employees
      NEXT max_emp = COND #( WHEN ls_emp-salary > max_emp-salary THEN ls_emp ELSE max_emp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter eines Mitarbeiters in Jahren basierend auf einem gegebenen Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.

CLASS zcl_hcm_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
        iv_current_date TYPE d DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age_in_years) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hcm_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_years) = iv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).
    IF iv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( iv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND iv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) ).
      lv_years = lv_years - 1.
    ENDIF.
    rv_age_in_years = lv_years.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` aggregiert, um die durchschnittliche Belegung pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Die Ausgabe soll eine strukturierte Tabelle sein, die für die Darstellung als Balkendiagramm im `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` vorbereitet ist. Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` mit `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `SUM` für die Aggregation und `VALUE #( FOR ... )` für die Transformation der Daten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f, " Percentage
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_chart_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_occupancy_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_chart_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_data.
    " Modern ABAP SQL allows direct aggregation.
    SELECT carrid,
           SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_seats_occ,
           SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_seats_max
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR flight_agg IN lt_aggregated_data
                       LET avg_occ = COND f( WHEN flight_agg-total_seats_max > 0
                                             THEN ( flight_agg-total_seats_occ / flight_agg-total_seats_max ) * 100
                                             ELSE 0 ) IN
                       ( carrid = flight_agg-carrid, avg_occupancy = avg_occ ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_occupancy_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_occupancy_data.
    " For a robust unit test, ensure SFLIGHTS has predictable test data.
    " Here, we assume SFLIGHTS is populated.
    DATA(lo_chart_data) = NEW zcl_sflight_chart_data( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_chart_data->get_occupancy_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_occupancy IS INITIAL ). " Should not be initial if SFLIGHTS has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_occupancy ) ). " Should have some entries

    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_occupancy).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_occupancy-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy GE 0 AND ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy LE 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird der `VALUE` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck verwendet, um die aggregierten Daten in das gewünschte Format zu transformieren und dabei die durchschnittliche Belegung zu berechnen. Dies ist sehr kompakt, performant und vermeidet manuelle Schleifen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von 'klickbaren' Bereichen (z.B. Rechtecke) definiert, die im `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` dargestellt werden könnten. Die Klasse soll auch eine Methode bereitstellen, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Klickpunkt (X, Y) in einem dieser Bereiche liegt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die Bereichsprüfung.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Struktur für klickbare Bereiche und verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` um den Treffer zu finden.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_clickable_area,
             id    TYPE string,
             x     TYPE i,
             y     TYPE i,
             width TYPE i,
             height TYPE i,
           END OF ty_clickable_area.
TYPES tt_clickable_areas TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_clickable_area WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_gui_clickable_areas DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_areas RETURNING VALUE(rt_areas) TYPE tt_clickable_areas.
    METHODS check_click
      IMPORTING
        iv_click_x TYPE i
        iv_click_y TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_clickable_areas IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_areas.
    rt_areas = VALUE #( 
      ( id = 'AREA_A' x = 10 y = 10 width = 50 height = 50 )
      ( id = 'AREA_B' x = 70 y = 10 width = 30 height = 50 )
      ( id = 'AREA_C' x = 10 y = 70 width = 90 height = 20 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_click.
    DATA(lt_areas) = get_areas( ).
    LOOP AT lt_areas INTO DATA(ls_area).
      IF iv_click_x BETWEEN ls_area-x AND ( ls_area-x + ls_area-width ) AND
         iv_click_y BETWEEN ls_area-y AND ( ls_area-y + ls_area-height ).
        rv_area_id = ls_area-id.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_points_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_2d_data_provider~get_points.
    " Use SFLIGHTS data to generate points
    SELECT FROM sflight FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_points = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight_data
                         ( x = ( sy-tabix * 10 ) + 50
                           y = ( sy-tabix * 5 ) + 20 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_2d_data_provider~get_description.
    rv_description = 'Flugdaten als Punkte (SFLIGHTS)'.

CLASS zcl_2d_viewer_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_data.
    DATA(lt_points) = io_data_provider->get_points( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = io_data_provider->get_description( ).

    rv_output = |Anzeige von: { lv_description }\n|.
    LOOP AT lt_points INTO DATA(ls_point).

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `zif_data_filter` mit einer Methode `filter_data`. Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren: eine, die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft filtert, und eine andere, die nach einer Mindestanzahl von belegten Sitzen filtert. Eine Konsumentenklasse soll polymorph mit diesen Filtern arbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE` und den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_filter PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
         END OF ty_sflight_data.
  TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS filter_data
    IMPORTING
      it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_carrid_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_filter.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_filter~filter_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data WHERE carrid = mv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_occupancy_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_filter.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_occupancy TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_min_occupancy TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_occupancy_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_occupancy = iv_min_occupancy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_filter~filter_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data WHERE seatsocc GE mv_min_occupancy ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_filtered_data
      IMPORTING
        io_filter TYPE REF TO zif_data_filter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE zif_data_filter=>tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_filtered_data.
    " Fetch all SFLIGHTS data for demonstration
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_result = io_filter->filter_data( lt_all_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrid_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_occupancy_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrid_filter.
    " Prepare test data
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zif_data_filter=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_carrid_filter) = NEW zcl_carrid_filter( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_carrid_filter->filter_data( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_occupancy_filter.
    " Prepare test data
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zif_data_filter=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 80 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_occupancy_filter) = NEW zcl_occupancy_filter( 100 ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_occupancy_filter->filter_data( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-seatsocc exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-seatsocc exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Interfaces und den `FILTER` Operator, um eine flexible Filterlogik zu implementieren. Verschiedene Filterstrategien können über das `zif_data_filter` Interface bereitgestellt werden. Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und performante Filterung von internen Tabellen, was die Lesbarkeit und Effizienz des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Filter, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Data Processing

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `zif_error_handler` mit einer Methode `handle_error`. Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren: eine, die Fehler in einem Log sammelt, und eine andere, die eine Exception auslöst. Eine Klasse, die Operationen auf dem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` durchführt, soll einen Fehler-Handler über den Konstruktor erhalten und diesen bei Problemen nutzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE`, `TRY ... CATCH` und `RAISE EXCEPTION NEW`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_error_handler PUBLIC.
  METHODS handle_error
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_log_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_error_handler.
    METHODS get_log RETURNING VALUE(rt_log) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_log TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_error_handler~handle_error.
    APPEND iv_message TO mt_log.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log.
    rt_log = mt_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_viewer_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check PUBLIC.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_viewer_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_error_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_error_handler~handle_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_viewer_error( text = iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_viewer_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_error_handler TYPE REF TO zif_error_handler.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_error_handler TYPE REF TO zif_error_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_viewer_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_error_handler = io_error_handler.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value < 0.
          mo_error_handler->handle_error( |Ungültiger Wert: { iv_value }| ).
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ELSE.
          " Simulate a successful operation on the viewer
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH zcx_viewer_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_error_handler FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_exception_error_handler FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_viewer_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_error_handler.
    DATA(lo_log_handler) = NEW zcl_log_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lo_operation) = NEW zcl_viewer_operation( lo_log_handler ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_operation->perform_operation( -10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_log_handler->get_log( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_log ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ungültiger Wert: -10' act = lt_log[1] ).

    lv_success = lo_operation->perform_operation( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_exception_error_handler.
    DATA(lo_exception_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lo_operation) = NEW zcl_viewer_operation( lo_exception_handler ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      act = NEW zcx_viewer_error( ) 
      exp = lo_operation->perform_operation( -5 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Interfaces für eine flexible Fehlerbehandlung. Die `zcl_viewer_operation` Klasse ist von der konkreten Fehlerbehandlungsstrategie entkoppelt und kann entweder einen Fehler protokollieren (`zcl_log_error_handler`) oder eine Exception auslösen (`zcl_exception_error_handler`). Dies wird durch Dependency Injection im Konstruktor erreicht und ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Verantwortlichkeiten und eine verbesserte Testbarkeit.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Error Handling, Exception, Dependency Injection, TRY CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION NEW

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_displayable_object
      IMPORTING
        io_display_object TYPE REF TO zif_displayable_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_displayable_object.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_display_object ).
    DATA(lv_class_name) = lo_class_descr->get_name( ).

    rv_processed_info = |Objekttyp: { lv_class_name } - |.

    IF lv_class_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_DISPLAY_OBJECT'.
      rv_processed_info = rv_processed_info && 'Spezielle Flugbehandlung: '.
    ELSEIF lv_class_name = 'ZCL_AIRPORT_DISPLAY_OBJECT'.
      rv_processed_info = rv_processed_info && 'Spezielle Flughafenbehandlung: '.
    ENDIF.

    rv_processed_info = rv_processed_info && io_display_object->get_display_info( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `zif_data_transformer` mit einer Methode `transform`. Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren: eine, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (aus `SFLIGHTS`) in ein JSON-Format transformiert, und eine andere, die sie in ein XML-Format transformiert. Eine Konsumentenklasse soll polymorph mit diesen Transformatoren arbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für XML/JSON.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_transformer PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
         END OF ty_sflight_data.
  TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS transform
    IMPORTING
      it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_transformed_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_json_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_transformer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_transformer~transform.
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>create( ).
    lo_json_writer->serialize( EXPORTING data = it_data IMPORTING json = rv_transformed_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_transformer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_transformer~transform.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE data = it_data RESULT XML rv_transformed_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transformer_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_transformed_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        io_transformer TYPE REF TO zif_data_transformer
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transformer_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 2 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rv_output = io_transformer->transform( lt_sflight_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` abruft und diese nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) filtert. Die gefilterten Daten sollen dann für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` vorbereitet werden. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für die Datenreduktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um interne Tabellen effizient zu filtern.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

           seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    " Fetch all SFLIGHTS data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    " Filter using the FILTER operator
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_filter_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen, die für die Visualisierung in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` vorbereitet werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` aggregiert, um die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Flugdatum zu ermitteln. Die aggregierten Daten sollen für die Darstellung in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` vorbereitet werden. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Aggregation.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_occupancy,
           fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
           total_seats TYPE i,
         END OF ty_daily_occupancy.
TYPES tt_daily_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_daily_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_daily_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_daily_occupancy.
    SELECT fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_data = REDUCE tt_daily_occupancy(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_daily_occupancy( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( fldate = flight-fldate )
      " Use REDUCE to aggregate total seats per flight date
      ( fldate = flight-fldate
        total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_occupancy.
    " For a real unit test, mock SFLIGHTS or use test data setup.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce_data( ).
    DATA(lt_daily_occupancy) = lo_reducer->get_daily_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_daily_occupancy ).
    LOOP AT lt_daily_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_entry-total_seats GE 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Example: If SFLIGHTS has data for '20250101' with total 250 seats
    " DATA(ls_expected) = VALUE ty_daily_occupancy( fldate = '20250101' total_seats = 250 ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_daily_occupancy exp = ls_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.55), um Daten in internen Tabellen zu aggregieren und zu transformieren. Es ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Programmierung, die den Code kompakter, lesbarer und oft performanter macht als traditionelle Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`. Dies ist ideal für die Vorbereitung komplexer Daten für GUI-Visualisierungen.
keywords: GUI, 2D Viewer, Data Aggregation, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einem einfachen ALV Grid an. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung und Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) und `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_basic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_basic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    " Moderne Datenbeschaffung mit Inline-Deklaration
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = iv_container.

    " Feldkatalog dynamisch erstellen (oder manuell, hier dynamisch für Einfachheit)
    DATA: lt_fieldcatalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE lvc_s_vari( report = sy-repid )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcatalog.

    mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( 0 ). " Read-only
    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_sflights.
    " Mock-Container, da kein echtes UI verfügbar ist
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_basic_display( ).

    " Da die Methode ein UI-Element erstellt und anzeigt, können wir hier nur
    " die Ausführung ohne Dump testen. Eine echte Überprüfung der ALV-Anzeige
    " wäre nur in einem Integrationstest mit UI-Interaktion möglich.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflights( lo_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method should execute without dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Aufräumen (wichtig für UI-Elemente in Tests)
    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Datenbeschaffung mittels `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration (`DATA(lt_sflights)`) und die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_gui_alv_grid` zur Anzeige von Daten. Die `set_table_for_first_display` Methode wird verwendet, um das ALV zu initialisieren und die Daten anzuzeigen.
keywords: ALV, SELECT, Inline Declaration, cl_gui_alv_grid, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein ALV Grid, das Daten aus `sflights` anzeigt und Bearbeitungen zulässt. Wenn Daten im ALV geändert werden, sollen diese Änderungen in der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` aktualisiert werden.
hint: Registrieren Sie den Event `DATA_CHANGED` des `cl_gui_alv_grid` und verwenden Sie `UPDATE` mit `FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_update_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_editable,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight_editable.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_editable TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_editable WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_and_update
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_editable.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION DEFERRED.
    DATA mo_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION:
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid
                                    io_parent   TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_update_sflights.
        METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_modified_cells TYPE lvc_t_modc
            e_onf4           TYPE abap_bool
            e_onvalue        TYPE abap_bool.
      PRIVATE SECTION:
        DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
        DATA mo_parent TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_update_sflights.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mo_alv_grid = io_alv_grid.
        mo_parent = io_parent.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD handle_data_changed.
        DATA: ls_modified_cell TYPE lvc_s_modc.
        DATA: ls_sflight_db TYPE sflight.

        LOOP AT e_modified_cells INTO ls_modified_cell.
          " Zeile aus der ALV-Tabelle lesen
          READ TABLE mo_parent->mt_sflights INDEX ls_modified_cell-row_id INTO DATA(ls_sflight_alv).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Nur die geänderten Felder aktualisieren
            " CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ist hier wichtig, um nur die passenden Felder zu übertragen
            ls_sflight_db = CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight_alv MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate ).
            " Update der Datenbanktabelle
            UPDATE sflights FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_alv.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              " Erfolgreich aktualisiert
              MESSAGE 'Daten erfolgreich aktualisiert.' TYPE 'S'.
            ELSE.
              " Fehler beim Update
              MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Aktualisieren der Daten.' TYPE 'E'.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        mo_alv_grid->check_changed_data( ). " Änderungen im ALV bestätigen
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

  METHOD display_and_update.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    IF mt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = iv_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' outputlen = 10 edit = 'X' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flugnummer'       outputlen = 8  edit = 'X' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum'        outputlen = 10 edit = 'X' )
      ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Flugzeugtyp'      outputlen = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Belegte Sitze'    outputlen = 10 edit = 'X' )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSMAX' coltext = 'Max. Sitze'       outputlen = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSFREE' coltext = 'Freie Sitze'      outputlen = 10 )
    ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE lvc_s_vari( report = sy-repid )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcatalog.

    " Event-Handler registrieren
    CREATE OBJECT mo_event_handler EXPORTING io_alv_grid = mo_alv_grid io_parent = me.
    SET HANDLER mo_event_handler->handle_data_changed FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( 1 ). " Bearbeitbar machen
    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_data_changed_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_changed_update.
    " Testdaten für sflights einfügen (oder vorhandene sichern und ändern)
    DATA: ls_sflight_orig TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_sflight_orig WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20251224'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ls_sflight_orig = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 seatsfree = 50 ).
      INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight_orig.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_update_sflights( ).
    lo_cut->display_and_update( lo_container ).

    " Simulieren einer Änderung im ALV
    DATA(lt_modified_cells) = VALUE lvc_t_modc(
      ( row_id = 1 fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' )
    ).
    lo_cut->mt_sflights[ 1 ]-seatsocc = 110. " Wert in der internen Tabelle ändern

    " Event-Handler direkt aufrufen (simuliert den ALV-Event)
    DATA(lo_alv_grid_mock) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_event_handler_mock) = NEW zcl_alv_update_sflights=>lcl_event_handler( io_alv_grid = lo_alv_grid_mock io_parent = lo_cut ).

    lo_event_handler_mock->handle_data_changed( e_modified_cells = lt_modified_cells ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Datenbank aktualisiert wurde
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_seatsocc_db)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20251224'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_seatsocc_db exp = 110
      msg = 'Database should be updated with new seatsocc value' ).

    " Datenbank auf Originalzustand zurücksetzen
    UPDATE sflights FROM ls_sflight_orig.
    COMMIT WORK.
    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein bearbeitbares ALV Grid erstellt und Änderungen in der Datenbank persistiert. Der Schlüssel ist die Registrierung des `DATA_CHANGED` Events des ALV Grids. Im Event-Handler wird die interne ALV-Tabelle aktualisiert und dann ein `UPDATE` Statement mit `FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` verwendet, um nur die geänderten Felder in der Datenbank zu aktualisieren. `CORRESPONDING` ist hier eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zwischen Strukturen mit gleichen Feldnamen zu übertragen.
keywords: ALV, Event Handling, DATA_CHANGED, UPDATE, CORRESPONDING, cl_gui_alv_grid, sflights

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Button zur ALV-Toolbar hinzu und reagieren Sie auf dessen Klick-Ereignis.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `set_toolbar_interactive` und `handle_toolbar_button_click` des ALV-Grids.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_toolbar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_with_custom_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION DEFERRED.
    DATA mo_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

    CONSTANTS: gc_fcode_custom TYPE ui_func VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION:
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
        METHODS handle_toolbar_button_click FOR EVENT toolbar_button_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_fcode TYPE ui_func.
      PRIVATE SECTION:
        DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mo_alv_grid = io_alv_grid.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD handle_toolbar_button_click.
        CASE e_fcode.
          WHEN gc_fcode_custom.
            MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierter Button geklickt!' TYPE 'S'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Andere Standard-Funktionen
        ENDCASE.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

  METHOD display_with_custom_toolbar.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    IF mt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = iv_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' outputlen = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flugnummer'       outputlen = 8 )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flugdatum'        outputlen = 10 )
    ).

    " Toolbar interaktiv machen und Button hinzufügen
    DATA(ls_toolbar_button) = VALUE lvc_s_tbar(
      fcode = gc_fcode_custom
      icon  = icon_information
      butn_type = 0 " Standard Button
      text  = 'Mein Button'
      quickinfo = 'Klicken Sie hier für eine Aktion'
    ).
    DATA(lt_toolbar_buttons) = VALUE lvc_t_tbar( ( ls_toolbar_button ) ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_toolbar_interactive
      EXPORTING
        it_toolbar_excluding = VALUE lvc_t_excl( )
        it_toolbar_adding    = lt_toolbar_buttons.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE lvc_s_vari( report = sy-repid )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcatalog.

    " Event-Handler registrieren
    CREATE OBJECT mo_event_handler EXPORTING io_alv_grid = mo_alv_grid.
    SET HANDLER mo_event_handler->handle_toolbar_button_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_custom_toolbar_button FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_custom_toolbar_button.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_custom_toolbar( ).
    lo_cut->display_with_custom_toolbar( lo_container ).

    " Simulieren des Klicks auf den benutzerdefinierten Button
    DATA(lo_alv_grid_mock) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_event_handler_mock) = NEW zcl_alv_custom_toolbar=>lcl_event_handler( io_alv_grid = lo_alv_grid_mock ).

    " Der Event-Handler selbst gibt nur eine Nachricht aus, die schwer zu testen ist.
    " Wir können aber prüfen, ob der Handler ohne Fehler aufgerufen wird.
    TRY.
        lo_event_handler_mock->handle_toolbar_button_click( e_fcode = zcl_alv_custom_toolbar=>gc_fcode_custom ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Custom button click handler should execute without dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die ALV-Toolbar um eigene Buttons erweitert. Die Methode `set_toolbar_interactive` wird verwendet, um Buttons hinzuzufügen. Das Klick-Ereignis wird über den Event `toolbar_button_click` abgefangen, der in einer lokalen Event-Handler-Klasse implementiert ist. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Erweiterung der ALV-Funktionalität.
keywords: ALV, Toolbar, Custom Button, Event Handling, cl_gui_alv_grid

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an und heben Sie Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') farblich hervor. Nutzen Sie `FOR` Ausdrücke, um die Styling-Tabelle zu füllen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine `LVC_T_SCOL` Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit `FOR` Schleifen, um Zellstile zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cell_styling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_styled,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
             cell_style TYPE lvc_t_styl,
           END OF ty_sflight_styled.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_styled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_styled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_styled_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_styled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cell_styling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_styled_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Füllen der Styling-Tabelle mit FOR-Ausdruck
    rt_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_styled(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( ls_sflight
        cell_style = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_airline
                             THEN VALUE lvc_t_styl( ( fname = 'CARRID' style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_enabled_f4 ) )
                             ELSE VALUE lvc_t_styl( ) ) " Beispiel: F4-Hilfe für die Airline-Zelle
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_styled_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_styled_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_cell_styling( ).
    DATA(lt_styled_flights) = lo_cut->get_styled_sflights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_styled_flights
      msg = 'Should return styled flights' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Flüge von 'LH' einen Stil haben
    DATA(lv_found_styled) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_styled_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        IF ls_flight-cell_style IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_found_styled = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_styled
      msg = 'LH flights should have cell styling' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Flüge, die nicht 'LH' sind, keinen Stil haben (oder einen anderen)
    DATA(lv_found_un_styled) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_styled_flights INTO ls_flight.
      IF ls_flight-carrid <> 'LH'.
        IF ls_flight-cell_style IS INITIAL.
          lv_found_un_styled = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_un_styled
      msg = 'Non-LH flights should not have cell styling' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR` Ausdrücke, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und dabei dynamisch Zellstile zuzuweisen. Der `COND` Operator innerhalb des `FOR` Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine bedingte Zuweisung des Stils. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Daten zu transformieren und vorzubereiten, anstatt explizite `LOOP` und `IF` Statements zu verwenden.
keywords: ALV, Cell Styling, FOR, Internal Tables, COND, lvc_t_styl

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an, aber filtern Sie die angezeigten Daten dynamisch nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. alle Flüge, die mehr als 200 freie Plätze haben). Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... )` um die interne Tabelle vor der Anzeige zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seats_free TYPE sflight-seatsfree
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).

    IF lt_sflights_all IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Filtern der internen Tabelle mit FILTER Operator
    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_all USING KEY primary_key
                            WHERE seatsfree > iv_min_seats_free ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_sflights.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 250 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 150 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 300 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflights( 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Should return 2 flights with more than 200 free seats' ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsfree > 200 )
        msg = 'All filtered flights should have more than 200 free seats' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA') AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich, insbesondere wenn die Filterkriterien komplexer werden.
keywords: ALV, FILTER, Internal Tables, Dynamic Filtering, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der freien Sitze für alle Flüge in `sflights` und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis an. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der freien Sitze zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_total_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Aggregation mit REDUCE Operator
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsfree
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_free_seats.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0000'.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 100 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250102' seatsfree = 50 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250103' seatsfree = 200 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 350
      msg = 'Total free seats should be 350' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0000'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Akkumulationen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Ausdrucksform zu schreiben. Dies ist eine funktionale Programmierweise, die den Code kürzer und fehlerresistenter macht.
keywords: ALV, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Übertragen Sie spezifische Felder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, die für die ALV-Anzeige optimiert ist. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` für den Feldabgleich zwischen Strukturen/Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_corresponding_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_display,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_alv_display.
    TYPES: tt_alv_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights_to_alv_display
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_alv_flights) TYPE tt_alv_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_corresponding_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights_to_alv_display.
    " Datenübertragung mit CORRESPONDING Operator
    rt_alv_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING
                                       carrid = airline_id
                                       connid = flight_num
                                       fldate = flight_date
                                       seatsocc = occupied_seats
                                       seatsfree = free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_sflights_to_alv_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflights_to_alv_display.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_alv_corresponding_data=>tt_sflight_source(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 seatsfree = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251225' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 200 seatsmax = 300 seatsfree = 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_corresponding_data( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_sflights_to_alv_display( lt_source_flights = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Target table should have 2 entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-airline_id exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'First entry: Incorrect airline_id' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-flight_num exp = '0400'
      msg = 'First entry: Incorrect flight_num' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-free_seats exp = 50
      msg = 'First entry: Incorrect free_seats' ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_target_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-airline_id exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Second entry: Incorrect airline_id' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ist ideal, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu übertragen, deren Feldnamen sich unterscheiden oder nur teilweise übereinstimmen. Mit der `MAPPING` Klausel kann man explizit festlegen, welche Felder wie gemappt werden sollen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen Zuweisungen oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` in Schleifen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, ALV, Data Transfer, MAPPING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz des ALV Grid Controllers und rufen Sie Methoden in einer Kette auf, um die Initialisierung zu vereinfachen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung und die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (`->method1( )->method2( )`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_configure_alv
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_alv_grid) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_configure_alv.
    " Erstellung und Konfiguration des ALV-Grids mit Method Chaining
    ro_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = iv_container
    )->set_ready_for_input( 0
    )->set_toolbar_interactive( ).

    " Beispiel: Datenbeschaffung und Anzeige
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline' )

        ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Date' )
        ( fieldname = 'SEATSFREE' coltext = 'Free Seats' )

      ro_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights

      ro_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
