Instructions: Verwenden Sie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) in einem ALV-Event-Handler, um Variablen direkt bei der Zuweisung zu deklarieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_variable) = ...` innerhalb einer Event-Handler-Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_inline_data_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION DEFERRED.
    DATA mo_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION:
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
        METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_row     TYPE lvc_s_row
            e_column  TYPE lvc_s_col
            es_row_no TYPE lvc_s_roid.
      PRIVATE SECTION:
        DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD handle_double_click.
        " Inline-Deklaration für lokale Variablen im Event-Handler
        DATA(lv_row_index) = e_row-index.
        DATA(lv_column_name) = e_column-fieldname.

        MESSAGE |Doppelklick auf Zeile { lv_row_index }, Spalte { lv_column_name }| TYPE 'S'.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD constructor.
        mo_alv_grid = io_alv_grid.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

  METHOD display_alv_with_event.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    IF mt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = iv_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Date' )
    ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE lvc_s_vari( report = sy-repid )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcatalog.

    " Event-Handler registrieren
    CREATE OBJECT mo_event_handler EXPORTING io_alv_grid = mo_alv_grid.
    SET HANDLER mo_event_handler->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_inline_data_in_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inline_data_in_event.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_inline_data_event( ).
    lo_cut->display_alv_with_event( lo_container ).

    " Simulieren eines Doppelklicks
    DATA(ls_row) = VALUE lvc_s_row( index = 5 ).
    DATA(ls_col) = VALUE lvc_s_col( fieldname = 'CARRID' ).
    DATA(ls_row_no) = VALUE lvc_s_roid( row_id = 5 ).

    DATA(lo_alv_grid_mock) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_event_handler_mock) = NEW zcl_alv_inline_data_event=>lcl_event_handler( io_alv_grid = lo_alv_grid_mock ).

    " Der Event-Handler gibt eine Nachricht aus, die schwer zu testen ist.
    " Wir können aber prüfen, ob der Handler ohne Fehler aufgerufen wird und die Inline-Deklarationen funktionieren.
    TRY.
        lo_event_handler_mock->handle_double_click( e_row = ls_row e_column = ls_col es_row_no = ls_row_no ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Event handler with inline data should execute without dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen mit `DATA(...)` sind eine der wichtigsten modernen ABAP-Funktionen. Sie ermöglichen es, Variablen genau dort zu deklarieren, wo sie zum ersten Mal verwendet werden, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. Dies gilt auch für Event-Handler-Methoden, wo oft temporäre Variablen benötigt werden.
keywords: ALV, Inline Declaration, Event Handling, DATA, cl_gui_alv_grid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'STATUS' hinzu, deren Wert basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze ('SEATSFREE') mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck gesetzt wird. Zeigen Sie diese Daten im ALV an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` um die neue Spalte zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_for_new_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_extended,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_extended.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_extended.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_for_new_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Erstellen einer neuen Tabelle mit zusätzlicher Spalte 'STATUS' mittels FOR-Ausdruck
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_extended(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( ls_sflight
        status = COND string(
          WHEN ls_sflight-seatsfree > 100 THEN 'Viele Plätze frei'
          WHEN ls_sflight-seatsfree > 50  THEN 'Einige Plätze frei'
          ELSE 'Wenige Plätze frei'
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '0000'.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 120 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250102' seatsfree = 70 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250103' seatsfree = 30 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_for_new_column( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_status) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_with_status ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Should return 3 flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights_with_status WITH KEY carrid = 'YY' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' INTO DATA(ls_flight_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_1-status exp = 'Viele Plätze frei'
      msg = 'Status for 120 seatsfree should be correct' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights_with_status WITH KEY carrid = 'YY' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250102' INTO DATA(ls_flight_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_2-status exp = 'Einige Plätze frei'
      msg = 'Status for 70 seatsfree should be correct' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights_with_status WITH KEY carrid = 'YY' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250103' INTO DATA(ls_flight_3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_3-status exp = 'Wenige Plätze frei'
      msg = 'Status for 30 seatsfree should be correct' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '0000'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `FOR` Ausdrücken in Kombination mit `COND` Operatoren, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und dabei eine neue Spalte dynamisch zu befüllen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaufbereitung, die den Code extrem kompakt und lesbar macht, im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP` und `IF/CASE` Konstrukten.
keywords: ALV, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an und formatieren Sie die Flugnummer ('CONNID') in einem String-Template, um sie mit einem Präfix 'FL-' anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) um die Flugnummer zu formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_formatted,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_formatted TYPE string,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_formatted.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_formatted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_formatted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_formatted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Formatieren der Flugnummer mit String-Templates in einem FOR-Ausdruck
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_formatted(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid_formatted = |FL-{ ls_sflight-connid ALPHA = OUT }|,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle entgegennimmt und diese in einem ALV Grid anzeigt. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um den Feldkatalog dynamisch zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( )` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( )` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_generic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS display_generic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    METHODS create_fieldcatalog_from_rtti
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fieldcatalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_generic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_generic_table.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Daten zur Anzeige vorhanden.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = iv_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = create_fieldcatalog_from_rtti( it_data ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        is_variant       = VALUE lvc_s_vari( report = sy-repid )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_data
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcatalog.

    mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( 0 ).
    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_fieldcatalog_from_rtti.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_fieldcatalog = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
      ( fieldname = ls_comp-name
        coltext   = ls_comp-name
        outputlen = ls_comp-length ) " Vereinfachte Längenbestimmung
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_generic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_generic_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).

    lo_container->free( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um einen Feldkatalog dynamisch aus der Struktur einer beliebigen internen Tabelle zu generieren. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die es ermöglicht, generische ALV-Anzeigekomponenten zu erstellen, die nicht an eine feste Struktur gebunden sind. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` ist der moderne Weg, Typinformationen zur Laufzeit abzufragen.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an und verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator, um eine Spalte 'FLIGHT_CATEGORY' basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') zu befüllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um bedingt Werte zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_categorized,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_categorized.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_categorized TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_categorized WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_categorized.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Befüllen der neuen Spalte 'FLIGHT_CATEGORY' mit SWITCH Operator
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_categorized(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( ls_sflight
        flight_category = SWITCH string( ls_sflight-carrid
                                  WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                  WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                  WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
                                  ELSE 'Andere Airline' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_categorized_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_categorized_flights.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'XX') AND connid = '0000'.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250102' ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250103' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_switch_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_categorized_flights) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_categorized_flights ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Should return 3 categorized flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_categorized_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-flight_category exp = 'Lufthansa'
      msg = 'Category for LH should be correct' ).

    READ TABLE lt_categorized_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-flight_category exp = 'American Airlines'
      msg = 'Category for AA should be correct' ).

    READ TABLE lt_categorized_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'XX' INTO DATA(ls_flight_xx).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_xx-flight_category exp = 'Andere Airline'
      msg = 'Category for XX should be correct' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'XX') AND connid = '0000'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu `CASE` Statements, insbesondere wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zuzuweisen. In Kombination mit `FOR` Ausdrücken ermöglicht er eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Transformation von Daten, wie hier beim Hinzufügen einer Kategorie-Spalte zu den Flugdaten.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an und berechnen Sie das Enddatum eines Fluges, indem Sie eine Dauer zum Flugdatum hinzufügen. Nutzen Sie moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_duration,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             end_date  TYPE d,
           END OF ty_sflight_duration.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_end_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_duration_days TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_end_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Berechnung des Enddatums mit Datumsarithmetik in einem FOR-Ausdruck
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_duration(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( ls_sflight
        end_date = ls_sflight-fldate + iv_duration_days )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_end_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_end_date.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'WW' AND connid = '0000'.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'WW' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_end_date) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_end_date( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_with_end_date ) exp = 1
      msg = 'Should return 1 flight with end date' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights_with_end_date WITH KEY carrid = 'WW' INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-end_date exp = '20250106'
      msg = 'End date should be 5 days after flight date' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'WW' AND connid = '0000'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP unterstützt seit Version 7.40+ direkte Datumsarithmetik, was das Hinzufügen oder Subtrahieren von Tagen zu einem Datum erheblich vereinfacht. Anstatt komplexe Funktionsbausteine zu verwenden, kann man einfach `datum + tage` schreiben. Dies ist eine sehr intuitive und moderne Art, mit Datumsberechnungen umzugehen, die den Code sauber und effizient hält.
keywords: ALV, Date/Time, Datumsarithmetik, FOR, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') und berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft. Zeigen Sie die gruppierten Ergebnisse in einem ALV an. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` innerhalb des `FOR` Ausdrucks für die Gruppierung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_grouped,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_free_seats TYPE i,
             number_of_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_grouped.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_grouped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsfree
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Gruppierung und Aggregation mit FOR GROUPS und REDUCE
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_grouped(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_sflight
          NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_member-seatsfree
        ),
        number_of_flights = GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_flights.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('GR1', 'GR2') AND connid = '0000'.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'GR1' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 100 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'GR1' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' seatsfree = 50 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'GR2' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 200 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped_flights ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Should return 2 grouped entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'GR1' INTO DATA(ls_group_gr1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_gr1-total_free_seats exp = 150
      msg = 'Total free seats for GR1 should be 150' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_gr1-number_of_flights exp = 2
      msg = 'Number of flights for GR1 should be 2' ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'GR2' INTO DATA(ls_group_gr2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_gr2-total_free_seats exp = 200
      msg = 'Total free seats for GR2 should be 200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_gr2-number_of_flights exp = 1
      msg = 'Number of flights for GR2 should be 1' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('GR1', 'GR2') AND connid = '0000'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('GR1', 'GR2') AND connid = '0001'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Syntax in Kombination mit `REDUCE` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie ersetzt traditionelle `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und nachfolgende Aggregationslogik durch einen einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessern kann.
keywords: ALV, Grouping, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Standardtabelle von Strings in eine sortierte Tabelle von Integern, wobei nur gültige Zahlen berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` mit `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_string,
      ty_t_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_string WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_s_int,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_int,
      ty_t_int TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_s_int WITH UNIQUE KEY value.

    METHODS convert_string_table_to_int
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE ty_t_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ints) TYPE ty_t_int.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_int.
    rt_ints = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN it_strings
                       WHERE ( <fs>-value IS NUMERIC )
                       ( value = CONV i( <fs>-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA: lt_strings TYPE zcl_conv_table_type=>ty_t_string,
          lt_expected TYPE zcl_conv_table_type=>ty_t_int.

    APPEND VALUE #( value = '10' ) TO lt_strings.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 'abc' ) TO lt_strings.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = '5' ) TO lt_strings.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = '20' ) TO lt_strings.

    APPEND VALUE #( value = 5 ) TO lt_expected.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 10 ) TO lt_expected.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 20 ) TO lt_expected.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_type( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_string_table_to_int( lt_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #(...)`, `FOR`-Iteratoren und dem `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen, inklusive Filterung und Typkonvertierung in einem Schritt.
keywords: CONV, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Type Conversion, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für einen bestimmten Flug, wobei der Preis als String vorliegt und in einen Dezimalwert konvertiert werden muss.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONV` für die Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + CONV p DECIMALS 2( <fs>-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird `CONV` verwendet, um den `price`-Feld (typisch `sflight-price` ist `s_price`, was ein `curr` Feld ist, aber für die Demonstration nehmen wir an, es wäre ein String, der konvertiert werden muss) in einen Dezimalwert zu konvertieren, bevor er zur Summe addiert wird.
keywords: CONV, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hash eines Strings und geben Sie ihn als `XSTRING` zurück.

CLASS zcl_binary_sha256_hash DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_binary_sha256_hash IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_hash.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( iv_string ).

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei `XSTRING`-Werte auf Gleichheit.

CLASS zcl_binary_compare_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_xstrings
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring1 TYPE xstring
        iv_xstring2 TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_equal) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_as_int.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN lt_sflights ( CONV i( <fs>-connid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine bitweise ODER-Operation auf zwei Hexadezimalwerten (Typ `X`) durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `BIT-OR`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_binary_bit_or DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_bit_or
      IMPORTING
        iv_hex1 TYPE x LENGTH 1
        iv_hex2 TYPE x LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE x LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_bit_or IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_bit_or.
    rv_result = iv_hex1 BIT-OR iv_hex2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_bit_or FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bit_or.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_bit_or( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_bit_or( iv_hex1 = 'F0' iv_hex2 = '0F' ). " F0 = 11110000, 0F = 00001111 -> FF = 11111111
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'FF' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->perform_bit_or( iv_hex1 = 'A5' iv_hex2 = '5A' ). " A5 = 10100101, 5A = 01011010 -> FF = 11111111

    lv_result = lo_cut->perform_bit_or( iv_hex1 = '00' iv_hex2 = 'FF' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die ersten 3 Zeilen der Tabelle `sflight` und geben Sie diese aus. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Zeilen enthält, deren `sy-tabix` kleiner oder gleich 3 ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_n_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_all WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_n_rows )
      ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung von `sy-tabix` innerhalb einer `FOR`-Expression, um eine interne Tabelle basierend auf dem Zeilenindex zu filtern. Anstatt einer expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisung wird hier eine deklarative und kompakte Syntax verwendet, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert. `VALUE #(...)` erzeugt eine neue Tabelle, und `FOR ... WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_n_rows )` filtert die Elemente effizient.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der 'CONNID' Werte aus `sflight` für Zeilen mit geradem Index. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression und `sy-tabix` mit dem Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_even_index_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_even_index_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0 )
                       NEXT s = s + ls_sflight-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_even_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_even_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sy_tabix( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_even_index_connid( ).

    " Since sflight content can vary, we assert that a sum is calculated.
    " For a robust test, sflight data would be mocked or controlled.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_sum,
      msg = 'The sum should not be initial if sflight has data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression und der Bedingung `sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0` werden nur die `CONNID`-Werte von Zeilen mit geradem Index summiert. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster in ABAP, das Schleifen und temporäre Variablen überflüssig macht und den Code prägnanter gestaltet.
keywords: sy-tabix, REDUCE, FOR, Aggregation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Finden Sie den Index des ersten Fluges in `sflight` mit der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und geben Sie die gesamte Zeile dieses Fluges zurück. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und anschließend `sy-tabix` oder die Funktion `line_index()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_index_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.

CLASS zcl_line_index_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " sy-tabix now holds the index of the found line
      rs_flight = lt_sflights[ sy-tabix ]. " Access using table expression
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen klassischen ABAP-Bericht für `sflight` und formatieren Sie die Überschrift mit `cl_abap_list_layout`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_list_layout_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_layout_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_report.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    NEW cl_abap_list_layout( )->set_top_of_page_text(
      iv_text = 'Flugübersicht (Top 5 Flüge)'
      iv_color = cl_abap_list_layout=>co_color_positive
      iv_intensity = cl_abap_list_layout=>co_intensity_on
      iv_bold = abap_true
    )->display_top_of_page( ).

    SKIP.
    WRITE: / 'Carrier', 10 'Conn. ID', 20 'Flight Date', 35 'Occupied Seats'.
    ULINE.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      WRITE: / ls_flight-carrid, 10 ls_flight-connid, 20 ls_flight-fldate, 35 ls_flight-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Testing classic list output is challenging in unit tests as it involves screen output.

Obwohl klassische Listen nicht die primäre Wahl für moderne UIs sind, ist die Klasse nützlich, um bestehende Berichte zu verbessern. Die Datenbeschaffung erfolgt hier mit einem modernen `SELECT INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` Statement. Der Test konzentriert sich auf die fehlerfreie Ausführung, da die Überprüfung der Listenformatierung in Unit-Tests komplex ist.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie für jede Gruppe die ersten 2 Flüge aus, zusammen mit ihrem Index innerhalb der Gruppe. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT GROUP` und `sy-tabix` innerhalb der Gruppeniteration, um den Index innerhalb der Gruppe zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             group_index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_per_group
      IMPORTING
        iv_n_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_per_group.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 20 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_group_flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_group_flight-carrid
      ( 
        FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group_flight WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_n_rows )
        ( 
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
          group_index = sy-tabix
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status_by_index
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.

CLASS zcl_cond_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_by_index.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        status = COND string( WHEN sy-tabix <= 5 THEN 'First 5' ELSE 'Other' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den minimalen und maximalen Wert in einer Liste von Zahlen unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_math` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `cl_abap_math=>min` und `cl_abap_math=>max`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_min_max_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_numbers,
        value TYPE decfloat34,
      END OF ty_numbers,
      tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_numbers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_min_max
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      EXPORTING
        ev_min_value TYPE decfloat34
        ev_max_value TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_min_max_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_min_max.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ev_min_value = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = it_numbers[ 1 ]-value
      FOR <fs_number> IN it_numbers
      NEXT result = cl_abap_math=>min( val1 = result val2 = <fs_number>-value )
    ).

    ev_max_value = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = it_numbers[ 1 ]-value
      FOR <fs_number> IN it_numbers
      NEXT result = cl_abap_math=>max( val1 = result val2 = <fs_number>-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( value = 7.8  )
      ( value = 1.0  )
    ).

    lo_cut->find_min_max(

  METHOD test_empty_table.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) nach einem bestimmten Kriterium und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit ausgewählten Feldern unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `FILTER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Zeilenauswahl und `FOR` in Kombination mit `VALUE` für die Transformation der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight_filtered,
      tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        price  = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining und Constructor Injection in einer ABAP-Klasse.
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` zurück und verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator mit Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_chain_inject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_chain_inject.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_chain_inject.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_chain_inject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_oo_chain_inject( iv_initial_value = 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    DATA(lo_calculator_start_10) = NEW zcl_oo_chain_inject( iv_initial_value = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result_1) = lo_calculator_start_10->add( 5 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_1 exp = 15 ).

    DATA(lo_calculator_start_0) = NEW zcl_oo_chain_inject( iv_initial_value = 0 ).
    DATA(lv_result_2) = lo_calculator_start_0->add( 100 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_2 exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Kettenaufrufe) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem Methoden, die den aktuellen Objektkontext zurückgeben, direkt nacheinander aufgerufen werden können. Constructor Injection ermöglicht die Übergabe von Initialwerten oder Abhängigkeiten beim Erzeugen eines Objekts, was die Testbarkeit und Flexibilität erhöht.
keywords: OBJECT ORIENTATION, METHOD CHAINING, CONSTRUCTOR INJECTION, NEW

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_structure,
        field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_dynamic_structure.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Get description of the structure
    lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYN_TABLE_CREATION=>TY_DYNAMIC_STRUCTURE' ).

    " Create a table type based on the structure
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lr_struct_type
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_row>   TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
        CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_row> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_row>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).

        IF <fs_row> IS ASSIGNED.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
          IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_field1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
          ENDIF.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
          IF <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_field2> = sy-index * 10.
          ENDIF.

          INSERT <fs_row> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden und formatieren Sie einen Zeitstempel in ein benutzerfreundliches Datum und eine Uhrzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitstempel-Operationen und `CONV` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_time_tstmp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_timestamp_diff
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_diff_seconds) TYPE i.

    METHODS format_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_dt) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_tstmp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_timestamp_diff.
    rv_diff_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( 
      tstmp1 = iv_tstmp1
      tstmp2 = iv_tstmp2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_time) TYPE t.

    CONVERT TIME STAMP iv_tstmp INTO DATE lv_date TIME lv_time.

    rv_formatted_dt = |Datum: { lv_date DATE = USER } Uhrzeit: { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `CONVERT TIME STAMP` Anweisung in Kombination mit String-Templates und der `DATE = USER` / `TIME = USER` Option ermöglicht eine flexible und benutzerfreundliche Formatierung von Datums- und Zeitangaben.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (SFlight) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_capacity TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_capacity_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsmax
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_capacity = lv_total_capacity
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_capacity FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_capacity_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).

    " Check for a known carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-total_capacity > 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No data found for carrier LH, check SFlight data' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Ensure no duplicate carriers
    DATA(lv_unique_carriers) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR <fs_entry> IN lt_summary
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = lv_unique_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflight.
    " This test would require mocking or temporarily clearing SFlight, which is complex.
    " For simplicity, we assume SFlight always has data in a real system.
    " A conceptual test would assert initial result if SFlight was empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_capacity_by_carrier( ).
    " If SFlight could be empty, we'd assert_initial(lt_summary).
    " For now, we just ensure it doesn't dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Test for empty SFlight (conceptual) passed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um interne Tabellen nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator können Aggregationen (wie Summen, Minima, Maxima) direkt innerhalb der Schleife für jede Gruppe berechnet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und performantem Code führt.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, GROUP BY, REDUCE, AGGREGATION, SFlight

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Sinus und Kosinus eines Winkels in Radiant unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_math`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `sin` und `cos` der Klasse `cl_abap_math`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_trigonometry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_trig_functions
      IMPORTING
        iv_angle_rad TYPE decfloat34
      EXPORTING
        ev_sin_value TYPE decfloat34
        ev_cos_value TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_trigonometry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_trig_functions.
    ev_sin_value = cl_abap_math=>sin( iv_angle_rad ).
    ev_cos_value = cl_abap_math=>cos( iv_angle_rad ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_trig_functions FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_pi_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_trig_functions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    DATA(lv_sin) TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA(lv_cos) TYPE decfloat34.

    " Angle 0 radians
    lo_cut->calculate_trig_functions(
      EXPORTING
        iv_angle_rad = 0
      IMPORTING
        ev_sin_value = lv_sin
        ev_cos_value = lv_cos
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sin exp = 0.0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cos exp = 1.0 ).

    " Angle PI/2 radians (approx 1.57079632679)
    lo_cut->calculate_trig_functions(
      EXPORTING
        iv_angle_rad = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) / 2
      IMPORTING
        ev_sin_value = lv_sin
        ev_cos_value = lv_cos
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_sin exp = 1.0 msg = 'Sin(PI/2)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_cos exp = 0.0 msg = 'Cos(PI/2)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_pi_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    DATA(lv_sin) TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA(lv_cos) TYPE decfloat34.

    " Angle PI radians
    lo_cut->calculate_trig_functions(
      EXPORTING
        iv_angle_rad = cl_abap_math=>pi( )
      IMPORTING
        ev_sin_value = lv_sin
        ev_cos_value = lv_cos
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_sin exp = 0.0 msg = 'Sin(PI)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_cos exp = -1.0 msg = 'Cos(PI)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_math` stellt auch trigonometrische Funktionen wie Sinus (`sin`) und Kosinus (`cos`) bereit. Diese Methoden arbeiten mit Winkeln in Radiant und bieten eine präzise Möglichkeit für wissenschaftliche und technische Berechnungen in ABAP.
keywords: MATH, SIN, COS, TRIGONOMETRY, DECFLOAT34

Instructions: Verketten Sie Strings effizient und verwenden Sie den `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` Operator mit String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Verkettung und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` für die Ersetzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_concat_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_old_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_concat_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = |Original: { iv_text }|.

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_char IN lv_temp_text WITH iv_new_char.

    rv_processed_text = |{ lv_temp_text } | & 
                        |Ersetzt '{ iv_old_char }' durch '{ iv_new_char }'|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_concat_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_string( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_old_char = 'o' iv_new_char = 'x' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Original: Hellx Wxrld Ersetzt ''o'' durch ''x''' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replacement.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_concat_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_string( iv_text = 'ABAP' iv_old_char = 'Z' iv_new_char = 'Y' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Original: ABAP Ersetzt ''Z'' durch ''Y''' ).

explanation: String-Templates sind die bevorzugte Methode zur String-Verkettung und -Formatierung in modernem ABAP, da sie lesbarer und oft performanter sind als die alte `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung. `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` bietet eine einfache und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Zeichen oder Substrings in einem String zu ersetzen.
keywords: STRING PROCESSING, STRING TEMPLATES, REPLACE, CONCATENATION

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Arcustangens (atan2) von zwei Zahlen unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_math`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `atan2` der Klasse `cl_abap_math`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_atan2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_atan2
      IMPORTING
        iv_y TYPE decfloat34
        iv_x TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_angle_rad) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_atan2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_atan2.
    rv_angle_rad = cl_abap_math=>atan2( y = iv_y x = iv_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_atan2_quadrants FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_atan2_special_cases FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_atan2_quadrants.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_atan2( ).
    DATA(lv_angle) TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA(lv_pi) TYPE decfloat34 VALUE cl_abap_math=>pi( ).

    " Quadrant 1: (1, 1) -> PI/4
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = 1 iv_x = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = lv_pi / 4 msg = 'Q1' ).

    " Quadrant 2: (1, -1) -> 3*PI/4
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = 1 iv_x = -1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = 3 * lv_pi / 4 msg = 'Q2' ).

    " Quadrant 3: (-1, -1) -> -3*PI/4
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = -1 iv_x = -1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = -3 * lv_pi / 4 msg = 'Q3' ).

    " Quadrant 4: (-1, 1) -> -PI/4
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = -1 iv_x = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = -lv_pi / 4 msg = 'Q4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_atan2_special_cases.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_atan2( ).
    DATA(lv_angle) TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA(lv_pi) TYPE decfloat34 VALUE cl_abap_math=>pi( ).

    " Positive X-axis: (0, 1) -> 0
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = 0 iv_x = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = 0.0 msg = 'Pos X-axis' ).

    " Positive Y-axis: (1, 0) -> PI/2
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = 1 iv_x = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = lv_pi / 2 msg = 'Pos Y-axis' ).

    " Negative X-axis: (0, -1) -> PI
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = 0 iv_x = -1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = lv_pi msg = 'Neg X-axis' ).

    " Negative Y-axis: (-1, 0) -> -PI/2
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = -1 iv_x = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = -lv_pi / 2 msg = 'Neg Y-axis' ).

    " Origin: (0, 0) -> 0 (or undefined, but ABAP returns 0)
    lv_angle = lo_cut->calculate_atan2( iv_y = 0 iv_x = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_angle exp = 0.0 msg = 'Origin' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `atan2`-Funktion (Arcustangens von y/x) ist nützlich, um den Winkel zwischen der positiven x-Achse und einem Punkt (x, y) in der Ebene zu berechnen. `cl_abap_math=>atan2` liefert den Winkel im Bereich von -PI bis +PI, was die korrekte Bestimmung des Quadranten ermöglicht und somit eine robustere Lösung als der einfache Arcustangens bietet.
keywords: MATH, ATAN2, TRIGONOMETRY, DECFLOAT34

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle `sflights` und modifizieren Sie dynamisch die Währung (`CURRENCY`) für Flüge, deren Flugdatum (`FLDATE`) in der Vergangenheit liegt, auf 'EUR'. Verwenden Sie dabei `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und eine `FOR` Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_currency.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      IF <fs_sflight>-fldate < lv_today.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CURRENCY' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_currency>).
        IF <fs_currency> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_currency> = 'EUR'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_currency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_currency.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_modify=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum - 10.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 10.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'GBP'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_modify( ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-currency exp = 'GBP' msg = 'Currency should remain GBP for future date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Modifikation einer internen Tabelle. Durch die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` innerhalb einer `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` Schleife kann direkt auf die Zeile zugegriffen und diese verändert werden, ohne eine explizite `MODIFY` Anweisung zu benötigen. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Komponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was für flexible Datenverarbeitung unerlässlich ist.

CLASS zcl_fs_inline_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_fs_inline_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gespeichert ist. Setzen Sie den Wert dieser Komponente auf 'X'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_component_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_component_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_value          TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_dynamically.
    rs_data-field1 = 'Initial1'.
    rs_data-field2 = 'Initial2'.

    ASSIGN rs_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_structure>).
    IF <fs_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_component> = iv_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_component( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->set_component_dynamically( iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 'Modified1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field1 exp = 'Modified1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = 'Initial2' ).

    ls_result = lo_cut->set_component_dynamically( iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' iv_value = 'Modified2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field1 exp = 'Initial1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = 'Modified2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Fähigkeit von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien, in denen die Namen der zu verarbeitenden Felder erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von generischen Daten oder Konfigurationen. Es ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure, RTTI

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise (`PRICE`) aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT` Klauseln, um die Summe zu akkumulieren. Greifen Sie auf die Preis-Komponente über das `FIELD-SYMBOL` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0123' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit der Inline-Deklaration von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` (`FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights`) wird der Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark, um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob zwei Termine sich zeitlich überschneiden. Erstellen Sie dazu zwei `cl_appointment` Objekte und implementieren Sie die Prüflogik.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Start- und Endzeiten der Termine. Ein Konflikt liegt vor, wenn (Start1 < Ende2 UND Start2 < Ende1).
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_conflict DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_for_conflict
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment1 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
        io_appointment2 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_conflict) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_conflict IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_conflict.
    IF io_appointment1 IS NOT BOUND OR io_appointment2 IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start1_ts) = io_appointment1->get_start_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_end1_ts)   = io_appointment1->get_end_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_start2_ts) = io_appointment2->get_start_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_end2_ts)   = io_appointment2->get_end_timestamp( ).

    IF lv_start1_ts < lv_end2_ts AND lv_start2_ts < lv_end1_ts.
      rv_has_conflict = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_has_conflict = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conflict_detection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conflict_detection.
    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_app1->set_start_time( '090000' ).
    lo_app1->set_end_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_app1->set_end_time( '100000' ).

    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app2->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_app2->set_start_time( '093000' ).
    lo_app2->set_end_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_app2->set_end_time( '103000' ).

    DATA(lo_app3) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app3->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_app3->set_start_time( '100000' ).
    lo_app3->set_end_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_app3->set_end_time( '110000' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_conflict( ).

    " Conflict expected
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_for_conflict( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ) msg = 'Should detect conflict' ).

    " No conflict (touching at end/start)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_for_conflict( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app3 ) msg = 'Should not detect conflict (touching)' ).

    " No conflict (separate)
    lo_app3->set_start_time( '100100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_for_conflict( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app3 ) msg = 'Should not detect conflict (separate)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_appointment` und grundlegender Logik Terminüberschneidungen erkennt. Die Klasse `cl_appointment` bietet Methoden wie `get_start_timestamp()` und `get_end_timestamp()`, die die Umwandlung von Datum und Uhrzeit in einen Zeitstempel erleichtern, was Vergleiche über Mitternacht hinweg vereinfacht. Die Bedingung `Start1 < Ende2 AND Start2 < Ende1` ist die Standardlogik zur Erkennung von Überschneidungen zweier Zeitintervalle.
keywords: cl_appointment, Date/Time, Conflict Detection, Object Orientation, Timestamp

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') 'LH' ist, und geben Sie die gefilterten Zeilen aus. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.

CLASS zcl_fs_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.

        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   ( <fs_flight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_filter_for=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_filter_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Schleife, einer `WHERE` Klausel und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` zur effizienten Filterung interner Tabellen. Diese Syntax ist sehr modern und ermöglicht es, Filteroperationen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile durchzuführen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance optimieren kann.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, die mit 'L' beginnen. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und den `VALUE` Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_l_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_l_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_l_carriers.
    rt_l_carriers = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid CP 'L*' )
                                 ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LX' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_value_filter( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von `cl_appointment` Objekten entgegennimmt und nur die Termine zurückgibt, die an einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `cl_appointment`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator auf die Tabelle von Objektreferenzen und greifen Sie auf die `get_start_date()` Methode zu.

CLASS zcl_filter_appointments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_date         TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_appointments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_date.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_appointments USING KEY default
                                         WHERE table_line->get_start_date( ) = iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_date.
    DATA: lt_all_appointments TYPE zcl_filter_appointments=>tt_appointments.

    APPEND NEW cl_appointment( i_description = 'App1' i_start_date = sy-datum i_start_time = '090000' ) TO lt_all_appointments.
    APPEND NEW cl_appointment( i_description = 'App2' i_start_date = sy-datum + 1 i_start_time = '090000' ) TO lt_all_appointments.
    APPEND NEW cl_appointment( i_description = 'App3' i_start_date = sy-datum i_start_time = '100000' ) TO lt_all_appointments.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_appointments( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_date( it_appointments = lt_all_appointments iv_date = sy-datum ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]->get_description( ) exp = 'App1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]->get_description( ) exp = 'App3' ).
