Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen als String entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll den Wert dieses Feldes für jede Zeile der Tabelle in Großbuchstaben umwandeln. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `TO UPPER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Kombination mit `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_generic_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_generic_data.
    TYPES tt_generic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_generic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_field_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_generic_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data_upper) TYPE tt_generic_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_upper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_field_to_upper.
    rt_data_upper = it_data.

    LOOP AT rt_data_upper ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
        <fs_field> = to_upper( <fs_field> ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_convert_to_upper FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_upper.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_fs_generic_upper=>tt_generic_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field_a = 'hello' field_b = 'world' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field_a = 'abap' field_b = 'modern' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_generic_upper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_field_to_upper( it_data = lt_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD_A' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field_a exp = 'HELLO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field_b exp = 'world' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-field_a exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-field_b exp = 'modern' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->convert_field_to_upper( it_data = lt_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field_a exp = 'hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field_b exp = 'WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Flexibilität von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die generische Datenmanipulation. Durch die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` kann ein Feld einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch identifiziert und sein Wert mit der eingebauten Funktion `to_upper()` modifiziert werden. Dies ist ideal für Frameworks oder generische Dienstprogramme, die mit unterschiedlichen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, TO_UPPER, Generic, String Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer eines Termins in Minuten unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_appointment`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_start_timestamp()` und `get_end_timestamp()` und subtrahieren Sie die Zeitstempel, um die Dauer zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_duration_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration_in_minutes.
    IF io_appointment IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start_ts) = io_appointment->get_start_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_end_ts)   = io_appointment->get_end_timestamp( ).

    IF lv_end_ts IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_start_ts IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_duration_minutes = ( lv_end_ts - lv_start_ts ) / 60.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_duration_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_duration_calculation.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_time( '090000' ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_time( '103000' ). " 1 hour 30 minutes = 90 minutes

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lo_cut->calculate_duration_in_minutes( lo_appointment ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = 90 ).

    " Test over midnight
    lo_appointment->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_time( '230000' ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_date( sy-datum + 1 ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_time( '010000' ). " 2 hours = 120 minutes
    lv_duration = lo_cut->calculate_duration_in_minutes( lo_appointment ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = 120 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung der Dauer eines Termins unter Verwendung der Zeitstempel-Funktionalität von `cl_appointment`. Durch die Umwandlung von Start- und Enddatum/-zeit in Zeitstempel (`get_start_timestamp()`, `get_end_timestamp()`) wird die Berechnung der Dauer, auch über Mitternacht hinweg, vereinfacht und ist robust gegenüber Zeitzonenunterschieden (wenn die Zeitstempel entsprechend behandelt werden). Die Subtraktion von Zeitstempeln liefert die Dauer in Sekunden, die dann in Minuten umgerechnet wird.
keywords: cl_appointment, Date/Time, Duration, Timestamp, Calculation

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen) aus einem gegebenen String und geben Sie diese als Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit dem Pattern `\d+` und der `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX ... RESULTS ...` Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create( pattern = '\d+' ).
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lo_regex IN iv_input_string RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( ls_match-offset = ls_match-offset length = ls_match-length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers( 'abc123def45ghi' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '45' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->extract_numbers( 'No numbers here' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

RESULTS ...` Syntax, um alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem String zu finden. Die `VALUE` Operator und `FOR` Iteration werden genutzt, um die Ergebnisse effizient in eine String-Tabelle zu transformieren.
keywords: REGEX, FIND, Zahlen, String, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Setzen Sie eine einzelne Zeile eines sprachabhängigen Textes für ein simuliertes Transportobjekt unter Verwendung von `CL_CTS_LANGUAGE_FILE_IO`. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine konzeptionelle Nutzung ist, da reale Transportobjekte komplexer sind.

CLASS zcl_cts_set_text_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cts_set_text_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_language_text.
    DATA(lv_trkorr) = 'DUMMY_TR'. " Simulierter Transportauftrag
    DATA(lv_object) = 'R3TR'.
    DATA(lv_objname) = 'ZTEST_OBJ'.
    DATA(lv_text_id) = 'TEXT_001'.

    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>set_text_line(
          EXPORTING
            i_trkorr   = lv_trkorr
            i_langu    = iv_langu
            i_object   = lv_object
            i_objname  = lv_objname
            i_text_id  = lv_text_id
            i_text_line = iv_text_line
        ).
        " In einem realen Szenario würde hier ein Commit oder ähnliches folgen
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_cts).
        MESSAGE lx_cts->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Validieren Sie, ob ein gegebener String eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse gemäß einem einfachen Regex-Muster ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_validate_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_validate_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create(
      pattern = '^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,3})+$'
    ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_regex->match( iv_email ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_emails FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_emails FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_emails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_validate_email( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'test@example.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'firstname.lastname@domain.co.uk' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'user123@sub.domain.net' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_emails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_validate_email( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'invalid-email' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'test@.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_email( '@example.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'test@example' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die `MATCH`-Methode, um die Gültigkeit einer E-Mail-Adresse anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks zu überprüfen. Dies ist eine effiziente und moderne Art der String-Validierung in ABAP.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen von mehreren Leerzeichen (zwei oder mehr) in einem String durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.

CLASS zcl_reg_replace_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_multiple_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_replace_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_multiple_spaces.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create( pattern = '\s{2,}' ).
    rv_result_string = lo_regex->replace(
      text  = iv_input_string

    ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_replace_spaces( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Dies   ist    ein     Teststring.'.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Dies ist ein Teststring.'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->replace_multiple_spaces( lv_input ).

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_urls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_urls) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_urls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_urls.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create(
      pattern = 'https?://(?:[a-zA-Z]|[0-9]|[$-_@.&+]|[!*\(\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]))+'
    ).
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lo_regex IN iv_input_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_urls = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( ls_match-offset = ls_match-offset length = ls_match-length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines komplexen Delimiters, der aus einem Semikolon gefolgt von einem oder mehreren Leerzeichen besteht (z.B. '; ', ';   ').
hint: Da `SPLIT` keine Regex unterstützt, verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` um die Delimiter-Positionen zu finden und dann String-Operationen oder `REDUCE` zum Aufteilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_split_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_split_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create( pattern = ';\s+' ).
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lo_regex IN iv_input_string RESULTS DATA(lt_delimiters).

    IF lt_delimiters IS INITIAL.
      APPEND iv_input_string TO rt_parts.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_delimiters INTO DATA(ls_delimiter).
      APPEND iv_input_string+lv_last_offset( ls_delimiter-offset - lv_last_offset ) TO rt_parts.
      lv_last_offset = ls_delimiter-offset + ls_delimiter-length.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND iv_input_string+lv_last_offset TO rt_parts.

    " Entferne leere Einträge, die durch aufeinanderfolgende Delimiter entstehen könnten
    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lv_input = 'Nur ein Teil'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).

      i_langu    = sy-langu
      i_object   = lv_object
      i_objname  = lv_objname
      i_text_id  = lv_text_id
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_initial_check ).

    " Texte löschen
    lo_deleter->delete_language_texts( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Texte wirklich gelöscht wurden (Tabelle sollte leer sein)
    DATA(lt_final_check) = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_text_table(
      i_trkorr   = lv_trkorr
      i_langu    = sy-langu
      i_object   = lv_object
      i_objname  = lv_objname
      i_text_id  = lv_text_id
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_final_check ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da `CL_CTS_LANGUAGE_FILE_IO` keine explizite 'DELETE'-Methode für Texte bietet, wird in diesem Beispiel das 'Löschen' durch das Überschreiben der vorhandenen Texte mit einer leeren Tabelle simuliert. Dies ist die gängige Methode, um sprachabhängige Texte für ein Transportobjekt zu entfernen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE string_table( )` ist hier modern und prägnant.
keywords: CTS, Sprache, Text, Löschen, CL_CTS_LANGUAGE_FILE_IO, VALUE

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Hashtags (Wörter, die mit '#' beginnen) aus einem gegebenen Text, ohne das '#' Zeichen selbst.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit einem Pattern, das die Hashtags erfasst, und nutzen Sie Gruppen, um das '#' auszuschließen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_hashtags DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_hashtags
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashtags) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_hashtags IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create( pattern = '#(\w+)' ).
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lo_regex IN iv_input_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_hashtags = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( ls_match-submatches[1] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_hashtags FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_extract_hashtags( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Dies ist ein Text mit #Hashtag1 und #nochEinHashtag. #ABAP #ModernABAP'.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hashtag1' ) ( 'nochEinHashtag' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ( 'ModernABAP' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->extract_hashtags( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[ 1 ] exp = lt_expected[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[ 2 ] exp = lt_expected[ 2 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[ 3 ] exp = lt_expected[ 3 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[ 4 ] exp = lt_expected[ 4 ] ).

    lv_input = 'Keine Hashtags hier.'.
    lt_actual = lo_cut->extract_hashtags( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_actual ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX ... RESULTS ...` Syntax, um Hashtags zu extrahieren. Durch die Verwendung einer Fanggruppe `(\w+)` im regulären Ausdruck `#(\w+)` kann nur der eigentliche Hashtag-Text (ohne das '#'-Zeichen) extrahiert werden. Die moderne `VALUE` Operator und `FOR` Iteration mit `ls_match-submatches[1]` machen den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: REGEX, Hashtag, Extraktion, String, FIND, Gruppen, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle verfügbaren sprachabhängigen Texte für ein simuliertes Transportobjekt und eine bestimmte Sprache, auch wenn die Text-ID unbekannt ist.
hint: Die `GET_TEXT_TABLE` Methode kann auch ohne `i_text_id` aufgerufen werden, um alle Texte für das Objekt zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_get_all_texts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_entry,
             text_id   TYPE string,
             text_line TYPE string,
           END OF ty_text_entry.
    TYPES: tt_text_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_text_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_language_texts
      IMPORTING
        iv_langu     TYPE sy-langu DEFAULT sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_texts) TYPE tt_text_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_get_all_texts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_language_texts.
    DATA(lv_trkorr) = 'DUMMY_TR_ALL'. " Simulierter Transportauftrag
    DATA(lv_object) = 'R3TR'.
    DATA(lv_objname) = 'ZTEST_OBJ_ALL'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_raw_texts) = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_text_table(
          i_trkorr   = lv_trkorr
          i_langu    = iv_langu
          i_object   = lv_object
          i_objname  = lv_objname
          i_text_id  = '' " Leere Text-ID, um alle Texte zu erhalten
        ).

        " Die zurückgegebene Tabelle enthält die Text-ID im ersten Feld der Zeile
        rt_all_texts = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_texts
                                 LET lv_first_space = find( val = ls_raw-table_line regex = '\s' ) IN
                                 ( text_id   = COND string( WHEN lv_first_space IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_raw-table_line(lv_first_space) ELSE ls_raw-table_line ) 
                                   text_line = COND string( WHEN lv_first_space IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_raw-table_line+lv_first_space ELSE '' ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_cts).
        MESSAGE lx_cts->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_all_texts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_texts.
    DATA(lo_getter) = NEW zcl_cts_get_all_texts( ).
    DATA(lv_trkorr) = 'DUMMY_TR_ALL'.
    DATA(lv_object) = 'R3TR'.
    DATA(lv_objname) = 'ZTEST_OBJ_ALL'.

    " Zuerst mehrere Texte mit verschiedenen IDs setzen
    cl_cts_language_file_io=>set_text_line(
      i_trkorr   = lv_trkorr
      i_langu    = sy-langu
      i_object   = lv_object
      i_objname  = lv_objname
      i_text_id  = 'ID_A'
      i_text_line = 'Text für ID A'
    ).
    cl_cts_language_file_io=>set_text_line(
      i_trkorr   = lv_trkorr
      i_langu    = sy-langu
      i_object   = lv_object
      i_objname  = lv_objname
      i_text_id  = 'ID_B'
      i_text_line = 'Text für ID B'
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_texts) = lo_getter->get_all_language_texts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_texts ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_texts[ 1 ]-text_id exp = 'ID_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_texts[ 1 ]-text_line exp = 'Text für ID A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_texts[ 2 ]-text_id exp = 'ID_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_texts[ 2 ]-text_line exp = 'Text für ID B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man alle sprachabhängigen Texte für ein Transportobjekt abrufen kann, indem man `CL_CTS_LANGUAGE_FILE_IO=>GET_TEXT_TABLE` mit einer leeren `i_text_id` aufruft. Die zurückgegebenen Zeilen enthalten sowohl die Text-ID als auch den Text, die dann mit modernen String-Funktionen (`FIND`, `COND`) in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle umgewandelt werden.
keywords: CTS, Sprache, Text, Alle Texte, CL_CTS_LANGUAGE_FILE_IO, VALUE, FOR, COND, FIND

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem String, wobei die Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignoriert werden soll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit dem `IGNORE CASE` Flag und der `REPLACE` Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_replace_case_insens DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_word_case_insens
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_word_to_find TYPE string
        iv_replacement  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_replace_case_insens IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_word_case_insens.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create(
      pattern = iv_word_to_find
      ignore_case = abap_true
    ).
    rv_result_string = lo_regex->replace(
      text  = iv_input_string
      with  = iv_replacement
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_case_insens FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_case_insens.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_replace_case_insens( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Das Wort Wort kommt hier mehrmals vor. wort'.
    DATA(lv_word) = 'Wort'.
    DATA(lv_replace) = 'Begriff'.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Das Begriff Begriff kommt hier mehrmals vor. begriff'.

      iv_input_string = lv_input

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` zum Ersetzen von Wörtern unter Ignorierung der Groß-/Kleinschreibung. Das `ignore_case = abap_true` Flag bei der Erstellung des Regex-Objekts ermöglicht eine flexible Suche. Die `REPLACE`-Methode führt die Ersetzung effizient durch.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Deserialisieren eines ungültigen JSON-Strings.
hint: Fangen Sie die Ausnahmen `CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR` oder `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        es_data        TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = es_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_parse_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_conversion_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other potential errors
        rv_error_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_valid_json FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_json.
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = `{"field1":"abc","field2":"not_a_number"}`. " field2 should be integer, but is string
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_json_error_handling=>ty_data( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling(
                         EXPORTING iv_json_string = lv_invalid_json
                         IMPORTING es_data        = ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_error exp = 'conversion' ). " Check for conversion error message

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die n-te Fibonacci-Zahl mit einer modernen `WHILE`-Schleife und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `WHILE`-Bedingung, um den Zustand iterativ zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fibonacci_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_fibonacci
      IMPORTING
        iv_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fib_n) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_fibonacci.
    IF iv_n <= 0.
      rv_fib_n = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_n = 1.
      rv_fib_n = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_counter) = 2.
    DATA(lv_result) = REDUCE i(
      INIT a = 0 b = 1
      WHILE lv_counter <= iv_n
      NEXT a = b
           b = a + b
           lv_counter = lv_counter + 1
      RESULT b
    ).
    rv_fib_n = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_fibonacci( 1 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_fibonacci( 2 ) exp = 1 ).

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen in einer `WHILE`-Schleife und verwenden Sie `SWITCH` für die bedingte Zuweisung basierend auf dem Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` für die Iteration und `SWITCH` für die Fallunterscheidung innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_switch_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             value TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_numbers) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_switch_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lt_local_numbers) = it_numbers. " Copy to allow modification if needed, or just use index

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_local_numbers ).
      READ TABLE lt_local_numbers INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen if index is valid
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_category) = SWITCH string( lv_number
                                         WHEN 0 THEN 'Zero'
                                         WHEN 1 THEN 'One'
                                         WHEN 2 THEN 'Two'
                                         WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Other' ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_result( value = lv_number category = lv_category ) TO rt_categorized_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Datensätze aus der `sflights`-Tabelle in einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis eine bestimmte Anzahl von Datensätzen erreicht ist oder keine weiteren Datensätze verfügbar sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` in einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_db_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_sflights_until_limit
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_records TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_db_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_sflights_until_limit.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key,
          lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    WHILE lv_count < iv_max_records.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT. " No more records
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fetch_limit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fetch_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_db_fetch( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->fetch_sflights_until_limit( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fetch_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_db_fetch( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_all) = lo_cut->fetch_sflights_until_limit( 99999 ). " Fetch more than available

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_total_sflights).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_all ) exp = lv_total_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_while_process_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_while_process_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_clear_table.
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) = it_numbers.

    WHILE lines( lt_temp_numbers ) > 0.
      READ TABLE lt_temp_numbers INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_current_number).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_current_number TO rt_processed_numbers.
        DELETE TABLE lt_temp_numbers INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " Should not happen if lines() > 0
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Text, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen, und verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und `FIND` oder `FIND FIRST` in Kombination mit `SHIFT` oder `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_extract_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words_with_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_prefix  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_extract_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words_with_prefix.
    DATA(lv_remaining_text) = iv_text.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = 0.

    WHILE lv_remaining_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\b' && iv_prefix && '\w*\b' IN lv_remaining_text MATCH OFFSET lv_offset MATCH LENGTH lv_length.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_word) = lv_remaining_text+lv_offset(lv_length).
        APPEND lv_word TO rt_words.
        " Remove the found word and everything before it to continue search
        lv_remaining_text = lv_remaining_text+lv_offset+lv_length.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " No more words with prefix found
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Zahlen in einer `WHILE`-Schleife verarbeitet und eine neue Liste erstellt, wobei jede Zahl durch ihre Quadratwurzel ersetzt wird, bis eine bestimmte Schwelle erreicht ist oder die Liste leer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und die mathematische Funktion `SQRT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sqrt_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sqrt_until_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_threshold TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sqrt_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sqrt_until_threshold.
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) = it_numbers.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_temp_numbers ).
      READ TABLE lt_temp_numbers INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_current_number).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_number < iv_threshold.
        EXIT. " Threshold reached, stop processing
      ENDIF.

      APPEND sqrt( lv_current_number ) TO rt_transformed_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_with_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_threshold_immediately_met FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_with_threshold.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY ( ( 100.0 ) ( 81.0 ) ( 25.0 ) ( 9.0 ) ( 4.0 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sqrt_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->transform_sqrt_until_threshold( it_numbers = lt_input iv_threshold = 10.0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[1] exp = 10.0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[2] exp = 9.0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[3] exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_threshold_immediately_met.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY ( ( 5.0 ) ( 16.0 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sqrt_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->transform_sqrt_until_threshold( it_numbers = lt_input iv_threshold = 10.0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY ( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sqrt_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->transform_sqrt_until_threshold( it_numbers = lt_input iv_threshold = 10.0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife für die bedingte Transformation von Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Die Schleife wird fortgesetzt, solange die Elemente eine bestimmte Schwelle nicht unterschreiten. Dies ist ein flexibles Muster für die iterative Datenverarbeitung mit dynamischen Abbruchbedingungen.
keywords: WHILE, Data Transformation, SQRT, Iteration, Threshold

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Dialogbox-Container und implementieren Sie die Behandlung des `CLOSE`-Events, um eine Meldung anzuzeigen, wenn der Benutzer den Dialog schließt.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `CLOSE`-Event des Containers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dialog_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS create_dialog_with_event
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    METHODS handle_close FOR EVENT close OF cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dialog_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dialog_with_event.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        parent  = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        width   = 400
        height  = 250
        left    = 150
        top     = 150
        caption = 'Dialog mit Event-Handler'.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_close FOR mo_container.
    ro_container = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_close.
    MESSAGE 'Der Dialog wurde geschlossen!' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei separate `cl_gui_dialogbox_container`-Instanzen auf demselben Dynpro, die sich nicht überlappen.
hint: Achten Sie auf die `left`, `top`, `width` und `height` Parameter, um Überlappungen zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_multiple_dialogs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multiple_dialogs
      IMPORTING
        iv_caption1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_caption2 TYPE string OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        eo_container1 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container
        eo_container2 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_multiple_dialogs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multiple_dialogs.
    CREATE OBJECT eo_container1
      EXPORTING
        parent  = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        width   = 400
        height  = 300
        left    = 50
        top     = 50
        caption = COND string( WHEN iv_caption1 IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_caption1 ELSE 'Dialog 1' ).

    CREATE OBJECT eo_container2
      EXPORTING
        parent  = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        width   = 400
        height  = 300
        left    = 500 " Positioned to the right of the first dialog
        top     = 50
        caption = COND string( WHEN iv_caption2 IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_caption2 ELSE 'Dialog 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_multiple_containers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_containers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_multiple_dialogs( ).
    DATA(lo_container1) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    DATA(lo_container2) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.

    lo_cut->create_multiple_dialogs(
      EXPORTING
        iv_caption1 = 'Test Dialog A'
        iv_caption2 = 'Test Dialog B'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( msg = 'Containers should be different objects' act = lo_container1 exp = lo_container2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Möglichkeit, mehrere unabhängige GUI-Container auf einem einzigen Dynpro zu verwalten. Durch die präzise Angabe von Position (`left`, `top`) und Größe (`width`, `height`) können diese Container nebeneinander oder in anderen Layouts angeordnet werden, um komplexe Benutzeroberflächen zu gestalten. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Benutzer auffordert, eine Textdatei vom Frontend auszuwählen und deren Inhalt in eine interne Tabelle zu laden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frn_file_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_text_file
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_file_content) TYPE string_table
      RAISING   cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frn_file_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_text_file.
    DATA: lv_frontend_file TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        window_title    = 'Textdatei zum Hochladen auswählen'
        file_filter     = '*.txt'
      CHANGING
        file_path       = lv_frontend_file
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS          = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten'.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_frontend_file
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = rt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error         = 1
        file_read_error         = 2
        no_authority            = 3
        unknown_error           = 4
        bad_data_format         = 5
        header_not_allowed      = 6
        separator_not_allowed   = 7
        empty_filename          = 8
        invalid_table_width     = 9
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 10
        OTHERS                  = 11
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upload_simulation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload_simulation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frn_file_upload( ).

    TRY.
        " This call will likely fail in a pure unit test environment without a GUI.
        " The purpose here is to demonstrate the structure and the call.
        " In a real test, you'd mock the frontend services.
        DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->upload_text_file( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_gui_frontend_services exception (no GUI available)' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for GUI interaction in unit test' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_gui_frontend_services` bietet Methoden für die Interaktion mit dem Frontend des Benutzers. `file_open_dialog` öffnet einen Dateiauswahldialog, und `gui_upload` liest den Inhalt der ausgewählten Datei in eine interne Tabelle. Die Verwendung von Exceptions (`RAISING cx_gui_frontend_services`) ist ein moderner Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES, GUI_UPLOAD, FILE_OPEN_DIALOG, FRONTEND, FILE, EXCEPTION

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle als Textdatei auf das Frontend des Benutzers herunterlädt.

CLASS zcl_frn_file_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Dateispeicherung abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten'.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_frontend_file
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = it_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error         = 1
        file_write_error        = 2
        no_authority            = 3
        unknown_error           = 4
        bad_data_format         = 5
        header_not_allowed      = 6
        separator_not_allowed   = 7
        empty_filename          = 8
        invalid_table_width     = 9
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 10
        OTHERS                  = 11
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist ein ABAP-Code-Snippet als String, bei dem jede Zeile unnötige führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen enthalten kann. Entfernen Sie diese Leerzeichen für jede Zeile des Codes.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CONDENSE` Befehl oder String-Methoden wie `strip` oder String-Templates mit `ALPHA = OUT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS cleanup_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD cleanup_code.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    LOOP AT lt_lines ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      <fs_line> = |{ <fs_line> ALPHA = OUT }|. " Modern way to strip leading/trailing spaces
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_cleaned_code = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_line> IN lt_lines
      NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_line> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <fs_line> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_input_code) = `  DATA(lv_test) = 'Hello'.  ` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && `  WRITE: / 'World'.  `.
    DATA(lv_expected_code) = `DATA(lv_test) = 'Hello'.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && `WRITE: / 'World'.`.
    DATA(lv_cleaned_code) = lo_cut->cleanup_code( lv_input_code ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cleaned_code exp = lv_expected_code msg = 'Code should be cleaned of leading/trailing spaces.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `SPLIT` um den Code in einzelne Zeilen zu zerlegen. Anschließend wird in einer `LOOP`-Anweisung mit einem Field-Symbol und einem String-Template (`ALPHA = OUT`) jede Zeile von führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen befreit. Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird dann verwendet, um die bereinigten Zeilen wieder zu einem einzigen String zusammenzufügen, getrennt durch Zeilenumbrüche. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der String-Verarbeitung, relevant für die Vorbereitung von Code für einen Editor wie `cl_gui_abapedit`.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, CONDENSE, REDUCE, cl_gui_abapedit

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Methodennamen, die in einem gegebenen ABAP-Code-Snippet aufgerufen werden (z.B. `lo_object->method_call( )` oder `CALL METHOD method_name`).
hint: Verwenden Sie reguläre Ausdrücke mit `CL_ABAP_REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_method_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_method_calls
      IMPORTING
        iv_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_method_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_method_calls.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `(?i)(?:CALL METHOD\s+|->)(\w+)`. " Regex to find method names
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_code ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_submatch( idx = 1 ) TO rt_method_names.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove duplicates and sort for consistent output
    SORT rt_method_names ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_method_names.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extraction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extraction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_method_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_input_code) = `  DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_my_class( ).` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                          `  lo_obj->do_something( ).` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                          `  CALL METHOD lo_obj->another_method.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                          `  some_function( ).` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                          `  lo_obj->do_something( ).`. " Duplicate call
    DATA(lt_expected_methods) = VALUE string_table( ( 'another_method' ) ( 'do_something' ) ). " Sorted and unique

    DATA(lt_extracted_methods) = lo_cut->extract_method_calls( lv_input_code ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_extracted_methods ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should extract 2 unique method calls.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_extracted_methods exp = lt_expected_methods msg = 'Extracted methods should match expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Klasse `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` für die Extraktion von Methodennamen mittels regulärer Ausdrücke. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Methode zur Textanalyse in ABAP, die besonders nützlich für Code-Editoren oder statische Code-Analysetools ist. Die Verwendung von `WHILE lo_matcher->match()` und `get_submatch()` ermöglicht das iterative Auffinden aller Treffer. Duplikate werden am Ende entfernt, um eine saubere Liste zu erhalten, was für die Code-Analyse in `cl_gui_abapedit` relevant ist.
keywords: Regex, Code Analysis, CL_ABAP_REGEX, cl_gui_abapedit

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Kommentare pro Benutzer aus einer Liste von Kollaborationskommentaren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_comment,
             id      TYPE string,
             user    TYPE string,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_comment.
    TYPES tt_comments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_comment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user_comment_count,
             user  TYPE string,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_user_comment_count.
    TYPES tt_user_comment_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_user_comment_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_clb_comment_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS count_comments_by_user
          IMPORTING
            it_all_comments TYPE tt_comments
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_user_comment_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_comment_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_comments_by_user.
    rt_counts = REDUCE tt_user_comment_counts(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_user_comment_counts( )
      FOR GROUPS OF comment_group IN it_all_comments GROUP BY ( user = comment_group-user )
      ASCENDING
      LET user_name = comment_group-user IN
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( user = user_name count = lines( comment_group ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_comment_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_comments) = VALUE tt_comments(
      ( id = 'C001' user = 'USER_A' comment = 'First comment by A' )
      ( id = 'C002' user = 'USER_B' comment = 'Comment by B' )
      ( id = 'C003' user = 'USER_A' comment = 'Second comment by A' )
      ( id = 'C004' user = 'USER_C' comment = 'Comment by C' )
      ( id = 'C005' user = 'USER_A' comment = 'Third comment by A' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_counts) = VALUE tt_user_comment_counts(
      ( user = 'USER_A' count = 3 )
      ( user = 'USER_B' count = 1 )
      ( user = 'USER_C' count = 1 )
    ).
    SORT lt_expected_counts BY user. " Ensure consistent order for comparison

    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->count_comments_by_user( lt_comments ).
    SORT lt_actual_counts BY user. " Ensure consistent order for comparison

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_counts ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should count comments for 3 unique users.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_counts exp = lt_expected_counts msg = 'Comment counts should match expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`, um Kommentare pro Benutzer zu gruppieren und deren Anzahl zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art, Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... AT NEW` Konstrukten. Dies ist nützlich für die Analyse von Kollaborationsdaten, die von `cl_clb_tools` bereitgestellt werden könnten.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'Left Outer Join'-ähnliche Operation auf zwei internen Tabellen durch: eine Liste von Benutzern und eine Liste ihrer Kollaborationsaktivitäten, um alle Benutzer und ihre zugehörigen Aktivitäten (falls vorhanden) zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `IN` und `WHERE` für die Verknüpfung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_user.
    TYPES tt_users TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_user WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_activity,
             user_id TYPE string,
             action  TYPE string,
             date    TYPE d,
           END OF ty_activity.
    TYPES tt_activities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_activity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user_activity,
             user_id   TYPE string,
             user_name TYPE string,
             action    TYPE string,
             date      TYPE d,
           END OF ty_user_activity.
    TYPES tt_user_activities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_user_activity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_clb_data_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS join_user_activities
          IMPORTING
            it_users      TYPE tt_users
            it_activities TYPE tt_activities
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_user_activities.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_data_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_user_activities.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE tt_user_activities(
      FOR ls_user IN it_users
      FOR ls_activity IN it_activities WHERE user_id = ls_user-id OPTIONAL
      ( user_id   = ls_user-id
        user_name = ls_user-name
        action    = COND string( WHEN ls_activity IS SUPPLIED THEN ls_activity-action ELSE '' )
        date      = COND d( WHEN ls_activity IS SUPPLIED THEN ls_activity-date ELSE '00000000' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_data_join( ).
    DATA(lt_users) = VALUE tt_users(
      ( id = 'U1' name = 'Alice' )
      ( id = 'U2' name = 'Bob' )
      ( id = 'U3' name = 'Charlie' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_activities) = VALUE tt_activities(
      ( user_id = 'U1' action = 'Commented' date = '20231120' )
      ( user_id = 'U1' action = 'Reviewed'  date = '20231121' )
      ( user_id = 'U3' action = 'Shared'    date = '20231120' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_data) = VALUE tt_user_activities(
      ( user_id = 'U1' user_name = 'Alice' action = 'Commented' date = '20231120' )
      ( user_id = 'U1' user_name = 'Alice' action = 'Reviewed'  date = '20231121' )
      ( user_id = 'U2' user_name = 'Bob'   action = ''          date = '00000000' ) " Bob has no activities
      ( user_id = 'U3' user_name = 'Charlie' action = 'Shared'    date = '20231120' )
    ).
    SORT lt_expected_data BY user_id date.

    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_user_activities( it_users = lt_users it_activities = lt_activities ).
    SORT lt_joined BY user_id date.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 4 msg = 'Should return 4 entries after join.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined exp = lt_expected_data msg = 'Joined data should match expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine 'Left Outer Join'-ähnliche Operation auf internen Tabellen unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit `IN` und `OPTIONAL`. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu kombinieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `READ TABLE` Anweisungen. Die `COND`-Funktion wird verwendet, um Standardwerte zu setzen, wenn keine Aktivität für einen Benutzer gefunden wird. Dies ist nützlich für die Aggregation von Kollaborationsdaten, die von `cl_clb_tools` bereitgestellt werden könnten.

Instructions: Identifizieren Sie doppelte Kollaborationsereignisse basierend auf Benutzer und Beschreibung aus einer Liste von Ereignissen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `WHERE`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_collaboration_event,
             id        TYPE string,
             user      TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_collaboration_event.
    TYPES tt_collaboration_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_collaboration_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_clb_duplicate_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS find_duplicate_events
          IMPORTING
            it_events TYPE tt_collaboration_events
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_duplicate_events) TYPE tt_collaboration_events.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_duplicate_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_duplicate_events.
    rt_duplicate_events = VALUE tt_collaboration_events(
      FOR GROUPS OF event_group IN it_events GROUP BY ( user = event_group-user description = event_group-description ) " Group by user and description
      WHERE lines( event_group ) > 1 " Only groups with more than one entry are duplicates
      FOR ls_event IN event_group " Iterate over the events in the duplicate group
      ( ls_event ) " Add each event from the duplicate group to the result
    ).
    SORT rt_duplicate_events BY user description timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_duplicate_finder( ).
    DATA(lt_events) = VALUE tt_collaboration_events(
      ( id = 'E001' user = 'U1' description = 'Task A completed' timestamp = '20231120100000.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E002' user = 'U2' description = 'Task B started'   timestamp = '20231120110000.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E003' user = 'U1' description = 'Task A completed' timestamp = '20231120100500.0000000' ) " Duplicate of E001
      ( id = 'E004' user = 'U3' description = 'Task C reviewed'  timestamp = '20231120120000.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E005' user = 'U1' description = 'Task A completed' timestamp = '20231120101000.0000000' ) " Another duplicate of E001
      ( id = 'E006' user = 'U2' description = 'Task B started'   timestamp = '20231120110100.0000000' ) " Duplicate of E002
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_duplicates) = VALUE tt_collaboration_events(
      ( id = 'E001' user = 'U1' description = 'Task A completed' timestamp = '20231120100000.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E003' user = 'U1' description = 'Task A completed' timestamp = '20231120100500.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E005' user = 'U1' description = 'Task A completed' timestamp = '20231120101000.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E002' user = 'U2' description = 'Task B started'   timestamp = '20231120110000.0000000' )
      ( id = 'E006' user = 'U2' description = 'Task B started'   timestamp = '20231120110100.0000000' )
    ).
    SORT lt_expected_duplicates BY user description timestamp.

    DATA(lt_found_duplicates) = lo_cut->find_duplicate_events( lt_events ).
    SORT lt_found_duplicates BY user description timestamp.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_found_duplicates ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should find 5 duplicate event entries.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_found_duplicates exp = lt_expected_duplicates msg = 'Found duplicate events should match expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_lines_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_lines_to_string

        it_code_lines TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_code_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_lines_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_lines_to_string.
    rv_code_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_line> IN it_code_lines
      NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_line> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <fs_line> )

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Aktivitäten pro Tag aus einer Liste von Kollaborationsereignissen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `GROUP BY` auf dem Datumsfeld.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_collaboration_event,
             id        TYPE string,
             user      TYPE string,
             date      TYPE d,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_collaboration_event.
    TYPES tt_collaboration_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_collaboration_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_activity_count,
             date  TYPE d,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_daily_activity_count.
    TYPES tt_daily_activity_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_activity_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_clb_daily_activity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS count_daily_activities
          IMPORTING
            it_events TYPE tt_collaboration_events
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_daily_counts) TYPE tt_daily_activity_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_daily_activity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_daily_activities.
    rt_daily_counts = REDUCE tt_daily_activity_counts(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_daily_activity_counts( )
      FOR GROUPS OF event_group IN it_events GROUP BY ( date = event_group-date )
      ASCENDING
      LET event_date = event_group-date IN
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( date = event_date count = lines( event_group ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_daily_activity_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_daily_activity_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_daily_activity( ).
    DATA(lt_events) = VALUE tt_collaboration_events(
      ( id = 'E001' user = 'U1' date = '20231120' description = 'Event 1' )
      ( id = 'E002' user = 'U2' date = '20231120' description = 'Event 2' )
      ( id = 'E003' user = 'U1' date = '20231121' description = 'Event 3' )
      ( id = 'E004' user = 'U3' date = '20231120' description = 'Event 4' )
      ( id = 'E005' user = 'U2' date = '20231121' description = 'Event 5' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_counts) = VALUE tt_daily_activity_counts(
      ( date = '20231120' count = 3 )
      ( date = '20231121' count = 2 )
    ).
    SORT lt_expected_counts BY date.

    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->count_daily_activities( lt_events ).
    SORT lt_actual_counts BY date.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_counts ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should count activities for 2 days.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_counts exp = lt_expected_counts msg = 'Daily activity counts should match expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet den `REDUCE`-Operator in Verbindung mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`, um die Anzahl der Kollaborationsaktivitäten pro Tag zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur Erstellung von Berichten oder Dashboards, die die tägliche Aktivität in einem Kollaborationstool, das `cl_clb_tools` verwendet, visualisieren. Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle leeren Zeilen aus einem ABAP-Code-Snippet (als String).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_remove_empty_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_empty_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_remove_empty_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_empty_lines.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    DATA(lt_non_empty_lines) = FILTER #( lt_lines WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL AND table_line ALPHA = OUT IS NOT INITIAL ).

    rv_cleaned_code = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_line> IN lt_non_empty_lines
      NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_line> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <fs_line> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_remove_empty_lines( ).
    DATA(lv_input_code) = `LINE 1` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                          `` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                          `  ` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && " Line with only spaces
                          `LINE 2`.
    DATA(lv_expected_code) = `LINE 1` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && `LINE 2`.

    DATA(lv_cleaned_code) = lo_cut->remove_empty_lines( lv_input_code ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cleaned_code exp = lv_expected_code msg = 'Empty lines should be removed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `SPLIT`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`, um leere Zeilen aus einem Code-Snippet zu entfernen. Zuerst wird der Code in Zeilen aufgeteilt. Dann werden mit `FILTER` alle Zeilen entfernt, die entweder komplett leer sind oder nur Leerzeichen enthalten (`ALPHA = OUT IS NOT INITIAL`). Schließlich werden die verbleibenden Zeilen wieder zu einem String zusammengefügt. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Kette von Operationen, die für die Bereinigung von Code in einem Editor wie `cl_gui_abapedit` nützlich ist.
keywords: String Processing, SPLIT, FILTER, REDUCE, Empty Lines, cl_gui_abapedit

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit zwei Feldern (z.B. 'ID' vom Typ I und 'TEXT' vom Typ STRING) und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Beispieldaten. Zeigen Sie diese dynamisch erstellte Tabelle in einem ALV Grid an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` und `cl_salv_table=>factory`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'ID' datatype = 'INT4' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'TEXT' datatype = 'CHAR' intlen = 255 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    DATA(lr_data) = cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table( it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat ).
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    LOOP AT sy-tab_range.
      <fs_line>-id = sy-tab_range.
      <fs_line>-text = |Text { sy-tab_range }|.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " This test can only verify that the method runs without dump,

    " A successful execution without exceptions is considered a pass.
    lo_cut->display_dynamic_alv( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true ). " If no dump, test passes
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: ALV, Dynamic Table, Field Catalog, cl_alv_table_create, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und deren Feldkatalog basierend auf der Struktur der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Füllen Sie diese dynamische Tabelle mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie sie in einem ALV Grid an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name` für RTTI und `cl_alv_table_create=>create_field_catalog`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    " 1. Get RTTI description for SFLIGHTS
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " 2. Create field catalog from RTTI structure
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_field_catalog(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        et_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    DATA(lr_data) = cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table( it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat ).
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    " 4. Select data into dynamic table
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <fs_table> UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " 5. Display ALV
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: ALV, Dynamic Table, RTTI, Field Catalog, cl_alv_table_create, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit Feldern, die manuell definiert werden (z.B. 'FLUGNR' vom Typ C(4), 'DATUM' vom Typ D, 'PREIS' vom Typ P(11) DECIMALS 2). Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Beispieldaten und zeigen Sie sie in einem ALV Grid an.
hint: Bauen Sie den Feldkatalog `lvc_t_fcat` manuell auf und übergeben Sie ihn an `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_manual_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_custom_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_manual_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_custom_alv.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    " Manually build field catalog
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'FLUGNR' datatype = 'CHAR' intlen = 4 outputlen = 4 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'DATUM' datatype = 'DATS' outputlen = 10 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'PREIS' datatype = 'DEC' intlen = 11 decimals = 2 outputlen = 15 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    DATA(lr_data) = cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table( it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat ).
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    " Fill with sample data
    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    LOOP AT sy-tab_range FROM 1 TO 5.
      <fs_line>-flugnr = |F{ sy-tab_range ALPHA = OUT }|.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Greifen Sie anschließend auf die Felder der dynamischen Tabelle über Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zu, um die Daten zu modifizieren oder zu lesen. Zeigen Sie die modifizierte Tabelle in einem ALV an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_modified_dynamic_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_modified_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'ID' datatype = 'INT4' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'TEXT' datatype = 'CHAR' intlen = 255 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    DATA(lr_data) = cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table( it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat ).
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    LOOP AT sy-tab_range FROM 1 TO 3.
      <fs_line>-id = sy-tab_range.
      <fs_line>-text = |Original Text { sy-tab_range }|.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Modify data using ASSIGN COMPONENT
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_text_field>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_text_field> = |Modified { <fs_text_field> }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Display ALV
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für jeden Fluggesellschaft (Carrier) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der `sflights` Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_sum.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_sum( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                  total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_flight_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data

CLASS zcl_htb_flight_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle Flugnummern (`connid`) für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_for_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    METHODS get_connids_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_for_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight ( ls_member-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
