CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_unique_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_unique) = lo_cut->get_unique_flight_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_unique, msg = 'Unique flights table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if a known unique entry exists
    READ TABLE lt_unique TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0, msg = 'Flight AA 0017 should be found' ).

    " Verify uniqueness by comparing with a manually built distinct count
    DATA(lt_sflight_all) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all.
    DATA(lv_distinct_count) = 0.
    DATA(lt_distinct_check) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF zcl_htb_unique_flights=>ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      INSERT VALUE zcl_htb_unique_flights=>ty_flight_key( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) INTO TABLE lt_distinct_check.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_distinct_count = lv_distinct_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique ) exp = lv_distinct_count, msg = 'Number of unique flights mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine Hash-Tabelle mit einem `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge für den definierten Schlüssel existieren. Dies ist effizient für das Speichern und Abrufen von eindeutigen Datensätzen und wird oft in Kombination mit `SELECT DISTINCT` verwendet.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, Internal Tables, SELECT DISTINCT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT s = 0
                                  FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                  NEXT s = s + ls_member-price ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_avg_price( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                         average_price = COND f( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ) ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' exists and has flights with prices that average to 1500.00
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_avg) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_avg-average_price exp = 1500.00, msg = 'Average price for AA is incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen. In Kombination mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht sie eine sehr funktionale und lesbare Berechnung von Aggregatwerten pro Gruppe, wie hier den Durchschnittspreis.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, deren Schlüsselkomponenten dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_dynamic_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_line TYPE sflight.
    METHODS create_dynamic_hashed_table
      IMPORTING
        it_key_components TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_dynamic_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_hashed_table.
    DATA: lv_key_string TYPE string.
    LOOP AT it_key_components INTO DATA(lv_component).
      IF lv_key_string IS INITIAL.
        lv_key_string = lv_component.
      ELSE.
        lv_key_string = lv_key_string && ` ` && lv_component.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_table_type_desc) = `HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH UNIQUE KEY (` && lv_key_string && `)`.

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE TABLE OF sflight. " Create a standard table first
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

    " Now create the hashed table dynamically
    DATA(lr_descr_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ).
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lr_descr_type ).

    DATA(lr_line_type) = lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    DATA(lr_new_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lr_line_type
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
                                  p_unique = abap_true
                                  p_key_def = cl_abap_tabledescr=>keydef_specified
                                  p_key_components = it_key_components ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_new_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_hashed_table> TYPE HASHED TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_hashed_table>.

    <lt_hashed_table> = <lt_table>. " Assign data from standard table to hashed table
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_key FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_creation.
    METHODS test_dynamic_key_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_dynamic_key( ).
    DATA(lt_key_components) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lr_hashed_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_hashed_table( lt_key_components ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_flights> TYPE HASHED TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_hashed_table->* TO <lt_flights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_flights>, msg = 'Dynamic hashed table should not be empty' ).

    " Verify table kind
    DATA(lr_descr_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_flights> ).
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lr_descr_type ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_table_descr->table_kind exp = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_key_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_dynamic_key( ).
    DATA(lt_key_components) = VALUE string_table( ( 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ) ).

    lo_cut->create_dynamic_hashed_table( lt_key_components ).

explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Hash-Tabellen mit zur Laufzeit definierten Schlüsseln ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` realisiert wird. Dies bietet maximale Flexibilität, wenn die Schlüsselstruktur nicht zur Kompilierzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, RTTI

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach `carrid` und `connid` und übertragen Sie die Ergebnisse in eine interne Tabelle mit einer abweichenden Struktur, die nur `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit einem `VALUE #` Konstruktor, um die Zielstruktur zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_corr_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-connid
      ( carrier_id = ls_flight-carrid
        connection_id = ls_flight-connid
        flight_dates = VALUE #( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight ( ls_member-fldate ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_corr_struct( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' '0017' exists and has at least one flight date
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_0017) WITH KEY carrier_id = 'AA' connection_id = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_0017-flight_dates, msg = 'AA 0017 should have flight dates' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_aa_0017-flight_dates ) exp = 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Expression erlaubt die Definition der Zielstruktur direkt im `VALUE #` Konstruktor. Hier werden die Gruppenschlüssel (`carrid`, `connid`) und eine Liste der `fldate`s der Gruppenelemente in eine neue, spezifische Struktur überführt.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, VALUE #, Internal Tables, Structure Transformation

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine Hash-Tabelle ein und initialisieren Sie diese mit Standardwerten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_initial_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_initial_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_new_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_insert_dup_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_initial_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_initial_flight.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE mt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_new_flight>).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_insert_dup_key.
    ENDIF.
    <fs_new_flight>-carrid = iv_carrid.
    <fs_new_flight>-connid = iv_connid.
    rs_new_flight = <fs_new_flight>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_initial_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_insert_dup_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_initial_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_initial_line( ).
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = lo_cut->add_initial_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_new_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_new_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_new_flight-price ). " Check if other fields are initial
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_initial_line( ).
    lo_cut->add_initial_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_table_insert_dup_key ).
    lo_cut->add_initial_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT INITIAL LINE` ist eine effiziente Methode, um eine neue, initialisierte Zeile in eine interne Tabelle einzufügen. Bei Hash-Tabellen mit `UNIQUE KEY` wird dabei automatisch geprüft, ob der Schlüssel bereits existiert, was bei Duplikaten zu einem Laufzeitfehler führt, der abgefangen werden kann.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, INSERT INITIAL LINE, Internal Tables, Unique Key

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach `carrid` und `connid` und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe, wobei Sie die Ergebnisse in eine Hash-Tabelle speichern.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `VALUE #` und einer Hash-Tabelle als Ziel.

CLASS zcl_grp_to_hashed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_grp_to_hashed IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-connid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid

Die `FOR GROUPS` Expression erzeugt die Gruppen, und der `VALUE #` Konstruktor füllt die Hash-Tabelle mit den Aggregatwerten (hier die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe). Die Hash-Tabelle sorgt für effizienten Zugriff auf die Gruppenergebnisse.
keywords: GROUP BY, HASHED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, VALUE #, Aggregation

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` oder `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` mit `READ TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_modify_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flight_data TYPE sflight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_updated) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_modify_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_data.
    READ TABLE mt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rb_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Das Aktualisieren von Einträgen in einer Hash-Tabelle erfolgt effizient über `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>` gefolgt von der direkten Modifikation des Feldsymbols. Dies vermeidet das Kopieren von Daten und ist performanter als `MODIFY TABLE` bei bekanntem Schlüssel.

Instructions: Finden Sie den teuersten Flug für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und finden Sie das Maximum innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_flight.
    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_max_flight) = VALUE ty_max_price_flight( ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        IF ls_member-price > ls_max_flight-price.
          ls_max_flight = CORRESPONDING #( ls_member ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      ls_max_flight-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      APPEND ls_max_flight TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_max_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' exists and its most expensive flight is '0017' with price 10000.00
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_max) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_max-connid exp = '0017' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_max-price exp = 10000.00 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht es, Aggregationen wie das Finden des Maximums (oder Minimums) innerhalb jeder Gruppe direkt und lesbar zu implementieren. Die Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING #` vereinfacht die Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen Strukturen.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Maximum

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE` mit einem `WHERE` Ausdruck, um mehrere Einträge zu löschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_delete_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flight_data TYPE sflight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_delete_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Populate with some test data for demonstration
    mt_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 10000.00 ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = 12000.00 ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 5000.00 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( mt_flights ).
    DELETE mt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    rv_deleted_count = lv_initial_lines - lines( mt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_non_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_delete_multi( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->mt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lo_cut->mt_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_non_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_delete_multi( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->mt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Löschen mehrerer Einträge aus einer Hash-Tabelle basierend auf einem Kriterium ist mit `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE` effizient möglich. Obwohl Hash-Tabellen für den Schlüsselzugriff optimiert sind, kann der `WHERE`-Ausdruck auch für nicht-Schlüsselfelder verwendet werden, wobei die Performance dann von der Anzahl der zu durchsuchenden Einträge abhängt.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, DELETE TABLE, Internal Tables, WHERE Clause

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach `carrid` und `connid` und erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Flugdaten (`fldate`) für jede Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates für die Listenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_string_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dates_list,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_dates_csv TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_dates_list.
    METHODS get_flight_dates_csv RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_dates_list WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_string_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_dates_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-connid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        flight_dates_csv = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                         FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                         NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ ls_member-fldate DATE = USER }|
                                                              ELSE |{ s }, { ls_member-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_dates_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_dates_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_string_list( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_dates_csv( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' '0017' exists and has flight dates '20251123' and '20251124'
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_0017_csv) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_0017_csv-flight_dates_csv exp = '23.11.2025, 24.11.2025' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `FOR GROUPS` für die Gruppierung mit der `REDUCE` Expression und String-Templates, um eine kommaseparierte Liste von Flugdaten pro Gruppe zu erstellen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und ausdrucksstarkes Muster in ABAP 7.55+ für die Datenaggregation und -formatierung.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, String Templates, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führen Sie eine linke äußere Verknüpfung (LEFT OUTER JOIN) zwischen einer Hash-Tabelle von Flügen und einer Standardtabelle von Buchungen durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Verknüpfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    METHODS perform_left_join RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA mt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sbook INTO TABLE @mt_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_left_join.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
      FOR ls_booking IN mt_bookings WHERE ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) OPTIONAL
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = ls_flight-price
        bookid = COND #( WHEN ls_booking IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_booking-bookid ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_left_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->perform_left_join( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Assuming a flight 'AA' '0017' '20251123' exists and has bookings
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_joined_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251123'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_joined_entry-bookid, msg = 'Booking ID should be filled for existing booking' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Assuming a flight 'LH' '0400' '20251125' exists but has no bookings
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_joined_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251125'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_joined_entry-bookid, msg = 'Booking ID should be initial for non-existing booking' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN` Expression ermöglicht es, Verknüpfungen zwischen internen Tabellen direkt im Code zu formulieren. Durch die Verwendung von `OPTIONAL` und `COND #` kann eine linke äußere Verknüpfung (LEFT OUTER JOIN) simuliert werden, wobei fehlende Einträge in der rechten Tabelle mit Initialwerten gefüllt werden. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu verknüpfen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, Internal Tables, FOR, LEFT OUTER JOIN, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und eine maximale Kapazität von über 200 Passagieren haben. Sammeln Sie die Flugnummern in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate planetype seatsmax seatsocc cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND seatsmax > 200 )
                           ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines Reduktionsoperators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).

    " Since SFLIGHTS data can change, we can't assert a fixed value.
    " We can assert it's not negative or perform a basic check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total >= 0 ).

    " For a more robust test, you might insert test data into a local table
    " and then perform the reduction.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine vereinfachte Terminverwaltung mit der Klasse `cl_appointment` demonstriert. Die Klasse soll Termine erstellen und nach Datum filtern können. CLASS zcl_appointment_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             start_date TYPE d,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Annahme: cl_appointment ist eine existierende Klasse mit den genannten Methoden
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir cl_appointment, da es nicht standardmäßig verfügbar ist.
    CLASS lcl_appointment DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_start_date TYPE d READ-ONLY.
        DATA mv_description TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d iv_description TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_start_date = iv_start_date.
        mv_description = iv_description.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS add_appointment IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d iv_description TYPE string.
    METHODS get_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO lcl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW lcl_appointment( iv_start_date = iv_start_date
                                                iv_description = iv_description ).
    APPEND lo_appointment TO mt_appointments.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_appointments_by_date.
    rt_appointments = VALUE #( FOR app_ref IN mt_appointments
                                WHERE ( app_ref->mv_start_date = iv_date )
                                ( start_date = app_ref->mv_start_date,
                                  description = app_ref->mv_description ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_appointment_management.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_appointment_manager( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = lv_today + 1.

    lo_manager->add_appointment( iv_start_date = lv_today iv_description = 'Meeting heute' ).
    lo_manager->add_appointment( iv_start_date = lv_tomorrow iv_description = 'Meeting morgen' ).
    lo_manager->add_appointment( iv_start_date = lv_today iv_description = 'Kaffee heute' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_today_apps ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_tomorrow_apps) = lo_manager->get_appointments_by_date( lv_tomorrow ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_tomorrow_apps ) exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lt_future_apps) = lo_manager->get_appointments_by_date( lv_tomorrow + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_future_apps ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    CLASS lcl_appointment DEFINITION FINAL.

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf die Flugnummer des ersten Fluges einer internen Tabelle zu, der von 'NEW YORK' abfliegt, ohne eine explizite Schleife zu verwenden. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass kein solcher Flug gefunden wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_ny_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_ny_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rv_connid = lt_sflights[  cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ]-connid.
    CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_connid = 'NOTFOUND'. " Oder ein anderer Standardwert
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_connid exp = 'NOTFOUND' ).
    " If a specific flight is expected, assert that:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_expression_not_found.
    " To properly test 'not found', we'd need to mock SFLIGHTS or ensure no 'NEW YORK' flights.
    " For this example, we'll assume get_first_ny_flight might return 'NOTFOUND' if no data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_table_expr( ).
    " Temporarily clear SFLIGHTS or use a custom table without 'NEW YORK' flights for a real test.
    " For now, we just call it and check the default behavior.
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_first_ny_flight( ).
    " If SFLIGHTS is empty or has no 'NEW YORK' flights, this would pass:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid exp = 'NOTFOUND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion, die explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen oft überflüssig macht. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ist notwendig, wenn der Zugriff fehlschlagen könnte.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen (Fluent Interface) für eine Klasse, die eine vereinfachte Konfiguration für `cl_appointment` Objekte ermöglicht, z.B. `create().with_description('...').on_date(...).build()`.
hint: Jede Methode in der Kette sollte eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " Annahme: lcl_appointment ist die simulierte cl_appointment Klasse aus Beispiel 3
    CLASS lcl_appointment DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_start_date TYPE d READ-ONLY.
        DATA mv_description TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d iv_description TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_start_date = iv_start_date.
        mv_description = iv_description.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS create RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_builder.
    METHODS with_description IMPORTING iv_description TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_builder.
    METHODS on_date IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_appointment_builder.
    METHODS build RETURNING VALUE(ro_appointment) TYPE REF TO lcl_appointment.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_temp_description TYPE string.
    DATA mv_temp_date TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create.
    ro_self = me.
    CLEAR: mv_temp_description, mv_temp_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD with_description.
    me->mv_temp_description = iv_description.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_date.
    me->mv_temp_date = iv_date.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    ro_appointment = NEW lcl_appointment( iv_start_date = mv_temp_date

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflights` die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität. Gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_seatsmax TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( seatsmax ) AS avg_seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_stats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_stats ) > 0 ).

    " Example: Check if 'LH' (Lufthansa) exists and has reasonable stats
    DATA(ls_lh_stats) = VALUE zcl_sflights_aggregation=>ty_carrier_stats(
                           FOR stat IN lt_stats WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( stat ) ).
    IF ls_lh_stats IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_stats-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_stats-avg_seatsmax > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL-Funktionen wie `GROUP BY` in Kombination mit Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT`, `AVG`) ermöglichen es, komplexe Datenanalysen direkt auf der Datenbank durchzuführen. Dies ist effizienter, da die Datenaggregation auf dem Datenbankserver stattfindet und nur die aggregierten Ergebnisse an die Applikationsschicht übertragen werden. Die Inline-Deklaration `INTO TABLE @rt_stats` trägt ebenfalls zur Modernität bei.
keywords: Open SQL, GROUP BY, Aggregation, COUNT, AVG, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen und deren Flugnummern mit '0' beginnen. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer Lambda-Expression oder einer lokalen Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND connid CP '0*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-connid CP '0*' ).

Er ermöglicht das Filtern einer Tabelle basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen, die direkt im Operator angegeben werden. Dies ist eine deklarative Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und führt zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code, insbesondere wenn Sekundärschlüssel verwendet werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Operator, SFLIGHTS, String Pattern

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte für den Status ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet') hinzu, basierend auf der Differenz zwischen maximalen und belegten Sitzen. Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung der neuen Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate seatsmax seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   connid = flight-connid,
                                   fldate = flight-fldate,
                                   status = COND string(
                                              WHEN flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc > 10 THEN 'Pünktlich'
                                              ELSE 'Verspätet' )
                                 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check a few entries if possible, or just the structure
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_status).
      IF ls_flight_status-carrid = 'LH' AND ls_flight_status-connid = '0400'. " Example for a known flight
        " Assuming LH 0400 has enough free seats to be 'Pünktlich'
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_status-status exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` mit dem `COND` Operator. Es ermöglicht die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur, wobei gleichzeitig eine neue Spalte mit bedingter Logik befüllt wird. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und deklarative Art der Datenmanipulation, die den Code extrem kompakt und verständlich macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, COND, SFLIGHTS, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `cl_appointment` Objekten in eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) umwandelt, wobei der Schlüssel das Startdatum und der Wert eine Liste von Beschreibungen für dieses Datum ist. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Zusatz im `FOR` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die Gruppierung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " Annahme: lcl_appointment ist die simulierte cl_appointment Klasse aus Beispiel 3
    CLASS lcl_appointment DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_start_date TYPE d READ-ONLY.
        DATA mv_description TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d iv_description TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_start_date = iv_start_date.
        mv_description = iv_description.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_appointment_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO lcl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_description_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_appointment_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_description_list
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line TYPE d.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_refs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointment_map) TYPE ty_appointment_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    rt_appointment_map = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF appointment IN it_appointments
                                  GROUP BY ( date = appointment->mv_start_date )
                                  ( key = date
                                    VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP appointment
                                             ( member->mv_description ) ) )
                                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_grouper( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = lv_today + 1.

    DATA lt_appointments TYPE zcl_appointment_grouper=>tt_appointment_refs.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_grouper=>lcl_appointment( iv_start_date = lv_today iv_description = 'Meeting heute' ) TO lt_appointments.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_grouper=>lcl_appointment( iv_start_date = lv_tomorrow iv_description = 'Meeting morgen' ) TO lt_appointments.
    APPEND NEW zcl_appointment_grouper=>lcl_appointment( iv_start_date = lv_today iv_description = 'Kaffee heute' ) TO lt_appointments.

    DATA(lt_map) = lo_cut->group_appointments_by_date( lt_appointments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_map ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_today_desc) = lt_map[ lv_today ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_today_desc ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_today_desc[ 1 ] exp = 'Meeting heute' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_today_desc[ 2 ] exp = 'Kaffee heute' ).

    DATA(lt_tomorrow_desc) = lt_map[ lv_tomorrow ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_tomorrow_desc ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tomorrow_desc[ 1 ] exp = 'Meeting morgen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator mit dem `GROUP BY` Zusatz ist eine der mächtigsten modernen ABAP-Funktionen für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Er ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Zeilen und die Aggregation von Werten innerhalb jeder Gruppe in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen-Operationen für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, Aggregation, cl_appointment

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der `COUNT` Aggregatfunktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_cnt TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key->carrid
                      flight_cnt = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0  operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    DATA(lv_lh_flights) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_lh_flights = ls_result-flight_cnt.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH should have flights' act = lv_lh_flights exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht eine direkte Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, ohne manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Maps. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was die Aggregation stark vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (`fldate`) und Flugdatum (`connid`) von Flügen aus `sflights` enthält, deren Preis (`price`) über 500 liegt. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `WHERE` Bedingung und `VALUE #(...)` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flight_info
      IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flight_info.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                               ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flight_info( iv_min_price = 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    DATA(lv_count_expensive) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE price > 500 INTO @lv_count_expensive.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count of expensive flights should match' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count_expensive ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FOR` Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` Schleife zu schreiben, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus den gefilterten Elementen der Quelltabelle konstruiert, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, LOOP, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_price.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for LH should match' act = lv_total_price_lh exp = lv_expected_price ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price_aa) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_price_aa.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for AA should match' act = lv_total_price_aa exp = lv_expected_price_aa ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression (ABAP 7.40+) ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Sie initialisiert einen Wert (`INIT`) und wendet dann in einer `FOR` Schleife eine Operation (`NEXT`) auf jedes Element an, das einer optionalen `WHERE` Bedingung entspricht. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code für Summen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, LOOP, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine `RANGES` Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`), die 'LH' und 'AA' einschließt, aber 'UA' ausschließt. Verwenden Sie diese `RANGES` Tabelle in einer `SELECT` Anweisung, um die entsprechenden Flüge aus `sflights` abzurufen.
hint: Füllen Sie die `RANGES` Tabelle mit verschiedenen `SIGN` (I/E) und `OPTION` (EQ) Werten und nutzen Sie `WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_by_dynamic_ranges
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_dynamic_ranges.
    DATA: lr_carrid TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

CLASS zcl_loop_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_loop_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_filter_ranges DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flights_in_date_range

        iv_end_date   TYPE s_date

CLASS zcl_filter_ranges IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' in einer internen Tabelle von `sflights` um 10%. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` um die Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increase_lh_prices
      CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_lh_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_modify( ).

    DATA(lt_original_flights) = lt_test_flights.

    lo_cut->increase_lh_prices( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_modified_flight).
      READ TABLE lt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original_flight)
        WITH KEY carrid = ls_modified_flight-carrid
                 connid = ls_modified_flight-connid
                 fldate = ls_modified_flight-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_modified_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH price should be increased by 10%' act = ls_modified_flight-price exp = ls_original_flight-price * '1.10' ).
        ELSE.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Other prices should remain unchanged' act = ls_modified_flight-price exp = ls_original_flight-price ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` Syntax (ABAP 7.40+) ist die effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen einer internen Tabelle direkt zu modifizieren. Anstatt eine Kopie der Zeile zu erstellen (`INTO`) und dann die Tabelle mit `MODIFY` zu aktualisieren, wird direkt auf die Speicheradresse der Zeile zugegriffen. Dies spart Ressourcen und macht den Code klarer für In-Place-Änderungen.
keywords: LOOP, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, Modification, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES` Tabelle für Flugnummern (`connid`), die alle Flugnummern von '0001' bis '0099' einschließt, aber explizit '0050' ausschließt. Demonstrieren Sie die Anwendung dieser `RANGES` Tabelle auf eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SIGN = 'I'` mit `OPTION = 'BT'` und `SIGN = 'E'` mit `OPTION = 'EQ'`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_complex_ranges
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_complex_ranges.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    DATA: lr_connid TYPE RANGE OF s_conn_id.

    " Include 0001 to 0099
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0099' ) TO lr_connid.
    " Exclude 0050
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = '0050' ) TO lr_connid.

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_sflights
                               WHERE ( connid IN lr_connid )
                               ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_complex_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_ranges.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_complex_ranges( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_connid_num) = CONV i( ls_flight-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Connid must be >= 1' act = lv_connid_num exp = 1 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ge ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Connid must be <= 99' act = lv_connid_num exp = 99 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-le ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( msg = 'Connid 0050 must be excluded' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0050' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE connid BETWEEN '0001' AND '0099' AND connid <> '0050' INTO @lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count of filtered flights should match' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `RANGES` mit verschiedenen `SIGN` (I für Include, E für Exclude) und `OPTION` (EQ für Equal, BT für Between) Werten ermöglicht die Definition komplexer Filterbedingungen. Diese können dann effizient mit `WHERE ... IN lr_connid` in `FOR` Expressions oder `SELECT` Anweisungen angewendet werden. Dies ist ein Standardmuster für flexible Selektionen seit ABAP 7.40.
keywords: RANGES, SIGN, OPTION, FOR, LOOP, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Daten aus `sflights` und `sairport` (Flughafen-Tabelle) um eine Liste von Flügen mit Start- und Zielflughafen-Namen zu erstellen. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR` Schleifen oder `JOIN`-ähnliche Logik mit `FOR` Expressions.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Expressions und `CORRESPONDING` oder `READ TABLE` innerhalb der Schleife, um die Flughafen-Namen zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_for_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom  TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto    TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_sairport TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sairport WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sairport INTO TABLE @lt_sairport.

    rt_flight_details = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 LET lv_cityfrom = VALUE s_cityname( lt_sairport[ city = ls_flight-cityfrom ]-cityname OPTIONAL )
                                     lv_cityto   = VALUE s_cityname( lt_sairport[ city = ls_flight-cityto ]-cityname OPTIONAL ) IN
                                 ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                   fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                   cityfrom = lv_cityfrom,
                                   cityto   = lv_cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_for_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'City From should be filled' act = ls_first_flight-cityfrom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'City To should be filled' act = ls_first_flight-cityto ).

    " Verify a specific known flight
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20250101'. " Adjust date if needed for test data

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_verified_flight)
      WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'City From for LH 0400 should be Frankfurt' act = ls_verified_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'City To for LH 0400 should be NEW YORK' act = ls_verified_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt eine `FOR` Expression (ABAP 7.40+) mit einer `LET` Expression, um temporäre Variablen für die Flughafen-Namen zu definieren. Der Zugriff auf die `sairport` Tabelle erfolgt über den Tabellen-Ausdruck `lt_sairport[ city = ... ]`, der seit ABAP 7.40 verfügbar ist und eine sehr effiziente Suche nach dem Primärschlüssel ermöglicht. Dies ist eine moderne, deklarative Alternative zu verschachtelten `LOOP` Schleifen oder `READ TABLE` Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, LOOP, LET, Internal Tables, Transformation, Table Expression, ABAP 7.40

TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` Syntax (ABAP 7.40+) ist die performanteste Methode, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, wenn die Daten der Zeile selbst nicht benötigt werden. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaften, die in einer `RANGES` Tabelle definiert sind, und zusätzlich nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität (`seatsocc`) überschreiten. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit `IN` Operator für die `RANGES` Tabelle.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die `WHERE` Bedingung der `LOOP` Schleife mit dem `IN` Operator für die `RANGES` Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_ranges_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids_filter TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
        iv_min_capacity   TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_ranges_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid IN it_carrids_filter
        AND seatsocc > iv_min_capacity.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lr_carrids TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lr_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) TO lr_carrids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_ranges_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( it_carrids_filter = lr_carrids iv_min_capacity = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Carrier must be LH or AA' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-cp ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Seats occupied must be > 100' act = ls_flight-seatsocc exp = 100 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA' ) AND seatsocc > 100 INTO @lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count of filtered flights should match' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Syntax (ABAP 7.40+) erlaubt komplexe Filterbedingungen direkt in der Schleifendefinition. Die Kombination mit dem `IN` Operator für `RANGES` Tabellen ermöglicht eine flexible Filterung nach mehreren Werten oder Bereichen, ohne dass die Schleife manuell mit `IF`-Anweisungen überladen werden muss. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: LOOP, RANGES, WHERE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` eine neue Zeile enthält, die die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Status 'ACTIVE' oder 'INACTIVE' basierend auf dem Flugdatum (z.B. vor oder nach dem heutigen Datum) anzeigt. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit einer `COND` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` um den Status dynamisch zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                   status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-fldate >= lv_today THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_status).
      DATA(ls_original_flight) = VALUE sflights( sflights[ carrid = ls_flight_status-carrid
                                                          connid = ls_flight_status-connid ] OPTIONAL ).
      IF ls_original_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF ls_original_flight-fldate >= lv_today.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be ACTIVE' act = ls_flight_status-status exp = 'ACTIVE' ).
        ELSE.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be INACTIVE' act = ls_flight_status-status exp = 'INACTIVE' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` Expressions mit `COND` Expressions (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Transformation von Daten. Anstatt eine `LOOP` Schleife mit `IF`-Anweisungen zu verwenden, wird der Wert einer Komponente bedingt zugewiesen, was den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer macht. Dies ist ein Muster für deklarative Programmierung.
keywords: FOR, LOOP, COND, Internal Tables, Transformation, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflights`. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE` um den Maximalwert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_max_price_flight.
    TYPES tt_max_price_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flights_per_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_price_flights) TYPE tt_max_price_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                             REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE sflights(
        INIT max_flight = VALUE sflights( )
        FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT max_flight = COND sflights( WHEN ls_group_flight-price > max_flight-price THEN ls_group_flight ELSE max_flight ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_max_flight-carrid
                      connid = ls_max_flight-connid
                      fldate = ls_max_flight-fldate
                      price  = ls_max_flight-price ) TO rt_max_price_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_max( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flights_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    " Verify for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(lv_max_price_lh) = 0.
    DATA(ls_expected_flight_lh) = VALUE sflights( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ORDER BY price DESCENDING INTO @ls_expected_flight_lh UP TO 1 ROWS.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max price for LH should match' act = ls_result_lh-price exp = ls_expected_flight_lh-price ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid for max price LH should match' act = ls_result_lh-connid exp = ls_expected_flight_lh-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.50+) mit einer `REDUCE` Expression (ABAP 7.40+) innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Dies ist ein sehr leistungsfähiges Muster, um Aggregationen oder das Finden von Maximal-/Minimalwerten pro Gruppe durchzuführen. `REDUCE` iteriert über die Elemente der aktuellen Gruppe und findet den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES` Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`), die alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'LH' und 'AA' einschließt. Verwenden Sie diese `RANGES` Tabelle in einer `SELECT` Anweisung, um die entsprechenden Flüge aus `sflights` abzurufen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SIGN = 'E'` mit `OPTION = 'EQ'` für die auszuschließenden Werte und `SELECT ... WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid`.

CLASS zcl_ranges_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ranges_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lr_carrid.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) TO lr_carrid.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @rt_sflights

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_excluding_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Liste der auszuschließenden Werte dynamisch ist. Die `SELECT ... WHERE ... IN @lr_carrid` Syntax (ABAP 7.40+) ist der moderne Weg, solche dynamischen Filter auf die Datenbank anzuwenden.
