Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch (Shuffle).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine temporäre Sortierspalte mit Zufallswerten und sortieren Sie die Tabelle danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffler,
             random_key TYPE i,
             data       TYPE ty_data,
           END OF ty_shuffler.
    TYPES: tt_shuffler TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffler WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).
    DATA(lt_temp_shuffler) = VALUE tt_shuffler(
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_input_table
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 1000000 ) " Generate a large random number
        data       = <fs_data> )
    ).

    SORT lt_temp_shuffler BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_table = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR <fs_shuffler> IN lt_temp_shuffler
      ( <fs_shuffler>-data )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES: tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' )
      ( id = 5 value = 'E' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original )
                                       msg = 'Shuffled table has incorrect number of entries' ).

    " Check if content is the same (regardless of order)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY id.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY id.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted
                                       msg = 'Shuffled table content is not the same as original' ).

    " Check if order is likely different (probabilistic check)
    " This test might fail rarely due to pure chance, but is generally good enough for a shuffle test.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_shuffled <> lt_original )
                                       msg = 'Table was not shuffled (order is identical)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt `cl_abap_random` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine temporäre Tabelle zu erstellen, die jede Originalzeile mit einem zufälligen Sortierschlüssel koppelt. Durch das anschließende Sortieren dieser temporären Tabelle und das Extrahieren der Daten in eine neue Tabelle wird die ursprüngliche Tabelle effektiv gemischt. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Tabellen zu manipulieren.
keywords: RANDOM, SHUFFLE, INTERNAL TABLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge (z.B. für ein Passwort oder einen Token).
hint: Definieren Sie einen Pool von erlaubten Zeichen und wählen Sie mit `cl_abap_random` Zeichen daraus aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_count) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_char_count - 1 ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_chars FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 15.
    DATA(lv_random_str) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_str ) exp = lv_length
                                       msg = 'Generated string has incorrect length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_chars.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 20.
    DATA(lv_random_str) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( lv_length ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.

    DATA(lv_all_chars_valid) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_random_str ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_random_str+sy-index-1(1).
      IF NOT ( lc_allowed_chars CS lv_char ).
        lv_all_chars_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_all_chars_valid
                                       msg = 'Generated string contains invalid characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode generiert einen String, indem sie wiederholt zufällige Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Pool auswählt. Die `DO ... TIMES`-Schleife und die String-Verkettung mit `&&` sind effiziente moderne ABAP-Konstrukte. `cl_abap_random` stellt sicher, dass die Auswahl der Zeichen zufällig ist.
keywords: RANDOM, STRING, CL_ABAP_RANDOM, STRING PROCESSING

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer Liste von Strings aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Einträge und generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_random_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_list TYPE tt_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_entry) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_random_entry.
    IF it_list IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input list is empty, cannot select random entry.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_list_size) = lines( it_list ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).
    " Generate a random index between 1 and lv_list_size (inclusive)
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lv_list_size ).

    rv_selected_entry = it_list[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_names) = VALUE zcl_random_selector=>tt_string(
      ( 'Alice' )
      ( 'Bob' )
      ( 'Charlie' )
      ( 'David' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_selected_name) = lo_cut->select_random_entry( lt_names ).

    " Check if the selected name is one of the original names
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_names INTO DATA(lv_name).
      IF lv_name = lv_selected_name.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found
                                       msg = 'Selected name is not from the original list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_list) = VALUE zcl_random_selector=>tt_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->select_random_entry( lt_empty_list ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Auswahl eines zufälligen Elements aus einer internen Tabelle. Sie nutzt `lines()` um die Größe der Tabelle zu ermitteln und `cl_abap_random` um einen gültigen Index zu generieren. Der Zugriff auf die Tabelle erfolgt über den Index `it_list[ lv_random_index ]`, was eine moderne und prägnante Syntax ist. Eine Ausnahmebehandlung für leere Listen ist ebenfalls integriert.
keywords: RANDOM, LIST, SELECTION, CL_ABAP_RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLE

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Werfen von zwei sechsseitigen Würfeln und geben Sie die Summe der Augenzahlen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random` zweimal, um zwei Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 6 zu generieren.

CLASS zcl_dice_roller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage auf `SFLIGHT` mit `OPEN CURSOR` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel aus einer internen Tabelle von Bedingungen konstruiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer dynamischen `WHERE`-Klausel, die als String übergeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_condition,
             field_name TYPE string,
             operator   TYPE string,
             value      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_condition.
    TYPES: tt_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_condition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_conditions TYPE tt_conditions
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string VALUE `1 = 1`.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``
        FOR <cond> IN it_conditions
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <cond>-field_name } { <cond>-operator } '{ <cond>-value }'|
          ELSE |{ s } AND { <cond>-field_name } { <cond>-operator } '{ <cond>-value }'|
        )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
            FROM sflight
            WHERE (lv_where_clause).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DO.
            FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
              INTO TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
            IF sy-subrc <> 0.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_package TO rt_sflights.
            CLEAR lt_sflight_package.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamic SQL error: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Aktualisieren einer großen Anzahl von `SFLIGHT`-Einträgen basierend auf einer Bedingung, indem Sie die zu aktualisierenden Schlüssel mit `OPEN CURSOR` in Paketen lesen und dann `UPDATE` verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` um die Schlüssel zu lesen und dann `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE` für die paketweise Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_sflights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
        iv_new_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
        iv_package_size  TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_keys_package TYPE tt_sflight_key.
    DATA: lt_update_data TYPE tt_sflight_update.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        WHERE planetype = iv_old_planetype.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
          INTO TABLE lt_keys_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        " Prepare data for update
        lt_update_data = VALUE tt_sflight_update(
          FOR <key> IN lt_keys_package
          ( carrid = <key>-carrid
            connid = <key>-connid
            fldate = <key>-fldate
            planetype = iv_new_planetype )
        ).

        UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_update_data.
        rv_updated_count = rv_updated_count + sy-dbcnt.

        CLEAR: lt_keys_package, lt_update_data.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_check

Instructions: Wählen Sie N zufällige Flugdatensätze aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` effizient aus, ohne die gesamte Tabelle in den Speicher zu laden.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtzahl der Datensätze, generieren Sie zufällige Zeilennummern und verwenden Sie `OFFSET` und `LIMIT` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung oder eine Reservoir-Sampling-Technik mit dem Cursor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_sampler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_records TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_sampler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflights.
    DATA: lv_total_records TYPE i.
    DATA: lt_all_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_dummy TYPE i.

    " 1. Get total number of records (efficiently with COUNT(*))
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_total_records.

    IF lv_total_records = 0 OR iv_number_of_records <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number_of_records >= lv_total_records.
      " If requesting more or equal to total, just get all
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE rt_random_sflights.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Generate unique random row numbers
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).
    DATA(lt_random_indices) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_selected_offsets) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO iv_number_of_records TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_offset) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_total_records - 1 ).
      " Ensure unique offsets (simple approach, for very large N and small total, might be slow)
      WHILE line_exists( lt_selected_offsets[ table_line = lv_random_offset ] ).
        lv_random_offset = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_total_records - 1 ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_random_offset INTO TABLE lt_selected_offsets.
    ENDDO.

    " Sort offsets to fetch efficiently (optional, but good practice)
    SORT lt_selected_offsets ASCENDING.

    " 3. Fetch records using OPEN CURSOR and skipping to random offsets
    DATA(lv_current_offset) = 0.
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_full.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_selected_offsets INTO DATA(lv_target_offset).
        " Skip records until target offset is reached
        DO ( lv_target_offset - lv_current_offset ) TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.
        lv_current_offset = lv_target_offset.

        " Fetch the actual record
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_random_sflights.
          lv_current_offset = lv_current_offset + 1.
        ELSE.
          " Should not happen if offsets are valid and cursor is open
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_random_sampling.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_random_sflights( lv_num_records ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_num_records
                                       msg = 'Incorrect number of random records returned' ).

    " Check for uniqueness (probabilistic for small N, but good enough)
    DATA(lv_distinct_count) = 0.
    DATA(lt_distinct_keys) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_random_sflight_sampler=>ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_random_sflight_sampler=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      ).
      INSERT ls_key INTO TABLE lt_distinct_keys.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_distinct_count = lines( lt_distinct_keys ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_distinct_count exp = lv_num_records
                                       msg = 'Returned records are not distinct' ).

    cleanup_test_data( ).

  METHOD test_sampling_more_than_total.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'YY' INTO lv_total_records.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_random_sflights( lv_total_records + 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_total_records
                                       msg = 'Should return all records if requested number is greater than total' ).
    cleanup_test_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sampling_zero_records.
    setup_test_data( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight_sampler( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_random_sflights( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result

solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_distinct_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_carrid_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT carrid
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
          INTO TABLE lt_carrid_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        INSERT LINES OF lt_carrid_package INTO TABLE rt_distinct_carriers.
        CLEAR lt_carrid_package.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einer zufälligen Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 30%) einen bestimmten Wert zurückgibt, ansonsten einen Standardwert.
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 100 und prüfen Sie, ob sie unter dem Schwellenwert liegt. Nutzen Sie `COND` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_condition DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_by_probability
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability_percent TYPE i " e.g., 30 for 30%
        iv_special_value     TYPE string
        iv_default_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_condition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_by_probability.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).
    DATA(lv_random_percent) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 ).

    rv_result_value = COND string(
      WHEN lv_random_percent <= iv_probability_percent THEN iv_special_value
      ELSE iv_default_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_probability_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_probability_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_condition( ).
    DATA(lv_special_value) = 'SPECIAL'.
    DATA(lv_default_value) = 'DEFAULT'.

    " Test with 100% probability - should always return special value
    DATA(lv_result_100) = lo_cut->get_value_by_probability(
      iv_probability_percent = 100
      iv_special_value     = lv_special_value
      iv_default_value     = lv_default_value
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_100 exp = lv_special_value
                                       msg = '100% probability failed' ).

    " Test with 0% probability - should always return default value
    DATA(lv_result_0) = lo_cut->get_value_by_probability(
      iv_probability_percent = 0
      iv_special_value     = lv_special_value
      iv_default_value     = lv_default_value
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_0 exp = lv_default_value
                                       msg = '0% probability failed' ).

    " Test with intermediate probability (probabilistic check)
    DATA(lv_special_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 100.
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result_50) = lo_cut->get_value_by_probability(
        iv_probability_percent = 50
        iv_special_value     = lv_special_value
        iv_default_value     = lv_default_value
      ).
      IF lv_result_50 = lv_special_value.
        lv_special_count = lv_special_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    " Assert that the count is within a reasonable range (e.g., 30-70 for 50% probability over 100 iterations)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_special_count >= 30 AND lv_special_count <= 70 )
                                       msg = '50% probability did not yield expected distribution' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random` zur Implementierung einer zufälligen bedingten Logik. Eine Zufallszahl wird generiert und mit einem Wahrscheinlichkeitsschwellenwert verglichen. Die moderne `COND`-Expression wird verwendet, um den Rückgabewert prägnant und funktional basierend auf dieser Bedingung zuzuweisen, was den Code lesbarer und kompakter macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die einen zufälligen Satz aus einer Liste von Sätzen zurückgibt, wobei jeder Satz eine bestimmte Wahrscheinlichkeit hat, ausgewählt zu werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random` und eine gewichtete Auswahl basierend auf den Wahrscheinlichkeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_random_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_entry,
             text        TYPE string,
             probability TYPE i, " 0-100
           END OF ty_text_entry.
    TYPES: tt_text_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_text_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_random_text
      IMPORTING
        it_text_entries TYPE tt_text_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_random_text.
    IF it_text_entries IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input list is empty, cannot select random entry.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_weight) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR <entry> IN it_text_entries
      NEXT s = s + <entry>-probability
    ).

    IF lv_total_weight <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Total probability is zero or negative, cannot select random entry.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).
    DATA(lv_random_point) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lv_total_weight ).

    DATA(lv_current_weight) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_text_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lv_current_weight = lv_current_weight + ls_entry-probability.
      IF lv_random_point <= lv_current_weight.
        rv_selected_text = ls_entry-text.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Fallback (should not be reached if probabilities are handled correctly)
    rv_selected_text = it_text_entries[ 1 ]-text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_weighted_selection FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    METHODS test_zero_total_weight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_text( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_text=>tt_text_entries(
      ( text = 'Low chance' probability = 10 )
      ( text = 'Medium chance' probability = 30 )
      ( text = 'High chance' probability = 60 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_low_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_medium_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_high_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_selected) = lo_cut->get_weighted_random_text( lt_entries ).
      IF lv_selected = 'Low chance'.
        lv_low_count = lv_low_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_selected = 'Medium chance'.
        lv_medium_count = lv_medium_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_selected = 'High chance'.
        lv_high_count = lv_high_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Check if counts are roughly proportional to probabilities
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_low_count   >= 50  AND lv_low_count   <= 150 )
                                       msg = 'Low chance distribution incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_medium_count >= 250 AND lv_medium_count <= 350 )
                                       msg = 'Medium chance distribution incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_high_count  >= 550 AND lv_high_count  <= 650 )
                                       msg = 'High chance distribution incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_text( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_text=>tt_text_entries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->get_weighted_random_text( lt_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_total_weight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_text( ).
    DATA(lt_zero_weight) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_text=>tt_text_entries(
      ( text = 'No chance' probability = 0 )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->get_weighted_random_text( lt_zero_weight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine gewichtete Zufallsauswahl. Zuerst wird die Summe aller Wahrscheinlichkeiten berechnet (`REDUCE`). Dann wird mit `cl_abap_random` ein Zufallspunkt innerhalb dieses Gesamtgewichts generiert. Durch Iteration über die Einträge wird der Satz ausgewählt, dessen kumulierte Wahrscheinlichkeit den Zufallspunkt überschreitet. Dies ist eine elegante Lösung für Szenarien, in denen Elemente mit unterschiedlicher Häufigkeit ausgewählt werden sollen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die die Existenz eines Datensatzes in `SFLIGHT` prüft, indem sie `OPEN CURSOR` verwendet und den Cursor sofort schließt, sobald ein Treffer gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `UP TO 1 ROWS` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` gefolgt von `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_existence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_sflight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_existence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sflight_exists.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight_key TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
          AND connid = iv_connid
          AND fldate = iv_fldate
        UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight_key.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rb_exists = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rb_exists = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rb_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die aus der `sflights`-Tabelle generiert wird. Jeder Eintrag in der neuen Tabelle soll die Felder `carrid`, `connid`, `fldate` und ein neues Feld `flight_index` enthalten, das den ursprünglichen Index (sy-tabix) des Eintrags in der `sflights`-Tabelle widerspiegelt. Beschränken Sie die Ausgabe auf die ersten 5 Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... FROM 1 TO 5` und `VALUE #` mit `sy-tabix` in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_sy_tabix_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_indexed,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid       TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate       TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_indexed.
    TYPES: tt_flight_indexed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_indexed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_indexed_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_indexed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_sy_tabix_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid,
                            fldate = flight-fldate,
                            flight_index = sy-tabix ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 entries' exp = 5 act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry index should be 1' exp = 1 act = lt_result[1]-flight_index ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (`price`) für Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, deren Index (sy-tabix) ungerade ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und prüfen Sie `sy-tabix` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_sy_tabix_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_odd_index_price_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_sy_tabix_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_odd_index_price_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                       FOR flight IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                       WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD 2 <> 0 )
                       NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf `sflights`. Für jeden zweiten Eintrag (basierend auf `sy-tabix`) soll das Feld `currency` auf 'EUR_MOD' gesetzt werden, ansonsten bleibt es unverändert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `sy-tabix` und den `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_sy_tabix_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_currency_by_index
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_sy_tabix_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_currency_by_index.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                          ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                            connid   = flight-connid,
                            fldate   = flight-fldate,
                            price    = flight-price,
                            currency = COND #( WHEN sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'EUR_MOD' ELSE flight-currency ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_currency_by_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_currency_by_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_sy_tabix_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_currency_by_index( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 10 entries' exp = 10 act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    " Check first entry (odd index) - currency should be original
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'First entry currency should not be EUR_MOD' exp = 'EUR_MOD' act = lt_result[1]-currency ).
    " Check second entry (even index) - currency should be 'EUR_MOD'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry currency should be EUR_MOD' exp = 'EUR_MOD' act = lt_result[2]-currency ).
    " Check third entry (odd index) - currency should be original
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Third entry currency should not be EUR_MOD' exp = 'EUR_MOD' act = lt_result[3]-currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code sehr prägnant macht. In Kombination mit `FOR ... INDEX INTO sy-tabix` kann man Transformationen auf interne Tabellen anwenden, die vom Zeilenindex abhängen.
keywords: sy-tabix, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen von `/UI2/CL_JSON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING   cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                   RECEIVING data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).

CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             origin    TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( flight_id = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|
        origin    = ls_flight-cityfrom )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_prices
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_origin IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                            iv_origin      TYPE sflight-cityfrom

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_flights_by_origin.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_flights=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'  cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO'   cityto = 'FRANKFURT' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_origin(
      it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
      iv_origin      = 'FRANKFURT'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 flights from FRANKFURT.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-cityfrom
        exp = 'FRANKFURT'
        msg = 'Filtered flight origin mismatch.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_no_match) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_origin(
      it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
      iv_origin      = 'BERLIN'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_no_match )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Expected 0 flights from BERLIN.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. In Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator können gefilterte Tabellen direkt zugewiesen werden, was den Code sehr prägnant macht.

    DATA(lv_expected_date) = sy-datum.
    CONVERT DATE lv_expected_date INTO MASK 'DD.MM.YYYY'.

    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->format_flight_info( ls_flight ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = |Flight LH-0400 on { lv_expected_date } from FRANKFURT to NEW YORK is scheduled.|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_formatted
      exp = lv_expected
      msg = 'Formatted string mismatch.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten eine moderne und flexible Möglichkeit, Strings zu formatieren und dynamische Inhalte einzubetten. Sie sind wesentlich lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig als die Verkettung mit '&' oder die Verwendung von CONCATENATE.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, VALUE, Formatting

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einer Bedingung, unter Verwendung des COND-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie COND type( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_delay_minutes TYPE i.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING iv_delay_minutes TYPE ty_delay_minutes
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes <= 0 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0 AND iv_delay_minutes <= 30 THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 30 THEN 'Stark verspätet'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 )
      exp = 'Pünktlich'
      msg = 'Status for 0 delay mismatch.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 15 )

explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Reihe von Bedingungen in einer einzigen Expression. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu IF-ELSEIF-ELSE-Konstrukten, besonders wenn es um die Zuweisung eines Ergebnisses geht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie direkt eine Methode auf, die eine interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die mit VALUE erstellt wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie NEW class( )->method( ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_chain_value_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_static_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
    METHODS process_and_get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chain_value_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_static_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #( 
      ( key = 'A' value = 'Alpha' )
      ( key = 'B' value = 'Beta' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_and_get_data.
    " Hier wird die Methode get_static_data direkt nach der Instanziierung aufgerufen
    " und das Ergebnis weiterverarbeitet (hier nur eine 1:1 Zuweisung zur Demonstration).
    rt_processed_data = NEW zcl_chain_value_method( )->get_static_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chain_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_method_call.
    DATA(lt_result) = NEW zcl_chain_value_method( )->process_and_get_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 items from chained method call.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_first_entry-key
      exp = 'A'
      msg = 'First entry key mismatch.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Möglichkeit, Methoden direkt nach der Instanziierung einer Klasse aufzurufen (Method Chaining), ist ein Merkmal von ABAP 7.50+. In Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator für die Rückgabe von Daten ermöglicht dies sehr kompakten und flüssigen Code, der die Lesbarkeit und den funktionalen Stil fördert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, NEW, VALUE, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine LET-Expression, um temporäre Variablen innerhalb einer komplexeren Expression zu definieren und den Code lesbarer zu machen.
hint: Verwenden Sie LET var = expression IN ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_let_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_with_discount IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items
                                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_let_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_with_discount.
    rv_total = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT total_sum = 0
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      LET item_value = ls_item-quantity * ls_item-price IN
      NEXT total_sum = total_sum + item_value
    ).

    " Beispiel für eine weitere Verwendung von LET außerhalb von REDUCE/FOR
    DATA(lv_intermediate_result) = LET a = 10 b = 20 IN a + b.
    IF lv_intermediate_result <> 30.
      " Should not happen in this example
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_with_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_with_discount.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_let_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_input_items) = VALUE zcl_let_expression=>tt_items(
      ( quantity = 2 price = '10.50' )
      ( quantity = 3 price = '5.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_with_discount( lt_input_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '36.00'
      msg = 'Total price with discount mismatch.'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_let_expression=>tt_items( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_with_discount( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_empty
      exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LET-Expression (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen, temporären Variablen innerhalb einer Expression. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit komplexer Ausdrücke, indem Zwischenergebnisse benannt und wiederverwendet werden können, ohne separate Deklarationen außerhalb der Expression zu benötigen. Sie wird oft in Kombination mit FOR- oder REDUCE-Expression verwendet.
keywords: LET, Expressions, REDUCE, Functional Programming, VALUE

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder mit gleichen Namen von einer Struktur in eine andere, unter Verwendung des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie CORRESPONDING #( ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             type   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source
                       RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING type = status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_operator=>ty_source(
      id     = 1
      name   = 'Test Item'
      amount = '123.45'
      status = 'A'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-name
      exp = 'Test Item'
      msg = 'Name field mismatch.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-amount
      exp = '123.45'
      msg = 'Amount field mismatch.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-type
      exp = 'A'
      msg = 'Mapped status to type field mismatch.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das einfache Kopieren von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, basierend auf übereinstimmenden Namen. Mit der MAPPING-Option können Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zugeordnet werden. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu MOVE-CORRESPONDING oder manuellen Zuweisungen, insbesondere bei komplexen Strukturen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Manipulation, Structures, MAPPING, VALUE

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum vor dem minimal möglichen ABAP-Datum liegt. (Beachten Sie, dass ABAP-Datumsfelder keine Werte vor 00010101 speichern können, aber die Konstante kann für logische Vergleiche nützlich sein).
hint: Vergleichen Sie mit `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_min_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_before_min_date IMPORTING iv_date TYPE dats RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_before) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_before_min_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_min_date( ).

    " Für reale Szenarien würde man eher prüfen, ob ein Datum 'initial' ist oder in einem gültigen Bereich liegt.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine interne Tabelle von Dateinamen durchläuft und für jede Datei den korrekten MIME-Typ ermittelt und zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Features.
hint: Kombinieren Sie String-Operationen (z.B. `FIND`, `SUBSTRING`) mit `cl_fxs_mime_types` Konstanten und `FOR` Expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mim_file_mime_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_mime,
             file_name  TYPE string,
             mime_type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_mime,
           tt_file_mime TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_mime WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_files_to_mime IMPORTING it_file_names TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_file_mime_map) TYPE tt_file_mime.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type_for_extension IMPORTING iv_extension TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mim_file_mime_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_files_to_mime.
    rt_file_mime_map = VALUE #( FOR file_name IN it_file_names
                                 LET lv_extension = COND string( WHEN file_name CS '.' THEN substring( val = file_name off = find( val = file_name sub = '.' ) + 1 ) ELSE '' ) IN
                                 ( file_name = file_name,
                                   mime_type = get_mime_type_for_extension( lv_extension ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_type_for_extension.
    rv_mime_type = CASE to_lower( iv_extension )
                     WHEN 'pdf' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_pdf
                     WHEN 'xml' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_xml
                     WHEN 'json' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_json
                     WHEN 'jpg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_image_jpeg
                     WHEN 'png' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_image_png
                     ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_application_octet_stream
                   END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_decfloat_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

                                           iv_val2 TYPE decfloat34

CLASS zcl_exc_decfloat_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_clamped_abs_diff.
    DATA(lv_abs_diff) = ABS( iv_val1 - iv_val2 ).
    rv_diff = COND #( WHEN lv_abs_diff > cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_decfloat THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_decfloat
                      ELSE lv_abs_diff ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Teilstring in einem Text vorhanden ist. Demonstrieren Sie den Unterschied zwischen der Verwendung von `FIND` mit `sy-subrc` und der modernen funktionalen Methode `CONTAINS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONTAINS` für eine direktere und lesbarere Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_contains DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_string_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS check_string_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_contains IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_string_legacy.
    FIND iv_pattern IN iv_text.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_string_modern.
    rv_found = xsdbool( CONTAINS( val = iv_text sub = iv_pattern ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, und lesen Sie ihn gegebenenfalls. Vergleichen Sie die traditionelle Methode mit `READ TABLE` und `sy-subrc` mit der modernen funktionalen Expression `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine elegante Möglichkeit, die Existenz eines Tabelleneintrags zu prüfen, ohne `sy-subrc` zu verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_and_read_legacy
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.

    METHODS check_and_read_modern
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_read_legacy.
    READ TABLE it_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_flight. " Ensure empty structure if not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_and_read_modern.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Datensatz aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT`. Vergleichen Sie die traditionelle `SELECT SINGLE` mit `sy-subrc`-Prüfung mit einer modernen Methode, die `SELECT SINGLE` in Kombination mit der Prüfung der Zielvariable auf `IS INITIAL` verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO @DATA(ls_data)` und prüfen Sie `ls_data IS INITIAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_flight_legacy
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.

    METHODS get_flight_modern
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_legacy.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = is_key-carrid
        AND connid = is_key-connid
        AND fldate = is_key-fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_modern.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @is_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_key-fldate.
    IF rs_flight IS INITIAL. " Modern check for 'not found'
      " No explicit sy-subrc needed, the target variable itself indicates success/failure
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren oder fügen Sie einen Datensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` ein. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `MODIFY` mit `sy-subrc` und eine modernere Herangehensweise, die `INSERT` und `UPDATE` kombiniert, wobei `sy-subrc` für die Fehlerbehandlung genutzt wird, aber in einem Kontext, der auf Ausnahmen vorbereitet ist.
hint: `INSERT` und `UPDATE` sind spezifischer als `MODIFY`. `sy-subrc` ist hier immer noch relevant, kann aber durch eine klare Fehlerbehandlung ergänzt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_legacy
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS modify_flight_modern
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db. " Example for potential exception handling
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_legacy.
    MODIFY sflight FROM is_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_flight_modern.
    " Try to update first
    UPDATE sflight FROM @is_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4. " Not found, so insert
      INSERT sflight FROM @is_flight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        " Handle insert error, e.g., duplicate key if primary key was changed
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Error inserting flight record'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Handle other update errors
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error updating flight record'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `sy-subrc`-Prüfung ist hier weiterhin notwendig, um den Erfolg der Operationen zu bewerten. Die moderne Herangehensweise kombiniert dies mit der Möglichkeit, bei Fehlern Ausnahmen (`RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_db`) auszulösen, was eine robustere Fehlerbehandlung in aufrufenden Programmen ermöglicht.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Funktionsbaustein auf, der Ausnahmen auslösen kann. Vergleichen Sie die traditionelle Behandlung von Ausnahmen über `sy-subrc` (bei `EXCEPTIONS OTHERS`) mit der modernen, objektorientierten Fehlerbehandlung mittels `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um spezifische Ausnahmen abzufangen und zu behandeln, anstatt sich auf `sy-subrc` nach `EXCEPTIONS OTHERS` zu verlassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_function_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_function_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS call_function_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_function_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_function_legacy.
    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_DEMO_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO'
      EXPORTING
        iv_numerator   = iv_input
        iv_denominator = 0
      IMPORTING
        ev_result      = DATA(lv_calc_result)
      EXCEPTIONS
        division_by_zero = 1
        OTHERS           = 2.

    IF sy-subrc = 1.
      rv_result = 'Error: Division by zero (legacy)'.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 2.
      rv_result = 'Error: Other error (legacy)'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Result: { lv_calc_result } (legacy)|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_function_modern.
    TRY.
        CALL FUNCTION 'Z_DEMO_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO'
          EXPORTING
            iv_numerator   = iv_input
            iv_denominator = 0
          IMPORTING
            ev_result      = DATA(lv_calc_result).
        rv_result = |Result: { lv_calc_result } (modern)|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) } (modern)|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith_error. " Re-raise for caller
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) } (modern)|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper Function Module (Z_DEMO_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO) - Must be created manually in SE37
" Function Group: ZDEMO
" Short Text: Demo for Divide by Zero
" Import Parameters:
"   IV_NUMERATOR TYPE I
"   IV_DENOMINATOR TYPE I
" Export Parameters:
"   EV_RESULT TYPE I
" Exceptions:
"   DIVISION_BY_ZERO

" Source code for Z_DEMO_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO:
" FUNCTION Z_DEMO_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO.
"   IF iv_denominator = 0.
"     RAISE division_by_zero.
"   ENDIF.
"   ev_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
" ENDFUNCTION.

CLASS zcl_cond_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_status_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_legacy.
    FIND 'ERROR' IN iv_value.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_status = 'Found Error'.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'No Error'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_modern.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN CONTAINS( val = iv_value sub = 'ERROR' ) THEN 'Found Error'
      ELSE 'No Error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_replace_pair,
             old_value TYPE string,
             new_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_replace_pair.
    TYPES: tt_replace_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_replace_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_multiple_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        it_repl_pairs TYPE tt_replace_pairs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS replace_multiple_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        it_repl_pairs TYPE tt_replace_pairs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_multiple_legacy.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    LOOP AT it_repl_pairs INTO DATA(ls_pair).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ls_pair-old_value IN rv_result WITH ls_pair-new_value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_multiple_modern.
    rv_result = REDUCE string( INIT s = iv_text
      FOR ls_pair IN it_repl_pairs
      NEXT s = REPLACE( val = s sub = ls_pair-old_value with = ls_pair-new_value occ = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_trim_and_compress IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_mask_sensitive_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_card_number TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_masked_number) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_mask_sensitive_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mask_credit_card.
    " Regex to match a 16-digit number, capturing the first 4 and last 4 digits
    " (\d{4}) captures first 4, (\d{8}) captures middle 8, (\d{4}) captures last 4
    " Replacement: $1********$3 (use captured groups and asterisks)
    rv_masked_number = REPLACE( val = iv_card_number
                                regex = '(\d{4})(\d{8})(\d{4})'
                                with = '$1********$3'
                                occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die funktionale `REPLACE` Expression mit regulären Ausdrücken und Rückreferenzen (`$1`, `$3`) ist eine sehr elegante und sichere Methode, um sensible Daten zu maskieren. Der reguläre Ausdruck identifiziert das Muster der Kreditkartennummer und fängt die relevanten Teile (erste und letzte vier Ziffern) in Gruppen ein. Im Ersetzungsstring werden diese Gruppen (`$1`, `$3`) wiederverwendet, während der mittlere Teil durch Sternchen ersetzt wird. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Lösung für Datenschutzanforderungen.
keywords: REPLACE, REGEX, Masking, Sensitive Data, String Processing, Functional Expression, Matcher Groups

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in 'CamelCase', indem Sie Leerzeichen und Bindestriche entfernen und den nachfolgenden Buchstaben großschreiben. Nutzen Sie die funktionale `REPLACE` Expression mit `REGEX` und einer Ersetzungsfunktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE` mit `REGEX` und einer Lambda-Funktion oder einer Methode als Ersetzungsroutine.
solution:
CLASS zcl_to_camel_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_camel_case
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_camel_case_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS replace_callback
      FOR REPLACE_REGEX_SUBSTRING OF cl_abap_regex
      IMPORTING
        match_offset TYPE i
        match_length TYPE i
        match_string TYPE string
        group_index  TYPE i
        group_offset TYPE i
        group_length TYPE i
        group_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replacement) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_to_camel_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_camel_case.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input_string.

    " First, replace spaces/hyphens followed by a letter with uppercase letter
    " Regex: (\s|-)(\w) - capture space/hyphen and the following word character
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '(\s|-)(\w)' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = lv_temp ).

    rv_camel_case_string = lo_matcher->replace_with_callback( callback_class = me->replace_callback ).

    " Ensure the first character is lowercase (if not already)
    IF rv_camel_case_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_camel_case_string = |
        { to_lower( rv_camel_case_string(1) ) }
        { rv_camel_case_string+1 }
      |.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_callback.
    " group_string for group 2 is the character after space/hyphen
    rv_replacement = to_upper( group_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die fortgeschrittene Funktionalität von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit der Methode `replace_with_callback`. Dies ermöglicht es, eine benutzerdefinierte Logik (hier in der Methode `replace_callback`) auszuführen, um den Ersetzungsstring dynamisch zu generieren, basierend auf den gefundenen Matcher-Gruppen. Der reguläre Ausdruck `(\s|-)(\w)` fängt Leerzeichen oder Bindestriche und den darauf folgenden Buchstaben ein. Die Callback-Methode wandelt den gefangenen Buchstaben in Großbuchstaben um. Abschließend wird der erste Buchstabe des gesamten Strings in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt, um die korrekte CamelCase-Konvention zu erfüllen. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und moderne Art der String-Transformation.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) für eine bestimmte Währung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur (z.B. `sflight`) zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endpreis eines Fluges nach Anwendung eines Rabatts und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Verwenden Sie `DECFLOAT34` für präzise Berechnungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DECFLOAT34` für Dezimalberechnungen und `ROUND` für die Rundung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_discount_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_rate  TYPE decfloat16 " e.g., 0.10 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_discount_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_price_df) = CONV decfloat34( iv_original_price ).
    DATA(lv_discount_df) = CONV decfloat34( iv_discount_rate ).
    DATA(lv_final_price_df) = lv_price_df * ( 1 - lv_discount_df ).
    rv_final_price = CONV sflight-price( lv_final_price_df ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_flights_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_flights_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrid_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt und geben Sie den Rest des Strings zurück, falls ja. Andernfalls geben Sie den ursprünglichen String zurück.

CLASS zcl_str_prefix_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_string_after_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_prefix       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_prefix_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string_after_prefix.
    IF iv_input_string STARTS WITH iv_prefix.
      rv_result_string = iv_input_string+strlen( iv_prefix ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface und eine Factory-Klasse mit `NEW` für die Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_std DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_std IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_processor~process_flight_data.
    rv_result = |Standardverarbeitung für Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } abgeschlossen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_premium DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_premium IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_processor~process_flight_data.
    rv_result = |Premiumverarbeitung für Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } abgeschlossen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_processor
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_processor) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_processor.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'STANDARD'.
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_flight_processor_std( ).
      WHEN 'PREMIUM'.
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_flight_processor_premium( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default or error handling
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_flight_processor_std( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (FLIGHTNUM) von Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks und der `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` um die neue Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_num,
             flightnum TYPE sflight-flightnum,
           END OF ty_flight_num,
           tt_flight_num TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_num WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flight_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_nums) TYPE tt_flight_num.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_nums = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                 ( flightnum = flight-flightnum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flight_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Should be initial if no data, or check specific content

    " To make the test more robust, we could insert test data into SFLIGHTS
    " For simplicity, we assume SFLIGHTS might be empty or contain data.
    " A more complete test would involve mocking or setup for SFLIGHTS.

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flightnum is not initial exp = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Füllung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten effizient. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Bestimme den Status eines Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf der Flugverfügbarkeit (SEATSMAX, SEATSOCC) und einem booleschen Parameter für Verspätung, unter Verwendung eines `COND`-Ausdrucks mit `WHEN` und `ELSE`.
hint: Nutze `COND string OF abap_true WHEN ... THEN ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_max TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        iv_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_is_delayed TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_seats_occ >= iv_seats_max THEN 'Ausgebucht'
      WHEN iv_is_delayed = abap_true THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
