Instructions: Berechne für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) die maximale und minimale Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und aggregiere mit `MAX` und `MIN` innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seat_stats,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_seats_occupied TYPE s_seatsocc,
             min_seats_occupied TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_seat_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seat_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seat_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_max_seats_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_seat_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_seat_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_max_seats_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_flights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(lv_max_seats) = REDUCE #( INIT max_val = ( VALUE s_seatsocc( ) )
                                     FOR flight IN GROUP <fs_group>
                                     NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = flight-seatsocc ) ).
      DATA(lv_min_seats) = REDUCE #( INIT min_val = ( VALUE s_seatsocc( 9999 ) ) " Initialize with a high value
                                     FOR flight IN GROUP <fs_group>
                                     NEXT min_val = nmin( val1 = min_val val2 = flight-seatsocc ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                      max_seats_occupied = lv_max_seats
                      min_seats_occupied = lv_min_seats ) TO rt_seat_stats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Zahlen quadriert und anschließend nur die Ergebnisse zurückgibt, die größer als ein bestimmter Schwellenwert sind. Nutze dabei funktionale Programmieransätze.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR` mit `FILTER` und `VALUE` in einem Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_math DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_number TYPE i.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS square_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_threshold TYPE ty_number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_squares) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD square_and_filter.
    rt_filtered_squares = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers
                                   LET squared_number = number * number IN
                                   WHERE ( squared_number > iv_threshold )
                                   ( squared_number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fangen Sie verschiedene Systemausnahmen in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block ab und reagieren Sie spezifisch darauf.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke für unterschiedliche Ausnahmeklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
        iv_op   TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    TRY.
        CASE iv_op.
          WHEN '+'.
            rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
          WHEN '-'.
            rv_result = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
          WHEN '*'.
            rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
          WHEN '/'.
            rv_result = iv_val1 / iv_val2.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Invalid operator'.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        " Specific handling for division by zero
        MESSAGE lx_zero->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow INTO DATA(lx_overflow).
        " Specific handling for overflow
        MESSAGE lx_overflow->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        " General arithmetic error
        MESSAGE lx_arith->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        " Conversion error (e.g., invalid operator)
        MESSAGE lx_conv->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in der Ausnahmebehandlung, um Ressourcen freizugeben.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor der `CATCH`-Block erreicht wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lv_resource_locked TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true. " Simulate resource lock

    TRY.
        " Simulate some operation that might raise an exception
        IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Input cannot be initial'.
        ENDIF.
        " ... further processing ...
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_strg_par_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle specific error
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed if an exception occurs in TRY
        IF lv_resource_locked = abap_true.
          " Unlock resource
          lv_resource_locked = abap_false.
          " Log cleanup action
          " cl_demo_output=>display( 'Resource unlocked in CLEANUP.' ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        " Dynamically call method
        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        MESSAGE lx_create_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        MESSAGE lx_call_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other exception
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_exc_custom DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_my_custom_exception.

CLASS zcl_exc_custom IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_custom_exception

Instructions: Lesen Sie Datensätze aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle, bis eine bestimmte Gesamtkapazität erreicht ist, und verwenden Sie dabei eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` und iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse, um die Bedingung zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_capacity TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_capacity.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_current_capacity TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    " Sort to get a consistent order for testing
    SORT lt_all_flights BY fldate ASCENDING.

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    WHILE lv_current_capacity < iv_target_capacity AND lv_index <= lines( lt_all_flights ).
      DATA(ls_flight) = lt_all_flights[ lv_index ].
      lv_current_capacity = lv_current_capacity + ls_flight-seatsocc.
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_data(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc
        seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax
      ) TO rt_selected_flights.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit `CONTINUE` und `CHECK`, um bestimmte Iterationen zu überspringen oder die Schleife vorzeitig zu beenden.
hint: `CONTINUE` springt zur nächsten Iteration, `CHECK` beendet die Schleife, wenn die Bedingung `FALSE` ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_continue_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_continue_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.
    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ).
      DATA(lv_current_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].

      " Skip negative numbers
      IF lv_current_number < 0.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      " Stop if sum exceeds 100
      CHECK lv_sum + lv_current_number <= 100.

      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_current_number.
      APPEND lv_current_number TO rt_processed_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen String zeichenweise mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife und extrahieren Sie numerische Werte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Index und String-Operatoren wie `substring` oder `(offset, length)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_string_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_numbers_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_string_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_numbers_from_string.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_current_number_str) = ``.

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_length.
      DATA(lv_char) = iv_input_string+lv_index-1(1).

      IF lv_char CA '0123456789'.
        lv_current_number_str = lv_current_number_str && lv_char.
      ELSE.
        IF lv_current_number_str IS NOT INITIAL.
          TRY.
              APPEND CONV i( lv_current_number_str ) TO rt_numbers.
            CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
              " Ignore conversion errors for simplicity in this example
          ENDTRY.
          lv_current_number_str = ``.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Add any remaining number at the end of the string
    IF lv_current_number_str IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          APPEND CONV i( lv_current_number_str ) TO rt_numbers.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Ignore conversion errors
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Wiederholungsmechanismus mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife und einer Verzögerung (`WAIT UP TO`), um eine Operation zu wiederholen, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder die maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Zähler für die Versuche und `WAIT UP TO` für die Verzögerung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_retry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_reliable_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
        iv_delay_seconds TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_retry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_reliable_operation.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    DATA(lv_operation_successful) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries AND lv_operation_successful = abap_false.
      lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
      " Simulate an operation that might fail
      IF sy-uzeit MOD 2 = 0 AND lv_retries < iv_max_retries. " Simulate failure for some attempts
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Attempt { lv_retries } failed. Retrying in { iv_delay_seconds } seconds...| ).
        WAIT UP TO iv_delay_seconds SECONDS.
      ELSE.
        lv_operation_successful = abap_true.
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Operation successful after { lv_retries } attempts.| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_success = lv_operation_successful.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_succeeds_eventually FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_fails_after_max_retries FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_succeeds_first_try FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_succeeds_eventually.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry( ).
    " This test might be flaky due to sy-uzeit MOD 2. For a real test, mock the dependency.
    " For demonstration, we assume it eventually succeeds within 5 retries.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_reliable_operation( iv_max_retries = 5 iv_delay_seconds = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_fails_after_max_retries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry( ).
    " To reliably test failure, we need to ensure the simulated operation always fails.
    " This is a conceptual test. In a real scenario, the 'sy-uzeit MOD 2' would be replaced
    " by a mockable dependency that can be controlled by the test.
    " For this example, we'll assume a scenario where it fails more often than not.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_reliable_operation( iv_max_retries = 1 iv_delay_seconds = 0 ).
    " This assertion might fail if sy-uzeit MOD 2 happens to be 1 on the first try.
    " It demonstrates the intent of testing the retry limit.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_succeeds_first_try.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry( ).
    " If sy-uzeit MOD 2 is 1, it succeeds immediately. If 0, it fails once and retries.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_reliable_operation( iv_max_retries = 1 iv_delay_seconds = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Wiederholungsmechanismus mit `WHILE` und `WAIT UP TO` ist eine gängige Praxis, um die Robustheit von Anwendungen zu erhöhen, insbesondere bei der Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder bei Operationen, die vorübergehend fehlschlagen können. Die Verzögerung verhindert eine Überlastung des Systems.
keywords: WHILE, LOOP, RETRY, WAIT UP TO, DELAY, ROBUSTNESS, CONTROL FLOW

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um redundante Daten in sortierten internen Tabellen zu entfernen. Die `COMPARING` Klausel erlaubt die Definition der Felder, die für die Duplikatsprüfung relevant sind.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Table, SORT

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Fügen Sie jeder Zeile einen Zufallsschlüssel hinzu und sortieren Sie die Tabelle danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_random,
             random_key TYPE i,
             sflight    TYPE sflight,
           END OF ty_sflight_random.
    DATA: lt_sflight_random TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_random WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ).

    LOOP AT ct_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_random( random_key = lo_random->get_next( ) sflight = ls_sflight ) TO lt_sflight_random.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_sflight_random BY random_key.

    CLEAR ct_sflights.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_random INTO DATA(ls_sflight_random).
      APPEND ls_sflight_random-sflight TO ct_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflights_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shuffle_table( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights_orig.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20230601' ) TO lt_sflights_orig.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '402' fldate = '20231231' ) TO lt_sflights_orig.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '403' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights_orig.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '404' fldate = '20230601' ) TO lt_sflights_orig.

    lt_sflights_shuffled = lt_sflights_orig.
    lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights_shuffled ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_sflights_orig ) ).
    " It's highly improbable for a shuffled table to be identical to the original, but not impossible.
    " For a robust test, one might check if all original elements are present.
    DATA(lv_is_same_order) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_orig INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_shuffled INTO DATA(ls_shuffled) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF ls_orig <> ls_shuffled.
        lv_is_same_order = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_same_order ). " Assert that the order is likely different
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch das Hinzufügen eines zufälligen Schlüssels zu jeder Zeile einer Hilfstabelle und das anschließende Sortieren nach diesem Schlüssel kann eine interne Tabelle effizient gemischt werden. Dies ist eine gängige Technik, um eine zufällige Reihenfolge zu erzielen.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Table, SORT, Shuffle, cl_abap_random_int

Instructions: Löschen Sie aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen alle Einträge, bei denen die Anzahl der belegten Sitze die maximale Anzahl überschreitet (Überbuchung) und das Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne funktionale Ansätze.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER` Expression mit `EXCEPT WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_overbooked_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_overbooked
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_overbooked_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_overbooked.
    ct_sflights = FILTER #( ct_sflights EXCEPT WHERE fldate < sy-datum AND seatsocc > seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_overbooked FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_overbooked.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_overbooked_flights( ).

    " Overbooked, past date - should be deleted
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '100' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 90 ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Not overbooked, past date - should remain
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '101' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 90 ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Overbooked, future date - should remain
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '102' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 90 ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Not overbooked, future date - should remain
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '103' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 90 ) TO lt_sflights.

    lo_cut->delete_overbooked( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '103' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Expression mit `EXCEPT WHERE` ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, indem eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Zeilen erstellt wird. Dies ist oft performanter und lesbarer als explizite `DELETE` Anweisungen in Schleifen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, FILTER, Functional Programming, EXCEPT WHERE

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus einer internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY

        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_sflights ).
    IF lv_table_size = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
    READ TABLE it_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_flight_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_selection.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20230601' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '402' fldate = '20231231' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_random_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( it_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_random_flight IS INITIAL ).
    " Check if the selected flight is actually in the original table
    READ TABLE lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = ls_random_flight-carrid connid = ls_random_flight-connid fldate = ls_random_flight-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).

  METHOD test_empty_table_exception.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      act = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( )->get_random_flight( lt_sflights )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_TABLE_LINE_NOT_FOUND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `cl_abap_random_int` und `lines()` kann ein gültiger Zufallsindex für den Zugriff auf eine interne Tabelle ermittelt werden. Die Behandlung des leeren Tabellenfalls mit einer Exception ist eine gute Praxis.

CLASS zcl_delete_from_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_alphanum_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_alphanum_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_length) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_chars_length - 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = ``.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      lv_random_string = lv_random_string && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1).
    ENDDO.
    rv_random_string = lv_random_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_uniqueness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = lo_cut->get_random_alphanum_string( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_string ) exp = 10 ).

    lv_string = lo_cut->get_random_alphanum_string( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_string ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = lo_cut->get_random_alphanum_string( 20 ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_contains_only_allowed) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_string ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_string+sy-index-1(1).
      IF NOT ( lc_allowed_chars CS lv_char ).
        lv_contains_only_allowed = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_contains_only_allowed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_string1) = lo_cut->get_random_alphanum_string( 15 ).
    DATA(lv_string2) = lo_cut->get_random_alphanum_string( 15 ).
    " Highly unlikely to be the same, but not impossible for true random.
    " For practical purposes, we assert they are different.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_string1 exp = lv_string2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die wiederholte Generierung von Zufallsindizes und den Zugriff auf einen vordefinierten Zeichensatz kann ein zufälliger String beliebiger Länge erstellt werden. String-Templates (`&&`) ermöglichen eine lesbare Verkettung der Zeichen.
keywords: RANDOM, String, String Template, cl_abap_random_int, String Processing

Instructions: Löschen Sie aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen alle Einträge, deren Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in einer separaten 'Blacklist'-Tabelle vorhanden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER` Expression mit `EXCEPT IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_flights_by_blacklist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_from_blacklist.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_flights_by_blacklist( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_delete_flights_by_blacklist=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'UA' connid = '007' ) TO lt_blacklist.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '123' ).

explanation: Die `FILTER` Expression mit `EXCEPT IN` ist eine sehr elegante und performante Methode, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die in einer anderen Tabelle (Blacklist) vorhanden sind. Dies vermeidet explizite Schleifen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit erheblich.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, FILTER, EXCEPT IN, Functional Programming

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei Flüge mit mehr freien Sitzen eine höhere Wahrscheinlichkeit haben, ausgewählt zu werden.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine kumulative gewichtete Liste und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weighted_random_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_random_flight.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_flight,
             weight TYPE i,
             sflight TYPE sflight,
           END OF ty_weighted_flight.
    DATA: lt_weighted_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_total_weight) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_free_seats) = ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc.
      IF lv_free_seats > 0.
        lv_total_weight = lv_total_weight + lv_free_seats.
        APPEND VALUE ty_weighted_flight( weight = lv_total_weight sflight = ls_sflight ) TO lt_weighted_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_total_weight = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_total_weight ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_weighted_flights INTO rs_sflight
      WITH KEY weight GTE lv_random_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weighted_random_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_random_selection.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '100' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights. " 50 free seats
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '200' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights. " 10 free seats
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '300' seatsocc = 0 seatsmax = 10 ) TO lt_sflights.   " 10 free seats

    DATA: lv_lh_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_ua_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_aa_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DO 1000 TIMES.
      DATA(ls_selected_flight) = lo_cut->get_weighted_random_flight( it_sflights ).
      IF ls_selected_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_selected_flight-carrid = 'UA'.
        lv_ua_count = lv_ua_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_selected_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " LH should be selected roughly 50/(50+10+10) = 50/70 = ~71% of the time
    " UA and AA should be selected roughly 10/70 = ~14% of the time each
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lh_count > lv_ua_count AND lv_lh_count > lv_aa_count ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lh_count > 600 ) ). " Check if it's roughly in the expected range
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_exception.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      act = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( )->get_weighted_random_flight( lt_sflights )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_TABLE_LINE_NOT_FOUND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Erstellung einer kumulativen Gewichtungsliste und die Generierung einer Zufallszahl innerhalb des Gesamtgewichts kann ein Element basierend auf seiner relativen Gewichtung ausgewählt werden. `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... GTE` findet effizient das erste Element, dessen kumulatives Gewicht den Zufallswert erreicht oder überschreitet.
keywords: RANDOM, Weighted Selection, Internal Table, Math, cl_abap_random_int

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die keine Buchungen haben (SEATSOCC = 0) und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die zu behaltenden Flüge enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_empty_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_empty_future_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_empty_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_empty_future_flights.
    ct_sflights = REDUCE #( INIT r = ct_sflights
                            FOR ls_sflight IN ct_sflights
                            WHERE NOT ( ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0 AND ls_sflight-fldate > sy-datum )
                            APPEND ls_sflight TO r ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_empty_future FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_empty_future.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_empty_future_flights( ).

    " Empty, future - should be deleted
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '100' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 0 ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Not empty, future - should remain
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '101' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 10 ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Empty, past - should remain
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '102' fldate = sy-datum - 1 seatsocc = 0 ) TO lt_sflights.
    " Not empty, past - should remain
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '103' fldate = sy-datum - 1 seatsocc = 10 ) TO lt_sflights.

    lo_cut->delete_empty_future_flights( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '103' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ermöglicht es, eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, indem Elemente aus einer Quelltabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung selektiv hinzugefügt werden. Dies ist eine funktionale Alternative zu `DELETE` in Schleifen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen, zufälligen Flugnummern (CONNID) im Format 'XXX' (z.B. '001', '123', '999').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `FOR` Expression mit `COND` für die Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_connids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_connids.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 999 ).
    DATA(lt_generated_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ).

    DO iv_count * 5 TIMES. " Try more times to ensure uniqueness
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_generated_numbers[ table_line = lv_new_number ] ).
        APPEND lv_new_number TO lt_generated_numbers.
        IF lines( lt_generated_numbers ) = iv_count.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_connids = VALUE string_table( FOR num IN lt_generated_numbers ( |{ num ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_connids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_and_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->generate_unique_connids( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 5 ).

    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lt_unique_connids) = lt_connids.
    SORT lt_unique_connids ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_connids.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_connids ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_and_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->generate_unique_connids( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 3 ).
    LOOP AT lt_connids INTO DATA(lv_connid).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_connid ) exp = 3 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_connid CO '0123456789' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung von Zufallszahlen mit einer Schleife und einer `line_exists` Prüfung, um die Eindeutigkeit der generierten Flugnummern sicherzustellen. Die `ALPHA = OUT` Option in String-Templates formatiert die Zahlen mit führenden Nullen, um das gewünschte 'XXX'-Format zu erreichen.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die in den letzten 30 Tagen stattgefunden haben und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, aber nur, wenn die Tabelle mehr als 100 solcher Flüge enthält. Andernfalls behalten Sie alle Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die bedingte Löschung und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_conditionally
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_conditionally.
    DATA(lv_threshold_date) = sy-datum - 30.

    DATA(lt_flights_to_check) = FILTER #( ct_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate GE lv_threshold_date AND fldate LE sy-datum ).

    IF lines( lt_flights_to_check ) > 100.
      ct_sflights = FILTER #( ct_sflights EXCEPT IN lt_flights_to_check WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid AND fldate = fldate ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_above_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_delete_below_threshold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_above_threshold.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_delete( ).

    " Add 101 flights matching criteria
    DO 101 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = |{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 10 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
    " Add one flight not matching criteria
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 10 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '102' fldate = sy-datum + 10 ) TO lt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 103 ).

    lo_cut->delete_conditionally( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '102' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_delete_below_threshold.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_delete( ).

    " Add 50 flights matching criteria
    DO 50 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = |{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 10 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
    " Add one flight not matching criteria
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 10 ) TO lt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 51 ).

    lo_cut->delete_conditionally( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 51 ). " No deletion should occur
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die bedingte Löschung von Tabellenzeilen. Zuerst werden die potenziell zu löschenden Zeilen mit `FILTER` identifiziert. Anschließend wird die tatsächliche Löschung (erneut mit `FILTER EXCEPT IN`) nur durchgeführt, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung (Anzahl der Zeilen > 100) erfüllt ist. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, komplexe Löschlogik zu implementieren.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, FILTER, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Objekten (z.B. Flugobjekte) verwaltet und eine Methode bereitstellt, um ein zufälliges Objekt aus der Liste zurückzugeben, ohne es zu entfernen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und generische Typen (`ANY TABLE`) für die Flexibilität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_object_picker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE ANY TABLE.

    METHODS get_random_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_object) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_objects TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA mv_lines TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_object_picker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE DATA mt_objects LIKE it_objects.
    ASSIGN it_objects TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_table>).
    ASSIGN mt_objects->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_table>).
    <fs_target_table> = <fs_source_table>.
    mv_lines = lines( <fs_target_table> ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_random_object.
    IF mv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = mv_lines ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    ASSIGN mt_objects->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    CREATE DATA ro_object LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN ro_object->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_object>).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX lv_random_index INTO <fs_object>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '123' fldate = '20231231' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_picker) = NEW zcl_random_object_picker( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lr_random_flight) = lo_picker->get_random_object( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-tcode exp = 'SFLIGHT' ). " Check type (indirectly)

    " Check if the selected flight is actually in the original table

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die in den letzten 7 Tagen stattgefunden haben und deren Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist, aber nur, wenn die Anzahl der verbleibenden Flüge dieser Gesellschaft nach der Löschung nicht unter 5 fällt. Andernfalls löschen Sie keine Flüge dieser Gesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `FILTER` in Kombination mit `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_min_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_conditionally_grouped
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_min_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_conditionally_grouped.
    DATA(lv_seven_days_ago) = sy-datum - 7.
    DATA(lv_min_flights) = 5.

    DATA(lt_flights_to_delete) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ).

    LOOP AT ct_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lt_current_group) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

      DATA(lt_candidates_for_deletion) = FILTER #( lt_current_group WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate GE lv_seven_days_ago AND fldate LE sy-datum ).

      IF lv_carrid = 'AA' AND lines( lt_current_group ) - lines( lt_candidates_for_deletion ) GE lv_min_flights.
        APPEND LINES OF lt_candidates_for_deletion TO lt_flights_to_delete.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_flights_to_delete IS NOT INITIAL.
      ct_sflights = FILTER #( ct_sflights EXCEPT IN lt_flights_to_delete WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid AND fldate = fldate ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_with_threshold_met FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_delete_threshold_not_met FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_airlines_unaffected FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_with_threshold_met.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_min_threshold( ).

    " AA flights: 10 total, 6 in last 7 days. Remaining: 4. Threshold 5 not met. -> No delete
    " Correction: 10 total, 6 in last 7 days. Remaining: 4. Threshold 5 NOT met. -> No delete
    " Let's make it 12 total, 6 in last 7 days. Remaining: 6. Threshold 5 met. -> Delete 6.
    DO 6 TIMES. " 6 flights in last 7 days
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = |{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 3 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
    DO 6 TIMES. " 6 flights older than 7 days
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = |{ sy-index + 6 ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 10 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 3 ) TO lt_sflights. " Other airline

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 13 ).

    lo_cut->delete_conditionally_grouped( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 7 ). " 6 old AA + 1 LH
    READ TABLE lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 4 ). " Assert deleted
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_delete_threshold_not_met.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_min_threshold( ).

    " AA flights: 10 total, 6 in last 7 days. Remaining: 4. Threshold 5 not met. -> No delete
    DO 6 TIMES. " 6 flights in last 7 days
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = |{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 3 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
    DO 4 TIMES. " 4 flights older than 7 days
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = |{ sy-index + 6 ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 10 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 3 ) TO lt_sflights. " Other airline

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 11 ).

    lo_cut->delete_conditionally_grouped( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 11 ). " No deletion should occur
    READ TABLE lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ). " Assert not deleted
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_airlines_unaffected.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_min_threshold( ).

    " LH flights: 10 total, 6 in last 7 days. Remaining: 4. Threshold 5 not met. -> No delete
    DO 10 TIMES. " 10 flights in last 7 days
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = |{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| fldate = sy-datum - 3 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 10 ).

    lo_cut->delete_conditionally_grouped( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 10 ). " No deletion should occur for LH
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird dann mit `FILTER` geprüft, welche Flüge die Löschkriterien erfüllen. Die eigentliche Löschung (mittels `FILTER EXCEPT IN`) erfolgt nur, wenn die Anzahl der verbleibenden Flüge einer Gesellschaft einen Mindestschwellenwert nicht unterschreitet. Dies demonstriert fortgeschrittene Tabellenoperationen und bedingte Logik.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, GROUP BY, FILTER, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

hint: Nutzen Sie CL_GOS_ATTACHMENT_QUERY und den LINE_EXISTS-Operator mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_check_mime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_attachment_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfinstid
        iv_mime_type   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_type) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_mime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_attachment_type.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(lt_attachments) = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
                              is_object_type = iv_object_type
                              is_object_key  = iv_object_key
                            )->get_results( ).

    rv_has_type = COND abap_bool(
                    WHEN line_exists( lt_attachments[ mime_type = iv_mime_type ] )

CLASS zcl_esh_connector_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_connector_healthy.
    DATA(lo_admin_api) = NEW cl_esh_admin_api( ).
    TRY.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_esh_index_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_esh_index_stats IMPLEMENTATION.

hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT mit INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und den VALUE-Operator mit FOR-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                          ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                            cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assert that some flights are returned for 'LH' (assuming data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

CLASS zcl_greeting_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_greeting_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_personalized_greeting.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_time_of_day) = COND string(
                               WHEN lv_time >= '060000' AND lv_time < '120000' THEN 'Morgen'
                               WHEN lv_time >= '120000' AND lv_time < '180000' THEN 'Tag'
                               ELSE 'Abend' ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für 'Flugobjekte' mit einer Methode zur Berechnung der Flugdauer. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse für 'SFLIGHT' und demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie.
hint: Nutzen Sie INTERFACE, CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING und die neue Objektinstanziierung mit NEW.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_object.
  METHODS get_flight_duration
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_duration_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_adapter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_object.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_sflight TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_adapter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight = is_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_flight_object~get_flight_duration.
    DATA(lv_dep_time) = ms_sflight-deptime.
    DATA(lv_arr_time) = ms_sflight-arrtime.

    " Einfache Berechnung: Ankunftszeit - Abflugzeit (ohne Datumsgrenzen)
    IF lv_arr_time >= lv_dep_time.
      rv_duration_minutes = ( lv_arr_time - lv_dep_time ) / 100.
    ELSE.
      " Annahme: Flug geht über Mitternacht
      rv_duration_minutes = ( '240000' - lv_dep_time + lv_arr_time ) / 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_duration.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-deptime = '100000'.
    ls_sflight-arrtime = '123000'.

    DATA(lo_flight_obj) = CAST zif_flight_object( NEW zcl_sflight_adapter( is_sflight = ls_sflight ) ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lo_flight_obj->get_flight_duration( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = 150 ). " 2 Stunden 30 Minuten

    " Test über Mitternacht
    ls_sflight-deptime = '230000'.
    ls_sflight-arrtime = '010000'.
    lo_flight_obj = CAST zif_flight_object( NEW zcl_sflight_adapter( is_sflight = ls_sflight ) ).
    lv_duration = lo_flight_obj->get_flight_duration( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = 120 ). " 2 Stunden
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung eines Interfaces und die Nutzung von Polymorphie. Die Klasse `zcl_sflight_adapter` implementiert `zif_flight_object`, wodurch Instanzen beider Typen über das Interface angesprochen werden können. Die neue Objektinstanziierung mit `NEW` und `CAST` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Polymorphism, CLASS, INTERFACES, NEW, CAST

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA').
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT mit INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und den REDUCE-Operator zur Berechnung des Durchschnitts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflight ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflight ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    END IF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg_price_aa > 0 ). " Expecting a positive average price

    " Test with a carrier that has no data

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck in einem LOOP AT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( BASE rt_flight_counts
                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " Assert that the result is not empty
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).

    " Assert specific counts for known carriers (if data is stable)
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = VALUE i( lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lh_count > 0 ). " Assuming LH has flights

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = VALUE i( lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_aa_count > 0 ). " Assuming AA has flights
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze: 'Available' (> 10 Sitze), 'Limited' (1-10 Sitze) oder 'Full' (0 Sitze).
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator mit mehreren WHEN-Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_freeslots TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
                  WHEN iv_freeslots > 10 THEN 'Available'
                  WHEN iv_freeslots > 0  THEN 'Limited'
                  ELSE 'Full' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    " Test case 1: Available
    DATA(lv_status_available) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_available exp = 'Available' ).

    " Test case 2: Limited
    DATA(lv_status_limited) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_limited exp = 'Limited' ).

    " Test case 3: Full
    DATA(lv_status_full) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_full exp = 'Full' ).

    " Test case 4: Boundary condition
    DATA(lv_status_boundary) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_boundary exp = 'Limited' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Möglichkeit, bedingte Zuweisungen vorzunehmen. Anstatt mehrerer IF-ELSEIF-ENDIF-Blöcke kann die gesamte Logik in einer einzigen Zeile ausgedrückt werden, was den Code moderner und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, IF-ELSE, Status Determination

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben und von einem bestimmten Abflugort starten. Geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_freeslots TYPE i
        iv_city_from     TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_freeslots
                                    AND   cityfrom = iv_city_from ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).

    " Test case 1: Filter for flights from 'FRANKFURT' with at least 50 free slots
    DATA(lt_filtered_ffm) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_freeslots = 50 iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered_ffm ). " Assuming such flights exist

    " Assert that all returned flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_ffm INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 50 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test case 2: Filter for flights with very high free slots (likely empty result)
    DATA(lt_filtered_empty) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_freeslots = 999 iv_city_from = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die deklarative Filterung interner Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, Zeilen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen effizient auszuwählen, ohne explizite LOOP- und IF-Statements. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, SFLIGHT, Data Filtering, Declarative Programming

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene interne Tabelle eine Standardtabelle, eine sortierte Tabelle oder eine Hash-Tabelle ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und die Attribute `table_kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_kind DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_table_info,
             is_standard TYPE abap_bool,
             is_sorted   TYPE abap_bool,
             is_hashed   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_table_info.

    METHODS get_table_kind_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_table_info) TYPE ty_table_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_kind IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_kind_info.
    DATA(lo_descr_ref) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table_data ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr_ref ).

    rs_table_info-is_standard = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_table_descr->table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
    rs_table_info-is_sorted   = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_table_descr->table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
    rs_table_info-is_hashed   = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_table_descr->table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_kind FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_kind.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA: lt_std    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data,
          lt_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY field1,
          lt_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY field1.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_kind( ).

    DATA(ls_std_info) = lo_cut->get_table_kind_info( REF #( lt_std ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_std_info-is_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_std_info-is_sorted ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_std_info-is_hashed ).

    DATA(ls_sorted_info) = lo_cut->get_table_kind_info( REF #( lt_sorted ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_sorted_info-is_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_sorted_info-is_sorted ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_sorted_info-is_hashed ).

    DATA(ls_hashed_info) = lo_cut->get_table_kind_info( REF #( lt_hashed ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_hashed_info-is_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_hashed_info-is_sorted ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_hashed_info-is_hashed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI, um den Tabellentyp (Standard, Sorted, Hashed) einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Die Attribute `table_kind` der Klasse `cl_abap_tabledescr` in Kombination mit `COND` für die Zuweisung von `abap_bool` Werten zeigen eine moderne und prägnante Art der Typanalyse.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, table_kind, COND, abap_bool, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle, die die gleiche Struktur wie eine vorhandene Tabelle hat, aber als Hash-Tabelle definiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit den Parametern der Quelltabelle und passen Sie `table_kind` an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_hashed_table_like
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_new_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_hashed_table_like.
    DATA(lo_descr_ref) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_source_table ).
    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr_ref ).

    DATA(lo_new_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type  = lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
                                  p_unique     = abap_true
                                  p_key        = lo_source_table_descr->get_keys( )->get_primary_key( )->get_components( )
                                ).
    CREATE DATA rr_new_table TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE ty_source_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_new_table) = lo_cut->create_hashed_table_like( REF #( lt_source ) ).

    DATA(lo_new_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_new_table ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_new_table_descr->table_kind exp = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_new_table_descr->is_unique_primary_key( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mit RTTI. Es wird die Typbeschreibung einer Quelltabelle verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle mit derselben Zeilenstruktur, aber einem anderen Tabellentyp (Hash-Tabelle) zu erstellen. Die Methode `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` ist hierbei zentral.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, create, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, get_keys, get_primary_key, get_components

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Komponenten (Feldnamen) des Primärschlüssels einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `get_keys`, `get_primary_key` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_key_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_primary_key_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_components) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_key_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_primary_key_components.
    DATA(lo_descr_ref) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table_data ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr_ref ).

    DATA(lo_primary_key) = lo_table_descr->get_keys( )->get_primary_key( ).
    IF lo_primary_key IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT lo_primary_key->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_key_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_primary_key_comp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_primary_key_comp.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_test_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA: lt_test TYPE ty_test_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_key_comp( ).

CLASS zcl_img_properties IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_dimensions.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).
    TRY.

        DATA(lt_properties) = lo_converter->get_image_properties( ).
        READ TABLE lt_properties WITH KEY name = 'width' INTO DATA(ls_width_prop).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rs_properties-width = ls_width_prop-value.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_properties WITH KEY name = 'height' INTO DATA(ls_height_prop).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rs_properties-height = ls_height_prop-value.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_igs_error INTO DATA(lx_igs_error).
        MESSAGE lx_igs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sql_check_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sql_check_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

        AND connid = @iv_connid.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(

Instructions: Lese einen externen Byte-Stream (XSTRING), der einen UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) enthalten kann, und konvertiere ihn korrekt in einen ABAP-String, wobei der BOM automatisch erkannt und ignoriert wird.
hint: `cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create` mit `detect_bom = abap_true` erkennt und verarbeitet BOMs automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_bom_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_bom_detection
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_bom_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_bom_detection.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding   = 'UTF-8'
      endian     = 'L' " Little Endian, common for UTF-8
      detect_bom = abap_true " Automatically detect and skip BOM
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        input  = iv_input_xstring
      IMPORTING
        data   = rv_result_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bom_detection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bom_detection.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_conv_bom_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Test mit BOM und Umlauten: äöü'.
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = lv_original_string.

    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring_with_bom) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = lv_original_string
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      add_bom     = abap_true " Add BOM
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_string) = lo_handler->convert_with_bom_detection( lv_utf8_xstring_with_bom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_string
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'Conversion with BOM detection failed'
    ).

    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring_no_bom) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = lv_original_string
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      add_bom     = abap_false " No BOM
    ).
    DATA(lv_actual_string_no_bom) = lo_handler->convert_with_bom_detection( lv_utf8_xstring_no_bom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_string_no_bom
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'Conversion without BOM (but with detection) failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Option `detect_bom = abap_true` in der `create`-Methode von `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` ist eine moderne und robuste Art, mit Byte Order Marks (BOMs) in externen UTF-8-Daten umzugehen. Der Konverter erkennt und überspringt den BOM automatisch, was die manuelle Handhabung überflüssig macht und die Fehleranfälligkeit reduziert.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, BOM, UTF-8, Codepage, Konvertierung, XSTRING

Instructions: Versuche, einen ungültigen Byte-Stream in einen String zu konvertieren und fange die dabei auftretende Ausnahme `CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE` ab.
hint: Die Konvertierungsmethoden von `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` werfen Ausnahmen bei Fehlern. Nutze `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_result_string TYPE string.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-8'
        ).
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_invalid_xstring
          IMPORTING
            data   = lv_result_string
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_conversion.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handler( ).

    " Create an invalid UTF-8 byte sequence (e.g., incomplete multi-byte char)
    DATA(lv_invalid_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE 'C3'. " Start of a 2-byte UTF-8 char, but incomplete

    DATA(lv_conversion_successful) = lo_handler->convert_with_error_handling( lv_invalid_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_conversion_successful
      msg = 'Conversion of invalid byte stream should have failed'
    ).

    " Test with a valid string to ensure it works
    DATA(lv_valid_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = 'Valid String'
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    lv_conversion_successful = lo_handler->convert_with_error_handling( lv_valid_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_conversion_successful

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_iso

        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_iso IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        input  = iv_input_string
      IMPORTING
        data   = rv_result_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
