unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_to_iso FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_string_to_iso( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Test mit Umlauten: äöüß'.

    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = lv_original_string
      target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_string_to_iso( lv_original_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_xstring
      exp = lv_expected_xstring
      msg = 'String to ISO-8859-1 conversion failed'
    ).

    " Test with a character not representable in ISO-8859-1 (e.g., emoji)
    DATA(lv_string_with_emoji) = 'Emoji: 😊'.
    TRY.
        lo_converter->convert_string_to_iso( lv_string_with_emoji ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Conversion of unrepresentable char should have raised exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught exception for unrepresentable char' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist das Gegenstück zu `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und ermöglicht die präzise Steuerung der Ausgabe-Kodierung, was für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder die Erstellung von Dateien in bestimmten Formaten unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Verwendung von TRY...CATCH, um eine Division durch Null abzufangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH und fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " Re-raise or handle as needed. For this example, we re-raise.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_div_by_zero( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_div_by_zero( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR caught successfully.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: TRY...CATCH ist der moderne Weg, um Ausnahmen in ABAP zu behandeln. CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR ist eine vordefinierte Systemausnahme für arithmetische Fehler wie Division durch Null.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR, Exception Handling

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl. Wenn diese Zahl einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus und fangen Sie diese ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, eine IF-Bedingung und TRY...CATCH mit einer eigenen Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_random_threshold_exceeded DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA threshold TYPE f READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        i_threshold TYPE f OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_random_threshold_exceeded IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->threshold = i_threshold.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_random_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_random_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value_ok) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_random_threshold_exceeded.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_random_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_random_value.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_float) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_float >= iv_threshold.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_random_threshold_exceeded
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_random_threshold_exceeded=>default_text " Assuming default_text
          i_threshold = iv_threshold.
    ELSE.
      rv_value_ok = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_check_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_random_check( ).
    " This test might fail if random number is >= 0.0, but for demonstration,
    " we assume a threshold that is likely to pass.
    " In a real scenario, you'd mock cl_abap_random_float or run multiple times.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_random_value( iv_threshold = 0.99 ). " High threshold, likely to pass
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true
                                            msg = 'Value should be OK.' ).
      CATCH zcx_random_threshold_exceeded.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_check_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_random_check( ).
    " This test might fail if random number is < 0.01, but for demonstration,

    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_random_value( iv_threshold = 0.01 ). " Low threshold, likely to trigger exception
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_RANDOM_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_random_threshold_exceeded.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception ZCX_RANDOM_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED caught successfully.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode GET_TEXT() der Ausnahme-Instanz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_message_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_message_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        " Simulate an error, e.g., trying to convert a non-numeric string to an integer
        DATA(lv_number) = CONV i( iv_input ).
        rv_message = 'Operation successful.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other exception
        rv_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_operation_error_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS aus und geben Sie diesen zurück. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Lesen Sie SFLIGHTS in eine interne Tabelle, generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex und verwenden Sie eine Tabellenexpression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS
                                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                            connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_itab_line_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = floor( lv_table_size * lo_random->get_next( ) ) + 1. " 1-based index

    rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_sflight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_get_random_sflight_empty FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = abap_false
                                          msg = 'Random sflight should not be initial.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-connid exp = abap_false
                                          msg = 'Random sflight should not be initial.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_random_sflight_empty.
    " To test the empty case, we would need to mock SFLIGHT or ensure it's empty.
    " For simplicity, this test assumes SFLIGHT might be empty and checks the exception.
    " In a real scenario, a test double for DB access would be used.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_random_sflight( ).
    " This test is tricky as SFLIGHT is usually not empty.
    " A proper test would involve a test double for the database access.
    " For now, we'll just call it and expect it not to fail if SFLIGHT has data.
    " If SFLIGHT is empty, it should raise cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'SFLIGHT has data, no exception raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'SFLIGHT is empty, exception caught.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie VALUE für die Inline-Initialisierung der internen Tabelle, FOR für die Schleife über SELECT-Ergebnisse und Tabellenexpressions (lt_sflights[ lv_random_index ]) für den Zugriff auf Elemente. CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT wird verwendet, um einen zufälligen Index zu bestimmen.
keywords: Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, cl_abap_random_float, VALUE, FOR, Table Expression, READ TABLE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des CLEANUP-Blocks in einer TRY...ENDTRY-Struktur, um Ressourcen freizugeben, auch wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt und nicht lokal abgefangen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation_with_cleanup
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lv_resource_status) = 'Resource acquired.'.
    rv_log = lv_resource_status.

    TRY.
        rv_log = rv_log && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Performing operation...'.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_log = rv_log && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Operation completed successfully.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_log = rv_log && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Exception caught in CATCH block.'.
        " Re-raise to trigger CLEANUP and propagate
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CLEANUP.
        rv_log = rv_log && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Resource released in CLEANUP.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_cleanup_no_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_cleanup_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not re-raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource acquired.' act = lv_log ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Performing operation...' act = lv_log ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Exception caught in CATCH block.' act = lv_log ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource released in CLEANUP.' act = lv_log ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource acquired.' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Performing operation...' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Operation completed successfully.' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = 'Resource released in CLEANUP.' act = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer dann ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt und nicht durch einen lokalen CATCH-Block behandelt wird. Er ist ideal, um Ressourcen freizugeben oder Aufräumarbeiten durchzuführen, bevor die Ausnahme weitergegeben wird.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception Handling, Resource Management

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines angegebenen Datumsbereichs.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Daten in Tage seit einem Referenzdatum, generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl für die Tage und konvertieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_random_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_random_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date_in_range.
    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start_days) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = '00000000' iv_date2 = iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_end_days) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = '00000000' iv_date2 = iv_end_date ).

    DATA(lv_range_days) = lv_end_days - lv_start_days + 1.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_offset) = floor( lv_range_days * lo_random->get_next( ) ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = iv_start_date iv_days = lv_random_offset ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_date_range FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_random_date_invalid_range FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_date_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_random_date( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_end) = '20231231'.
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->get_random_date_in_range( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_random_date >= lv_start AND lv_random_date <= lv_end )
                                      msg = 'Random date not in expected range.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_date_invalid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_random_date( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_date_in_range( iv_start_date = '20231231' iv_end_date = '20230101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR was not raised for invalid range.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR caught successfully for invalid range.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung eines zufälligen Datums innerhalb eines Bereichs. Es nutzt CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER für Datumsberechnungen und CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT für die Zufallsauswahl der Tage innerhalb des Bereichs. Die Umwandlung in Tage seit einem Referenzdatum ist eine gängige Technik für Datumsarithmetik.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Behandlung mehrerer verschiedener Ausnahmetypen in einem einzigen TRY...CATCH-Block.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere CATCH-Anweisungen für unterschiedliche Ausnahmeklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_diverse_operations
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation_type TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_diverse_operations.
    TRY.
        CASE iv_operation_type.
          WHEN 1. " Division by zero
            DATA(lv_result_div) = 10 / 0.
            rv_message = 'Division successful (should not happen)'.
          WHEN 2. " Conversion error
            DATA(lv_num_conv) = CONV i( 'NOT_A_NUMBER' ).
            rv_message = 'Conversion successful (should not happen)'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_message = 'No error triggered.'.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        rv_message = 'Arithmetic Error: ' && lx_arith->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        rv_message = 'Conversion Error: ' && lx_conv->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_message = 'Other Error: ' && lx_other->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_multi_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_diverse_operations( 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'No error triggered.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_arithmetic_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_multi_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_diverse_operations( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Arithmetic Error:' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'division by zero' act = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_multi_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_diverse_operations( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Conversion Error:' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'cannot be converted' act = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein TRY...CATCH-Block kann mehrere CATCH-Anweisungen enthalten, um verschiedene Ausnahmetypen spezifisch zu behandeln. Die Reihenfolge der CATCH-Blöcke ist wichtig, da die erste passende Ausnahme abgefangen wird. CX_ROOT fängt alle anderen Ausnahmen ab, die nicht spezifisch behandelt wurden.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Multiple Exceptions, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR, CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR, CX_ROOT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Zufallszahlen, die in einem bestimmten Bereich liegen, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach einem Schwellenwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, FOR-Schleife mit VALUE, REDUCE und GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_random_avg_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_random_value,
             value TYPE f,
           END OF ty_random_value.
    TYPES tt_random_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_random_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_avg,
             threshold_group TYPE string,
             average_value   TYPE f,
             count           TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_avg.
    TYPES tt_grouped_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_values TYPE i
        iv_threshold  TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_avg) TYPE tt_grouped_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_random_avg_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_average.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    DATA(lt_random_values) = VALUE tt_random_value(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_values
      ( value = lo_random->get_next( ) )
    ).

    rt_grouped_avg = VALUE tt_grouped_avg(
      FOR GROUPS OF value_entry IN lt_random_values
        GROUP BY COND string(
          WHEN value_entry-value < iv_threshold THEN 'Below Threshold'
          ELSE 'Above or Equal Threshold'
        ) INTO group_key
      ( threshold_group = group_key
        average_value = REDUCE f( INIT avg = 0.0 FOR member IN GROUP group_key NEXT avg = avg + member-value ) / lines( GROUP group_key )
        count = lines( GROUP group_key ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_grouped_average_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_random_avg_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_average( iv_num_values = 100 iv_threshold = 0.5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Should have two groups: below and above threshold.' ).

    DATA(ls_below) = VALUE zcl_math_random_avg_group=>ty_grouped_avg( lt_result[ threshold_group = 'Below Threshold' ] ).
    DATA(ls_above) = VALUE zcl_math_random_avg_group=>ty_grouped_avg( lt_result[ threshold_group = 'Above or Equal Threshold' ] ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_below-count > 0 AND ls_above-count > 0 )
                                      msg = 'Both groups should have members.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_below-average_value < 0.5 )
                                      msg = 'Average of below group should be less than threshold.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_above-average_value >= 0.5 )
                                      msg = 'Average of above group should be greater or equal to threshold.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_grouped_average_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_random_avg_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_average( iv_num_values = 0 iv_threshold = 0.5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result
                                        msg = 'Result should be empty for 0 values.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt fortgeschrittene ABAP 7.55 Features wie FOR-Schleifen mit VALUE für die Generierung von Zufallszahlen und die GROUP BY-Klausel in Tabellenexpressions, um die Zahlen nach einem Schwellenwert zu gruppieren. REDUCE wird verwendet, um den Durchschnitt innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu berechnen. Dies demonstriert eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: cl_abap_random_float, FOR, VALUE, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Average, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation dynamisch aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab, um den Fehler zu protokollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie dynamischen Methodenaufruf (CALL METHOD) und TRY...CATCH.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lx_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name).
        rv_log = 'Dynamic method executed successfully.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_log = 'Error creating object: ' && lx_exception->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_log = 'Error calling method dynamically: ' && lx_exception->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_exception.
        rv_log = 'General error during dynamic call: ' && lx_exception->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class to demonstrate dynamic call and potential error
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS successful_method.
    METHODS failing_method RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD successful_method.
    " Do nothing or log success
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD failing_method.
    DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
    DATA(lv_error) = 1 / lv_zero. " This will raise CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_fail_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_fail_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET' iv_method_name = 'SUCCESSFUL_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_log exp = 'Dynamic method executed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_fail_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET' iv_method_name = 'FAILING_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error calling method dynamically:' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'division by zero' act = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_fail_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error creating object:' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'class NON_EXISTENT_CLASS does not exist' act = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung, wie der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit CALL METHOD, ist mächtig, birgt aber auch Risiken. TRY...CATCH ist hier unerlässlich, um Laufzeitfehler wie nicht existierende Klassen oder Methoden oder Ausnahmen innerhalb der dynamisch aufgerufenen Logik abzufangen und robust zu behandeln.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR, CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von Zufallszahlen und filtern Sie diese, um nur Zahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs zu behalten. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT und die FILTER-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_random_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_random_value,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE f,
           END OF ty_random_value.
    TYPES tt_random_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_random_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_filter_randoms
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_values TYPE i
        iv_min_filter TYPE f
        iv_max_filter TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_values) TYPE tt_random_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_random_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_filter_randoms.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    DATA(lt_all_random_values) = VALUE tt_random_value(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_values
      ( id = i, value = lo_random->get_next( ) )
    ).

    rt_filtered_values = FILTER #( lt_all_random_values USING KEY primary_key
                                   WHERE value >= iv_min_filter AND value <= iv_max_filter ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen String in ein Datum zu konvertieren. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, wenn die Konvertierung fehlschlägt, und geben Sie eine informative Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CONV d(...) und fangen Sie CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_DATE ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_date_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_no_date.

    METHODS convert_string_to_date_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_date_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_date.
    rv_date = CONV d( iv_date_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_string_to_date_safe.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_date) = CONV d( iv_date_string ).
        rs_result = |Successfully converted: { lv_date DATE = USER }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_date INTO DATA(lx_date_error).
        rs_result = |Error: { lx_date_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        rs_result = |General Conversion Error: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_date_conversion_safe_success.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Zufallszahlen und finden Sie den Median dieser Zahlen. Behandeln Sie den Fall einer leeren Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, VALUE mit FOR, SORT und Tabellenexpressions. Fangen Sie CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_random_median DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             val TYPE f,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_median
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_values TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_median) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_random_median IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_median.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE tt_value(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_values
      ( val = lo_random->get_next( ) * 100 ) " Scale random float to 0-100 for better median examples
    ).

    IF lt_values IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_itab_line_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    SORT lt_values BY val.

    DATA(lv_size) = lines( lt_values ).
    DATA(lv_mid_index) = lv_size DIV 2.

    IF lv_size MOD 2 = 1. " Odd number of elements
      rv_median = lt_values[ lv_mid_index + 1 ]-val.
    ELSE. " Even number of elements
      rv_median = ( lt_values[ lv_mid_index ]-val + lt_values[ lv_mid_index + 1 ]-val ) / 2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_median_odd_count FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_median_even_count FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_median_empty_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_median_odd_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_random_median( ).
    " This test is tricky due to randomness. We'll test the logic with a fixed list.
    DATA(lt_test_values) = VALUE zcl_math_random_median=>tt_value(
      ( val = 10 ) ( val = 50 ) ( val = 20 ) ( val = 40 ) ( val = 30 )
    ).
    SORT lt_test_values BY val.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( lt_test_values ).
    DATA(lv_mid_index) = lv_size DIV 2.
    DATA(lv_expected_median) = lt_test_values[ lv_mid_index + 1 ]-val.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_median exp = 30.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_median_even_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_random_median( ).
    DATA(lt_test_values) = VALUE zcl_math_random_median=>tt_value(
      ( val = 10 ) ( val = 50 ) ( val = 20 ) ( val = 40 ) ( val = 30 ) ( val = 60 )
    ).
    SORT lt_test_values BY val.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( lt_test_values ).
    DATA(lv_mid_index) = lv_size DIV 2.
    DATA(lv_expected_median) = ( lt_test_values[ lv_mid_index ]-val + lt_test_values[ lv_mid_index + 1 ]-val ) / 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_median exp = 35.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_median_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_random_median( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_median( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND was not raised for empty table.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND caught successfully for empty table.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung des Medians einer Liste von Zufallszahlen. Es verwendet CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT zur Generierung, VALUE mit FOR zur Füllung der internen Tabelle, SORT zur Sortierung und Tabellenexpressions für den Zugriff auf Elemente. Die Ausnahme CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND wird abgefangen, um den Fall einer leeren Tabelle robust zu behandeln.
keywords: cl_abap_random_float, Median, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, SORT, Table Expression, CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die entweder von 'FRA' oder 'MUC' abfliegen und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `COND` und `CASE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `COND` und `CASE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND
                                   ( COND #( WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'FRA' THEN abap_true
                                             WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'MUC' THEN abap_true
                                             ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true ) )
                           ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft muss LH sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-cityfrom = 'FRA' OR ls_flight-cityfrom = 'MUC' ) msg = 'Abflugort muss FRA oder MUC sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `FOR` mit `WHERE` für die Tabelleniteration und -filterung. Innerhalb der `WHERE`-Klausel wird eine `COND` Expression mit `CASE` verwendet, um komplexe logische Bedingungen für den Abflugort zu formulieren. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, COND, CASE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Objekttypen (z.B. `cl_abap_char_utilities`, `cl_abap_unit_assert`) entgegennimmt und basierend auf dem Typ eine spezifische Aktion ausführt. Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_object_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_object_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_object.
    CASE TYPE OF io_object.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_char_utilities.
        rv_message = 'Objekt ist vom Typ CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES'.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_unit_assert.
        rv_message = 'Objekt ist vom Typ CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Objekttyp'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP SQL Abfrage auf die Tabelle `sflights`, die für jeden Flug eine 'Service-Kategorie' basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft ('LH', 'UA', 'AA') und der Flugnummer (`connid`) bestimmt. Nutzen Sie eine `CASE` Expression direkt im `SELECT` Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END` direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_service_cat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_service,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             service_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_service.
    TYPES tt_flight_service TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_service WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_service_categories
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_services) TYPE tt_flight_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_service_cat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_service_categories.
    SELECT carrid, connid,
           CASE
             WHEN carrid = 'LH' AND connid BETWEEN '0001' AND '0100' THEN 'Premium Langstrecke'
             WHEN carrid = 'LH' THEN 'Standard Langstrecke'
             WHEN carrid = 'UA' THEN 'USA Inland'
             WHEN carrid = 'AA' THEN 'USA Inland'
             ELSE 'Andere'
           END AS service_category
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_services
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_service_categories FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_service_categories.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_service_cat( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_service_categories( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_service).
      IF ls_flight_service-carrid = 'LH' AND ls_flight_service-connid BETWEEN '0001' AND '0100'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_service-service_category exp = 'Premium Langstrecke' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight_service-carrid = 'LH'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_service-service_category exp = 'Standard Langstrecke' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight_service-carrid = 'UA' OR ls_flight_service-carrid = 'AA'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_service-service_category exp = 'USA Inland' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_service-service_category exp = 'Andere' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE` Expression in ABAP SQL ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste auszuführen, um abgeleitete Spalten zu erstellen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing in ABAP und verbessert die Performance, da die Logik direkt auf der Datenbankebene ausgeführt wird.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen Text, die von Klammern umschlossen sind (z.B. '(123)', '(45)'). Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die `FIND_ALL` Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `FIND_ALL` und einer passenden Regex-Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_bracketed_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_bracketed_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '\((\d+)\)'. " Muster für Zahlen in Klammern, Gruppe 1 fängt die Zahl
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_group( 1 ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks in eine Tabelle von Strings auf. Der reguläre Ausdruck soll alle Leerzeichen und Kommas als Trennzeichen behandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS` und einer Schleife, um die Matches zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '[^\s,]+'. " Muster: Eine oder mehrere Nicht-Leerzeichen oder Kommas
    DATA lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_pattern
      IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_parts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach ihrer Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer `CASE` Expression für die Gruppierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `CASE` Expression im `GROUP BY` Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             group_key TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( group_key = CASE ls_flight-carrid
                                   WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                   WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                   WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
                                   ELSE 'Andere Fluggesellschaften'
                                 END
                    )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( group_key = ls_group_key-group_key
                      flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_ua_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_other_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
      CASE ls_grouped_flight-group_key.
        WHEN 'Lufthansa'.
          lv_lh_count = ls_grouped_flight-flight_count.
        WHEN 'American Airlines'.
          lv_aa_count = ls_grouped_flight-flight_count.
        WHEN 'United Airlines'.
          lv_ua_count = ls_grouped_flight-flight_count.
        WHEN 'Andere Fluggesellschaften'.
          lv_other_count = ls_grouped_flight-flight_count.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lh_count > 0 OR lv_aa_count > 0 OR lv_ua_count > 0 OR lv_other_count > 0 ) msg = 'Mindestens eine Gruppe sollte Flüge enthalten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Durch die Verwendung einer `CASE` Expression direkt im `GROUP BY` Schlüssel kann man dynamisch Gruppierungskriterien definieren, was eine flexible und moderne Datenverarbeitung ermöglicht.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, CASE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges Datum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' enthält und extrahieren Sie Jahr, Monat und Tag als separate Werte. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit benannten Gruppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `create_instance` und einem Muster mit benannten Gruppen (`(?<name>...)`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_parts,
             year  TYPE string,
             month TYPE string,
             day   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_date_parts.

    METHODS extract_date_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_parts) TYPE ty_date_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_parts.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '(?<YEAR>\d{4})-(?<MONTH>\d{2})-(?<DAY>\d{2})'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_date_parts-year = lo_matcher->get_group( 'YEAR' ).
      rs_date_parts-month = lo_matcher->get_group( 'MONTH' ).
      rs_date_parts-day = lo_matcher->get_group( 'DAY' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Preis eines Artikels inklusive Mehrwertsteuer. Der Mehrwertsteuersatz soll basierend auf einer Länderkennung ('DE', 'AT', 'CH') mit einer `CASE` Expression bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE` Expression, um den Mehrwertsteuersatz zu ermitteln und dann den Endpreis zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tax_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price_with_tax
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_country_code TYPE c LENGTH 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tax_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_with_tax.
    DATA(lv_tax_rate) = CASE iv_country_code

Instructions: Validieren Sie einen String, der eine IP-Adresse (IPv4) darstellen soll. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex`.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein komplexes Regex-Muster für IPv4-Adressen und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex=>match`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ipv4_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_ipv4
      IMPORTING
        iv_ip_address TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ipv4_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_ipv4.
    " Regex für IPv4-Adresse: (0-255).(0-255).(0-255).(0-255)
    " Ein Oktett: (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)
    DATA(lv_octet_pattern) = '(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)'.
    DATA(lv_ipv4_pattern) = '^' && lv_octet_pattern && '\.' && lv_octet_pattern && '\.' && lv_octet_pattern && '\.' && lv_octet_pattern && '$'.

    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_instance( pattern = lv_ipv4_pattern ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_regex->match( text = iv_ip_address ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ipv4_validator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '0.0.0.0' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '10.0.0.1' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4_range.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.256' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '1.2.3' ) ).

Durch die Zerlegung des Musters in wiederverwendbare Teile (hier `lv_octet_pattern`) wird das Regex lesbarer und einfacher zu warten. `cl_abap_regex=>match` stellt sicher, dass der gesamte String dem Muster entspricht.
keywords: REGEX, String Processing, Validation, IPv4, cl_abap_regex

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (z.B. 'Offen', 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen'). Nutzen Sie eine `CASE` Expression mit komplexen `WHEN` Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` Bedingungen, die logische Operatoren (`AND`, `OR`) enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status_determiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_data,
             status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             is_paid     TYPE abap_bool,
             delivery_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_order_data.

    METHODS get_order_status_text
      IMPORTING
        is_order_data TYPE ty_order_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_determiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status_text.
    rv_status_text = CASE abap_true " CASE mit abap_true für komplexe Bedingungen
                       WHEN is_order_data-status_code = 'O' AND is_order_data-is_paid = abap_false THEN 'Offen & Unbezahlt'
                       WHEN is_order_data-status_code = 'P' AND is_order_data-is_paid = abap_true THEN 'In Bearbeitung & Bezahlt'
                       WHEN is_order_data-status_code = 'C' THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                       WHEN is_order_data-delivery_date IS NOT INITIAL AND is_order_data-delivery_date < sy-datum THEN 'Überfällig'
                       ELSE 'Unbekannter Status'
                     END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem Text nach allen Wörtern, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen und mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sind. Geben Sie diese Wörter in einer Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und einem Muster für Wörter mit Großbuchstaben am Anfang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_capitalized_word_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_capitalized_word_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_capitalized_words.
    " Muster: Wortgrenze, Großbuchstabe, dann mindestens zwei weitere Wortzeichen
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b'.
    DATA lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_pattern
      IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_words.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: REGEX, String Processing, Find All, Capitalized Words, cl_abap_regex

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen von 'FRA' nach 'JFK' mit einer Fluggesellschaft 'LH'.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Tabelleniteration mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND cityto = iv_cityto AND carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'SFO' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'MUC' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights(
      iv_cityfrom = 'FRA'
      iv_cityto   = 'JFK'
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      it_sflights = lt_test_data
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` Syntax ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Filterung von internen Tabellen, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` Konstrukte. Das `VALUE #(...)` Konstrukt erstellt die Zieltabelle direkt.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der freien Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_free_seats.
    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT total = total + ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight_seats(
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 80  seatsmax = 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_free_seats(
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      it_sflights = lt_test_data
    ).

    " LH: (200-100) + (180-120) + (100-80) = 100 + 60 + 20 = 180
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 180 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_total_free_seats(
      iv_carrid   = 'UA'
      it_sflights = lt_test_data
    ).
    " UA: (150-50) = 100
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger Ausdruck, um Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` kann man sehr effizient über gefilterte Daten iterieren und eine Summe, einen Zähler oder einen anderen aggregierten Wert berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und einen Status ('Full', 'Almost Full', 'Available') basierend auf der Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) enthält. 'Full' > 90%, 'Almost Full' > 70%, sonst 'Available'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einem `COND` Ausdruck für die Statuszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_sflight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      LET occupancy_percent = COND decfloat34( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) IN
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        status = COND string(
                   WHEN occupancy_percent > 90 THEN 'Full'
                   WHEN occupancy_percent > 70 THEN 'Almost Full'
                   ELSE 'Available'

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitze.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ...` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_group_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_group_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_group_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( carrid       = group_key
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_seats  = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT s = s + member-seatsmax )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `FOR GROUPS ... OF ...` ist ein sehr leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und gleichzeitig Aggregationen durchzuführen. Es ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Konstrukte und macht den Code viel deklarativer und lesbarer. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe, und `REDUCE` kann für weitere Aggregationen innerhalb der Gruppe verwendet werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Tabellentypnamen und fügen Sie einen Datensatz hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
        iv_field1_value    TYPE string
        iv_field2_value    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lo_line TYPE REF TO data.

    " Get description of the table type
    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    " Create dynamic table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    CREATE DATA lo_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    " Assign values to the dynamic line
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <fs_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_field1_value.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_field2_value.
    ENDIF.

    " Append line to dynamic table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT` Abfrage auf der Tabelle `sflights` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Validieren Sie die `WHERE`-Klausel vor der Ausführung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_where_clause` zur Validierung und `SELECT ... WHERE (dynamic_where_clause)`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    " Validate the WHERE clause
    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_where_clause(
      EXPORTING
        iv_where_clause = iv_where_clause
        iv_table_name   = 'SFLIGHTS'
    ).

    " Execute dynamic SELECT
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_result
      WHERE (iv_where_clause).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen zurück.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_rtti_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_example_struct,
             comp1 TYPE string,
             comp2 TYPE i,
             comp3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_example_struct.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_any_struct TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_rtti_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_any_struct ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( 
      FOR component IN lt_components
      ( name = component-name,
        type = component-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dynamisch ermittelten Spaltennamen in eine CSV-formatierte Zeichenkette.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI, um Spaltennamen zu erhalten, und `FOR ... IN ...` mit String Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_small,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_small.
    TYPES tt_sflight_small TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_small WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_csv.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA lv_header_line  TYPE string.
    DATA lv_data_line    TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_dynamic_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get component names for header
    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    lv_header_line = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR component IN lt_components
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN component-name ELSE s && ',' && component-name )
    ).
    rv_csv_string = lv_header_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Build data lines
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      lv_data_line = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR component IN lt_components
        LET comp_name = component-name IN
        NEXT s = COND string(
                   WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                     cl_abap_dyn_prg=>get_value( is_data = <fs_line> iv_comp_name = comp_name )
                   ELSE
                     s && ',' && cl_abap_dyn_prg=>get_value( is_data = <fs_line> iv_comp_name = comp_name )
                 )
      ).
      rv_csv_string = rv_csv_string && lv_data_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Anzahl von Spalten und deren Typen, die zur Laufzeit definiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_def.
    TYPES tt_column_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_column_definitions TYPE tt_column_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_build_error,
        cx_sy_table_build_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_dynamic_table.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Build component table for the dynamic structure
    LOOP AT it_column_definitions INTO DATA(ls_col_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_col_def-name.
      ls_component-type_descr_ref ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_col_def-type ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic structure type
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Create dynamic table type
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic table data object
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_build_dynamic_table_fail FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_struct_build_error cx_sy_table_build_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_col_defs) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_builder=>tt_column_def(
      ( name = 'ID'   type = 'I' )
      ( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' )
      ( name = 'DATE' type = 'D' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_table( it_column_definitions = lt_col_defs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_dynamic_table ).

    " Verify the structure of the created table
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lo_dynamic_table->* ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( ) exp = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_build_dynamic_table_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_invalid_col_defs) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_builder=>tt_column_def(
      ( name = 'ID'   type = 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->build_dynamic_table( it_column_definitions = lt_invalid_col_defs ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_build_error cx_sy_table_build_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung vollständig dynamischer interner Tabellen, deren Struktur (Anzahl und Typen der Spalten) zur Laufzeit definiert wird. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes RTTI-Szenario, das für generische Datencontainer, Konfigurations-gesteuerte Anwendungen oder die Integration mit externen Systemen, deren Datenstrukturen variieren können, unerlässlich ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die für jeden Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` eine formatierte Zeichenkette zurückgibt, die die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthält. Jede Zeichenkette soll in einer neuen Zeile stehen.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates und eine `FOR`-Schleife über `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_flight_details DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_details) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_flight_details IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    rv_details = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Flug: { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } am { flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
        ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }Flug: { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } am { flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine kommaseparierte Liste aller eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften zurückgibt, die am heutigen Datum Flüge anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `DISTINCT` für die Fluggesellschaften, kombiniert mit String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_carriers_today
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carriers) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers_today.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lv_today TYPE sy-datum.

    lv_today = sy-datum. " Get current date

    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE fldate = @lv_today.

    " Use REDUCE with FOR to get distinct carriers and concatenate them
    rv_carriers = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrid_entry IN ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM @lt_sflights AS carriers )
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrid_entry-carrid
        ELSE |{ s }, { carrid_entry-carrid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_distinct_carriers.
    " Insert dummy data for sflights for predictable test results
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = sy-datum ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' fldate = sy-datum ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = sy-datum ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20251122' ) 
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_distinct_carriers( ).
    DATA(lv_carriers) = lo_cut->get_distinct_carriers_today( ).

    " The order of distinct carriers might vary, so check for both possibilities or sort.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_carriers = 'LH, UA' OR lv_carriers = 'UA, LH' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression mit einer `SELECT DISTINCT` Unterabfrage auf einer internen Tabelle, um eindeutige Werte zu filtern. Die `REDUCE`-Expression verknüpft diese Werte effizient zu einer kommaseparierten Zeichenkette, was eine moderne Alternative zu traditionellen Schleifen und `CONCATENATE`-Anweisungen darstellt.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, CONCATENATE, String Templates, Internal Tables, DISTINCT, REDUCE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Zeichenkette zurückgibt, die alle ihre Flugnummern (connid) enthält, getrennt durch einen Bindestrich. Die Ausgabe soll pro Fluggesellschaft in einer neuen Zeile stehen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und verschachtelte `REDUCE`-Expressions mit String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_carrier_connections DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_carrier_connections IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connections.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_output = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL
        THEN |{ flight-carrid }: { REDUCE string(
                                        INIT conn_list = ``
                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                        NEXT conn_list = COND string(

solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_distinct_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_cities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cities_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_distinct_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_cities.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lt_distinct_cities TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights-cityfrom WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT cityfrom FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Get distinct cities and sort them
    lt_distinct_cities = VALUE #( FOR city IN lt_sflights ( city-cityfrom ) ).
    SORT lt_distinct_cities ASCENDING.

    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR city IN lt_distinct_cities
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN city
        ELSE |{ s }; { city }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
