CLASS zcl_itb_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_nested_flight_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_output = REDUCE string(
      INIT all_carriers_str = ``
      FOR GROUPS OF flight_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight_group-carrid )
      NEXT all_carriers_str = COND string(
        WHEN all_carriers_str IS INITIAL
        THEN |{ flight_group-carrid }: { REDUCE string(
                                            INIT flights_str = ``
                                            FOR member IN GROUP flight_group
                                            NEXT flights_str = COND string(
                                              WHEN flights_str IS INITIAL THEN |{ member-connid } ({ member-fldate DATE = USER })|
                                              ELSE |{ flights_str }, { member-connid } ({ member-fldate DATE = USER })|
                                            )
                                          ) }|
        ELSE |{ all_carriers_str }; { flight_group-carrid }: { REDUCE string(
                                                                  INIT flights_str = ``
                                                                  FOR member IN GROUP flight_group
                                                                  NEXT flights_str = COND string(
                                                                    WHEN flights_str IS INITIAL THEN |{ member-connid } ({ member-fldate DATE = USER })|
                                                                    ELSE |{ flights_str }, { member-connid } ({ member-fldate DATE = USER })|
                                                                  )
                                                                ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (carrid) zurückgibt, die aus der Tabelle `sflights` gelesen werden. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Tabelle zu füllen.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_fill IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( flight-carrid ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Wörtern (als interne Tabelle von Strings) entgegennimmt und diese zu einem Satz verkettet. Jedes Wort soll durch ein Leerzeichen getrennt sein, und der Satz soll mit einem Punkt enden. Leere Wörter sollen ignoriert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Expression und String Templates. Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `FILTER` um leere Wörter zu ignorieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_sentence_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_sentence
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_sentence_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sentence.
    DATA(lt_non_empty_words) = VALUE string_table( FOR word IN it_words WHERE ( word IS NOT INITIAL ) ( word ) ).

    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN lt_non_empty_words
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word
        ELSE |{ s } { word }|
      )
    ).

    IF rv_sentence IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_sentence = |{ rv_sentence }.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_sentence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_sentence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_sentence_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_words1) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Das' ) ( 'ist' ) ( '' ) ( 'ein' ) ( 'Test' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sentence1) = lo_cut->build_sentence( lt_words1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence1 exp = 'Das ist ein Test.' ).

    DATA(lt_words2) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hallo' ) ( 'Welt' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sentence2) = lo_cut->build_sentence( lt_words2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence2 exp = 'Hallo Welt.' ).

    DATA(lt_words3) = VALUE string_table( ( '' ) ( '' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sentence3) = lo_cut->build_sentence( lt_words3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_sentence3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `VALUE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Expression und einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um leere Strings zu filtern. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` mit String Templates verwendet, um die verbleibenden Wörter effizient zu einem Satz zu verketten. Dies zeigt eine moderne, funktionale Herangehensweise an die String-Manipulation und Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: CONCATENATE, FOR, REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, FILTER, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (carrid) und deren Gesamtanzahl an Flügen (connid) zurückgibt. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen sein, die `carrid` und `flight_count` enthält. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `COUNT` und den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid       TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_flight_counts.
    " Insert dummy data for sflights
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' ) 
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_count) = lt_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF`-Expression in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe, was die Berechnung von Zählungen vereinfacht.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, COUNT

Instructions: Exportieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. sflights) in eine XLSX-Datei und laden Sie diese herunter.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_ehfnd_xlsx und die Methode create_document_from_itab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_export_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.xlsx'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_export_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
        lo_xlsx->create_document_from_itab(
          EXPORTING
            i_data_table = lt_sflights
            i_sheet_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        ).
        lo_xlsx->download_document(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_filename
        ).

      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_export_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_export_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_export_basic( ).
    " We cannot assert the actual download in a unit test.
    " We can only check if the method executes without raising an exception.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->export_sflights_to_xlsx( 'test_sflights.xlsx' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during XLSX export' ).
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert den grundlegenden Export einer internen Tabelle in eine XLSX-Datei mit der Klasse `cl_ehfnd_xlsx`. Die Methode `create_document_from_itab` erstellt das Dokument aus den Daten, und `download_document` stößt den Download im Frontend an.       IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_xlsx_export_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,

            i_data_table = lt_sflights

        " Add second sheet

          EXPORTING
            i_data_table = lt_scarr
            i_sheet_name = 'SCARR'
        ).

        lo_xlsx->download_document(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_filename
        ).

      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

CLASS zcl_xlsx_export_formatted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

          EXPORTING
            i_data_table  = lt_sflights
            i_sheet_name  = 'Formatted SFLIGHTS'
            i_field_catalog = lt_field_catalog
        ).
        lo_xlsx->download_document(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_filename
        ).

      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

CLASS zcl_filter_struct_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_custom_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE s_from_cit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_info) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_struct_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_custom_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_flight_info) = VALUE ty_t_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom )
    ).

    rt_filtered_info = FILTER #( lt_flight_info WHERE cityfrom = iv_origin ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA` und `ZCL_FLIGHT_PROCESSOR`. Die Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_PROCESSOR` soll auf eine private Methode von `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA` zugreifen können, um Flugdaten zu validieren. Nutzen Sie hierfür das `FRIENDS`-Konzept.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration in der Definition der Klasse, die den Zugriff gewährt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS validate_flight_data IMPORTING is_flight TYPE ty_flight RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    FRIENDS zcl_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_flight_data.
    " Beispielvalidierung: Preis muss positiv sein
    IF is_flight-price > 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_filter_flights IMPORTING io_flight_data TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_data
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_valid_flights) TYPE zcl_flight_data=>tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_filter_flights.
    LOOP AT io_flight_data->mt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF io_flight_data->validate_flight_data( ls_flight ) = abap_true.
        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_valid_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_data=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = -50 ) " Invalid price
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_flight_data) = NEW zcl_flight_data( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lo_flight_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).

    DATA(lt_valid_flights) = lo_flight_processor->process_and_filter_flights( lo_flight_data ).

      msg = 'Es sollten 2 gültige Flüge gefunden werden.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_valid_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc
      msg = 'Der ungültige Flug sollte nicht in der Liste sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Das `FRIENDS`-Konzept ermöglicht es einer Klasse, explizit anderen Klassen Zugriff auf ihre privaten und geschützten Komponenten zu gewähren. Dies fördert die Kapselung, da der Zugriff kontrolliert und nicht über öffentliche Schnittstellen erfolgen muss, was die interne Implementierung flexibler hält.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer internen Tabelle, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_totals) TYPE tt_carrid_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    rt_totals = REDUCE tt_carrid_total(
      INIT lt_result = VALUE tt_carrid_total( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      " (Optional: ASCENDING/DESCENDING)
      " (Optional: WITHOUT MEMBERS)
      " (Optional: REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref))
      " (Optional: INDEX INTO DATA(group_idx))
      " (Optional: WHERE condition)
      LET lv_sum_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                             INIT lv_current_sum = 0
                             FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                             NEXT lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + <fs_member>-price )
      IN
      NEXT lt_result = VALUE #( BASE lt_result
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = lv_sum_price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_group.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_group_flights=>tt_flight_price(
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' price = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = 300 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_total-total_price exp = 250
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte 250 sein.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_total-total_price exp = 550
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AA sollte 550 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator mit `FOR GROUPS` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu aggregieren und zu transformieren. Er ermöglicht komplexe Gruppierungen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung, was den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht, im Vergleich zu verschachtelten `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Funktionale Programmierung, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und diese mit einer klassenbasierten Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`) abfängt und behandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die vordefinierte Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        " Fehlerbehandlung für Division durch Null
        MESSAGE lx_zerodivide TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. " Nur zu Demozwecken, in realem Code besser loggen oder Standardwert zurückgeben
        rv_result = 0. " Standardwert bei Fehler
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " Allgemeine Fehlerbehandlung für arithmetische Fehler
        MESSAGE lx_arith_error TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_safe_divide_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_safe_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0
      msg = 'Division sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0.0
      msg = 'Division durch Null sollte 0.0 zurückgeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen (`TRY...CATCH`) sind der moderne und empfohlene Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie bieten eine strukturierte und objektorientierte Methode, um Fehler abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, im Gegensatz zu den veralteten `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfungen oder `MESSAGE`-Anweisungen, die den Programmfluss abrupt beenden können.
keywords: Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Fehlerbehandlung, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_line_exists_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Zeitdiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT zeigt.

CLASS zcl_tch_flights_per_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

Instructions: Visualisieren Sie den Gesamtumsatz pro Jahr aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in einem Zeitdiagramm.

CLASS zcl_tch_revenue_per_year DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_revenue_data,
             year   TYPE n LENGTH 4,
             revenue TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_revenue_data.
    TYPES tt_revenue_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_revenue_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_revenue_per_year
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_revenue_data.

    METHODS display_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tch_revenue_per_year IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_revenue_per_year.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS LEFT( fldate, 4 ) AS year,
                  SUM( price ) AS revenue
           GROUP BY LEFT( fldate, 4 )
           ORDER BY LEFT( fldate, 4 )
           INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_revenue_data) = get_revenue_per_year( ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Gesamtumsatz pro Jahr' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Jahr' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Umsatz' ).

    LOOP AT lt_revenue_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_revenue>).
      " CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE expects a date, so we convert the year to a date (e.g., Jan 1st of that year)
      DATA(lv_date) = <fs_revenue>-year && '0101'.
      lo_chart->add_data_point(
        iv_date  = lv_date
        iv_value = <fs_revenue>-revenue
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tch_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_series,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_series.
    TYPES tt_flight_series TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_series WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_series.

    METHODS display_chart.

CLASS zcl_tch_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS fldate,
                  COUNT( * ) AS count
           WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
           GROUP BY fldate
           ORDER BY fldate
           INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_flights_lh) = get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lt_flights_aa) = get_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Monat nach Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    " Add series for LH
    DATA(lo_series_lh) = lo_chart->add_series( 'Lufthansa' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_lh ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_lh>).
      lo_series_lh->add_data_point(
        iv_date  = <fs_lh>-fldate
        iv_value = <fs_lh>-count
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add series for AA
    DATA(lo_series_aa) = lo_chart->add_series( 'American Airlines' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_aa ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_aa>).
      lo_series_aa->add_data_point(
        iv_date  = <fs_aa>-fldate
        iv_value = <fs_aa>-count
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Stellen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugdauer (angenommen als Differenz zwischen ARRTTIME und DEPTTIME in Minuten) pro Monat in einem Zeitdiagramm dar.
hint: Berechnen Sie die Dauer in Minuten und aggregieren Sie den Durchschnitt pro Monat. Beachten Sie, dass SFLIGHT keine direkte Dauer hat, daher muss eine Annahme getroffen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tch_avg_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_duration_data,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             avg_duration TYPE f, " Average duration in minutes
           END OF ty_duration_data.
    TYPES tt_duration_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_duration_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_duration_per_month
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_duration_data.

    METHODS display_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tch_avg_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_duration_per_month.
    " For simplicity, assuming ARRTTIME and DEPTTIME are in the same day
    " and converting to minutes for duration calculation.
    " In a real scenario, date changes would need more complex handling.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS fldate,
                  AVG( ( ( arrttime DIV 10000 * 60 ) + ( arrttime MOD 10000 DIV 100 ) )
                     - ( ( depttime DIV 10000 * 60 ) + ( depttime MOD 10000 DIV 100 ) ) ) AS avg_duration
           GROUP BY fldate
           ORDER BY fldate
           INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_duration_data) = get_avg_duration_per_month( ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugdauer pro Monat' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Durchschnittliche Dauer (Minuten)' ).

    LOOP AT lt_duration_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_duration>).
      lo_chart->add_data_point(
        iv_date  = <fs_duration>-fldate
        iv_value = <fs_duration>-avg_duration
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_lll_cond_formatting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_colored,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             color    TYPE lvc_t_scol,
           END OF ty_flight_colored.
    TYPES tt_flight_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_colored_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_colored.

    METHODS display_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lll_cond_formatting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_colored_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, price
           UP TO 10 ROWS
           INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
                         ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                           connid = <fs_flight>-connid
                           fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate
                           price  = <fs_flight>-price
                           color  = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > 500
                                            THEN VALUE lvc_t_scol( ( fname = 'PRICE' color = '3' ) ) " Color 3 is yellow
                                            ELSE VALUE lvc_t_scol( ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_list.
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = get_colored_flight_data( ).

    DATA(lo_list) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).

    lo_list->set_title( 'Flüge mit Konditionaler Formatierung' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'CARRID' iv_text = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'CONNID' iv_text = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'FLDATE' iv_text = 'Flugdatum' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'PRICE'  iv_text = 'Preis' ).
    lo_list->set_column_color_field( 'COLOR' ).

    lo_list->display( it_data = lt_flight_data ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Liste der Flugdaten, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugnummer.
hint: CL_ABAP_LIST_LAYOUT unterstützt keine direkte hierarchische Anzeige. Simulieren Sie dies durch Einrückung oder verwenden Sie eine andere ALV-Klasse, falls eine echte Hierarchie benötigt wird. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine einfache Gruppierung mit CL_ABAP_LIST_LAYOUT demonstriert.

CLASS zcl_lll_hierarchical_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_grouped,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             group_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_grouped.
    TYPES tt_flight_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_grouped.

    METHODS display_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lll_hierarchical_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, price
           UP TO 20 ROWS
           ORDER BY carrid, connid
           INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_grouped( group_text = |Fluggesellschaft: { <fs_flight>-carrid }| ) TO rt_data.
        lv_prev_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid.
        lv_prev_connid = ''. " Reset connid for new carrier
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_flight>-connid <> lv_prev_connid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_grouped( group_text = |  Flugnummer: { <fs_flight>-connid }| ) TO rt_data.
        lv_prev_connid = <fs_flight>-connid.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_grouped(
        carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_flight>-connid
        fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate
        price  = <fs_flight>-price
      ) TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_list.
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = get_grouped_flight_data( ).

    DATA(lo_list) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).

    lo_list->set_title( 'Hierarchische Flugliste' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'GROUP_TEXT' iv_text = 'Gruppe' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'CARRID' iv_text = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'CONNID' iv_text = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'FLDATE' iv_text = 'Flugdatum' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'PRICE'  iv_text = 'Preis' ).

    lo_list->display( it_data = lt_flight_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lll_totals_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_totals
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_carrier_total.

    METHODS display_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lll_totals_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_totals.
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid,
                  SUM( price ) AS total_price
           GROUP BY carrid
           ORDER BY carrid
           INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_list.
    DATA(lt_carrier_totals) = get_carrier_totals( ).

    DATA(lo_list) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).

    lo_list->set_title( 'Gesamtpreise pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'CARRID' iv_text = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_list->set_column_text( iv_fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' iv_text = 'Gesamtpreis' ).

    " Add a total line manually
    DATA(lv_grand_total) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_total> IN lt_carrier_totals NEXT sum = sum + <fs_total>-total_price ).
    APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_total( carrid = 'TOTAL' total_price = lv_grand_total ) TO lt_carrier_totals.

    lo_list->display( it_data = lt_carrier_totals ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tch_flights_by_year DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_year
      IMPORTING iv_year TYPE n LENGTH 4
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING iv_year TYPE n LENGTH 4.

CLASS zcl_tch_flights_by_year IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_year.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = iv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = iv_year && '1231'.

    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS fldate,
                  COUNT( * ) AS count
           WHERE fldate BETWEEN @lv_start_date AND @lv_end_date
           GROUP BY fldate
           ORDER BY fldate
           INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = get_flights_for_year( iv_year ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).

    lo_chart->set_title( |Anzahl Flüge im Jahr { iv_year }| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      lo_chart->add_data_point(
        iv_date  = <fs_flight>-fldate
        iv_value = <fs_flight>-count
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jede Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        curr     TYPE sflight-curr,
        passsum  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_passenger_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_passenger_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate seatsocc curr
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid curr = ls_flight-curr )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_passsum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT s = s + <fs_member>-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid curr = ls_group_key-curr passsum = lv_passsum ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine elegante Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` kann man Aggregationen direkt innerhalb der Schleife durchführen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und erhalten Sie eine Referenz auf jeden Eintrag, um diesen direkt zu modifizieren. Erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um 10.

CLASS zcl_sflights_ref_mod DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_sflights_ref_mod IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_seatsocc.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight)
         WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      lr_flight->seatsocc = lr_flight->seatsocc + 10.
    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_modify_seatsocc.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_ref_mod( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_flights[ 2 ]-seatsocc exp = 50 ). " Should not be modified
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_flights[ 3 ]-seatsocc exp = 130 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO DATA(...)` ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen, ohne dass ein `MODIFY` Statement erforderlich ist. Dies ist besonders effizient, da keine Kopien der Zeilen erstellt werden und die Änderungen direkt im Speicher der internen Tabelle vorgenommen werden.
keywords: LOOP AT, REFERENCE INTO, Internal Tables, Modification

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_carrid_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_sflights_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_carrid_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights. " Only need one row to check existence

    LOOP AT lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_exists = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Für jede Gruppe sollen die Flugnummern gesammelt und die Gesamtanzahl der freien Sitze berechnet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die Konstruktion der Ergebnisstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
        connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
        free_seats  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_details
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_details) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate seatsmax seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
        fldate      = ls_group_key-fldate
        connections = VALUE #( FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key ( <fs_member>-connid ) )
        free_seats  = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT s = s + ( <fs_member>-seatsmax - <fs_member>-seatsocc ) )
      ) TO rt_grouped_details.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group-free_seats exp = <expected_sum> ).

Es ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten und das Sammeln von Detailinformationen pro Gruppe in einem einzigen, sehr ausdrucksstarken Statement.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, VALUE, FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Structured Output

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flugverbindungen (`sflight`) für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die in einer internen Tabelle vorliegen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
      END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_basic.
    DATA lt_carriers TYPE zcl_fae_basic=>tt_carrid.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_fae_basic=>ty_carrid( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_carriers.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_fae_basic=>ty_carrid( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_carriers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_basic( ).

Instructions: Selektieren Sie spezifische Felder von Flügen aus `sflight` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern in eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur nicht exakt der Datenbanktabelle entspricht.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ... FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_conn,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_carrier_conn.
    TYPES tt_carrier_conn TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_conn WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
        flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
        occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_conn TYPE tt_carrier_conn
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    IF it_carrier_conn IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid AS airline_id, connid AS flight_num, fldate AS flight_date, seatsocc AS occupied_seats
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carrier_conn
        WHERE carrid = it_carrier_conn-carrid
          AND connid = it_carrier_conn-connid
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flight_info.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fae_corr_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_corr_fields.
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_fae_corr_fields=>tt_carrier_conn.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_fae_corr_fields=>ty_carrier_conn( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_fae_corr_fields=>ty_carrier_conn( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    " Check if fields are mapped correctly
    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-airline_id exp = 'LH' OR 'AA' ). " Depends on data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-flight_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist nützlich, wenn die Zielstruktur der internen Tabelle nicht exakt der Datenbanktabelle entspricht, aber Felder mit gleichen Namen (oder durch `AS` umbenannte Felder) übernommen werden sollen. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Database Access, Field Mapping

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und nur solche, die an einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.

CLASS zcl_fae_multi_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_fae_multi_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_and_date.
    IF it_criteria IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *

        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_criteria
        WHERE carrid = it_criteria-carrid
          AND fldate = it_criteria-fldate
        INTO TABLE rt_sflights.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_currency,
        curr TYPE sflight-curr,
      END OF ty_currency.
    TYPES tt_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_carriers_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_currencies TYPE tt_currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers_by_currency.
    IF it_currencies IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT DISTINCT carrid
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_currencies
        WHERE curr = it_currencies-curr
        INTO TABLE rt_carriers.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie die ersten 5 Flüge für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_up_to_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
      END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_up_to_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflight
        UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) in das CSV-Format und versenden Sie diese als Anhang per E-Mail.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die CSV-Generierung und `CL_BCS_CONVERT` für die Umwandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_csv_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             curr   TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_body_text TYPE string
        iv_filename  TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_csv_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_csv.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_main_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix( iv_body_text )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_main_document ).

    " Fetch data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency AS curr
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Generate CSV header
    DATA(lv_csv_content) = |"CARRID";"CONNID";"FLDATE";"PRICE";"CURRENCY"\n|.

    " Generate CSV data using REDUCE
    lv_csv_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_content
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT s = |{ s }"{ ls_flight-carrid }";"{ ls_flight-connid }";"{ ls_flight-fldate }";{ ls_flight-price };"{ ls_flight-curr }"\n|
    ).

    DATA(lt_csv_solix) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix( lv_csv_content ).

    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = lt_csv_solix
      i_length  = xstrlen( cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_xstring( lt_csv_solix ) )
      i_subject = iv_filename
    ).

    lo_bcs->add_attachment(
      i_document = lo_attachment
      i_attachment_size = xstrlen( cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_xstring( lt_csv_solix ) )
      i_attachment_type = 'CSV'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_filename
    ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_generation.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             curr   TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251123' price = '100.00' curr = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251124' price = '200.50' curr = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_content) = |"CARRID";"CONNID";"FLDATE";"PRICE";"CURRENCY"\n|.
    lv_csv_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_content
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_test_flights
      NEXT s = |{ s }"{ ls_flight-carrid }";"{ ls_flight-connid }";"{ ls_flight-fldate }";{ ls_flight-price };"{ ls_flight-curr }"\n|
    ).

    DATA(lt_csv_solix) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix( lv_csv_content ).
    DATA(lv_converted_csv) = cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_string( lt_csv_solix ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_csv_solix ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_converted_csv
      exp = '"CARRID";"CONNID";"FLDATE";"PRICE";"CURRENCY"\n'

      act = lv_converted_csv

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine ALV-Liste der `sflights`-Tabelle an, aber nur mit ausgewählten Spalten und benutzerdefinierten Spaltenüberschriften.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_COLUMNS` und `SET_SHORT_TEXT` oder `SET_MEDIUM_TEXT` für die Spaltenobjekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_custom_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_custom_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_custom_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_custom_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency AS curr, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_optimize( abap_true ).

        " Hide all columns first
        LOOP AT lo_columns->get_column_list( ) INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
          lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name )->set_visible( abap_false ).
        ENDLOOP.

        " Show and set texts for specific columns
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->set_visible( abap_true )->set_short_text( 'Airline' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->set_visible( abap_true )->set_short_text( 'Flug-Nr.' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'FLDATE' )->set_visible( abap_true )->set_short_text( 'Datum' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' )->set_visible( abap_true )->set_short_text( 'Preis' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CURR' )->set_visible( abap_true )->set_short_text( 'Währung' ).

        lo_salv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie der ALV-Toolbar einen benutzerdefinierten Button hinzu und implementieren Sie eine Aktion dafür (z.B. eine Meldung anzeigen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_FUNCTIONS` und `SET_HANDLER` für die Ereignisbehandlung.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL FOR EVENTS cl_salv_events_table.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS on_function_selected FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING e_salv_function.

CLASS zcl_salv_custom_button IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_with_button.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency AS curr
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_functions) = lo_salv->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ). " Enable all standard functions

        DATA(lv_function_code) = 'MY_FUNC'.
        lo_functions->add_function( name = lv_function_code icon = icon_information text = 'Meine Funktion' tooltip = 'Klicken Sie hier!' ).

        DATA(lo_event_handler) = NEW lcl_event_handler( ).
        SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->on_function_selected FOR lo_salv->get_event_handler( ).

        lo_salv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_function_selected.
    IF e_salv_function = 'MY_FUNC'.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierte Funktion wurde ausgelöst!' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_salv_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency AS curr
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_filters) = lo_salv->get_filters( ).

        " Add filter for CARRID
        lo_filters->add_filter(
          columnname = 'CARRID'
          value      = iv_carrid
          sign       = 'I'
          option     = 'EQ'
        ).

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
        name    TYPE string,
        content TYPE string,
      END OF ty_file_content,
      tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_content

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      lo_zip->add(
        i_name    = ls_file-name
        i_content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_data(
                        EXPORTING
                          data = ls_file-content
                          encoding = 'UTF-8'
                        RECEIVING
                          buffer = DATA(lv_xstring_content) )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zipped_xcontent( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Dateien aus einem ZIP-Archiv und geben Sie deren Namen und Inhalte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip`, `load`, `get_files` und `get`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_extracted_file,
        name    TYPE string,
        content TYPE string,
      END OF ty_extracted_file,
      tt_extracted_files TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_file WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS decompress_all_files
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extracted_files) TYPE tt_extracted_files.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_all_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_file_names) = lo_zip->get_files( ).

    LOOP AT lt_file_names INTO DATA(lv_file_name).
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) = lo_zip->get( i_name = lv_file_name ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_extracted_file(
        name    = lv_file_name
        content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string(
                      EXPORTING
                        buffer = lv_xstring_content
                        encoding = 'UTF-8' )
      ) TO rt_extracted_files.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_decompress_all_files.
    DATA(lo_compressor) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_multi( ).
    DATA(lt_original_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_compress_multi=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = 'doc1.txt' content = 'First document content.' )
      ( name = 'doc2.txt' content = 'Second document content.' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_zipped_xstring) = lo_compressor->compress_files( lt_original_files ).

    DATA(lo_decompressor) = NEW zcl_zip_decompress_multi( ).
    DATA(lt_extracted_files) = lo_decompressor->decompress_all_files( lv_zipped_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_extracted_files ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_extracted_files INTO DATA(ls_extracted_file1) WITH KEY name = 'doc1.txt'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_extracted_file1-content exp = 'First document content.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_extracted_files INTO DATA(ls_extracted_file2) WITH KEY name = 'doc2.txt'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_extracted_file2-content exp = 'Second document content.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache hierarchische Struktur von Flugverbindungen (aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS) in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree`, `cl_gui_custom_container` und die Methoden `set_table_for_first_display` und `add_nodes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_basic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
        node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
        relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
        text     TYPE string,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        level    TYPE i,
        expcol   TYPE lvc_expcol, " 'X' for expanded, ' ' for collapsed
      END OF ty_flight_node,
      tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        planetype TYPE s_planetye,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_basic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_nodes    TYPE tt_flight_nodes.
    DATA: ls_node     TYPE ty_flight_node.
    DATA: lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    " Fetch data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    " Create column tree
    mo_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_width  = 100
      i_height = 100
    ).

    " Define columns
    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT'   coltext = 'Description' width = 30 )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline'     width = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Connection'  width = 10 )
    ).
    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_NODE' " Structure for node data
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_columns
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_nodes " Initial empty table, will be filled by tree
    ).

    " Build tree nodes
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      " Carrier node
      lv_node_key = |CARR_{ ls_sflight-carrid }|.
      READ TABLE lt_nodes TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY node_key = lv_node_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
          node_key = lv_node_key
          text     = |Airline: { ls_sflight-carrid }|
          carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
          level    = 0
          expcol   = 'X'
        ) TO lt_nodes.
      ENDIF.

      " Connection node
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
        node_key = |CONN_{ ls_sflight-carrid }_{ ls_sflight-connid }|
        relatkey = lv_node_key
        text     = |Connection: { ls_sflight-connid } ({ ls_sflight-fldate })|
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        level    = 1
        expcol   = ' '
      ) TO lt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add nodes to tree
    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        it_nodes = lt_nodes
    ).

    " Expand all nodes (optional)
    mo_column_tree->expand_all( ).

    " Update display
    mo_column_tree->update_item( ).
    mo_column_tree->frontend_update( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD add_new_flight_connection.

    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(

      IMPORTING
        node_key.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_width  = 100
      i_height = 100
    ).

    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT'   coltext = 'Description' width = 30 )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline'     width = 10 )

    ).

      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_columns
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = NEW tt_flight_nodes( ) 
    ).

    " Register event handler
    SET HANDLER me->handle_node_double_click FOR mo_column_tree.

    " Register event
    mo_column_tree->set_registered_events(
      EXPORTING
        it_events = VALUE lvc_t_alv_events(
          ( eventid = cl_gui_column_tree=>eventid_node_double_click )
        )
    ).

    " Add some initial nodes for demonstration

      ( node_key = 'CARR_LH' text = 'Airline: LH' carrid = 'LH' level = 0 expcol = 'X' )

    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        it_nodes = lt_initial_nodes
    ).
    mo_column_tree->update_item( ).
    mo_column_tree->frontend_update( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    " In a real application, you would perform an action based on the node_key
    mv_last_clicked_node = node_key.
    MESSAGE |Node '{ node_key }' wurde doppelt geklickt!| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem Knoten in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` ein Kontextmenü hinzu und reagieren Sie auf dessen Auswahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ctmenu` für das Kontextmenü, `set_registered_events` für `context_menu_request` und `context_menu_selected`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mo_context_menu TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
    DATA mv_last_menu_selection TYPE i.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
        node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
        relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
        text     TYPE string,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        level    TYPE i,
        expcol   TYPE lvc_expcol,
      END OF ty_flight_node,
      tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS handle_context_menu_request FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.

    METHODS handle_context_menu_selected FOR EVENT context_menu_selected OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING
        fcode.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_width  = 100
      i_height = 100
    ).

    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT'   coltext = 'Description' width = 30 )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline'     width = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Connection'  width = 10 )
    ).
    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_columns
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = NEW tt_flight_nodes( ) 
    ).

    DATA(lt_initial_nodes) = VALUE tt_flight_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'CARR_LH' text = 'Airline: LH' carrid = 'LH' level = 0 expcol = 'X' )
      ( node_key = 'CONN_LH_0400' relatkey = 'CARR_LH' text = 'Connection: 0400' carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' level = 1 expcol = ' ' )
    ).
    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_by_key = abap_true
        it_nodes = lt_initial_nodes
    ).
    mo_column_tree->update_item( ).
    mo_column_tree->frontend_update( ).

    " Register context menu events
    SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_column_tree.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_selected FOR mo_column_tree.

    mo_column_tree->set_registered_events(
      EXPORTING
        it_events = VALUE lvc_t_alv_events(
          ( eventid = cl_gui_column_tree=>eventid_context_menu_request )
          ( eventid = cl_gui_column_tree=>eventid_context_menu_selected )
        )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    " Create context menu dynamically
    mo_context_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 1 menu_text = 'Details anzeigen' ).
    mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 2 menu_text = 'Knoten löschen' ).
    mo_context_menu->add_separator( ).
    mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 3 menu_text = 'Refresh' ).

    " Set the context menu for the tree
    mo_column_tree->set_context_menu( mo_context_menu ).

    MESSAGE |Kontextmenü für Knoten '{ node_key }' angefordert.| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_selected.
    " React to menu selection
    mv_last_menu_selection = fcode.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 1.
        MESSAGE 'Details anzeigen ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 2.
        MESSAGE 'Knoten löschen ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 3.
        MESSAGE 'Refresh ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE |Unbekannte Funktion '{ fcode }' ausgewählt!| TYPE 'W'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    READ TABLE lt_events TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY eventid = cl_gui_column_tree=>eventid_context_menu_selected.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).

    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung eines Kontextmenüs für Baumknoten. Die Ereignisse `context_menu_request` und `context_menu_selected` werden registriert. Im `handle_context_menu_request` wird dynamisch ein `cl_ctmenu`-Objekt erstellt und mit Funktionen gefüllt. Dieses Menü wird dann dem Baum mit `set_context_menu` zugewiesen. Der `handle_context_menu_selected` Event-Handler reagiert auf die Auswahl einer Menüfunktion.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table vom Typ `sflight` mit einigen initialen Werten unter Verwendung des `VALUE #` Operators. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Eintrag anhand des Primärschlüssels liest und zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` für die Initialisierung und `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS get_initial_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    CLASS-METHODS get_sflight_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_sflights.
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 200 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_entry.
    READ TABLE it_sflights INTO rs_sflight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_initial_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_entry_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_entry_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_initial_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = zcl_hashed_table_ops=>get_initial_sflights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_check) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM ls_sflight_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_sflight_entry_found.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = zcl_hashed_table_ops=>get_initial_sflights( ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_ops=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ).
    DATA(ls_found) = zcl_hashed_table_ops=>get_sflight_entry( is_key = ls_key it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-seatsocc exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_sflight_entry_not_found.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = zcl_hashed_table_ops=>get_initial_sflights( ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_ops=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    TRY.
        zcl_hashed_table_ops=>get_sflight_entry( is_key = ls_key it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_read_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Exception caught, test passed
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `VALUE #` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von internen Tabellen. `CLASS-METHODS` werden hier als Utility-Methoden verwendet, die direkt aufgerufen werden können, ohne eine Instanz der Klasse zu erzeugen. Der Zugriff auf die Hashed Table erfolgt effizient über den Primärschlüssel.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, VALUE #, CLASS-METHODS, READ TABLE, Internal Tables, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine statische Fabrikmethode zur Instanziierung bereitstellt. Fügen Sie dann Methoden hinzu, die eine Eigenschaft setzen und die Instanz selbst zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für die Fabrik und `RETURNING VALUE(me)` für das Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    CLASS-METHODS create RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_builder.
    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_builder.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create.
    ro_instance = NEW #( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = zcl_chainable_builder=>create( )->set_value( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_builder->mv_value exp = 10 ).

    DATA(lo_another_builder) = zcl_chainable_builder=>create( )->set_value( 20 )->set_value( 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_another_builder->mv_value exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Statische Fabrikmethoden (`CLASS-METHODS create`) sind ein modernes Designmuster, um die Objekterzeugung zu steuern. Durch das Zurückgeben der eigenen Instanz (`RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_builder`) in den Setter-Methoden wird Method Chaining ermöglicht, was zu flüssigerem und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Factory Method, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, RETURNING VALUE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugverbindung (`connid`) und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Gruppe. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hashed Table.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR` Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS aggregate_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_sflight_agg_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_sflights.
    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid connid = ls_group-connid ) 
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        connid = ls_group-connid
        total_seats_occ = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsocc ) 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_sflights.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 75 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = zcl_hashed_grouping=>aggregate_sflights( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_0400_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_grouping=>ty_sflight_agg( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_lh_0400) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = ls_lh_0400_key-carrid connid = ls_lh_0400_key-connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_0400-total_seats_occ exp = 225 ). " 100 + 50 + 75

    DATA(ls_ua_0010_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_grouping=>ty_sflight_agg( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_ua_0010) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = ls_ua_0010_key-carrid connid = ls_ua_0010_key-connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_0010-total_seats_occ exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` und `REDUCE #` ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Das Ergebnis wird direkt in eine Hashed Table geschrieben, was den effizienten Zugriff auf die aggregierten Daten ermöglicht.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Hashed Table von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von belegten Sitzen überschreiten, und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen Hashed Table.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS filter_sflights_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_min_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_seats.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE seatsocc > iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_filter=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' seatsocc = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(ls_aa_0020_key) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    DATA(ls_dl_0030_key) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM ls_dl_0030_key.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    DATA(ls_lh_0400_key) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM ls_lh_0400_key.
