explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und kompakte Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In Kombination mit Hashed Tables bleibt die Performance auch bei großen Datenmengen hoch, da der Filter direkt auf die Tabellenstruktur angewendet wird.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die ein statisches Ereignis auslöst, und eine andere Klasse, die dieses Ereignis mit einer statischen Methode behandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-EVENTS` und `CLASS-METHODS FOR EVENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS trigger_data_change
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_data_change.
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING iv_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_last_message TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS handle_data_change FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_publisher
      IMPORTING
        iv_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_data_change.
    gv_last_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_static_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_static_event_handling.
    " Register the event handler
    SET HANDLER zcl_event_subscriber=>handle_data_change FOR zcl_event_publisher.

    " Trigger the event
    zcl_event_publisher=>trigger_data_change( 'Hello Event!' ).

    " Check if the event handler updated the static data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_event_subscriber=>gv_last_message exp = 'Hello Event!' ).

    " Trigger another event
    zcl_event_publisher=>trigger_data_change( 'Another Message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_event_subscriber=>gv_last_message exp = 'Another Message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Statische Ereignisse und deren Behandlung durch `CLASS-METHODS FOR EVENT` ermöglichen eine entkoppelte Kommunikation zwischen Klassen, ohne dass Instanzen voneinander wissen müssen. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der Objektorientierung, das die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: CLASS-EVENTS, CLASS-METHODS FOR EVENT, Object Orientation, Events, Decoupling

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag in einer Hashed Table existiert, und ermitteln Sie gegebenenfalls dessen Index (obwohl bei Hashed Tables der Index keine semantische Bedeutung hat, kann `LINE_INDEX` verwendet werden, um die Existenz zu prüfen und den internen Index zu erhalten).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit dem Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS check_sflight_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS get_sflight_line_index
      IMPORTING
        is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i. " Returns 0 if not found
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sflight_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_sflights[ carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_line_index.
    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_sflights[ carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_sflight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_line_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_sflight_exists.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_check=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(ls_key_found) = VALUE zcl_hashed_check=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = zcl_hashed_check=>check_sflight_exists( is_key = ls_key_found it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists ).

    DATA(ls_key_not_found) = VALUE zcl_hashed_check=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    lv_exists = zcl_hashed_check=>check_sflight_exists( is_key = ls_key_not_found it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_sflight_line_index.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_check=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(ls_key_found) = VALUE zcl_hashed_check=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lv_index) = zcl_hashed_check=>get_sflight_line_index( is_key = ls_key_found it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).

    DATA(ls_key_not_found) = VALUE zcl_hashed_check=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    lv_index = zcl_hashed_check=>get_sflight_line_index( is_key = ls_key_not_found it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` bieten eine moderne und prägnante Syntax, um die Existenz von Einträgen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und deren (internen) Index zu ermitteln. Bei Hashed Tables ist der Zugriff über den Schlüssel extrem performant.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in einer Hashed Table von Flugdaten (`sflight`) basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel. Wenn der Eintrag nicht existiert, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit einem Inline-Ausdruck oder `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS update_sflight_seats
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_data TYPE sflight
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflight_seats.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_sflight_data-carrid connid = is_sflight_data-connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = is_sflight_data-seatsocc.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei verschiedenen Klassen und rufen Sie die Methode polymorph über eine statische Methode auf, die eine Referenz auf das Interface akzeptiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES`, `CLASS-METHODS` mit Interface-Referenz als Parameter.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_area
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = io_shape->get_area( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphic_area_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphic_area_calculation.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ).
    DATA(lv_circle_area) = zcl_shape_processor=>calculate_area( lo_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_circle_area exp = '78.53975' ).

    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '4' ).
    DATA(lv_square_area) = zcl_shape_processor=>calculate_area( lo_square ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_square_area exp = '16' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Polymorphismus durch Interfaces ist ein Kernkonzept der modernen Objektorientierung. Eine `CLASS-METHOD` kann eine Referenz auf ein Interface akzeptieren und somit Methoden von verschiedenen Implementierungsklassen aufrufen, ohne deren konkreten Typ zu kennen. Dies fördert flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Interfaces, Polymorphism, Object Orientation

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `DELETE` Operation auf einer Hashed Table durch, um alle Einträge zu entfernen, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen. Demonstrieren Sie die Effizienz durch den direkten Zugriff auf den Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE` mit einem `WHERE` Ausdruck oder `FOR` Schleife mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS delete_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_to_delete TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights         TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_sflights_by_carrid.
    DELETE ct_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_to_delete.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_sflights_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_non_existent_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_sflights_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_delete=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    zcl_hashed_delete=>delete_sflights_by_carrid( EXPORTING iv_carrid_to_delete = 'LH' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_data ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_test_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    READ TABLE lt_test_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_non_existent_carrid.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_delete=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    zcl_hashed_delete=>delete_sflights_by_carrid( EXPORTING iv_carrid_to_delete = 'XX' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_data ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE` Anweisung ist die effizienteste Methode, um Einträge aus einer Hashed Table zu entfernen, die einem bestimmten Kriterium entsprechen. Die Operation nutzt den Hash-Algorithmus der Tabelle, um die zu löschenden Einträge schnell zu finden und zu entfernen, was besonders bei großen Tabellen performant ist.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, DELETE TABLE, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Singleton-Designmuster für eine Klasse unter Verwendung einer statischen Methode, die die einzige Instanz der Klasse verwaltet und zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` und eine `CLASS-DATA` Referenz, um die Instanz zu speichern. Der Konstruktor muss `PRIVATE` sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    METHODS get_timestamp RETURNING VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    DATA mv_creation_timestamp TYPE timestampl.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_creation_timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      go_instance = NEW #( ).
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_timestamp.
    rv_timestamp = mv_creation_timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_singleton_instance FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_singleton_uniqueness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_instance.
    DATA(lo_instance1) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_instance1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_singleton_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_instance1) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_instance2) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance1->get_timestamp( ) exp = lo_instance2->get_timestamp( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance1 exp = lo_instance2 ). " Check if references are identical
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Designmuster stellt sicher, dass eine Klasse nur eine Instanz hat und einen globalen Zugriffspunkt darauf bietet. Dies wird durch einen privaten Konstruktor und eine statische Fabrikmethode (`CLASS-METHODS get_instance`) erreicht, die die einzige Instanz verwaltet. Dies ist ein wichtiges Designmuster für Ressourcen, die nur einmal existieren dürfen.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Singleton, Design Patterns, Object Orientation, CLASS-DATA

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer Hashed Table nach einem Eintrag und geben Sie diesen als Referenz zurück, um direkte Änderungen zu ermöglichen, ohne die Tabelle erneut lesen zu müssen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE OF` oder `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_get_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS get_sflight_reference
      IMPORTING
        is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_sflight) TYPE REF TO sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_get_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_reference.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      GET REFERENCE OF <fs_sflight> INTO rr_sflight.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_reference_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_reference_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_reference_found.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_get_ref=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_get_ref=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lr_sflight) = zcl_hashed_get_ref=>get_sflight_reference( is_key = ls_key it_sflights = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_sflight->seatsocc exp = 100 ).

    " Modify via reference
    lr_sflight->seatsocc = 150.

    READ TABLE lt_test_data INTO DATA(ls_modified) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_modified-seatsocc exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_reference_not_found.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_get_ref=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_get_ref=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    TRY.
        zcl_hashed_get_ref=>get_sflight_reference( is_key = ls_key it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_read_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf einen Tabellenzeile (`GET REFERENCE OF <fs>`) ermöglicht die direkte Manipulation des Eintrags in der Hashed Table, ohne dass ein erneutes `MODIFY` erforderlich ist. Dies ist effizient und vermeidet unnötige Datenkopien, besonders nützlich in ABAP 7.40+.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, GET REFERENCE OF, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Data Retrieval

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode einer anderen Klasse aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_class TYPE (iv_class_name).

        IF iv_param IS SUPPLIED.
          ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming method has an IV_INPUT parameter
          ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>exporting.
          GET REFERENCE OF iv_param INTO ls_parameter-value.
          APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
        ENDIF.

        ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'. " Assuming method has an RV_OUTPUT returning parameter
        ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>returning.
        GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
        APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

        CALL METHOD (lo_class)->(iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_string.
    rv_output = iv_input && ' - Processed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_no_param FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_dynamic_caller=>call_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
      iv_method_name = 'CONCATENATE_STRING'
      iv_param       = 'TestString' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'TestString - Processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_no_param.
    " Assuming a method without parameters exists or handling for it
    " For this example, we'll test with a method that expects a parameter but pass none
    TRY.
        zcl_dynamic_caller=>call_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
          iv_method_name = 'CONCATENATE_STRING' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_dyn_call_error was not raised for missing parameter.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_invalid.
    TRY.
        zcl_dynamic_caller=>call_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
          iv_method_name = 'SOME_METHOD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_dyn_call_error was not raised for invalid class.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf (`CALL METHOD (lo_class)->(iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters`) ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche Methode einer Klasse aufgerufen wird. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für Frameworks oder generische Verarbeitungslogiken und wird oft in Kombination mit `CLASS-METHODS` für Utility-Funktionen verwendet.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, RTTI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Hashed Table von Flugdaten (`sflight`) in eine neue Hashed Table, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugverbindung enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE #` und einer neuen Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_flight_id_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    CLASS-METHODS transform_to_flight_ids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE tt_flight_id_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_to_flight_ids.
    rt_flight_ids = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights 
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid 
        connid = ls_sflight-connid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_sflights.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_transform=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_transformed) = zcl_hashed_transform=>transform_to_flight_ids( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_check_lh) = VALUE zcl_hashed_transform=>ty_flight_id( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    READ TABLE lt_transformed TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM ls_check_lh.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    DATA(ls_check_ua) = VALUE zcl_hashed_transform=>ty_flight_id( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ).
    READ TABLE lt_transformed TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM ls_check_ua.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` bietet eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, Daten aus einer internen Tabelle zu lesen und in eine neue Struktur zu transformieren, die ebenfalls eine Hashed Table sein kann. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, VALUE #, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8-String in einen Latin-1-String (Codepage 1100).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_latin1
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latin1_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_latin1.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                              iv_string = iv_utf8_string
                              iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
                            ).

    rv_latin1_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                         iv_xstring = lv_xstring_utf8
                         iv_codepage = '1100' " Latin-1
                       ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_input) = `Hello, World! ÄÖÜäöüß`.
    DATA(lv_expected_latin1) = `Hello, World! ÄÖÜäöüß`. " Latin-1 can represent these

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_latin1( lv_utf8_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = lv_expected_latin1
      msg = 'UTF-8 to Latin-1 conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Konvertierung eines Strings von einer Codepage in eine andere. Zuerst wird der Eingabestring in ein XSTRING im UTF-8-Format umgewandelt und dann dieses XSTRING in einen String im Latin-1-Format zurückkonvertiert. Dies ist ein häufiger Anwendungsfall beim Umgang mit externen Daten.
keywords: Codepage, UTF-8, Latin-1, Konvertierung, String, XSTRING

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Codepage eines gegebenen XSTRINGs, das potenziell in verschiedenen Codepages vorliegen kann.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_detect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_xstring_codepage
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_codepage) TYPE abap_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS create_save_and_display_log
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_bal_display_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_save_and_display_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'S'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).

    lo_log->save_log(
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = lv_log_handle
    ).

    IF lv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_DSP_LOG'
        EXPORTING
          i_s_log_filter = VALUE bal_s_lfil( log_handle = lv_log_handle )
          i_display_profile = 'DEFAULT'
        EXCEPTIONS
          log_not_found = 1
          no_messages_found = 2
          no_authority = 3
          OTHERS = 4.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Error handling for display
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj=>get_instance` und `get_all_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
             msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
             msgv2 TYPE bal_msgv,
             msgv3 TYPE bal_msgv,
             msgv4 TYPE bal_msgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_read_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_message1 TYPE string
        iv_message2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log_writer) = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

    lo_log_writer->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message1
    ).
    lo_log_writer->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'W'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '001'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message2
    ).

    lo_log_writer->save_log(
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = lv_log_handle
    ).

    IF lv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_log_reader) = cl_bal_logobj=>get_instance( lv_log_handle ).
      DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_log_reader->get_all_messages( ).

      rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_bal_msg IN lt_bal_messages
                                ( msgty = ls_bal_msg-msgty
                                  msgid = ls_bal_msg-msgid
                                  msgno = ls_bal_msg-msgno
                                  msgv1 = ls_bal_msg-msgv1
                                  msgv2 = ls_bal_msg-msgv2
                                  msgv3 = ls_bal_msg-msgv3
                                  msgv4 = ls_bal_msg-msgv4 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_log_messages.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( ).
    DATA(lv_msg1) = `Erste Nachricht`.
    DATA(lv_msg2) = `Zweite Nachricht`.

    DATA(lt_read_messages) = lo_reader->create_and_read_log(
                                iv_message1 = lv_msg1
                                iv_message2 = lv_msg2
                              ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_read_messages )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 messages in the log'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_read_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1
      exp = lv_msg1
      msg = 'First message content mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_read_messages[ 2 ]-msgv1
      exp = lv_msg2
      msg = 'Second message content mismatch'
    ).

CLASS zcl_codepage_table_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_table_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table.
    rt_target_strings = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_source_strings
                                 LET lx_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                                    iv_string = lv_string
                                                    iv_codepage = iv_source_codepage
                                                  )
                                 IN
                                 cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                   iv_xstring = lx_xstring
                                   iv_codepage = iv_target_codepage
                                 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und fügen Sie Nachrichten mit dynamisch ermittelten Nachrichtentexten hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg` und den Funktionsbaustein `MESSAGE_PREPARE` oder String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_dynamic_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_log_with_dynamic_msg
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE string
        iv_value2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_dynamic_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_with_dynamic_msg.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ).

    " Dynamische Nachricht mit String-Templates
    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = |Der erste Wert ist: { iv_value1 }|
      i_msgv2 = |Der zweite Wert ist: { iv_value2 }|
    ).

    " Beispiel mit MESSAGE_PREPARE (für komplexere Fälle oder ältere Nachrichtenklassen)
    DATA(lv_msg_text) TYPE string.
    CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_PREPARE'
      EXPORTING
        i_msgid = 'SY'
        i_msgno = '002'
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgv1 = iv_value1
        i_msgv2 = iv_value2
      IMPORTING
        e_message_text = lv_msg_text.

    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '002'
      i_msgv1 = iv_value1
      i_msgv2 = iv_value2
    ).

    lo_log->save_log(
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

                            ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

    ).

Es demonstriert die Verwendung von String-Templates für einfache dynamische Texte und erwähnt `MESSAGE_PREPARE` als Alternative für komplexere Szenarien oder die Verwendung von Nachrichten aus dem Nachrichten-Editor (Transaktion SE91).

CLASS zcl_random_category_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id       TYPE i,
             category TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_item.

CLASS zcl_random_category_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_random_categories.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(

      FOR ls_item IN it_input_items

      ( id       = ls_item-id
        category = CASE lv_random_num
                     WHEN 0 THEN 'A'
                     WHEN 1 THEN 'B'
                     WHEN 2 THEN 'C'

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` und die zugehörigen Flugzeugtypen aus `SAPLANE` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei `FOR ALL ENTRIES` Statements nacheinander.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_with_planes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_and_planes
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_with_planes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_and_planes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_saplane  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF saplane WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 1. Get flights for carriers
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = it_carriers-carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Get plane details for planetypes found in flights
    SELECT planetype, seatsmax
      FROM saplane
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_sflights
      WHERE planetype = lt_sflights-planetype
      INTO TABLE lt_saplane.

    " 3. Combine data using a FOR expression
    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET ls_plane = lt_saplane[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS planetype = ls_flight-planetype ] IN
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
        connid    = ls_flight-connid
        fldate    = ls_flight-fldate
        planetype = ls_flight-planetype
        seatsmax  = ls_plane-seatsmax ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sflights_with_planes=>tt_carriers(

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_filter,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             min_seats_free TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_filter.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_filters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_carrier_count) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 3 ). " Select 1 to 3 carriers
    DATA(lo_random_min_seats) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 10 high = 100 ). " Min 10 to 100 free seats

    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights GROUP BY carrid ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
    ).
    IF lt_all_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_carriers_to_select) = lo_random_carrier_count->get_next( ).
    DATA(lt_selected_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > lv_num_carriers_to_select
      LET lv_random_index = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lines( lt_all_carriers ) )->get_next( ) IN
      ( lt_all_carriers[ lv_random_index ] )
    ).

    DATA(lt_driving_table) = VALUE tt_carrier_filters(
      FOR ls_carrid IN lt_selected_carriers
      ( carrid = ls_carrid
        min_seats_free = lo_random_min_seats->get_next( ) )
    ).

    IF lt_driving_table IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_driving_table
        WHERE carrid = lt_driving_table-carrid
          AND seatsocc < ( sflights~seatsmax - lt_driving_table-min_seats_free )
        INTO TABLE rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status von Flügen in `SFLIGHTS` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern auf 'C' (Cancelled).

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_to_update,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_to_update.
    TYPES: tt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_to_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_cancel TYPE tt_flights_to_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    IF it_flights_to_cancel IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_update_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      FOR ls_key IN it_flights_to_cancel
      ( carrid = ls_key-carrid, connid = ls_key-connid, status = 'C' )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE lt_update_data
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_update_data
      WHERE carrid = lt_update_data-carrid
        AND connid = lt_update_data-connid.

    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_to_cancel) = VALUE zcl_sflights_update_fae=>tt_flights_to_update(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) " Example flight that should exist
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) " Example flight that should exist
    ).

    " Ensure initial state (status is not 'C')
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_old_status_aa) WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_old_status_lh) WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    IF lv_old_status_aa = 'C'. UPDATE sflights SET status = '' WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'. ENDIF.
    IF lv_old_status_lh = 'C'. UPDATE sflights SET status = '' WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'. ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_status( lt_flights_to_cancel ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_updated > 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge aktualisiert werden.'
    ).

    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_new_status_aa) WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_new_status_lh) WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_status_aa exp = 'C' msg = 'Status von AA 0017 sollte C sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_status_lh exp = 'C' msg = 'Status von LH 0400 sollte C sein.' ).

    " Clean up: revert status for subsequent tests
    UPDATE sflights SET status = '' WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    UPDATE sflights SET status = '' WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_flight_status_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflights_update_fae=>tt_flights_to_update( ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_status( lt_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_updated
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten keine Zeilen aktualisiert werden, wenn die Eingabetabelle leer ist.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein sicheres, zufälliges Passwort mit einer Länge von 12 Zeichen, das Kleinbuchstaben, Großbuchstaben, Ziffern und Sonderzeichen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit String-Templates und `REDUCE` für die Zeichenauswahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secure_password_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 12
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_password_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_lower TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
               lc_upper TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',
               lc_digits TYPE string VALUE '0123456789',
               lc_special TYPE string VALUE '!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?'.

    DATA(lc_all_chars) = lc_lower && lc_upper && lc_digits && lc_special.
    DATA(lv_all_chars_len) = strlen( lc_all_chars ).

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_all_chars_len - 1 ).

    rv_password = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_all_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1) ).

    " Ensure at least one of each type if length allows
    IF iv_length >= 4.
      DATA(lo_random_pos) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = iv_length - 1 ).
      rv_password+lo_random_pos->get_next( )(1) = lc_lower+cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = strlen( lc_lower ) - 1 )->get_next( )(1).
      rv_password+lo_random_pos->get_next( )(1) = lc_upper+cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = strlen( lc_upper ) - 1 )->get_next( )(1).
      rv_password+lo_random_pos->get_next( )(1) = lc_digits+cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = strlen( lc_digits ) - 1 )->get_next( )(1).
      rv_password+lo_random_pos->get_next( )(1) = lc_special+cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = strlen( lc_special ) - 1 )->get_next( )(1).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitzplätze für alle Flüge einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und anschließend `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = it_carriers-carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Anonymisieren Sie eine Liste von E-Mail-Adressen, indem Sie den lokalen Teil durch eine zufällige Zeichenfolge ersetzen, während die Domain erhalten bleibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die zufällige Zeichenfolge und String-Funktionen wie `FIND`, `SUBSTRING` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_anonymizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS anonymize_emails
      IMPORTING
        it_emails TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_anonymized_emails) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_anonymizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD anonymize_emails.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    rt_anonymized_emails = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_email IN it_emails
      LET lv_at_pos = find( val = lv_email sub = '@' ) IN
      IF lv_at_pos IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_at_pos > 0.
        DATA(lv_domain) = lv_email+lv_at_pos( ).
        DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_chars_len - 1 ).
        DATA(lv_random_local_part) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 8 " Anonymized local part length 8
          NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random_char->get_next( )(1) ).
        ( |{ lv_random_local_part }{ lv_domain }| )
      ELSE.
        ( lv_email ) " Return original if not a valid email format
      ENDIF 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( 'test.user@example.com' )
      ( 'another.one@domain.net' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_anonymized ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der E-Mails sollte gleich bleiben.' ).

    LOOP AT lt_anonymized INTO DATA(lv_anon_email) INDEX sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_original_email) = lt_emails[ sy-tabix ].
      DATA(lv_original_domain) = lv_original_email+find( val = lv_original_email sub = '@' )( ).
      DATA(lv_anon_domain) = lv_anon_email+find( val = lv_anon_email sub = '@' )( ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_anon_domain exp = lv_original_domain msg = 'Domain sollte erhalten bleiben.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( strlen( lv_anon_email ) > strlen( lv_original_domain ) ) msg = 'Lokaler Teil sollte anonymisiert sein.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_anon_email CP '*@*' ) msg = 'Anonymisierte E-Mail sollte @ enthalten.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_anonymize_emails_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_email_anonymizer( ).
    DATA(lt_emails) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'invalid-email' )
      ( 'noat.com' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_anonymized) = lo_cut->anonymize_emails( lt_emails ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`SFLIGHTS`) basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzplätzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für den Datenbankzugriff und anschließend `FILTER` für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filter_criteria,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             min_seats_free TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_filter_criteria.
    TYPES: tt_filter_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filter_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_filter_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_criteria IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 1. Get all flights for the specified carriers
    SELECT * FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_criteria
      WHERE carrid = it_criteria-carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw.

    " 2. Filter the results based on min_seats_free using FILTER expression
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE carrid IN it_criteria
        AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= it_criteria-min_seats_free ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights_empty_criteria FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_sflights_filter_fae=>tt_filter_criteria(
      ( carrid = 'AA' min_seats_free = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' min_seats_free = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_flights
      msg = 'Es sollten gefilterte Flüge gefunden werden.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(ls_matching_criteria) = lt_criteria[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= ls_matching_criteria-min_seats_free )
        msg = 'Flug sollte die Mindestanzahl freier Sitzplätze erfüllen.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights_empty_criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_criteria) = VALUE zcl_sflights_filter_fae=>tt_filter_criteria( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( lt_empty_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_flights
      msg = 'Ausgabetabelle sollte leer sein, wenn keine Kriterien angegeben sind.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_sflights_filter_fae=>tt_filter_criteria(
      ( carrid = 'AA' min_seats_free = 9999 ) " Unlikely to have 9999 free seats
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_flights
      msg = 'Es sollten keine Flüge gefunden werden, wenn die Kriterien zu streng sind.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für den initialen, performanten Datenbankzugriff mit dem `FILTER` Ausdruck für die nachfolgende, flexible Filterung der internen Tabelle. Der `FILTER` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und lesbare Filterung basierend auf komplexeren Bedingungen, die auch auf die Driving Table (`it_criteria`) zugreifen können.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, FILTER, Data Filtering, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Testdaten-Generator-Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`-Einträgen mit zufälligen Werten für `seatsocc` (belegte Sitze) und `planetype` (Flugzeugtyp) erzeugt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die zufälligen Werte und `FOR` Ausdrücke zur Generierung der Testdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_test_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_test_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_test_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_test_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_test_flights.
    DATA(lt_base_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO iv_count ROWS
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    IF lt_base_flights IS INITIAL.
      " Fallback if SFLIGHTS is empty or less than iv_count
      lt_base_flights = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 200 ) 
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 ) 
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_seats) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = 100 ). " Percentage of seats occupied
    DATA(lo_random_planetype) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = 2 ).

    rt_test_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_base_flights
      LET lv_planetype_idx = lo_random_planetype->get_next( ) IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax
        planetype = CASE lv_planetype_idx
                      WHEN 0 THEN '747'
                      WHEN 1 THEN 'A320'
                      WHEN 2 THEN 'CRJ'
                      ELSE 'UNK'
                    END
        seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsmax * lo_random_seats->get_next( ) / 100 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Erstellen Sie dazu einen Testdatensatz, aktualisieren Sie ihn und prüfen Sie die Änderung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die MODIFY-Anweisung mit einem Work Area.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RAISING
        cx_abap_unit_assert.

    METHODS create_test_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_price TYPE s_price.

    METHODS delete_test_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price = iv_new_price.
      MODIFY sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_unit_assert EXPORTING msg = 'Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Fluges.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_unit_assert EXPORTING msg = 'Flug nicht gefunden zum Aktualisieren.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_flight.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      mandt  = sy-mandt
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      price  = iv_price
      currency = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'BOEING747'
      seatsmax = 300
      seatsocc = 100
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_flight.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
          mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0400',
          mv_fldate TYPE s_date    VALUE '20251224',
          mv_initial_price TYPE s_price VALUE '100.00',
          mv_new_price TYPE s_price VALUE '150.00'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_modify( ).
    lo_cut->delete_test_flight( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate ).
    lo_cut->create_test_flight( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate iv_price = mv_initial_price ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_modify( ).
    lo_cut->delete_test_flight( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_modify( ).
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_old_price)
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_old_price exp = mv_initial_price msg = 'Initialer Preis stimmt nicht.' ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate iv_new_price = mv_new_price ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_updated_price)
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price exp = mv_new_price msg = 'Preis wurde nicht korrekt aktualisiert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die MODIFY-Anweisung ist die Standardmethode zum Aktualisieren oder Einfügen einzelner Datensätze. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (DATA(...)) und Hostvariablen-Escape-Zeichen (@) sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken, die den Code lesbarer und sicherer machen.
keywords: UPDATE, MODIFY, SFLIGHTS, Database, Inline Declaration, Host Variable

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Preise mehrerer Flüge in SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer internen Tabelle, die neue Preise enthält. Nutzen Sie die moderne Syntax `UPDATE FROM TABLE`.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price,
           tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_new_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.

    METHODS create_test_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflight_tab.

    METHODS delete_test_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_from_table.
    DATA lt_sflight_update TYPE sflight_tab.

    lt_sflight_update = VALUE #( FOR ls_price IN it_new_prices
                                 ( mandt = sy-mandt
                                   carrid = ls_price-carrid
                                   connid = ls_price-connid
                                   fldate = ls_price-fldate
                                   price  = ls_price-price ) ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_update.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_flights.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_flights.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_prices_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_conditionally.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      price = CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN price * '1.10' ELSE price * '1.05' END
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(

      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = iv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = '600.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 60 )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = iv_carrid connid = '0003' fldate = '20250103' price = '500.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'B737' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 70 )
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_flights.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Flugdatensatz in SFLIGHTS in einem spezifischen Mandanten (CLIENT SPECIFIED) und über eine alternative Datenbankverbindung (CONNECTION).
hint: Nutzen Sie die `CLIENT SPECIFIED` und `CONNECTION`-Klauseln in der `UPDATE`-Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_sflights_adv_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_cross_client
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_mandt TYPE mandt
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.

    METHODS create_test_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_mandt TYPE mandt
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_price TYPE s_price.

    METHODS delete_test_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_mandt TYPE mandt
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_adv_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_cross_client.
    " For demonstration, we assume a default connection. In a real scenario,
    " lv_connection_name would be dynamically determined or configured.
    DATA(lv_connection_name) = 'DEFAULT'. " Or a specific secondary connection

    UPDATE sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED CONNECTION (lv_connection_name)
      SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE mandt = @iv_target_mandt
        AND carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_flight.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      mandt  = iv_mandt
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      price  = iv_price
      currency = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'BOEING747'
      seatsmax = 300
      seatsocc = 100
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_flight.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE mandt = @iv_mandt AND carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD setup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_adv_update( ).
    lo_cut->delete_test_flight( iv_mandt = mv_test_mandt iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate ).
    lo_cut->create_test_flight( iv_mandt = mv_test_mandt iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate iv_price = mv_initial_price ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_adv_update( ).
    lo_cut->delete_test_flight( iv_mandt = mv_test_mandt iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_flight_cross_client.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_adv_update( ).
    DATA lv_old_price TYPE s_price.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED INTO @lv_old_price
      WHERE mandt = @mv_test_mandt AND carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_old_price exp = mv_initial_price msg = 'Initialer Preis im Testmandanten stimmt nicht.' ).

    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_cross_client(
      iv_target_mandt = mv_test_mandt
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_fldate
      iv_new_price = mv_new_price
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 1 msg = 'Es sollte 1 Zeile aktualisiert werden.' ).

    DATA lv_updated_price TYPE s_price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED INTO @lv_updated_price
      WHERE mandt = @mv_test_mandt AND carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price exp = mv_new_price msg = 'Preis im Testmandanten wurde nicht korrekt aktualisiert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist für fortgeschrittene Szenarien wie mandantenübergreifende Operationen oder den Zugriff auf externe Datenbanken nützlich. Der Unit-Test demonstriert die Funktionalität, erfordert jedoch eine entsprechende Konfiguration des Testmandanten.

CLASS zcl_sflights_calc_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_calc_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_seats_by_percentage.
    DATA(lv_factor) = iv_percentage / 100.

    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = seatsocc + ( seatsmax * @lv_factor )
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND seatsocc < seatsmax.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = iv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 150 ) " Full flight

    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_flights.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Methoden. Die erste Methode löst eine `cx_sy_zerodivide` aus. Die zweite Methode fängt diese ab und löst eine eigene, spezifischere Ausnahme `zcx_calculation_error` aus, die die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' Ausnahme enthält.

CLASS zcx_calculation_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.

    METHODS calculate_and_handle
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_calculation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_division.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_and_handle.
    TRY.
        rv_result = perform_division( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_calculation_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_zerodivide
            textid   = zcx_calculation_error=>default_text.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Chaining von Ausnahmen (`previous` Attribut) ist eine Best Practice, um den ursprünglichen Fehlerkontext nicht zu verlieren, wenn eine Ausnahme auf einer höheren Abstraktionsebene neu geworfen wird. Dies erleichtert die Fehleranalyse erheblich.
keywords: EXCEPTION, CHAINING, PREVIOUS, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, ERROR HANDLING

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadratwurzeln einer Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl negativ ist, soll eine Ausnahme `zcx_negative_number` ausgelöst werden, anstatt die Berechnung fortzusetzen. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` in Kombination mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcx_negative_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA number TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        number TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_negative_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->number = number.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_negative_number=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sqrt_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sqrt_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        sum = sum +
              COND f(
                WHEN number < 0 THEN
                  RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_number EXPORTING number = number
                ELSE
                  sqrt( number )
              )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_number FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_numbers.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_operations=>tt_numbers( ( 4 ) ( 9 ) ( 16 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_math->calculate_sqrt_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 9.0 msg = 'Correct sum for valid numbers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_operations=>tt_numbers( ( 4 ) ( -9 ) ( 16 ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_math->calculate_sqrt_sum( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception zcx_negative_number expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_number INTO DATA(lx_neg_num).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_neg_num->number exp = -9 msg = 'Correct negative number in exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression in Kombination mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen direkt in funktionalen Kontexten zu behandeln. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code, der Fehlerbedingungen elegant integriert.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, RAISE EXCEPTION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, SQRT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften. Wenn eine Fluggesellschaft mit 'XX' beginnt, soll der Filtervorgang abgebrochen und eine Ausnahme `zcx_forbidden_airline` mit `THROW` ausgelöst werden.

CLASS zcx_forbidden_airline DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    DATA airline_id TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.

      IMPORTING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_forbidden_airline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->airline_id = airline_id.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_forbidden_airline=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_airline_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_airlines
      IMPORTING
        it_all_airlines TYPE tt_airlines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_airlines) TYPE tt_airlines
      RAISING
        zcx_forbidden_airline.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airline_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_airlines.
    rt_filtered_airlines = VALUE #( 
      FOR airline IN it_all_airlines
      WHERE ( airline CP 'LH*' OR airline CP 'AA*' OR airline CP 'UA*' OR airline CP 'XX*' ) " Example filter to include XX for test
      ( 
        COND s_carr_id(
          WHEN airline CP 'XX*' THEN
            THROW zcx_forbidden_airline( airline_id = airline )
          ELSE
            airline
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in einem einfachen Textreport ausgibt. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_list_layout` und moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung, einschließlich `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` um die Daten für die Liste vorzubereiten und `cl_abap_list_layout` zur Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_modern_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_modern_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_summary.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_summary  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                             ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                               connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                               fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                               price    = ls_sflight-price
                               currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).

      DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
      lo_list_layout->add_line( |{ 'Fluggesellschaft' WIDTH = 15 } { 'Flugnummer' WIDTH = 10 } { 'Datum' WIDTH = 12 } { 'Preis' WIDTH = 10 } { 'Währung' WIDTH = 8 }| ).
      lo_list_layout->add_line( |{ sy-uline(15) } { sy-uline(10) } { sy-uline(12) } { sy-uline(10) } { sy-uline(8) }| ).

      LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
        lo_list_layout->add_line( |{ ls_summary-carrid WIDTH = 15 } { ls_summary-connid WIDTH = 10 } { ls_summary-fldate WIDTH = 12 } { ls_summary-price WIDTH = 10 ALIGN = RIGHT } { ls_summary-currency WIDTH = 8 }| ).
      ENDLOOP.

      lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    METHODS constructor

CLASS zcl_alv_with_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_validated_sflights
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_with_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_validated_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_valid_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight-price <= 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
          EXPORTING
            carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
            connid = ls_sflight-connid
            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_valid_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                  t_data    = lt_valid_sflights ).
          lo_alv->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Wenn dabei ein Flug mit einem ungültigen Datum (z.B. in der Vergangenheit) gefunden wird, soll eine Ausnahme `zcx_invalid_flight_date` ausgelöst werden, bevor die Liste mit `cl_abap_list_layout` angezeigt wird.

  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING

CLASS zcl_list_with_date_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flights_with_date_check
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_with_date_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_date_check.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_valid_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_date
          EXPORTING
            carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
            connid = ls_sflight-connid
            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_valid_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
    lo_list_layout->add_line( |Fluggesellschaft | && |Flugnummer | && |Datum | ).
    lo_list_layout->add_line( |----------------------------------------------------| ).

    LOOP AT lt_valid_sflights INTO DATA(ls_valid_sflight).
      lo_list_layout->add_line( |{ ls_valid_sflight-carrid ALPHA = OUT } { ls_valid_sflight-connid } { ls_valid_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_list_layout->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
