Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) basierend auf einem dynamisch erstellten Wertebereich für die Flugnummer. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und einen Range-Tabelle für die Flugnummer erhalten und die gefilterten Daten zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer dynamisch erstellten `RANGE`-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_range_connid,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE sflight-connid,
             high   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_range_connid,
           ty_range_connid_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE ty_sflights_tt
        it_connid_range TYPE ty_range_connid_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE connid IN it_connid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_filter_flights_by_range=>ty_sflights_tt,
          lt_connid_range TYPE zcl_filter_flights_by_range=>ty_range_connid_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.

    " Range: connid between '0017' and '0400'
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0017' high = '0400' ) TO lt_connid_range.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_by_range( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_sflights it_connid_range = lt_connid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0018' ).

    " Test with no matching entries
    CLEAR lt_connid_range.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '9999' ) TO lt_connid_range.
    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_sflights it_connid_range = lt_connid_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel und einem `IN`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Filterung interner Tabellen basierend auf dynamischen Wertebereichen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu selektieren, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `READ TABLE` Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, RANGE, Internal Tables, WHERE, Dynamic Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung aus einer `RANGE`-Tabelle generiert und diese auf die `sflights`-Tabelle anwendet. Die Methode soll eine Range-Tabelle für die Fluggesellschaft (carrid) erhalten und die passenden Flugdaten zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... WHERE (itab_cond)` mit einer internen Tabelle, die die dynamische Bedingung enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid,
           ty_range_carrid_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    " Build dynamic WHERE clause from range table
    LOOP AT it_carrid_range INTO DATA(ls_range).
      IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ' AND '.
      ENDIF.
      lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && `carrid ` && ls_range-option && ` '` && ls_range-low && `'`.
      IF ls_range-option = 'BT'.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ` AND carrid <= '` && ls_range-high && `'`.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flights
        WHERE (lv_where_clause).
    ELSE.
      " If no range is provided, select all (or handle as error)
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lt_carrid_range TYPE zcl_dynamic_select_range=>ty_range_carrid_tt.

    " Test with a specific carrier
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select_range( ).
    DATA(lt_result_lh) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result_lh ).
    LOOP AT lt_result_lh INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a range of carriers
    CLEAR lt_carrid_range.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'AA' high = 'DL' ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    DATA(lt_result_range) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result_range ).
    LOOP AT lt_result_range INTO DATA(ls_flight_range).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight_range-carrid GE 'AA' AND ls_flight_range-carrid LE 'DL' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel in `SELECT`-Anweisungen (`WHERE (itab_cond)`) ist ein mächtiges Feature, um flexible Datenbankabfragen zu erstellen. In Kombination mit Range-Tabellen können komplexe Selektionskriterien zur Laufzeit generiert werden, was die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Anpassungsfähigkeit des Codes erhöht. String-Templates (` `) werden für die lesbare Konstruktion der WHERE-Klausel verwendet.
keywords: SELECT, WHERE, Dynamic SQL, RANGE, String Templates

CLASS zcl_random_float_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_floats.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_random_floats = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_floats) = lo_cut->generate_random_floats( 5 ).

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine zufällige Ganzzahl zwischen einem gegebenen unteren und oberen Grenzwert (inklusiv) unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_float`.
hint: Multiplizieren Sie das Ergebnis von `get_next()` mit der Spanne der Zahlen und addieren Sie den unteren Grenzwert, dann runden Sie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_integer
      IMPORTING
        iv_low  TYPE i
        iv_high TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_int) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_integer.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_float) = lo_random->get_next( ). " 0.0 <= lv_float < 1.0

    " Scale to range [0, high - low + 1) and shift by low
    rv_random_int = floor( lv_float * ( iv_high - iv_low + 1 ) + iv_low ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_random_integer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_int_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_low) = 1.
    DATA(lv_high) = 100.
    DATA(lv_random_int) = 0.
    DATA(lv_in_range_count) = 0.

    " Run multiple times to check distribution (not a strict test, but good for sanity)
    DO 100 TIMES.
      lv_random_int = lo_cut->generate_random_integer( iv_low = lv_low iv_high = lv_high ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_random_int GE lv_low AND lv_random_int LE lv_high ) ).
      IF lv_random_int GE lv_low AND lv_random_int LE lv_high.
        lv_in_range_count = lv_in_range_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_in_range_count exp = 100 " All 100 should be in range
                                        msg = 'All generated numbers should be within the specified range' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `cl_abap_random_float` Gleitkommazahlen liefert, kann man diese durch Skalierung und Rundung nutzen, um zufällige Ganzzahlen in einem beliebigen Bereich zu erzeugen. Die `floor`-Funktion stellt sicher, dass die Zahl korrekt abgerundet wird, um den gewünschten Bereich zu treffen. Dies ist eine gängige Methode in der Programmierung.
keywords: Random, Integer, Float, Math, cl_abap_random_float, floor

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus einer gegebenen internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und die Anzahl der Zeilen in der Tabelle, um einen zufälligen Index zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE ty_sflights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_flights ).

    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    " Generate random index between 1 and lv_lines (inclusive)
    DATA(lv_random_index) = floor( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_lines ) + 1.

    READ TABLE it_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_random_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Should not happen if lv_random_index is correctly calculated
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_random_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_random_flight_empty FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_random_flight_selector=>ty_sflights_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    DATA(ls_random_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( it_flights = lt_sflights ).

    " Check if the selected flight exists in the original table
    READ TABLE lt_sflights WITH KEY carrid = ls_random_flight-carrid connid = ls_random_flight-connid TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Selected flight must exist in the original table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_random_flight_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_random_flight_selector=>ty_sflights_tt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->get_random_flight( it_flights = lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Auswahl eines zufälligen Eintrags aus einer internen Tabelle ist eine häufige Anforderung. Durch die Kombination von `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Tabellengröße und `cl_abap_random_float` zur Generierung eines Index kann dies effizient umgesetzt werden. Die Fehlerbehandlung für leere Tabellen ist dabei wichtig.
keywords: Random, Internal Tables, Data Selection, cl_abap_random_float, lines()

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein zufälliges Datum zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten (Start- und Enddatum).
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Daten in Tage seit einem Referenzdatum, generieren Sie eine zufällige Anzahl von Tagen in diesem Bereich und konvertieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_date.
    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Start date must not be after end date'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_days_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = '00000000' iv_date2 = iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_days_end)   = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = '00000000' iv_date2 = iv_end_date ).

    DATA(lv_day_span) = lv_days_end - lv_days_start + 1.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_offset) = floor( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_day_span ).

    DATA(lv_random_days) = lv_days_start + lv_random_offset.

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = '00000000' iv_days = lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_random_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_random_date_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20200101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = '20231231'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->generate_random_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_random_date GE lv_start_date AND lv_random_date LE lv_end_date ) ).

    " Test with same start and end date
    lv_random_date = lo_cut->generate_random_date( iv_start_date = '20220615' iv_end_date = '20220615' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_random_date exp = '20220615' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_random_date_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_generator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    lo_cut->generate_random_date( iv_start_date = '20230101' iv_end_date = '20220101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Generierung eines zufälligen Datums erfordert die Umwandlung von Daten in eine numerische Darstellung (Tage seit einem Referenzdatum), die Anwendung der Zufallszahlengenerierung und die Rückumwandlung. Die Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` vereinfacht Datumsberechnungen erheblich und macht den Code robust und lesbar. Die Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Datumsbereiche ist ebenfalls wichtig.
keywords: Random, Date, cl_abap_random_float, cl_abap_date_helper, Math

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Erstellen Sie einen Pool von erlaubten Zeichen und wählen Sie zufällig Zeichen aus diesem Pool, um den String zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_char_pool TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_pool_length) = strlen( lc_char_pool ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = floor( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_pool_length ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_char_pool+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_random_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_random_string_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = lv_length ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_char_pool TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    LOOP AT lv_random_string INTO DATA(lc_char).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( find( val = lc_char_pool sub = lc_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_random_string_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_random_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Erzeugung zufälliger Strings ist nützlich für Testdaten oder temporäre IDs. Hier wird ein Pool von erlaubten Zeichen definiert. `cl_abap_random_float` wird verwendet, um zufällige Indizes in diesem Pool zu generieren, und `strlen` sowie String-Operationen (`&&`, `+offset(length)`) werden genutzt, um den String effizient aufzubauen. String-Templates sind hier nicht direkt anwendbar, aber die String-Verkettung ist modern.
keywords: Random, String, cl_abap_random_float, String Processing, strlen

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) unter Verwendung von Zufallszahlen.
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 und prüfen Sie, ob sie kleiner als 0.5 ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flipper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_coin_result,
             result TYPE string,
           END OF ty_coin_result.

    METHODS flip_coin
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_coin_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flipper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_value < 0.5.
      rs_result-result = 'Kopf'.
    ELSE.
      rs_result-result = 'Zahl'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flip_coin FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_coin_flipper( ).
    DATA(lv_heads_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_tails_count) = 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).
      IF ls_result-result = 'Kopf'.
        lv_heads_count = lv_heads_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_result-result = 'Zahl'.
        lv_tails_count = lv_tails_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected coin flip result' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_heads_count + lv_tails_count = 100 ) ).
    " Due to randomness, we can't assert exact counts, but we can check if they are plausible.
    " For 100 flips, a range like 30-70 for each is usually acceptable for a basic test.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_heads_count GE 30 AND lv_heads_count LE 70 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_tails_count GE 30 AND lv_tails_count LE 70 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Simulation von Zufallsereignissen ist ein grundlegendes Konzept. `cl_abap_random_float` liefert eine Zahl zwischen 0 und 1, die ideal für binäre Entscheidungen wie einen Münzwurf ist. Die `IF`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um das Ergebnis basierend auf dem Zufallswert zu bestimmen.
keywords: Random, Conditional Logic, cl_abap_random_float, IF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zurückgibt. Die Gruppierung soll mit modernen ABAP-Features erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `REDUCE` oder `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid,
           ty_flight_count_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   count  = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_group_flights=>ty_sflights_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( it_flights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-count exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS`-Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.50), um interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht dies eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Art, Gruppierungsaufgaben zu lösen, ohne explizite `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Schleifen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Internal Tables, VALUE, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) gruppiert und für jede Gruppe eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Flugnummern (connid) dieser Gruppe zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `VALUE` und einer inneren `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_connid_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connids,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE ty_connid_tt,
           END OF ty_grouped_connids,
           ty_grouped_connids_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_connids_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_connids) TYPE ty_grouped_connids_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights_connids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_connids_by_carrid.
    rt_grouped_connids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights BY ls_flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                    connids = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight ( member-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_group_flights_connids=>ty_sflights_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_connids_by_carrid( it_flights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_connids).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_lh_connids-connids ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( '0400' IN ls_lh_connids-connids ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( '0401' IN ls_lh_connids-connids ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( '0402' IN ls_lh_connids-connids ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_connids).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_aa_connids-connids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( '0017' IN ls_aa_connids-connids ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( '0018' IN ls_aa_connids-connids ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Gruppierung mit `FOR GROUPS` um eine weitere Aggregation: Für jede Gruppe wird eine neue interne Tabelle mit spezifischen Feldern der Gruppenelemente erstellt. Die innere `FOR`-Schleife (`FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight`) in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht es, die Elemente jeder Gruppe zu transformieren und zu sammeln, was eine sehr flexible Datenverarbeitung darstellt.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Internal Tables, VALUE, Nested FOR, Aggregation

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Würfelwurf (Zahl zwischen 1 und 6) unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_float`.
hint: Skalieren Sie die Zufallszahl, um den Bereich 1 bis 6 abzudecken, und runden Sie auf die nächste Ganzzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS roll_dice
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_roller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD roll_dice.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ). " 0.0 <= lv_random_value < 1.0

    " Scale to range [0, 6) and shift by 1 to get [1, 7)
    rv_result = floor( lv_random_value * 6 ) + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_roll_dice FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_roll_dice.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = 0.
    DATA(lv_valid_rolls) = 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      lv_result = lo_cut->roll_dice( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_result GE 1 AND lv_result LE 6 ) ).
      IF lv_result GE 1 AND lv_result LE 6.
        lv_valid_rolls = lv_valid_rolls + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_valid_rolls exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie beim Münzwurf kann `cl_abap_random_float` verwendet werden, um einen Würfelwurf zu simulieren. Die Skalierung der Zufallszahl auf den Bereich [0, 6) und das anschließende Hinzufügen von 1 liefert eine Ganzzahl im gewünschten Bereich [1, 6]. Die `floor`-Funktion ist hier entscheidend für die korrekte Abrundung.
keywords: Random, Math, cl_abap_random_float, floor, Simulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Flugnummer (connid) berechnet. (Hinweis: connid ist ein CHAR-Feld, muss für die Berechnung konvertiert werden).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `REDUCE` und einer Konvertierung von `connid` zu `i`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_connid_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_avg_connid_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_connid TYPE f,
           END OF ty_avg_connid_by_carrid,
           ty_avg_connid_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_connid_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_connids) TYPE ty_avg_connid_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_connid_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_connid.
    rt_avg_connids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   avg_connid = REDUCE f( INIT sum = 0.0
                                                          FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                          NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( member-connid ) ) / lines( GROUP ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Flugdatum (fldate) gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit mehreren Schlüsselfeldern in der `BY`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_multi,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_multi,
           ty_flight_count_multi_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_multi WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_multi_key
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_multi_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_multi_key.
    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                   count  = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 10 zufälligen, eindeutigen Ganzzahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` in einer Schleife und speichern Sie die generierten Zahlen in einer Hash-Tabelle, um Duplikate zu vermeiden, bis die gewünschte Anzahl erreicht ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_int_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_unique_random_integers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_low   TYPE i
        iv_high  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_integers) TYPE ty_int_tt
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_random_integers.
    IF iv_count > ( iv_high - iv_low + 1 ) OR iv_low > iv_high.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid range or count for unique numbers'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA: lt_generated_numbers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA: lv_random_int TYPE i.

    DO.
      lv_random_int = floor( lo_random->get_next( ) * ( iv_high - iv_low + 1 ) + iv_low ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_random_int INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_duplicate.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
      IF lines( lt_generated_numbers ) = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_integers = VALUE #( FOR num IN lt_generated_numbers ( num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_unique_random FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_unique_random_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_unique_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_int_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 5.
    DATA(lv_low) = 1.
    DATA(lv_high) = 10.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->generate_unique_random_integers( iv_count = lv_count iv_low = lv_low iv_high = lv_high ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count ).

    " Check for uniqueness (by inserting into a hashed table)
    DATA(lt_check_uniqueness) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num GE lv_low AND lv_num LE lv_high ) ).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_check_uniqueness.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_uniqueness ) exp = lv_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_unique_random_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_int_gen( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    " Requesting more unique numbers than available in the range
    lo_cut->generate_unique_random_integers( iv_count = 10 iv_low = 1 iv_high = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Generierung einer Liste von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen erfordert eine spezielle Logik, um Duplikate zu vermeiden. Hier wird eine `HASHED TABLE` verwendet, da das Einfügen eines Duplikats eine Ausnahme auslöst, die abgefangen werden kann. Die Schleife läuft, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Eindeutigkeit zu gewährleisten.
keywords: Random, Unique, Integer, Hashed Table, cl_abap_random_float, Loop, Exception Handling

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS get_flight_price IMPORTING is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_price.
    READ TABLE mt_flights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_key-carrid
                                      connid = is_key-connid
                                      fldate = is_key-fldate

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = ls_flight-price.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer Hashed Table um einen festen Betrag. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Modifikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS increase_prices IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                      iv_increase TYPE sflight-price
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                                  WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) price = ls_flight-price + iv_increase ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer Hashed Table.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Konstruktor-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrid IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrid.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                               FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS check_flight_exists IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                            iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                            iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_flight_line_index IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                              iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                              iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rb_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_line_index.
    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_write_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_excel_from_data
      IMPORTING it_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_simple
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING   cx_openxml_format_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_write_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_excel_from_data.
    DATA(lo_excel_document) = cl_openxml_helper=>s_ooxml_cross->create_excel_document( ).
    DATA(lv_row) TYPE i VALUE 1.

    " Write header
    lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = 'A1' iv_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = 'B1' iv_value = 'Flight No.' ).
    lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = 'C1' iv_value = 'Price' ).

    ADD 1 TO lv_row.
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |A{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |B{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |C{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-price ).
      ADD 1 TO lv_row.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_excel_document->save_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_excel_document) = cl_openxml_helper=>s_ooxml_cross->create_excel_document( ).
    DATA(lv_row) TYPE i VALUE 1.

    " Write header

    lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = 'B1' iv_value = 'Flight No.' ).

    lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = 'D1' iv_value = 'Price' ).

    ADD 1 TO lv_row.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |A{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |B{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |C{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_excel_document->set_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = 'Flights' iv_cell_address = |D{ lv_row }| iv_value = ls_flight-price ).
      ADD 1 TO lv_row.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_excel_document->save_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Gruppierung von Flügen in einer Hashed Table nach Fluggesellschaft durch und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_carrid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT mt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_flight_count_by_carrid( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Zeilen und Spalten eines bestimmten Arbeitsblatts aus einer Excel-Datei (XLSX) und speichern Sie die Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `cl_openxml_helper`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_max_row`, `get_max_column` und `get_cell_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_read_all_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             cells TYPE string_table,
           END OF ty_excel_row.
    TYPES tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sheet_data
      IMPORTING iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
                iv_sheet_name    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_excel_data) TYPE tt_excel_data
      RAISING   cx_openxml_format_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_read_all_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sheet_data.
    DATA(lo_excel_document) = cl_openxml_helper=>s_ooxml_cross->get_excel_document_from_xstring( iv_excel_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_excel_document->get_max_row( iv_sheet_name ).
    DATA(lv_max_column) = lo_excel_document->get_max_column( iv_sheet_name ).

    LOOP AT cl_abap_int_table=>get_range( low = 1 high = lv_max_row ) INTO DATA(lv_row_index).
      DATA(ls_excel_row) TYPE ty_excel_row.
      LOOP AT cl_abap_int_table=>get_range( low = 1 high = lv_max_column ) INTO DATA(lv_col_index).
        DATA(lv_cell_address) = cl_openxml_helper=>s_ooxml_cross->get_column_name( lv_col_index ) && lv_row_index.
        APPEND lo_excel_document->get_cell_value( iv_sheet_name = iv_sheet_name iv_cell_address = lv_cell_address ) TO ls_excel_row-cells.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_excel_row TO rt_excel_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS add_flight IMPORTING is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight
                       RETURNING VALUE(rb_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE mt_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS update_flight_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                          iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                          iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
                                          iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
                                RETURNING VALUE(rb_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_flight_update) = VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate price = iv_new_price ).
    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM ls_flight_update.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Verbindungsnummern (connid) aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... NEXT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_connid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_connid.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_connids.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                           FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                           NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen aller öffentlichen Attribute einer gegebenen Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: mv_public_attr TYPE string VALUE 'Public Class Attribute'.
    DATA: mv_instance_attr TYPE string VALUE 'Public Instance Attribute'.

    METHODS get_public_attribute_names
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attribute_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attribute_names.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lt_attributes  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>attributes_table.
    DATA: ls_attribute   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>attribute_descr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        lt_attributes = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

        LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO ls_attribute WHERE visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
          APPEND ls_attribute-name TO rt_attribute_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
        " Handle class not found or other RTTI errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Typen der Parameter einer Methode einer gegebenen Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name`, `get_method_descr` und `get_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS example_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE string
        iv_param2 TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_param3 TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cv_param4 TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS get_method_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE clike
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parameters) TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD example_method.
    ev_param3 = iv_param1 && iv_param2.
    cv_param4 = cv_param4 + iv_param2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).
        rt_parameters = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
        " Handle class/method not found or other RTTI errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab( SELECT * FROM sflights ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_for_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0319' ] OPTIONAL ). "Should not contain AZ
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ).

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer Hashed Table.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol>` zur direkten Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflights.
    READ TABLE mt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_price.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = ls_flight-price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_failure FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_update( ).
    DATA(lv_old_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_new_price = '123.45' ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_updated ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_price exp = '123.45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_new_price exp = lv_old_price ).

    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_price = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_updated ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für einen bestimmten Carrier ('LH') aus einer Hashed Table unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck über die Hashed Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_xx FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_price.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_xx.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Operator, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` kann man sehr elegant und performant Summen oder andere Aggregationen über gefilterte Daten in einer Hashed Table bilden.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_math_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rv_result = cl_abap_math=>round( val = lv_raw_result decimals = 2 ).

CLASS zcl_math_div_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_div_zero IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table von Flugdaten, gruppieren Sie diese nach `carrid` und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugdauer pro Carrier. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Syntax wie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             fltime TYPE s_fltime,
             deptime TYPE s_fltime,
             arrtime TYPE s_fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate fltime.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_duration,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_duration TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_duration.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_avg_durations TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_duration WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_avg_flight_duration_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_durations) TYPE ty_carrier_avg_durations.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, fltime, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_avg_flight_duration_by_carrier.
    rt_avg_durations = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN mt_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_duration = REDUCE i(
                                  INIT sum_dur = 0
                                  FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                  LET lv_dep_sec = member-deptime DIV 10000 * 3600 + ( member-deptime MOD 10000 DIV 100 ) * 60 + ( member-deptime MOD 100 ),
                                      lv_arr_sec = member-arrtime DIV 10000 * 3600 + ( member-arrtime MOD 10000 DIV 100 ) * 60 + ( member-arrtime MOD 100 )
                                  IN NEXT sum_dur = sum_dur + ( lv_arr_sec - lv_dep_sec ) )
          lv_flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
      IN ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid,
           avg_duration = cl_abap_math=>divide( val1 = lv_total_duration val2 = lv_flight_count decimals = 2 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_duration_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_group_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_durations) = lo_cut->get_avg_flight_duration_by_carrier( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_avg> TYPE zcl_hashed_group_avg=>ty_carrier_avg_duration.

    READ TABLE lt_avg_durations ASSIGNING <fs_avg> WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_avg>-avg_duration ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_durations ASSIGNING <fs_avg> WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_avg>-avg_duration ).

    " Verify a specific carrier's average duration if known
    " For example, if LH has 2 flights with durations 3600 and 7200 seconds, avg should be 5400
    " This requires knowing test data, so a general check for non-zero is often sufficient for unit tests.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    " This test would require mocking sflights or creating a specific instance with empty data
    " For simplicity, we assume sflights always has data. If not, this test would need adjustment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_group_avg( ).
    " To properly test an empty table, the constructor would need to be mockable or accept data.
    " As is, it always reads from sflights.
    DATA(lt_avg_durations) = lo_cut->get_avg_flight_duration_by_carrier( ).
    " If sflights could be empty, assert_initial( lt_avg_durations ) would be appropriate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Zinseszins für einen Startbetrag über mehrere Perioden mit einem festen Zinssatz. Runden Sie das Endergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_math=>pow` und `cl_abap_math=>round` in einer Schleife oder iterativ.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_compound_interest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_compound_interest
      IMPORTING
        iv_principal TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 4 " e.g., 0.05 for 5%
        iv_periods TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_amount) TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_compound_interest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_compound_interest.
    DATA(lv_factor) = cl_abap_math=>add( val1 = '1.00' val2 = iv_rate ).
    DATA(lv_power_factor) = cl_abap_math=>pow( base = lv_factor exponent = iv_periods ).
    DATA(lv_raw_amount) = cl_abap_math=>multiply( val1 = iv_principal val2 = lv_power_factor ).
    rv_final_amount = cl_abap_math=>round( val = lv_raw_amount decimals = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei die Ziel-Tabelle eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle enthält, deren Felder ebenfalls entsprechend kopiert werden sollen. Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... FOR ... IN ... )` mit `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_itab_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        item_id TYPE i,
        item_desc TYPE string,
      END OF ty_item,
      tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_header_src,
        doc_id TYPE string,
        items TYPE tt_items,
      END OF ty_header_src,
      tt_header_src TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header_src WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_header_tgt,
        doc_id TYPE string,
        items TYPE tt_items,
        status TYPE string,
      END OF ty_header_tgt,
      tt_header_tgt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header_tgt WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_complex_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_header_src
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_header_tgt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_itab_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_complex_data.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_src IN it_source
                           ( MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_src TO CORRESPONDING zcl_move_corr_itab_nested=>ty_header_tgt( status = 'NEW' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Arten von Nachrichten (Erfolg, Warnung, Fehler) sammelt und diese anschließend als interne Tabelle zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_message()` mit verschiedenen `iv_msgty` und `get_messages()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_collector_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_various_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_various_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_success iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Operation' iv_msgv2 = 'successful' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_warning iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = 'Some' iv_msgv2 = 'warnings occurred' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_error   iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = 'Critical' iv_msgv2 = 'error' ).

    LOOP AT lo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      APPEND VALUE ty_message(
        msgty = ls_message-msgty
        msgid = ls_message-msgid
        msgno = ls_message-msgno
        msgv1 = ls_message-msgv1
        msgv2 = ls_message-msgv2
        msgv3 = ls_message-msgv3
        msgv4 = ls_message-msgv4
      ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_collection.
    DATA(lo_collector) = NEW zcl_msg_collector_types( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_error_count
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Should have one error message'
    ).

    DATA(lv_warning_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR msg IN lt_messages WHERE ( msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_warning ) NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'Should have one warning message'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den MD5-Hash-Wert des Inhalts einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`), um deren Integrität zu überprüfen.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die interne Tabelle in einen XSTRING und verwenden Sie `calculate_hash_for_xstring()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_internal_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_md5_hash_for_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_internal_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_md5_hash_for_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Serialize the internal table to an XSTRING
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_writer->get_xstring( ).

    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      if_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5
    ).
    rv_hash = lo_hasher->calculate_hash_for_xstring( iv_xstring = lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hash_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hash_sflights.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = NEW zcl_hash_internal_table( ).
    DATA(lv_hash1) = lo_hasher->calculate_md5_hash_for_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_hash2) = lo_hasher->calculate_md5_hash_for_sflights( ). " Calculate again for consistency check

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_hash1
      msg = 'Hash should not be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_hash1
      exp = lv_hash2
      msg = 'Hashes for identical table content should be equal'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Serialisierung der Tabelle in einen XSTRING mit `cl_abap_conv_x2x_writer` ist eine moderne Methode, um komplexe Datenstrukturen für das Hashing vorzubereiten.
keywords: Hash, MD5, Data Integrity, Internal Tables, Serialization, cl_abap_message_digest, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Integrität eines Strings, indem Sie seinen Hash-Wert mit einem zuvor gespeicherten Hash-Wert vergleichen.
hint: Berechnen Sie den Hash-Wert des aktuellen Strings und vergleichen Sie ihn mit dem Referenz-Hash.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_integrity_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_string_integrity
      IMPORTING
        iv_data         TYPE string
        iv_reference_hash TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_integrity_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_string_integrity.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
    ).
    DATA(lv_current_hash) = lo_hasher->calculate_hash_for_string( iv_input = iv_data ).

    IF lv_current_hash = iv_reference_hash.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_original_data) = 'Sensitive Data'.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_reference_hash) = lo_hasher->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_original_data ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_checker->check_string_integrity(
      iv_data         = lv_original_data
      iv_reference_hash = lv_reference_hash
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_is_valid
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Valid data should pass integrity check'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_tampered_data.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_hash_integrity_check( ).
    DATA(lv_original_data) = 'Sensitive Data'.
    DATA(lv_tampered_data) = 'Tampered Data'.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_reference_hash) = lo_hasher->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_original_data ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_checker->check_string_integrity(
      iv_data         = lv_tampered_data
      iv_reference_hash = lv_reference_hash
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_is_valid
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Tampered data should fail integrity check'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie den Nachrichtensammler, um Nachrichten mit spezifischem Kontext (z.B. einem Objekt-ID) zu versehen und diese kontextbezogen abzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_message()` mit zusätzlichen Parametern für den Kontext und filtern Sie Nachrichten beim Abruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_collector_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_context_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
             context TYPE string, " Custom context field
           END OF ty_context_message.
    TYPES: tt_context_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_context_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.

    METHODS get_messages_for_context
      IMPORTING
        iv_context TYPE string
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_messages) TYPE tt_context_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    ro_message_list = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF lv_item IS INITIAL.
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_error
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          iv_msgno = '007'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Item'
          iv_msgv2 = 'is empty'
          iv_context = lv_item " Using item itself as context for simplicity
        ).
      ELSEIF strlen( lv_item ) < 3.
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_warning
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          iv_msgno = '008'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Item'
          iv_msgv2 = 'too short'
          iv_context = lv_item
        ).
      ELSE.
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_success
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          iv_msgno = '009'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Item'
          iv_msgv2 = 'processed'
          iv_context = lv_item
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_messages_for_context.
    rt_filtered_messages = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_message IN io_message_list->get_messages( )
      WHERE ( context = iv_context )
      (
        msgty = ls_message-msgty
        msgid = ls_message-msgid
        msgno = ls_message-msgno
        msgv1 = ls_message-msgv1
        msgv2 = ls_message-msgv2
        msgv3 = ls_message-msgv3
        msgv4 = ls_message-msgv4
        context = ls_message-context
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Hash-Wert eines Strings unter Verwendung verschiedener kryptografischer Algorithmen (z.B. SHA1, SHA256, MD5).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest=>create()` mit unterschiedlichen `if_abap_message_digest=>alg_*` Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_algorithms DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_hash_result,
             algorithm TYPE string,
             hash_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_hash_result.
    TYPES: tt_hash_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_hash_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hashes_for_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashes) TYPE tt_hash_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_algorithms IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hashes_for_string.
    DATA(lt_algorithms) = VALUE string_table(
      ( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha1 )
      ( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 )
      ( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 )
    ).

    rt_hashes = VALUE #(
      FOR lv_algorithm IN lt_algorithms
      LET lo_hasher = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( lv_algorithm ) IN
      (
        algorithm = lv_algorithm,
        hash_value = lo_hasher->calculate_hash_for_string( iv_input = iv_input )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_hashes FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_hashes.
    DATA(lo_hasher_factory) = NEW zcl_hash_algorithms( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Test Data'.
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_hasher_factory->calculate_hashes_for_string( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should calculate 3 hashes'
    ).

    DATA(ls_sha256) = lt_results[ algorithm = if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ].
    DATA(lo_temp_hasher_sha256) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = lo_temp_hasher_sha256->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_input )
      msg = 'SHA256 hash is incorrect'
    ).

    DATA(ls_md5) = lt_results[ algorithm = if_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ].
    DATA(lo_temp_hasher_md5) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'MD5 hash is incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,

             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,

             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,

      RETURNING
