CLASS zcl_msg_collector_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_filter_errors.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_success iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '010' iv_msgv1 = 'Info' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_warning iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '011' iv_msgv1 = 'Warning' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_error   iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '012' iv_msgv1 = 'Error 1' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_error   iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '013' iv_msgv1 = 'Error 2' ).

    rt_error_messages = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_message IN lo_message_list->get_messages( )
      WHERE ( msgty = if_reca_message_list=>co_msgty_error )
      (
        msgty = ls_message-msgty,
        msgid = ls_message-msgid,
        msgno = ls_message-msgno,
        msgv1 = ls_message-msgv1,
        msgv2 = ls_message-msgv2,
        msgv3 = ls_message-msgv3,
        msgv4 = ls_message-msgv4

    ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Hash-Wert eines großen Datenstroms inkrementell, indem Sie Daten in Blöcken hinzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest=>create()`, `add_data()` und `get_hash_value()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_incremental DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_incremental_hash
      IMPORTING
        it_data_blocks TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_hash) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_incremental IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_incremental_hash.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
    ).

    LOOP AT it_data_blocks INTO DATA(lv_block).
      lo_hasher->add_data( iv_data = lv_block ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_final_hash = lo_hasher->get_hash_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_incremental_hash FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_consistency_with_single_hash FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_incremental_hash.
    DATA(lo_incremental_hasher) = NEW zcl_hash_incremental( ).
    DATA(lt_data_blocks) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Part 1 of ' ) ( 'the data stream.' ) ).
    DATA(lv_incremental_hash) = lo_incremental_hasher->calculate_incremental_hash( lt_data_blocks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_incremental_hash
      msg = 'Incremental hash should not be initial'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_consistency_with_single_hash.
    DATA(lo_incremental_hasher) = NEW zcl_hash_incremental( ).
    DATA(lt_data_blocks) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( ' ' ) ( 'World' ) ).
    DATA(lv_incremental_hash) = lo_incremental_hasher->calculate_incremental_hash( lt_data_blocks ).

    DATA(lo_single_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_single_hash) = lo_single_hasher->calculate_hash_for_string( 'Hello World' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_incremental_hash
      exp = lv_single_hash
      msg = 'Incremental hash should match single hash for concatenated data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die inkrementelle Hash-Berechnung ist entscheidend für die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen oder Datenströme, die nicht vollständig im Speicher gehalten werden können. `cl_abap_message_digest` unterstützt dies durch die `add_data`-Methode, die es ermöglicht, Daten blockweise hinzuzufügen, bevor der finale Hash abgerufen wird.
keywords: Hash, Incremental, Data Stream, Security, cl_abap_message_digest

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Datei, die in einer spezifischen Codepage (z.B. Shift-JIS) gespeichert ist, konvertieren Sie ihn in das Systemformat und geben Sie den konvertierten Inhalt zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` in Kombination mit `OPEN DATASET` und `READ DATASET`. Fangen Sie `cx_sy_conversion_codepage` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_file_with_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_convert_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_file_access
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_file_with_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_convert_file.
    DATA: lv_raw_content TYPE xstring,
          lv_file_line TYPE string.

    OPEN DATASET iv_filepath FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access.
    ENDIF.

    READ DATASET iv_filepath INTO lv_raw_content.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_filepath.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = iv_encoding
      endian      = 'BIG'
      replacement = '#'
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            data   = lv_raw_content
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_converted_content
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_file_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_file_access cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_file_access cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_conversion.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_read_file_with_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_filepath) = '/tmp/test_shiftjis.txt'.
    DATA(lv_shiftjis_content) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'SHIFT-JIS' )->write( data = 'テスト' )->get_buffer( ).

    OPEN DATASET lv_filepath FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    TRANSFER lv_shiftjis_content TO lv_filepath.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_filepath.

    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_reader->read_and_convert_file( iv_filepath = lv_filepath iv_encoding = 'SHIFT-JIS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted exp = 'テスト' msg = 'Shift-JIS conversion failed' ).

    DELETE DATASET lv_filepath.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_read_file_with_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_filepath) = '/tmp/test_invalid_encoding.txt'.
    DATA(lv_invalid_content) = 'Invalid byte sequence' ##XSTRING.

    OPEN DATASET lv_filepath FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    TRANSFER lv_invalid_content TO lv_filepath.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_filepath.

    TRY.
        lo_reader->read_and_convert_file( iv_filepath = lv_filepath iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_conversion_codepage but no exception raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_conversion_codepage caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.

    DELETE DATASET lv_filepath.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Dateizugriff mit Codepage-Konvertierung und robuster Fehlerbehandlung. Die Verwendung von `OPEN DATASET` und `READ DATASET` im Binärmodus ermöglicht das Lesen von Rohdaten, die dann mit `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` konvertiert werden. Die `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke sind entscheidend für die Handhabung von Dateizugriffs- und Konvertierungsfehlern, was ab ABAP 7.40+ als Best Practice gilt.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, File Handling, Data Conversion, Error Handling, cx_sy_conversion_codepage, OPEN DATASET

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status (STATUS) von Flügen in `sflights` basierend auf dem Flugdatum (FLDATE). Wenn das Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt, setzen Sie den Status auf 'COMPLETED', andernfalls auf 'SCHEDULED'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `UPDATE` Anweisung mit einer `CASE` Expression im `SET` Teil. Beachten Sie, dass `CASE` im `SET` Teil von Open SQL nicht direkt für alle Datenbanken verfügbar ist. Eine Alternative ist eine Schleife mit individuellen Updates oder eine temporäre interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    " Direkte CASE Expression im SET-Teil ist nicht in allen DBs/ABAP-Versionen
    " direkt unterstützt. Hier eine moderne Alternative mit internen Tabellen.

    DATA lt_sflights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-status = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-fldate < sy-datum THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'SCHEDULED' ).
      APPEND <fs_flight> TO lt_sflights_to_update.
    ENDLOOP.

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_sflights_to_update.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Status erfolgreich aktualisiert
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_status.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_update_sflights_status( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid_past) = 'AZ'.
    DATA(lv_connid_past) = '0010'.
    DATA(lv_fldate_past) = sy-datum - 1.
    DATA(lv_carrid_future) = 'AZ'.
    DATA(lv_connid_future) = '0020'.
    DATA(lv_fldate_future) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdatensätze existieren
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_past connid = lv_connid_past fldate = lv_fldate_past price = 50.00 currency = 'EUR' status = 'NEW' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_future connid = lv_connid_future fldate = lv_fldate_future price = 75.00 currency = 'EUR' status = 'NEW' )
    ) ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    lo_updater->update_flight_status( ).

    DATA(lv_status_past) = ''.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO lv_status_past
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_past AND connid = lv_connid_past AND fldate = lv_fldate_past.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_past exp = 'COMPLETED' msg = 'Status for past flight incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_status_future) = ''.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO lv_status_future
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_future AND connid = lv_connid_future AND fldate = lv_fldate_future.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_future exp = 'SCHEDULED' msg = 'Status for future flight incorrect' ).

    " Aufräumen
    UPDATE sflights SET status = 'NEW'
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_past AND connid = lv_connid_past AND fldate = lv_fldate_past.
    UPDATE sflights SET status = 'NEW'
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_future AND connid = lv_connid_future AND fldate = lv_fldate_future.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da eine direkte `CASE` Expression im `SET` Teil von `UPDATE` in Open SQL nicht immer universell unterstützt wird, ist eine moderne und performante Alternative, die Daten zunächst in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen, die Statuslogik mit `COND #()` anzuwenden und dann die gesamte interne Tabelle per `UPDATE FROM TABLE` zu aktualisieren. Dies nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax für bedingte Zuweisungen und effiziente Massenaktualisierungen.
keywords: UPDATE, sflights, Conditional Logic, COND, Internal Tables, Database Operations

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis (PRICE) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in der Tabelle `sflights` um einen festen Prozentsatz. Verwenden Sie dabei eine performante `UPDATE` Anweisung.

        iv_percentage TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_update_sflights_percent IMPLEMENTATION.

    UPDATE sflights SET price = price * @lv_factor

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen fehlerhaften String (z.B. ungültige Byte-Sequenz für die angegebene Codepage) mit `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` zu konvertieren und fangen Sie die spezifische Ausnahme `cx_sy_conversion_codepage` ab, um eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage` und die Attribute der Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = iv_encoding
      endian      = 'BIG'
      replacement = '#'
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            data   = iv_data_xstring
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_converted_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Hier könnte man detailliertere Fehlerinformationen loggen
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    " Eine ungültige Byte-Sequenz für UTF-8
    DATA(lv_invalid_utf8) = 'C328' ##XSTRING. " C3 ist Startbyte für 2-Byte UTF-8, 28 ist aber kein gültiges Folgebyte

    TRY.
        lo_converter->convert_with_error_handling( iv_data_xstring = lv_invalid_utf8 iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_conversion_codepage but no exception raised' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lx_caught_error->get_text( ) msg = 'Error message should not be empty' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_conversion_codepage caught as expected' ).

explanation: Die explizite Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_conversion_codepage` ist entscheidend, um robuste Anwendungen zu entwickeln, die mit potenziell fehlerhaften externen Daten umgehen können. Die Ausnahmeobjekte bieten detaillierte Informationen über den Fehler, die für die Diagnose und Fehlerbehebung genutzt werden können.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, Error Handling, cx_sy_conversion_codepage, Exceptions, Data Conversion

Instructions: Reduzieren Sie die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in der Tabelle `sflights` um einen festen Wert, aber stellen Sie sicher, dass die Anzahl nicht negativ wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE` mit einer arithmetischen Operation und einer `CASE` Expression oder `GREATEST` Funktion im `SET` Teil (falls von der DB unterstützt) oder eine temporäre interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_sflights_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reduce_available_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_reduction_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflights_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_available_seats.
    " Direkte GREATEST/CASE im SET-Teil ist nicht in allen DBs/ABAP-Versionen
    " direkt unterstützt. Hier eine moderne Alternative mit internen Tabellen.

    DATA lt_sflights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(lv_available_seats) = <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc.
      <fs_flight>-seatsocc = <fs_flight>-seatsocc + COND #( WHEN lv_available_seats > iv_reduction_value THEN iv_reduction_value ELSE lv_available_seats ).
      APPEND <fs_flight> TO lt_sflights_to_update.
    ENDLOOP.

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_sflights_to_update.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Sitze erfolgreich reduziert
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_seat_reduction FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_seat_reduction.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_update_sflights_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'DL'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0100'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0101'.
    DATA(lv_initial_seatsmax1) = 100.
    DATA(lv_initial_seatsocc1) = 50.
    DATA(lv_initial_seatsmax2) = 10.
    DATA(lv_initial_seatsocc2) = 8.
    DATA(lv_reduction) = 20.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdatensätze existieren
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = lv_initial_seatsmax1 seatsocc = lv_initial_seatsocc1 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = lv_initial_seatsmax2 seatsocc = lv_initial_seatsocc2 currency = 'EUR' )
    ) ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    lo_updater->reduce_available_seats( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_reduction_value = lv_reduction ).

    DATA(lv_updated_seatsocc1) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflights INTO lv_updated_seatsocc1
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_seatsocc1 exp = 70 msg = 'Seats for flight 1 not reduced correctly' ).

    DATA(lv_updated_seatsocc2) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflights INTO lv_updated_seatsocc2
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_seatsocc2 exp = 10 msg = 'Seats for flight 2 not reduced correctly (should not be negative)' ).

    " Aufräumen
    UPDATE sflights SET seatsocc = lv_initial_seatsocc1
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid1.
    UPDATE sflights SET seatsocc = lv_initial_seatsocc2
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um sicherzustellen, dass die Anzahl der belegten Sitze nicht die maximale Kapazität überschreitet (oder die verfügbaren Sitze nicht negativ werden), wird hier eine `COND #()` Expression verwendet, um den Reduktionswert dynamisch zu bestimmen. Die Aktualisierung erfolgt dann über eine interne Tabelle, was eine flexible und moderne Methode für komplexe Aktualisierungslogik darstellt.
keywords: UPDATE, sflights, Database Operations, Math, Conditional Logic, COND, Internal Tables

category: Data Integration, Database Operations, Data Conversion
Instructions: Lesen Sie eine externe CSV-Datei, die Flugdaten in einer spezifischen Codepage (z.B. ISO-8859-1) enthält. Konvertieren Sie die Daten in das interne Systemformat und aktualisieren Sie die entsprechenden Einträge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` für die Konvertierung mit Dateizugriff und `UPDATE FROM TABLE` für die Datenbankaktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_integrate_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_csv_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_csv_flight.
    TYPES: tt_csv_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_csv_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_file_access
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_integrate_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_update_flights.
    DATA: lv_raw_line TYPE xstring,
          lv_converted_line TYPE string,
          lt_flights_to_update TYPE tt_csv_flight.

    OPEN DATASET iv_filepath FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = iv_encoding
      endian      = 'BIG'
      replacement = '?'
    ).

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_filepath INTO lv_raw_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          lo_conv->read(
            EXPORTING
              data   = lv_raw_line
            IMPORTING
              buffer = lv_converted_line
          ).
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
          " Fehlerhafte Zeile überspringen oder loggen
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.

      DATA(ls_flight_data) = VALUE ty_csv_flight(
        carrid   = substring( val = lv_converted_line off = 0 len = 2 )
        connid   = substring( val = lv_converted_line off = 3 len = 4 )
        fldate   = substring( val = lv_converted_line off = 8 len = 8 )
        price    = substring( val = lv_converted_line off = 17 len = 10 )
        currency = substring( val = lv_converted_line off = 28 len = 3 )
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight_data TO lt_flights_to_update.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_filepath.

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Preis unter einem Schwellenwert enthält, wobei der Preis um einen Rabatt reduziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` für die Tabellenerstellung und `WHERE` für die Filterung.

CLASS zcl_itl_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_reduced,
      tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount  TYPE decfloat16 DEFAULT '0.10'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price < iv_max_price )
      (
        carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        price    = flight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount ),
        currency = flight-currency
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 600 currency = 'EUR' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '380.00' ).

Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten direkt im Ausdruck, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt, der Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen überflüssig macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.

CLASS zcl_itl_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit Akkumulator in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck zu formulieren, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als manuelle Schleifen und Zwischenvariablen.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über die Komponenten einer Struktur (z.B. einer Flugstruktur) und geben Sie deren Werte aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `DO ... TIMES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_structure_components.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA: lv_component_name TYPE string.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        APPEND |Fehler: Eingabe ist keine Struktur.| TO rt_output.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).
      lv_component_name = ls_component_descr-name.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ lv_component_name }: { <fs_component> }| TO rt_output.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |Fehler beim Zugriff auf Komponente { lv_component_name }.| TO rt_output.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_itl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_flight. " Return initial structure if not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Flugpreise für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die in der Zukunft liegen, und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` mit `VALUE`, `REDUCE` und mathematische Funktionen in einer Kette von Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fnc_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_future_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnc_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_future_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = FILTER #( 
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > sy-datum
    ).

    IF lt_future_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
      FOR flight IN lt_future_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_future_flights ).
    rv_avg_price = round( val = rv_avg_price dec = 2 ). " Round to 2 decimal places
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_itl_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        total_price TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_carrier_summary,
      tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_count)
      (
        carrid       = flight-carrid,
        flight_count = lv_count,
        total_price  = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BB' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 300 currency = 'EUR' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-total_price exp = '300.00' ).

Er ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Datenverarbeitung, die direkt eine neue, aggregierte Tabelle erzeugt.

CLASS zcl_cce_001_utf8_to_utf16 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cce_001_utf8_to_utf16 IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_cce_003_itab_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cce_003_itab_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding    = 'UTF-8'
      replacement = '#'
    ).
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf. "Platform-independent CR+LF

    LOOP AT it_input_strings INTO DATA(lv_line).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_line ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_output_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cce_004_xstring_to_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cce_004_xstring_to_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_table.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = 'UTF-8'
      replacement = '#'
    ).
    DATA(lv_string_buffer) TYPE string.
    lo_conv->read( EXPORTING data = iv_input_xstring IMPORTING data = lv_string_buffer ).

    " Split the string buffer by line breaks
    SPLIT lv_string_buffer AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_output_strings.

    " Remove potential empty last line if the xstring ended with a line break
    IF NOT rt_output_strings IS INITIAL.
      IF rt_output_strings[ lines( rt_output_strings ) ] IS INITIAL.
        DELETE TABLE rt_output_strings INDEX lines( rt_output_strings ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cce_007_csv_bom DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_with_bom
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cce_007_csv_bom IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_with_bom.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding    = 'UTF-8'
      replacement = '#'
    ).
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_tab) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab. " Using tab as separator for CSV example

    " Add BOM for UTF-8
    rv_csv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to_utf8( '' ). " This adds the BOM for an empty string

    " Add header
    DATA(lv_header) = `CARRID` && lv_tab && `CONNID` && lv_tab && `FLDATE` && lv_tab && `PRICE`.
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_header ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_line) = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ lv_tab }{ ls_sflight-connid }{ lv_tab }{ ls_sflight-fldate }{ lv_tab }{ ls_sflight-price }|.
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_line ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_xstring = rv_csv_xstring && lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer externen Datei (als XSTRING) ein, die in einer unbekannten Codepage vorliegt, und versuchen Sie, sie in UTF-8 zu konvertieren, wobei Sie die Codepage automatisch erkennen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cce_008_auto_detect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_auto_detect
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cce_008_auto_detect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_auto_detect.
    DATA(lv_detected_codepage) TYPE abap_encoding.

    " Attempt to detect codepage (this is a simplification, real detection is complex)
    " For demonstration, we'll assume a common scenario or pre-knowledge.
    " In a real scenario, you might use cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage_from_bom
    " or other heuristics.
    " For this example, let's simulate detection or assume UTF-8 if BOM is present.
    IF iv_input_xstring IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_input_xstring(3) = 'EFBBBF'X. " UTF-8 BOM
      lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-8'.
    ELSEIF iv_input_xstring IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_input_xstring(2) = 'FFFE'X. " UTF-16LE BOM
      lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-16LE'.
    ELSEIF iv_input_xstring IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_input_xstring(2) = 'FEFF'X. " UTF-16BE BOM
      lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-16BE'.
    ELSE.
      " Fallback or more advanced detection needed here. For demo, assume UTF-8 if no BOM.
      lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-8'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = lv_detected_codepage
      replacement = '#'
    ).

    " If BOM was detected, skip it for conversion
    IF lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-8' AND iv_input_xstring(3) = 'EFBBBF'X.
      lo_conv->read( EXPORTING data = iv_input_xstring+3 IMPORTING data = rv_output_string ).
    ELSEIF ( lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-16LE' OR lv_detected_codepage = 'UTF-16BE' ) AND ( iv_input_xstring(2) = 'FFFE'X OR iv_input_xstring(2) = 'FEFF'X ).
      lo_conv->read( EXPORTING data = iv_input_xstring+2 IMPORTING data = rv_output_string ).
    ELSE.
      lo_conv->read( EXPORTING data = iv_input_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_output_string ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, die sowohl Zeichen- als auch numerische Felder enthält, in ein XSTRING für die binäre Übertragung, wobei die Daten in einer spezifischen Codepage und Endianness vorliegen sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und iterieren Sie über die Strukturfelder, um sie einzeln zu konvertieren oder nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` für komplexere Szenarien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cce_009_struct_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data_record.
    TYPES: tt_data_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_records_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_records TYPE tt_data_records
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
        iv_endian   TYPE cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian DEFAULT 'DEFAULT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cce_009_struct_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_records_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding    = iv_encoding
      endian      = iv_endian
      replacement = '#'
    ).
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    LOOP AT it_records INTO DATA(ls_record).
      " Convert each field individually to ensure proper representation
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = |{ ls_record-id }| ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = ';' ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = ls_record-name ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = ';' ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = |{ ls_record-value }| ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = ';' ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = |{ COND string( WHEN ls_record-active = abap_true THEN 'X' ELSE '' ) }| ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_output_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und parsen Sie den resultierenden String zurück in die Strukturfelder.

CLASS zcl_cce_010_xstring_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data_record.
    TYPES: tt_data_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_xstring_to_records
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
        iv_endian   TYPE cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian DEFAULT 'DEFAULT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_records) TYPE tt_data_records.

CLASS zcl_cce_010_xstring_to_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_records.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = iv_encoding
      endian      = iv_endian
      replacement = '#'
    ).
    DATA(lv_string_buffer) TYPE string.
    lo_conv->read( EXPORTING data = iv_input_xstring IMPORTING data = lv_string_buffer ).

    DATA(lt_lines) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_string_buffer AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    " Remove potential empty last line
    IF NOT lt_lines IS INITIAL.
      IF lt_lines[ lines( lt_lines ) ] IS INITIAL.
        DELETE TABLE lt_lines INDEX lines( lt_lines ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      DATA(ls_record) TYPE ty_data_record.
      DATA(lt_fields) TYPE string_table.
      SPLIT lv_line AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_fields.

      IF lines( lt_fields ) = 4.
        TRY.
            ls_record-id = lt_fields[ 1 ].
            ls_record-name = lt_fields[ 2 ].
            ls_record-value = lt_fields[ 3 ].
            ls_record-active = COND abap_bool( WHEN lt_fields[ 4 ] = 'X' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
            APPEND ls_record TO rt_output_records.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion errors for individual fields if necessary
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,

  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

                                   text       = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Passagierzahlen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `ADD` Operator, um die Passagierzahlen zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_cond_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cond_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_date )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen `cl_gui_column_tree` initialisiert und die `SEU_TREE_CONTROL` Funktionalität simuliert, indem sie eine einfache Baumstruktur mit Knoten und Unterknoten aufbaut. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbefüllung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` Methoden wie `add_node` und `add_item` und bereiten Sie die Daten mit `VALUE` und `FOR` vor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_seu_tree_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_seu_tree_structure
      IMPORTING
        io_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_seu_tree_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_seu_tree_structure.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>nodes_table,
          lt_items TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>items_table.

    " Root Node
    io_tree->add_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = 'ROOT'
                                 i_relat_node_key = ''
                                 i_relationship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_first_child
                                 i_text = 'ABAP Objects' ).

    " Child Nodes using VALUE and FOR
    lt_nodes = VALUE #( ( node_key = 'CLASS_DEF' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Class Definition' )
                        ( node_key = 'CLASS_IMP' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Class Implementation' )
                        ( node_key = 'METHODS' parent_key = 'CLASS_DEF' text = 'Methods' )
                        ( node_key = 'ATTRIBUTES' parent_key = 'CLASS_DEF' text = 'Attributes' ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      io_tree->add_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = ls_node-node_key
                                   i_relat_node_key = ls_node-parent_key
                                   i_relationship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                                   i_text = ls_node-text ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Items for 'Methods' node
    lt_items = VALUE #( ( node_key = 'METHODS' fieldname = 'METHOD_NAME' value = 'CONSTRUCTOR' )
                        ( node_key = 'METHODS' fieldname = 'METHOD_NAME' value = 'RUN' ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      io_tree->add_item( EXPORTING i_node_key = ls_item-node_key
                                   i_fieldname = ls_item-fieldname
                                   i_value = ls_item-value ).
    ENDLOOP.

    io_tree->update_tree( ).
    io_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_tree.
    " Due to GUI dependency, direct testing of tree content is complex.

    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree,

CLASS zcl_flight_seats_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_avail,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsavail TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_with_avail.

    METHODS get_flights_with_available_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_avail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_seats_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_available_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                            ( carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid,
                              connid     = ls_sflight-connid,
                              fldate     = ls_sflight-fldate,
                              seatsocc   = ls_sflight-seatsocc,
                              seatsmax   = ls_sflight-seatsmax,
                              seatsavail = ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 err_msg = 'Tabelle ist leer' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_expected_avail) = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Verfügbare Sitze korrekt berechnet' act = ls_flight-seatsavail exp = lv_expected_avail ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen durchläuft und eine neue Tabelle mit den kumulativen Summen erstellt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und den `ADD` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR` Ausdruck mit `LET` und `NEXT` um den kumulativen Wert zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cumulative_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_cumulative_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cumulative_sums) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cumulative_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_sum.
    rt_cumulative_sums = VALUE #( LET lv_current_sum = 0 IN
                                  FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
                                  NEXT lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_number
                                  ( lv_current_sum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_cumulative_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cumulative_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 6 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_sum( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    lt_input = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( -5 ) ( 2 ) ).
    lt_expected = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ( 7 ) ).
    lt_result = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_sum( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt einen `FOR` Ausdruck mit der `LET`-Klausel, um eine lokale Variable `lv_current_sum` zu initialisieren und mit `NEXT` in jeder Iteration zu aktualisieren. Der `ADD` Operator wird hier verwendet, um die kumulative Summe zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und funktionale Art, kumulative Werte in einer neuen internen Tabelle zu erzeugen, ohne eine explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisung.
keywords: ADD, FOR, LET, NEXT, Internal Tables, Cumulative Sum, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Strukturtyp (z.B. 'SFLIGHT' oder ein benutzerdefinierter Typ) erzeugt und diese mit zwei Beispieldatensätzen füllt. Die Methode soll einen Referenz auf die dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Erzeugung. Für das Füllen verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.
        ENDIF.

        " Ersten Datensatz füllen
        CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field1> = 'Value 1'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field2> = 100. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

        " Zweiten Datensatz füllen
        CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field1>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field1> = 'Value 2'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field2>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field2> = 200. ENDIF.
        INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    END TRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lv_struct_name) = 'ZCL_RTTI_DYNAMIC_TABLE=>TY_TEST_STRUCT'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( lv_struct_name ).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
        ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht initial sein' act = <lt_dynamic_table> IS INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Tabelle sollte 2 Einträge haben' act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

        " Optional: Überprüfung der Daten
        READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_row>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster Eintrag FIELD1' act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value 1' ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_abap_invalid_data_reference wurde unerwartet ausgelöst.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erzeugung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` holt die Typbeschreibung einer Struktur, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` erzeugt daraus einen Tabellentyp, und `CREATE DATA` instanziiert die Tabelle. Das Füllen erfolgt generisch über Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, was Flexibilität bei unbekannten Strukturen bietet.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Table, CREATE DATA, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr, Field Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine interne Tabelle mit den Feldnamen und deren ABAP-Typen (z.B. 'C', 'I', 'D') der Zeilenstruktur zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` um die Tabellenbeschreibung zu erhalten, und dann `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` für die Feldinformationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_components
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA: lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type_descr->get_type_kind( ) ) TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_components.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            id   TYPE i,
            name TYPE string,
            date TYPE d,
          END OF ls_test_data.
    DATA: lt_test_table LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Test A' date = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Test B' date = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_components( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_table_components( lt_test_table ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Komponenten' act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).

        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'ID' INTO DATA(ls_id_comp).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Typ von ID' act = ls_id_comp-type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int ).

        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'NAME' INTO DATA(ls_name_comp).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Typ von NAME' act = ls_name_comp-type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string ).

        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'DATE' INTO DATA(ls_date_comp).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Typ von DATE' act = ls_date_comp-type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_abap_invalid_data_reference wurde unerwartet ausgelöst.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt RTTI, um die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` liefert eine Typbeschreibung der übergebenen Tabelle. Von dieser kann man über `get_table_line_type` die Zeilenstruktur erhalten und anschließend mit `get_components` eine Liste aller Felder und deren Typbeschreibungen abrufen. Dies ist essenziell für generische Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen als String akzeptiert. Die Methode soll die übergebene Tabelle dynamisch nach diesem Feld sortieren. Die Sortierung soll in aufsteigender Reihenfolge erfolgen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die dynamische `SORT` Anweisung mit einem Klammerausdruck für den Feldnamen: `SORT <internal_table> BY (<field_name>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sort_data.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ct_any_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " Prüfen, ob das Feld existiert
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in der Struktur gefunden.|.
        ENDIF.

hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` für beide Tabellen, um deren Zeilenstrukturen zu erhalten. Vergleichen Sie dann die Listen der Komponenten (`get_components`) auf Übereinstimmung in Name und Typ.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_table_types_compatible
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE ANY TABLE
        it_table2 TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_compatible) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_a,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_a.
    TYPES: tt_table_a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_a WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_b,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_b.
    TYPES: tt_table_b TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_b WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_c,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_c.
    TYPES: tt_table_c TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_c WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_d,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_struct_d.
    TYPES: tt_table_d TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_d WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_table_types_compatible.
    DATA: lo_table_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr1 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table1 ).
        lo_struct_descr1 ?= lo_table_descr1->get_table_line_type( ).

        lo_table_descr2 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table2 ).
        lo_struct_descr2 ?= lo_table_descr2->get_table_line_type( ).

        DATA(lt_components1) = lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ).
        DATA(lt_components2) = lo_struct_descr2->get_components( ).

        IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
          rb_compatible = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
          READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) INDEX sy-tabix.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR
             ls_comp1-name <> ls_comp2-name OR
             ls_comp1-type_descr->get_type_kind( ) <> ls_comp2-type_descr->get_type_kind( ).
            rb_compatible = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rb_compatible = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Spaltenüberschriften sollen dynamisch aus den Feldnamen der Tabellenstruktur ermittelt werden. Die Ausgabe soll formatiert sein, um die Lesbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` für die Feldnamen. Für den Datenzugriff verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. String-Templates können für die Formatierung verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_table_content
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_display_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_display_data.
    TYPES: tt_display_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_display_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_table_content.
    DATA: lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        " Header ausgeben
        DATA(lv_header_line) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
          NEXT s = s && |{ ls_comp-name ALPHA = OUT } | ).
        WRITE / lv_header_line.
        WRITE / |{ sy-uline( strlen( lv_header_line ) ) }|.

        " Daten ausgeben
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE ANY,
                       <fs_value> TYPE ANY.

        LOOP AT it_any_table ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
          DATA(lv_data_line) = REDUCE string(
            INIT s = ''
            FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
            NEXT s = s &&
              BLOCK (
                ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_value>.
                IF sy-subrc = 0.
                  s = s && |{ <fs_value> ALPHA = OUT } |
                ELSE.
                  s = s && |(Error) |
                ENDIF.
              )
          ).
          WRITE / lv_data_line.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode soll einen Referenz auf die dynamisch erzeugte Struktur zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit dem Parameter `p_components`. Die Typbeschreibungen für die Komponenten können mit `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind` erstellt werden.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_definition,
             name       TYPE fieldname,
             type_kind  TYPE c LENGTH 1, " e.g., 'C', 'I', 'D', 'P', 'S'
             length     TYPE i,
             decimals   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_definition.
    TYPES: tt_field_definition TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_definition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_structure
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_definition
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_structure.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_def-name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind(
          p_type_kind = ls_field_def-type_kind
          p_length    = ls_field_def-length
          p_decimals  = ls_field_def-decimals
        )
      ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = lt_components ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine bestehende Struktur (als `REF TO data`), einen neuen Feldnamen, dessen ABAP-Typkind und Länge akzeptiert. Die Methode soll eine *neue* Struktur erzeugen, die alle Felder der ursprünglichen Struktur plus das neue Feld enthält, und einen Referenz auf diese neue Struktur zurückgeben. Der Inhalt der ursprünglichen Struktur soll in die neue Struktur übertragen werden.
hint: Beschreiben Sie die ursprüngliche Struktur mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data`. Sammeln Sie deren Komponenten, fügen Sie die Definition des neuen Feldes hinzu und erstellen Sie dann mit `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` eine neue Struktur. Nutzen Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` für die Datenübertragung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_add_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_original_data.

    METHODS add_field_to_structure
      IMPORTING
        io_original_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_new_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_field_type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_field_length TYPE i DEFAULT 0
        iv_new_field_decimals TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_new_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_add_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_field_to_structure.
    DATA: lo_original_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_new_components        TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_new_struct_descr      TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_original_data> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_new_data>      TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN io_original_data->* TO <fs_original_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = 'Ungültige Referenz auf Originalstruktur'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_original_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_original_data> ).

        " Komponenten der Originalstruktur sammeln
        lt_new_components = lo_original_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        " Neues Feld hinzufügen
        DATA(ls_new_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
          name = iv_new_field_name
          type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind(
            p_type_kind = iv_new_field_type_kind
            p_length    = iv_new_field_length
            p_decimals  = iv_new_field_decimals
          )
        ).
        APPEND ls_new_component TO lt_new_components.

        " Neue Struktur erstellen
        lo_new_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = lt_new_components ).
        CREATE DATA ro_new_data TYPE HANDLE lo_new_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN ro_new_data->* TO <fs_new_data>.

        " Daten übertragen
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING <fs_original_data> TO <fs_new_data>.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist notwendig, da ABAP-Strukturen zur Laufzeit nicht direkt geändert werden können. RTTI wird verwendet, um die Komponenten der alten Struktur zu lesen, die neue Komponente hinzuzufügen und dann eine neue Struktur zu erstellen. `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` ist hier entscheidend für die effiziente Datenübertragung zwischen den strukturell ähnlichen, aber typverschiedenen Strukturen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen (als String) akzeptiert. Die Methode soll die Summe der Werte dieses Feldes berechnen, vorausgesetzt, es handelt sich um ein numerisches Feld. Der Rückgabewert soll vom Typ `P` (gepackte Zahl) sein. Falls das Feld nicht existiert oder nicht numerisch ist, soll eine entsprechende Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components`, um den Typ des Feldes zu prüfen. Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole in einer Schleife über die Tabelle, um auf die Feldwerte zuzugreifen und diese zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_dynamic_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_data_reference.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_data,
             product_id TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             price      TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sales_data.
    TYPES: tt_sales_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_sum.
    DATA: lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_elem_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_value> TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name INTO DATA(ls_component).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in der Struktur gefunden.|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_elem_descr ?= ls_component-type_descr.
        IF NOT lo_elem_descr->is_numeric( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist nicht numerisch.|.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT it_any_table ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_sum = rv_sum + <fs_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_data_reference EXPORTING text = lx_runtime_error->get_text( ).
    END TRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird in einer Schleife über die Tabelle iteriert, der Feldwert dynamisch über ein Feld-Symbol gelesen und zur Gesamtsumme addiert. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in ein CSV-Format als XSTRING, um sie für einen E-Mail-Anhang vorzubereiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates für die CSV-Formatierung und `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` für die Umwandlung in XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " Header
    lv_csv_string = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }| &&
                      cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Convert string to xstring
    rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string = lv_csv_string
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_conversion.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_bcs_csv_converter=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_csv_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_csv_string) = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                    'LH;0400;20250101;100.00;EUR' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                    'AA;0017;20250102;200.00;USD' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring( it_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_actual_csv_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(
      EXPORTING
        iv_xstring = lv_xstring
        iv_codepage = '4103'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_csv_string
      exp = lv_expected_csv_string
      msg = 'CSV XSTRING conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

METHOD create_html_xstring. DATA(lv_html_string) = |
