Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen XML-String und extrahieren Sie spezifische Attributwerte und Textinhalte unter Verwendung von `cl_xml_document` und dem `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML und navigieren Sie durch die Knoten. Der `FOR`-Operator kann für die Extraktion verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_xml_items
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_items.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>string_to_xstring( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_element_by_tag_name( 'items' ).
    IF lo_root IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'item' ).

    rt_items = VALUE #( FOR lo_node IN lt_nodes
                        LET lv_id = lo_node->get_attribute( 'id' )
                            lv_name = lo_node->get_text( ) IN
                        ( id = lv_id name = lv_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xml_parsing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_xml FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xml_parsing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml_string) =
      `<items>` &&
        `<item id="1">Apple</item>` &&
        `<item id="2">Banana</item>` &&
      `</items>`.

    DATA(lt_expected_items) = VALUE zcl_xml_parser=>tt_items(
      ( id = '1' name = 'Apple' )
      ( id = '2' name = 'Banana' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_items) = lo_cut->parse_xml_items( lv_xml_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_items )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_items )
      msg = 'Number of items mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_items[ 1 ]-id
      exp = lt_expected_items[ 1 ]-id
      msg = 'First item ID mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_items[ 1 ]-name
      exp = lt_expected_items[ 1 ]-name
      msg = 'First item Name mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xml_string) = `<items><item id="1">Apple</item><item id="2">Banana</items>`. " Missing closing tag

    TRY.
        lo_cut->parse_xml_items( lv_invalid_xml_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_xml_parse_error was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Parsen eines XML-Strings mit `cl_xml_document`. Die Extraktion der Daten erfolgt modern und kompakt mit dem `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE`, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert. Für XML-Sicherheitsaspekte wie digitale Signaturen oder Verschlüsselung würde man Klassen wie `cl_secxml_helper` verwenden.
keywords: XML, Parsing, FOR, VALUE, cl_xml_document, cl_secxml_helper

Instructions: Filtern Sie die interne Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Mindestpreis.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für eine kompakte Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_it_filter=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights(
      it_all_flights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
      iv_min_price   = '120.00'
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_it_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = lt_expected[ 1 ]-connid
      msg = 'Filtered flight connection ID mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Filterung von internen Tabellen. Er ist effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte, insbesondere bei komplexeren Filterbedingungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, sflights, Data Selection

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_it_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( price = '250.50' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( price = '50.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '400.50'
      msg = 'Total price calculation failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_it_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Schleifen für Aggregationen zu ersetzen, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Statusvariablen basierend auf einem numerischen Wert einen Text zu (z.B. 'High', 'Medium', 'Low').
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value > 100 THEN 'High'
      WHEN iv_value > 50  THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_status_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_status_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 150 ) exp = 'High' msg = 'Value 150 should be High' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 75 )  exp = 'Medium' msg = 'Value 75 should be Medium' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 25 )  exp = 'Low' msg = 'Value 25 should be Low' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 50 )  exp = 'Low' msg = 'Value 50 should be Low' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 101 ) exp = 'High' msg = 'Value 101 should be High' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine bedingte Zuweisung in einer einzigen Zeile, ähnlich einem Ternary-Operator in anderen Sprachen. Dies macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer als verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Assignment

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string, " This field will not be mapped automatically
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_operator=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = 'Value C'
    ).
    DATA(ls_expected_target) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_operator=>ty_target_data(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 123
      field_x = '' " Should remain initial
    ).

    DATA(ls_actual_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_target-field1 exp = ls_expected_target-field1 msg = 'Field1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_target-field2 exp = ls_expected_target-field2 msg = 'Field2 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_target-field_x exp = ls_expected_target-field_x msg = 'Field_X should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator bietet eine elegante und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) übereinstimmenden Feldnamen zu kopieren. Er reduziert den Boilerplate-Code im Vergleich zu manuellen Zuweisungen.
keywords: Data Transformation, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen komplexen String, der Variablen und Ausdrücke enthält, unter Verwendung von String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Backtick-Syntax (`` ` ``) und geschweifte Klammern (`{ }`) für Variablen und Ausdrücke.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle eines generischen Typs und befüllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Typisierung und Feld-Symbole für den Zugriff und die Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN ro_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    " Populate with some dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
    IF iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lo_sflight_line) TYPE sflight.
      ASSIGN lo_sflight_line->* TO <ls_line>.

      <ls_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
      <ls_line>-connid = '0400'.
      <ls_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
      <ls_line>-price = '123.45'.
      <ls_line>-currency = 'EUR'.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

      <ls_line>-carrid = 'AA'.
      <ls_line>-connid = '0017'.
      <ls_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
      <ls_line>-price = '678.90'.
      <ls_line>-currency = 'USD'.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_type_name FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_creation( ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <lt_sflight_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_sflight_table> msg = 'Table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sflight_table>[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First entry CARID mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_creation( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_create_data_error was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen dynamisch interne Tabellen basierend auf einem übergebenen Typnamen erstellt und befüllt. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Programmieraufgaben, bei denen der Datentyp zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, NEW, VALUE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für eine Division durch Null, um einen Programmabbruch zu verhindern und eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Re-raise for caller if needed, or handle internally
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Log error or handle gracefully
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Re-raise the exception if the caller needs to handle it
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 msg = 'Division result incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_arithmetic_error was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Konstruktion ist der Standardweg für die moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Hier wird eine Division durch Null abgefangen und eine Fehlermeldung ausgegeben.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY...CATCH, Exceptions, cx_sy_arithmetic_error

Instructions: Summiere alle Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die Preise zu addieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_concatenated_cities
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cities_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_concatenated_cities.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT cityfrom, cityto FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ flight-cityfrom }, { flight-cityto }|
        ELSE |{ result }, { flight-cityfrom }, { flight-cityto }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_cities INTO DATA(ls_city).

        lv_expected_string = |{ ls_city-cityfrom }, { ls_city-cityto }|.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights` vorhanden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ASCENDING
      LET count = GROUP SIZE IN flight
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_count(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = flight-carrid count = count )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    " Get expected counts from database
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_db_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_db_count.
    DATA: lt_expected_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_db_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sflights GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @lt_expected_counts.

    " Sort both tables for comparison
    SORT lt_actual_counts BY carrid.
    SORT lt_expected_counts BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_counts ),
      exp = lines( lt_expected_counts ),
      msg = 'Number of distinct carriers should match'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_counts INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_counts INTO DATA(ls_actual) WITH KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc,
        exp = 0,
        msg = |Carrier { ls_expected-carrid } should be found in actual results|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-count,
        exp = ls_expected-count,
        msg = |Count for carrier { ls_expected-carrid } should match|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`. Es ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle und das Aggregieren von Werten pro Gruppe. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. `VALUE tt_flight_count( BASE result ... )` wird verwendet, um die Ergebnis-Tabelle inkrementell aufzubauen. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, DATA, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY

CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_flights = REDUCE tt_carrier_flights(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_flights(
      )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ASCENDING
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_flights(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = flight-carrid
          flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
            FOR group_flight IN GROUP flight
            ( connid = group_flight-connid
              fldate = group_flight-fldate
              price = group_flight-price
              currency = group_flight-currency )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_nested_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_nested_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_data) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( ).

    " Get expected data from database
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_db_flight_data,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_db_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_db_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_db_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_db_carrier_flights,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE tt_db_flight_data,
           END OF ty_db_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_db_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_db_carrier_flights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    DATA: lt_db_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_db_sflights.

    DATA(lt_expected_data) = VALUE tt_db_carrier_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_db_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        flights = VALUE tt_db_flight_data(
          FOR group_flight IN GROUP flight
          ( connid = group_flight-connid
            fldate = group_flight-fldate
            price = group_flight-price
            currency = group_flight-currency )
        )
      )
    ).

    " Compare results
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_data ),
      exp = lines( lt_expected_data ),
      msg = 'Number of carriers should match'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_data INTO DATA(ls_expected_carrier).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_data INTO DATA(ls_actual_carrier) WITH KEY carrid = ls_expected_carrier-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc,
        exp = 0,
        msg = |Carrier { ls_expected_carrier-carrid } should be found|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lines( ls_actual_carrier-flights ),
        exp = lines( ls_expected_carrier-flights ),
        msg = |Number of flights for carrier { ls_expected_carrier-carrid } should match|
      ).
      " Further detailed comparison could be added if needed
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie eine kumulative Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, sortiert nach Flugdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und aktualisieren Sie eine Variable im `NEXT`-Teil, um die laufende Summe zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cumulative_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             cumulative_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_cumulative_price.
    TYPES: tt_cumulative_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cumulative_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cumulative_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cumulative_prices) TYPE tt_cumulative_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate connid.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING.

    rt_cumulative_prices = REDUCE tt_cumulative_price(
      INIT current_sum = 0
           result      = VALUE tt_cumulative_price(
           )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT current_sum = current_sum + flight-price,
           result = VALUE tt_cumulative_price(
             BASE result
             ( carrid = flight-carrid
               connid = flight-connid
               fldate = flight-fldate
               price = flight-price
               cumulative_price = current_sum )
           )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cumulative_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'LH'.

    " Prepare expected cumulative sums manually or by a simple loop
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_db_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_db_flight.
    DATA: lt_db_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_db_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate connid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_db_flights
      WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING.

    DATA(lt_expected_cumulative) = VALUE zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum=>tt_cumulative_price(
      INIT current_sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_db_flights
      NEXT current_sum = current_sum + flight-price,
           ( carrid = flight-carrid
             connid = flight-connid
             fldate = flight-fldate
             price = flight-price
             cumulative_price = current_sum )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_cumulative) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_prices( lv_test_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_cumulative ),
      exp = lines( lt_expected_cumulative ),
      msg = 'Number of entries in cumulative table should match'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_cumulative INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_cumulative INTO DATA(ls_actual) WITH KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid
                                                                  connid = ls_expected-connid
                                                                  fldate = ls_expected-fldate.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc,
        exp = 0,
        msg = |Flight { ls_expected-carrid }-{ ls_expected-connid }-{ ls_expected-fldate } not found|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-cumulative_price,
        exp = ls_expected-cumulative_price,
        msg = |Cumulative price for flight { ls_expected-carrid }-{ ls_expected-connid }-{ ls_expected-fldate } should match|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann, um eine kumulative Summe zu berechnen. Die `INIT`-Klausel deklariert sowohl die laufende Summe (`current_sum`) als auch die Ergebnis-Tabelle (`result`). Im `NEXT`-Teil werden beide Variablen in jeder Iteration aktualisiert. Dies ist eine elegante und funktionale Methode, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen, die über einfache Summen hinausgehen.
keywords: REDUCE, DATA, Internal Tables, Cumulative Sum, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und berechnen Sie die Summe und Anzahl pro Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_prices = REDUCE tt_avg_price(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_avg_price(
      )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ASCENDING
      LET sum_prices = REDUCE s_price(
                         INIT s = 0
                         FOR group_flight IN GROUP flight
                         NEXT s = s + group_flight-price )
          count_flights = GROUP SIZE IN flight
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_avg_price(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = flight-carrid
          avg_price = COND s_price(
            WHEN count_flights > 0 THEN sum_prices / count_flights
            ELSE 0
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_prices( ).

    " Get expected average prices from database
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_db_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_db_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_expected_avg_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_db_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price FROM sflights GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @lt_expected_avg_prices.

    " Sort both tables for comparison
    SORT lt_actual_avg_prices BY carrid.
    SORT lt_expected_avg_prices BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_avg_prices ),
      exp = lines( lt_expected_avg_prices ),
      msg = 'Number of distinct carriers for average price should match'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_actual) WITH KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc,
        exp = 0,
        msg = |Carrier { ls_expected-carrid } should be found in actual results|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-avg_price,
        exp = ls_expected-avg_price,
        msg = |Average price for carrier { ls_expected-carrid } should match|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Ausdrücken, um den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird ein weiterer `REDUCE`-Ausdruck verwendet, um die Summe der Preise zu ermitteln. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente. Die `COND`-Expression verhindert eine Division durch Null. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität von `REDUCE` für komplexe Aggregationen.
keywords: REDUCE, DATA, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, FOR GROUPS, Average

CLASS zcl_enum_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_color,
             red    VALUE 'R' FIELD 'FF0000',
             yellow VALUE 'Y' FIELD 'FFFF00',
             green  VALUE 'G' FIELD '00FF00',
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_color.

    METHODS get_hex_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_color TYPE traffic_light_color
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hex_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hex_code.
    CASE iv_color.
      WHEN traffic_light_color=>red.
        rv_hex_code = traffic_light_color=>red->field.
      WHEN traffic_light_color=>yellow.
        rv_hex_code = traffic_light_color=>yellow->field.
      WHEN traffic_light_color=>green.
        rv_hex_code = traffic_light_color=>green->field.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_hex_code = 'UNKNOWN'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_traffic_light->get_hex_code( zcl_enum_traffic_light=>traffic_light_color=>red )
      exp = 'FF0000'
      msg = 'Hex code for RED should be FF0000'

CLASS zcl_enum_order_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status_type,
             pending   VALUE 'P',
             confirmed VALUE 'C',
             shipped   VALUE 'S',
             delivered VALUE 'D',
             cancelled VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM order_status_type.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE order_status_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_order_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN order_status_type=>pending.
        rv_description = 'Bestellung ausstehend'.
      WHEN order_status_type=>confirmed.
        rv_description = 'Bestellung bestätigt'.
      WHEN order_status_type=>shipped.
        rv_description = 'Bestellung versandt'.
      WHEN order_status_type=>delivered.
        rv_description = 'Bestellung geliefert'.
      WHEN order_status_type=>cancelled.
        rv_description = 'Bestellung storniert'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannter Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle Mitglieder einer gegebenen Enumeration (z.B. die Ampelfarben aus ENM_002) und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI, speziell die Klasse `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR`, um Metadaten von Enumerationen zur Laufzeit abzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_color,
             red    VALUE 'R',
             yellow VALUE 'Y',
             green  VALUE 'G',
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_color.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_enum_member,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_enum_member.
    TYPES: ty_enum_members_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_enum_member WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enum_members
      IMPORTING
        iv_enum_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'ZCL_ENUM_ITERATOR=>TRAFFIC_LIGHT_COLOR'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_members) TYPE ty_enum_members_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enum_members.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_enum_descr) = cl_abap_enumdescr=>get_by_name( iv_enum_type_name ).
        DATA(lt_members) = lo_enum_descr->get_members( ).

        rt_members = VALUE #( FOR member IN lt_members
                              ( name = member-name
                                value = member-value ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., enum type not found
        " In a real scenario, log the error or raise a specific exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Log-Level (Info, Warning, Error) und verwenden Sie diese als typsicheren Parameter in einer Logging-Methode. Die Methode soll eine formatierte Log-Nachricht zurückgeben.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Enumeration und nutzen Sie den Enumerationstyp direkt im Methodenparameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM log_level_type,
             info    VALUE 'I',
             warning VALUE 'W',
             error   VALUE 'E',
           END OF ENUM log_level_type.

    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_level  TYPE log_level_type
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lv_level_text) = SWITCH #( iv_level
                                    WHEN log_level_type=>info    THEN 'INFO'
                                    WHEN log_level_type=>warning THEN 'WARNING'
                                    WHEN log_level_type=>error   THEN 'ERROR'
                                    ELSE 'UNKNOWN' ).

    rv_formatted_log = |[{ sy-datum } { sy-uzeit }] { lv_level_text }: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Die Datei soll ein Arbeitsblatt enthalten, das die Spalten `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`, `PRICE` und `CURRENCY` als Header und die entsprechenden Daten enthält. Die Ausgabe soll als XSTRING erfolgen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Erstellen des Workbooks, Hinzufügen eines Blattes und Setzen der Zellwerte. Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` für die Datenbeschaffung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_report
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_excel_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_report.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_worksheet.

    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_sflight,
            carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
            connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
            fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
            price    TYPE sflight-price,
            currency TYPE sflight-currency,
          END OF ls_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Get data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_worksheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flight Data' ).

    " Write header
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Currency' ).

    " Write data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einem gegebenen Excel XSTRING. Das Excel enthält ein Blatt namens 'Products' mit den Spalten 'ID', 'Name', 'Price'. Extrahieren Sie diese Daten in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Laden des Workbooks und `get_cell_value` zum Auslesen der Zellen. Beachten Sie, dass Sie ein gültiges Excel XSTRING als Eingabe benötigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: ty_products_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_product_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products) TYPE ty_products_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_product_data.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_worksheet.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    TRY.
        lo_excel->load_xstring( iv_excel_xstring ).
        lo_worksheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_name( 'Products' ).
        IF lo_worksheet IS BOUND.
          DATA(lv_row) = 2. " Assuming header in row 1
          DO.
            DATA(lv_id)    = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ).
            DATA(lv_name)  = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ).
            DATA(lv_price) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ).

            IF lv_id IS INITIAL AND lv_name IS INITIAL AND lv_price IS INITIAL.
              EXIT. " End of data
            ENDIF.

            APPEND VALUE ty_product(
              id    = lv_id
              name  = lv_name
              price = CONV decfloat16( lv_price )
            ) TO rt_products.
            lv_row = lv_row + 1.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid Excel format or sheet not found
        " In a real scenario, log the error or raise a specific exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS`. Formatieren Sie die Kopfzeile fett und zentriert. Die Spalte 'Price' soll als Währung formatiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `set_cell_style` und `set_column_width` für die Formatierung. Für Währung können Sie `CL_FDT_XL_STYLE_MANAGER` verwenden oder direkt den Format-String setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_formatted_report
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_report.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_worksheet,
          lo_style_manager TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_style_manager.

    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_sflight,
            carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
            connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
            fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
            price    TYPE sflight-price,
            currency TYPE sflight-currency,
          END OF ls_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_worksheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Formatted Flights' ).
    lo_style_manager = lo_excel->get_style_manager( ).

    " Define styles
    DATA(lv_header_style) = lo_style_manager->create_style( ).
    lv_header_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    lv_header_style->set_alignment_horizontal( if_fdt_xl_style=>c_align_h_center ).

    DATA(lv_currency_style) = lo_style_manager->create_style( ).
    lv_currency_style->set_number_format( '#,##0.00' ). " Example format

    " Write header and apply style
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Currency' ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lv_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style = lv_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_style = lv_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_style = lv_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_style = lv_header_style ).

    " Set column widths for better readability
    lo_worksheet->set_column_width( ip_column = 1 ip_width = 15 ).
    lo_worksheet->set_column_width( ip_column = 2 ip_width = 15 ).
    lo_worksheet->set_column_width( ip_column = 3 ip_width = 15 ).
    lo_worksheet->set_column_width( ip_column = 4 ip_width = 15 ).
    lo_worksheet->set_column_width( ip_column = 5 ip_width = 15 ).

    " Write data and apply currency style to Price column
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_style = lv_currency_style ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_excel_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM task_status_type,
             open      VALUE 'O',
             in_work   VALUE 'W',
             completed VALUE 'C',
             blocked   VALUE 'B',
           END OF ENUM task_status_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE task_status_type,
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES: ty_tasks_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_task_report
      IMPORTING
        it_tasks TYPE ty_tasks_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE task_status_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_excel_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_task_report.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_worksheet.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_worksheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Task Report' ).

    " Write header
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Task ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Task Name' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Status' ).

    " Write data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_tasks INTO DATA(ls_task).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_task-id ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_task-name ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = get_status_text( ls_task-status ) ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_text = SWITCH #( iv_status
                        WHEN task_status_type=>open      THEN 'Offen'
                        WHEN task_status_type=>in_work   THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                        WHEN task_status_type=>completed THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                        WHEN task_status_type=>blocked   THEN 'Blockiert'
                        ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_dynamic_sheets DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             daily   VALUE 'D',

CLASS zcl_enum_dynamic_sheets IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_report.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_worksheet.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.

    " Manually iterate through enum members (or use RTTI as in ENM_004)
    DATA(lt_report_types) = VALUE string_table(
      ( zcl_enum_dynamic_sheets=>report_type=>daily )
      ( zcl_enum_dynamic_sheets=>report_type=>weekly )
      ( zcl_enum_dynamic_sheets=>report_type=>monthly )
      ( zcl_enum_dynamic_sheets=>report_type=>yearly )

      DATA(lv_report_type_enum) = CONV report_type( lv_report_type_char ).
      DATA(lv_sheet_name) = get_report_type_text( lv_report_type_enum ).

      lo_worksheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = |Report: { lv_sheet_name }| ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = |Generated on: { sy-datum }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_text = SWITCH #( iv_type
                        WHEN report_type=>daily   THEN 'Täglicher Bericht'
                        WHEN report_type=>weekly  THEN 'Wöchentlicher Bericht'
                        WHEN report_type=>monthly THEN 'Monatlicher Bericht'

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Excel-Datei, die mehrere Arbeitsblätter enthält. Extrahieren Sie den Inhalt des Blattes 'Configuration' in eine interne Tabelle und den Inhalt des Blattes 'Data' in eine andere interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_sheet_by_name` für jedes Blatt und dann `get_cell_value` zum Auslesen der Daten. Sie müssen ein Beispiel-XSTRING für den Unit-Test bereitstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_row,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_row.
    TYPES: ty_config_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_row.
    TYPES: ty_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_multi_sheet_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
      EXPORTING
        et_config TYPE ty_config_tt
        et_data   TYPE ty_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_worksheet.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    TRY.
        lo_excel->load_xstring( iv_excel_xstring ).

        " Read Configuration Sheet
        lo_worksheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_name( 'Configuration' ).
        IF lo_worksheet IS BOUND.
          DATA(lv_row) = 2. " Assuming header in row 1
          DO.
            DATA(lv_key) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ).
            DATA(lv_value) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ).
            IF lv_key IS INITIAL AND lv_value IS INITIAL. EXIT. ENDIF.
            APPEND VALUE ty_config_row( key = lv_key value = lv_value ) TO et_config.
            lv_row = lv_row + 1.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.

        " Read Data Sheet
        lo_worksheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_name( 'Data' ).
        IF lo_worksheet IS BOUND.
          lv_row = 2.
          DO.
            DATA(lv_col1) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ).
            DATA(lv_col2) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ).
            IF lv_col1 IS INITIAL AND lv_col2 IS INITIAL. EXIT. ENDIF.
            APPEND VALUE ty_data_row( col1 = lv_col1 col2 = lv_col2 ) TO et_data.
            lv_row = lv_row + 1.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-col2 exp = 'DataB2' msg = 'Data col2 row 2 incorrect' ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_weekday_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM weekday_type,
             monday    VALUE 'MON',
             tuesday   VALUE 'TUE',
             wednesday VALUE 'WED',
             thursday  VALUE 'THU',
             friday    VALUE 'FRI',
             saturday  VALUE 'SAT',
             sunday    VALUE 'SUN',
           END OF ENUM weekday_type.

    METHODS get_next_working_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_day TYPE weekday_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_working_day) TYPE weekday_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_weekday_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_working_day.
    rv_next_working_day = SWITCH #( iv_current_day
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>monday    THEN weekday_type=>tuesday
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>tuesday   THEN weekday_type=>wednesday
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>wednesday THEN weekday_type=>thursday
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>thursday  THEN weekday_type=>friday
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>friday    THEN weekday_type=>monday
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>saturday  THEN weekday_type=>monday
                                    WHEN weekday_type=>sunday    THEN weekday_type=>monday
                                    ELSE weekday_type=>monday ). " Default to Monday
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_message_list.

    APPEND VALUE ty_message( type = iv_type text = iv_text id = iv_id ) TO mt_messages.

    rv_has_errors = xsdbool( line_exists( mt_messages[ type = 'E' ] ) ).

CLASS zcl_process_flights_with_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             id       TYPE string, " Added for unique identification
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      EXPORTING
        eo_message_list TYPE REF TO zif_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_flights_with_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_filter_flights.
    eo_message_list = zcl_message_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    rt_valid_flights = it_flights.

    LOOP AT rt_valid_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-price <= 0.
        eo_message_list->add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_text = |Flug { <fs_flight>-carrid }-{ <fs_flight>-connid } hat ungültigen Preis: { <fs_flight>-price }| iv_id = <fs_flight>-id ).
      ENDIF.
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid IS INITIAL.
        eo_message_list->add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_text = |Flug mit ID { <fs_flight>-id } hat keine Fluggesellschaft.| iv_id = <fs_flight>-id ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_error_ids) = eo_message_list->get_error_ids( ).
    IF lt_error_ids IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE rt_valid_flights WHERE id IN lt_error_ids.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

category: Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming
Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') haben und deren Preis unter dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge dieser Fluggesellschaft liegt.
hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Durchschnittspreis mit REDUCE und verwenden Sie dann DELETE mit einer komplexen WHERE-Bedingung oder einer FOR-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_below_avg
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_below_avg.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE price_t(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( FILTER #( it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ).

    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND price < lv_avg_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_delete_below_avg FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_below_avg.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_subquery( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 400 currency = 'EUR' ) " Below avg for LH (450)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 500 currency = 'EUR' ) " Above avg for LH
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = 450 currency = 'EUR' ) " At avg for LH
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250104' price = 300 currency = 'USD' ) " Not LH
    ).
    " Average price for LH: (400 + 500 + 450) / 3 = 450

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_below_avg( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ). " 500
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' ). " 450
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine "Subquery"-Logik in ABAP implementiert, indem man zuerst Aggregationen (hier: Durchschnittspreis mit `REDUCE`) berechnet und diese dann in einer `DELETE WHERE`-Anweisung verwendet. `REDUCE` und `FILTER` sind moderne Sprachkonstrukte, die die Datenverarbeitung in internen Tabellen sehr ausdrucksstark und kompakt machen.
keywords: DELETE, REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge enthält, deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, indem Sie eine REDUCE-Expression verwenden, die nur die gewünschten Elemente sammelt (effektiv die anderen "löscht").

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_selected_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( flight-carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Flügen. Behalten Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft nur den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis. Löschen Sie alle anderen Flüge innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und innerhalb der Gruppe eine Logik, um den höchsten Preis zu finden und die anderen zu löschen oder zu ignorieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS keep_highest_price_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD keep_highest_price_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_temp_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_max_price) = REDUCE price_t(
        INIT max_p = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = grouped_flight-price )
      ).

      DATA(ls_highest_price_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight(
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_group_key
        WHERE ( grouped_flight-price = lv_max_price )
        ( grouped_flight )
      ).
      APPEND ls_highest_price_flight TO lt_temp_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_unique_flights = lt_temp_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Flug-IDs. Für jede ID, die mit 'X' beginnt, fügen Sie eine Warnung zur Nachrichtenliste hinzu. Löschen Sie anschließend die verarbeiteten IDs aus der Originalliste.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression, um die zu löschenden IDs zu sammeln, und dann DELETE.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_list.
  METHODS add_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_type TYPE c LENGTH 1 " 'E' for error, 'W' for warning, 'I' for info
      iv_text TYPE string
      iv_id   TYPE string OPTIONAL. " Optional ID for the affected item
  METHODS has_errors
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.
  METHODS get_messages
    RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
  METHODS get_error_ids
    RETURNING VALUE(rt_error_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_message_list_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_list.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             text TYPE string,
             id   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_messages TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_list_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_list~add_message.
    APPEND VALUE ty_message( type = iv_type text = iv_text id = iv_id ) TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list~has_errors.
    rv_has_errors = xsdbool( line_exists( mt_messages[ type = 'E' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list~get_messages.
    rt_messages = VALUE string_table( FOR msg IN mt_messages ( |{ msg-type }: { msg-text }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list~get_error_ids.
    rt_error_ids = VALUE string_table( FOR msg IN mt_messages WHERE ( type = 'E' AND id IS NOT INITIAL ) ( msg-id ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_message_list
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO zif_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_list.
    ro_message_list = NEW zcl_message_list_mock( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_and_delete_ids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_delete
      IMPORTING
        it_ids TYPE tt_ids
      EXPORTING
        eo_message_list TYPE REF TO zif_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_ids) TYPE tt_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_and_delete_ids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_delete.
    eo_message_list = zcl_message_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    rt_remaining_ids = it_ids.

    DATA(lt_ids_to_delete) = VALUE tt_ids( ).

    LOOP AT rt_remaining_ids ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_id>).
      IF <fs_id> CS 'X'. " Check if ID starts with 'X'
        eo_message_list->add_message( iv_type = 'W' iv_text = |ID { <fs_id> } beginnt mit 'X'.| iv_id = <fs_id> ).
        APPEND <fs_id> TO lt_ids_to_delete.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_ids_to_delete IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE rt_remaining_ids WHERE table_line IN lt_ids_to_delete.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer haben, aber nur, wenn es keinen anderen Flug mit derselben Fluggesellschaft und einem höheren Preis gibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie LINE_EXISTS in einer WHERE-Klausel, um die Existenz eines "besseren" Fluges zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_complex_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_if_not_best
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_complex_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_if_not_best.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.

    DATA lt_flights_to_delete TYPE tt_sflight.

    LOOP AT rt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_current_flight>).
      " Check if there's another flight with the same carrier and a higher price
      IF line_exists( rt_filtered_flights[ carrid = <fs_current_flight>-carrid
                                          price > <fs_current_flight>-price ] ).
        APPEND <fs_current_flight> TO lt_flights_to_delete.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_flights_to_delete IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE rt_filtered_flights FROM TABLE lt_flights_to_delete.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_delete_complex_condition FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_complex_condition.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_complex_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 400 currency = 'EUR' ) " Should be deleted (LH 0401 is better)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 500 currency = 'EUR' ) " Should be kept (no better LH)
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 currency = 'USD' ) " Should be kept (no better UA)
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250104' price = 250 currency = 'USD' ) " Should be deleted (UA 0010 is better)
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_if_not_best( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexere Löschlogik, bei der Zeilen nur dann gelöscht werden, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung (hier: Existenz eines "besseren" Fluges) nicht erfüllt ist. Die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` in einer `WHERE`-Klausel ist effizient für die Prüfung der Existenz von Zeilen. Für die Löschung selbst wird hier eine temporäre Tabelle verwendet, um die zu löschenden Einträge zu sammeln, was eine sichere Methode ist, wenn die Löschbedingung auf der gleichen Tabelle basiert, die gerade iteriert wird.
keywords: DELETE, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge enthält, deren Preis zwischen 300 und 600 liegt und die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' durchgeführt werden, indem Sie eine FOR-Expression mit COND verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die FOR-Expression, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und die COND-Expression für die Filterlogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_complex
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_complex.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( flight-carrid = 'LH' AND flight-price BETWEEN 300 AND 600 )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
