Instructions: Validieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten. Flüge sind ungültig, wenn der Preis negativ ist oder die Fluggesellschaft leer ist. Sammeln Sie Fehlermeldungen in einer Nachrichtenliste. Erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle, die nur die gültigen Flüge enthält, indem Sie eine FOR-Expression mit einer COND-Expression verwenden, die die Nachrichtenliste berücksichtigt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die simulierte Nachrichtenliste (zcl_message_factory als Ersatz für cf_reca_message_list RE_CA_BC Nachrichtensammler: Factory) und eine FOR-Expression mit COND, um die gültigen Flüge zu filtern.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_list.
  METHODS add_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_type TYPE c LENGTH 1 " 'E' for error, 'W' for warning, 'I' for info
      iv_text TYPE string
      iv_id   TYPE string OPTIONAL. " Optional ID for the affected item
  METHODS has_errors
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.
  METHODS get_messages
    RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
  METHODS get_error_ids
    RETURNING VALUE(rt_error_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_message_list_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_list.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             text TYPE string,
             id   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_messages TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_list_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_list~add_message.
    APPEND VALUE ty_message( type = iv_type text = iv_text id = iv_id ) TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list~has_errors.
    rv_has_errors = xsdbool( line_exists( mt_messages[ type = 'E' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list~get_messages.
    rt_messages = VALUE string_table( FOR msg IN mt_messages ( |{ msg-type }: { msg-text }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list~get_error_ids.
    rt_error_ids = VALUE string_table( FOR msg IN mt_messages WHERE ( type = 'E' AND id IS NOT INITIAL ) ( msg-id ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_message_list
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO zif_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_list.
    ro_message_list = NEW zcl_message_list_mock( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validate_and_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             id       TYPE string, " Added for unique identification
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_and_filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      EXPORTING
        eo_message_list TYPE REF TO zif_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validate_and_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_and_filter_flights.
    eo_message_list = zcl_message_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    DATA lt_error_ids TYPE string_table.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-price <= 0.
        eo_message_list->add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_text = |Flug { <fs_flight>-carrid }-{ <fs_flight>-connid } hat ungültigen Preis: { <fs_flight>-price }| iv_id = <fs_flight>-id ).
        APPEND <fs_flight>-id TO lt_error_ids.
      ENDIF.
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid IS INITIAL.
        eo_message_list->add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_text = |Flug mit ID { <fs_flight>-id } hat keine Fluggesellschaft.| iv_id = <fs_flight>-id ).
        APPEND <fs_flight>-id TO lt_error_ids.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Use FOR expression to build a new table with only valid flights
    rt_valid_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( lt_error_ids[ table_line = flight-id ] ) )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             id       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_validate_and_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_and_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_validate_and_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( id = 'F001' carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 450 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( id = 'F002' carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = -10 currency = 'EUR' ) " Invalid price
      ( id = 'F003' carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 currency = 'USD' )
      ( id = 'F004' carrid = ''   connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) " Invalid carrier
    ).
    DATA lo_message_list TYPE REF TO zif_message_list.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->validate_and_filter_flights(
      EXPORTING eo_message_list = lo_message_list
      IMPORTING it_flights = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_message_list->has_errors( ) ). " Should have errors
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 'F001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 'F003' ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Datenvalidierung mit einer Nachrichtenliste (simuliert durch `zcl_message_factory` als Ersatz für `cf_reca_message_list RE_CA_BC Nachrichtensammler: Factory`) und der funktionalen Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle. Ungültige Datensätze werden identifiziert, Fehlermeldungen gesammelt und deren IDs in einer separaten Tabelle gespeichert. Anschließend wird eine `FOR`-Expression verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gültigen Flüge enthält, indem die fehlerhaften IDs mit `LINE_EXISTS` ausgeschlossen werden. Dies ist ein moderner, funktionaler Ansatz zur Datenbereinigung.
keywords: FOR, COND, LINE_EXISTS, Data Validation, Message Handling, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, cf_reca_message_list (simuliert), DELETE (conceptual)

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Preis außerhalb des Bereichs von 200 bis 800 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die DELETE-Anweisung mit einer WHERE-Klausel und dem NOT BETWEEN-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_outside_range
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_outside_range.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE price NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 800.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_delete_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_range( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 currency = 'EUR' ) " Delete (below range)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 400 currency = 'EUR' ) " Keep
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = 900 currency = 'USD' ) " Delete (above range)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250104' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ) " Keep (at lower bound)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0403' fldate = '20250105' price = 800 currency = 'EUR' ) " Keep (at upper bound)
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_outside_range( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = 400 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-price exp = 800 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE ... WHERE`-Anweisung ist die Standardmethode zum Entfernen von Zeilen. Der `NOT BETWEEN`-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante Definition von Bedingungen, um Zeilen zu löschen, deren Werte außerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs liegen. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber wichtige Funktion in der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: DELETE, BETWEEN, NOT, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und füllen Sie diese direkt mit dem `VALUE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid` und den `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( " Direct initialization of a sorted table
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Expected 4 entries in the sorted table'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'First entry carrid should be AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 4 ]-carrid
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Last entry carrid should be UA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid
      exp = 'DL'
      msg = 'Second entry carrid should be DL (due to sorting)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen, einschließlich sortierter Tabellen, in einer kompakten und lesbaren Syntax. Die `SORTED TABLE` stellt sicher, dass die Einträge immer nach dem definierten Schlüssel sortiert sind, was effiziente Zugriffe ermöglicht.
keywords: SORTED, VALUE, Internal Tables, Table Expressions

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag effizient aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lt_table[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS ... ]` oder `lt_table[ <index> ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_flight_data IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                      iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                            RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
                            RAISING   cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( " Initialize sorted table
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data.
    " Efficient read using table expression with primary key
    rs_flight = mt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zugriff auf sortierte Tabellen über Tabellenausdrücke mit `KEY primary_key COMPONENTS` ist äußerst effizient, da ABAP intern einen binären Suchalgorithmus verwendet. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Art, auf einzelne Zeilen zuzugreifen, ohne explizit `READ TABLE WITH KEY BINARY SEARCH` verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: SORTED, Table Expressions, READ TABLE, Performance

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in einer sortierten internen Tabelle und fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag hinzu, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` und `INSERT TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS update_and_add_flight IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                            iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                            iv_new_price TYPE s_price
                                            iv_new_fldate TYPE s_date
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( " Initialize sorted table
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' price = '150.00' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_and_add_flight.
    " Update an existing entry
    DATA(ls_update) = VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid price = iv_new_price fldate = mt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-fldate ).
    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM ls_update.

    " Add a new entry
    DATA(ls_new) = VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0050' fldate = iv_new_fldate price = '300.00' ).
    INSERT ls_new INTO TABLE mt_flights.

    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_and_add FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_and_add.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->update_and_add_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_price = '250.00' iv_new_fldate = '20250106' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-price exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'BA' connid = '0050' ]-price exp = '300.00' ).
    " Check sort order after insert
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 4 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MODIFY TABLE` und `INSERT TABLE` auf sortierten internen Tabellen stellen sicher, dass die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehalten wird. Dies vereinfacht die Datenverwaltung erheblich, da keine manuelle Sortierung nach Änderungen erforderlich ist. Die Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken für den Zugriff auf bestehende Daten ist hier ebenfalls modern und effizient.
keywords: SORTED, MODIFY TABLE, INSERT TABLE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle nach bestimmten Kriterien und erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle mit den gefilterten Ergebnissen, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( " Initialize sorted table
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250105' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250106' price = '180.00' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    " Filter using FOR expression with WHERE clause
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN mt_flights WHERE ( flight-carrid = iv_carrid ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0018' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `WHERE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung von internen Tabellen. Bei sortierten Tabellen wird die Sortierreihenfolge der Ergebnisse automatisch beibehalten, was die Weiterverarbeitung vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit des Codes erhöht.
keywords: SORTED, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei sortierte interne Tabellen zu einer neuen sortierten Tabelle, wobei Duplikate basierend auf dem Schlüssel vermieden werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `WHERE` und `line_exists`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS combine_unique_flights IMPORTING it_flights1 TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                             it_flights2 TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_unique_flights.
    " Combine two sorted tables, avoiding duplicates using REDUCE
    rt_combined_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight_sorted(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights1
        NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted( BASE result ( flight ) )
      FOR flight IN it_flights2
        WHERE ( NOT line_exists( result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ] ) )
        NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted( BASE result ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle, z.B. die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `GROUP BY` ähnlichen Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_totals TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_totals = REDUCE tt_carrier_totals(
      INIT totals = VALUE tt_carrier_totals( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      NEXT totals = VALUE tt_carrier_totals( BASE totals
        ( carrid = flight-carrid
          total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                        NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '120.00' )

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '180.00' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ]-total_price exp = '220.00' ).

CLASS zcl_bcs_create_email_with_att DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

                                            iv_text_content TYPE string
                                            iv_attachment_name TYPE string

CLASS zcl_bcs_create_email_with_att IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_email_document.
    DATA: lt_text_content TYPE bcs_text.

    " Convert string to BCS text table
    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( EXPORTING iv_string = iv_text_content
                                    IMPORTING et_soli_tab = lt_text_content ).

    " Create the document
    ro_document = cl_bcs_document=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = lt_text_content
      i_subject = iv_subject

    " Add attachment from XSTRING
    ro_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = iv_attachment_type " e.g., 'TXT', 'PDF', 'JPG'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( iv_attachment_xstring )

    ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie ein einfaches E-Mail-Dokument mit Textinhalt an einen Empfänger unter Verwendung von `cl_bcs` und `cl_bcs_document`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs=>create_persistent`, `set_document`, `add_recipient`, `send`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_simple_email IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                                        iv_subject         TYPE string
                                        iv_text_content    TYPE string
                                RAISING   cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_simple_email.
    DATA: lo_bcs       TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document  TYPE REF TO cl_bcs_document,
          lo_recipient TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs,
          lt_text_content TYPE bcs_text.

    " Create persistent send request
    lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Convert string to BCS text table
    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( EXPORTING iv_string = iv_text_content
                                    IMPORTING et_soli_tab = lt_text_content ).

    " Create document
    lo_document = cl_bcs_document=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = lt_text_content
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    " Set document to send request
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add recipient
    lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    " Send the email
    lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).

    " Commit work to ensure email is sent
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email FOR TESTING RAISING cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_email( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'test@example.com'. " Use a valid test email address
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Unit Test Email from ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'This is a test email sent from an ABAP Unit Test.'.

    " Note: Actual email sending cannot be fully asserted in a unit test
    " without mocking external systems. This test primarily checks if the
    " BCS calls execute without immediate exceptions.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_simple_email(
          iv_recipient_email = lv_recipient
          iv_subject         = lv_subject
          iv_text_content    = lv_content
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Email send process initiated successfully' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Email sending failed: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den vollständigen Prozess zum Senden einer E-Mail über die Business Communication Services (BCS). Es verwendet `cl_bcs` zum Erstellen der Sendeanfrage, `cl_bcs_document` für den E-Mail-Inhalt und `cl_cam_address_bcs` für die Empfängeradresse. Der `COMMIT WORK` ist entscheidend, um die Sendeanfrage im System zu persistieren und die tatsächliche E-Mail-Verarbeitung auszulösen.
keywords: cl_bcs, cl_bcs_document, cl_bcs_convert, Email, Send, BCS, COMMIT WORK

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_names
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Werte in einer internen Tabelle von Zahlen mit einer einzigen Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_mixed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_positive.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_empty.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_mixed.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( -5 ) ( 2 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 7 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP 7.40+. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable (`s`) aktualisiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, functional programming, internal tables, sum, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl freier Plätze.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc < iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch, die eine Division durch Null sicher abfängt und einen Standardwert zurückgibt, anstatt einen Dump zu verursachen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_math=>divide`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE decfloat34
        iv_denominator TYPE decfloat34
        iv_default_val TYPE decfloat34 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = cl_abap_math=>divide(
          val1 = iv_numerator
          val2 = iv_denominator
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        IF iv_default_val IS SUPPLIED.
          rv_result = iv_default_val.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 0. "Default to 0 if no default value supplied
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Fluges basierend auf der `SEATSCC`-Belegung anzeigt (z.B. 'Full' wenn `SEATSCC = SEATSOCC`, 'Available' sonst). Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN` im `SELECT`-Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN` direkt im `SELECT`-Statement für die bedingte Spaltenberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax,
           CASE WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'Full'
                ELSE 'Available'
           END AS status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_status
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for demo
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    " Check if at least one entry has a valid status
    DATA(lv_found_full) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_available) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-status = 'Full'.
        lv_found_full = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-status = 'Available'.
        lv_found_available = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = lv_found_full OR lv_found_available ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE WHEN` in Open SQL ermöglicht die direkte bedingte Berechnung von Spaltenwerten auf der Datenbankebene, was die Datenübertragung reduziert und die Performance verbessert, da keine Nachbearbeitung in ABAP erforderlich ist.
keywords: SQL, CASE WHEN, Database Access, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `SEATSOCC` aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte `CARRID` haben. Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` über eine interne Tabelle und filtern Sie mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS. " Get some data

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_total_aa) TYPE i.

    " Assuming 'LH' and 'AA' exist in SFLIGHT for testing
    lv_total_lh = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( 'LH' ).
    lv_total_aa = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( 'AA' ).

    " Basic check: sum should be non-negative
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_lh >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_aa >= 0 ).

    " More specific test if we know expected values or can mock SFLIGHT
    IF lv_total_lh > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_lh > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_total_aa > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_aa > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb von `FOR` dient hier als implizites `WHEN`, um nur relevante Einträge in die Aggregation einzubeziehen, was den Code sehr kompakt macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte `CARRID` und `CONNID` haben. Verwenden Sie die `FOR`-Expression mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` um die Tabelle zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Get some data

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_key) TYPE zcl_for_filter_sflight=>ty_flight_key.
    ls_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_key-connid = '0400'. " Example values, adjust if needed

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ls_key ).

    " Assert that all filtered entries match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = ls_key-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = ls_key-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some results are returned if data exists
    IF lines( lt_filtered ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_filtered ) > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern und neue Tabellen zu konstruieren. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft performanter als explizite `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ... ENDLOOP`-Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster, um verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien für einen Preis zu ermöglichen. Definieren Sie ein Interface für die Strategie und zwei konkrete Strategie-Klassen (z.B. Rabattstrategie, Aufschlagstrategie). Eine Kontext-Klasse soll die Strategie zur Laufzeit austauschen können.
hint: Das Interface definiert die `calculate`-Methode, die Strategie-Klassen implementieren diese.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_price_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_price
    IMPORTING
      iv_base_price TYPE decfloat16
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_discount_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_price_strategy.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_discount_rate = iv_discount_rate.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_price_strategy~calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price * ( 1 - mv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_markup_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_price_strategy.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_markup_rate TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_markup_rate TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_markup_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_markup_rate = iv_markup_rate.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_price_strategy~calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price * ( 1 + mv_markup_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_price_strategy.
    METHODS get_final_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_price_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_final_price.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_final_price = mo_strategy->calculate_price( iv_base_price ).
    ELSE.
      rv_final_price = iv_base_price. " No strategy, return base price
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_price_context( ).
    DATA(lv_base_price) TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_final_price) TYPE decfloat16.

    " Test Discount Strategy (10% discount)
    DATA(lo_discount_strategy) = NEW zcl_discount_strategy( '0.10' ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( lo_discount_strategy ).
    lv_final_price = lo_context->get_final_price( lv_base_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = '90.00' ).

    " Test Markup Strategy (20% markup)
    DATA(lo_markup_strategy) = NEW zcl_markup_strategy( '0.20' ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( lo_markup_strategy ).
    lv_final_price = lo_context->get_final_price( lv_base_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = '120.00' ).

    " Test no strategy
    lo_context->set_strategy( CAST zif_price_strategy( cl_abap_objectdescr=>get_null_object_ref( ) ) ). " Set to null
    lv_final_price = lo_context->get_final_price( lv_base_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster nutzt Interfaces, um austauschbare Algorithmen zu definieren. Dies fördert die Kapselung von Algorithmen, ermöglicht deren unabhängige Variation und verbessert die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: INTERFACE, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Für jede Gruppe sollen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) berechnen. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb des Gruppen-Loops `REDUCE` oder `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seatsocc TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS. " Get some data

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_seats = lv_total_seats + ls_group_member-seatsocc.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        total_seatsocc = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped_data ).

    " Check if grouping and aggregation works for at least one entry
    DATA(ls_first_group) TYPE zcl_group_sflight=>ty_flight_group.
    READ TABLE lt_grouped_data INDEX 1 INTO ls_first_group.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_group-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_group-total_seatsocc >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` (ab 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und lesbare Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die Aggregation innerhalb des Gruppen-Loops kann mit einfachen Zählern oder komplexeren Ausdrücken erfolgen, was die Datenverarbeitung in ABAP erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie ein Interface verwendet werden kann, um Abhängigkeiten in Unit Tests zu mocken. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von einem Service-Interface abhängt, und einen Unit Test, der eine Mock-Implementierung des Interfaces verwendet.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für den Service und implementieren Sie eine Mock-Klasse für den Test.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_service PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_id TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_real_data_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_real_data_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_service~get_data.
    " Simulate real data retrieval (e.g., from DB or external system)
    rv_data = |Real data for ID { iv_id }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_data_service TYPE REF TO zif_data_service.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_service TYPE REF TO zif_data_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_service = io_data_service.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_raw_data) = mo_data_service->get_data( iv_input_id ).
    rv_processed_data = |Processed: { lv_raw_data }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mocking_with_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  " Mock implementation of the data service interface
  CLASS lcl_mock_data_service DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
    PUBLIC SECTION.
      INTERFACES zif_data_service.
      DATA mv_mock_return_value TYPE string.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS lcl_mock_data_service IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD zif_data_service~get_data.
      rv_data = mv_mock_return_value.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_mocking_with_interface.
    DATA(lo_mock_service) = NEW lcl_mock_data_service( ).
    lo_mock_service->mv_mock_return_value = 'Mocked Data'.

    DATA(lo_app_logic) = NEW zcl_application_logic( lo_mock_service ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_app_logic->process_data( '123' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Mocked Data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces sind entscheidend für die Implementierung von Mocking in Unit Tests. Sie ermöglichen es, echte Abhängigkeiten durch Test-Doubles (Mocks) zu ersetzen, die vordefinierte Antworten liefern. Dies isoliert die zu testende Einheit und macht Tests schneller, zuverlässiger und unabhängiger von externen Systemen.
keywords: INTERFACE, Mocking, Unit Testing, Dependency Injection

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA') und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen und den `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `VALUE #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flights_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und der `VALUE`-Operator (implizit durch `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) ermöglichen eine kompaktere und lesbarere Code-Schreibweise, da Variablen direkt dort deklariert werden, wo sie benötigt werden. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Fluggesellschaft und eine Flugnummer entgegennimmt und einen formatierten String zurückgibt, z.B. 'Flug AA 001 ist bereit zum Abflug'.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_flight_info
      IMPORTING

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_format_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_string_formatter( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flügen (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum, Preis) entgegennimmt und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und den Preis enthält, wobei der Preis um 10% erhöht wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in einer `VALUE`-Expression, um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        price  = flight-price * '1.10' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_flights_in(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output_flights) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_output_flights ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Output table should have 2 entries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output_flights[ 1 ]-carrid,
      exp = 'AA',
      msg = 'First entry carrier should be AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output_flights[ 1 ]-price,
      exp = '110.00',
      msg = 'First entry price should be 110.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output_flights[ 2 ]-price,
      exp = '220.00',
      msg = 'Second entry price should be 220.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben, kann man die Logik zur Erzeugung neuer Zeilen direkt im Ausdruck definieren, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene interne Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = '50.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price,
      exp = '350.00',
      msg = 'Total price should be 350.00'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_price) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_empty_price,
      exp = '0.00',
      msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit Akkumulator in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu formulieren, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP` mit manueller Summenbildung.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator in einer `VALUE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      it_flights
      WHERE price > iv_min_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = '50.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_price(
      it_flights = lt_input_flights,
      iv_min_price = '150.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ),
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'Only one flight should remain after filtering'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid,
      exp = 'LH',
      msg = 'The remaining flight should be LH'
    ).

    DATA(lt_no_match) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_price(
      it_flights = lt_input_flights,
      iv_min_price = '300.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      lt_no_match,
      msg = 'No flights should remain if min_price is too high'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` und erzeugt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen, ohne den Originalinhalt zu modifizieren. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Flugpreis entgegennimmt und einen Status-String zurückgibt: 'Günstig' wenn der Preis unter 100 ist, sonst 'Normal'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_price_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_status.
    rv_status = COND string(

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_price_status.
    DATA(lo_status) = NEW zcl_price_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_status->get_price_status( '50.00' ),

keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA', 'LH', 'UA') entgegennimmt und den vollen Namen der Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt. Für unbekannte Codes soll 'Unbekannt' zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung basierend auf mehreren Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_code TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_name.
    rv_carrier_name = SWITCH string( iv_carrier_code
      WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
      WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
      WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_name.
    DATA(lo_resolver) = NEW zcl_carrier_resolver( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_resolver->get_carrier_name( 'AA' ),
      exp = 'American Airlines',
      msg = 'AA should resolve to American Airlines'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_resolver->get_carrier_name( 'LH' ),
      exp = 'Lufthansa',
      msg = 'LH should resolve to Lufthansa'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_resolver->get_carrier_name( 'XX' ),
      exp = 'Unbekannt',
      msg = 'XX should resolve to Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine elegante und moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Strukturen oder `CASE ... WHEN ... ENDCASE` für die bedingte Zuweisung basierend auf einem Wert. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights`-Daten entgegennimmt und diese in einem modernen ALV-Grid mit `cl_salv_table` anzeigt. Die Methode zur Anzeige soll im `PUBLIC SECTION` der Klasse definiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` und die Methoden des ALV-Objekts zur Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_alv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_flight_alv_display IMPLEMENTATION.

        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING

          IMPORTING

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_flights.
    DATA(lo_alv_display) = NEW zcl_flight_alv_display( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_alv_display=>tt_flights_alv(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )

        i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IT_FLIGHTS' value = REF #( lt_test_flights ) ) )
      ),

    ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_salv_table` ist die moderne, objektorientierte Klasse zur Anzeige von ALV-Listen. Sie bietet eine flexible und erweiterbare API im Vergleich zu den älteren Funktionsbausteinen (`REUSE_ALV_GRID_DISPLAY`). Die Kapselung der Anzeigelogik in einer Klasse mit einer `PUBLIC SECTION`-Methode fördert die Objektorientierung und Wiederverwendbarkeit.
keywords: ALV, cl_salv_table, Object Orientation, PUBLIC SECTION, GUI

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden sollen. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit Flugdaten, bei denen die Zielstruktur weniger Felder hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_source.
    TYPES tt_flight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_target,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_target.
    TYPES tt_flight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_flight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_flight_target.

    METHODS map_flight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_flight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_flight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_flight_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flight_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_flight_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_flight_source(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_flight_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-price exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_flight_table.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>tt_flight_source(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_mapper->map_flight_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu verschieben, deren Feldnamen teilweise übereinstimmen. Er ersetzt manuelle Zuweisungen oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` und ist besonders nützlich, wenn Quell- und Zielstrukturen unterschiedliche Feldmengen haben, aber gemeinsame Felder übertragen werden sollen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Manipulation, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die jeweils einen Wert zurückgeben. Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung der Klasse mit dem `NEW`-Operator und das Aufrufen mehrerer Methoden in einer Kette (Method Chaining).
hint: Sorgen Sie dafür, dass die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.

    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_final_result) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( iv_initial_value = 10 )->add( 5 )->subtract( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_final_result,
      exp = 13,
      msg = 'Chained calculation should result in 13'
    ).

    DATA(lv_another_result) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( )->add( 100 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_another_result,
      exp = 100,
      msg = 'Initial value 0 + 100 should be 100'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator ermöglicht die Instanziierung von Objekten direkt in Ausdrücken, was den Code kompakter macht. Method Chaining, bei dem Methoden das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben, erlaubt es, mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, ähnlich wie in anderen modernen Programmiersprachen.
keywords: NEW, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, PUBLIC SECTION, READ-ONLY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einem `READ-ONLY` Attribut und einem Konstruktor, der einen optionalen Parameter akzeptiert. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des optionalen Parameters und den Zugriff auf das `READ-ONLY` Attribut.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPTIONAL` im Methodenparameter und `READ-ONLY` für das Attribut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_person DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_age  TYPE i      READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_age  TYPE i OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_description
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_person IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
    IF iv_age IS SUPPLIED.
      mv_age = iv_age.
    ELSE.
      mv_age = 0. " Default age if not supplied
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = |Name: { mv_name }, Alter: { mv_age }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_person_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_person_creation.
    DATA(lo_person1) = NEW zcl_person( iv_name = 'Alice' iv_age = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_person1->mv_name exp = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_person1->mv_age exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_person1->get_description( ) exp = 'Name: Alice, Alter: 30' ).

    DATA(lo_person2) = NEW zcl_person( iv_name = 'Bob' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_person2->mv_name exp = 'Bob' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_person2->mv_age exp = 0 ). " Default age
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_person2->get_description( ) exp = 'Name: Bob, Alter: 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `OPTIONAL`-Parameter in Methoden und Konstruktoren ermöglichen flexiblere Schnittstellen, da nicht alle Parameter bei jedem Aufruf übergeben werden müssen. `READ-ONLY`-Attribute (`READ-ONLY`) stellen sicher, dass der Wert eines Attributs nach der Instanziierung nur innerhalb der Klasse geändert werden kann, was die Datenintegrität und Kapselung verbessert. Dies sind wichtige Konzepte für modernes, robustes objektorientiertes Design.
keywords: OPTIONAL, READ-ONLY, Object Orientation, Constructor, PUBLIC SECTION

Instructions: Lesen Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und nur für diejenigen Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... HAVING ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carriers_with_many_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_analyzer->get_carriers_with_many_flights( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_flights).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_flights-flight_count > 5 ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_no_match) = lo_analyzer->get_carriers_with_many_flights( 9999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_no_match ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT(*)`) und `GROUP BY` sowie `HAVING` in der `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`-Klausel. Dies ermöglicht es, komplexe Datenbankabfragen direkt im ABAP-Code zu formulieren und die Ergebnisse in einer passenden internen Tabelle zu empfangen, ohne temporäre Variablen oder zusätzliche Schleifen. Dies ist effizient und reduziert den Codeumfang.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, HAVING, Database Access, Aggregation, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine SORTED TABLE vom Typ `sflight` nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und erstellen Sie eine neue SORTED TABLE mit den gefilterten Daten.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

    METHODS create_sample_flights

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
