Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer SORTED TABLE vom Typ `sflight` basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE KEY ...` oder `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL ...` mit `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS create_sample_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    " Modern approach: Use a field symbol for direct modification
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.

    " Alternative using MODIFY TABLE (less modern for single line update with key)
    " DATA(ls_flight_update) = VALUE sflight( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate price = iv_new_price ).
    " MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_update TRANSPORTING price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->create_sample_flights( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_new_price = '110.50' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '110.50' ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_new_price = '500.00' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_original_price) = lo_cut->create_sample_flights( )[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ]-price.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ]-price exp = lv_original_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für den Zugriff auf einen Eintrag in einer `SORTED TABLE` ist sehr effizient. Die direkte Modifikation über das Feldsymbol ist performanter als `MODIFY TABLE`, da keine erneute Suche oder Kopie des Eintrags erforderlich ist. Der Zugriff über den Primärschlüssel ist dank der Sortierung optimiert.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Aggregation (Summe der Preise) über eine SORTED TABLE vom Typ `sflight` durch, gruppiert nach der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_sum.
    TYPES: tt_flight_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS aggregate_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_sums) TYPE tt_flight_sums.

    METHODS create_sample_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) "LH total 410
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) "AA total 220
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) "UA total 150
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '210.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = create_sample_flights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                 INTO DATA(group_key).
      rt_flight_sums = VALUE #( BASE rt_flight_sums
                                 ( carrid = group_key-carrid
                                   total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                                           FOR <member> IN GROUP group_key
                                                           NEXT sum = sum + <member>-price ) ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation_sums FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_sums.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_sums) = lo_cut->aggregate_prices_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sums ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_sum) = lt_sums[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_sum-total_price exp = '220.00' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_sum) = lt_sums[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_sum-total_price exp = '410.00' ).

    DATA(ls_ua_sum) = lt_sums[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_sum-total_price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE` Operator ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen in ABAP durchzuführen. `GROUP BY` ermöglicht die Verarbeitung von Tabellenzeilen in Gruppen, während `REDUCE` eine kompakte Syntax für die Akkumulation von Werten innerhalb dieser Gruppen bietet. Dies ist deutlich effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle Schleifen mit manueller Summenbildung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer SORTED TABLE vom Typ `sflight` eine Liste aller eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` um eindeutige Werte basierend auf einem Gruppierungskriterium zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrids.

    METHODS create_sample_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '210.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = create_sample_flights( ).

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                           ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_carrids[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_carrids[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_carrids[ table_line = 'UA' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Expression ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Syntax, um Daten aus internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. In diesem Fall wird sie verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die eindeutigen Werte des Feldes `CARRID` enthält. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Methode, um Duplikate zu eliminieren und eindeutige Listen zu erstellen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, Unique Values, Grouping

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'Join'-Operation zwischen zwei SORTED TABLEs durch, um Flugdaten mit zusätzlichen Informationen zu verknüpfen. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `FOR` Operator mit `IN` und `WHERE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` um eine Art inneren Join zu simulieren und eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_desc,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_desc.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_desc TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_desc WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS join_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.

    METHODS create_sample_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS create_carrier_descriptions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descriptions) TYPE tt_carrier_desc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_carrier_descriptions.
    rt_descriptions = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' description = 'American Airlines' )
                               ( carrid = 'LH' description = 'Lufthansa' )
                               ( carrid = 'BA' description = 'British Airways' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD join_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_flights) = create_sample_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_descriptions) = create_carrier_descriptions( ).

    rt_joined_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                 FOR ls_desc IN lt_descriptions WHERE ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                   price = ls_flight-price,
                                   currency = ls_flight-currency,
                                   description = ls_desc-description ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_join( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 ). "UA should not be included as no description

    DATA(ls_aa_flight) = lt_joined[ carrid = 'AA' ].

    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_joined[ carrid = 'LH' ].

    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_joined[ carrid = 'UA' ]-description ). "UA has no description in the second table
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator mit verschachtelten `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` Ausdrücken ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art, 'Join'-Operationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen und `READ TABLE` Anweisungen und führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code. Die Performance ist bei `SORTED TABLE`s aufgrund des optimierten Schlüsselzugriffs sehr gut.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, Internal Tables, Join, Declarative

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element und einem Kind-Element, das einen Textwert enthält. Serialisieren Sie das XML in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und Methoden wie `create_element`, `append_child` und `display` oder `render_2_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Root' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( child = lo_root_node ).

    DATA(lo_child_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Child' ).
    lo_child_node->set_value( value = 'Hello XML' ).
    lo_root_node->append_child( child = lo_child_node ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( EXPORTING pretty_print = abap_true
                                       RECEIVING xdocument = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_create_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_simple_xml( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml) TYPE xstring.
    lv_expected_xml = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<Root>\n  <Child>Hello XML</Child>\n</Root>' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xml exp = lv_expected_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_xml_document` bietet eine objektorientierte API zur Erstellung und Bearbeitung von XML-Dokumenten. Die Methoden `create_element`, `append_child` und `set_value` ermöglichen eine intuitive Strukturierung des XML. `render_2_xstring` serialisiert das Dokument in ein `xstring`, was für die Weiterverarbeitung oder Speicherung nützlich ist. `pretty_print` verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Create XML, Object Orientation, xstring

Instructions: Laden Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einem String, lesen Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Knotens (`<Item>`) und behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler beim Parsen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>parse_xstring` und `get_elements_by_tag_name` oder `find_node`. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_xml_node_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_tag_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_xml_node_value.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).

        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        IF lo_root IS BOUND.
          DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).
          IF lines( lt_nodes ) > 0.
            DATA(lo_first_node) = lt_nodes[ 1 ].
            rv_node_value = lo_first_node->get_value( ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xml_parse_error( previous = lx_parse_error
                                                text = 'Fehler beim Parsen des XML-Strings' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einem String und fügen Sie einem bestehenden Element ein neues Attribut hinzu. Serialisieren Sie das modifizierte XML zurück in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>parse_xstring`, `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `set_attribute`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_add_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_attribute_to_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_tag_name TYPE string
        iv_attr_name TYPE string
        iv_attr_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_attribute_to_element.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).

        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        IF lo_root IS BOUND.
          DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).
          IF lines( lt_nodes ) > 0.
            DATA(lo_target_node) = lt_nodes[ 1 ].
            lo_target_node->set_attribute( name = iv_attr_name value = iv_attr_value ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( EXPORTING pretty_print = abap_true
                                           RECEIVING xdocument = rv_modified_xml_xstring ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xml_parse_error( previous = lx_parse_error
                                                text = 'Fehler beim Parsen des XML-Strings' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie ein XML-Dokument mithilfe von XSLT. Das XSLT soll einfache Daten aus dem Eingabe-XML extrahieren und in ein neues XML-Format umwandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_xslt_processor` in Verbindung mit `cl_xml_document`.

CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml_with_xslt
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xml TYPE xstring
        iv_xslt_program TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_xslt_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml_with_xslt.
    DATA(lo_xslt_processor) = NEW cl_abap_xslt_processor( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xslt_processor->set_parameter( name = 'program' value = iv_xslt_program ).
        lo_xslt_processor->set_source_xml( iv_source_xml ).
        lo_xslt_processor->transform( RECEIVING result_xml = rv_transformed_xml ).

      CATCH cx_xslt_exception INTO DATA(lx_xslt_exception).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xslt_exception( previous = lx_xslt_exception
                                                text = 'Fehler bei der XSLT-Transformation' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

"Missing closing tag for xsl:for-each

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`). Jede Zeile der Tabelle soll ein `<Flight>`-Element im XML darstellen, mit Kind-Elementen für `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE`.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie `create_element` und `set_value` für jedes Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_xml_from_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_from_flights.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( child = lo_root_node ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flight' ).
      lo_root_node->append_child( child = lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_carrid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Carrid' ).
      lo_carrid_node->set_value( value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( child = lo_carrid_node ).

      DATA(lo_connid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Connid' ).
      lo_connid_node->set_value( value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( child = lo_connid_node ).

      DATA(lo_fldate_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Fldate' ).
      lo_fldate_node->set_value( value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( child = lo_fldate_node ).

      " Add other fields as needed
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( EXPORTING pretty_print = abap_true
                                       RECEIVING xdocument = rv_xml_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_xml_from_itab FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_itab FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xml_from_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_from_itab( ).
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    lt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).

    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_xml_from_flights( lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml) TYPE xstring.
    lv_expected_xml = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<Flights>\n  <Flight>\n    <Carrid>AA</Carrid>\n    <Connid>0017</Connid>\n    <Fldate>20250101</Fldate>\n  </Flight>\n  <Flight>\n    <Carrid>LH</Carrid>\n    <Connid>0400</Connid>\n    <Fldate>20250102</Fldate>\n  </Flight>\n</Flights>' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xml exp = lv_expected_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_from_itab( ).
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_xml_from_flights( lt_empty_flights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml) TYPE xstring.
    lv_expected_xml = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<Flights/>\n' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xml exp = lv_expected_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von XML aus internen Tabellen ist ein häufiges Szenario, z.B. für die Generierung von Schnittstellendaten. Durch die Iteration über die Tabelle (`LOOP AT`) und die Verwendung der `cl_xml_document`-Methoden (`create_element`, `append_child`, `set_value`) kann eine beliebige XML-Struktur aufgebaut werden. Dies ist flexibler als statische Transformationen, wenn die Struktur variieren kann.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Internal Tables, Serialization, Dynamic XML

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Attribute eines bestimmten XML-Elements aus einem geladenen XML-Dokument und speichern Sie diese in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>parse_xstring`, `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_read_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    METHODS get_element_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_tag_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_read_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_attributes.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).

        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        IF lo_root IS BOUND.
          DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).
          IF lines( lt_nodes ) > 0.
            DATA(lo_target_node) = lt_nodes[ 1 ].
            DATA(lt_xml_attributes) = lo_target_node->get_attributes( ).

            rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR ls_xml_attr IN lt_xml_attributes
                                     ( name = ls_xml_attr-name
                                       value = ls_xml_attr-value ) ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xml_parse_error( previous = lx_parse_error
                                                text = 'Fehler beim Parsen des XML-Strings' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie ein XML-Dokument gegen ein XML-Schema (XSD), das als String bereitgestellt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methode `validate`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_validate_xsd DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_xml_with_xsd
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_xsd_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_validate_xsd IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_xml_with_xsd.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).
        lo_xml_document->validate( EXPORTING xsd_xstring = iv_xsd_xstring ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " XML itself is not well-formed or XSD is invalid
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xml_parse_error( previous = lx_parse_error
                                                text = 'XML-Parsing- oder XSD-Fehler' ).
      CATCH cx_xml_validation_error INTO DATA(lx_validation_error).
        " XML is not valid against XSD
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        " Optionally log lx_validation_error->get_text( )
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_validate_xsd( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Root><Item id="1"/></Root>' ).
    DATA(lv_xsd) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">\n  <xs:element name="Root">\n    <xs:complexType>\n      <xs:sequence>\n        <xs:element name="Item">\n          <xs:complexType>\n            <xs:attribute name="id" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>\n          </xs:complexType>\n        </xs:element>\n      </xs:sequence>\n    </xs:complexType>\n  </xs:element>\n</xs:schema>' ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->validate_xml_with_xsd( iv_xml_xstring = lv_xml iv_xsd_xstring = lv_xsd ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_valid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_xml_against_xsd.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_validate_xsd( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Root><Item id="abc"/></Root>' ). "id should be integer
    DATA(lv_xsd) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">\n  <xs:element name="Root">\n    <xs:complexType>\n      <xs:sequence>\n        <xs:element name="Item">\n          <xs:complexType>\n            <xs:attribute name="id" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>\n          </xs:complexType>\n        </xs:element>\n      </xs:sequence>\n    </xs:complexType>\n  </xs:element>\n</xs:schema>' ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->validate_xml_with_xsd( iv_xml_xstring = lv_xml iv_xsd_xstring = lv_xsd ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_valid ).

  METHOD test_malformed_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_validate_xsd( ).
    DATA(lv_malformed_xml) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<Root><Item></Root>' ). "Missing closing tag for Item
    DATA(lv_xsd) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">\n  <xs:element name="Root">\n    <xs:complexType>\n      <xs:sequence>\n        <xs:element name="Item"/>\n      </xs:sequence>\n    </xs:complexType>\n  </xs:element>\n</xs:schema>' ).

    TRY.

explanation: Die Validierung von XML-Dokumenten gegen ein XSD-Schema ist entscheidend, um die Datenintegrität in Schnittstellen sicherzustellen. Die Methode `validate` der Klasse `cl_xml_document` ermöglicht diese Prüfung. Sie wirft eine `cx_xml_validation_error`, wenn das XML nicht dem Schema entspricht, oder eine `cx_xml_parse_error`, wenn das XML oder XSD selbst fehlerhaft ist. Eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung ist hierbei unerlässlich.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, XSD, Validation, Error Handling, xstring

Instructions: Entfernen Sie ein bestimmtes Element aus einem XML-Dokument und serialisieren Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>parse_xstring`, `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `remove_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_remove_element DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_element_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_tag_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_remove_element IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_element_from_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).

        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        IF lo_root IS BOUND.
          DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).
          IF lines( lt_nodes ) > 0.
            DATA(lo_target_node) = lt_nodes[ 1 ].
            lo_root->remove_child( child = lo_target_node ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( EXPORTING pretty_print = abap_true
                                           RECEIVING xdocument = rv_modified_xml_xstring ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xml_parse_error( previous = lx_parse_error
                                                text = 'Fehler beim Parsen des XML-Strings' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem XML-Dokument einen Namespace hinzu und erstellen Sie Elemente innerhalb dieses Namespace.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_element_ns` und `set_namespace_declaration`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_namespaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_xml_with_namespace
      IMPORTING
        iv_namespace_uri TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_namespace.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Root' namespace_uri = iv_namespace_uri prefix = iv_prefix ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( child = lo_root_node ).
    lo_root_node->set_namespace_declaration( namespace_uri = iv_namespace_uri prefix = iv_prefix ).

    DATA(lo_child_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Item' namespace_uri = iv_namespace_uri prefix = iv_prefix ).
    lo_child_node->set_value( value = 'Namespaced Value' ).
    lo_root_node->append_child( child = lo_child_node ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( EXPORTING pretty_print = abap_true
                                       RECEIVING xdocument = rv_xml_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

  METHOD test_create_namespaced_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_namespaces( ).
    DATA(lv_namespace) = 'http://example.com/ns'.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'ex'.
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_xml_with_namespace( iv_namespace_uri = lv_namespace iv_prefix = lv_prefix ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml) TYPE xstring.
    lv_expected_xml = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<ex:Root xmlns:ex="http://example.com/ns">\n  <ex:Item>Namespaced Value</ex:Item>\n</ex:Root>' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xml exp = lv_expected_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Namespaces sind entscheidend für die Vermeidung von Namenskollisionen in komplexen XML-Dokumenten und für die Integration mit anderen Systemen. `create_element_ns` ermöglicht die Erstellung von Elementen innerhalb eines bestimmten Namespace, während `set_namespace_declaration` den Namespace auf dem Element deklariert. Dies ist eine moderne und korrekte Art, mit XML-Namespaces in ABAP umzugehen.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Namespace, create_element_ns, xstring

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem XML-Dokument nach Elementen mittels XPath-Ausdrücken und extrahieren Sie deren Werte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>parse_xstring` und `select_nodes` mit XPath.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_nodes_by_xpath
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_xpath_expression TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_node_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_nodes_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).

        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_xml_document->select_nodes( iv_xpath_expression ).

        rt_node_values = VALUE #( FOR lo_node IN lt_nodes
                                  ( lo_node->get_value( ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_xml_parse_error( previous = lx_parse_error
                                                text = 'Fehler beim Parsen des XML-Strings' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: XPath ist eine leistungsstarke Sprache zur Navigation und Auswahl von Knoten in XML-Dokumenten. Die Methode `select_nodes` der Klasse `cl_xml_document` ermöglicht die Ausführung von XPath-Ausdrücken direkt in ABAP. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um komplexe XML-Strukturen zu durchsuchen und spezifische Daten zu extrahieren, ohne das gesamte Dokument manuell traversieren zu müssen. Die `FOR` Expression wird verwendet, um die Werte der gefundenen Knoten kompakt zu sammeln.

Instructions: Rufe eine statische Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    " Dynamischer Aufruf einer statischen Methode
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_class_name)=>(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = lv_result.
        rv_result = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic call failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_static_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_static_helper IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_greeting = 'Hello from dynamic call!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit dynamisch definierten Spalten (z.B. `CARRID`, `CONNID` aus `sflights`) und fülle sie mit Daten aus `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA` für die Instanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE abap_typname,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ts_field_def,
           tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS füllen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      " Dynamische Zuweisung der Werte
      LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_sflight_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_dynamic_field>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_dynamic_field> = <lv_sflight_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dyn_table_creator=>tt_field_def.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'CARRID' type = 'S_CARR_ID' length = 4 ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'CONNID' type = 'S_CONN_ID' length = 4 ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FLDATE' type = 'S_DATE' length = 8 ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( <lt_table> )
      msg = 'Expected dynamic table to be filled'
    ).

    " Check structure of first line
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = <lv_carrid>
        msg = 'Expected CARRID to be filled'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datentypen zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`. Anschließend wird eine interne Tabelle dieses dynamischen Typs instanziiert und über Feld-Symbole mit Daten befüllt. Dies ist essenziell für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Internal Tables, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, sflights

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Felder einer Struktur zu, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, und lesen Sie deren Werte.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feld-Symbole (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_values
      IMPORTING
        is_structure   TYPE any
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <lv_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <lv_field_value> }| TO rt_field_values.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |Field '{ lv_field_name }' not found.| TO rt_field_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_access.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).
    DATA: lt_field_names TYPE zcl_dyn_field_access=>tt_field_names.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_field_names.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_field_names.
    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_field_names.

    DATA(lt_values) = lo_cut->get_field_values(
      is_structure   = ls_sflight
      it_field_names = lt_field_names
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_values ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_values[ 1 ] exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_values[ 2 ] exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_values[ 3 ] exp = |{ sy-datum }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).
    DATA: lt_field_names TYPE zcl_dyn_field_access=>tt_field_names.
    APPEND 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' TO lt_field_names.

    DATA(lt_values) = lo_cut->get_field_values(
      is_structure   = ls_sflight
      it_field_names = lt_field_names
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_values ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_values[ 1 ] sub = 'not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Feldzugriff mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ist ein grundlegendes Konzept in ABAP für generische Datenverarbeitung. Es erlaubt, auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist unverzichtbar für Tools, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen arbeiten.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, Structures, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie zur Laufzeit eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Typ dynamisch bestimmt wird, und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf.

solution:
CLASS zif_dynamic_action DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS perform_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_class.
    DATA lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_action.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        rv_result = lo_dynamic_object->perform_action( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Class not found or instantiation failed.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method call failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_impl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~perform_action.
    rv_message = 'Action performed by ZCL_ACTION_IMPL!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    " Not relevant for this example, but required for ADT
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling_syntax.
    " Dieser Test prüft primär die Syntax der Fehlerbehandlung.
    " Eine echte Prüfung der Fehlerbehandlung würde das Auslösen
    " der Ausnahmen erfordern, was in Unit-Tests für GUI-Controls
    " schwierig ist.

    " Simulation der Fehlerbehandlung
    TRY.
        " Hier würde man Code platzieren, der eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte
        " z.B. durch Mocking eines fehlerhaften Containers oder Viewers.
        " Da dies hier nicht möglich ist, prüfen wir nur, dass der TRY-CATCH-Block
        " syntaktisch korrekt ist.
        DATA(lv_dummy) = 'Test'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_dummy exp = 'Test' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'cx_sy_create_object_error should not be caught in this dummy test' ).
      CATCH cx_ecl_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'cx_ecl_error should not be caught in this dummy test' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'cx_root should not be caught in this dummy test' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Das Abfangen spezifischer Ausnahmen wie `cx_sy_create_object_error` und `cx_ecl_error` ermöglicht es, auf diese Fehler gezielt zu reagieren und die Anwendung stabil zu halten.

Instructions: Lese einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Flugdatum. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_single_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_single_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      INTO @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @is_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_key-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_single_read( ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_single_read=>ty_flight_key(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = '20250101'
    ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_single_flight( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'Flight should be found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `INTO @DATA(...)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration von Variablen direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. `SELECT SINGLE` ist die effizienteste Methode, um einen einzelnen Datensatz zu lesen.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, INTO @DATA, Inline Declaration, sflights, Database Access

             fldate TYPE s_date,

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, um alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in Paketen zu lesen und zu verarbeiten, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA lt_flight_chunk TYPE sflights_tab.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flight_chunk PACKAGE SIZE 10.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      " Hier könnte die Verarbeitung des aktuellen Datenpakets erfolgen
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flight_chunk TO rt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, um Flugdaten zusammen mit zugehörigen Buchungsdaten zu lesen. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zur Verknüpfung der Tabellen `sflights` und `sbook`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einem `INNER JOIN` und geben Sie die Felder explizit an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             bookid TYPE s_book_id,
             customid TYPE s_cust_id,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_bookings
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_booking.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_bookings.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA lt_chunk TYPE tt_flight_booking.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT FROM sflights AS a
        INNER JOIN sbook AS b ON a~carrid = b~carrid AND a~connid = b~connid AND a~fldate = b~fldate
        FIELDS a~carrid, a~connid, a~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
        WHERE a~carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_chunk PACKAGE SIZE 10.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_chunk TO rt_flight_bookings.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften unter Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` und einer `IN`-Klausel für die dynamische Selektion.
hint: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den gewünschten Fluggesellschaften und verwenden Sie diese in einer `IN`-Klausel mit `OPEN CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA lt_flight_chunk TYPE sflights_tab.

    DATA(lt_carrids_list) = VALUE string_table( FOR <carr> IN it_carriers ( <carr>-carrid ) ).

    IF lt_carrids_list IS NOT INITIAL.
      OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
        SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrids_list.

      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flight_chunk PACKAGE SIZE 100.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND LINES OF lt_flight_chunk TO rt_flights.
      ENDDO.

      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne für eine Tabelle von Verkaufszahlen den prozentualen Anteil jedes Artikels am Gesamtumsatz.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `FOR` mit `VALUE` zur Transformation der Tabelle, inklusive Division.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
         item_id   TYPE string,
         amount    TYPE decfloat16,
         percentage TYPE decfloat16,
       END OF ty_sales_item.
TYPES: tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sales_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_percentages IMPORTING it_sales TYPE tt_sales_items RETURNING VALUE(rt_sales_with_perc) TYPE tt_sales_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_percentages.
    DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_sales NEXT s = s + item-amount ).

    IF lv_total_amount = 0.
      rt_sales_with_perc = it_sales. " Original zurückgeben, um Division durch Null zu vermeiden
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_sales_with_perc = VALUE tt_sales_items(
      FOR ls_item IN it_sales
      ( ls_item WITH percentage = ( ls_item-amount / lv_total_amount ) * 100 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH').
hint: Nutze `FILTER` um die relevanten Einträge zu selektieren und `REDUCE` für Summe und Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).

    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT s = s + flight-price
    ).
    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         average_price TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_flight_avg.
TYPES: tt_flight_avgs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_grouped_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_grouped_average_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_avgs) TYPE tt_flight_avgs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_average_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_avgs = VALUE tt_flight_avgs(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET lv_count = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        average_price = COND s_price(
                                  WHEN lv_count = 0 THEN 0
                                  ELSE REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + f-price ) / lv_count
                                )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    rt_weighted_avgs = VALUE tt_weighted_avgs(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET lv_total_weighted_price = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + ( f-price * f-seatsocc ) )
          lv_total_seats = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + f-seatsocc ) IN
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        weighted_average_price = COND decfloat16(
                                           WHEN lv_total_seats = 0 THEN 0
                                           ELSE lv_total_weighted_price / lv_total_seats
                                         )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge, bei denen die Flugnummer (`CONNID`) eine bestimmte Ziffer enthält (z.B. '0').
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einer Schleife und `CONTAINS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_with_digit
          IMPORTING
            it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
            iv_digit    TYPE c LENGTH 1
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_with_digit.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                             WHERE ( CONTAINS( val = ls_flight-connid sub = iv_digit ) )
                             NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_tree_nodes
          IMPORTING
            it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    rt_nodes = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_carrid IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight_carrid-carrid
      LET lv_carrid_node_id = CONV lvc_nkey( ++lv_node_counter ) IN
      (
        node_id   = lv_carrid_node_id
        parent_id = ''
        text      = ls_flight_carrid-carrid
        is_folder = abap_true
      )
      (
        FOR ls_flight_connid IN GROUP ls_flight_carrid
        LET lv_flight_node_id = CONV lvc_nkey( ++lv_node_counter ) IN
        (
          node_id   = lv_flight_node_id
          parent_id = lv_carrid_node_id
          text      = ls_flight_connid-connid
          is_folder = abap_false
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_update,
             node_id   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_id TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node_update.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

            it_nodes TYPE tt_tree_nodes_update
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_updated_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes_update.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_folder_node_text.
    rt_updated_nodes = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_node IN it_nodes
      LET lv_child_count = COND i( WHEN ls_node-is_folder = abap_true
                                       THEN COUNT( it_nodes WHERE parent_id = ls_node-node_id )
                                       ELSE 0 ) IN
      (
        ls_node-node_id,
        ls_node-parent_id,
        text      = COND string( WHEN ls_node-is_folder = abap_true
                                    THEN |{ ls_node-text } ({ lv_child_count } Kinder)|
                                    ELSE ls_node-text ) ,
        ls_node-is_folder
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe, Differenz, das Produkt und den Quotienten zweier Zahlen (10 und 5) und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in inline deklarierten Variablen. Geben Sie die Ergebnisse zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COMPUTE` (implizit) und inline Deklarationen (`DATA(result) = ...`) für die arithmetischen Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_math DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_results,
             sum       TYPE i,
             difference TYPE i,
             product   TYPE i,
             quotient  TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_results.

    METHODS perform_calculations
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE ty_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculations.
    rs_results-sum        = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
    rs_results-difference = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
    rs_results-product    = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
    IF iv_num2 <> 0.
      rs_results-quotient = iv_num1 / iv_num2.
    ELSE.
      rs_results-quotient = 0. " Handle division by zero
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-difference exp = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-quotient   exp = 2.0 ).

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_even DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_even_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_even IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_even_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                       FOR number IN it_numbers
                       WHERE ( number MOD 2 = 0 )
                       NEXT total = total + number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_derived_table IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wert einer komplexen mathematischen Formel (z.B. `(A + B) * C - D / E`), die Zwischenergebnisse verwendet, die mit einem `LET`-Ausdruck deklariert werden, um die Lesbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LET` zur Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks, um komplexe Berechnungen mit `COMPUTE` übersichtlicher zu gestalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_let_complex_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_complex_formula
      IMPORTING
        iv_a TYPE decfloat34
        iv_b TYPE decfloat34
        iv_c TYPE decfloat34
        iv_d TYPE decfloat34
        iv_e TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_let_complex_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_complex_formula.
    rv_result = LET
                  sum_ab = iv_a + iv_b
                  prod_sum_c = sum_ab * iv_c
                  div_de = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_e <> 0 THEN iv_d / iv_e ELSE 0 )
                IN
                  prod_sum_c - div_de.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_complex_formula FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_formula.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_let_complex_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_complex_formula(
      iv_a = 10 iv_b = 5 iv_c = 2 iv_d = 20 iv_e = 4
    ).
    " Expected: (10 + 5) * 2 - 20 / 4 = 15 * 2 - 5 = 30 - 5 = 25
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '25.0' ).

    DATA(lv_result_div_by_zero) = lo_cut->calculate_complex_formula(
      iv_a = 10 iv_b = 5 iv_c = 2 iv_d = 20 iv_e = 0
    ).
    " Expected: (10 + 5) * 2 - 0 = 30
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_div_by_zero exp = '30.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Ausdruck, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55, ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Berechnungen erheblich, da Zwischenergebnisse benannt und wiederverwendet werden können. Die arithmetischen Operationen nutzen implizit `COMPUTE`.

CLASS zcl_cond_bonus_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_sales_amount TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bonus_amount) TYPE decfloat16.

CLASS zcl_cond_bonus_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    DATA(lv_threshold) = '1000.00'.
    DATA(lv_bonus_rate_high) = '0.10'. " 10%
    DATA(lv_bonus_rate_low) = '0.05'.  " 5%

    rv_bonus_amount = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN iv_sales_amount > lv_threshold
      THEN iv_sales_amount * lv_bonus_rate_high
      ELSE iv_sales_amount * lv_bonus_rate_low
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_bonus_high) = lo_cut->calculate_bonus( lv_sales_high ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_bonus_high exp = '120.00' ). " 1200 * 0.10

    " Testfall: Umsatz unter Schwellenwert

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz für Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, konvertiert in eine Zielwährung (z.B. EUR), unter Berücksichtigung eines festen Wechselkurses (z.B. 1 USD = 0.9 EUR).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `COMPUTE` (implizit) für die Währungsumrechnung und Aggregation. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_revenue_eur
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_currency TYPE s_curcode DEFAULT 'EUR'
        iv_exchange_rate   TYPE decfloat16 DEFAULT '0.9'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE decfloat16.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue_eur.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).

    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT total_eur = '0.0'
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        total_eur = total_eur + COND decfloat16(
          WHEN ls_flight-currency = 'USD' THEN ls_flight-price * iv_exchange_rate
          WHEN ls_flight-currency = iv_target_currency THEN ls_flight-price
          ELSE '0.0' " For simplicity, ignore other currencies or handle with a more complex conversion
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    " Simulate fetching data from sflights table
    " In a real scenario, this would be SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_sflight_data.
    rt_sflight_data = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0268' fldate = '20230101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' price = '120.00' currency = 'GBP' ) " Ignored in this simple example
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_currency_conversion( ).

    " Test mit Standard-Wechselkurs (USD zu EUR)
    DATA(lv_total_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue_eur( ).
    " Expected: (100 * 0.9) + (150 * 0.9) + 200 = 90 + 135 + 200 = 425
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_revenue exp = '425.0' ).

    " Test mit anderem Wechselkurs
    DATA(lv_total_revenue_custom_rate) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue_eur( iv_exchange_rate = '0.8' ).
    " Expected: (100 * 0.8) + (150 * 0.8) + 200 = 80 + 120 + 200 = 400
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_revenue_custom_rate exp = '400.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Strings zu einem einzigen String, wobei jeder String in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt und durch ein Komma und Leerzeichen getrennt wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concat_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_and_upper
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_concat_upper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_and_upper.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR ls_string IN it_strings
      NEXT
        result = COND string(
          WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN to_upper( ls_string )
          ELSE result && ', ' && to_upper( ls_string )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten verarbeitet. Für jedes Objekt soll ein Attribut basierend auf einer komplexen Berechnung aktualisiert werden, die von anderen Attributen des Objekts abhängt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `NEW` für die Transformation der Objekte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `NEW` und `LET` für die Transformation und Berechnung innerhalb der Objektliste. `COMPUTE` ist implizit in den Berechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_object_transformation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id       TYPE i,
             value1   TYPE decfloat16,
             value2   TYPE decfloat16,
             calculated_value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_transformation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_items.
    rt_transformed_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_items
                                    ( NEW ty_item(
                                        id = ls_item-id
                                        value1 = ls_item-value1
                                        value2 = ls_item-value2
                                        calculated_value = LET
                                                                intermediate_sum = ls_item-value1 + ls_item-value2
                                                                factor = COND decfloat16( WHEN ls_item-id MOD 2 = 0 THEN '1.2' ELSE '1.0' )
                                                            IN
                                                                intermediate_sum * factor
                                      )
                                    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_object_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_object_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_object_transformation( ).
    DATA(lt_input_items) = VALUE zcl_object_transformation=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value1 = '10.0' value2 = '5.0' )
      ( id = 2 value1 = '20.0' value2 = '10.0' )
      ( id = 3 value1 = '1.0'  value2 = '2.0' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed_items) = lo_cut->transform_items( lt_input_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed_items ) exp = 3 ).

    " Item 1: (10+5) * 1.0 = 15.0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed_items[ 1 ]-calculated_value exp = '15.0' ).

    " Item 2: (20+10) * 1.2 = 30 * 1.2 = 36.0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed_items[ 2 ]-calculated_value exp = '36.0' ).

    " Item 3: (1+2) * 1.0 = 3.0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed_items[ 3 ]-calculated_value exp = '3.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, deren Schlüssel eine UUID ist, und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Hash-Tabelle mit einem `UUID_C` Feld als Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             uuid TYPE sysuuid_c,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_description TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.

    METHODS get_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    rs_data-uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->get_uuid_c( ).
    rs_data-description = iv_description.
    INSERT rs_data INTO TABLE mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry.
    READ TABLE mt_data INTO rs_data WITH TABLE KEY uuid = iv_uuid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hashed_table_ops FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existent_entry FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_table_ops.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(ls_entry1) = lo_cut->add_entry( 'First Entry' ).
    DATA(ls_entry2) = lo_cut->add_entry( 'Second Entry' ).

    DATA(ls_retrieved_entry) = lo_cut->get_entry( ls_entry1-uuid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_retrieved_entry-description exp = 'First Entry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_retrieved_entry-uuid exp = ls_entry1-uuid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existent_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lv_non_existent_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->get_uuid_c( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_class = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
    ).
    lo_cut->get_entry( lv_non_existent_uuid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von UUIDs als eindeutige Schlüssel in einer Hash-Tabelle. Hash-Tabellen bieten eine sehr schnelle Zugriffszeit auf Einträge, was sie ideal für Szenarien macht, in denen eine schnelle Suche nach einem eindeutigen Bezeichner erforderlich ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit Ausnahmen ist ebenfalls ein moderner Ansatz.
keywords: UUID, Hashed Table, Key, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, Internal Table, Exception Handling

CLASS zcl_if_inline_declaration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_if_inline_declaration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date.
    IF it_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_if_is_supplied DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_if_table_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items

CLASS zcl_if_table_initial IMPLEMENTATION.

      rv_message = 'No items to process.'.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer SORTED TABLE mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( " Funktionaler Operator zur Aggregation
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.
