Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder aus einer SORTED TABLE enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( FIELD1 = itab-FIELD1, ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( " Erstellung und Transformation in einem Schritt
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( '100.00' ). " Flüge mit Preis > 100
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summaries ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen Ausdruck, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE #, Table Comprehension, Transformation

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Endian-Konvertierung eines numerischen Wertes (z.B. Integer) in ein `xstring` unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create` mit dem `endian` Parameter und `convert`. Beachten Sie, dass ABAP intern Big Endian ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_endian_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_int_to_xstring_little
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.

    METHODS convert_int_to_xstring_big
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_endian_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_int_to_xstring_little.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8' " Codepage ist für reine Endian-Konvertierung von Binärdaten irrelevant
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
    ).
    lo_converter->convert(
      EXPORTING
        data   = iv_value
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_int_to_xstring_big.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8' " Codepage ist für reine Endian-Konvertierung von Binärdaten irrelevant
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big
    ).
    lo_converter->convert(
      EXPORTING
        data   = iv_value
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_int_to_xstring_little FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    METHODS test_convert_int_to_xstring_big FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_int_to_xstring_little.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_endian_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = 256. " Hex 0100
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_int_to_xstring_little( lv_value ).
    " Erwartet für 256 (0x0100) in Little Endian (4 Bytes): 00 01 00 00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xstring exp = '00010000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_int_to_xstring_big.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_endian_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = 256. " Hex 0100
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_int_to_xstring_big( lv_value ).
    " Erwartet für 256 (0x0100) in Big Endian (4 Bytes): 00 00 01 00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xstring exp = '00000100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` kann auch für die Endian-Konvertierung von binären Daten verwendet werden, was bei der Kommunikation mit Systemen, die eine andere Byte-Reihenfolge verwenden, entscheidend ist. ABAP-interne numerische Typen sind standardmäßig Big-Endian.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, Endian Conversion, xstring, Binary Data

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge in einer SORTED TABLE nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft mit `LOOP AT GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( carrid = itab-carrid )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_ref->carrid flight_count = group_ref->*->lines( ) ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen zu benötigen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine SORTED TABLE ein und lassen Sie gleiche Schlüssel automatisch aggregieren (falls die Zeilenstruktur dies zulässt) mit `COLLECT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COLLECT wa INTO itab`. Beachten Sie, dass `COLLECT` nur bei numerischen Feldern aggregiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_sum.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sum_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_sum WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS collect_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_collected_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sum_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_flight_prices.
    DATA: ls_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight_sum.

    ls_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' total_price = '100.00' ).
    COLLECT ls_flight_data INTO rt_collected_flights.

    ls_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' total_price = '200.00' ).
    COLLECT ls_flight_data INTO rt_collected_flights.

    ls_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' total_price = '150.00' ).
    COLLECT ls_flight_data INTO rt_collected_flights. " Dies wird zum bestehenden LH 0400 Eintrag addiert

    ls_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' total_price = '300.00' ).
    COLLECT ls_flight_data INTO rt_collected_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_collect_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_collected) = lo_cut->collect_flight_prices( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_collected ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_collected[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-total_price exp = '250.00' ). " 100 + 150
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_collected[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ]-total_price exp = '200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_collected[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ]-total_price exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COLLECT` ist eine spezielle Anweisung, die bei `SORTED TABLE`s effizient ist, um Zeilen mit identischem Schlüssel zu aggregieren, wobei numerische Felder summiert werden. Dies ist eine kompakte Methode zur Datenkonsolidierung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, COLLECT, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag in einer SORTED TABLE existiert, ohne eine Exception auszulösen, unter Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF line_exists( itab[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS ... ] )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    IF line_exists( lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken bietet eine elegante und sichere Methode, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne eine Laufzeitfehlerbehandlung für `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` zu benötigen. Dies ist besonders effizient bei `SORTED TABLE`s.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, Tabellenausdruck, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für ein 'Tier' mit einer Methode 'mach_geraeusch'. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen (z.B. 'Hund' und 'Katze') und rufen Sie die Methode über eine Interface-Referenz auf.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Tier-Objekten (Hund, Katze, basierend auf INT_001) und lassen Sie jedes Tier sein Geräusch machen. Sammeln Sie die Geräusche in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ REF TO zif_tier und eine FOR-Expression.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_tier_poly.
  METHODS mach_geraeusch RETURNING VALUE(rv_geraeusch) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_tier_poly.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_katze_poly IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_tier_poly~mach_geraeusch.
    rv_geraeusch = 'Miau!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tier_orchestrator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_tier_orchestrator IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression mit einer WHERE-Klausel und VALUE #.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( flight-fldate > lv_today )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT mit dem REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einem initialen Wert und addieren Sie die Passagierzahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_passenger_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_passenger_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Akkumulationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Zeile auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.

CLASS zcl_sflight_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Flugdetails (z.B. Abflugort) für einen bestimmten Flug (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) direkt aus einer internen Tabelle SFLIGHT mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck itab[ key = value ].
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_city_from
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_city_from) TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_from.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    TRY.
        rv_city_from = lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                   connid = iv_connid
                                   fldate = iv_fldate ]-cityfrom.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_city_from = 'N/A'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_city_from FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_city_from.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_table_expr( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT contains a flight LH 0400 on 20251224 from FRANKFURT
    " For a robust test, ensure this data exists or mock it.
    DATA(lv_city) = lo_cut->get_city_from(
                       iv_carrid = 'LH'
                       iv_connid = '0400'
                       iv_fldate = '20251224' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_city exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'Abflugort sollte FRANKFURT sein' ).

    " Test for non-existent flight
    DATA(lv_city_not_found) = lo_cut->get_city_from(
                                 iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                 iv_connid = '9999'
                                 iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_city_not_found exp = 'N/A' msg = 'Nicht gefundener Flug sollte N/A zurückgeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke ermöglichen den direkten und typsicheren Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle über ihren Schlüssel. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, auf Tabellendaten zuzugreifen, die die Notwendigkeit expliziter READ TABLE-Anweisungen oft überflüssig macht und den Code kompakter gestaltet. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH für cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ist dabei essenziell.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Key Access, Exception Handling, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (FIELD `PRICE` aus Tabelle `SFLIGHT`) für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( "COMPUTE"-like operation
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.

    " Prepare test data (assuming SFLIGHT has data for 'AA')
    " For a real unit test, you might mock SFLIGHT or use a dedicated test client.
    " Here, we'll just sum up some known values if 'AA' exists.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_expected_price
      msg = 'Total price for AA should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Weise. Anstatt einer expliziten Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariable wird die Logik direkt im Ausdruck definiert. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, COMPUTE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Flugverbindung (aus `SFLIGHT`) die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und den doppelten Preis enthält. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             double_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_doubled_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_doubled_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( "COMPUTE"-like operation
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        double_price = flight-price * 2 ) "COMPUTE"-like operation
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_doubled_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_doubled_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_data) = lo_cut->get_doubled_prices( ).

    " Check if any data was returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_actual_data )
      msg = 'Should return some flight data'
      _negated = abap_true
    ).

    " Check a specific entry (assuming 'AA' '0017' exists and has a price)
    READ TABLE lt_actual_data WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_original_price) = 0.
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_original_price WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_aa-double_price
        exp = lv_original_price * 2
        msg = 'Doubled price for AA 0017 should be correct'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine elegante Transformation von internen Tabellen. Es wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, deren Zeilen aus den transformierten Werten der Quelltabelle bestehen, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, COMPUTE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Strategie-Muster zur Berechnung von Rabatten. Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_DISCOUNT_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `CALCULATE_DISCOUNT`. Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `CL_FIXED_DISCOUNT` und `CL_PERCENT_DISCOUNT`, die dieses Interface implementieren und unterschiedliche Rabattlogiken anwenden. Eine Hauptklasse soll den Rabatt basierend auf der übergebenen Strategie berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie Interfaces und Polymorphie, um verschiedene Rabattstrategien dynamisch auszutauschen.
solution:
INTERFACE if_discount_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_discount
    IMPORTING
      iv_price TYPE sflight-price
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_fixed_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_discount_strategy. "IMPLEMENTS
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_fixed_amount TYPE sflight-price.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_fixed_amount TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fixed_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_discount_strategy~calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_price = iv_price - mv_fixed_amount. "COMPUTE"-like operation
    IF rv_discounted_price < 0.
      rv_discounted_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_fixed_amount = iv_fixed_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_percent_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_discount_strategy. "IMPLEMENTS
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1. " e.g. 10.0 for 10%
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_percent_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_discount_strategy~calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_price = iv_price * ( 1 - mv_percentage / 100 ). "COMPUTE"-like operation
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_percentage = iv_percentage.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_final_price
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO if_discount_strategy
        iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_final_price.
    rv_final_price = io_strategy->calculate_discount( iv_original_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fixed_discount FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_percent_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fixed_discount.
    DATA(lo_fixed_strategy) = NEW zcl_fixed_discount( iv_fixed_amount = 100 ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_final_price) = lo_calculator->get_final_price(
                                  io_strategy = lo_fixed_strategy
                                  iv_original_price = 500
                                ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = 400 msg = 'Fixed discount should be 400' ).

    lv_final_price = lo_calculator->get_final_price(
                                  io_strategy = lo_fixed_strategy
                                  iv_original_price = 50
                                ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = 0 msg = 'Fixed discount should not be negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_percent_discount.
    DATA(lo_percent_strategy) = NEW zcl_percent_discount( iv_percentage = '10.0' ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_final_price) = lo_calculator->get_final_price(
                                  io_strategy = lo_percent_strategy
                                  iv_original_price = 500
                                ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_price exp = 450 msg = 'Percent discount should be 450' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster nutzt Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`) und Polymorphie, um Algorithmen (hier: Rabattberechnungen) zur Laufzeit austauschbar zu machen. Die `zcl_discount_calculator`-Klasse ist entkoppelt von der konkreten Implementierung der Rabattlogik, was die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Struktur vom Typ `sflight` und füllen Sie diese mit initialen Werten, aber überschreiben Sie `CARRID` und `CONNID` mit spezifischen Werten. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Der `VALUE`-Operator kann verwendet werden, um Strukturen und interne Tabellen zu initialisieren und zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_flight_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_LOGGER` mit einer Methode `LOG_MESSAGE`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `CL_CONSOLE_LOGGER` (gibt Nachrichten auf der Konsole aus) und `CL_FILE_LOGGER` (simuliert das Schreiben in eine Datei). Eine Hauptklasse soll den Logger dynamisch verwenden.
hint: Interfaces ermöglichen es, verschiedene Implementierungen einer Funktionalität auszutauschen.
solution:
INTERFACE if_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_logger. "IMPLEMENTS
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / 'Console Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_logger. "IMPLEMENTS
    METHODS get_logged_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_logged_messages TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_logger~log_message.
    APPEND iv_message TO mt_logged_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_logged_messages.
    rt_messages = mt_logged_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO if_logger
        iv_data   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    io_logger->log_message( |Processing data: { iv_data }| ).
    " ... further processing ...
    io_logger->log_message( |Data { iv_data } processed successfully.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_file_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_console_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_application_processor( ).
    " This test primarily checks if the method can be called without error.
    " Output to console is hard to assert in unit tests.
    lo_processor->process_data( io_logger = lo_console_logger iv_data = 'Test Data 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Console logger call should not dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_logger.
    DATA(lo_file_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_application_processor( ).
    lo_processor->process_data( io_logger = lo_file_logger iv_data = 'Test Data 2' ).

    DATA(lt_logged_messages) = lo_file_logger->get_logged_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_logged_messages ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two messages should be logged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logged_messages[1] exp = 'Processing data: Test Data 2' msg = 'First message incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logged_messages[2] exp = 'Data Test Data 2 processed successfully.' msg = 'Second message incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung eines Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`) wird eine lose Kopplung zwischen der Anwendung (`zcl_application_processor`) und der konkreten Logger-Implementierung erreicht. Dies ermöglicht es, den Logger-Typ (z.B. Konsole, Datei, Datenbank) einfach auszutauschen, ohne den Anwendungscode ändern zu müssen.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Dependency Injection

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt und die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( "COMPUTE"-like operation for filtering
      lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights(
                                     iv_carrid = 'AA'
                                     iv_min_price = 500
                                   ).

    " Get expected count from DB directly for comparison
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_count WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND price > 500.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_flights )
      exp = lv_expected_count
      msg = 'Number of filtered flights should match'
    ).

    " Check if all filtered flights meet criteria
    LOOP AT lt_actual_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrid should be AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) msg = 'Price should be > 500' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen, ohne dass eine explizite Schleife und `APPEND`-Anweisungen erforderlich sind.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, COMPUTE

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn der Eingabepreis größer als 1000 ist, soll der Status 'Premium' sein, ansonsten 'Standard'. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `COND`-Operator.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_CALCULATOR` mit Methoden für Addition, Subtraktion, Multiplikation und Division. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `CL_SIMPLE_CALCULATOR`. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung der Methoden und die Fehlerbehandlung bei Division durch Null.
hint: Nutzen Sie Interfaces für die Definition von Verhaltensweisen und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse. Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_calculator PUBLIC.
  METHODS add
    IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  METHODS subtract
    IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  METHODS multiply
    IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  METHODS divide
    IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
    RAISING   cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_calculator. "IMPLEMENTS
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_calculator~add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2. "COMPUTE"-like operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_calculator~subtract.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2. "COMPUTE"-like operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_calculator~multiply.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2. "COMPUTE"-like operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_calculator~divide.
    IF iv_num2 = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_num1 / iv_num2. "COMPUTE"-like operation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_subtract FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calc->if_calculator~add( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ) exp = 8 msg = '5 + 3 should be 8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_subtract.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calc->if_calculator~subtract( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 4 ) exp = 6 msg = '10 - 4 should be 6' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calc->if_calculator~multiply( iv_num1 = 2 iv_num2 = 6 ) exp = 12 msg = '2 * 6 should be 12' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calc->if_calculator~divide( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 2 ) exp = 5 msg = '10 / 2 should be 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = lo_calc->if_calculator~divide( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 0 ) exp_class = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR' msg = 'Division by zero should raise exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`) zur Definition eines Vertrags für eine Funktionalität (hier: Rechneroperationen). Die Implementierung in `zcl_simple_calculator` zeigt, wie die Methoden des Interfaces konkretisiert werden und wie mit Ausnahmen (z.B. Division durch Null) umgegangen wird, was für robuste Anwendungen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Object Orientation, Exception Handling, COMPUTE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_analysis) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_analysis = VALUE #( "COMPUTE"-like operation for grouping and aggregation
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid        = flight-carrid
        flight_count  = GROUP SIZE
        average_price = REDUCE #( INIT avg TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                  FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                  NEXT avg = avg + member-price ) / GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_group_analysis FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_group_analysis.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_analysis( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_analysis) = lo_cut->analyze_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_actual_analysis )
      msg = 'Should return some grouped data'
      _negated = abap_true
    ).

    " Check a specific carrier, e.g., 'AA'
    READ TABLE lt_actual_analysis WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_analysis).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_sum_price) = 0.
      SELECT COUNT(*) SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO (lv_expected_count, lv_expected_sum_price) WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_analysis-flight_count exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Flight count for AA should match' ).
      IF lv_expected_count > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_analysis-average_price exp = lv_expected_sum_price / lv_expected_count msg = 'Average price for AA should match' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit auszulesen und deren Namen und Typen in einer internen Tabelle zu speichern. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer Struktur vom Typ `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für die RTTI-Analyse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_components = VALUE #( "COMPUTE"-like operation for transformation
          FOR ls_component_entry IN lt_components
          ( name = ls_component_entry-name
            type = ls_component_entry-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) )
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if ir_data is not a structure
        CLEAR rt_components.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_components.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_comp-type exp = 'CARRID' msg = 'CARRID component type incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'PRICE' INTO DATA(ls_price_comp).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_price_comp-type exp = 'SFLIGHT_PRICE' msg = 'PRICE component type incorrect' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` und erstellen Sie dann eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine ID und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft enthält, wobei der Name aus einer anderen Tabelle (z.B. `scarr`) abgeleitet wird. Nutzen Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` und den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` für die Fluggesellschaften und anschließend `VALUE #( FOR ... )` mit einem `READ TABLE` oder `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` auf eine Lookup-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_value_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carrier_details RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_details) TYPE tt_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_value_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrier_details.
    DATA lt_distinct_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " 1. Eindeutige Fluggesellschaften aus sflights lesen
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_distinct_carrids.

    " 2. Alle Fluggesellschaftsdaten aus scarr lesen (für den Lookup)
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    " 3. Neue Tabelle mit VALUE und FOR erstellen, die die Namen hinzufügt
    rt_carrier_details = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_distinct_carrids
                                  LET ls_scarr_entry = lt_scarr[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_carrid ] IN
                                  ( carrid = ls_carrid
                                    carrname = ls_scarr_entry-carrname ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrier_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Lufthansa (LH) mit korrektem Namen enthalten ist
    DATA(ls_lh_entry) = VALUE zcl_distinct_value_combine=>ty_carrier_info(
      carrid = 'LH'
      carrname = 'Lufthansa'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob American Airlines (AA) mit korrektem Namen enthalten ist
    DATA(ls_aa_entry) = VALUE zcl_distinct_value_combine=>ty_carrier_info(
      carrid = 'AA'
      carrname = 'American Airlines'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `SELECT DISTINCT` zur effizienten Beschaffung eindeutiger Schlüssel und dem `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `LET` für die anschließende Transformation und Anreicherung dieser Daten. `LET` ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, was den Code lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise in einer internen Tabelle von Produkten unter Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE type( REDUCE <result_var> FOR <wa> IN <itab> NEXT <result_var> = <result_var> + <wa>-field )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = VALUE #( REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR product IN it_products
                                NEXT sum = sum + product-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_value_reduce_sum=>tt_products(
      ( name = 'Item A' price = '10.50' )
      ( name = 'Item B' price = '20.00' )
      ( name = 'Item C' price = '5.25' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '35.75' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_input) = VALUE zcl_value_reduce_sum=>tt_products( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator innerhalb von `VALUE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Mit `INIT` wird ein Startwert für die Akkumulatorvariable (`sum`) festgelegt, und `NEXT` definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Summen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionen durchzuführen.
keywords: VALUE, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob es in der Tabelle `sflights` mindestens einen Flug gibt, der von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegt und nach 'NEW YORK' fliegt, unter Verwendung von `SELECT DISTINCT` und einer `EXISTS` Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE @abap_true FROM sflights WHERE ... AND EXISTS ( SELECT DISTINCT ... )` oder `IF EXISTS ( SELECT DISTINCT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_distinct_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_route_exists
      IMPORTING iv_city_from TYPE s_city_fr
                iv_city_to   TYPE s_city_to
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_distinct_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_route_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true
      FROM sflights
      WHERE cityfrom = @iv_city_from
        AND cityto   = @iv_city_to
      INTO @rv_exists.

    " Alternativ mit EXISTS (ABAP 7.50+)
    " IF EXISTS( SELECT DISTINCT carrid, connid FROM sflights
    "            WHERE cityfrom = @iv_city_from AND cityto = @iv_city_to ).
    "   rv_exists = abap_true.
    " ELSE.
    "   rv_exists = abap_false.
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische Open SQL SELECT-Anweisung für die Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf optionalen Benutzereingaben (z.B. Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort). Verwende `CONCATENATE` zum Aufbau der WHERE-Klausel.
hint: Baue die WHERE-Klausel schrittweise mit `CONCATENATE` auf und nutze `COND` für optionale Bedingungen. Beachte die SQL-Injektionsgefahr bei echtem dynamischem SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sflight_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sflight_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = ``.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      CONCATENATE lv_where_clause `CARRID = '` iv_carrid `'` INTO lv_where_clause SEPARATED BY ` AND `.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_cityfrom IS NOT INITIAL.
      CONCATENATE lv_where_clause `CITYFROM = '` iv_cityfrom `'` INTO lv_where_clause SEPARATED BY ` AND `.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_select_statement) = `SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflights `.
    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      CONCATENATE lv_select_statement `WHERE` lv_where_clause INTO lv_select_statement SEPARATED BY ` `.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
          FROM sflights
          WHERE (lv_where_clause)
          INTO TABLE rt_flights.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_osql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_osql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_all FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_all.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID should be LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should return flights from FRANKFURT' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'CITYFROM should be FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_both.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sflight_query( ).

    ENDLOOP.

Die Verwendung von dynamischem SQL (`WHERE (lv_where_clause)`) ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die Vorsicht erfordert, um SQL-Injektionen zu vermeiden. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und optionale Parameter (`OPTIONAL`) sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Lies Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und formatiere sie zeilenweise in einem einzigen String, wobei jedes Feld durch ein Komma getrennt ist und jede Zeile mit einem Zeilenumbruch endet. Verwende `CONCATENATE` innerhalb einer Schleife.
hint: Nutze eine `LOOP` über die `sflights`-Daten und `CONCATENATE` für jede Zeile. Füge `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_sflights_to_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_sflights_to_string.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_line_string TYPE string.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CONCATENATE ls_sflight-carrid
                  ls_sflight-connid
                  ls_sflight-fldate
                  ls_sflight-cityfrom
                  ls_sflight-cityto
        INTO lv_line_string
        SEPARATED BY ',' .
      CONCATENATE rv_formatted_string lv_line_string cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
        INTO rv_formatted_string.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstriere den Unterschied zwischen `CONCATENATE` und String Templates (`&&`) beim Zusammenfügen von Strings, indem du beide Ansätze für das gleiche Ergebnis verwendest und die Ergebnisse vergleichst.
hint: Verwende `CONCATENATE` und String Templates, um denselben Satz zu bilden. Vergleiche die Lesbarkeit und Kürze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_concatenation
      IMPORTING
        iv_part1 TYPE string
        iv_part2 TYPE string
        iv_part3 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_compare=>ty_results.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_results,
             concatenated_string TYPE string,
             template_string     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_concatenation.
    CREATE DATA rs_results.

    " Using CONCATENATE
    CONCATENATE iv_part1 iv_part2 iv_part3
      INTO rs_results->concatenated_string
      SEPARATED BY ' '.

    " Using String Templates
    rs_results->template_string = |{ iv_part1 } { iv_part2 } { iv_part3 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_concatenation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_concatenation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_cut->compare_concatenation( iv_part1 = 'Hello' iv_part2 = 'modern' iv_part3 = 'ABAP' ).

    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Hello modern ABAP'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->concatenated_string exp = lv_expected msg = 'CONCATENATE result should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->template_string exp = lv_expected msg = 'String Template result should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->concatenated_string exp = ls_results->template_string msg = 'Both methods should yield the same result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die klassische `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung mit den modernen String-Templates (`|...|`). Während `CONCATENATE` weiterhin funktional ist, bieten String-Templates eine deutlich lesbarere und flexiblere Syntax, insbesondere bei der Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken. Dies ist ein klares Beispiel für die Evolution der ABAP-Sprache hin zu mehr Ausdruckskraft und Kürze.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, String Processing, Comparison

Instructions: Verwende `CONCATENATE` in Kombination mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zu verbinden.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und `CONCATENATE` innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concatenate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrids_as_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concatenate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_as_string.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight-carrid )
    ).

    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrid IN lt_carrids
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrid
        ELSE CONCATENATE s `, ` carrid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrids_as_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrids_as_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concatenate( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carrids_as_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Result string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = ',' msg = 'Result should contain commas' ).
    " Further assertions could check for specific carrid values if known and stable in sflights
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von `CONCATENATE` mit dem funktionalen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck. Zuerst werden eindeutige Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck in eine interne Tabelle geladen. Dann wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um diese Liste zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zu aggregieren. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` sorgt dafür, dass das erste Element nicht mit einem führenden Komma beginnt. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster für die Datenaggregation.
keywords: CONCATENATE, REDUCE, String Processing, Functional Programming, sflights, COND

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number,
             id TYPE i,
             square TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_squares) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_squares.
    INSERT LINES OF VALUE tt_numbers(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i <= iv_count
      ( id = i square = i * i )
    ) INTO TABLE rt_squares.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_generate_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_for( ).
    DATA(lt_squares) = lo_cut->generate_squares( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_squares ) exp = 5 ).

    READ TABLE lt_squares WITH KEY id = 3 TRANSPORTING square.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_squares[ id = 3 ]-square exp = 9 ).

    READ TABLE lt_squares WITH KEY id = 5 TRANSPORTING square.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_squares[ id = 5 ]-square exp = 25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, deren Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert (z.B. 500) liegt. Die Fluggesellschaften sollen in Großbuchstaben formatiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `COND` oder `FILTER` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und `TO UPPER` für die String-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                             ( TO_UPPER( flight-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_carriers( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming no flights over 500 in test system, adjust as needed

    " Add some dummy data for a more robust test if sflights is empty or unpredictable
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 600 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 300 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 750 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_filtered_carriers( 500 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE #(` und `FOR ... WHERE ... IN` um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien und Transformationen zu erstellen. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND` Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, FILTER, sflights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_manufacturer( '747' ) exp = 'Boeing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_manufacturer( 'A320' ) exp = 'Airbus' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Expression (eingeführt mit ABAP 7.50) ist eine weitere funktionale Erweiterung für die Fallunterscheidung. Sie ist besonders nützlich, wenn ein einzelner Wert gegen mehrere mögliche Werte geprüft und ein Ergebnis zurückgegeben werden soll, was zu sehr prägnantem Code führt.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation von Tabellendaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).

    " Ensure sflights has some data for 'LH'
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 300 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 350 ).

    lv_total = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (eingeführt mit ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ist eine elegante Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen und führt zu kürzerem und ausdrucksstärkerem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA') durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für die funktionale Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                             WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_future( ).

    " Prepare test data
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' OR carrid = 'DL'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum - 1 price = 200 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum + 2 price = 300 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0001' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( 'DL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0003' ).
