explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (eingeführt mit ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Flugdatum in eine interne Tabelle ein. Verwenden Sie dabei Inline-Deklaration für die Zieltabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration der Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_from_db)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rt_flights = lt_flights_from_db.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_reader( ).

    " Prepare test data
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'SQ' AND fldate = '20251224'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251224' price = 1000 currency = 'SGD' ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251224' price = 1200 currency = 'SGD' ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' price = 500 currency = 'EUR' ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_key( iv_carrid = 'SQ' iv_fldate = '20251224' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = 1200 ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_flights_by_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_fldate = '20251224' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von Datenobjekten (eingeführt mit ABAP 7.40) in Open SQL-Anweisungen (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) macht den Code kürzer und lesbarer, da die explizite Deklaration der internen Tabelle vor dem `SELECT` entfällt. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen für Host-Variablen sind ebenfalls Teil des modernen Open SQL.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Database Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Nachricht mit einem Präfix und einem Suffix versehen kann. Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung des Objekts und das Aufrufen von Methoden in einer Kette (Method Chaining).
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung und geben Sie `ME` in den Methoden zurück, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_message_builder.
    METHODS set_suffix
      IMPORTING
        iv_suffix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_message_builder.
    METHODS build_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_prefix TYPE string.
    DATA mv_suffix TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_prefix.
    mv_prefix = iv_prefix.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_suffix.
    mv_suffix = iv_suffix.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_message.
    rv_final_message = |{ mv_prefix }{ iv_message }{ mv_suffix }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_message) = NEW zcl_message_builder( )->set_prefix( 'INFO: ' )->set_suffix( ' (Ende)' )->build_message( 'Dies ist eine Testnachricht' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'INFO: Dies ist eine Testnachricht (Ende)' ).

    DATA(lv_simple_message) = NEW zcl_message_builder( )->build_message( 'Einfach' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_simple_message exp = 'Einfach' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. In Kombination mit dem `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung führt dies zu sehr flüssigem und lesbarem Code, der temporäre Variablen reduziert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, NEW, Constructor Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache ALV-Liste aus der `sflights`-Tabelle und greifen Sie über das ALV-Objektmodell auf die Metadaten des Controllers zu, um beispielsweise den Titel der Liste zu setzen. (Hinweis: Die Anzeige des ALV ist hier nicht das Ziel, sondern der Zugriff auf die Metadaten.)
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_salv_table` und nutzen Sie dessen `get_controller` Methode, um auf `cl_salv_controller_metadata` zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_metadata_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_alv_title
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_metadata_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_alv_title.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_metadata_controller) = lo_salv_table->get_controller( ).
        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_list_header( iv_title ).

        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_set_alv_title FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_alv_title.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_metadata_access( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_alv_title( 'Mein Test ALV Titel' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Further assertions would require mocking CL_SALV_TABLE and its dependencies,
    " which is complex for a simple example. Here we just check for successful execution.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Zugriff auf die Metadaten eines ALV-Objekts über das ALV-Objektmodell. Obwohl `cl_salv_controller_metadata` eine abstrakte Klasse ist, wird sie über die Methode `get_controller()` von `cl_salv_table` zurückgegeben. Dies zeigt, wie man mit modernen ABAP-Objektorientierungsprinzipien (wie Method Chaining und Inline-Deklarationen) die Eigenschaften eines ALV-Berichts dynamisch zur Laufzeit manipulieren kann, ohne auf veraltete Funktionsbausteine zurückzugreifen.
keywords: ALV, cl_salv_controller_metadata, Object Orientation, cl_salv_table

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine Konstante für einen Fluggesellschaftscode ('LH') und eine Variable für einen Flugpreis (initial 0), beide mit Inline-Deklaration, wobei die Konstante als `FINAL` gekennzeichnet ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FINAL` für Konstanten und `DATA(...)` für Variablen in Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_declarations
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE REF TO struct_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_data,
             carrier TYPE s_carr_id,
             price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF struct_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_declarations.
    FINAL(lc_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_price) = 0.

    " lv_price kann später geändert werden
    lv_price = 123.45.

    CREATE DATA rs_data.
    rs_data->carrier = lc_carrid.
    rs_data->price = lv_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_declarations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_declarations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declarations( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_cut->demonstrate_declarations( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data->carrier exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data->price exp = 123.45 ).

    " Test, dass lc_carrid wirklich final ist (würde Syntaxfehler geben, wenn versucht)
    " lc_carrid = 'AA'. " Dies würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FINAL`-Deklaration (eingeführt mit ABAP 7.50) in Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Konstanten, deren Wert nach der Initialisierung nicht mehr geändert werden kann. Dies verbessert die Code-Sicherheit und Lesbarkeit, da der Entwickler sofort erkennt, dass ein Wert konstant ist. Es ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, Variablen und Konstanten zu deklarieren.
keywords: Inline Declaration, FINAL, Constants, Data Declarations

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur die Fluggesellschaften 'LH' oder 'AA' enthält, und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'STATUS' hinzu, die 'ACTIVE' ist, wenn der Flugpreis über 300 liegt, ansonsten 'INACTIVE'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR`, `VALUE` und `COND` in Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_with_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_with_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA' )
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                               connid = flight-connid,
                               fldate = flight-fldate,
                               price  = flight-price,
                               status = COND string( WHEN flight-price > 300 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_with_status( ).

    " Prepare test data
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 400 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 550 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = 600 ) ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_lh_low) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh_low-status exp = 'INACTIVE' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_lh_high) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh_high-status exp = 'ACTIVE' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa_low) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa_low-status exp = 'INACTIVE' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa_high) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa_high-status exp = 'ACTIVE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR ... WHERE` für die Filterung und Iteration mit `VALUE #(` für die Konstruktion einer neuen internen Tabelle. Innerhalb der Konstruktion wird die `COND`-Expression verwendet, um dynamisch einen Wert für die neue Spalte 'STATUS' zu bestimmen. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Ausdrücke, um komplexe Datenmanipulationen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung durchzuführen, anstatt mehrere Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen zu verwenden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, ELSE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Schnittstelle mit einer Standardimplementierung für eine Methode. Erstellen Sie dann eine Klasse, die diese Schnittstelle implementiert und die Standardimplementierung überschreibt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung der Schnittstelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES ... DEFAULT METHODS` für die Standardimplementierung und `REDEFINITION` in der Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.

  " Standardimplementierung ab ABAP 7.50
  METHODS log_info
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
    DEFAULT METHODS zif_logger~log_message.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.

    METHODS zif_logger~log_message REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / 'Console Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.

    METHODS zif_logger~log_message REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier in eine Datei geschrieben
    WRITE: / 'File Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_logger_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_logger_interface.
    DATA lo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.

    " Test Console Logger
    lo_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " Die Ausgabe müsste manuell geprüft werden, da WRITE nicht in Unit Tests erfasst wird.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man die WRITE-Ausgabe umleiten oder mocken.
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Testnachricht für Konsole' ).
    lo_logger->log_info( 'Info für Konsole (Standard)' ).

    " Test File Logger
    lo_logger = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Testnachricht für Datei' ).
    lo_logger->log_info( 'Info für Datei (Standard)' ).

    " Da WRITE-Anweisungen schwer in Unit-Tests zu prüfen sind, 
    " wird hier nur die erfolgreiche Ausführung ohne Dump geprüft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Dummy assertion
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und eine spezifische Ausnahme (`cx_sy_zerodivide`) abfängt. Geben Sie eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH` für die Ausnahmebehandlung und `RAISE EXCEPTION` (implizit durch Division durch Null).
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    DATA lv_division_result TYPE f.

    TRY.
        lv_division_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.'.
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_result = 'Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Ergebnis: 5.00000000000000000000E+00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP mit `TRY ... CATCH` (eingeführt vor ABAP 7.40, aber als Best Practice in modernem Code) ermöglicht eine strukturierte und robuste Fehlerbehandlung. Anstatt SY-SUBRC zu prüfen, werden Ausnahmen als Objekte behandelt, die spezifische Fehlerzustände repräsentieren. Dies führt zu klarerem und wartbarerem Code, da Fehler explizit abgefangen und verarbeitet werden können.
keywords: Exception Handling, TRY, CATCH, cx_sy_zerodivide, Error Handling

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING, die eine 4-Byte-Integer-Zahl im Little-Endian-Format enthält, in eine ABAP-Integer-Zahl (Big-Endian-System).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create` mit `endian = 'LITTLE'` und `read`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_endian DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_little_endian_int
      IMPORTING
        ix_little_endian_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_endian IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_little_endian_int.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8' " Encoding doesn't matter for pure binary data, but required.
      endian = 'LITTLE'
    ).

    lo_conv->read(
      EXPORTING
        data = ix_little_endian_data
      IMPORTING
        nbytes = DATA(lv_nbytes)
        buffer = rv_integer
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_endian_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_endian_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_endian( ).
    " Example: Integer 256 (0x0100) in Little Endian is 0001 (hex)
    " In Big Endian (ABAP internal), it's 0100 (hex)
    DATA(lx_little_endian_256) = '00010000'X. " 256 in little endian (0x00000100)
    DATA(lv_result_256) = lo_converter->convert_little_endian_int( lx_little_endian_256 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_256 exp = 256 msg = 'Should convert little endian 256 correctly' ).

    " Example: Integer 1 (0x0001) in Little Endian is 01000000 (hex)
    DATA(lx_little_endian_1) = '01000000'X. " 1 in little endian (0x00000001)
    DATA(lv_result_1) = lo_converter->convert_little_endian_int( lx_little_endian_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_1 exp = 1 msg = 'Should convert little endian 1 correctly' ).

    " Example: Integer 16777216 (0x01000000) in Little Endian is 00000001 (hex)
    DATA(lx_little_endian_16M) = '00000001'X. " 16777216 in little endian (0x01000000)
    DATA(lv_result_16M) = lo_converter->convert_little_endian_int( lx_little_endian_16M ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_16M exp = 16777216 msg = 'Should convert little endian 16777216 correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Endian-Konvertierung ist entscheidend beim Austausch von Binärdaten zwischen Systemen mit unterschiedlicher Byte-Reihenfolge. `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` ermöglicht das Lesen von XSTRING-Daten unter Angabe der externen Endianness, um sie korrekt in ABAP-Datentypen zu interpretieren.
keywords: Endian, Little Endian, Big Endian, XSTRING, Integer, Conversion, cl_abap_conv_in_ce

      EXPORTING iv_value = 1

      EXPORTING iv_value = 100
      IMPORTING ev_ln_value = lv_ln ev_log10_value = lv_log10
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_log10 exp = 2 AS decfloat34 msg = 'log10(100) should be 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Sinus, Cosinus und Tangens eines Winkels (im Bogenmaß).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_math=>sin`, `cl_abap_math=>cos` und `cl_abap_math=>tan`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_trigonometry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_trig_functions
      IMPORTING
        iv_angle_radians TYPE decfloat34
      EXPORTING
        ev_sin_value TYPE decfloat34
        ev_cos_value TYPE decfloat34
        ev_tan_value TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_trigonometry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_trig_functions.
    ev_sin_value = cl_abap_math=>sin( iv_angle_radians ).
    ev_cos_value = cl_abap_math=>cos( iv_angle_radians ).
    ev_tan_value = cl_abap_math=>tan( iv_angle_radians ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_trig_functions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_trig_functions.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    DATA: lv_sin TYPE decfloat34, lv_cos TYPE decfloat34, lv_tan TYPE decfloat34.

    " Angle 0 radians
    lo_math->calculate_trig_functions(
      EXPORTING iv_angle_radians = 0
      IMPORTING ev_sin_value = lv_sin ev_cos_value = lv_cos ev_tan_value = lv_tan
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sin exp = 0 AS decfloat34 msg = 'sin(0) should be 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cos exp = 1 AS decfloat34 msg = 'cos(0) should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_tan exp = 0 AS decfloat34 msg = 'tan(0) should be 0' ).

    " Angle PI/2 radians (approx 1.570796326794897)
    DATA(lv_pi_half) = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) / 2.
    lo_math->calculate_trig_functions(
      EXPORTING iv_angle_radians = lv_pi_half
      IMPORTING ev_sin_value = lv_sin ev_cos_value = lv_cos ev_tan_value = lv_tan
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_delta( act = lv_sin exp = 1 AS decfloat34 delta = '0.000000000000001' AS decfloat34 msg = 'sin(PI/2) should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_delta( act = lv_cos exp = 0 AS decfloat34 delta = '0.000000000000001' AS decfloat34 msg = 'cos(PI/2) should be 0' ).
    " Tan(PI/2) is undefined, cl_abap_math=>tan raises CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW
    " So we test with a value close to PI/2
    DATA(lv_angle_near_pi_half) = lv_pi_half - '0.000000000000001' AS decfloat34.
    lo_math->calculate_trig_functions(
      EXPORTING iv_angle_radians = lv_angle_near_pi_half
      IMPORTING ev_sin_value = lv_sin ev_cos_value = lv_cos ev_tan_value = lv_tan
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_delta( act = lv_tan exp = '1592653589793238' AS decfloat34 delta = '1' AS decfloat34 msg = 'tan(near PI/2) should be very large' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_abap_math`-Klasse bietet direkte Implementierungen für trigonometrische Funktionen wie Sinus, Cosinus und Tangens, was die Durchführung mathematischer Berechnungen in ABAP erheblich vereinfacht und standardisiert.
keywords: Math, Trigonometry, Sine, Cosine, Tangent, Radians, decfloat34, cl_abap_math

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(

CLASS zcl_sflight_lh_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_sflight_lh_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_lh_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          " cl_salv_ex_util ist eine Utility-Klasse für den Export von ALV-Daten.
          " Hier wird ein Dummy-Aufruf für den Export nach Excel demonstriert.
          " In einer realen Anwendung würde dies einen Dateidialog oder ähnliches erfordern.
          DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
          lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
            EXPORTING
              t_data = rt_flights
              i_title = 'LH Flights'
          ).
        CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
          " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Meldung ausgeben
          MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_cnt TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
        DATA(ls_group) = VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_cnt = GROUP SIZE ).
        APPEND ls_group TO rt_grouped_data.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF NOT rt_grouped_data IS INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
            lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
              EXPORTING
                t_data = rt_grouped_data
                i_title = 'Flight Count by Carrier'
            ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_type,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_city_from_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_sflight_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_city_from.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        TRY.
            " Zugriff auf ein Element über einen Tabellenausdruck
            DATA(lv_city_from) = lt_sflights[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid ]-cityfrom.
            APPEND VALUE ty_flight_info(
              carrid = ls_flight-carrid
              connid = ls_flight-connid
              cityfrom = lv_city_from
            ) TO rt_city_from_data.
          CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
            " Fehlerbehandlung, falls der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird (sollte hier nicht passieren)
            CONTINUE.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF NOT rt_city_from_data IS INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
            lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
              EXPORTING
                t_data = rt_city_from_data
                i_title = 'Flight Departure Cities'
            ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH'). Exportieren Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator und `cl_salv_ex_util`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_total_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_total_capacity.
    TYPES tt_total_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_total_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_export_total_capacity
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_capacity_data) TYPE tt_total_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_total_capacity(
        carrid = iv_carrid
        total_capacity = lv_total_capacity
      ) TO rt_capacity_data.

      IF NOT rt_capacity_data IS INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
            lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
              EXPORTING
                t_data = rt_capacity_data
                i_title = |Total Capacity for { iv_carrid }|
            ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten kapselt und eine Methode zur Berechnung der Auslastung bietet. Exportieren Sie eine Liste dieser Flugobjekte mit ihrer Auslastung.
hint: Verwenden Sie Objektorientierung, `NEW` Operator und `cl_salv_ex_util`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY,
          connid   TYPE sflight-connid READ-ONLY,
          seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc READ-ONLY,
          seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    METHODS get_occupancy_rate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_occupancy_rate) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->connid = iv_connid.
    me->seatsocc = iv_seatsocc.
    me->seatsmax = iv_seatsmax.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_occupancy_rate.
    IF seatsmax > 0.
      rv_occupancy_rate = ( seatsocc / seatsmax ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      rv_occupancy_rate = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_oo_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_export_occupancy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy_data) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_oo_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        DATA(lo_flight) = NEW zcl_flight_data(
          iv_carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          iv_connid = ls_flight-connid,
          iv_seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc,
          iv_seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax
        ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_occupancy(
          carrid = lo_flight->carrid
          connid = lo_flight->connid
          occupancy_rate = lo_flight->get_occupancy_rate( )
        ) TO rt_occupancy_data.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF NOT rt_occupancy_data IS INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
            lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
              EXPORTING
                t_data = rt_occupancy_data
                i_title = 'Flight Occupancy Rates'
            ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie Flüge basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH' als 'Lufthansa', 'AA' als 'American Airlines', sonst 'Andere'). Exportieren Sie diese Kategorisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator und `cl_salv_ex_util`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_export_flight_categories
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_categories) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_flight_categories.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        DATA(lv_category) = SWITCH string(
          ls_flight-carrid
          WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
          WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
          WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
          ELSE 'Andere'
        ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_category(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          category = lv_category
        ) TO rt_categories.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF NOT rt_categories IS INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
            lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
              EXPORTING
                t_data = rt_categories
                i_title = 'Flight Categories'
            ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie eine Kette von Operationen auf einer internen Tabelle ausführen (z.B. Filtern und dann Reduzieren). Exportieren Sie das Endergebnis.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in einem Ausdruck und `cl_salv_ex_util`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_filtered_sum.
    TYPES tt_filtered_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_export_chained_data
      IMPORTING iv_min_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chained_data) TYPE tt_filtered_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_export_chained_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_seats_filtered) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE connid > iv_min_connid )
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_filtered_sum(
        carrid = 'Filtered'
        total_seats = lv_total_seats_filtered
      ) TO rt_chained_data.

      IF NOT rt_chained_data IS INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
            lo_salv_ex_util->if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_excel(
              EXPORTING
                t_data = rt_chained_data
                i_title = 'Chained Operations Result'
            ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_ex_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_chaining( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_chained_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Gesamtsitze sollten größer als 0 sein' act = xsdbool( lt_chained_data[ 1 ]-total_seats > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich, da Zwischenergebnisse nicht in separaten Variablen gespeichert werden müssen. Das Endergebnis wird mit `cl_salv_ex_util` exportiert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem bestimmten Zeilentyp und füllen Sie sie mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table IMPORTING iv_line_type_name TYPE string it_data_rows TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_line_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
    DATA(lo_table_typedescr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_line_typedescr p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_typedescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
      LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_row_data).
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          TRY.
              <fs_line> = lv_row_data.
            CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
              " Handle type mismatch
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_rows) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Value1' ) ( 'Value2' ) ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_line_type_name = 'STRING' it_data_rows = lt_rows ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE string.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line> exp = 'Value1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle mit einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Zeilentyp. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für generische Datencontainer.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, Internal Table

CLASS zcl_csv_create_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_csv_create_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_csv_from_flights.
    DATA(lt_header) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'CITYFROM' ) ( 'CITYTO' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_string_table_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( VALUE string_table( ( ls_flight-carrid ) ( ls_flight-connid ) ( ls_flight-cityfrom ) ( ls_flight-cityto ) ) )
    ).

    rv_csv_string = cl_icf_csv=>create_csv_string(
      i_header_table = lt_header
      i_data_table   = lt_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_csv_create_simple=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'DALLAS' cityto = 'LONDON' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_create_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_cut->create_csv_from_flights( lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = 'CARRID,CONNID,CITYFROM,CITYTO' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            'LH,0400,FRANKFURT,NEW YORK' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            'AA,0010,DALLAS,LONDON'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv exp = lv_expected_csv msg = 'CSV string mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_to_flights.
    DATA(lt_parsed_data) = cl_icf_csv=>parse_csv_string(
      i_csv_string = iv_csv_string
      i_has_header = abap_false
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_parsed_data INTO DATA(ls_row).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid   = ls_row[ 1 ]
                      connid   = ls_row[ 2 ]
                      cityfrom = ls_row[ 3 ]
                      cityto   = ls_row[ 4 ] ) TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_parse_simple( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->parse_csv_to_flights( lv_csv ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of rows mismatch' ).

Die Indizierung `ls_row[ 1 ]` ist eine moderne Art, auf Elemente einer String-Tabelle zuzugreifen.

CLASS zcl_csv_create_custom IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_csv_with_options.
    DATA(lt_header) = VALUE string_table( ( 'ID' ) ( 'NAME' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_string_table_table(
      FOR ls_product IN it_products
      ( VALUE string_table( ( ls_product-id ) ( ls_product-name ) ( CONV string( ls_product-price ) ) ) )
    ).

    rv_csv_string = cl_icf_csv=>create_csv_string(
      i_header_table = lt_header
      i_data_table   = lt_data
      i_delimiter    = ';'
      i_quoting      = cl_icf_csv=>c_quoting_all
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parse einen CSV-String, bei dem die Spaltennamen im CSV von den Feldnamen der Zielstruktur abweichen, und mappe sie korrekt. Der CSV-String hat die Spalten 'Product ID', 'Product Name', 'Unit Price'. Die Zielstruktur hat 'id', 'name', 'price'.
hint: Nutze `CL_ICF_CSV=>PARSE_CSV_STRING` mit dem Parameter `I_FIELD_MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parse_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_with_mapping
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_mapping.
    DATA(lt_field_mapping) = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_field_mapping(
      ( csv_field = 'Product ID'    abap_field = 'ID' )
      ( csv_field = 'Product Name'  abap_field = 'NAME' )
      ( csv_field = 'Unit Price'    abap_field = 'PRICE' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_parsed_data) = cl_icf_csv=>parse_csv_string(
      i_csv_string   = iv_csv_string
      i_has_header   = abap_true
      i_field_mapping = lt_field_mapping
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_parsed_data INTO DATA(ls_row).
      APPEND VALUE #( id    = ls_row[ 'ID' ]
                      name  = ls_row[ 'NAME' ]
                      price = CONV p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2( ls_row[ 'PRICE' ] ) ) TO rt_products.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_parse_csv_mapping FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_csv_mapping.
    DATA(lv_csv) = 'Product ID,Product Name,Unit Price' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                    'P003,Keyboard,75.00' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                    'P004,Monitor,299.99'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_parse_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = lo_cut->parse_csv_with_mapping( lv_csv ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_products ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of rows mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[ 1 ]-id exp = 'P003' msg = 'Product ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Monitor' msg = 'Product Name mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[ 2 ]-price exp = '299.99' msg = 'Price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Fehlerbehandlung beim Parsen eines fehlerhaften CSV-Strings, der eine ungleichmäßige Anzahl von Spalten pro Zeile enthält.
hint: `CL_ICF_CSV=>PARSE_CSV_STRING` kann Ausnahmen vom Typ `CX_ICF_ERROR` auslösen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_icf_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_parsed_data) = cl_icf_csv=>parse_csv_string(
          i_csv_string = iv_csv_string
          i_has_header = abap_false
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_parsed_data INTO DATA(ls_row).
          APPEND VALUE #( field1 = ls_row[ 1 ]
                          field2 = ls_row[ 2 ] ) TO rt_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_icf_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_parse_csv_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_csv_error.
    DATA(lv_csv_invalid) = 'Val1,Val2' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            'Val3'. " Missing Val4

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_error_handling( ).

    " Expecting an exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcx_test_exception_wrapper( lo_cut->parse_csv_with_error_handling( lv_csv_invalid ) )
      exp_type = 'CX_ICF_ERROR'
      msg = 'Expected CX_ICF_ERROR for invalid CSV' ).

    " Helper class to wrap method call for assert_raises
    CLASS zcx_test_exception_wrapper DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_dummy TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcx_test_exception_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit Ausnahmen umgeht, die von `CL_ICF_CSV=>PARSE_CSV_STRING` ausgelöst werden können, z.B. bei fehlerhaften CSV-Formaten. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ist essentiell für robuste Anwendungen. Die Ausnahme `CX_ICF_ERROR` wird gefangen und erneut ausgelöst, um die Fehlerbehandlung an den Aufrufer zu delegieren.
keywords: CSV, Error Handling, Exception, CX_ICF_ERROR, CL_ICF_CSV

CLASS zcl_ecl_alv_integration IMPLEMENTATION.

      CHANGING

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ts_component_info.

                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      APPEND VALUE ts_component_info( name = ls_comp-name type = ls_comp-type->type_name ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

    METHODS call_method_dynamically IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                                            iv_method_name TYPE string
                                            iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_param TYPE string.
    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_param = iv_param_value.
      CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) EXPORTING iv_input = lv_param.
    ELSE.
      CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Attribut eines Objekts zu und lesen/schreiben Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit dem Zusatz `OF STRUCTURE` oder `OF OBJECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_attribute_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_value IMPORTING io_object      TYPE REF TO object
                                          iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    METHODS set_attribute_value IMPORTING io_object      TYPE REF TO object
                                          iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                          iv_new_value   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_attribute_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF OBJECT io_object TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF OBJECT io_object TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_value> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_interfaces`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface IMPORTING iv_class_name    TYPE string
                                           iv_interface_name TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rb_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA: lt_interfaces TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_interface_descr.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        lt_interfaces = lo_classdescr->get_interfaces( ).
        LOOP AT lt_interfaces INTO DATA(ls_interface).
          IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
            rb_implements = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        " Class or interface not found
        rb_implements = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
    rb_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Methoden einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_method_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_public_method_names IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE tt_method_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_method_names.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
          IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
            APPEND ls_method-name TO rt_method_names.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        " Class not found
        " Return empty table
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_compatible IMPORTING iv_data1 TYPE any
                                           iv_data2 TYPE any
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rb_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_typedescr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).
    IF lo_typedescr1 = lo_typedescr2.

    ELSE.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String (z.B. CSV-Inhalt) in ein XSTRING-Format, um ihn als E-Mail-Anhang zu versenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `STRING_TO_XSTRING` der Klasse `CL_BCS_CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_str_to_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING iv_string_content TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_str_to_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
            iv_string = iv_string_content
            iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
            iv_endian = 'B'     " Big Endian
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE 'Error converting string to xstring' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_str_to_xstr( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello,World,123'.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_string_to_xstring( lv_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).
    " Inhalt durch Rückkonvertierung überprüfen (optional, aber gut für robusten Test)
    DATA(lv_back_to_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(
                                  iv_xstring = lv_xstring
                                  iv_codepage = '4103'

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_str_to_xstr( ).

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_string_to_xstring( lv_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_special_chars.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) in einen CSV-String.

CLASS zcl_bcs_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv.
    DATA(lv_header) = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY'.
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    rv_csv_string = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = lv_header && lv_crlf
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
        NEXT s = s && |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid },{ <fs_sflight>-connid },{ <fs_sflight>-fldate },{ <fs_sflight>-price },{ <fs_sflight>-currency }| && lv_crlf
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und weisen Sie ihm einen Wert zu. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` zur sicheren Handhabung des Feldsymbols.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_updated_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    rs_updated_data = is_data. " Kopie der Eingabestruktur

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE rs_updated_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Wert basierend auf Feldtyp zuweisen
      CASE cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> )->type_kind.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          <fs_field> = iv_value.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
          <fs_field> = CONV i( iv_value ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Andere Typen behandeln oder Fehler auslösen
          MESSAGE 'Unsupported field type for dynamic assignment' TYPE 'W'.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      " Feld nicht gefunden
      MESSAGE 'Field not found in structure' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Explizit freigeben für Sicherheit/Ressourcenmanagement
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen zu. Wenn die Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist, stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nicht zugewiesen ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN` in Kombination mit `IF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_cond_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_symbol_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_cond_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_symbol_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    IF iv_condition = abap_true.
      ASSIGN is_data-value TO <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      UNASSIGN <fs_value>. " Sicherstellen, dass es nicht zugewiesen ist, wenn Bedingung falsch ist
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field symbol not assigned'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle effizient mit Feldsymbolen, um die Performance zu optimieren. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` nach der Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_fs_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflights_with_fs
      IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_fs_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights_with_fs.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      " Beispiel: Preis um 10% erhöhen
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'.
      " Beispiel: Währung auf 'USD' setzen, wenn 'EUR'
      IF <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
        <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>. " Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch freigeben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen und versenden Sie eine E-Mail mit HTML-Inhalt und einem CSV-Anhang, der Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_BCS_CONVERT` für HTML-zu-Text und String-zu-XSTRING mit den BCS-Klassen (`CL_BCS`, `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS`, `CL_SENDER_BCS`, `CL_RECIPIENT_BCS`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, price TYPE sflight-price, currency TYPE sflight-currency, END OF ty_sflight_data. TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY. METHODS send_sflight_report_email IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD send_sflight_report_email. DATA: lo_bcs TYPE REF TO cl_bcs, lo_document TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs, lo_sender TYPE REF TO cl_sender_bcs, lo_recipient TYPE REF TO cl_recipient_bcs, lv_subject TYPE so_obj_des, lv_html_body TYPE string, lt_text_body TYPE bcs_text, lv_csv_string TYPE string, lv_xstring_csv TYPE xstring. " 1. E-Mail-Betreff lv_subject = 'SFLIGHTS Report - ' && sy-datum. " 2. HTML-E-Mail-Textkörper lv_html_body = |

Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

| && |

anbei finden Sie den aktuellen SFLIGHTS-Report.

| && |

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Ihr ABAP-System

|. " HTML in Text konvertieren für den E-Mail-Textkörper lt_text_body = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_string = cl_bcs_convert=>html_to_text( lv_html_body ) iv_codepage = '4103' ). " 3. CSV-Anhang generieren DATA(lv_header) = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY'. DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf. lv_csv_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = lv_header && lv_crlf FOR IN it_sflights NEXT s = s && |{ -carrid },{ -connid },{ -fldate },{ -price },{ -currency }| && lv_crlf ). " CSV-String in XSTRING konvertieren lv_xstring_csv = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( iv_string = lv_csv_string iv_codepage = '4103' ). TRY. " 4. BCS-Objekte instanziieren lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ). " 5. Dokument erstellen (E-Mail-Textkörper) lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document( i_type = 'RAW' i_text = lt_text_body i_subject = lv_subject ). " 6. Anhang hinzufügen lo_document->add_attachment( i_attachment_type = 'CSV' i_attachment_subject = 'SFLIGHTS_Report.csv' i_attachment_size = xstrlen( lv_xstring_csv ) i_att_content_hex = lv_xstring_csv ). " 7. Dokument zum Sendeauftrag hinzufügen lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ). " 8. Absender festlegen lo_sender = cl_sender_bcs=>create_persistent( 'SY-UNAME' ). " Aktueller Benutzer als Absender lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ). " 9. Empfänger hinzufügen lo_recipient = cl_recipient_bcs=>create_persistent_smtp( iv_recipient_email ). lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ). " 10. Sendeauftrag senden lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ). COMMIT WORK. CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs). MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'. ENDTRY. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email.
    " Hinweis: Dieser Unit-Test kann die E-Mail nicht tatsächlich versenden oder den Versand überprüfen.
    " Er testet lediglich, ob der Code ohne Syntaxfehler durchläuft und die BCS-Objekte korrekt instanziiert werden.
    " Für einen vollständigen Test müsste ein Mocking-Framework oder eine manuelle Überprüfung des Sendestatus erfolgen.

    DATA(lo_email_sender) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_email( ).
    DATA(lv_test_email) = 'test@example.com'. " Dummy-E-Mail-Adresse
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE zcl_bcs_send_email=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    " Der Aufruf sollte keine Exception werfen
    TRY.
        lo_email_sender->send_sflight_report_email(
          iv_recipient_email = lv_test_email
          it_sflights        = lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Code reached here without exception" ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |BCS Exception caught: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` innerhalb einer `SORT`-Anweisung mit `BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_num TYPE i,
             value_txt TYPE string,
           END OF ty_generic_data.
    TYPES: tt_generic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_generic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_descending TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      CHANGING
        ct_table      TYPE tt_generic_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_generic_data.

    IF ct_table IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Prüfen, ob das Feld existiert und zugreifbar ist
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ct_table[ 1 ] TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in table structure.|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_descending = abap_true.
      SORT ct_table BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
    ELSE.
      SORT ct_table BY (iv_field_name).
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in ein XSTRING und fangen Sie dabei mögliche Fehler der `CL_BCS_CONVERT`-Klasse ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_BCS` um Fehler bei der Konvertierung abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_xstring_safe
      IMPORTING iv_string_content TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING   cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_xstring_safe.
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
            iv_string = iv_string_content
            iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
            iv_endian = 'B'     " Big Endian
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Fehler protokollieren und weiterleiten
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_bcs.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_error_propagation.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_error_handling( ).
    " Um einen Fehler zu provozieren, müsste man ungültige Parameter übergeben,
    " was bei string_to_xstring schwierig ist, da es robust ist.
    " Hier simulieren wir einen Fehler, indem wir eine leere Zeichenkette übergeben,
    " obwohl die Methode robust genug ist, dies zu handhaben.
    " Ein realistischerer Test würde eine ungültige Codepage oder ähnliches erfordern,
    " was aber nicht direkt über die Methode iv_string_to_xstring_safe steuerbar ist.
    " Daher wird hier nur die Fehlerweiterleitung demonstriert, falls ein Fehler auftritt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_bcs ).
    " Da string_to_xstring bei leerem String keinen Fehler wirft, muss man hier einen
    " künstlichen Fehlerfall konstruieren, der die CATCH-Logik triggert.
    " Für diesen Beispielcode ist es schwierig, einen CX_BCS-Fehler zu erzwingen,
    " da die Methode sehr robust ist. Der Test prüft die Fehlerweiterleitung, falls sie auftritt.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_string_to_xstring_safe( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_xstring ). " Sollte hier nicht erreicht werden, wenn Exception geworfen wird
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` für die Feldsymbole.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_object_ref)->(lv_method_name)` oder `CALL METHOD (lv_object_ref)->('METHOD_NAME')` mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_action.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_action.
  METHODS get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  METHODS increment_counter.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_counter = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_dynamic_action~get_status.
    rv_status = |Counter: { mv_counter }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_dynamic_action~increment_counter.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_method_name> TYPE csequence.

    ASSIGN io_object TO <fs_object>.
    IF <fs_object> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Object reference is not assigned.'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN iv_method_name TO <fs_method_name>.
    IF <fs_method_name> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Method name is not assigned.'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(<fs_method_name>).
        " Wenn die Methode einen Rückgabewert hat, müsste dieser dynamisch abgefangen werden.
        " Für dieses Beispiel gehen wir von Methoden ohne direkten Rückgabewert aus oder
        " von Methoden, die den Zustand des Objekts ändern.
        IF iv_method_name = 'GET_STATUS'.
          DATA(lo_dynamic_action) = CAST if_dynamic_action( io_object ).
          rv_result = lo_dynamic_action->get_status( ).
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Method executed successfully (no direct return value captured).'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_dyn_call.
    ENDTRY.

    UNASSIGN <fs_object>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_method_name>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen internen Tabelle basierend auf einem dynamischen Feldnamen und einem Suchwert aktualisiert. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...) WHERE (dynamic_condition)` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_update_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_field_in_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_key_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_key_value        TYPE string
        iv_target_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value        TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_generic_table    TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_update_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table>  TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>   TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_key>    TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_generic_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_condition) = |{ iv_key_field_name } = '{ iv_key_value }'|.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> WHERE (lv_condition).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_target_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_target>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Typkonvertierung je nach Zieltyp
        CASE cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_target> )->type_kind.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
            <fs_target> = iv_new_value.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
            <fs_target> = CONV i( iv_new_value ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Weitere Typen behandeln oder Fehler auslösen
            MESSAGE 'Unsupported target field type for dynamic update' TYPE 'W'.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_target>. " Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch freigeben
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_table>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_key>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CHANGING ct_generic_table = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ id = 'A1' ]-value exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_dyn_update_itab( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_test_data.

    lo_updater->update_field_in_table(
      iv_key_field_name    = 'ID'
      iv_key_value         = 'A1'
      iv_target_field_name = 'VALUE'
      iv_new_value         = '100'
      CHANGING ct_generic_table = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine hochgradig generische Methode zur dynamischen Aktualisierung von Feldern in internen Tabellen. Es verwendet Feldsymbole (`<fs_table>`, `<fs_line>`, `<fs_target>`) für den flexiblen Zugriff auf Tabellen und deren Zeilen/Felder. Die `WHERE`-Klausel mit dynamischer Bedingung (`(lv_condition)`) ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature. `UNASSIGN` wird konsequent eingesetzt, um die Feldsymbole nach ihrer Verwendung freizugeben, was für die Code-Sauberkeit und zur Vermeidung von unbeabsichtigten Referenzen wichtig ist.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SOLI` (BCS-Textzeilen) zurück in einen einzelnen String. Dies ist nützlich, um den Inhalt einer empfangenen E-Mail zu verarbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>SOLI_TO_STRING`.

CLASS zcl_bcs_soli_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_soli_to_string
      IMPORTING it_soli_text TYPE soli_tab
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_full_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_bcs_soli_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_soli_to_string.
    TRY.
        rv_full_string = cl_bcs_convert=>soli_to_string(
                             it_soli = it_soli_text
                             iv_codepage = '4103' ). " UTF-8
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        rv_full_string = 'Error converting SOLI to string: ' && lx_bcs->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes in einer Struktur und geben Sie dessen Typbeschreibung aus. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` nach der Typbeschreibung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_type_description
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_description.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA: lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lo_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).
      rv_type_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }': Type Kind = { lo_descr->type_kind }, Name = { lo_descr->get_name( ) }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_type_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Feldsymbol freigeben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine E-Mail-Adresse validiert. Wenn die Adresse kein '@' Zeichen enthält, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `zcx_invalid_email` ausgelöst werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine globale Exception-Klasse `zcx_invalid_email` (erbt von `CX_STATIC_CHECK`) und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_email.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_email.
    IF iv_email IS INITIAL OR NOT iv_email CA '@'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_email=>cx_invalid_email
          iv_email = iv_email.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_email.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    TRY.
