Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Profilparameters. Wenn der Parameter nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert ('DEFAULT') zurückgegeben werden. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` und `cl_spfl_profile_parameter`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_cond_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_param_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_parameter_name TYPE string
        iv_default_value  TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value)   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_cond_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_param_with_default.
    DATA(lo_spfl) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    rv_value = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_parameter_name IS INITIAL THEN iv_default_value
      ELSE
        TRY.
            lo_spfl->get_parameter_value( iv_parameter_name = iv_parameter_name )
          CATCH cx_spfl_error.
            iv_default_value
        ENDTRY
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.

                ELSE iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Wenn ein Flug eine Kapazität von Null hat, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Exception `zcx_zero_capacity` ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `REDUCE` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb des `COND`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_zero_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + COND #( 
        WHEN flight-seatsocc + flight-seatsfree = 0 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_zero_capacity
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_zero_capacity=>cx_zero_capacity
              iv_carrid = flight-carrid
              iv_connid = flight-connid
        ELSE
          flight-seatsocc + flight-seatsfree
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_zero_capacity.
    METHODS test_zero_capacity_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_zero_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    " Dieser Test geht davon aus, dass SFLIGHT keine Flüge mit Nullkapazität enthält.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity( ).
    DATA(lv_capacity) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_capacity( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_capacity > 0,
      msg = 'Gesamtkapazität sollte positiv sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Wenn ein Flugpreis negativ ist, soll eine `zcx_negative_price` Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu berechnen, und `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb des `COND`-Ausdrucks für negative Preise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        zcx_negative_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + COND #( 
        WHEN flight-price < 0 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_price
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_negative_price=>cx_negative_price
              iv_carrid = flight-carrid
              iv_connid = flight-connid
              iv_price = flight-price
        ELSE
          flight-price
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_price_sum( ).
    " Annahme: Für 'AA' gibt es Flüge mit positiven Preisen

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_price_exception.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_price_sum( ).
    " Um dies zu testen, müsste man Testdaten mit negativen Preisen in SFLIGHT einfügen
    " oder die Tabelle mocken. Hier wird nur der Aufruf simuliert.
    TRY.
        lo_calculator->calculate_sum_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_negative_price erwartet, wenn ein negativer Preis existiert' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_price INTO DATA(lx_negative_price).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
          act = lx_negative_price->iv_carrid,

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Wenn die angegebene Fluggesellschaft nicht existiert, soll eine `zcx_carrier_not_found` Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator. Prüfen Sie nach dem Filtern, ob die Ergebnistabelle leer ist, und lösen Sie dann die Exception aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RAISING
        zcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lines( rt_flights ) = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_carrier_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_carrier_not_found=>cx_carrier_not_found
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie mehrere Profilparameter dynamisch aus einer Liste. Wenn ein Parameter nicht gefunden wird, soll dies in einer Ergebnisstruktur vermerkt werden, ohne eine Exception zu werfen. Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter` und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks, um die Ergebnisse zu sammeln.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_result,
         name  TYPE string,
         value TYPE string,
         found TYPE abap_bool,
       END OF ty_param_result.
TYPES tt_param_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_profile_multi_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_multiple_params
      IMPORTING
        it_param_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_param_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_multi_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multiple_params.
    DATA(lo_spfl) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).

    rt_results = VALUE tt_param_results(
      FOR name IN it_param_names
      LET lv_value = TRY.
                         lo_spfl->get_parameter_value( iv_parameter_name = name )
                       CATCH cx_spfl_error.
                         '' " Leerer String im Fehlerfall
                     ENDTRY
      IN
      ( name = name,
        value = lv_value,
        found = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multiple_params FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_params.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_profile_multi_reader( ).
    DATA lt_names TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'login/system_client' TO lt_names.
    APPEND 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' TO lt_names.
    APPEND 'non_existent_param_789' TO lt_names.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_reader->get_multiple_params( lt_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results ),
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Sollte 3 Ergebnisse zurückgeben'
    ).

    DATA(ls_client_result) = lt_results[ name = 'login/system_client' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ls_client_result-found,
      msg = 'login/system_client sollte gefunden werden'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_client_result-value,
      msg = 'login/system_client sollte einen Wert haben'
    ).

    DATA(ls_non_existent_result) = lt_results[ name = 'non_existent_param_789' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = ls_non_existent_result-found,
      msg = 'non_existent_param_789 sollte nicht gefunden werden'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_non_existent_result-value,
      msg = 'Wert für nicht existierenden Parameter sollte leer sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die volle Kraft moderner ABAP-Ausdrücke: `VALUE` für die Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle, `FOR` für die Iteration und `LET` für lokale Variablen. Innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks wird `TRY...CATCH` verwendet, um Fehler beim Lesen einzelner Parameter abzufangen, ohne den gesamten Prozess zu unterbrechen. Der `COND`-Ausdruck setzt das `found`-Flag basierend auf dem Ergebnis.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Zahl in einen String umwandelt. Wenn die Zahl außerhalb eines gültigen Bereichs (z.B. 1-100) liegt, soll eine `zcx_out_of_range` Exception mit dem `THROW`-Ausdruck ausgelöst werden.

CLASS zcl_number_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines Profilparameters als Integer zurückgibt. Wenn der Parameter nicht existiert oder nicht in einen Integer umgewandelt werden kann, soll eine `zcx_profile_param_conversion_error` Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter` und fangen Sie sowohl `cx_spfl_error` als auch `cx_sy_conversion_error` ab, um Ihre benutzerdefinierte Exception auszulösen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_int_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_param_as_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_parameter_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_int_value) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_profile_param_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_int_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_param_as_int.
    DATA(lo_spfl) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA lv_string_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_string_value = lo_spfl->get_parameter_value(
          iv_parameter_name = iv_parameter_name
        ).

        rv_int_value = CONV i( lv_string_value ).

      CATCH cx_spfl_error INTO DATA(lx_spfl_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_profile_param_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_profile_param_conversion_error=>cx_param_not_found
            iv_param_name = iv_parameter_name
            iv_original_error = lx_spfl_error.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_profile_param_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_profile_param_conversion_error=>cx_conversion_failed
            iv_param_name = iv_parameter_name
            iv_param_value = lv_string_value
            iv_original_error = lx_conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_valid_int_param.

    " Annahme: rdisp/max_wprun_time ist ein Integer-Wert

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_int_value >= 0,
      msg = 'Sollte einen gültigen Integer-Wert zurückgeben'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_param.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_profile_int_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_param_as_int( 'non_existent_int_param' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_profile_param_conversion_error erwartet (Parameter nicht gefunden)' ).
      CATCH zcx_profile_param_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_error->textid,
          exp = zcx_profile_param_conversion_error=>cx_param_not_found,
          msg = 'Falsche Exception-Text-ID für nicht gefundenen Parameter'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_int_param.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_profile_int_reader( ).
    " Annahme: Ein Parameter, der keinen Integer-Wert enthält (z.B. 'login/system_client' ist ein String)
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_param_as_int( 'login/system_client' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_profile_param_conversion_error erwartet (Konvertierungsfehler)' ).
      CATCH zcx_profile_param_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

Es fängt zwei verschiedene Standard-Exceptions (`cx_spfl_error` und `cx_sy_conversion_error`) ab und kapselt sie in eine einzige, spezifische benutzerdefinierte Exception (`zcx_profile_param_conversion_error`). Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode `create_instance` für eine Klasse `zcl_config_manager`. Die Factory-Methode soll einen Profilparameter lesen und eine `zcx_config_error` Exception auslösen, wenn der Parameter nicht gefunden wird oder ungültig ist, bevor die Instanz erstellt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Factory-Methode. Nutzen Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` in der Factory-Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_instance
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_param_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_manager
      RAISING
        zcx_config_error.

    METHODS get_config_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_config_value TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_config_value = iv_config_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_instance.
    DATA(lo_spfl) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA lv_param_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_param_value = lo_spfl->get_parameter_value(
          iv_parameter_name = iv_config_param_name
        ).

        IF lv_param_value IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_config_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_config_error=>cx_invalid_config_value
              iv_param_name = iv_config_param_name.
        ENDIF.

        ro_instance = NEW zcl_config_manager( iv_config_value = lv_param_value ).

      CATCH cx_spfl_error INTO DATA(lx_spfl_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_config_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_config_error=>cx_config_param_not_found
            iv_param_name = iv_config_param_name
            iv_original_error = lx_spfl_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config_value.
    rv_value = mv_config_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_instance_success FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_config_error.
    METHODS test_create_instance_param_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_config_error.
    METHODS test_create_instance_invalid_value FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_config_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_instance_success.
    " Annahme: 'login/system_client' existiert und hat einen Wert
    DATA(lo_manager) = zcl_config_manager=>create_instance( 'login/system_client' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_manager->get_config_value(),
      msg = 'Konfigurationswert sollte nicht leer sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_instance_param_not_found.
    TRY.
        zcl_config_manager=>create_instance( 'non_existent_config_param' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_config_error erwartet (Parameter nicht gefunden)' ).
      CATCH zcx_config_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_error->textid,
          exp = zcx_config_error=>cx_config_param_not_found,
          msg = 'Falsche Exception-Text-ID für nicht gefundenen Parameter'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_instance_invalid_value.
    " Um dies zu testen, müsste man einen Profilparameter haben, der existiert, aber einen leeren Wert hat.
    " Oder man mockt cl_spfl_profile_parameter.
    TRY.
        " Simuliere einen Parameter, der einen leeren Wert zurückgibt
        " (z.B. durch Mocking oder einen speziell konfigurierten Testparameter)
        zcl_config_manager=>create_instance( 'some_param_with_empty_value' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_config_error erwartet (ungültiger Wert)' ).
      CATCH zcx_config_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_error->textid,
          exp = zcx_config_error=>cx_invalid_config_value,
          msg = 'Falsche Exception-Text-ID für ungültigen Wert'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Factory-Methoden sind ein Design-Pattern, um die Objekterzeugung zu kapseln. Hier wird eine Factory-Methode verwendet, um die Gültigkeit von Konfigurationsparametern vor der Instanziierung zu prüfen. Durch die Verwendung von `cl_spfl_profile_parameter` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` wird sichergestellt, dass nur korrekt konfigurierte Objekte erstellt werden, was die Robustheit der Anwendung erhöht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Method, Exception Handling, RAISE EXCEPTION, cl_spfl_profile_parameter, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (sflights) validiert und bei ungültigen Daten (z.B. negative Flugzeit) eine Ausnahme auslöst.
hint: Statische Methoden werden mit CLASS_NAME=>METHOD_NAME aufgerufen. Verwenden Sie eine Schleife über die Tabelle und prüfen Sie die Bedingungen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: flight_key TYPE string.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            i_flight_key TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            textid = textid.
        me->flight_key = i_flight_key.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CLASS-METHODS validate_flights
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
          RAISING
            zcx_invalid_flight_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD validate_flights.
        LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          IF ls_flight-deptime IS INITIAL OR ls_flight-arrtime IS INITIAL.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
              EXPORTING
                i_flight_key = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|
                textid       = zcx_invalid_flight_data=>default_text.
          ENDIF.
          " Simple validation: arrival time must be after departure time
          IF ls_flight-arrtime < ls_flight-deptime.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
              EXPORTING
                i_flight_key = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|
                textid       = zcx_invalid_flight_data=>default_text.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_flights FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' deptime = '100000' arrtime = '120000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' deptime = '140000' arrtime = '160000' )
    ).
    TRY.
        zcl_flight_validator=>validate_flights( it_flights = lt_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Valid flights passed validation' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_data INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Unexpected exception: { lx_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' deptime = '100000' arrtime = '090000' ) " Invalid: arrtime < deptime
    ).
    TRY.
        zcl_flight_validator=>validate_flights( it_flights = lt_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected ZCX_INVALID_FLIGHT_DATA' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_data INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->flight_key exp = 'LH-0400-20250101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'ZCX_INVALID_FLIGHT_DATA caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine statische Methode zur Validierung von Daten. Bei ungültigen Daten wird eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst, die zusätzliche Informationen (Flugschlüssel) enthält. Die Verwendung von VALUE für die interne Tabelle ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.

Instructions: Eine Methode soll eine simulierte Ressource öffnen, verarbeiten und bei einem Fehler eine Ausnahme auslösen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ressource im Fehlerfall (oder Erfolgsfall) geschlossen wird, indem Sie den CLEANUP-Block verwenden.
hint: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer ausgeführt, egal ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. Er ist ideal für Aufräumarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resource_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resource_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS open_resource.
    METHODS process_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_resource_error.
    METHODS close_resource.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_is_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialisierung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD open_resource.
    mv_is_open = abap_true.
    " Simulierte Öffnung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_resource.
    IF mv_is_open = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resource_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_resource_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulierte Verarbeitung, die fehlschlagen kann
    IF iv_data CA 'ERROR'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resource_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_resource_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Erfolgreiche Verarbeitung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_resource.
    IF mv_is_open = abap_true.
      mv_is_open = abap_false.
      " Simulierte Schließung
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resource_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_resource_error_cleanup FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_resource_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resource_success.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_resource_handler( ).
    lo_handler->open_resource( ).
    TRY.
        lo_handler->process_resource( 'Valid Data' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Resource processed successfully' ).
      CATCH zcx_resource_error INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Unexpected exception: { lx_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
      CLEANUP.
        lo_handler->close_resource( ).
        " Assert that resource is closed
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->mv_is_open exp = abap_false ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_resource_error_cleanup.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_resource_handler( ).
    lo_handler->open_resource( ).
    TRY.
        lo_handler->process_resource( 'Data with ERROR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected ZCX_RESOURCE_ERROR' ).
      CATCH zcx_resource_error INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'ZCX_RESOURCE_ERROR caught as expected' ).
      CLEANUP.
        lo_handler->close_resource( ).
        " Assert that resource is closed even after error
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->mv_is_open exp = abap_false ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung des CLEANUP-Blocks in einer TRY-CATCH-ENDTRY-Struktur. Der CLEANUP-Block garantiert, dass Aufräumarbeiten (hier das Schließen einer Ressource) immer ausgeführt werden, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. Dies ist entscheidend für die Stabilität von Anwendungen.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY-CATCH-CLEANUP, Resource Management, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine funktionale Methode, die eine Zeichenkette in Großbuchstaben umwandelt. Wenn die Zeichenkette leer ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Zeigen Sie die Verwendung in einer Kette von Aufrufen.
hint: Funktionale Methoden geben einen Wert zurück und können direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden. String Templates sind nützlich.
solution:
CLASS zcx_empty_string DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_empty_string IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_empty_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS add_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_upper.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_string.
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    rv_output = |{ iv_prefix }{ iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Eine Methode soll eine Geschäftslogik ausführen und bei einem Fehler eine Ausnahme mit einer Nachricht aus einer Nachrichtenklasse auslösen. Die Nachricht soll Platzhalter verwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahme-Klasse, die die Schnittstelle IF_T100_MESSAGE implementiert. Verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ... MESSAGE ID ... NUMBER ... WITH ...
solution:
" Voraussetzung: Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG_DEMO mit Nachricht 001 'Input {0} is invalid.'
" (oder eine andere existierende Nachrichtenklasse mit Platzhaltern)

CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA: input_value TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_input_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->input_value = i_input_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_business_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_business_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'INPUT_VALUE' )
          i_input_value = iv_value.
    ENDIF.
    rv_processed_value = iv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Unterklassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt. Wenn der Parameter ungültig ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Die Factory-Methode ist typischerweise statisch und gibt eine Referenz auf die Basisschnittstelle/Klasse zurück. Verwenden Sie CREATE OBJECT.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcx_invalid_product_type DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_product_type IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_product_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_product_type.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param      TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RAISING
        zcx_dynamic_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE string.
    TRY.
        IF iv_param IS SUPPLIED.
          CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = iv_param
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result.
        ELSE.
          CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_not_found INTO DATA(lx_meth_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dynamic_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous    = lx_meth_not_found
            i_method_name = iv_method_name
            textid      = zcx_dynamic_call_error=>default_text.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dynamic_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous    = lx_call_error
            i_method_name = iv_method_name
            textid      = zcx_dynamic_call_error=>default_text.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine asynchrone Aufgabe startet. Wenn die asynchrone Aufgabe fehlschlägt, soll der Fehler über eine Ausnahme im aufrufenden Kontext behandelt werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK` oder `CALL METHOD ... IN BACKGROUND TASK` und eine Callback-Methode, um das Ergebnis oder den Fehler zu verarbeiten. Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir den Fehler in der asynchronen Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcx_async_task_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: task_id TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_task_id TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_async_task_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->task_id = i_task_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_async_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS process_data_async
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_async_task_failed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS _async_task_method
      FOR BACKGROUND TASK
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_async_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_async.
    DATA(lv_task_id) = |ASYNC_{ sy-uzeit }|.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    " Simulate error in async task for demonstration
    IF iv_data CA 'ERROR'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_async_task_failed
        EXPORTING
          i_task_id = lv_task_id
          textid    = zcx_async_task_failed=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    " In a real scenario, the error would be handled in the async task
    " and potentially communicated back via a different mechanism (e.g., database table, event)
    " For this example, we simulate the failure directly in the calling context
    " as the actual background task error propagation is complex and not directly via RAISE EXCEPTION to caller.
    " A more realistic async error handling would involve checking a status table after COMMIT WORK.

    " For a true background task, you'd typically do:
    " CALL METHOD zcl_async_processor=>_async_task_method IN BACKGROUND TASK
    "   EXPORTING
    "     iv_data = iv_data
    "   ASYNCHRONOUS MESSAGES.
    " COMMIT WORK.
    " Then check for errors in a separate process or callback.

    " For the purpose of demonstrating RAISE EXCEPTION in a method related to async logic,
    " we'll raise it here based on input, simulating a pre-check or a synchronous part of the async initiation.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _async_task_method.
    " This method would run in a separate LUW.
    " If an error occurs here, it would typically be logged or written to a status table.
    " It cannot directly raise an exception back to the original caller's LUW.
    " For this example, we assume the error is detected before the actual background task starts.
    " Or, if an error occurs within this method, it would be handled internally (e.g., logging).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Eine Methode soll Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` aggregieren. Wenn für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft keine Flüge gefunden werden, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und prüfen Sie das Ergebnis, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcx_no_flights_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        i_carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_no_flights_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->carrier_id = i_carrier_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_found
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_prices( FOR ls_sflight IN
      ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid price = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        EXPORTING
          i_carrier_id = iv_carrid
          textid       = zcx_no_flights_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Aggregation von Daten aus der Datenbank mit modernen ABAP-Features wie `FOR` und `REDUCE`. Wenn keine Daten für die Aggregation gefunden werden, wird eine spezifische Ausnahme ausgelöst. Dies ist eine effiziente und lesbare Art, Daten zu verarbeiten und Fehler zu behandeln.

Instructions: Eine Methode soll einen Bericht generieren, der auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften basiert. Wenn eine der Fluggesellschaften ungültig ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die den Berichtsprozess stoppt.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Eingabeliste und validieren Sie jede Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei der ersten ungültigen Eingabe.
solution:
TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: invalid_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        i_invalid_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->invalid_carrier = i_invalid_carrier.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_flight_report
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_report.
    DATA(lv_report_header) = |Flight Report for Carriers: { REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR carrier IN it_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrier ELSE |{ s }, { carrier }| ) ) }\n\n|.
    DATA(lv_report_body) = VALUE string( ).

    LOOP AT it_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      " Simulate validation: check if carrier exists in sflight
      SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_check_carrid) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrier.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report
          EXPORTING
            i_invalid_carrier = lv_carrier
            textid            = zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report=>default_text.
      ENDIF.

      " Simulate report generation for each valid carrier
      lv_report_body = |{ lv_report_body }Carrier: { lv_carrier } - Details...\n|.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_report_output = |{ lv_report_header }{ lv_report_body }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_report_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_report_invalid_carrier FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_report_success.
    DATA(lt_valid_carriers) = VALUE tt_carriers( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ). " Assuming AA, LH exist
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_report_generator( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_report) = lo_generator->generate_flight_report( lt_valid_carriers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_report ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_report exp = 'Carrier: AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Report generated successfully' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Unexpected exception: { lx_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_report_invalid_carrier.
    DATA(lt_mixed_carriers) = VALUE tt_carriers( ( 'AA' ) ( 'XX' ) ( 'LH' ) ). " XX is invalid
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_report_generator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_generator->generate_flight_report( lt_mixed_carriers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected ZCX_INVALID_CARRIER_FOR_REPORT' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_carrier_for_report INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->invalid_carrier exp = 'XX' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'ZCX_INVALID_CARRIER_FOR_REPORT caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine Methode zur Berichtsgenerierung eine Liste von Eingabeparametern (Fluggesellschaften) validiert. Bei der ersten ungültigen Fluggesellschaft wird eine Ausnahme ausgelöst, die den weiteren Berichtsprozess stoppt. Dies verhindert die Generierung eines fehlerhaften Berichts und informiert den Aufrufer präzise über das Problem. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung ist ein modernes Feature.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, RAISE EXCEPTION, Reporting, Data Validation, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Error Handling

Instructions: Mappe Felder von einer Quellstruktur auf eine Zielstruktur, die identische Feldnamen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` mit der Methode `create` und `execute`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_simple_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

CLASS zcl_cor_simple_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structures.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
                               source      = is_source
                               destination = rs_target ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = is_source CHANGING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Mappe eine Quellstruktur auf eine Zielstruktur und wende dabei eine Transformation auf ein Feld an, z.B. Konvertierung in Großbuchstaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_corresponding_transformer` und einer Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_dyn_map_trans DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             text_field TYPE string,
             number_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             text_upper TYPE string,
             number_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_with_transformation
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_dyn_map_trans IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_transformation.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
                               source      = is_source
                               destination = rs_target
                               mapping     = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table(
                                               ( source = 'TEXT_FIELD' destination = 'TEXT_UPPER' ) ) ).

    DATA(lo_transformer) = cl_abap_corresponding_transformer=>create( lo_corresponding ).
    lo_transformer->add_transformation(
      source_field      = 'TEXT_FIELD'
      destination_field = 'TEXT_UPPER'
      transformation    = cl_abap_corresponding_transformer=>to_upper( ) ).

    lo_transformer->execute( EXPORTING source = is_source CHANGING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mappe eine interne Tabelle auf eine andere, wobei nur bestimmte Zeilen basierend auf einer Bedingung gemappt werden sollen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck oder einer vorherigen Filterung der Quelltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_filtered_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_source_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_id  TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             amount     TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_target.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_target_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_sflight_source_tab
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_sflight_target_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_filtered_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_filtered_sflights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_source) = FILTER ty_sflight_source_tab FROM it_source WHERE price > iv_min_price.

    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
                               source      = lt_filtered_source
                               destination = rt_target
                               mapping     = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table(
                                               ( source = 'CARRID' destination = 'AIRLINE_ID' )
                                               ( source = 'CONNID' destination = 'FLIGHT_ID' )
                                               ( source = 'FLDATE' destination = 'FLIGHT_DATE' )
                                               ( source = 'PRICE'  destination = 'AMOUNT' ) ) ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = lt_filtered_source CHANGING destination = rt_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für ein beliebiges Feld dynamisch zur Laufzeit und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE RANGE OF` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
        it_values    TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_range) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_range.
    DATA: lv_type_name TYPE string.
    DATA: lr_descr     TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lr_range_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Get type description for the fieldname
    TRY.
        lr_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_fieldname ).
        lv_type_name = lr_descr->get_relative_name( ).
    CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        " Handle error: fieldname not found
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Construct the range type name, e.g., 'RANGE OF SFLIGHT-CARRID'
    lv_type_name = |RANGE OF { lv_type_name }|.

    " Create data reference for the dynamic range table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_range TYPE (lv_type_name).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_range_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_range->* TO <fs_range_table>.

    IF <fs_range_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_range_line> TYPE any.
      LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
        CREATE DATA <fs_range_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_range_table>.
        ASSIGN <fs_range_line> TO <fs_range_line>.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sign>   TYPE any,
                       <fs_option> TYPE any,
                       <fs_low>    TYPE any.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SIGN' OF STRUCTURE <fs_range_line> TO <fs_sign>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'OPTION' OF STRUCTURE <fs_range_line> TO <fs_option>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'LOW' OF STRUCTURE <fs_range_line> TO <fs_low>.

        IF <fs_sign> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_option> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_low> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_sign> = 'I'.
          <fs_option> = 'EQ'.
          <fs_low> = lv_value.
          APPEND <fs_range_line> TO <fs_range_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_create_dynamic_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_abap_tabledescr=>string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_range) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_range( 
      iv_fieldname = 'SFLIGHT-CARRID'
      it_values    = lt_values

CLASS zcl_range_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_range_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS mit einem expliziten Cursor und verarbeiten Sie die gelesenen Daten mit modernen internen Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und anschließend `VALUE` und `FILTER` für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_data(
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
      ) TO rt_sflight.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    " Modern processing example: Filter flights with price > 1000
    rt_sflight = FILTER #( rt_sflight WHERE price > 1000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data, check if any flights are returned after filtering.
    " For a robust unit test, one would ensure test data or mock DB access.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights found for LH' act = lt_flights ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lt_flights[ 1 ]-price > 1000 ) msg = 'Price should be > 1000' ).
    ELSE.
      " If no flights found for 'LH' > 1000, try without filter to ensure basic functionality
      lt_flights = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights found without carrid filter' act = lt_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` zur iterativen Datenbeschaffung. Die gelesenen Daten werden mit `VALUE` in eine interne Tabelle eingefügt und anschließend mit dem modernen `FILTER` Operator weiterverarbeitet, was eine kompakte und lesbare Datenmanipulation ermöglicht.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR, VALUE, FILTER, Inline Declaration, Database Access

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in Paketen mit einem expliziten Cursor und verarbeiten Sie jedes Paket mit einer modernen `FOR`-Schleife und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` und eine `FOR GROUPS OF`-Schleife für die Paketverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_sflight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_summary.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_package TO lt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    " Modern grouping and aggregation of all fetched data
    rt_summary = VALUE tt_sflight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE #( INIT p = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT p = p + f-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_package( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_sflight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Summary should not be empty' act = lt_summary ).
    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR s IN lt_summary NEXT c = c + s-count ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_total_flights > 0 ) msg = 'Total flights should be greater than 0' ).
      " Check if grouping works for a known carrier (e.g., 'LH')
      DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE ty_sflight_summary( ).
      READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_lh_summary-count > 0 ) msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die paketweise Verarbeitung von Datenbankdaten mittels `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE`. Die gelesenen Datenpakete werden gesammelt und anschließend mit einer modernen `FOR`-Schleife mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` aggregiert, was eine effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen ermöglicht.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Database Access, Aggregation

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten mit einem Cursor und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft, um die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis pro Gesellschaft zu ermitteln, unter Verwendung moderner interner Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` und anschließend `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_group.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_sflight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, price
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    " Modern grouping and aggregation
    rt_grouped = VALUE tt_sflight_group(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid       = flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price  = REDUCE #( INIT p = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT p = p + f-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_group( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped flights should not be empty' act = lt_grouped ).
    IF lines( lt_grouped ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_has_flights) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_group).
        IF ls_group-flight_count > 0.
          lv_has_flights = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_has_flights msg = 'At least one group should have flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie Daten zunächst mit `OPEN CURSOR` gelesen und dann mit modernen internen Tabellenoperationen gruppiert und aggregiert werden können. Die `FOR GROUPS OF`-Syntax in Kombination mit `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Aggregation von Daten, die zuvor über den Cursor beschafft wurden.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer `TYPES BEGIN OF`-Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_types_begin_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS get_dynamic_table_content
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_begin_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Get description of the structure type
    lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_TYPES_BEGIN_DYNAMIC=>TY_DYNAMIC_DATA' ).

    " Create a table type from the structure type
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

    " Fill the dynamic table (example data)
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_data( field1 = 'Dynamic Entry 1' field2 = 10 ) TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_data( field1 = 'Dynamic Entry 2' field2 = 20 ) TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_dynamic_table_content.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_source_table>.

    IF <lt_source_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_dynamic_line>).
        APPEND CORRESPONDING #( <ls_dynamic_line> ) TO rt_content.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table reference should not be initial' act = lr_dynamic_table ).

    DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_content( lr_dynamic_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_content ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_content[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 'Dynamic Entry 1' ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_types_begin_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_aggregated) TYPE ty_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_begin_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_data.
    rs_aggregated = REDUCE ty_flight_agg(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_flight_agg( total_price = 0 flight_count = 0 )
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
      NEXT
        result = VALUE ty_flight_agg(
          total_price  = result-total_price + flight-price
          flight_count = result-flight_count + 1
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 1500 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' price = 500 ) TO lt_test_flights.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für Flüge mit der Flugnummer 'AA' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine moderne Aggregationsmethode.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE sflight-price(

    rv_total_price = lv_sum.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC). Wenn mehr als 50% frei sind, ist der Status 'Verfügbar', zwischen 10% und 50% 'Wenige Plätze', sonst 'Ausgebucht'. Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
hint: Der `COND` Operator ist gut geeignet für diese Art von bedingter Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = is_sflight-seatsmax - is_sflight-seatsocc.
    DATA(lv_capacity_percent) = COND decfloat34( WHEN is_sflight-seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                                                ELSE ( lv_free_seats / is_sflight-seatsmax ) * 100 ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_capacity_percent > 50 THEN 'Verfügbar'
      WHEN lv_capacity_percent >= 10 AND lv_capacity_percent <= 50 THEN 'Wenige Plätze'
      ELSE 'Ausgebucht'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    ls_sflight-seatsmax = 100.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 10.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Verfügbar' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight ) exp = 'Verfügbar' ).

    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 60.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Wenige Plätze' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight ) exp = 'Wenige Plätze' ).

    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 95.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Ausgebucht' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight ) exp = 'Ausgebucht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen, ähnlich einem Ternary Operator in anderen Sprachen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Notwendigkeit von `IF`-Blöcken.
keywords: DATA, COND, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Flugnummer im Konstruktor entgegennimmt und eine Methode bereitstellt, die alle Flüge dieser Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie moderne Objektinstanziierung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = mv_carrid )
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_date1) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_context_date_time_obj( iv_date = iv_date1 ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Geben Sie den Wert als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den dynamischen Komponenten-Zugriff `(feldname)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    DATA: ls_test_struct TYPE ty_test_struct.
    ls_test_struct-field1 = 'Hello Dynamic'.
    ls_test_struct-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_test_struct iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD1 incorrect' act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello Dynamic' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_test_struct iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD2 incorrect' act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_value_not_found) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_test_struct iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Non-existent field should return error' act = lv_value_not_found exp = 'Field not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Komponenten-Zugriff mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die dynamische Programmierung. Er erlaubt es, auf Felder einer Struktur zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was Flexibilität in generischen Anwendungen bietet.
keywords: DATA, Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Der `GROUP BY` Zusatz zu `LOOP AT` ist die moderne Art der Aggregation und Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_count TYPE ty_carrier_flight_count.

    LOOP AT sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      ls_count-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ls_count-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_count TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_counts ).
    " Überprüfen, ob LH vorhanden ist und eine positive Anzahl hat
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT VALUE ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH flights count should be positive' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Zusatz zu `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle. Mit `GROUP SIZE` kann direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe ermittelt werden, was eine sehr performante und lesbare Methode für Aggregationen darstellt.
keywords: DATA, LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator ist die moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_min_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_free_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                          ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                   WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_filtered
                                   ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_entry-connid,
                                     free_seats = ls_entry-seatsmax - ls_entry-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_free_seats( 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    " Überprüfen, ob alle zurückgegebenen Flüge die Bedingung erfüllen
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight has less than 50 free seats' act = ( ls_flight-free_seats >= 50 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern. Er ist performanter als ein manueller `LOOP` mit `DELETE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: DATA, FILTER, Internal Table, Selection, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die für die Anzeige in einem GUI-Element (z.B. einer Tabelle oder einem 3D-Viewer) vorbereitet ist. Fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte 'STATUS_TEXT' hinzu, die den Status des Fluges basierend auf der Auslastung anzeigt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die Transformation und Statusermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_for_gui,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_for_gui.
    TYPES tt_flight_for_gui TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_for_gui WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_prepared_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_gui_data) TYPE tt_flight_for_gui.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_prepared_flight_data.

                                               WHEN lv_capacity_percent > 50 THEN 'Verfügbar'

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_summary TYPE ty_carrier_summary.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      ls_summary-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_summary-total_passengers = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                              FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_passengers_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_group_sum=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_sum( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 150.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 75.

    DATA(lt_expected_summary) TYPE zcl_flight_group_sum=>tt_carrier_summary.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' total_passengers = 125 ) TO lt_expected_summary.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' total_passengers = 250 ) TO lt_expected_summary.

    DATA(lt_actual_summary) = lo_cut->get_passengers_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    " Sort both tables for comparison
    SORT lt_expected_summary BY carrid.
    SORT lt_actual_summary BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_summary
      exp = lt_expected_summary
      msg = 'Summary by carrier should match expected values'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine elegante Gruppierung von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe ist dies eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Erstellung von Zusammenfassungen.
keywords: SUM, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT
