Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere und den Gesamtpreis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_agg_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_full_summary,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE s_seats,
             total_price     TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_full_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_full_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_full_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_full_summary_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_full_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_agg_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_full_summary_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_member IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group_member-carrid ) ASCENDING
                           ( carrid           = ls_group_member-carrid
                             total_passengers = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                                          FOR flight IN GROUP ls_group_member
                                                            NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc )
                             total_price      = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                                          FOR flight IN GROUP ls_group_member
                                                            NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie 'Magic Numbers' in einer Methode durch lokale Konstanten, um die Lesbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Deklarieren Sie `CONSTANTS` innerhalb der Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    CONSTANTS: lc_discount_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.10'. " 10% discount
    CONSTANTS: lc_min_price_for_discount TYPE s_price VALUE '50.00'.

    IF iv_original_price >= lc_min_price_for_discount.
      rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( 1 - lc_discount_percentage ).
    ELSE.
      rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_discount_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discount_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( ).

    " Test with discount
    DATA(lv_price_with_discount) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_price_with_discount
      exp = '90.00'
      msg = 'Price 100.00 should be 90.00 after discount'
    ).

    " Test without discount
    DATA(lv_price_no_discount) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '40.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_price_no_discount
      exp = '40.00'
      msg = 'Price 40.00 should remain 40.00 (no discount)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Lokale Konstanten (`CONSTANTS` innerhalb einer Methode) verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich, indem sie 'Magic Numbers' (direkt im Code verwendete Literalwerte) durch aussagekräftige Namen ersetzen. Dies macht den Zweck der Werte sofort ersichtlich und erleichtert zukünftige Anpassungen.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Local, Readability, Magic Numbers, Clean Code

      act = lo_airbus->get_max_possible_passengers()
      exp = 495 " 500 - 5
      msg = 'Calculated passengers should be 495'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces können Konstanten definieren, die dann von allen implementierenden Klassen über den Interface-Namen (`zif_flight_limits~gc_max_seats`) direkt zugegriffen werden können. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendung und stellt sicher, dass gemeinsame, unveränderliche Werte konsistent über verschiedene Klassen hinweg verwendet werden.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Interface, Shared Values, Object Orientation

solution:
CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status_code.
      WHEN gc_status_new.

      WHEN gc_status_in_process.
        rv_description = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN gc_status_completed.
        rv_description = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN OTHERS.

    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Fehlermeldungstexte als Konstanten und verwenden Sie diese in String Templates.

solution:
CLASS zcl_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_error_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'Fehler: ',
               gc_error_invalid_input TYPE string VALUE 'Ungültige Eingabe für { input_field }.',
               gc_error_value_range TYPE string VALUE 'Wert { value } liegt außerhalb des gültigen Bereichs ({ min } - { max }).'.

    METHODS validate_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
        iv_min    TYPE i
        iv_max    TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_number.
    IF iv_number < iv_min OR iv_number > iv_max.
      DATA(lv_error_message) = |{ gc_error_prefix }{ gc_error_value_range
                                 INPUT_FIELD = 'Nummer'
                                 VALUE = iv_number
                                 MIN = iv_min
                                 MAX = iv_max }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
        EXPORTING
          text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validation_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_validation_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validation_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_message) = 'Fehler: Wert 5 liegt außerhalb des gültigen Bereichs (10 - 20).'.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_number( iv_number = 5 iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_abap_message_digest was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_message).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_message->get_text()
          exp = lv_expected_message
          msg = 'Error message should match expected value'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_number( iv_number = 15 iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = '' " No exception means success
          msg = 'No exception should be raised for valid input'
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_message).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Unexpected exception: { lx_message->get_text() }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Speichern von Fehlermeldungsteilen als Konstanten und deren dynamische Zusammenstellung mittels String Templates (`|...|`) ist eine moderne und flexible Methode zur Fehlerbehandlung. Es ermöglicht die einfache Anpassung von Meldungstexten, die Wiederverwendung von Textbausteinen und die Erstellung kontextbezogener Nachrichten, was die Wartbarkeit und Benutzerfreundlichkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der `price` Spalte für alle Flüge, die in einem bestimmten Zeitraum liegen, und gib das Ergebnis als String mit Währung aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER`, `REDUCE` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sum_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_in_range
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_start_date TYPE s_date
        iv_end_date   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_price) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_in_range.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate >= iv_start_date AND fldate <= iv_end_date ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0.00
                                          FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                            NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

    DATA(lv_currency) = COND s_curr_code( WHEN lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0 THEN lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-currency ELSE 'EUR' ).

    rv_formatted_price = |{ lv_total_price } { lv_currency }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_sum_date_range=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_sum_date_range( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20230115' price = '200.50' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20230201' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' fldate = '20230120' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = '600.50 EUR'. "100.00 + 200.50 + 300.00
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_in_range( it_flights = lt_flights iv_start_date = '20230101' iv_end_date = '20230131' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FILTER` für die Auswahl von Einträgen basierend auf einem Datumsbereich, `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und String Templates für die formatierte Ausgabe. Instructions: Berechne die Summe der `seatsocc` Spalte und den Durchschnittspreis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die in einer `VALUE` Expression erstellt wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE`, `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für Summe und Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_agg_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE s_seats,
             average_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_agg_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    rt_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_member IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group_member-carrid ) ASCENDING
                         LET lv_group_size = lines( GROUP ls_group_member ) IN
                         ( carrid           = ls_group_member-carrid
                           total_passengers = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                                        FOR flight IN GROUP ls_group_member
                                                          NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc )
                           average_price    = COND s_price( WHEN lv_group_size > 0
                                                            THEN REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0.00
                                                                                FOR flight IN GROUP ls_group_member
                                                                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ) / lv_group_size
                                                            ELSE 0.00 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_statistics FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_statistics.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_agg_value_for=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_agg_value_for( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 100 price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 50  price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 150 price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 75  price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_expected_stats) TYPE zcl_flight_agg_value_for=>tt_carrier_stats.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' total_passengers = 125 average_price = '150.00' ) TO lt_expected_stats.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' total_passengers = 250 average_price = '150.00' ) TO lt_expected_stats.

    DATA(lt_actual_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_statistics( lt_flights ).

    SORT lt_expected_stats BY carrid.
    SORT lt_actual_stats BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_stats
      exp = lt_expected_stats
      msg = 'Carrier statistics should match expected values'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `VALUE` und `FOR GROUPS OF` zur Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle mit komplexen Aggregationen. Es berechnet sowohl die Summe der Passagiere als auch den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft, wobei `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und `COND` für die Division durch Null-Prüfung verwendet wird. Die `LET` Expression verbessert die Lesbarkeit durch die Definition lokaler Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks.
keywords: SUM, VALUE, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, Average

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und behandeln Sie mögliche Netzwerkfehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und die Methoden `send` und `receive`. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_HTTP_DEST_STATE_ERROR` und `CX_HTTP_COMMUNICATION_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check. " For other potential errors
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    " Expecting an exception for communication failure or destination state error

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen grundlegenden HTTP GET-Request unter Verwendung von `cl_http_client`. Es zeigt die Erstellung des Clients, das Senden des Requests und das Empfangen der Antwort. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke, die spezifische Ausnahmen wie `CX_HTTP_DEST_STATE_ERROR` (Fehler bei der Destination) und `CX_HTTP_COMMUNICATION_ERROR` (Netzwerk- oder Kommunikationsfehler) abfangen. Zusätzlich wird der HTTP-Statuscode geprüft, um auch anwendungsbezogene Fehler zu erkennen und eine generische `CX_STATIC_CHECK` zu werfen. Die Verwendung von `DATA()` und `VALUE()` ist ein Beispiel für modernen ABAP-Stil.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an einen externen Dienst und behandeln Sie Fehler, die durch den Server-Statuscode (z.B. 400 Bad Request, 500 Internal Server Error) signalisiert werden.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

           END OF ty_payload.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_payload TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        " Serialize payload to JSON
        cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_payload
            pretty_name = if_abap_bool=>true
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_payload
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Content-Type'
          value = 'application/json'
        ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          " Raise a custom exception or a generic one with detailed message
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON Serialization Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Empfangen Sie eine JSON-Antwort von einem HTTP-Service, parsen Sie diese in eine ABAP-Struktur und behandeln Sie Fehler, die während des Parsens auftreten können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für den Request und `cl_json=>deserialize` für das Parsen. Fangen Sie `CX_JSON_DESERIALIZER_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             userId TYPE i,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             completed TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS fetch_and_parse
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check
        cx_json_deserializer_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_and_parse.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_response_body TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        lv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        " Deserialize JSON response
        cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_response_body
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_data
        ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_json_deserializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_json_deserializer_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON Deserialization Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-Request durch und fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen (z.B. `cx_http_dest_state_error`, `cx_http_communication_error`) ab, um unterschiedliche Fehlerszenarien gezielt zu behandeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke oder mehrere `CATCH`-Anweisungen, um verschiedene Ausnahmetypen zu unterscheiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_specific_exc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_specific_exc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          rv_result_message = |HTTP Error { lv_status_code }: { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result_message = |Success: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( 0, 50 ) }...|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        rv_result_message = |Destination State Error: { lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        rv_result_message = |Communication Error: { lx_comm_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_result_message = |Client Creation Error: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        rv_result_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTPS GET-Request an eine sichere URL durch und behandeln Sie mögliche SSL/TLS-Verbindungsfehler.
hint: `cl_http_client` unterstützt HTTPS automatisch. Fehler können als `CX_HTTP_COMMUNICATION_ERROR` auftreten, oft mit spezifischen Untertexten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_https_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_secure_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_https_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_secure_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        " For HTTPS, ensure the URL starts with 'https://' and the system has proper SSL configuration.
        " No special client-side code is needed for basic HTTPS, but errors can occur.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error sending HTTPS request'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error receiving HTTPS response'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTPS Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |SSL/TLS Destination State Error: { lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |SSL/TLS Communication Error: { lx_comm_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit Query-Parametern und behandeln Sie Fehler, wenn die Parameter vom Server als ungültig zurückgewiesen werden (z.B. HTTP 400 Bad Request).
hint: Verwenden Sie `request->set_query_parameter` zum Hinzufügen von Parametern. Prüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_query_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_with_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url TYPE string
        it_params   TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_with_params.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_base_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).

        " Add query parameters
        LOOP AT it_params INTO DATA(lv_param_pair).
          DATA(lv_name) = SUBSTRING( val = lv_param_pair off = 0 len = FIND( val = lv_param_pair sub = '=' ) ).
          DATA(lv_value) = SUBSTRING( val = lv_param_pair off = FIND( val = lv_param_pair sub = '=' ) + 1 ).
          lo_http_client->request->set_query_parameter(
            name  = lv_name
            value = lv_value
          ).
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP-Request mit benutzerdefinierten Headern (z.B. für Authentifizierung oder Content-Type) und behandeln Sie Fehler, wenn ein erforderlicher Header fehlt oder vom Server als ungültig zurückgewiesen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `request->set_header_field`. Simulieren Sie einen Fehler, indem Sie einen erwarteten Header weglassen oder einen ungültigen Wert senden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_custom_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_request_with_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_url    TYPE string
        it_headers TYPE string_table OPTIONAL " Format: 'Name: Value'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_request_with_headers.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ). " Or POST, PUT etc.

        " Add custom headers
        LOOP AT it_headers INTO DATA(lv_header_pair).
          DATA(lv_name) = SUBSTRING( val = lv_header_pair off = 0 len = FIND( val = lv_header_pair sub = ':' ) ).
          DATA(lv_value) = SUBSTRING( val = lv_header_pair off = FIND( val = lv_header_pair sub = ':' ) + 1 ).
          lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
            name  = lv_name
            value = lv_value
          ).
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP PUT-Request durch, um eine Ressource zu aktualisieren, und behandeln Sie Konflikte (z.B. HTTP 409 Conflict), die bei gleichzeitigen Aktualisierungen auftreten können.
hint: Setzen Sie die HTTP-Methode auf `PUT` und senden Sie einen JSON-Payload. Prüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode auf 409.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_put_conflict DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_update_payload,
             id    TYPE i,
             title TYPE string,
           END OF ty_update_payload.

    METHODS update_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_url    TYPE string
        is_payload TYPE ty_update_payload
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_put_conflict IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_resource.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_payload TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_payload
            pretty_name = if_abap_bool=>true
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_payload
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_put ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Content-Type'
          value = 'application/json'
        ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code = 409. " HTTP 409 Conflict
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |Concurrency Conflict (HTTP 409): { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON Serialization Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-Request mit einem definierten Timeout durch und behandeln Sie die Ausnahme, wenn der Timeout überschritten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `client->property_set_runtime` für den Timeout. Ein Timeout führt zu einer `CX_HTTP_COMMUNICATION_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_timeout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_request_with_timeout
      IMPORTING
        iv_url    TYPE string
        iv_timeout TYPE i " Timeout in seconds
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_timeout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_request_with_timeout.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        " Set timeout for the request
        lo_http_client->property_set_runtime(
          i_name  = if_http_client=>co_property_timeout
          i_value = iv_timeout
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        " This exception is typically raised for timeouts
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Communication Error (possibly Timeout): { lx_comm_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP DELETE-Request durch, um eine Ressource zu löschen, und behandeln Sie Fehler bei unautorisiertem Zugriff (HTTP 401 Unauthorized oder 403 Forbidden).
hint: Setzen Sie die HTTP-Methode auf `DELETE`. Prüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode auf 401 oder 403.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_resource.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).
        " Potentially add Authorization header here for real scenarios
        " lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Authorization' value = 'Bearer <token>' ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code = 200 OR lv_status_code = 204. " 200 OK or 204 No Content for successful DELETE
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code = 401. " Unauthorized
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |Unauthorized Access (HTTP 401): { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code = 403. " Forbidden
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |Forbidden Access (HTTP 403): { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit Basic Authentication durch und behandeln Sie Fehler, wenn die Authentifizierung fehlschlägt (z.B. HTTP 401 Unauthorized).

CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_url     TYPE string
        iv_username TYPE string

        cx_http_dest_state_error

CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_authenticated_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        " Set Basic Authentication credentials
        lo_http_client->authenticate(
          EXPORTING
            username = iv_username
            password = iv_password
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code = 401. " Unauthorized
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |Authentication Failed (HTTP 401): { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP PATCH-Request durch, um eine Ressource teilweise zu aktualisieren, und behandeln Sie den Fehler, wenn die PATCH-Methode vom Server nicht unterstützt wird (HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed).
hint: Setzen Sie die HTTP-Methode auf `PATCH`. Prüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode auf 405.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_patch_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_payload,
             title TYPE string,
           END OF ty_patch_payload.

    METHODS patch_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_url    TYPE string
        is_payload TYPE ty_patch_payload
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_patch_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD patch_resource.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_payload TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_payload
            pretty_name = if_abap_bool=>true
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_payload
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_patch ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Content-Type'
          value = 'application/json'
        ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code = 405. " Method Not Allowed
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |Method Not Allowed (HTTP 405): PATCH is not supported by the server. { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) }|.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) } }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON Serialization Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-Request durch. Wenn die Antwort des Servers einen spezifischen Geschäftsfehlercode oder eine Meldung enthält, die auf einen Geschäftsfehler hinweist, lösen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme aus.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme (`CX_...`) und werfen Sie diese basierend auf dem Inhalt der HTTP-Antwort.
solution:
CLASS zcx_business_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

      IMPORTING
        text       TYPE string OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_http_custom_business_exc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check
        zcx_business_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_business_exc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_response_body TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          lv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
          " Simulate a business error based on response content
          IF lv_status_code = 400 AND lv_response_body CS 'INVALID_INPUT'.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_business_error
              EXPORTING
                text       = 'Business Error: Invalid input provided.'
                error_code = 'INVALID_INPUT'.
          ELSE.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
              EXPORTING
                text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lv_response_body }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        rv_result = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen externen Service, der Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) liefert. Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request aus und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass keine Daten gefunden werden (z.B. durch einen 404-Statuscode oder eine leere Antwort).
hint: Mocken Sie den HTTP-Client im Unit-Test, um verschiedene Szenarien (Daten gefunden, keine Daten gefunden) zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sflights_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_communication_error
        cx_static_check
        cx_json_deserializer_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sflights_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_flights.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_response_body TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code = 404. " Not Found
          " No data found, return empty table without raising an error
          RETURN.
        ELSEIF lv_status_code >= 400.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ) } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        lv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        IF lv_response_body IS INITIAL.
          " If response is empty, return empty table
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Deserialize JSON response into table of structures
        cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_response_body
          CHANGING
            data        = rt_flights
        ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_state_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dest_state_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_http_communication_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_communication_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_comm_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_json_deserializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_json_deserializer_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON Deserialization Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es verwendet `cl_http_client` für den GET-Request und `cl_json=>deserialize` zum Parsen der JSON-Antwort in eine interne Tabelle. Die Fehlerbehandlung berücksichtigt zwei Szenarien für "keine Daten gefunden": einen HTTP 404-Statuscode oder eine leere Antwort. In beiden Fällen wird eine leere interne Tabelle zurückgegeben, anstatt eine Ausnahme auszulösen, was eine gängige Praxis für "keine Ergebnisse" ist. Andere HTTP-Fehler (>= 400) führen weiterhin zu einer `CX_STATIC_CHECK`-Ausnahme.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in eine neue interne Tabelle um, die nur ausgewählte Felder enthält und ein Feld umbenennt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CONV-Operator in Kombination mit einer FOR-Schleife und der VALUE-Anweisung für interne Tabellen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             ticket_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_sflights_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                              ( airline_id   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                flight_num   = ls_sflight-connid
                                flight_date  = ls_sflight-fldate
                                ticket_price = CONV decfloat16( ls_sflight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_itab_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_itab_conversion.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE tt_sflight_source.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
    <fs_source>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_source>-connid = '400'.
    <fs_source>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_source>-price = '123.45'.
    <fs_source>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_source>.
    <fs_source>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_source>-connid = '001'.
    <fs_source>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
    <fs_source>-price = '500.00'.
    <fs_source>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_itab_to_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_converter->convert_sflights_to_summary( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_summary )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Die Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_summary1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary1-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary1-flight_num exp = '400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary1-ticket_price exp = '123.45' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_summary2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary2-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary2-flight_num exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary2-ticket_price exp = '500.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dem CONV-Operator, der FOR-Schleife und der VALUE-Anweisung ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere zu mappen und dabei auch Typkonvertierungen durchzuführen, ohne explizite LOOP-Anweisungen und APPENDs.
keywords: CONV, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, Mapping, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Typumwandlung eines Wertes durch, der durch eine Datenreferenz repräsentiert wird, in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CONV-Operator mit Dereferenzierung und RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_data_ref_to_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_data_ref_to_string
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_data_ref_to_str IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_data_ref_to_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " CONV kann direkt mit Feldsymbolen verwendet werden
      rv_string = CONV string( <fs_data> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_string = 'Error: Data reference not assigned'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
