CLASS zcl_range_table_safe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_safe_range_for_carrid.
    " This method is a placeholder, demonstrating dynamic range creation
    " with potential for internal errors, which are then caught by add_entry_to_range_safe.
    " For simplicity, we directly call add_entry_to_range_safe here.
    DATA(lv_current_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_condition> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_conditions ASSIGNING <fs_condition>.
      " Assuming it_conditions contains structures with SIGN, OPTION, LOW, HIGH
      TRY.
          " This mimics adding a range entry from potentially unsafe source
          APPEND VALUE #( sign = <fs_condition>-sign
                          option = <fs_condition>-option
                          low = <fs_condition>-low
                          high = <fs_condition>-high ) TO lv_current_range.
        CATCH cx_sy_range_bounds_error INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
          " Log or handle error: Invalid range entry ignored
          " For example, cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Invalid range entry ignored: { lx_range_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_range = lv_current_range.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_entry_to_range_safe.
    DATA(ls_range_line) TYPE LINE OF RANGE OF s_carr_id.
    rr_range = ir_range. " Initialize with base range

    TRY.
        ls_range_line-sign = iv_sign.
        ls_range_line-option = iv_option.
        ls_range_line-low = iv_low.
        IF iv_high IS SUPPLIED.
          ls_range_line-high = iv_high.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND ls_range_line TO rr_range.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_bounds_error INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
        " Log or handle the error, e.g., output a message
        " cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Failed to add range entry. Error: { lx_range_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_valid_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_invalid_option FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_invalid_bounds FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_valid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_table_safe( ).
    DATA(lt_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

    lt_range = lo_cut->add_entry_to_range_safe( ir_range = lt_range
                                                 iv_sign = 'I' iv_option = 'EQ' iv_low = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_invalid_option.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_table_safe( ).
    DATA(lt_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

    lt_range = lo_cut->add_entry_to_range_safe( ir_range = lt_range
                                                 iv_sign = 'I' iv_option = 'XX' iv_low = 'BB' ). " 'XX' is an invalid option
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 0 ). " Should not add invalid entry
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_invalid_bounds.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_table_safe( ).
    DATA(lt_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

    lt_range = lo_cut->add_entry_to_range_safe( ir_range = lt_range
                                                 iv_sign = 'I' iv_option = 'BT' iv_low = 'ZZ' iv_high = 'AA' ). " low > high
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 0 ). " Should not add invalid entry
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Manipulation von Range-Tabellen ist ein häufiges Szenario in ABAP, birgt aber das Risiko ungültiger Definitionen (z.B. falsche Operatoren oder umgekehrte LOW/HIGH-Werte für 'BT'). Der TRY-CATCH-Block, der cx_sy_range_bounds_error abfängt, ist entscheidend, um solche Fehler abzufangen und zu verhindern, dass die Range-Tabelle inkonsistent wird. Dies ermöglicht eine robuste Verarbeitung von dynamisch erzeugten Selektionskriterien, wo die Eingabe nicht immer vertrauenswürdig ist. Die VALUE-Operatoren sind hier nicht direkt anwendbar für das Füllen dynamischer Felder, aber das Beispiel zeigt, wann TRY für Dateneinfügungen notwendig ist.
keywords: Range Tables, Dynamic Data, Exception Handling, TRY, CATCH, cx_sy_range_bounds_error, Selektionsoptionen

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine Nachricht dynamisch mit `cl_message_helper` und geben Sie deren Details zurück. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Platzhaltern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_message_helper=>build_message` und die Methoden des zurückgegebenen Nachrichtenobjekts.

CLASS zcl_msg_helper_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_details,
             msgid   TYPE symsgid,
             msgno   TYPE symsgno,
             msgty   TYPE symsgty,
             msgv1   TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2   TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3   TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4   TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message_details.

    METHODS get_message_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_msgid TYPE symsgid
        iv_msgno TYPE symsgno
        iv_msgty TYPE symsgty
        iv_msgv1 TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL
        iv_msgv2 TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_helper_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_details.
    DATA(lo_message) = cl_message_helper=>build_message(
      i_msgid = iv_msgid
      i_msgno = iv_msgno
      i_msgty = iv_msgty
      i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1
      i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2
    ).

    rs_message-msgid = lo_message->get_message_id( ).
    rs_message-msgno = lo_message->get_message_number( ).
    rs_message-msgty = lo_message->get_message_type( ).
    rs_message-msgv1 = lo_message->get_message_variable( 1 ).
    rs_message-msgv2 = lo_message->get_message_variable( 2 ).
    rs_message-msgv3 = lo_message->get_message_variable( 3 ).
    rs_message-msgv4 = lo_message->get_message_variable( 4 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Preise (`PRICE`) aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflight`) mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Initialisieren Sie eine Variable und addieren Sie in der Schleife mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    (
      carrid   = 'AA' connid   = '0017' fldate   = '20251124' price    = '200.00' currency = 'USD'

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt verketten, die jeweils das Objekt selbst zurückgeben.
hint: Jede Methode muss `ME` als `RETURNING` Parameter vom Typ der Klasse zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain_demo.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_mult TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain_demo.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chain_demo( iv_initial_value = 5 ).

    lo_calculator->add( 5 )->multiply( 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->mv_value exp = 20 msg = 'Chained calculation result mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse einer SELECT-Anweisung für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und verarbeiten Sie jede Zeile direkt in einer FOR-Schleife, um eine Liste der Flugverbindungen zu erstellen.

CLASS zcl_sflight_for_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lh_connections RETURNING VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_sflight_for_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_connections.
    LOOP AT ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid } ({ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER })| TO rt_connections.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights, SUM(seatsmax) AS total_seats
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_aggregates( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary IS INITIAL exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Die Zusammenfassung sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten Zusammenfassungsdaten gefunden werden' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_sflight_aggregates=>ty_flight_summary( ).

explanation: Moderne ABAP-Versionen erlauben komplexe Aggregationen und Gruppierungen direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung auf der Datenbank. Dies ist performanter, da die Datenverarbeitung auf dem Datenbankserver stattfindet und nur die aggregierten Ergebnisse an den Applikationsserver übertragen werden. Die Inline-Deklaration für die Ergebnis-Tabelle macht den Code zusätzlich schlanker.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM, Aggregate Functions, Database Access

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse zweier SELECT-Anweisungen auf der Tabelle SFLIGHTS (z.B. Flüge von 'LH' und Flüge von 'AA') in einer einzigen internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei den UNION ALL Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION ALL`-Operator zwischen zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen. Beachten Sie, dass die Spaltenanzahl und -typen übereinstimmen müssen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    INTO TABLE @rt_combined.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_combined IS INITIAL exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Die kombinierte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten kombinierte Flüge gefunden werden' ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_combined INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_lh_count exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge von LH enthalten sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_aa_count exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge von AA enthalten sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION ALL`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das effiziente Zusammenführen von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren `SELECT`-Anweisungen direkt auf der Datenbank. Dies ist oft performanter als das separate Auslesen und anschließende Zusammenführen in ABAP. `UNION ALL` behält Duplikate bei, während `UNION` diese entfernt.
keywords: SELECT, UNION, UNION ALL, Database Access

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS aus und verwenden Sie einen CASE-Ausdruck in der SELECT-Liste, um eine neue Spalte zu erstellen, die den Status des Fluges basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze (SEATSOCC) anzeigt (z.B. 'Full', 'Almost Full', 'Available').
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS <new_column_name>` direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc,
           CASE
             WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'Full'
             WHEN seatsocc >= seatsmax * 0.8 THEN 'Almost Full'
             ELSE 'Available'
           END AS status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_case_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Die Flugtabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden' ).

    DATA(lv_full_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_available_found) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-status = 'Full'.
        lv_full_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-status = 'Available'.
        lv_available_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_full_found = abap_true AND lv_available_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_full_found exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Mindestens ein "Full"-Flug sollte gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_available_found exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Mindestens ein "Available"-Flug sollte gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE`-Ausdrücken direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik auf Datenbankebene anzuwenden und neue, abgeleitete Spalten zu erstellen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Daten nach dem Laden in ABAP zu verarbeiten, was die Performance verbessert und den Code vereinfacht. Es ist ein Beispiel für 'Code-Pushdown'.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, Conditional Logic, Database Access, Code Pushdown

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Dateien und Unterverzeichnisse in einem bestimmten Verzeichnis auf dem Applikationsserver auf. Das Verzeichnis soll `/tmp/` sein.

CLASS zcl_file_dir_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dir_entry,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, "'F' for file, 'D' for directory
           END OF ty_dir_entry.
    TYPES tt_dir_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dir_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dir_content IMPORTING iv_directory TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE tt_dir_entry
                            RAISING   cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_dir_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dir_content.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_file_list,
          lt_dirs  TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_dir_list.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_list(
      EXPORTING
        i_directory = iv_directory
      IMPORTING
        e_file_list = lt_files
        e_dir_list  = lt_dirs
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      APPEND VALUE ty_dir_entry( name = ls_file-name type = 'F' ) TO rt_content.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT lt_dirs INTO DATA(ls_dir).
      APPEND VALUE ty_dir_entry( name = ls_dir-name type = 'D' ) TO rt_content.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse enthält. Eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse muss das Format 'name@domain.com' haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `MATCHES` Operator mit einem geeigneten Regex-Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_email_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_email_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_email.
    CONSTANTS: lc_email_pattern TYPE string VALUE '^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,3})+$.'.
    IF iv_email MATCHES lc_email_pattern.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_email( 'first.last@sub.domain.co.uk' ) msg = 'Valid email with subdomains should return true' ).

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen) aus einem Textstring und geben Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle von Strings zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS` und dem `VALUE` Operator für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_all_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_numbers.
    CONSTANTS: lc_number_pattern TYPE string VALUE '\d+'.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lc_number_pattern IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
                           ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_parts,
             year  TYPE string,
             month TYPE string,
             day   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_date_parts.

    METHODS extract_date_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_parts) TYPE ty_date_parts
      RAISING
        cx_sy_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_parts.
    CONSTANTS: lc_date_pattern TYPE string VALUE '^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$'.

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lc_date_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_date_string ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) = abap_true.
      rs_date_parts-year = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_date_parts-month = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_date_parts-day = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle error or raise exception if date format is not matched
      CLEAR rs_date_parts.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_regex_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Date string does not match expected format.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_multiple_delimiters
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_multiple_delimiters.
    CONSTANTS: lc_delimiter_pattern TYPE string VALUE '[\s,;]+'. " Matches one or more spaces, commas, or semicolons

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lc_delimiter_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rt_words = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT words = VALUE string_table( )
           lv_current_offset = 0
      FOR <match> IN lo_matcher->get_matches( )
      NEXT words = COND string_table(
                     WHEN <match>-offset > lv_current_offset
                       THEN VALUE #( BASE words ( substring( val = iv_text off = lv_current_offset len = <match>-offset - lv_current_offset ) ) )
                     ELSE words )
           lv_current_offset = <match>-offset + <match>-length
    ).

    " Add the last part of the string after the last delimiter
    IF lv_last_offset < strlen( iv_text ).
      APPEND substring( val = iv_text off = lv_last_offset ) TO rt_words.
    ENDIF.

    " Remove empty entries that might result from leading/trailing delimiters or multiple delimiters
    DELETE rt_words WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Passwort mindestens 8 Zeichen lang ist und Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben, Ziffern und Sonderzeichen (z.B. !@#$%^&*) enthält. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine Kombination von `MATCHES` Operatoren.
hint: Nutzen Sie mehrere `MATCHES` Operatoren, um jede Bedingung separat zu prüfen und diese dann logisch zu verknüpfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_password_policy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_password_strength
      IMPORTING
        iv_password TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_strong) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_password_policy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_password_strength.
    DATA: lv_has_upper TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_has_lower TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_has_digit TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_has_special TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_min_length TYPE abap_bool.

    " Check minimum length
    IF strlen( iv_password ) >= 8.
      lv_min_length = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for uppercase letter
    IF iv_password MATCHES '.*[A-Z].*'.
      lv_has_upper = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for lowercase letter
    IF iv_password MATCHES '.*[a-z].*'.
      lv_has_lower = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for digit
    IF iv_password MATCHES '.*\d.*'.
      lv_has_digit = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for special character (example set)
    IF iv_password MATCHES '.*[!@#$%^&*].*'.
      lv_has_special = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_min_length AND lv_has_upper AND lv_has_lower AND lv_has_digit AND lv_has_special.
      rv_is_strong = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_strong = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen kompakten String, der eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`-Datensätzen enthält, zurück in eine interne Tabelle. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Daten korrekt wiederhergestellt werden.
hint: Die Methode `DESERIALIZE` kann auch interne Tabellen verarbeiten. Verwenden Sie eine Inline-Deklaration für die Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_deserialize_sflight_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_serialized_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deserialize_sflight_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = /ui2/cl_number=>create_instance( ).
    lo_serializer->deserialize( EXPORTING iv_data = iv_serialized_string IMPORTING ev_data = rt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_deserialize_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deserialize_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_deserialize_table.
    DATA: lt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight           TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AZ'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0310'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price = '350.75'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0001'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum + 2.
    ls_sflight-price = '1200.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_original_sflights.

    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_serialize_sflight_tab( ).
    DATA(lv_serialized) = lo_serializer->serialize_sflight_table( lt_original_sflights ).

    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_deserialize_sflight_tab( ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized_sflights) = lo_deserializer->deserialize_sflight_table( lv_serialized ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deserialized_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Number of lines should match' ).
    LOOP AT lt_original_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      READ TABLE lt_deserialized_sflights INTO DATA(ls_deserialized) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized-carrid exp = ls_sflight-carrid msg = 'CARRID should match for line' && sy-tabix ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized-connid exp = ls_sflight-connid msg = 'CONNID should match for line' && sy-tabix ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized-fldate exp = ls_sflight-fldate msg = 'FLDATE should match for line' && sy-tabix ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized-price exp = ls_sflight-price msg = 'PRICE should match for line' && sy-tabix ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized-currency exp = ls_sflight-currency msg = 'CURRENCY should match for line' && sy-tabix ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_deserialize_sflight_tab( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deserializer->deserialize_sflight_table( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Empty string should result in empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deserialisierung einer internen Tabelle mit `/UI2/CL_NUMBER` ist ebenso unkompliziert wie die Serialisierung. Dies ermöglicht einen vollständigen Roundtrip von komplexen Datensätzen, was für die Persistenz oder den Austausch von Daten in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen unerlässlich ist. Die Inline-Deklaration der Zieltabelle macht den Code noch prägnanter.
keywords: Deserialization, /UI2/CL_NUMBER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Datenwiederherstellung

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String ein gültiges deutsches Postleitzahlenformat (5 Ziffern) hat und extrahieren Sie diese. Wenn mehrere PLZs vorhanden sind, sollen alle extrahiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem Muster für 5 Ziffern und Wortgrenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_plz_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_german_plz
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_plz_list) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_plz_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_german_plz.
    CONSTANTS: lc_plz_pattern TYPE string VALUE '\b\d{5}\b'. " Matches exactly 5 digits as a whole word

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lc_plz_pattern IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_plz_list = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
                             ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_single_plz FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_plz FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_plz FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_plz_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_plz.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_plz_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '12345' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_german_plz( 'Meine Adresse ist in 12345 Berlin.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Should extract single valid PLZ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_plz.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_plz_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '10115' ) ( '80331' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_german_plz( 'Berlin: 10115, München: 80331.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Should extract multiple valid PLZs' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_plz.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_plz_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_german_plz( 'Keine Postleitzahl hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should return empty table if no PLZ found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_plz_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_plz_extract( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_german_plz( 'PLZ 1234 und 123456 sind ungültig.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should not extract PLZs with invalid length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit dem Muster `\b\d{5}\b` ist präzise, um genau fünfstellige Zahlen zu finden, die von Wortgrenzen umschlossen sind. Dies verhindert das Matching von Teilen längerer Zahlen. Der `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Schleife ist wieder die moderne Wahl, um die Ergebnisse kompakt in eine interne Tabelle zu überführen.
keywords: REGEX, FIND, String, Postleitzahl, Extraktion, Deutschland

Instructions:
Entfernen Sie alle HTML-Tags (z.B. `

`, `

`, ``) aus einem gegebenen String, um reinen Text zu erhalten. Berücksichtigen Sie auch Attribute innerhalb der Tags.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem Muster, das öffnende und schließende Tags sowie deren Inhalt erfasst.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_remove_html DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_html_tags
      IMPORTING
        iv_html_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_plain_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_remove_html IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_html_tags.
    " Regex to match any HTML tag, including attributes. Non-greedy match for content.
    CONSTANTS: lc_html_tag_pattern TYPE string VALUE '<[^>]+>'.

    rv_plain_text = iv_html_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lc_html_tag_pattern IN rv_plain_text WITH ''.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Das Muster `<[^>]+>` ist ein gängiger Weg, um beliebige Tags zu erfassen, einschließlich ihrer Attribute, und sie durch einen leeren String zu ersetzen, um reinen Text zu erhalten.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen basierend auf einer Bedingung einen Wert zu. Wenn eine Zahl größer als 10 ist, soll 'Groß' zugewiesen werden, sonst 'Klein'.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag (Montag, Dienstag, etc.) basierend auf einer Zahl (1=Montag, 2=Dienstag, ..., 7=Sonntag). Ungültige Zahlen sollen 'Ungültig' zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_switch_example IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_day_name = SWITCH string( iv_day_number
                                    WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'

                                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                                    WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                                    WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, wobei alle Flugnummern in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` für die Transformation von Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_map_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_uppercase_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_map_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_uppercase_carrids.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS. " Beispielhafte Daten

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
                          ( carrid = CONV #( <fs_sflight>-carrid && '' ) ) ). " CONV for string conversion
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_uppercase_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_uppercase_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_map_example( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_uppercase_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_carrids ).
    IF lines( lt_carrids ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 1 ]-carrid exp = to_upper( lt_carrids[ 1 ]-carrid ) msg = 'First carrid not uppercase' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen, ähnlich wie `map` in anderen Sprachen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Mapping, String Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um Werte einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                               FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_example( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.
    DATA lt_sflight_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare test data for 'AA'
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight_test.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight_test.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = 500 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight_test.

    " Sum for 'AA' should be 300
    lv_expected_price = 300.
    DATA(lv_actual_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price_aa exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Test for AA failed' ).

    " Sum for 'LH' should be 500
    lv_expected_price = 500.
    DATA(lv_actual_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price_lh exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Test for LH failed' ).

    " Sum for non-existent carrid should be 0
    lv_expected_price = 0.
    DATA(lv_actual_price_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price_xx exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Test for non-existent carrid failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Art, Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis (PRICE) über 500 zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit gefilterten Zeilen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 20 ROWS. " Beispielhafte Daten

    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE price > 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_example( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( ).

    " Assert that all flights in the result are indeed expensive
    LOOP AT lt_expensive_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) msg = 'Flight with price <= 500 found' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that if there are any flights in SFLIGHT, the filtered table is not initial
    DATA lv_sflight_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_sflight_count.
    IF lv_sflight_count > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_expensive_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die die angegebene Bedingung erfüllen, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering

explanation: String-Templates bieten eine moderne und intuitive Syntax zur dynamischen Erstellung von Strings. Variablen und Ausdrücke können direkt in den String eingebettet werden, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als die Verkettung mit `&&`.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, Date Formatting

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 50 ROWS. " Beispielhafte Daten

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                              ( carrid       = flight-carrid
                                flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                avg_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                         FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                         NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    " Check if summary is not empty (assuming SFLIGHT has data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary ).

    " Find a specific carrid and check its values (e.g., 'LH')
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_group_by_example=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Assert that flight count and avg price are reasonable (e.g., > 0)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'LH flight count not greater than 0' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_summary-avg_price > 0 ) msg = 'LH average price not greater than 0' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test with a carrid that might not exist
    DATA(ls_xx_summary) = VALUE zcl_group_by_example=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_xx_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'XX'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 4 msg = 'XX carrid found unexpectedly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF` und `GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe können weitere Operationen wie `REDUCE` für Aggregationen durchgeführt werden, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Zeichenkette in Kleinbuchstaben umwandelt, dann alle Leerzeichen entfernt und schließlich die Länge der resultierenden Zeichenkette zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie Method Chaining.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen, und eine finale Methode, die das Ergebnis liefert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_lowercase RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain_example.
    METHODS remove_spaces RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain_example.
    METHODS get_length RETURNING VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_lowercase.
    mv_string = to_lower( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_spaces.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN mv_string WITH ''.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_length.
    rv_length = strlen( mv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_method_chain_example( '  Hello World  ' ).
    DATA(lv_length) = lo_processor->to_lowercase( )->remove_spaces( )->get_length( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_length exp = 10 msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_processor2) = NEW zcl_method_chain_example( 'ABAP is great' ).
    DATA(lv_length2) = lo_processor2->remove_spaces( )->to_lowercase( )->get_length( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_length2 exp = 11 msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect for second test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe aneinandergereiht werden können. Dies wird durch Methoden erreicht, die eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben, was einen flüssigen, objektorientierten Stil ermöglicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Functional Methods, String Processing

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und die Route (Start- und Zielstadt kombiniert) enthält, unter Verwendung des FOR-Ausdrucks.
hint: Definieren Sie zwei TYPES-Strukturen und nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit einer Schleife über die Quelltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itt_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_route,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             route     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_route.
    TYPES tt_flight_route TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_route WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_routes) TYPE tt_flight_route.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itt_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_routes = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
                         ( flight_id = |{ ls_raw-carrid }-{ ls_raw-connid }|
                           route     = |{ ls_raw-cityfrom } -> { ls_raw-cityto }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itt_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_itt_for_transform=>tt_flight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_routes) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_routes ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_routes[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH-0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_routes[ 2 ]-route exp = 'DALLAS -> LONDON' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit String-Templates (|...|) wird die Erstellung neuer Datenstrukturen aus bestehenden sehr effizient und lesbar.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle eines benutzerdefinierten Typs als Importparameter akzeptiert und eine gefilterte Version dieser Tabelle als Rückgabewert liefert. Nutzen Sie TYPES für die Typdefinitionen.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Verwenden Sie ein Feldsymbol für den Zugriff und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch UNASSIGNED wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS> und anschließend UNASSIGN <FS>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Explicitly unassign for clarity/resource management
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign_fs( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign_fs=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign_fs( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign_fs=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test' field2 = 456 ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Field not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Feldsymbole ermöglichen den dynamischen Zugriff auf Datenstrukturen, was in Szenarien mit variablen Feldnamen nützlich ist. Obwohl in vielen Fällen implizit unassigned, kann ein explizites UNASSIGN die Absicht verdeutlichen und in komplexen dynamischen Szenarien zur besseren Ressourcenverwaltung beitragen. Die Verwendung von TYPES für die Struktur sorgt für Typsicherheit bei der Deklaration.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, TYPES

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Verwenden Sie ein Feldsymbol für die Objektinstanz und UNASSIGN Sie es nach dem Aufruf.
hint: Nutzen Sie ASSIGN (lv_object_ref) TO <FS_OBJECT> und CALL METHOD <FS_OBJECT>->(lv_method_name).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_target DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      method_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string,
      method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign_obj_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign_obj_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.

    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.
    DATA lv_input_param TYPE string.

    lv_method_name = iv_method_name.
    lv_input_param = iv_input_value.

    ASSIGN io_object TO <fs_object>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(lv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = lv_input_param
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = <fs_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ELSE.
            rv_result = 'Method call failed'.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          rv_result = 'Dynamic method call error'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Object reference assignment failed'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_object>. " Explicitly unassign the object field symbol
    UNASSIGN <fs_result>. " Unassign result field symbol if used
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method_call FOR TESTING.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itt_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itt_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_product IN it_products
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_product-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itt_loop_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itt_loop_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    LOOP AT it_items ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
      " Simulate some processing
      APPEND <fs_item>-value TO rt_processed_values.
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_item>. " Explicitly unassign the field symbol
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Verkaufsdaten nach Produktkategorie und berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz pro Kategorie. Verwenden Sie TYPES für die Datenstrukturen und den GROUP BY-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und den REDUCE-Operator innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itt_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             category TYPE string,
             product  TYPE string,
             amount   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_summary,
             category TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_summary.
    TYPES tt_sales_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_category
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_sales_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itt_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_category.
    LOOP AT it_sales_data INTO DATA(ls_sales_item) GROUP BY ls_sales_item-category ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_group>).

      DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <fs_group>
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-amount
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_sales_summary(
        category = <fs_group>-category
        total_amount = lv_total_amount
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( category = 'Electronics' product = 'Laptop' amount = '1200.00' )
      ( category = 'Books'       product = 'Novel'  amount = '25.50' )
      ( category = 'Electronics' product = 'Mouse'  amount = '50.00' )

      ( category = 'Electronics' product = 'Keyboard' amount = '150.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_category( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ category = 'Books' ]-total_amount exp = '100.50' ).

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie dynamisch den Wert einer bestimmten Spalte in einer internen Tabelle, deren Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für den Zeilenzugriff und den Spaltenzugriff und UNASSIGN Sie diese nach der Operation.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS_LINE> und ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <FS_LINE> TO <FS_FIELD>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value1    TYPE string,
             value2    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_record.
    TYPES tt_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_dynamic_column
      CHANGING
        ct_records    TYPE tt_records
      IMPORTING
        iv_key_value  TYPE string
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_record> TYPE ty_record.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_records ASSIGNING <fs_record> WHERE key_field = iv_key_value.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_record> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Attempt to assign new value, handle type conversion if necessary
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion error, e.g., log it
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
      EXIT. " Assuming key_field is unique
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_record>. " Explicitly unassign
    UNASSIGN <fs_field>.  " Explicitly unassign
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` Methoden wie `create_document`, `add_sheet`, `add_row`, `add_cell` und `xstring_to_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_create_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sflights_xlsx
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xlsx_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_create_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 5 ROWS
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price = ls_sflight-price,
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lv_sheet_name) = 'SFLIGHTS'.

    lo_xlsx->create_document( ).
    lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).

    " Add header row
    lo_xlsx->add_row( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Flight No.' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Currency' ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_xlsx->add_row( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
      lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xlsx_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_document_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_row,
             col1 TYPE string, " CARRID
             col2 TYPE string, " CONNID
             col3 TYPE string, " FLDATE
             col4 TYPE string, " PRICE
             col5 TYPE string, " CURRENCY
           END OF ty_sflight_row.
    TYPES tt_sflight_rows TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHOD read_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lv_sheet_name) = 'SFLIGHTS'. " Assuming sheet name is 'SFLIGHTS'

    TRY.
        lo_xlsx->load_document_xstring( iv_xstring = iv_xlsx_xstring ).
        rt_sflights_data = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_data( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
        " Remove header row if present
        IF lines( rt_sflights_data ) > 0.
          DELETE rt_sflights_data INDEX 1.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, deren Spalten dynamisch auf eine ABAP-Struktur abgebildet werden müssen, basierend auf einer Header-Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und dynamische Feldzuweisung (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dynamic,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_dynamic.
    TYPES tt_sflight_dynamic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_dynamic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_xlsx_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_xlsx_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_dynamic.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_xlsx_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lv_sheet_name) = 'SFLIGHTS'.

    TRY.
        lo_xlsx->load_document_xstring( iv_xstring = iv_xlsx_xstring ).
        DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_data( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lines( lt_raw_data ) < 2. " Need at least header + 1 data row
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_header_row) = lt_raw_data[ 1 ].
    DELETE lt_raw_data INDEX 1. " Remove header

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( VALUE ty_sflight_dynamic( ) ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw_row).
      DATA(ls_target_row) = VALUE ty_sflight_dynamic( ).
      DATA(lv_col_idx) = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_col_idx OF ls_raw_row TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw_cell>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF ls_target_row TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_field>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_raw_cell>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_target_row TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus `sflights` (z.B. Summe der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft) und konvertieren Sie das aggregierte Ergebnis in einen JSON-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrid_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_serialize
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_serialize.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc )
    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE tt_carrid_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      LET lv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) IN
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                        total_passengers = lv_total_passengers
                                        flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_group ) ) ) )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_abap2json=>serialize( lt_summary ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_abap2json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, in der die 'Price'-Zellen von Flügen mit einem Preis über 500 EUR rot gefärbt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` Methoden für Zellstile, z.B. `set_cell_style`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_conditional_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_formatted_xlsx
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xlsx_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_conditional_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_xlsx.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 5 ROWS
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price = ls_sflight-price,
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lv_sheet_name) = 'Formatted_SFLIGHTS'.

    lo_xlsx->create_document( ).
    lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).

    " Add header row
    lo_xlsx->add_row( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Flight No.' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Currency' ).

    DATA(lv_row_idx) = 1. " Start after header
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
      lo_xlsx->add_row( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).

CLASS zcl_nested_json_to_xlsx DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES tt_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             name     TYPE s_carr_name,
             segments TYPE tt_flight_segments,
           END OF ty_airline_data.
    TYPES tt_airline_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_nested_json_and_xlsx
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xlsx_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_json_to_xlsx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_json_and_xlsx.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_flight_segments(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 2 ROWS
      ( connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).

    DATA(ls_airline_data) = VALUE ty_airline_data(
      carrid = 'LH'
      name = 'Lufthansa'
      segments = lt_sflights
    ).

    DATA(lv_json_string) = ''.
    TRY.
        lv_json_string = /ui2/cl_abap2json=>serialize( ls_airline_data ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_abap2json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lv_sheet_name) = 'Nested_JSON'.

    lo_xlsx->create_document( ).
    lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).

    lo_xlsx->add_row( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = 'Nested SFLIGHTS JSON Data' ).

    lo_xlsx->add_row( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).
    lo_xlsx->add_cell( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name iv_value = lv_json_string ).

    rv_xlsx_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_document_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_json_to_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_json_to_xlsx( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `INIT sum = 0`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 15 msg = 'Summe sollte 15 sein' ).

    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    lv_sum = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Summe sollte 0 für leere Tabelle sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated = REDUCE string( INIT r = '' FOR s IN it_strings NEXT r = COND string( WHEN r IS INITIAL THEN s ELSE r && ',' && s ) ).

Instructions: Finde den größten Wert in einer internen Tabelle von Ganzzahlen.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und initialisiere mit dem ersten Element oder dem kleinstmöglichen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_max IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide. " Oder eine passendere Ausnahme
    ENDIF.
    rv_max = REDUCE i( INIT m = it_numbers[1] FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT m = COND #( WHEN num > m THEN num ELSE m ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_max FOR TESTING. METHODS test_max_empty_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ( 20 ) ( 3 ) ( 15 ) ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->find_max( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = 20 msg = 'Maximalwert sollte 20 sein' ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 7 ) ).
    lv_max = lo_cut->find_max( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = 7 msg = 'Maximalwert sollte 7 sein für Einzelelement' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_class_name( lo_cut->find_max( lt_numbers ) )
      exp = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE'
      msg = 'Sollte Ausnahme für leere Tabelle auslösen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` mit `COND` bietet eine prägnante Möglichkeit, den Maximalwert zu finden. Die Initialisierung mit dem ersten Element ist hier wichtig, um den Vergleich zu starten, und die Ausnahmebehandlung für leere Tabellen ist robust.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, COND, Internal Tables, Exception Handling

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT distinct_carriers = VALUE string_hashed_table( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT distinct_carriers = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( distinct_carriers[ flight-carrid ] ) THEN VALUE #( distinct_carriers ( flight-carrid ) ) ELSE distinct_carriers )
      FINALLY = lines( distinct_carriers )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_value_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_value_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( 
      carrier_id    = flight-carrid
      connection_id = flight-connid
      flight_date   = flight-fldate
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jede Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer `HASHED TABLE` als Akkumulator und `FOR ... IN GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passenger_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_passenger_sum.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_passenger_sum TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_passenger_sum WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS group_and_sum_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sums) TYPE tt_carrier_passenger_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum_passengers.
    rt_sums = REDUCE tt_carrier_passenger_sum(
      INIT s = VALUE tt_carrier_passenger_sum( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      NEXT s = VALUE #( s ( carrid = flight-carrid
                            total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT p = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT p = p + member-passengers ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Hash-Tabelle, die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) auf ihre Namen (CARRNAME) abbildet, basierend auf Daten aus `scarr`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_map_build DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_map_entry,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_map_entry.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_map_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS build_carrier_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_map) TYPE tt_carrier_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_map_build IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_carrier_map.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    rt_carrier_map = REDUCE tt_carrier_map(
      INIT m = VALUE tt_carrier_map( )
      FOR carrier IN lt_scarr
      NEXT m = VALUE #( m ( carrid = carrier-carrid carrname = carrier-carrname ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data

      RETURNING
