ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_passengers_by_carrier.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = s + flight-passengers
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle Flüge aus `sflights` basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften und einer optionalen dynamischen Bedingung für die Flugnummer.

CLASS zcl_fae_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
        iv_dynamic_where TYPE string OPTIONAL " e.g., 'AND connid LIKE ''0%'''
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    IF iv_dynamic_where IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = iv_dynamic_where.
    ENDIF.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid @lv_where_clause INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_dynamic_where=>tt_carriers( ( carrid = 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lv_dynamic_where) = 'AND connid LIKE ''00%'''. " Example: connection starts with '00'
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( it_carriers = lt_carriers iv_dynamic_where = lv_dynamic_where ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Sollte Flüge finden' ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte AA sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = <fs_flight>-connid CP '00*' msg = 'Flugnummer sollte mit 00 beginnen' ).
    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_no_dynamic_where.

    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_fae_subquery_concept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Transformiere eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften in eine interne Tabelle, die nur die ersten beiden Zeichen des Fluggesellschafts-IDs enthält, und entferne Duplikate.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: tt_short_carriers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_short_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_short_carriers) TYPE tt_short_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_short_distinct_carriers.
    rt_short_carriers = REDUCE tt_short_carriers(
      INIT s = VALUE tt_short_carriers( )
      FOR carrier IN it_carriers
      LET short_carrid = substring( val = carrier-carrid off = 0 len = 2 ) IN
      NEXT s = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( s[ short_carrid ] ) THEN VALUE #( s ( short_carrid ) ) ELSE s )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES tt_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights

Instructions: Simulieren Sie den Empfang einer JSON-Antwort von einer externen API (konzeptionell `cl_hcmfab_employee_api`) und parsen Sie diese in eine interne ABAP-Tabelle von Mitarbeiterstrukturen. Die JSON-Antwort enthält eine Liste von Mitarbeitern mit ID, Vorname und Nachname.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Flügen, die mehr als 200 freie Sitze haben, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer dieser Flüge enthält. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit der `WHERE`-Klausel und der direkten Zuweisung von Komponenten für eine effiziente Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_flight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map_flights
      IMPORTING it_all_flights    TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_flight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map_flights.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                             WHERE ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc > 200 )
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                               connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_filter_flights=>tt_flight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 300 ) " 200 free
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 250 seatsmax = 300 ) " 50 free
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 400 )  " 350 free
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 200 )  " 50 free
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_and_map_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Two filtered flights expected' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered carrier mismatch' act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second filtered connid mismatch' act = lt_filtered[2]-connid exp = '0001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel (als Filter) und der direkten Zuweisung von Komponenten ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`, die den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: FOR, FILTER, Internal Tables, Transformation, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aller Flüge in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`).
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_seats_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING it_flights        TYPE tt_flight_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_seats_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_seats_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_seats_sum=>tt_flight_seats(
      ( seatsocc = 100 )
      ( seatsocc = 250 )
      ( seatsocc = 50 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats mismatch' act = lv_total exp = 400 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_seats_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_seats_sum=>tt_flight_seats( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for empty table should be 0' act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator bietet eine funktionale und sehr prägnante Möglichkeit, Aggregationen (wie Summen, Minima, Maxima) über interne Tabellen durchzuführen. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP`s mit einer Akkumulator-Variable und ist ein Kernbestandteil von modernem ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251123' ).

    CONVERT DATE lv_expected_date INTO INVERTED DATE lv_expected_date.

Instructions: Greifen Sie sicher auf eine Methode oder ein Attribut eines Objekts zu, das möglicherweise initial ist, ohne eine Ausnahme (`CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL`) auszulösen. Wenn das Objekt initial ist, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `?->` Operator für Optional Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_chaining_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.

    METHODS get_message_text
      IMPORTING io_message_object TYPE REF TO if_abap_behv_message OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text)    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_chaining_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_text.
    " Optional chaining: If io_message_object is initial, get_text() is not called,
    " and the expression returns the initial value of string (empty string).
    rv_text = io_message_object?->get_text( ).
    IF rv_text IS INITIAL.
      rv_text = 'No message object provided or message is empty.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_text.
    rv_text = 'This is a test message.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_severity.
    rv_severity = if_abap_behv_message=>co_severity-success.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_parameters.
    " Dummy implementation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_with_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_initial_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_optional_chaining_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_message_text( lo_cut ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected message text mismatch' act = lv_text exp = 'This is a test message.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_initial_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_optional_chaining_demo( ).
    DATA(lo_initial_message) TYPE REF TO if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_message_text( lo_initial_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected default text for initial object' act = lv_text exp = 'No message object provided or message is empty.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Optional Chaining (`?->`) ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion, die es ermöglicht, Methoden oder Attribute von Objektreferenzen aufzurufen, ohne eine `CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL`-Ausnahme auszulösen, wenn die Referenz initial ist. Stattdessen wird der Ausdruck initial. Dies vereinfacht die Fehlerbehandlung und macht den Code robuster und lesbarer, da explizite `IF lo_object IS NOT BOUND` Prüfungen entfallen können.
keywords: Optional Chaining, Object Orientation, Null Pointer, Exception Handling

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen für die Zielstruktur und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE * FROM ... INTO @DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING iv_carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid       TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate       TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight_data ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp (als String) erzeugt und diese mit Beispieldaten füllt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) zur dynamischen Typisierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_descr` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING iv_table_type_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING   cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          ls_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

        CREATE DATA ls_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN ls_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

        " Fill with dummy data (assuming simple structure with string/char fields)
        " This part would need more sophisticated RTTI for complex types
        TRY.
            <fs_line>-* = 'Dynamic Value 1'. " Assign to first component if it's char-like
            APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
            <fs_line>-* = 'Dynamic Value 2'.
            APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Handle cases where direct assignment is not possible
        ENDTRY.

    CATCH cx_sy_type_descr_error cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA(lv_table_type) = 'SFLIGHTS_TAB'. " Assuming SFLIGHTS_TAB is a table type of SFLIGHTS

    TRY.
        lr_dynamic_table = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lv_table_type ).
        ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <fs_table> ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Two entries expected' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).
    CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die in Szenarien nützlich ist, in denen die Struktur der zu verarbeitenden Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei generischen Datenimporten oder -exporten. Es zeigt die Flexibilität von modernem ABAP im Umgang mit dynamischen Anforderungen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP` Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_group_flights_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (`price`) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `MAX` oder `MAXIMUM` innerhalb eines Ausdrucks, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_price = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = ls_flight-price ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_max_price > 0 ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen wie das Finden des Maximalwerts. Er iteriert über die Tabelle und wendet eine Logik an, um einen einzelnen Wert zu akkumulieren. `nmax` ist eine eingebaute Funktion, die den größeren von zwei numerischen Werten zurückgibt, was hier perfekt passt.

Instructions: Finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den höchsten Flugpreis (`price`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` oder `MAX` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ls_flight_entry-carrid.
      DATA(lv_max_price) = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                                     FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight_entry
                                     NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = <fs_member>-price ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_max_price( carrid = ls_flight_entry-carrid
                                         max_price = lv_max_price ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_per_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Check for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(ls_lh_max_price) = VALUE ty_carrier_max_price( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_max_price WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH should be in result' act = ls_lh_max_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH max price should be > 0' act = ( ls_lh_max_price-max_price > 0 ) ).

    " Ensure all entries have a positive max price (assuming valid data)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be positive' act = ( ls_entry-max_price >= 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchzuführen. `GROUP BY` erstellt temporäre Gruppen, über die dann mit `REDUCE` iteriert und der Maximalwert für jede Gruppe ermittelt wird. Dies ersetzt komplexe `AT NEW`/`AT END` Logik oder manuelle Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Aggregation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und transformieren Sie die gefilterten Einträge sofort in ein neues Format, das nur die Flugnummer und den Preis enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um Filterung und Transformation in einem Schritt durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND price > iv_min_price )
                          ( flight_id = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|
                            price     = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_and_map FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_and_map_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_summary( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_min_price = 300 ).

CLASS zcl_max_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_date.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      ORDER BY fldate DESC
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_latest_date = REDUCE #( INIT latest_d = sy-datum
                                 FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                 NEXT latest_d = nmax( val1 = latest_d val2 = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck, der mit `CONDENSE` oder `REPLACE` erstellt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_dynamically.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_where_condition) = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_value }'|.

    TRY.
        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE (lv_where_condition) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle error if field name is invalid or value type mismatch
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic filter failed' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie das Objekt mit dem höchsten Wert einer bestimmten Eigenschaft in einer Liste von Objekten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine geeignete Vergleichslogik, um das Objekt mit dem Maximalwert zu identifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_object_property DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_comparable.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    CLASS-METHODS create_flight_object
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_flight) TYPE REF TO zcl_max_object_property.

    METHODS get_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    METHODS get_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrier) TYPE sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_object_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_max_object_property WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_max_price_object) TYPE REF TO zcl_max_object_property.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
          mv_price  TYPE sflight-price.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_object_property IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = is_flight_data-carrid.
    mv_price  = is_flight_data-price.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_flight_object.
    ro_flight = NEW zcl_max_object_property( is_flight_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_price.
    rv_price = mv_price.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrier.
    rv_carrier = mv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_object_with_max_price.
    IF it_flight_objects IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_max_price_object = REDUCE #( INIT max_obj = it_flight_objects[ 1 ]
                                    FOR lo_flight IN it_flight_objects
                                    NEXT max_obj = COND #( WHEN lo_flight->get_price( ) > max_obj->get_price( ) THEN lo_flight ELSE max_obj ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_comparable~compare.
    " Not directly used for this example's MAX logic, but good practice for comparable objects
    IF me->mv_price < other->(zcl_max_object_property=>get_price( )) .
      result = -1.
    ELSEIF me->mv_price > other->(zcl_max_object_property=>get_price( )) .
      result = 1.
    ELSE.
      result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_object_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_object.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_max_object_property=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_max_object_property=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_max_object_property=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'UA' price = 500 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_max_object_property=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'AA' price = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA: lt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_max_object_property WITH EMPTY KEY.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_data).
      APPEND zcl_max_object_property=>create_flight_object( ls_flight_data ) TO lt_flight_objects.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_object_property( VALUE zcl_max_object_property=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'DUMMY' price = 0 ) ). " Dummy object for method call
    DATA(lo_max_obj) = lo_cut->get_object_with_max_price( lt_flight_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Max object should be found' act = lo_max_obj ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier of max price object should be UA' act = lo_max_obj->get_carrier( ) exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max price should be 500' act = lo_max_obj->get_price( ) exp = 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_object_empty.
    DATA: lt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_max_object_property WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_object_property( VALUE zcl_max_object_property=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'DUMMY' price = 0 ) ).
    DATA(lo_max_obj) = lo_cut->get_object_with_max_price( lt_flight_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( msg = 'No object should be returned for empty table' act = lo_max_obj ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann, um das 'maximale' Objekt in einer Liste von Objektreferenzen zu finden, basierend auf einer Eigenschaft des Objekts. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine prägnante bedingte Zuweisung, um das Objekt mit dem aktuell höchsten Preis zu verfolgen. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und objektorientierte Art der Aggregation.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von beliebigen Strukturen dynamisch, indem Sie zur Laufzeit einen Feldnamen und einen Wert angeben. Die Tabelle kann unterschiedliche Zeilentypen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Feldname im Zeilentyp existiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_value        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    IF NOT lo_struct_descr->has_component( iv_field_name ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' existiert nicht im Zeilentyp der Tabelle.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_where_condition) = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_value }'|.

    TRY.
        rt_filtered_table = FILTER #( it_source_table WHERE (lv_where_condition) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " This exception might occur if the dynamic condition is syntactically wrong
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamischer Filterausdruck '{ lv_where_condition }' ist ungültig.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_date_limit) = sy-datum + 30.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate > sy-datum AND fldate <= lv_date_limit ).

    IF lt_future_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_future_flights
                                NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = ls_flight-price ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle, um alle Einträge zu finden, die in einer anderen Referenztabelle vorhanden sind (Intersection).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` oder `FOR` mit `WHERE` auf der Referenztabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_intersection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_common_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_reference_keys TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_intersection) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_intersection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_common_flights.
    rt_intersection = FILTER #( it_source_flights WHERE line_exists( it_reference_keys[ carrid = carrid connid = connid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_intersection.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_sflight( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = 100 )
                                        ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' price = 200 )
                                        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' price = 300 ) ).
    DATA(lt_ref_keys) = VALUE tt_sflight_key( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' )
                                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_intersection( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

  METHOD test_intersection_empty.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_sflight( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = 100 ) ).
    DATA(lt_ref_keys) = VALUE tt_sflight_key( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_intersection( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_common_flights( it_source_flights = lt_source it_reference_keys = lt_ref_keys ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_intersection_no_match.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_sflight( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = 100 ) ).
    DATA(lt_ref_keys) = VALUE tt_sflight_key( ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '999' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_intersection( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator kann in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` verwendet werden, um effizient die Schnittmenge (Intersection) zweier interner Tabellen zu bilden. `LINE_EXISTS` prüft, ob ein Eintrag mit den angegebenen Schlüsseln in der Referenztabelle existiert. Dies ist eine sehr performante und moderne Art, Set-Operationen auf Tabellen durchzuführen, insbesondere wenn die Referenztabelle einen geeigneten Schlüssel hat (z.B. HASHED TABLE).
keywords: FILTER, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Set Operations, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft und jedes Flugdatum den höchsten Flugpreis (`price`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit mehreren Schlüsseln und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_per_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_date_max_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_date_max_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_date_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_date_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_date_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier_date.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ls_flight_entry-carrid, ls_flight_entry-fldate.
      DATA(lv_max_price) = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                                     FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight_entry
                                     NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = <fs_member>-price ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_date_max_price( carrid = ls_flight_entry-carrid
                                              fldate = ls_flight_entry-fldate
                                              max_price = lv_max_price ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price_per_carrier_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_per_carrier_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_per_day( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Check for a specific group, e.g., 'LH' and a specific date
    DATA(ls_test_entry) = VALUE ty_carrier_date_max_price( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_test_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = sy-datum. " Assuming some LH flights today
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH today max price should be > 0' act = ( ls_test_entry-max_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Ensure all entries have a positive max price (assuming valid data)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be positive' act = ( ls_entry-max_price >= 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Gruppierungsfunktionalität von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` auf mehrere Felder (`carrid` und `fldate`). Innerhalb jeder dieser feineren Gruppen wird dann mit `REDUCE` und `nmax` der höchste Flugpreis ermittelt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, komplexe Aggregationen über mehrere Dimensionen hinweg durchzuführen, ohne manuelle Sortierungen oder verschachtelte Schleifen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, Grouping, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer komplexen, benutzerdefinierten Logik, die in einer Lambda-Funktion gekapselt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck, der eine Lambda-Funktion aufruft oder eine komplexe Bedingung enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_lambda DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_custom_logic
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_threshold_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_min_connid_len  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_lambda IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_custom_logic.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_source_flights WHERE
                                    ( COND #( WHEN price > iv_threshold_price AND
                                                  strlen( connid ) >= iv_min_connid_len
                                              THEN abap_true
                                              ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb des `WHERE`-Teils können mehrere Bedingungen logisch verknüpft und sogar eingebaute Funktionen wie `strlen` direkt angewendet werden. Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis (`price`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie alle Details dieses Fluges zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `READ TABLE` oder eine Kombination aus `REDUCE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_get_max_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_get_max_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_max_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( )
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > max_flight-price THEN ls_flight ELSE max_flight ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             price    TYPE sflight-price,

           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS test_get_max_flight_empty FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_get_max_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Max flight should not be initial' act = ls_max_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be positive' act = ( ls_max_flight-price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_max_flight_empty.
    " This test is harder to simulate without mocking sflights.
    " For a real scenario, one would mock sflights to return an empty set.
    " Here, we assume a scenario where sflights might be empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_get_max_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( ).

explanation: Anstatt nur den Maximalwert zu finden, kann `REDUCE` auch verwendet werden, um den *gesamten Zeileneintrag* zurückzugeben, der den Maximalwert enthält. Dies geschieht, indem der Akkumulator (`max_flight`) als Struktur des Zeilentyps definiert und die `COND`-Expression verwendet wird, um die gesamte Zeile zu aktualisieren, wenn ein höherer Preis gefunden wird. Dies ist eine sehr elegante Methode, um den 'Top N'-Eintrag zu finden, wenn N=1 ist.
keywords: REDUCE, MAXIMUM, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Data Retrieval, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sehr große interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) effizient, um nur die ersten N Flüge zu erhalten, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR ... UP TO N ROWS` für eine performante Filterung und Begrenzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching a large amount of data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 1000 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_top_n_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_top_n_filter_less_than_n FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_top_n_filter_zero_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_top_n = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_top_n_filter_less_than_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_top_n( ).
    " Assuming 'XX' has fewer than 3 flights
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'AA' iv_top_n = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should have less than 100 entries' act = ( lines( lt_result ) < 100 ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be AA' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_top_n_filter_zero_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_top_n = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für performante Filterungen und Begrenzungen auf die ersten N Ergebnisse ist die Kombination von `FILTER` mit `FOR ... UP TO N ROWS` im `VALUE`-Ausdruck ideal. Der `FILTER`-Operator reduziert die Menge der zu verarbeitenden Daten, und `UP TO N ROWS` stellt sicher, dass die Schleife beendet wird, sobald N passende Einträge gefunden wurden, was die Performance bei großen Tabellen erheblich verbessert.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, UP TO N ROWS, Internal Tables, Performance, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches ALV-Grid, das Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT anzeigt. Das ALV soll entweder im Vollbildmodus oder in einem Custom Container angezeigt werden können.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_sflight_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name OPTIONAL
      RAISING
        cx_salv_msg.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_alv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflight_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF iv_container_name IS SUPPLIED.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name.
    ENDIF.

    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = mo_container
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = lt_sflight
    ).

    mo_alv_table->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache HTML-Seite in einem Custom Container an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_html_viewer` und die Methode `load_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_html_viewer_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
    METHODS display_html IMPORTING iv_html_string TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_html_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_html_viewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_html_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_html.
    DATA lt_html_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.

    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text   = iv_html_string
      IMPORTING
        buffer = lt_html_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    lv_length = xstrlen( lt_html_xstring ).

    mo_html_viewer->load_data(
      EXPORTING
        url    = 'about:blank'
        size   = lv_length
        type   = 'text'
        data_x = lt_html_xstring
    ).
    mo_html_viewer->show_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Feldkatalog für ein ALV-Grid basierend auf der Struktur einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Die Spalten sollen dabei automatisch aus der Struktur abgeleitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_salv_table->get_columns`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING
        ir_data      TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA ls_field TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_lvc_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA lv_col_pos TYPE i VALUE 1.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).
    ls_field = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT ls_field INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CLEAR ls_lvc_fcat.
      ls_lvc_fcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_lvc_fcat-col_pos   = lv_col_pos.
      ls_lvc_fcat-scrtext_s = ls_component-name.
      ls_lvc_fcat-scrtext_m = ls_component-name.
      ls_lvc_fcat-scrtext_l = ls_component-name.
      APPEND ls_lvc_fcat TO rt_fcat.
      lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_fcat FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_fcat.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_data.

    DATA lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_fcat_generator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat( ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = lo_fcat_generator->get_dynamic_fieldcatalog( REF #( lt_test_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_fcat ) exp = 2 msg = 'Field catalog should have 2 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_fcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'FIELD1' msg = 'First field name incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_fcat[ 2 ]-fieldname exp = 'FIELD2' msg = 'Second field name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `cl_abap_structdescr` ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische ALV-Anzeigen, bei denen die Struktur der anzuzeigenden Daten nicht im Voraus bekannt ist. Die moderne Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen und Referenzen (`REF #`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, ALV, Field Catalog, cl_abap_structdescr, describe_by_data

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, um verschiedene Typen von `cl_gui_control`-basierten Objekten (z.B. Button, TextEdit) zu erstellen, basierend auf einem übergebenen Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Methode in einer Factory-Klasse und `CASE` für die Objekterstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_control_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_control_type,
             button   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'B',
             textedit TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'T',
           END OF ty_control_type.

    CLASS-METHODS create_control
      IMPORTING
        iv_control_type TYPE ty_control_type
        io_parent       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_control) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_control_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_control.
    CASE iv_control_type.
      WHEN ty_control_type-button.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_control TYPE cl_gui_button
          EXPORTING
            parent = io_parent.
      WHEN ty_control_type-textedit.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_control TYPE cl_gui_textedit
          EXPORTING
            parent = io_parent.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Unsupported control type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_create_button FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.

    DATA(lo_button) = zcl_gui_control_factory=>create_control(

    DATA(lo_textedit) = zcl_gui_control_factory=>create_control(

explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern ist ein bewährtes Entwurfsmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Es ermöglicht die Erstellung von Objekten, ohne die genaue Klasse des zu erstellenden Objekts im Voraus kennen zu müssen. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes, insbesondere bei der Arbeit mit verschiedenen GUI-Controls, die eine gemeinsame Basisklasse (`cl_gui_control`) haben.
keywords: Factory, Design Pattern, Object Orientation, cl_gui_control, CREATE OBJECT, CASE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Timer, der alle paar Sekunden ein Ereignis auslöst, um z.B. eine Anzeige im GUI zu aktualisieren. Der Timer soll nach einer bestimmten Anzahl von Ticks stoppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und dessen `TICK`-Ereignis. Beachten Sie die Notwendigkeit von `cl_gui_cfw=>flush`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_max_ticks TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS handle_tick FOR EVENT tick OF cl_gui_timer IMPORTING sender.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_tick_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_max_ticks TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer
      EXPORTING
        interval = iv_interval.
    SET HANDLER handle_tick FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mv_max_ticks = iv_max_ticks.
    mv_tick_count = 0.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Wichtig, um GUI-Ereignisse zu verarbeiten
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_tick.
    mv_tick_count = mv_tick_count + 1.
    MESSAGE `Timer Tick: ` && mv_tick_count TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    IF mv_tick_count >= mv_max_ticks.
      stop_timer( ).
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Wichtig, um GUI-Ereignisse zu verarbeiten
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timer_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timer_start_stop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_creation.
    DATA(lo_timer_example) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_example( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_timer_example->mo_timer msg = 'Timer object should be created' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_start_stop.
    DATA(lo_timer_example) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_example( 1 ).
    " In a real scenario, you'd need to run this in a GUI context.
    " For unit testing, we can only verify method calls and state changes.
    " We cannot reliably test the actual 'tick' event firing in a headless unit test.
    lo_timer_example->start_timer( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer_example->mv_max_ticks exp = 2 msg = 'Max ticks should be set' ).
    lo_timer_example->stop_timer( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected on stop' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `cl_gui_timer` ermöglicht die Implementierung von zeitgesteuerten Aktionen im SAP GUI, was für periodische Aktualisierungen oder Animationen nützlich ist. Die Verwendung von `SET HANDLER` für das `TICK`-Ereignis und `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` zur Sicherstellung der GUI-Aktualisierung sind zentrale Elemente. String-Templates (`&&`) werden für die Meldungsausgabe verwendet.
keywords: Timer, cl_gui_timer, Event Handling, Asynchronous, cl_gui_cfw=>flush, String Templates

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von klassenbasierten Ausnahmen (`cx_`) bei der Interaktion mit GUI-Controls, z.B. wenn ein Custom Container mit einem ungültigen Namen erstellt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen wie `cx_gui_exception` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_invalid_container
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_invalid_container.
    DATA lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_invalid_container_name.
    DATA(lo_error_handler) = NEW zcl_gui_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_error_handler->create_invalid_container( '' ). " Empty name is invalid
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Creation with invalid name should fail' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen (`cx_`) sind der moderne und robuste Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Durch die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` können spezifische Fehlerzustände, wie sie bei der GUI-Programmierung auftreten können (`cx_gui_exception`), elegant abgefangen und behandelt werden. Dies führt zu stabilerem und wartbarerem Code.
keywords: Exception Handling, cx_, TRY CATCH, GUI, cx_gui_exception

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_tree.
    DATA lv_node_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_text = 'Root Node'
        i_is_folder = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        e_node_key  = lv_node_key
    ).

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_text = 'Child 1'
        i_is_folder = abap_false
        i_relat_node_key = lv_node_key
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
    ).

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_text = 'Child 2'
        i_is_folder = abap_true
        i_relat_node_key = lv_node_key
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
      IMPORTING
        e_node_key  = lv_node_key
    ).

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_text = 'Grandchild 2.1'
        i_is_folder = abap_false
        i_relat_node_key = lv_node_key
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
    ).

    mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = '00000001' ). " Expand root node
    mo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie einen Fortschrittsbalken im GUI an, der den Fortschritt einer simulierten langlaufenden Operation darstellt. Aktualisieren Sie den Fortschritt in Schritten.

CLASS zcl_progress_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_long_operation IMPORTING iv_steps TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_progress TYPE REF TO cl_progress_indicator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_progress_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_long_operation.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_progress.

    DO iv_steps TIMES.
      DATA(lv_percentage) = ( sy-index * 100 ) / iv_steps.
      mo_progress->set_progress_indicator(
        percentage = lv_percentage
        text       = |Verarbeite Schritt { sy-index } von { iv_steps } ({ lv_percentage }%)|
      ).
      WAIT UP TO '0.1' SECONDS.
    ENDDO.

    mo_progress->set_progress_indicator(
      percentage = 100
      text       = 'Operation abgeschlossen!'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar in einem Custom Container und fügen Sie einige Buttons hinzu. Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für die Buttons in der Toolbar.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_toolbar` und dessen Methoden `add_button` und `set_button_text`. Behandeln Sie das `BUTTON_CLICK`-Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar IMPORTING fcode.

    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'BTN_SAVE'
      icon  = icon_save
      text  = 'Speichern'
      quickinfo = 'Daten speichern'
    ).

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'BTN_EXIT'
      icon  = icon_exit
      text  = 'Beenden'
      quickinfo = 'Anwendung beenden'
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'BTN_SAVE'.
        MESSAGE 'Speichern-Button geklickt!' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      WHEN 'BTN_EXIT'.
        MESSAGE 'Beenden-Button geklickt!' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE |Unbekannter Button-Code: { fcode }| TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle gültigen E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` in Kombination mit `WHILE lo_matcher->match()` und der Methode `GET_MATCHED_SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ) TO rt_emails.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer Logzeile im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS [TYPE] MESSAGE' den Zeitstempel, den Typ und die Nachricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit Klammern für Gruppen (`()`) und `GET_SUBMATCH` um die extrahierten Teile zu erhalten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
         timestamp TYPE string,
         type      TYPE string,
         message   TYPE string,
       END OF ty_log_entry.
TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_regex_log_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_log_line
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry
      RAISING
        cx_abap_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_log_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_line.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) \[(\w+)\] (.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_log_entry-timestamp = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_log_entry-type      = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_log_entry-message   = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_regex_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Log line does not match expected format.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_valid_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_log_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = `2023-11-23 10:30:00 [INFO] Application started successfully.`.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->parse_log_line( lv_log_line ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-timestamp exp = `2023-11-23 10:30:00` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-type exp = `INFO` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-message exp = `Application started successfully.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_invalid_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_log_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = `Invalid log line format`.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->parse_log_line( lv_log_line ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_regex_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_regex_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_abap_regex_error correctly raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand mehrerer unterschiedlicher Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma, Semikolon oder Leerzeichen) in eine Tabelle von Substrings auf.
hint: `SPLIT` unterstützt keine Regex. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `WHILE lo_matcher->match()` um die nicht-Trennzeichen-Teile zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_multi_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex_delimiters
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_delimiters_regex TYPE string " e.g., `[,; ]+` for comma, semicolon, or space
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_multi_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex_delimiters.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_delimiters_regex ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lv_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset( lo_matcher->get_offset( ) - lv_last_offset ).
      IF lv_part IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_part TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = lo_matcher->get_offset( ) + lo_matcher->get_length( ).
    ENDWHILE.

    DATA(lv_remaining_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset.
    IF lv_remaining_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_remaining_part TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_eur_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_price_above_threshold
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_threshold     TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_above) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_eur_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND me->is_price_above_threshold( iv_current_price = price iv_threshold = iv_min_price ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_price_above_threshold.
    IF iv_current_price > iv_threshold.
      rv_is_above = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_above = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_regex_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_connid_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string " e.g., `.*0$` for connid ending with 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_regex TYPE REF TO cl_abap_regex.
    CLASS-DATA gv_current_pattern TYPE string.

    METHODS matches_connid_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_matches) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_regex_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connid_regex.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF gv_current_pattern <> iv_regex_pattern OR go_regex IS NOT BOUND.
      go_regex = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_regex_pattern ).
      gv_current_pattern = iv_regex_pattern.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE me->matches_connid_regex( connid ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD matches_connid_regex.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = go_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_connid ).
    rv_matches = lo_matcher->matches( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS get_flight_keys_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_max_rows   TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_db_dynamic_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD get_flight_keys_dynamic.

    DATA:
      lv_cursor_name TYPE cursor,
      ls_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    " Dynamic SQL statement for opening the cursor
    " Using @DATA for inline declaration of host variables
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor_name FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM (iv_table_name)
        UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error, e.g., table not found or authorization issue
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error opening cursor for dynamic table'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor_name INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_sflight_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_key TO rt_flight_keys.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor_name.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für zwei verschiedene Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'AA' und 'LH') in einem einzigen Ergebnis-Set.

CLASS zcl_db_union_all DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

      END OF ty_flight_union .

      tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY .

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier1 TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrier2 TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.

CLASS zcl_db_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier2
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights(
                               iv_carrier1 = 'AA'
                               iv_carrier2 = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.

Dies ist effizienter als das separate Abrufen und anschließende Zusammenführen von Daten im Applikationsserver, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. `UNION ALL` behält Duplikate bei, im Gegensatz zu `UNION`.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife über eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR  ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
