    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for AA should be greater than 0' act = lv_total_price_aa > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for LH should be greater than 0' act = lv_total_price_lh > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price should be 0 for non-existent carrier' act = lv_total_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

In Kombination mit `FOR`-Iteratoren führt dies zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code für Aggregationsaufgaben.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Interne Tabellen, Aggregation, Funktionale Programmierung, SABP_CORE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' enthält und nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid`, `fldate` und `price` kopiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                               connid = flight-connid,
                               fldate = flight-fldate,
                               price   = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_loop_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_loop_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_group_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid        = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count  = lv_count
        average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summary table should not be initial' act = lt_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_summary ) > 0 ) msg = 'Summary table should contain entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_lh_summary-average_price > 0 ) msg = 'LH average price should be > 0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies vereinfacht Aggregationen und Analysen erheblich, da man nicht mehr manuell sortieren und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` verwenden muss.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die angibt, ob sie mindestens einen Flug mit einem Preis über 1000 haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `VALUE`, `LINE_EXISTS` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_cond_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             has_exp_flight TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_carrier_status.
    TYPES tt_carrier_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_status WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_expensive_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_carrier_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_cond_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_expensive_status.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_status = VALUE #( FOR car IN lt_sflights GROUP BY car-carrid
                         ( carrid = car-carrid,
                           has_exp_flight = COND abap_bool(
                             WHEN line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = car-carrid AND price > 1000 ] )
                             THEN abap_true
                             ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_corr_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE string,
             price  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_string.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_numeric.
    TYPES tt_flight_numeric TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_numeric WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_numeric) TYPE tt_flight_numeric.

CLASS zcl_conv_corr_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_table.
    rt_flight_numeric = CORRESPONDING #( it_flight_string MAPPING fldate = CONV sflight-fldate( fldate )
                                                                  price  = CONV sflight-price( price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Fluggesellschaftscodes aus der Tabelle `sflight` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur für eindeutige Codes.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer temporären Hash-Tabelle zur Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_reduce_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carriers_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_reduce_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_string.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_carriers_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = '' TYPE string
           unique_carriers = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET current_carrier = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT
        result = COND string(
                   WHEN line_exists( unique_carriers[ table_line = current_carrier ] )
                   THEN result
                   ELSE COND string(
                          WHEN result IS INITIAL
                          THEN current_carrier
                          ELSE result && ',' && current_carrier ) )
        unique_carriers = VALUE #( BASE unique_carriers ( current_carrier ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_reduce_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result string should not be initial' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_result CS 'LH' ) msg = 'Result should contain LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_result CS 'AA' ) msg = 'Result should contain AA' ).

    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT lv_result AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.
    DATA(lv_unique_count) = lines( lt_parts ).
    SORT lt_parts ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_parts.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_count exp = lines( lt_parts ) msg = 'All carriers should be unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur String-Verkettung mit gleichzeitiger Behandlung von Eindeutigkeit. Durch die Verwendung einer lokalen Hash-Tabelle innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks (`INIT` und `NEXT` mit `LET`) kann die Logik sehr kompakt und effizient implementiert werden, ohne separate Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: LOOP, REDUCE, String Processing, Internal Tables, Unique, Concatenation

hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `VALUE` und `WHERE` mit einer arithmetischen Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_adjusted,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_adjusted.
    TYPES tt_flight_adjusted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_adjusted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_adjusted_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_adjusted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_adjusted_lh_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fldate = flight-fldate,
                                     price  = flight-price * '1.1' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adjusted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjusted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_adjusted_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'Result table should contain entries' ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_original_lh).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_adjusted).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_adjusted-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'All entries should be for carrier LH' ).
      READ TABLE lt_original_lh INTO DATA(ls_original) WITH KEY carrid = ls_adjusted-carrid
                                                              connid = ls_adjusted-connid
                                                              fldate = ls_adjusted-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_expected_price) = ls_original-price * '1.1'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_adjusted-price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Price should be increased by 10%' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Adjusted flight not found in original LH flights' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die arithmetische Operation `flight-price * '1.1'` wird direkt in der Zuweisung verwendet, was den Code sehr prägnant und effizient macht.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Arithmetic

solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_uuids IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_uuids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_uuids.
    DATA(lv_uuid_regex) = ` [0-9a-fA-F]{8}(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12} | [0-9a-fA-F]{32} `.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_uuid_regex IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_uuids = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String exakt dem Format einer UUID (32 Hex-Zeichen, optional mit Bindestrichen) entspricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND REGEX` mit Ankern (`^` und `$`) im regulären Ausdruck, um den gesamten String zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_uuid IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_uuid.
    DATA(lv_uuid_regex) = `^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|[0-9a-fA-F]{32})$`.
    FIND REGEX lv_uuid_regex IN iv_input.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_is_valid_uuid FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_is_valid_uuid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_validator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid( '12345678-ABCD-EF01-2345-6789ABCDEF01' ) msg = 'Valid UUID with hyphens' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid( 'AABBCCDD11223344556677889900AABB' ) msg = 'Valid UUID without hyphens' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid( 'INVALID-UUID-FORMAT' ) msg = 'Invalid format' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid( '12345678-ABCD-EF01-2345-6789ABCDEF01X' ) msg = 'Too long' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid( '12345678-ABCD-EF01-2345-6789ABCDEF0' ) msg = 'Too short' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_uuid( '' ) msg = 'Empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode nutzt `FIND REGEX` mit einem präzisen regulären Ausdruck, der durch `^` und `$` sicherstellt, dass der gesamte Eingabestring dem UUID-Muster entspricht. Dies ist eine effiziente und robuste Methode zur Validierung von String-Formaten in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Finden Sie die Startposition (Offset) und Länge des ersten Vorkommens eines bestimmten Substrings in einem längeren Text.

solution:
CLASS zcl_substring_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_substring_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_occurrence.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_substring IN iv_text
      MATCH OFFSET rs_match_info-offset
      MATCH LENGTH rs_match_info-length.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_match_info. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie 5 UUIDs und filtern Sie diese Liste, um nur UUIDs zu behalten, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_uuids_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_uuids) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_uuid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_uuids_by_prefix.
    DATA(lt_all_uuids) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i <= 5
      ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) )
    ).

    rt_filtered_uuids = FILTER #( lt_all_uuids USING KEY default WHERE table_line CS iv_prefix ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'A'. " This test might be flaky due to random UUIDs, but demonstrates the syntax.
    " For a robust test, we would generate specific UUIDs or mock cl_system_uuid.
    " Here, we just check if the filter works for *some* prefix.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_uuids_by_prefix( lv_prefix ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(lv_uuid).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = starts_with( val = lv_uuid sub = lv_prefix ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a prefix that is unlikely to match any generated UUIDs
    DATA(lv_unlikely_prefix) = 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ'.
    DATA(lt_filtered_empty) = lo_cut->filter_uuids_by_prefix( lv_unlikely_prefix ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen den Wert 'Gefunden' zu, wenn ein bestimmtes Wort im Eingabestring vorhanden ist, ansonsten 'Nicht gefunden'. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine moderne `COND`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` in Kombination mit `FIND` als Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_word_presence
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_word_presence.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN find( val = iv_text sub = iv_word ) IS NOT INITIAL THEN 'Gefunden'
      ELSE 'Nicht gefunden'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_word_presence( iv_text = lv_text iv_word = 'Teststring' ) exp = 'Gefunden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_word_presence( iv_text = lv_text iv_word = 'XYZ' ) exp = 'Nicht gefunden' ).

In Kombination mit der funktionalen `find()`-Funktion, die einen Offset zurückgibt (oder 0, wenn nicht gefunden), wird die Logik sehr kompakt und lesbar. Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen eindeutigen Bezeichner, indem Sie eine UUID mit dem aktuellen Zeitstempel (UTC) kombinieren. Extrahieren Sie anschließend den Zeitstempel-Teil aus diesem kombinierten String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_SYSTEM_UUID`, `GET TIME STAMP`, String-Templates und `FIND` mit `MATCH OFFSET`/`MATCH LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_timestamp_combiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_info,
             combined_id TYPE string,
             timestamp_part TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_info.

    METHODS create_and_extract
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_combined_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_timestamp_combiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_extract.
    DATA(lv_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_timestamp_utc).

    rs_info-combined_id = |{ lv_uuid }-{ lv_timestamp_utc }|.

    DATA(lv_timestamp_pattern) = `\d{14}`. " Regex for 14 digits (YYYYMMDDhhmmss)
    FIND REGEX lv_timestamp_pattern IN rs_info-combined_id
      MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset)
      MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_length).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_info-timestamp_part = rs_info-combined_id+lv_offset(lv_length).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_uuid_timestamp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uuid_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_timestamp_combiner( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->create_and_extract( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_info-combined_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_info-timestamp_part ).

    " Check format of combined_id (UUID-TIMESTAMP)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = strlen( ls_info-combined_id ) exp = 32 + 1 + 14 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-combined_id+32(1) exp = '-' ).

    " Check format of extracted timestamp
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( ls_info-timestamp_part ) exp = 14 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = matches( val = ls_info-timestamp_part regex = `^\d{14}$` ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `CL_SYSTEM_UUID` und `GET TIME STAMP` mit String-Templates, um einen komplexen Bezeichner zu erstellen. Die Extraktion des Zeitstempel-Teils erfolgt robust mittels `FIND REGEX` mit `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH`, was eine präzise und fehlerresistente String-Analyse ermöglicht. Dies ist ein Beispiel für die Verknüpfung verschiedener moderner ABAP-Features.
keywords: UUID, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, GET TIME STAMP, String Templates, FIND, REGEX, String Processing

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem Text nach allen Vorkommen eines Musters und geben Sie die gefundenen Substrings zusammen mit ihren Startpositionen und Längen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit dem Zusatz `RESULTS` und verarbeiten Sie die `match_result`-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_detail,
             substring TYPE string,
             offset    TYPE i,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_match_detail.
    TYPES tt_match_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_match_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_all_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_match_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_details.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_pattern IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_raw_matches).

    rt_details = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw_match IN lt_raw_matches
                           ( substring = iv_text+ls_raw_match-offset(ls_raw_match-length),
                             offset    = ls_raw_match-offset,
                             length    = ls_raw_match-length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_finder( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `ABAP ist toll, ABAP ist modern, ABAP ist effizient.`.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `ABAP`.

    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->find_all_details( iv_text = lv_text iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_details ) exp = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[1]-substring exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[1]-offset exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[1]-length exp = 4 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[2]-substring exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[2]-offset exp = 16 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[2]-length exp = 4 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[3]-substring exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[3]-offset exp = 34 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[3]-length exp = 4 ).

    DATA(lt_no_match) = lo_cut->find_all_details( iv_text = lv_text iv_pattern = 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_no_match ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF`-Anweisung mit dem `RESULTS`-Zusatz ist der moderne Weg, um alle Fundstellen eines Musters in einem String zu erhalten. Die Ergebnisse werden in einer Tabelle vom Typ `match_result` zurückgegeben, die dann mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck einfach in eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur umgewandelt werden kann. Dies ist sehr effizient und vermeidet manuelle Schleifen und String-Operationen.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem String durch einen neuen Wert. Zum Beispiel, ersetzen Sie alle Zahlen durch '###'.

CLASS zcl_regex_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_replacement TYPE string

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein bestimmtes Muster enthält, und geben Sie bei Erfolg den gefundenen Teil des Strings zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `COND`-Expression mit `FIND` und `MATCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `FIND` und dem `MATCH`-Ergebnis, um den gefundenen Teil direkt zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_match_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_matched_part
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_matched_part) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_match_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_matched_part.
    rv_matched_part = COND string(
      LET lv_offset = find( val = iv_text sub = iv_pattern )
          lv_length = strlen( iv_pattern ) IN
      WHEN lv_offset IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_text+lv_offset(lv_length)
      ELSE ''
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen `SELECT` auf `sflights` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel dynamisch aus einer Range-Tabelle für `CARRID` generiert wird. Stellen Sie sich vor, die Konstanten für die Range-Definition kommen von `if_fsbp_const_range`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE (lv_where_clause)` und die `IN` Operator für Ranges.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dynamic_select_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_range_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_select_by_carrid.
    DATA lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_carrid_field) = 'CARRID'. " Simulating constant from if_fsbp_const_range

    LOOP AT it_carrid_range ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_range>).
      IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ' OR '.
      ENDIF.
      CASE <fs_range>-option.
        WHEN 'EQ'.
          lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ lv_carrid_field } = '{ <fs_range>-low }'|.
        WHEN 'BT'.
          lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ lv_carrid_field } BETWEEN '{ <fs_range>-low }' AND '{ <fs_range>-high }'|.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle other options if necessary
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE (lv_where_clause)
        INTO TABLE @rt_selected_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_range( ).
    DATA lt_carrid_range TYPE zcl_dyn_select_range=>tt_range_carrid.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) TO lt_carrid_range.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->dynamic_select_by_carrid( lt_carrid_range ).

    " Assert that only 'LH' and 'AA' flights are present
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH' OR <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Assert that there are some results (assuming sflight has data for LH/AA)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel in `SELECT`-Anweisungen ermöglicht flexible Abfragen, deren Kriterien zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Selektionsbildschirme oder Schnittstellen, die dynamische Filter erfordern. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) vereinfacht die Konstruktion der Klausel.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.

    METHODS update_currency_for_carrid
      IMPORTING

        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_for_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range.
      <fs_sflight>-currency = iv_new_currency.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_updated_sflights = lt_sflights.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.

      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_range_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_sql_for_range_entry

        iv_field_name  TYPE string

  METHOD build_dynamic_where_clause.
    DATA(lv_carrid_field) = 'CARRID'. " Simulating constant from if_fsbp_const_range
    DATA lv_conditions TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_carrid_range ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_range>).
      IF lv_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_conditions = lv_conditions && ' OR '.
      ENDIF.
      lv_conditions = lv_conditions && get_sql_for_range_entry( is_range_entry = <fs_range> iv_field_name = lv_carrid_field ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = |WHERE { lv_conditions }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sql_for_range_entry.
    CASE is_range_entry-option.
      WHEN 'EQ'.
        rv_sql_part = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ is_range_entry-low }'|.
      WHEN 'BT'.
        rv_sql_part = |{ iv_field_name } BETWEEN '{ is_range_entry-low }' AND '{ is_range_entry-high }'|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle other options
        rv_sql_part = ''.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` unter Verwendung von zwei separaten Range-Tabellen und der `REDUCE`-Anweisung, um die Ergebnisse zu kombinieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für jede Range und dann `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `COND` zur Kombination der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_connid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-connid,
             high   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_range_connid.
    TYPES tt_range_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_multi_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_range_carrid
        it_connid_range TYPE tt_range_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_multi_range.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_carrid) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_connid) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE connid IN it_connid_range ).

    rt_filtered_sflights = REDUCE tt_sflight(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_carrid
      WHERE ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_filtered_connid[ carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
      " The WHERE condition above checks if the flight also exists in the connid-filtered table
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA lt_carrid_range TYPE zcl_itb_filter_reduce=>tt_range_carrid.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lt_carrid_range.

    DATA lt_connid_range TYPE zcl_itb_filter_reduce=>tt_range_connid.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 0001 ) TO lt_connid_range.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 0400 ) TO lt_connid_range.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_multi_range( 
      it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range 
      it_connid_range = lt_connid_range 
    ).

    " Assert that results are for LH and connid 0001 or 0400
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-connid = 0001 OR <fs_sflight>-connid = 0400 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für komplexe Filter- und Aggregationsszenarien. Zuerst werden zwei separate Filter angewendet, und dann wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Schnittmenge der Ergebnisse zu bilden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das sehr effizient und ausdrucksstark ist.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Range, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine unterschiedliche Nachricht zurückgibt, je nachdem, ob sie in der Transaktion 'SE38' oder einer anderen Transaktion aufgerufen wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTEXT_INFO=>GET_CURRENT_TRANSACTION_CODE()`.
solution:

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für Formen mit einer Methode zur Flächenberechnung. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen (Kreis und Rechteck) und demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `TYPES REF TO`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS calculate_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.

  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategy Pattern für die Zahlungsabwicklung. Definieren Sie ein Interface für Zahlungsstrategien und zwei konkrete Implementierungen (Kreditkarte, PayPal). Eine Kontextklasse soll die gewählte Strategie ausführen.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_payment_strategy.
  METHODS process_payment IMPORTING iv_amount TYPE decfloat16
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_credit_card_payment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_payment_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_credit_card_payment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_payment_strategy~process_payment.
    " Simulate credit card payment logic
    IF iv_amount > 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_payment_strategy.

    " Simulate PayPal payment logic
    IF iv_amount > 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_payment_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_payment_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_payment_strategy.
    METHODS execute_payment IMPORTING iv_amount TYPE decfloat16
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_payment_context IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine vereinfachte Version des Observer Patterns. Definieren Sie ein Interface für Beobachter, die auf ein Ereignis reagieren. Eine Subjekt-Klasse soll Beobachter registrieren und benachrichtigen können.
hint: Verwenden Sie Interfaces für Beobachter und eine interne Tabelle für die Registrierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_observer.
  METHODS update IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer1 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_observer.
    METHODS get_last_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_observer~update.
    mv_last_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_last_message.
    rv_message = mv_last_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_observer.
    METHODS get_last_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_observer~update.
    mv_last_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_last_message.
    rv_message = mv_last_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS attach IMPORTING io_observer TYPE REF TO zif_observer.
    METHODS detach IMPORTING io_observer TYPE REF TO zif_observer.
    METHODS notify IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_observer_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_observer WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_observers TYPE ty_observer_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD attach.
    INSERT io_observer INTO TABLE mt_observers.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD detach.
    DELETE TABLE mt_observers FROM io_observer.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD notify.
    LOOP AT mt_observers INTO DATA(lo_observer).
      lo_observer->update( iv_message = iv_message ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_observer_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_observer_pattern.
    DATA(lo_subject) = NEW zcl_subject( ).
    DATA(lo_observer1) = NEW zcl_concrete_observer1( ).
    DATA(lo_observer2) = NEW zcl_concrete_observer2( ).

    lo_subject->attach( lo_observer1 ).
    lo_subject->attach( lo_observer2 ).

    lo_subject->notify( 'First message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer1->get_last_message( ) exp = 'First message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer2->get_last_message( ) exp = 'First message' ).

    lo_subject->detach( lo_observer1 ).
    lo_subject->notify( 'Second message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer1->get_last_message( ) exp = 'First message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer2->get_last_message( ) exp = 'Second message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Observer Pattern ermöglicht eine lose Kopplung zwischen Objekten. Das Subjekt (`zcl_subject`) benachrichtigt alle registrierten Beobachter (`zif_observer`) über Änderungen, ohne deren konkrete Typen zu kennen. Dies wird durch das Interface `zif_observer` erreicht.
keywords: INTERFACE, Observer Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Event Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für einen generischen Datenprovider. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` liefert.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider.

CLASS zcl_sflights_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Die Implementierung `zcl_sflights_data_provider` nutzt moderne Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (`INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)`) und Host-Variablen-Escape (`@`) für den Zugriff auf die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine andere Methode einer Klasse dynamisch aufruft, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Die aufgerufene Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodenamen und `cl_abap_classdescr` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

    METHODS method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_instance) = lo_class_descr->create_object( ).

    CALL METHOD (lo_instance)->(iv_method_name)
      RECEIVING
        r = rv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_a.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALLER' iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Result from Method A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALLER' iv_method_name = 'METHOD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Result from Method B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_dyn_call_error ).
    lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALLER' iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (lo_instance)->(iv_method_name)`. Die Klasse `cl_abap_classdescr` wird verwendet, um eine Instanz der Klasse dynamisch zu erzeugen (RTTI - Run-Time Type Information). Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Architekturen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CALL METHOD, cl_abap_classdescr, cx_sy_dyn_call_error

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #()`. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: ty_flight_key_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_key_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->filter_expensive_flights( iv_min_price = '500' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_expensive_flights msg = 'Should find some expensive flights' ).

    LOOP AT lt_expensive_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_key).
      " Verify that the filtered flights actually exist in SFLIGHTS and meet the criteria
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_price)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_key-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight_key-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_price > '500' ) msg = 'Flight price should be > 500' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne Tabelleniteration `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` für die Inline-Konstruktion einer neuen internen Tabelle. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Filterung und Transformation von Daten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_prices_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->sum_prices_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Manually calculate expected sum for 'LH' (or use a known test data set)
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + lv_price.
    ENDSELECT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Total price for LH should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_prices_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->sum_prices_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '0' msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Operation ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um die Summe der Flugpreise zu berechnen, was zu sehr prägnantem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz, wobei jedes Wort durch ein Leerzeichen getrennt ist und der Satz mit einem Punkt endet. Verwenden Sie String Chaining.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Verkettungsoperator `&&` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_words
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_words.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word ELSE s && | { word }| )
    ) && '.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_words FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concatenate_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_chaining( ).
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Dies' ) ( 'ist' ) ( 'ein' ) ( 'Satz' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence exp = 'Dies ist ein Satz.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_chaining( ).
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->concatenate_words( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence exp = '.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit String Chaining (`&&`) und einem String Template, um eine Liste von Wörtern effizient zu einem Satz zu verketten. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` behandelt den ersten Eintrag speziell, um unnötige Leerzeichen zu vermeiden.
keywords: String Chaining, String Templates, REDUCE, Internal Tables, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) als Eingabe nimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Status (z.B. 'X' für cancelled) enthält. Nutzen Sie `FILTER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_status  TYPE sflight-status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_status.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE status = iv_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_cancelled_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_cancelled_flights.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum status = 'X' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum status = '' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum status = 'X' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_status( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_status = 'X' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'X' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_flights_found.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum status = '' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_status( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_status = 'X' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den passenden Einträgen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, SFLIGHTS, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `ZIF_LOG_WRITER` mit einer Methode `WRITE_LOG`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `ZCL_CONSOLE_LOG_WRITER` (schreibt auf den Bildschirm) und `ZCL_DB_LOG_WRITER` (simuliert das Schreiben in eine Datenbanktabelle). Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung über das Interface.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING` und `WRITE` bzw. eine interne Tabelle zur Simulation der Datenbank.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_log_writer.
  METHODS write_log IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_log_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_log_writer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_log_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_log_writer~write_log.
    " WRITE: / iv_message. " For actual console output
    " In unit test, we can't check console output directly, so this is conceptual.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_log_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_log_writer.
    CLASS-METHODS get_logs RETURNING VALUE(rt_logs) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_logs TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_log_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_log_writer~write_log.
    INSERT iv_message INTO TABLE gt_logs.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_logs.
    rt_logs = gt_logs.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_db_log_writer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_console_log_writer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_db_log_writer.
    DATA(lo_db_writer) = NEW zcl_db_log_writer( ).
    lo_db_writer->zif_log_writer~write_log( 'Test message for DB log' ).
    DATA(lt_logs) = zcl_db_log_writer=>get_logs( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_logs ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logs[ 1 ] exp = 'Test message for DB log' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_console_log_writer.
    DATA(lo_console_writer) = NEW zcl_console_log_writer( ).
    " Direct assertion on console output is not possible in ABAP Unit.
    " This test primarily ensures the method can be called without error.
    lo_console_writer->zif_log_writer~write_log( 'Test message for Console log' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Placeholder assertion
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Interfaces (`ZIF_LOG_WRITER`) verwendet werden können, um eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle für unterschiedliche Implementierungen (hier: verschiedene Log-Writer) zu definieren. Dies fördert die Austauschbarkeit und Testbarkeit von Komponenten.
keywords: INTERFACE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Logging

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in einen JSON-String. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize` und die `VALUE`-Anweisung für die Tabellenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " Beispielhafte Datenbeschaffung mit moderner Syntax
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data   = lt_sflights
            pretty = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json   = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain CARRID' substring = 'CARRID' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain CONNID' substring = 'CONNID' in_string = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die einfache Serialisierung einer internen Tabelle in einen lesbaren JSON-String mittels `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize`. Die `pretty = abap_true` Option sorgt für eine formatierte Ausgabe. Die Datenbeschaffung erfolgt mit moderner `SELECT`-Syntax und Inline-Deklaration.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der Flugdaten enthält, in eine ABAP-Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize` und eine passende ABAP-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS deserialize_sflight
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_sflight.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_sflight
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Exception werfen
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_json_pretty_print IMPLEMENTATION.

          EXPORTING
            data   = lv_abap_data
            pretty = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json   = rv_pretty_json
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING it_dynamic_data     TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN it_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_json_string = 'Error: Invalid data reference provided.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data   = <lt_data>
            pretty = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json   = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_row( field1 = 'Value A' field2 = 10 ) TO lt_dynamic_table.
    APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_row( field1 = 'Value B' field2 = 20 ) TO lt_dynamic_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_serialize( ).

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von ABAP-Strukturen. Behandeln Sie fehlende Felder im JSON robust.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize` und stellen Sie sicher, dass die ABAP-Struktur alle möglichen Felder abdeckt. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_item_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_item_list
      IMPORTING iv_json_string      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE ty_item_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_item_list.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = rt_items
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein Interface-Referenzobjekt akzeptiert und basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ des Objekts eine spezifische Aktion ausführt. Verwenden Sie hierfür `CASE TYPE OF`.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und mehrere Klassen, die dieses implementieren. Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` zur Typunterscheidung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    rv_info = CASE TYPE OF io_shape
                WHEN TYPE zcl_circle THEN
                  |Kreis mit Fläche: { io_shape->get_area( ) }|
                WHEN TYPE zcl_square THEN
                  |Quadrat mit Fläche: { io_shape->get_area( ) }|
                ELSE
                  'Unbekannte Form'
              END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) filtert und eine neue Tabelle mit ausgewählten Feldern und einem berechneten Wert (z.B. Gesamtpreis) erstellt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( field = expression ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_curr,
        total_price TYPE s_price, " Example for calculated field
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
        connid    = ls_flight-connid
        fldate    = ls_flight-fldate
        price     = ls_flight-price
        currency  = ls_flight-currency
        total_price = ls_flight-price * 1.1 " Example calculation: price + 10% tax
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'AA' ). " Assuming 'AA' exists in sflights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Sollte Flüge für AA finden, wenn vorhanden'
      cond = ( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ) ). " Assert that some flights are found

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_first_flight-carrid
        exp = 'AA'
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte AA sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_first_flight-total_price
        exp = ls_first_flight-price * 1.1
        msg = 'Totalpreis sollte korrekt berechnet sein' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglichen die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als traditionelle Schleifenkonstrukte.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Preise zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Manuelle Berechnung für Vergleich (oder Mock-Daten)
    DATA lt_sflights_aa TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_aa WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_expected_aa) = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR f IN lt_sflights_aa NEXT s = s + f-price ).

    DATA lt_sflights_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_lh) = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR f IN lt_sflights_lh NEXT s = s + f-price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price_aa
      exp = lv_expected_aa
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AA sollte korrekt sein' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price_lh
      exp = lv_expected_lh
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte korrekt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine funktionale und deklarative Weise. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei komplexen Berechnungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl verfügbarer Sitze. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc < iv_min_seats " Assuming seatsocc is occupied seats, so available = seatsmax - seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    " Check if all filtered flights match criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsocc < 100 )
        msg = 'Sollte weniger als 100 belegte Sitze haben' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a carrier that might not exist or have no matching flights
    DATA(lt_no_flights) = lo_cut->get_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_seats = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_no_flights )
      msg = 'Sollte keine Flüge für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft finden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine prägnante und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Table Filtering, sflights

CLASS zcl_time_chart_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Status eines Auftrags (z.B. 'Offen', 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen') basierend auf einem numerischen Code und einem booleschen Flag (z.B. `is_urgent`) zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_order_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
        ib_is_urgent   TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 1 AND ib_is_urgent = abap_true THEN 'Dringend Offen'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Offen'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 3 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                       ELSE 'Unbekannt'
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_order_status_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_order_status_text( iv_status_code = 1 ib_is_urgent = abap_false )
      exp = 'Offen'
      msg = 'Status 1, nicht dringend' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_order_status_text( iv_status_code = 1 ib_is_urgent = abap_true )
      exp = 'Dringend Offen'

Instructions: Zeigen Sie den Quellcode eines beliebigen ABAP-Programms in einem `cl_gui_abapedit`-Control auf einem Dynpro an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_abapedit` in Kombination mit `cl_gui_custom_container` und der Methode `set_text_as_r3table`. Benötigt ein Dynpro (z.B. 100) mit einem Custom Control namens 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
solution:
REPORT z_abapedit_display.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.

PARAMETERS: p_prog TYPE progname DEFAULT 'Z_ABAPEDIT_DISPLAY'.

CALL SCREEN 100.

MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'TITLE100'.

  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. "Name des Custom Controls auf Dynpro 100

    CREATE OBJECT go_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE string_table( ).
    READ REPORT p_prog INTO lt_source.

    go_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        table = lt_source
    ).
    go_editor->set_readonly_mode( cl_gui_abapedit=>true ).
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

Instructions: Erfassen Sie den vom Benutzer im `cl_gui_abapedit`-Control eingegebenen Text und speichern Sie ihn in einer internen Tabelle.

REPORT z_abapedit_get_text.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
DATA: gt_editor_content TYPE string_table.

CALL SCREEN 100.

MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'TITLE100'.

  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT go_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container.

    " Initial content for demonstration
    gt_editor_content = VALUE string_table( ( 'LINE 1: Edit this text.' ) ( 'LINE 2: And save it.' ) ).
    go_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        table = gt_editor_content
    ).
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      go_editor->get_text_as_r3table(
        IMPORTING
          table = gt_editor_content
      ).
      MESSAGE 'Content saved to internal table!' TYPE 'S'.
      " For demonstration, you could display gt_editor_content here
      " e.g., by looping and writing to screen.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_text.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
    DATA: lt_initial_content TYPE string_table,
          lt_retrieved_content TYPE string_table.

    lt_initial_content = VALUE string_table( ( 'Test Line 1' ) ( 'Test Line 2' ) ).

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_GET'.

          EXPORTING

        lo_editor->set_text_as_r3table(

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) in ein CSV-formatiertes XSTRING, das für den Download bereit ist. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` für die Kodierung und String-Templates (`&&`) sowie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die CSV-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " Header row
    lv_csv_string = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Data rows using modern ABAP features
    lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
      REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``

CLASS zcl_conv_iso_encoding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS convert_string_to_iso_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring

CLASS zcl_conv_iso_encoding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_iso_xstring.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_json_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,

    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string.

      EXPORTING
        data        = it_sflights

      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_string

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_json_string ).
