Instructions: Laden Sie den Inhalt eines ABAP-Programms dynamisch in ein `cl_gui_abapedit`-Control und ermöglichen Sie die Bearbeitung, aber nur für bestimmte Zeilen.

REPORT z_abapedit_partial_edit.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.

    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT go_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE string_table( ).
    READ REPORT p_prog INTO lt_source.

    go_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        table = lt_source
    ).

    " Example: Make line 3 editable, others read-only
    " Note: Direct line-specific read-only is complex. Often, it's all or nothing,
    " or requires custom event handling to prevent changes. For simplicity,
    " this example focuses on setting the whole editor to read-only and
    " a conceptual idea for partial edit (which might need more advanced features or workarounds).
    go_editor->set_readonly_mode( cl_gui_abapedit=>true ).
    " To truly enable partial editing, one would typically need to handle DATA_CHANGED
    " and revert changes if they are outside allowed lines, or use a more advanced editor control.
    " The ABAP Editor control itself doesn't easily support mixed read/write lines.
    " This example demonstrates loading and setting read-only for the whole content.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

    lt_test_code = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Line 1: Read-only' )
      ( 'Line 2: Read-only' )
      ( 'Line 3: Editable' )
    ).

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING

        lo_editor->set_text_as_r3table( EXPORTING table = lt_test_code ).
        lo_editor->set_readonly_mode( cl_gui_abapedit=>true ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
          act = lo_editor,

        ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` in ein XSTRING, das als XML-Dokument formatiert ist, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_obj` und `cl_abap_xml_serializer`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_xml_serializer` zur XML-Serialisierung und `cl_abap_conv_obj` zur Kodierung in XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_xml_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_xml_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_xml_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_xml_xstring.
    DATA: lv_xml_string TYPE string.

    cl_abap_xml_serializer=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = it_sflights
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        xml         = lv_xml_string
    ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_xml_string ).
    rv_xml_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xml_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xml_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_itab_to_xml_xstr( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_conv_itab_to_xml_xstr=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml_string) = 
      '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<asx:abap xmlns:asx="http://www.sap.com/abapxml" version="1.0">
  <asx:values>
    <IT_SFLIGHTS>
      <item>
        <CARRID>LH</CARRID>
        <CONNID>0400</CONNID>
        <FLDATE>20250101</FLDATE>
        <PRICE>100.00</PRICE>
        <CURRENCY>EUR</CURRENCY>
      </item>
    </IT_SFLIGHTS>
  </asx:values>
</asx:abap>'.

    DATA(lo_conv_exp) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv_exp->write( EXPORTING data = lv_expected_xml_string ).
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = lo_conv_exp->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_sflight_to_xml_xstring( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_xstring,

In Kombination mit `cl_abap_conv_obj` zur UTF-8-Kodierung in ein XSTRING ist dies der moderne und robuste Ansatz, um ABAP-Daten für die Kommunikation mit XML-basierten Schnittstellen vorzubereiten.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein `cl_gui_abapedit`-Control, das eine Fehlermeldung anzeigt, wenn der Benutzer versucht, eine leere Zeile zu speichern.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `DATA_CHANGED`-Event und die Methode `get_text_as_r3table` in Kombination mit modernen Tabellenoperationen wie `FILTER` oder `LINES`.
solution:
REPORT z_abapedit_empty_line_check.

DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      on_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_abapedit
        IMPORTING
          sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_data_changed.
    DATA(lt_current_content) = VALUE string_table( ).
    sender->get_text_as_r3table( IMPORTING table = lt_current_content ).

    " Check for empty lines using modern ABAP
    DATA(lv_empty_lines_exist) = abap_false.
    IF lines( lt_current_content ) > 0.
      DATA(lt_non_empty_lines) = FILTER string_table( lt_current_content WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL ).
      IF lines( lt_non_empty_lines ) < lines( lt_current_content ).
        lv_empty_lines_exist = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_empty_lines_exist = abap_true.
      MESSAGE 'Leere Zeilen sind nicht erlaubt!' TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

DATA: go_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

CALL SCREEN 100.

MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'TITLE100'.

  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT go_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_container.

    CREATE OBJECT go_event_handler.
    SET HANDLER go_event_handler->on_data_changed FOR go_editor.

    go_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        table = VALUE string_table( ( 'Erste Zeile' ) ( '' ) ( 'Dritte Zeile' ) ) 
    ).
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_empty_line_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_empty_line_check.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit,
          lo_handler   TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler. " Assuming lcl_event_handler is globally defined for test
    DATA: lt_content_with_empty TYPE string_table,
          lt_content_no_empty TYPE string_table.

    lt_content_with_empty = VALUE string_table( ( 'Line 1' ) ( '' ) ( 'Line 3' ) ).
    lt_content_no_empty = VALUE string_table( ( 'Line 1' ) ( 'Line 2' ) ).

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_EMPTY_CHECK'.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_editor
          EXPORTING
            parent = lo_container.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_handler.
        SET HANDLER lo_handler->on_data_changed FOR lo_editor.

        " Simulate setting content with empty line
        lo_editor->set_text_as_r3table( EXPORTING table = lt_content_with_empty ).
        " In a real scenario, the event would trigger and the message would appear.
        " Here, we can only assert that the setup is correct.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_editor ).

        " Simulate setting content without empty line
        lo_editor->set_text_as_r3table( EXPORTING table = lt_content_no_empty ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_editor ).

      CATCH cx_gui_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'GUI error during object creation or setup' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Event-Handling mit modernen ABAP-Tabellenoperationen. Der `DATA_CHANGED`-Event wird genutzt, um auf Änderungen im Editor zu reagieren. Innerhalb des Handlers wird mit `FILTER` und `LINES` effizient geprüft, ob leere Zeilen vorhanden sind. Dies demonstriert eine moderne und performante Art der Validierung von Benutzereingaben in GUI-Controls.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen großen String in ein XSTRING in Chunks, um Speicher zu sparen, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_obj`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` mit `write_chunk` und `get_buffer_chunk`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_large_str_chunk DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_large_string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_large_string TYPE string
        iv_chunk_size   TYPE i DEFAULT 10000 " in characters
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_large_str_chunk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_large_string_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = 0.
    DATA(lv_remaining_length) = xstrlen( iv_large_string ).

    DO.
      lv_length = MIN( iv_chunk_size, lv_remaining_length ).
      IF lv_length = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_chunk) = substring( val = iv_large_string off = lv_offset len = lv_length ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_chunk ).

      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_length.
      lv_remaining_length = lv_remaining_length - lv_length.

    ENDDO.

    rv_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chunk_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chunk_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_large_str_chunk( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'A' && REPEAT( val = 'B' occ = 9999 ) && 'C'. "10001 characters
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_large_string_to_xstring( lv_test_string ).

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_large_string_to_xstring( iv_large_string = lv_test_string iv_chunk_size = 5000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_xstring,
      exp = lv_expected_xstring,
      msg = 'Chunked conversion failed'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_xstring_small_chunk) = lo_cut->convert_large_string_to_xstring( iv_large_string = lv_test_string iv_chunk_size = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_xstring_small_chunk,
      exp = lv_expected_xstring,
      msg = 'Small chunked conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für sehr große Datenmengen kann es in ABAP sinnvoll sein, Daten in kleineren 'Chunks' zu verarbeiten, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Obwohl `cl_abap_conv_obj` intern Puffer verwaltet, demonstriert dieses Beispiel, wie man einen String manuell in Teilen an den Konverter übergibt. Dies ist besonders relevant, wenn der ursprüngliche String selbst schon sehr groß ist und man eine schrittweise Verarbeitung erzwingen möchte, bevor das gesamte Ergebnis abgerufen wird.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_obj, XSTRING, Streaming, Large Data, Memory Optimization, UTF-8

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight`, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Sammeln Sie die Flugnummern und Fluggesellschaften in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #( ... )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                              WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND
                                      flDate > sy-datum )
                              ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'No future flights found, check test data or current date.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` um Daten aus der `sflight`-Tabelle zu filtern und direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle zu transformieren. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: TABLES, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflight, Data Transformation, Filtering

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                               flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'No flight counts found, check test data.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flights) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    IF ls_lh_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_lh_flights-flight_count >= 0
        msg = 'LH should have non-negative flights.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` kann das Ergebnis direkt in eine neue Tabelle transformiert werden, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: TABLES, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflight, Grouping

Instructions: Finden Sie den Abflugort des Fluges mit der Flugnummer '0017' der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflight` und geben Sie diesen zurück. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`[...]`) und den Chaining-Operator (`->`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_city_from
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_cityfrom) TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_from.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rv_cityfrom = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityfrom.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_cityfrom = 'NOT FOUND'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_city_from FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_city_from.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_city) = lo_cut->get_city_from( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_city exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    lv_city = lo_cut->get_city_from( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_city exp = 'NOT FOUND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`[...]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle mittels Schlüssel oder Index. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um auf einzelne Datensätze zuzugreifen, und ersetzt oft `READ TABLE`.
keywords: TABLES, Table Expression, Internal Tables, sflight, Chaining, READ TABLE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight` mit dem Status 'X'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_pass) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_pass = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  WHERE ( seatsocc > 0 ) 
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_total >= 0
      msg = 'Total passengers should be non-negative.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Zeilen iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr lesbare Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflight, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Nachricht für einen Flug aus `sflight`, die die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Abflugort enthält. Verwenden Sie String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie Backticks (`` ` ``) und Ausdrücke in geschweiften Klammern (`{}`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_string_tmpl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_string_tmpl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_description.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode zur Berechnung der Flugdauer in Stunden für einen gegebenen Flug aus `sflight` bereitstellt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Datums-/Zeitfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` oder direkte Zeitberechnung mit `TIMS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_duration_hours
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_duration_hours) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_duration_hours.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_dep_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_fldate iv_time = ls_flight-deptime ).
      DATA(lv_arr_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_fldate iv_time = ls_flight-arrtime ).

      DATA(lv_diff_secs) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( iv_tstmp1 = lv_arr_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_dep_tstmp ).
      rv_duration_hours = lv_diff_secs / 3600.
    ELSE.
      rv_duration_hours = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Spaltennamen und -typen einer internen Tabelle, die auf der Struktur von `sflight` basiert, und geben Sie diese aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_info.
    TYPES tt_column_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_table_metadata
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_metadata) TYPE tt_column_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_table_metadata.
    DATA: lt_sflight_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight_dummy ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_metadata = VALUE #( FOR component IN lt_components
                               ( name = component-name,
                                 type = component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_check msg = 'Inserted flight should be found.' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Beschreiben Sie konzeptionell, wie `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` verwendet werden könnte, um Flugrouten aus `sflight` auf einer 2D-Karte darzustellen. Die Lösung soll die Interaktion mit dem Control skizzieren, ohne eine vollständige GUI-Implementierung zu liefern.
hint: Das Control benötigt Daten in einem spezifischen Format und wird über Methoden gesteuert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_viewer_concept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_routes_concept
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_viewer_concept IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_routes_concept.
    " Dies ist ein konzeptionelles Beispiel, keine lauffähige GUI-Implementierung.
    " Die tatsächliche Implementierung würde ein Dynpro oder Web Dynpro erfordern.

    " 1. Erzeugung des 2D-Viewers (im PBO eines Dynpros)
    " DATA: go_ecl_2dviewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
    " CREATE OBJECT go_ecl_2dviewer EXPORTING parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen.

    " 2. Datenaufbereitung für den Viewer
    " Der 2D-Viewer erwartet Daten in einem spezifischen Format, z.B. als XML oder interne Tabellen
    " für Punkte, Linien oder Polygone, die auf einer Karte dargestellt werden sollen.
    " Hier würden die Flugdaten (Abflug-/Ankunftsorte) in Koordinaten umgewandelt und
    " als Linien (Flugrouten) aufbereitet.
    DATA: lt_viewer_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    APPEND `Konzeptionelle Daten für Flugrouten:` TO lt_viewer_data.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }: { ls_flight-cityfrom } -> { ls_flight-cityto }| TO lt_viewer_data.
      " Beispiel: Umwandlung von Städtenamen in Geo-Koordinaten (nicht Teil dieser Lösung)
      " DATA(lv_lat_from) = get_latitude( ls_flight-cityfrom ).
      " DATA(lv_lon_from) = get_longitude( ls_flight-cityfrom ).
      " DATA(lv_lat_to) = get_latitude( ls_flight-cityto ).
      " DATA(lv_lon_to) = get_longitude( ls_flight-cityto ).
      " APPEND |<LINE x1='{lv_lon_from}' y1='{lv_lat_from}' x2='{lv_lon_to}' y2='{lv_lat_to}' />| TO lt_viewer_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 3. Laden der Daten in den Viewer
    " go_ecl_2dviewer->load_data( i_data = lt_viewer_data ).

    " 4. Aktualisierung und Anzeige des Viewers
    " go_ecl_2dviewer->set_display_mode( i_mode = 'MAP' ).
    " go_ecl_2dviewer->refresh( ).

    " In einem realen Szenario würde die Ausgabe im Viewer erfolgen, nicht über WRITE.
    WRITE: / 'Konzeptionelle Darstellung der Flugrouten im 2D-Viewer:' COLOR 4.
    LOOP AT lt_viewer_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      WRITE: / lv_line.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    lo_cut->display_flight_routes_concept( it_flights = lt_flights ).

CLASS zcl_dat_date_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_external_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_external_date TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_internal_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_date_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_external_date.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        rv_internal_date = lo_datfm->ext_2_date( iv_external_date ).
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_invalid_date.
        " Handle error: invalid date format
        rv_internal_date = '00000000'. " Or raise a custom exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` darstellt. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine GUI-Klasse ist und einen Container benötigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und `cl_gui_custom_container`. Datenaufbereitung mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gra_bar_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_bar_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart_engine) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gra_bar_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_bar_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE tt_flight_data.

    " 1. Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen und aggregieren
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_chart_data.

    " 2. GUI Container erstellen (Dummy für Unit Test, im echten Szenario an Dynpro gebunden)
    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Chart Engine instanziieren
    ro_chart_engine = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 4. Chart-Typ setzen
    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).

    " 5. Daten an Chart Engine übergeben
    DATA(lt_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series( ).
    DATA(ls_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_series( ).
    DATA(lt_data_points) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_points( ).

    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_point(
        value = ls_flight-count
        label = ls_flight-carrid
      ) TO lt_data_points.
    ENDLOOP.

    ls_data_series-data_points = lt_data_points.
    ls_data_series-label = 'Anzahl Flüge'.
    APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.

    ro_chart_engine->set_data_series( lt_data_series ).

    " 6. Titel setzen
    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).

    " 7. Chart anzeigen (im echten Szenario würde dies in einem Dynpro geschehen)
    " ro_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gra_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multi_series_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart_engine) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gra_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_series_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lt_occupancy TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.

    " 1. Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen
    SELECT fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS " Für Demo-Zwecke begrenzen
      INTO TABLE @lt_occupancy.

    " 2. GUI Container erstellen
    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Chart Engine instanziieren
    ro_chart_engine = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 4. Chart-Typ setzen (Liniendiagramm)
    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).

    " 5. Daten für mehrere Reihen aufbereiten
    DATA(lt_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series( ).
    DATA(lt_data_points_occ) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_points( ).
    DATA(lt_data_points_max) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_points( ).

    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_occupancy).
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_point(
        value = ls_occupancy-seatsocc
        label = |{ ls_occupancy-fldate DATE = USER }|
      ) TO lt_data_points_occ.
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_point(
        value = ls_occupancy-seatsmax
        label = |{ ls_occupancy-fldate DATE = USER }|
      ) TO lt_data_points_max.
    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_gra_chart_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_chart_to_png.
    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine(
      i_parent = lo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).

    " Dummy-Daten für das Diagramm
    DATA(lt_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series(
      ( label = 'Dummy Data'
        data_points = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_points(
          ( value = 10 label = 'A' )
          ( value = 20 label = 'B' )
        )
      )
    ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_series( lt_data_series ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Exportiertes Diagramm' ).

    TRY.
        lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ). " Muss vor dem Export gezeichnet werden
        lo_chart_engine->export_to_file(
          i_filename = iv_file_path
          i_filetype = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_filetype_png
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_gui_error cx_gui_exception.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simuliere den Zugriff auf Daten basierend auf der Data Aging Session-Temperatur. Wenn die Temperatur 'HOT' ist, sollen alle Daten gelesen werden, sonst nur 'WARM' Daten (hier simuliert durch eine Bedingung).
hint: Kombiniere `get_temperature` mit einer bedingten Logik, um das Verhalten zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simulate_da_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_data_based_on_temp
      IMPORTING
        iv_da_object TYPE daag_object_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data_read) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simulate_da_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_data_based_on_temp.
    DATA(lo_da_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_temp) = lo_da_temp->get_temperature( ).

    IF lv_current_temp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>daag_temp_hot.
      rv_data_read = |Alle Daten für { iv_da_object } gelesen (HOT-Zugriff)|.
    ELSEIF lv_current_temp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>daag_temp_warm.
      rv_data_read = |Nur WARME Daten für { iv_da_object } gelesen (WARM-Zugriff)|.
    ELSE.
      rv_data_read = |Keine Daten für { iv_da_object } gelesen (COLD-Zugriff oder Standard)|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_data_hot FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_data_warm FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_data_cold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_data_hot.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simulate_da_access( ).
    DATA(lo_da_temp_setter) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_original_temp) = lo_da_temp_setter->get_temperature( ).

    lo_da_temp_setter->set_temperature( cl_abap_session_temperature=>daag_temp_hot ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->read_data_based_on_temp( 'FLIGHT_DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Alle Daten für FLIGHT_DATA gelesen (HOT-Zugriff)'
    ).

    lo_da_temp_setter->set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).

  METHOD test_read_data_warm.

    DATA(lo_da_temp_setter) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).

    lo_da_temp_setter->set_temperature( cl_abap_session_temperature=>daag_temp_warm ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->read_data_based_on_temp( 'FLIGHT_DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Nur WARME Daten für FLIGHT_DATA gelesen (WARM-Zugriff)'
    ).

    lo_da_temp_setter->set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_data_cold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simulate_da_access( ).
    DATA(lo_da_temp_setter) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_original_temp) = lo_da_temp_setter->get_temperature( ).

    lo_da_temp_setter->set_temperature( cl_abap_session_temperature=>daag_temp_cold ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->read_data_based_on_temp( 'FLIGHT_DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Keine Daten für FLIGHT_DATA gelesen (COLD-Zugriff oder Standard)'
    ).

    lo_da_temp_setter->set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Je nach eingestellter Session-Temperatur kann das Programm entscheiden, welche Daten (z.B. alle, nur warme, keine) gelesen werden sollen, was für Data Aging Szenarien relevant ist.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hash eines sehr langen Strings, indem Sie ihn in Chunks verarbeiten, um Speicher zu sparen. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features wie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `update` und `get_hash_value` der Klasse `cl_abap_message_digest` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_large_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256_large_string IMPORTING iv_long_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_hash_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_large_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_large_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chunk_size TYPE i VALUE 1024. " 1KB chunks

    DATA(lo_message_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_instance(
      i_algorithm = if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
    ).

    " Split the string into chunks and update the hash incrementally
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = xstrlen( iv_long_string ).

    DO.
      DATA(lv_current_chunk_len) = MIN( val1 = lc_chunk_size val2 = lv_length - lv_offset ).
      IF lv_current_chunk_len = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_chunk) = iv_long_string+lv_offset(lv_current_chunk_len).
      lo_message_digest->update( lv_chunk ).

      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_current_chunk_len.
    ENDDO.

    rv_hash_xstring = lo_message_digest->get_hash_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_large_string( ).
    DATA(lv_long_string) = REDUCE string(

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_sha256_large_string( lv_small_string ).

explanation: Für sehr große Datenmengen ist es oft nicht praktikabel, den gesamten Inhalt in den Speicher zu laden. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Hash-Wert einer internen Tabelle von Strings, indem Sie die Strings zuerst zu einem einzigen String verketten. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Verkettung und `cl_abap_message_digest` für den Hash.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `CONCATENATE` Operator, um die Tabelle zu einem String zu reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hash_for_table IMPORTING it_strings TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_hash_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hash_for_table.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR wa IN it_strings
      NEXT s = s && wa
    ).

    DATA(lo_message_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_instance(
      i_algorithm = if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
    ).
    rv_hash_xstring = lo_message_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_concatenated_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Hash-Wert einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen (z.B. `sflights`), indem Sie die Daten zeilenweise zu einem String serialisieren und dann hashen. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife, um die Strukturfelder zu einem String zu verketten, und dann `cl_abap_message_digest`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_struct_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hash_for_sflight IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_hash_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_struct_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hash_for_sflight.
    DATA(lv_serialized_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
      NEXT s = s && |
        { ls_sflight-carrid }{ ls_sflight-connid }{ ls_sflight-fldate }{ ls_sflight-price }
      |
    ).

    DATA(lo_message_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_instance(
      i_algorithm = if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
    ).
    rv_hash_xstring = lo_message_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_serialized_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_hash_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_hash_empty_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hash_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_struct_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE zcl_hash_struct_table=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251123' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251124' price = '250.50' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_serialized) = |
        LH40020251123100.00
        AA00120251124250.50
      |.
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_instance( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 )->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_expected_serialized ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_hash_for_sflight( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = to_upper( lv_actual_hash )
      exp = to_upper( lv_expected_hash )
      msg = 'Hash of serialized sflight table should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hash_empty_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hash_struct_table( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_sflight) = VALUE zcl_hash_struct_table=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_serialized) = ''.
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_instance( if_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 )->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_expected_serialized ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_hash_for_sflight( lt_empty_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = to_upper( lv_actual_hash )
      exp = to_upper( lv_expected_hash )
      msg = 'Hash of empty string from empty sflight table should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Integrität einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen (hier `sflights`) überprüfen kann. Durch die Serialisierung der Daten in einen String mittels `REDUCE` und String-Templates (ABAP 7.50+) und anschließendes Hashing mit `cl_abap_message_digest` kann jede Änderung an den Tabellendaten erkannt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Audit-Trails oder die Sicherstellung der Datenkonsistenz.
keywords: cl_abap_message_digest, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Structures, sflights, SHA256, Hash, String Templates

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_file.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'Line 1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Line 2'.
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_text_file(
      i_filename = lc_test_file
      i_content  = lv_content
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_read_lines( ).
    DATA(lt_lines) = lo_cut->read_file_lines( lc_test_file ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_lines ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lc_test_file ). " Clean up

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` mit der Methode `match` und greifen Sie auf die Gruppen über `get_group` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_named_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_data,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_data.
    TYPES: tt_extracted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_named_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_extracted_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_named_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_named_groups.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
      pattern = iv_pattern
      text    = iv_text
    ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      TRY.
          APPEND VALUE ty_extracted_data( name = 'Name' value = lo_matcher->get_group( 'name' ) ) TO rt_data.
          APPEND VALUE ty_extracted_data( name = 'Value' value = lo_matcher->get_group( 'value' ) ) TO rt_data.
        CATCH cx_abap_matcher_error.
          " Handle error if group name not found
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_bukrs    TYPE bukrs

      IMPORTING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die verfügbaren Sitze aus SFLIGHT enthält, wobei die verfügbaren Sitze als Differenz zwischen MAX_SEATS und OCC_SEATS berechnet werden. Nutzen Sie dabei FOR-Iteratoren und VALUE-Konstruktor-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) und berechnen Sie die Differenz direkt im Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             avail_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        connid      = ls_flight-connid
        avail_seats = ls_flight-max_seats - ls_flight-occ_seats ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'Summary table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-carrid msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-connid msg = 'Connid should not be initial' ).
      " We cannot assert the exact value of avail_seats without knowing the SFLIGHT data
      " but we can check if it's a non-negative number.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_summary-avail_seats >= 0 ) msg = 'Available seats should be non-negative' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus FOR-Iteratoren und VALUE-Konstruktor-Ausdrücken ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Wartbarkeit.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Statusmeldung für einen Flug aus SFLIGHT. Wenn der Flug ausgebucht ist (MAX_SEATS = OCC_SEATS), soll 'Ausgebucht' angezeigt werden, ansonsten 'Verfügbar'. Nutzen Sie String Templates und den COND-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie String Templates mit { COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) }
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT SINGLE max_seats, occ_seats
      FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_status_text = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid }: { 
        COND string(
          WHEN ls_flight_data-max_seats = ls_flight_data-occ_seats THEN 'Ausgebucht'
          ELSE 'Verfügbar'
        )
      }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_status_text = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid }: Nicht gefunden|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_occ_seats = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum_occ_seats = sum_occ_seats + ls_flight-occ_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_operator FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_operator_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total >= 0 ) msg = 'Total occupied seats should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_operator_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total occupied seats for non-existent airline should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung zusammenzufassen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Math, sflight

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und mit einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_avail_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( max_seats - occ_seats ) >= iv_min_avail_seats 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_operator FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_operator_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_avail_seats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_filtered ) >= 0 ) msg = 'Filtered table should not dump' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrid should be AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-max_seats - ls_flight-occ_seats >= 100 ) msg = 'Available seats should be at least 100' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_operator_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_avail_seats = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Filtered table for non-existent airline should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu LOOP AT ... WHERE und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, sflight

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining und Constructor Expressions, indem Sie eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt ausführen oder Objekte kompakt erstellen.
hint: Methoden, die SELF-Referenzen zurückgeben, ermöglichen Chaining. Nutzen Sie NEW #( ... ) für Constructor Expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.

    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_constructor_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_obj->set_value( 5 )->add_value( 3 )->get_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 msg = 'Method chaining should work correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_constructor_expression.
    DATA(lo_obj_ce) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( mv_value = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj_ce->get_value( ) exp = 10 msg = 'Constructor expression should initialize value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Kettenaufrufe) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer Zeile verkettet werden. Constructor Expressions (Konstruktor-Ausdrücke) ermöglichen die direkte Initialisierung von Objekten bei der Erstellung, was den Code ebenfalls vereinfacht und die Notwendigkeit separater SET-Methoden reduziert.
keywords: Method Chaining, Constructor Expression, NEW, Object Orientation

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Meldungen eines zuvor gespeicherten Anwendungslogs aus und zeigen Sie diese an. Nutzen Sie cl_bal_logobj.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_bal_logobj=>get_log und die Methoden GET_MESSAGES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_display_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_display_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_logobj=>get_log( iv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    IF lt_messages IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Meldungen für Log Handle { iv_log_handle }:| ).
      LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Typ: { ls_message-msgty }, ID: { ls_message-msgid }, Nr: { ls_message-msgno }, Text: { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 } { ls_message-msgv3 } { ls_message-msgv4 }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Keine Meldungen für Log Handle { iv_log_handle } gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_log FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_empty_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_log.
    " First, create a log to read
    DATA(lo_create_log) = NEW zcl_log_simple( ).
    lo_create_log->create_and_save_log( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = cl_bal_logobj=>get_last_log_handle( ).

    DATA(lo_read_log) = NEW zcl_log_read( ).
    lo_read_log->read_and_display_log( lv_log_handle ).

    " Assert that messages were retrieved (indirectly, by checking if the log handle is valid)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_log_handle msg = 'Log handle should be valid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_empty_log.
    DATA(lo_read_log) = NEW zcl_log_read( ).
    " Use a non-existent log handle
    lo_read_log->read_and_display_log( '00000000000000000000000000000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Reading an empty log should not dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Auslesen von Anwendungslogs ist entscheidend für die Fehleranalyse und das Monitoring. cl_bal_logobj bietet mit get_log und get_messages eine einfache und standardisierte Schnittstelle, um auf gespeicherte Log-Informationen zuzugreifen.
keywords: cl_bal_logobj, Application Log, Read Log, GET_MESSAGES

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer hochgeladenen XLSX-Datei in eine interne Tabelle ein. Die Datei enthält Flugdaten (Carrid, Connid, Fldate).
hint: Nutzen Sie cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_document_from_xstring und get_itab_from_sheet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_import DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_upload,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_upload.
    TYPES tt_flight_upload TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_upload WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS import_xlsx_to_itab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_uploaded_flights) TYPE tt_flight_upload.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_import IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD import_xlsx_to_itab.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_filename TYPE string VALUE 'flights_upload.xlsx'.

    " For demonstration, simulate a file upload
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename   = lv_filename
        filetype   = 'BIN'
      IMPORTING
        filelength = DATA(lv_filelength)
        filecontent = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Upload fehlgeschlagen' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_document_from_xstring( lv_xstring ).
    lo_xlsx->get_itab_from_sheet(
      EXPORTING
        i_sheet_name = 'Sheet1'
      IMPORTING
        e_table      = rt_uploaded_flights
    ).

    cl_demo_output=>display( |{ lines( rt_uploaded_flights ) } Zeilen aus { lv_filename } importiert.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_import_xlsx FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_import_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_import( ).
    " This test requires manual interaction for file upload or a mocked GUI_UPLOAD.
    " For simplicity, we assert that the method call does not dump.
    DATA(lt_uploaded) = lo_cut->import_xlsx_to_itab( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'XLSX import should not dump' ).
    " Further assertions would require a known test file to be uploaded.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: cl_ehfnd_xlsx ermöglicht nicht nur den Export, sondern auch den Import von Daten aus XLSX-Dateien. Die Methode get_itab_from_sheet ist hierbei zentral, um die Daten eines Arbeitsblatts direkt in eine passende interne Tabelle zu überführen.
keywords: cl_ehfnd_xlsx, XLSX, Import, Upload, cl_gui_frontend_services

solution:

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_tables.
    DATA(lt_table1) = VALUE ty_data_tt( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ( id = 2 text = 'B' ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `APPEND LINES OF` ist die moderne und effizienteste Methode, um alle Zeilen einer internen Tabelle an eine andere anzuhängen. Es ist performanter als das Schleifen über die Quelltabelle und das einzelne Anhängen jeder Zeile.
keywords: Internal Tables, APPEND LINES OF, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle zu einer Zieltabelle hinzu, aber nur, wenn sie eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH').
hint: Kombinieren Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_append
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_carrier        TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_append.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_source_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_filter_and_append FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_append.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_append( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_append( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Zeilen für LH enthalten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck ist eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu extrahieren. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen, was in Kombination mit der Zuweisung direkt die gewünschte Zieltabelle füllt. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer als eine explizite Schleife mit `IF` und `APPEND`.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Conditional Logic, Data Manipulation

CLASS zcl_itab_uuid_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_uuid_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_uuid_to_flights.
    rt_flights_with_uuid = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    ( uuid   = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16()
                                      carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid
                                      fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_uuid.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_uuid_add( ).

    ENDLOOP.

    " Überprüfen, ob UUIDs eindeutig sind (für kleine Mengen)
    DATA(lt_uuids) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_entry IN lt_flights_with_uuid ( cl_system_uuid=>if_system_uuid~uuid_x16_to_string( ls_entry-uuid ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_unique_uuids) = lines( lt_uuids ).
    SORT lt_uuids BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_uuids.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_uuids exp = lines( lt_uuids ) msg = 'Alle generierten UUIDs sollten eindeutig sein' ).

explanation: Der `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und weisen Sie jeder Gruppe eine eindeutige UUID zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_uuid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             group_uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           ty_flight_group_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_flight_group_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_uuid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(ls_group_entry) = VALUE ty_flight_group(
        group_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16()
        carrid     = ls_group_key-carrid
        flights    = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key ( <fs_flight> ) )
      ).
      APPEND ls_group_entry TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_uuid( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_grouped ) msg = 'Sollte gruppierte Daten enthalten' ).
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_group-group_uuid msg = 'Jede Gruppe sollte eine UUID haben' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_group-carrid msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( ls_group-flights ) msg = 'Flüge in der Gruppe sollten nicht leer sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_group-carrid exp = lv_prev_carrid msg = 'Gruppen sollten nach Fluggesellschaft sortiert sein' ).
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_group-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist ein mächtiges Feature in modernem ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren. Hier wird für jede eindeutige Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) eine neue Gruppe gebildet. Innerhalb der Gruppe wird eine neue UUID generiert und alle zugehörigen Flüge gesammelt. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen direkt im Schleifenkonstrukt.
keywords: UUID, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, cl_system_uuid, sflight, Internal Tables

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle zu einer Zieltabelle hinzu, aber nur, wenn die Summe bestimmter numerischer Felder in der Zeile einen Schwellenwert überschreitet. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, der eine `COND` oder `FILTER` Klausel enthält, die wiederum `REDUCE` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value_item,
             val1 TYPE i,
             val2 TYPE i,
             val3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value_item,
           ty_value_item_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE ty_value_item_tt
        iv_threshold    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE ty_value_item_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_sum.
    rt_filtered_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_source_items
                                 WHERE ( REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR val IN ( ls_item-val1, ls_item-val2, ls_item-val3 ) NEXT sum = sum + val ) > iv_threshold )
                                 ( ls_item ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value_item,
             val1 TYPE i,
             val2 TYPE i,
             val3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value_item,
           ty_value_item_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_filter_by_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_sum.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE ty_value_item_tt(
      ( val1 = 1 val2 = 2 val3 = 3 ) " Sum = 6
      ( val1 = 5 val2 = 5 val3 = 5 ) " Sum = 15
      ( val1 = 1 val2 = 1 val3 = 1 ) " Sum = 3
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_append( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_sum( it_source_items = lt_source iv_threshold = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Sollte 1 Zeile filtern (Summe > 10)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-val1 exp = 5 ).

    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_by_sum( it_source_items = lt_source iv_threshold = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 msg = 'Sollte 3 Zeilen filtern (Summe > 2)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE` Ausdruck innerhalb einer `WHERE`-Bedingung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks. `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Operator, der es ermöglicht, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable durch Iteration über eine Datenmenge zu berechnen. Hier wird die Summe von `val1`, `val2` und `val3` für jede Zeile berechnet und dann gegen einen Schwellenwert geprüft. Nur Zeilen, die diese Bedingung erfüllen, werden in die Zieltabelle aufgenommen. Dies ist eine sehr fortgeschrittene und kompakte Art der Datenfilterung und -aggregation.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, FOR

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle zu einer Zieltabelle hinzu, wobei die Quelltabelle eine leere Schlüsseltabelle ist und die Zieltabelle eine Standardtabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel ist. Stellen Sie sicher, dass keine Duplikate hinzugefügt werden.

CLASS zcl_itab_append_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,

           ty_target_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_source_tt
      CHANGING
        ct_target_table TYPE ty_target_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_append_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_unique_lines.
    APPEND LINES OF it_source_table TO ct_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_source_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_target_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS test_append_unique FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_unique.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE ty_source_tt(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 1 text = 'Duplicate A' ) " This will be ignored
      ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE ty_target_tt(
      ( id = 4 text = 'Item D' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_append_unique( ).
    lo_cut->append_unique_lines( it_source_table = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 msg = 'Sollte 4 eindeutige Zeilen enthalten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 1 ]-text exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Erster Eintrag für ID 1 sollte beibehalten werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 2 ]-text exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 3 ]-text exp = 'Item C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 4 ]-text exp = 'Item D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wenn `APPEND LINES OF` auf eine interne Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel angewendet wird, werden Duplikate (basierend auf dem Schlüssel) automatisch ignoriert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und saubere Methode, um Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle zu integrieren und dabei die Eindeutigkeit der Zieltabelle zu gewährleisten, ohne manuelle Duplikatsprüfungen durchführen zu müssen.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine UUID und verwenden Sie diese in einem String Template, um einen Dateinamen zu erstellen.

CLASS zcl_uuid_filename DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_uuid_filename IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
