ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_filename.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_filename( ).
    DATA(lv_filename) = lo_cut->generate_filename( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_filename msg = 'Dateiname sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_filename exp = 'report_' msg = 'Dateiname sollte den Präfix enthalten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_filename exp = '_data.txt' msg = 'Dateiname sollte den Suffix enthalten' ).
    " Überprüfen, ob der UUID-Teil 32 Zeichen lang ist
    DATA(lv_uuid_part) = substring( val = lv_filename off = 7 len = 32 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_uuid_part ) exp = 32 msg = 'UUID-Teil sollte 32 Zeichen lang sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die praktische Anwendung von `cl_system_uuid` und String Templates zur Erstellung eindeutiger Dateinamen. Die generierte UUID wird direkt in das String Template eingefügt, um einen dynamischen und konfliktfreien Dateinamen zu erzeugen. Dies ist nützlich für temporäre Dateien, Protokolle oder andere Szenarien, die eindeutige Bezeichner erfordern.
keywords: UUID, String Templates, cl_system_uuid, File Naming

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary,
           ty_carrier_summary_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_carrier_summary_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data UP TO 20 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT count = count + 1 ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
        carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
        total_flights = lv_total_flights
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carrier_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) msg = 'Zusammenfassung sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob LH Flüge hat
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-total_flights msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_flights > 0 msg = 'Anzahl der LH Flüge sollte größer als 0 sein' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Prüfen, ob alle Einträge eine positive Fluganzahl haben
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_entry-total_flights > 0 msg = 'Jede Fluggesellschaft sollte eine positive Fluganzahl haben' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE` Ausdruck zur Aggregation von Daten. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe zu zählen (`count = count + 1`). Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um Aggregationen wie Summen, Zählungen oder Min/Max-Werte direkt während der Gruppierung zu berechnen.
keywords: Internal Tables, Data Aggregation, REDUCE, LOOP AT GROUP BY, sflight

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle zu einer Zieltabelle hinzu, wobei die Quelltabelle eine leere Schlüsseltabelle ist und die Zieltabelle eine Hash-Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel ist. Stellen Sie sicher, dass keine Duplikate hinzugefügt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` und nutzen Sie die Eigenschaften des eindeutigen Schlüssels der Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_append_hash DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product,
           ty_source_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_target_tt TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS append_unique_products
      IMPORTING
        it_source_products TYPE ty_source_tt
      CHANGING
        ct_target_products TYPE ty_target_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_append_hash IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_unique_products.
    APPEND LINES OF it_source_products TO ct_target_products.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product,
           ty_source_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_target_tt TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS test_append_unique_hash FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_unique_hash.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE ty_source_tt(
      ( id = 'P001' name = 'Product A' )
      ( id = 'P002' name = 'Product B' )
      ( id = 'P001' name = 'Duplicate Product A' ) " This will be ignored
      ( id = 'P003' name = 'Product C' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE ty_target_tt(
      ( id = 'P004' name = 'Product D' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_append_hash( ).
    lo_cut->append_unique_products( it_source_products = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_products = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 msg = 'Sollte 4 eindeutige Produkte enthalten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 'P001' ]-name exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Erster Eintrag für ID P001 sollte beibehalten werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 'P002' ]-name exp = 'Product B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 'P003' ]-name exp = 'Product C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 'P004' ]-name exp = 'Product D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie bei sortierten Tabellen ignoriert `APPEND LINES OF` bei Hash-Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel automatisch Zeilen, deren Schlüssel bereits in der Zieltabelle existiert. Dies bietet eine sehr performante Möglichkeit, große Datenmengen zu konsolidieren und Duplikate zu vermeiden, da der Zugriff auf Hash-Tabellen sehr schnell ist.
keywords: Internal Tables, APPEND LINES OF, Hashed Table, Unique Key, Duplicates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit Flügen von 'SFLIGHTS', die nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' enthält und deren Preis um 10% erhöht ist. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Konstruktoren `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_adjusted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_adjusted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                            WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                            ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                              connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                              fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                              price    = ls_sflight-price * '1.1',
                              currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flights_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_adjusted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Initial check, as sflight might be empty or not contain LH

    " To make it more robust, insert test data if sflight is empty
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) ).
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.

      lt_result = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_adjusted_flights( ).
      DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price > 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE` und `FOR` Konstruktoren ermöglichen eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb von `FOR` dient als Filter, was den Code lesbarer und effizienter macht als traditionelle `LOOP` und `APPEND` mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der die Flugnummer, den Abflugort und den Zielort eines Fluges aus der Tabelle 'SFLIGHT' enthält. Verwenden Sie String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie Backticks (`) für String Templates und die Einbettung von Variablen mit `{}`, sowie Formatierungsoptionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_description.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_description = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_description = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_templates( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Insert test data
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->get_flight_description( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description exp = 'LH 0400' ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_templates( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->get_flight_description( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description exp = 'nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu konstruieren. Sie sind wesentlich lesbarer und flexibler als die Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE`. Variablen können direkt mit `{}` eingebettet und mit Formatierungsoptionen wie `DATE = USER` versehen werden.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf dem Flugpreis, ob ein Flug 'Günstig', 'Standard' oder 'Teuer' ist. Verwenden Sie einen `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen in einer Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN iv_price >= 200 AND iv_price < 500 THEN 'Standard'
      ELSE 'Teuer' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_categories FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categories.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( 150 ) exp = 'Günstig' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( 350 ) exp = 'Standard' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( 550 ) exp = 'Teuer' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_category( 200 ) exp = 'Standard' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, wenn ein Wert basierend auf Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er macht den Code kompakter und funktionaler.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gespeichert ist. Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit einem Feldsymbol.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE ls_data TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_assign_comp( ).
    DATA ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_assign_comp=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_test_data-field3 = 'World'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ) exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD3' ) exp = 'World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_assign_comp( ).
    DATA ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_assign_comp=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Test'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ) exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ist der Standardweg, um zur Laufzeit auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen. Dies ist unerlässlich für generische Programme oder wenn die Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) sind hierbei das zentrale Element für den dynamischen Zugriff.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Structure, Component

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die es ermöglicht, Methoden nacheinander aufzurufen (Method Chaining), um eine Kette von Operationen auszuführen.
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` (die aktuelle Instanz) zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply_value IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add_value( 5 )->multiply_value( 2 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 13 ). " (0 + 5) * 2 + 3 = 13
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle 'SFLIGHT'. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator aggregiert Werte einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzelnen Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    " Insert test data
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = 500 currency = 'USD' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 350 ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid OR carrid = 'AA'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature ab ABAP 7.50, um Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Er ersetzt Schleifen mit manueller Akkumulation und führt zu kürzerem, deklarativerem und funktionalerem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen aus 'SFLIGHTS', um nur die Flüge anzuzeigen, die nach einem bestimmten Datum abfliegen. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate

CLASS zcl_itb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                             WHERE fldate > iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und deklarieren Sie die Zielvariablen inline. Verwenden Sie die neue `SELECT`-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` oder `INTO @DATA(ls_flight)` und das `@`-Escape-Zeichen.

CLASS zcl_db_inline_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_inline_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung, wenn eine Division durch Null auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `TRY...CATCH`-Block und fangen Sie die vordefinierte Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_catch_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_sy_zerodivide.

    METHODS divide_with_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_catch_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide_with_handling.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 0. " Oder einen anderen Standardwert/Fehlercode setzen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.

explanation: Die strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist seit langem Standard in ABAP und unerlässlich für robuste Anwendungen. Sie ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen (wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` bei Division durch Null) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Prinzip moderner Programmierung.
keywords: Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Index zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD` mit einem Feldsymbol.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD <lt_table>[lv_index] TO <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_table_line
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_item) TYPE ty_item.

    METHODS update_dynamic_table_line
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_items
      IMPORTING
        iv_index TYPE i
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    ASSIGN ct_items[ iv_index ] TO <fs_item>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_item = <fs_item>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_dynamic_table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    ASSIGN ct_items[ iv_index ] TO <fs_item>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_item>-value = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_line_success FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_update_line FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_line_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_assign_table( ).
    DATA lt_test_items TYPE zcl_dyn_assign_table=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Item A' ) TO lt_test_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Item B' ) TO lt_test_items.

    DATA(ls_item) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_line( it_items = lt_test_items iv_index = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item-value exp = 'Item B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_line_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_assign_table( ).
    DATA lt_test_items TYPE zcl_dyn_assign_table=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Item A' ) TO lt_test_items.

    DATA(ls_item) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_line( it_items = lt_test_items iv_index = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_item ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_line.

    DATA lt_test_items TYPE zcl_dyn_assign_table=>tt_items.

    lo_cut->update_dynamic_table_line( CHANGING ct_items = lt_test_items
                                        IMPORTING iv_index = 1 iv_new_value = 'New Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ 1 ]-value exp = 'New Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle mittels `ASSIGN <itab>[index] TO <fs_line>` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um zur Laufzeit auf Tabellenzeilen zuzugreifen und diese zu modifizieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Szenarien oder bei der Verarbeitung von Daten, deren Struktur oder Index erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Es ist eine Weiterentwicklung des älteren `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... ASSIGNING ...`.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Index Access

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer einfachen Methode, die einen String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und `RECEIVING` für den Rückgabewert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_farewell RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_text = 'Hallo Welt!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_farewell.
    rv_text = 'Auf Wiedersehen!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_method_call.
    lo_instance = me.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_instance->(iv_method_name)
          RECEIVING
            rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Methode nicht gefunden oder ungültiger Aufruf'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_greeting FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_farewell FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_greeting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_GREETING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hallo Welt!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_farewell.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_FAREWELL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Auf Wiedersehen!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD lo_instance->(iv_method_name)` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder zur Implementierung von Plugins. Er ermöglicht es, Methoden zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem String-Namen aufzurufen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist hierbei entscheidend, um Fehler bei nicht existierenden Methoden oder falschen Signaturen abzufangen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, RTTI, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flügen und verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` um zu prüfen, ob ein Flug existiert und dessen Index zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        is_key     TYPE ty_flight
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists  TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index   TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    ev_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_key-carrid
                                                                           connid = is_key-connid
                                                                           fldate = is_key-fldate ] ) ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_key-carrid
                                                                           connid = is_key-connid
                                                                           fldate = is_key-fldate ] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_line_exists_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_line_exists_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_line_exists( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_line_exists=>tt_flights.
    DATA ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_itb_line_exists=>ty_flight.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND ls_flight_key TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_exists) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights
                                           is_key     = ls_flight_key
                                 IMPORTING ev_exists  = lv_exists
                                           ev_index   = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 1 ).

  METHOD test_line_exists_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_line_exists( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_line_exists=>tt_flights.
    DATA ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_itb_line_exists=>ty_flight.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_exists) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights
                                           is_key     = ls_flight_key
                                 IMPORTING ev_exists  = lv_exists
                                           ev_index   = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken sind moderne und performante Wege, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen und deren Index zu ermitteln. Sie ersetzen ältere `READ TABLE` mit `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und `sy-tabix` und führen zu kürzerem, klarerem Code.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Table Expressions

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REPLACE`-Operator mit einem regulären Ausdruck, um alle Vorkommen eines Musters in einem String zu ersetzen.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_pattern      TYPE string
        iv_replacement  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_pattern.
    rv_output_string = REPLACE( val = iv_input_string
                                 regex = iv_pattern
                                 WITH = iv_replacement
                                 OCCURRENCES = ALL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights) in ein CSV-Format als XSTRING, geeignet für einen E-Mail-Anhang.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert` mit der Methode `string_to_xstring`. Zuerst die Tabelle in einen String konvertieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " Add header row
    lv_csv_string = 'Carrier ID,Connection ID,Flight Date,Price' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Add data rows using modern ABAP string templates and REDUCE
    lv_csv_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_string
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight_data
      NEXT s = s && |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid },{ <fs_sflight>-connid },{ <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = ISO },{ <fs_sflight>-price }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    " Convert string to XSTRING using cl_bcs_convert
    rv_csv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
                       iv_string = lv_csv_string
                       iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_to_csv FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE zcl_bcs_csv_converter=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.50' ) TO lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_csv_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring( lt_sflight_data ).

    " Convert back to string for assertion
    DATA(lv_csv_result_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(
                                   iv_xstring = lv_csv_xstring
                                   iv_codepage = '4103'
                                 ).

    DATA(lv_expected_csv) TYPE string.
    lv_expected_csv = 'Carrier ID,Connection ID,Flight Date,Price' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    lv_expected_csv = lv_expected_csv && 'LH,0400,2025-01-01,100.00' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    lv_expected_csv = lv_expected_csv && 'AA,0017,2025-01-02,200.50' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv_result_string exp = lv_expected_csv ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um die CSV-Daten effizient zu generieren. `cl_bcs_convert` wird dann verwendet, um den String in das binäre XSTRING-Format zu konvertieren, was für die Handhabung von Dateiinhalten in E-Mails oder anderen binären Kontexten unerlässlich ist.

CLASS zcl_img_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

hint: Simulieren Sie das Lesen aus der DB mit einem XSTRING-Literal. Die Klasse `cl_fxs_image_info` erwartet ein XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_db_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_properties,
             width  TYPE i,
             height TYPE i,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_properties.

    METHODS process_db_image
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_id TYPE string " Simulate image ID from DB
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_properties) TYPE ty_image_properties
      RAISING
        cx_fxs_image_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_db_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_db_image.
    DATA(lv_image_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Simulate reading image XSTRING from a database table
    " In a real scenario, this would be a SELECT statement fetching a BLOB/XSTRING field.
    IF iv_image_id = 'IMAGE_001'.
      lv_image_xstring = '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'. " 1x1 GIF
    ELSEIF iv_image_id = 'IMAGE_002'.
      lv_image_xstring = '89504E470D0A1A0A0000000D49484452000000010000000108060000001F15C4890000000A49444154789CCB00000002000101000021FD4F0000000049454E44AE426082'. " 1x1 PNG
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_fxs_image_info EXPORTING textid = cx_fxs_image_info=>invalid_image_data.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( lv_image_xstring ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in ein XSTRING konvertiert und dieses XSTRING dann als E-Mail-Anhang vorbereitet, indem sie `cl_bcs_convert` und `cl_bcs` verwendet.
hint: Kapseln Sie die Logik für die CSV-Konvertierung und die Vorbereitung des Anhangs in einer Klasse. Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert` für die Datenkonvertierung und `cl_bcs` für die E-Mail-Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_csv_attachment
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_filename     TYPE string
        iv_subject      TYPE string
        iv_recipient    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_csv_attachment.
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring( it_sflight_data ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = iv_subject
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lt_solix) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( lv_csv_xstring ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'CSV'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_filename
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_csv_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix
    ).

    ro_document = lo_document.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.
    lv_csv_string = 'Carrier ID,Connection ID,Flight Date,Price' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    lv_csv_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_string
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight_data
      NEXT s = s && |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid },{ <fs_sflight>-connid },{ <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = ISO },{ <fs_sflight>-price }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).
    rv_csv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
                       iv_string = lv_csv_string
                       iv_codepage = '4103'
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_robust_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bcs_robust_converter IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.
        ev_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(

        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        ev_error_msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch die Eigenschaften (Breite, Höhe, MIME-Typ) mehrerer Bilder in einer internen Tabelle von XSTRINGs bestimmt und die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle sammelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fxs_image_info` in einer `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` für die Transformation der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_batch_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_input,
             id           TYPE string,
             image_xstring TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_image_input.
    TYPES tt_image_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_result,
             id           TYPE string,
             width        TYPE i,
             height       TYPE i,
             mime_type    TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_result.
    TYPES tt_image_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_multiple_images
      IMPORTING
        it_images TYPE tt_image_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_image_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_batch_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_multiple_images.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR ls_image IN it_images
                           LET ls_properties = VALUE zcl_img_info_determiner=>ty_image_properties(
                                                 width = 0 height = 0 mime_type = '' )
                               lv_error_msg = ''
                           IN
                           ( id = ls_image-id
                             width = COND #( WHEN ls_image-image_xstring IS NOT INITIAL
                                             THEN TRY. DATA(lo_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ls_image-image_xstring ).
                                                       lo_info->get_width( )
                                                   CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_img). lv_error_msg = lx_img->get_text( ). 0 ENDTRY
                                             ELSE 0 )
                             height = COND #( WHEN ls_image-image_xstring IS NOT INITIAL
                                              THEN TRY. DATA(lo_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ls_image-image_xstring ).
                                                        lo_info->get_height( )
                                                    CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_img). lv_error_msg = lx_img->get_text( ). 0 ENDTRY
                                              ELSE 0 )
                             mime_type = COND #( WHEN ls_image-image_xstring IS NOT INITIAL
                                                THEN TRY. DATA(lo_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ls_image-image_xstring ).
                                                          lo_info->get_mime_type( )
                                                      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_img). lv_error_msg = lx_img->get_text( ). '' ENDTRY
                                                ELSE '' )
                             error_message = lv_error_msg
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_extension_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_img_extension_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_file_extension.
    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( iv_image_xstring ).

    " Example: 'image/jpeg' -> 'jpeg'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Fangen Sie verschiedene Ausnahmetypen in separaten CATCH-Blöcken ab, einschließlich einer spezifischen und einer generischen Ausnahme.

CLASS zcl_exc_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1_str TYPE string
        iv_value2     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA: lv_value1 TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_value1 = CONV i( iv_value1_str ). " Potential CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR
        rv_result = lv_value1 / iv_value2.    " Potential CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        MESSAGE lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion).
        MESSAGE lx_conversion->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arithmetic).
        MESSAGE lx_arithmetic->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den CLEANUP-Block, um Ressourcen freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt und nicht lokal behandelt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lv_handle TYPE REF TO object. " Simulate a resource handle

    TRY.
        " Acquire resource
        CREATE OBJECT lv_handle.
        " Simulate an operation that might raise an exception
        DATA(lv_number) = CONV i( iv_input ). " Potential CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR
        rv_output = |Processed: { lv_number }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        " Log error, but let the exception propagate
        MESSAGE lx_conv->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
      CLEANUP.
        " Release resource, always executed if an exception occurs in TRY block
        IF lv_handle IS BOUND.
          " Simulate resource release
          CLEAR lv_handle.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der CLEANUP-Block stellt sicher, dass Ressourcen (hier simuliert durch lv_handle) freigegeben werden, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt und nicht vollständig innerhalb des TRY-CATCH-Blocks behandelt wird, bevor die Ausnahme weitergegeben wird.

Instructions: Lesen Sie effizient einen Eintrag aus einer SORTED TABLE mit einem zusammengesetzten Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenindexoperator [ ] mit KEY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_read_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sorted_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_sorted_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_read_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_initial_flights ( <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    " Efficient read using table expression with key
    TRY.
        rs_flight = mt_flights[ KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_not_found EXPECTING EXCEPTION cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_read_access( it_initial_flights = lt_sflights ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid
      iv_connid = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid
      iv_fldate = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-fldate
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_not_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_read_access( it_initial_flights = lt_sflights ). " Empty table
    lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Tabellenindexoperator [ ] mit der KEY-Syntax ermöglicht einen hochperformanten Zugriff auf Einträge in SORTED TABLES, da die Suche direkt über den definierten Tabellenschlüssel erfolgt. Dies ist die modernste und effizienteste Art des Lesezugriffs.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, KEY, TABLE EXPRESSION, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine SORTED TABLE mit einer Untermenge von Flugdaten, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen, unter Verwendung einer FOR-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) für die Filterung und Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES: ty_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sorted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_flights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_flights 
      WHERE ( price >= iv_min_price ) 
      ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price  = ls_sflight-price 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Einträge in eine SORTED TABLE ein und behandeln Sie mögliche Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... oder MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_insert_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sorted_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sorted_sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_sorted_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_insert_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_initial_flights ( <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE mt_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      " Entry already exists (due to UNIQUE KEY)
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_new_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_new_flight.
    DATA: lt_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_insert_entries( it_initial_flights = lt_initial ).

    DATA(ls_new_flight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_new_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_new_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_new_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_new_flight-price  = 100.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_flight( ls_new_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_flights() ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flight.
    DATA: lt_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(ls_flight_data) TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight_data-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight_data-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight_data-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight_data-price  = 100.
    APPEND ls_flight_data TO lt_initial.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_insert_entries( it_initial_flights = lt_initial ).

    DATA(ls_duplicate_flight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_duplicate_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_duplicate_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_duplicate_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_duplicate_flight-price  = 200. " Different price, but key is same

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_flight( ls_duplicate_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_flights() ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flights()[ 1 ]-price exp = 100 ). " Original entry remains
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine SORTED TABLE mit UNIQUE KEY wird automatisch geprüft, ob ein Eintrag mit demselben Schlüssel bereits existiert. Wenn ja, schlägt der INSERT-Befehl fehl (sy-subrc <> 0), und der bestehende Eintrag bleibt unverändert. Dies gewährleistet die Datenintegrität und Sortierung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, UNIQUE KEY, DUPLICATE, SFLIGHT

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WHERE name = iv_field_name.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_exists = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Struktur von zwei internen Tabellen und geben Sie an, ob sie identisch sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und vergleichen Sie die Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_a,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_a.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_a WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_b,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_b.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_b TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_b WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_c,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_c.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_c TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_c WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        it_table1     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_table2     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_table_descr1) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table1 ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr1->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components1) = lo_line_descr1->get_components( ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr2) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table2 ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr2->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components2) = lo_line_descr2->get_components( ).

    IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
      rv_identical = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    END IF.

    LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) WITH KEY name = ls_comp1-name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_comp1-type_kind <> ls_comp2-type_kind OR ls_comp1-length <> ls_comp2-length.
        rv_identical = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      END IF.
    END LOOP.

    rv_identical = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_d TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_d WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer Teilmenge der Spalten einer bestehenden Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_subset_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_t_sflight
        it_fields_to_keep TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_new_table_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    METHODS get_data_from_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        io_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
        it_source_data TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_subset_table.
    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    DATA(lo_source_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_source_components) = lo_source_line_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA: lt_new_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT lt_source_components INTO DATA(ls_source_comp).
      IF line_exists( it_fields_to_keep[ table_line = ls_source_comp-name ] ).
        APPEND ls_source_comp TO lt_new_components.
      END IF.
    END LOOP.

    DATA(lo_new_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_new_components ).
    ro_new_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_new_struct_descr ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data_from_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_data TYPE HANDLE io_table_descr.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_table>).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. END IF.

    DATA(lo_target_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( io_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_target_components) = lo_target_line_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT it_source_data ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_target_table> ASSIGNING <fs_target_line>.
      LOOP AT lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_comp).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        END IF.
      END LOOP.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_new_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_new_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_new_components) = lo_new_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_new_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_new_components[1]-name exp = 'CARRID' ).

  METHOD test_get_data_from_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table=>ty_t_sflight.
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251123' price = '100.00' ) ).

    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_new_table_descr) = lo_cut->create_subset_table( it_source_table = lt_sflight it_fields_to_keep = lt_fields ).

    DATA(lt_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->get_data_from_dynamic_table( io_table_descr = lo_new_table_descr it_source_data = lt_sflight ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_carrid> TYPE any,
                   <fs_price> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lt_dynamic_data[1] TO <fs_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_line> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'LH' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_price>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_price> exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Mittels RTTI wird eine neue Struktur (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE`) und darauf basierend ein neuer Tabellentyp (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE`) zur Laufzeit erstellt. Die Datenübertragung erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch bestimmten Zeilenstruktur und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA` mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component.
    TYPES: ty_t_component TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE ty_t_component
        iv_num_rows   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_struct_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(ls_struct_comp) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name      = ls_comp_def-name
        type_kind = ls_comp_def-type_kind
        length    = ls_comp_def-length
      ).
      APPEND ls_struct_comp TO lt_struct_components.
    END LOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_struct_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. END IF.

    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT lt_struct_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_component-type_kind.
            WHEN 'C'. <fs_field> = |Char { sy-index }|.
            WHEN 'N'. <fs_field> = |{ sy-index }|.
            WHEN 'D'. <fs_field> = sy-datum.
            WHEN 'T'. <fs_field> = sy-uzeit.
            WHEN 'I'. <fs_field> = sy-index.
            WHEN 'P'. <fs_field> = sy-index * 100.
            WHEN 'F'. <fs_field> = sy-index / 3.0.
            WHEN 'X'. <fs_field> = 'FF' && sy-index.
            WHEN 'g'. " String
              <fs_field> = |String Value { sy-index }|.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Handle other types or leave initial
          ENDCASE.
        END IF.
      END LOOP.
    END DO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie, ob ein gegebener MIME-Typ zu einer bestimmten Kategorie (z.B. 'image', 'application') gehört.
hint: MIME-Typen sind in der Regel nach dem Format `type/subtype` aufgebaut. Nutzen Sie String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_category_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_mime_type_in_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
        iv_category  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_category) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_category_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_mime_type_in_category.
    DATA(lv_first_part) = SUBSTRING( val = iv_mime_type len = FIND( val = iv_mime_type sub = '/' ) ).
    IF lv_first_part = iv_category.
      rv_is_in_category = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_in_category = abap_false.
    END IF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights) und füllen Sie diese mit einer Teilmenge von Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_append_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '180.00' )
    ).

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und fügen Sie ein zusätzliches Feld hinzu, das den Status "Expensive" oder "Normal" angibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_append_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_status_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itl_append_value=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '180.00' )
    ).

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_status(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price > iv_price_threshold )
      ( 
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        price  = flight-price,
        status = COND string( WHEN flight-price > 150 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Normal' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer internen Tabelle zurück, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Gesamtsumme enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_append_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carr_total.
    TYPES tt_carr_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_total) TYPE tt_carr_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itl_append_value=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '180.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    IF lv_total_price IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carr_total( carrid = iv_carrid total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_total.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_append_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carr_summary.
    TYPES tt_carr_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carr_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itl_append_value=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '180.00' )
    ).

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_carr_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      (
        carrid       = carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE,
        total_price  = REDUCE sflight-price(
                           INIT sum_price = 0
                           FOR member IN GROUP
                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_price exp = '370.00' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_price exp = '200.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_summary-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_summary-total_price exp = '180.00' ).

explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Syntax in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, und `REDUCE` kann innerhalb der Gruppe für weitere Aggregationen verwendet werden. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und manuellen Aggregationen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, APPEND LINES OF
