Instructions: Wählen Sie spezifische Felder aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in eine interne Tabelle aus, unter Verwendung der modernen Open SQL Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES ty_flight_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_open_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_raw)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_flights = lt_flights_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine 'Fluent API' für den Aufbau einer einfachen Nachrichtenkette ermöglicht.
hint: Designen Sie Methoden so, dass sie `ME` zurückgeben, um Methodenverkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_message_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_header
      IMPORTING iv_header TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_message_builder.
    METHODS add_body
      IMPORTING iv_body TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_message_builder.
    METHODS add_footer
      IMPORTING iv_footer TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_message_builder.
    METHODS get_message
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_message_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_header.
    mv_message = |{ mv_message }Header: { iv_header }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_body.
    mv_message = |{ mv_message }Body: { iv_body }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_footer.
    mv_message = |{ mv_message }Footer: { iv_footer }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = mv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_message_builder( ).

    DATA(lv_message) = lo_builder->add_header( 'Willkommen' )
                                 ->add_body( 'Dies ist der Hauptteil der Nachricht.' )
                                 ->add_footer( 'Mit freundlichen Grüßen' )

Jede Methode, die einen Teil der Nachricht aufbaut, gibt eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurück. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und lesbar macht, ähnlich wie in anderen modernen Programmiersprachen.
keywords: Fluent API, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum für den nächsten Werktag (Montag bis Freitag) ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder einfache Datumsarithmetik mit `DO ... ENDDO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_working_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_working_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_working_day) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_working_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_working_day.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE sy-datum VALUE iv_date.
    DO.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5. " Montag (1) bis Freitag (5)
        rv_next_working_day = lv_current_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_working_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_working_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_next_working_day( ).

    " Testfall 1: Freitag -> Montag
    DATA(lv_friday) = '20251121'. " Ein Freitag
    DATA(lv_expected_monday) = '20251124'. " Der folgende Montag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_next_working_day( lv_friday ),
      exp = lv_expected_monday,
      msg = 'Freitag sollte zum nächsten Montag führen'
    ).

    " Testfall 2: Samstag -> Montag
    DATA(lv_saturday) = '20251122'. " Ein Samstag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_next_working_day( lv_saturday ),
      exp = lv_expected_monday,
      msg = 'Samstag sollte zum nächsten Montag führen'
    ).

    " Testfall 3: Mittwoch -> Donnerstag
    DATA(lv_wednesday) = '20251119'. " Ein Mittwoch
    DATA(lv_expected_thursday) = '20251120'. " Der folgende Donnerstag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `DO`-Schleife in Kombination mit der Klasse `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER` und Inline-Deklarationen, um den nächsten Werktag zu ermitteln. Die Datumsarithmetik (`lv_current_date + 1`) ist einfach und effizient. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER` ist eine moderne und zuverlässige Methode zur Bestimmung des Wochentags.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für eine potenzielle Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY`, `CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` und `ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Fehlerbehandlung für Division durch Null
        rv_result = 0. " Oder eine andere geeignete Fehlerreaktion
        " Optional: Protokollierung des Fehlers
        " cl_demo_output=>display( 'Division durch Null abgefangen!' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 5.0,
      msg = 'Division sollte korrekt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 0.0,
      msg = 'Division durch Null sollte 0.0 zurückgeben'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist der moderne Standard für die Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, potenzielle Laufzeitfehler (wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`) elegant abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies führt zu robusterem und wartungsfreundlicherem Code.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception Handling, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Error Handling

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `MAP`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu transformieren und dabei neue Felder zu berechnen oder umzubenennen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `MAP`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_map_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_original_flight.
    TYPES ty_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_cost TYPE s_price,
             currency   TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES ty_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_original_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE ty_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_map_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( airline_id = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_num = ls_flight-connid,
        total_cost = ls_flight-price * 1.10, " 10% Aufschlag
        currency   = ls_flight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_map_operator( ).

    DATA lt_input_flights TYPE zcl_itab_map_operator=>ty_original_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_input_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' price = 200.00 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_input_flights.

    DATA(lt_output_flights) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_output_flights ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Sollte zwei transformierte Flüge zurückgeben'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_output_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight1-airline_id,
      exp = 'LH',
      msg = 'Erster Flug: Airline ID sollte LH sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight1-total_cost,
      exp = 110.00,
      msg = 'Erster Flug: Total Cost sollte 110.00 sein'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_output_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight2-airline_id,
      exp = 'AA',
      msg = 'Zweiter Flug: Airline ID sollte AA sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight2-total_cost,
      exp = 220.00,
      msg = 'Zweiter Flug: Total Cost sollte 220.00 sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `MAP`-Operator, oft in Kombination mit `FOR`, ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Er erlaubt es, für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle eine neue Zeile in der Zieltabelle zu erstellen, wobei Felder umbenannt, berechnet oder weggelassen werden können. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: MAP, FOR, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `GROUP`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES ty_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group) = VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_group TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_counts ),
      msg = 'Sollte Gruppierungsergebnisse zurückgeben'
    ).

    " Überprüfen, ob LH vorhanden ist und eine positive Anzahl hat
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ),
        msg = 'LH sollte eine positive Fluganzahl haben'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Carrier LH nicht in den Gruppierungsergebnissen gefunden' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Funktion, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt im Code zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Der `GROUP SIZE`-Operator liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und ist eine effiziente Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, GROUP SIZE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den ABAP-Typnamen einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen aller Komponenten einer internen Tabelle mit Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` nach `describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_table_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_component_names IMPORTING it_data TYPE ty_t_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_table_comps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_names.
    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_component_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man RTTI verwendet, um die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zu analysieren. Zuerst wird der Tabellentyp beschrieben, dann der Zeilentyp als Strukturtyp gecastet. Anschließend können die Namen der Komponenten der Struktur abgerufen werden. Dies ist ideal für generische Datenverarbeitung oder die Erstellung dynamischer Oberflächen.
keywords: RTTI, Internal Table, Structure, Components, Dynamic, `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit anhand ihres Namens auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_objectdescr` und die Anweisung `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zif_dynamic_action DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~execute.
    rv_output = |Executed: { iv_input } by { mv_name }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                                            iv_method_name TYPE string
                                            iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_objectdescr.
    DATA lt_methods TYPE cl_abap_objectdescr=>method_table.
    DATA ls_method TYPE cl_abap_objectdescr=>method_info.
    DATA lv_param_name TYPE string VALUE 'IV_INPUT'.

    lo_descr = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    lt_methods = lo_descr->get_methods( ).

    READ TABLE lt_methods INTO ls_method WITH KEY name = iv_method_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              (lv_param_name) = iv_param_value
            RECEIVING
              rv_result = rv_result.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic call failed'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Error: Method not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_executor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_executor( 'MyExecutor' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically( io_object      = lo_executor
                                                      iv_method_name = 'ZIF_DYNAMIC_ACTION~EXECUTE'
                                                      iv_param_value = 'TestInput' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Executed: TestInput by MyExecutor' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically( io_object      = lo_executor
                                                 iv_method_name = 'GET_NAME'
                                                 iv_param_value = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'MyExecutor' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically( io_object      = lo_executor
                                                 iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
                                                 iv_param_value = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Method not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_value IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                                          iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    DATA lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_objectdescr.
    DATA lt_attributes TYPE cl_abap_objectdescr=>attribute_table.
    DATA ls_attribute TYPE cl_abap_objectdescr=>attribute_info.

    lo_descr = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    lt_attributes = lo_descr->get_attributes( ).

    READ TABLE lt_attributes INTO ls_attribute WITH KEY name = iv_attribute_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF io_object TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_value>.
      ELSE.
        rv_value = 'Error: Attribute access failed'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Error: Attribute not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lösen Sie eine Ausnahme mit einer Nachricht aus, die über `cl_message_helper` verwaltet wird, und fangen Sie diese ab, um die Nachricht zu extrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_raise_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS get_last_message RETURNING VALUE(rs_message) TYPE symsg.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_last_message TYPE symsg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_raise_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action.
    cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E'
                                    iv_msgid = '00'
                                    iv_msgno = '001'
                                    iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler'
                                    iv_msgv2 = 'aufgetreten' ).
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_message.
    DATA lt_messages TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
    lt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_messages( ).
    IF lt_messages IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_message = lt_messages[ lines( lt_messages ) ]-msg.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_raise_exception_with_msg FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_raise_exception_with_msg.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_raise_exception( ).
    DATA ls_message TYPE symsg.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_action( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        ls_message = lo_cut->get_last_message( ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgty exp = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgid exp = '00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgno exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgv1 exp = 'Fehler' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgv2 exp = 'aufgetreten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man `cl_message_helper` verwendet, um Nachrichten zu sammeln, die dann im Kontext einer Ausnahmebehandlung abgerufen werden können. `add_message` fügt eine Nachricht hinzu, und die Ausnahme wird ausgelöst. Im CATCH-Block kann die zuletzt hinzugefügte Nachricht über `get_messages` abgerufen werden. Dies ermöglicht eine standardisierte und flexible Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: Exception, Message, Error Handling, `cl_message_helper`, `RAISE EXCEPTION`

Instructions: Sammeln Sie mehrere Nachrichten unterschiedlichen Typs (E, W, I) in `cl_message_helper` und geben Sie diese formatiert aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` mehrfach und dann `get_messages` zur Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_collect_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_messages.
    METHODS get_formatted_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_messages) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collect_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_messages.
    cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler' iv_msgv2 = '1' ).
    cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung' iv_msgv2 = '2' ).
    cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = 'Info' iv_msgv2 = '3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_messages.
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_message_helper=>get_messages( ).
    LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      APPEND |{ ls_message-msgty }: { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 }| TO rt_formatted_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_collect_multiple_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_multiple_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_collect_multiple( ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ). " Sicherstellen, dass keine alten Nachrichten vorhanden sind

    lo_cut->add_messages( ).
    DATA(lt_formatted) = lo_cut->get_formatted_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_formatted ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 1 ] exp = 'E: Fehler 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 2 ] exp = 'W: Warnung 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 3 ] exp = 'I: Info 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Sammeln mehrerer Nachrichten unterschiedlicher Typen (Error, Warning, Info) mit `cl_message_helper`. Die Methode `add_message` wird mehrfach aufgerufen. Anschließend können alle gesammelten Nachrichten mit `get_messages` abgerufen und nach Bedarf formatiert werden. Dies ist ideal für Validierungsszenarien, bei denen mehrere Probleme gleichzeitig gemeldet werden müssen.
keywords: Message, Error Handling, Collection, `cl_message_helper`, `add_message`, `get_messages`

CLASS zcl_msg_check_errors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_msg_check_errors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
      cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Simulierter Fehler' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Operation erfolgreich' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD has_errors.
    rb_has_errors = cl_message_helper=>has_errors( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_has_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_has_errors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_check_errors( ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

    " Testfall 1: Mit Fehler
    lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_simulate_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->has_errors( ) ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Die Methode `has_errors` liefert einen booleschen Wert zurück, der angibt, ob mindestens eine Fehlermeldung gesammelt wurde. Dies ist eine schnelle und effiziente Möglichkeit, den Fehlerstatus einer Operation zu überprüfen, ohne alle Nachrichten explizit abrufen und prüfen zu müssen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Validierung eines Feldes in einer Struktur durch und protokollieren Sie Fehler mit `cl_message_helper`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) mit `cl_message_helper` für die Fehlerprotokollierung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_to_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             amount TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    DATA ms_data TYPE ty_s_data.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_s_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_to_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data = is_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_field IMPORTING is_data TYPE zcl_data_to_validate=>ty_s_data
                                     iv_field_name TYPE string
                                     iv_expected_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    METHODS has_validation_errors RETURNING VALUE(rb_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_value> TYPE any.
    DATA lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_info.

    lo_structdescr = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).

    READ TABLE lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF is_data TO <fs_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_field_value> IS INITIAL.
          cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E'
                                          iv_msgid = '00'
                                          iv_msgno = '001'
                                          iv_msgv1 = iv_field_name
                                          iv_msgv2 = 'ist leer' ).
        ELSEIF iv_expected_value IS SUPPLIED AND <fs_field_value> <> iv_expected_value.
          cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E'
                                          iv_msgid = '00'
                                          iv_msgno = '002'
                                          iv_msgv1 = iv_field_name
                                          iv_msgv2 = |hat unerwarteten Wert '{ <fs_field_value> }'| ).
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E'
                                        iv_msgid = '00'
                                        iv_msgno = '003'
                                        iv_msgv1 = iv_field_name
                                        iv_msgv2 = 'konnte nicht zugegriffen werden' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E'
                                      iv_msgid = '00'
                                      iv_msgno = '004'
                                      iv_msgv1 = iv_field_name
                                      iv_msgv2 = 'nicht gefunden' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD has_validation_errors.
    rb_has_errors = cl_message_helper=>has_errors( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_validation.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_data_to_validate=>ty_s_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_validation( ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

    " Testfall 1: Feld ist leer
    ls_data-id = ''.
    ls_data-amount = 100.
    ls_data-status = 'NEW'.
    lo_cut->validate_field( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->has_validation_errors( ) ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

    " Testfall 2: Feld hat unerwarteten Wert
    ls_data-id = 'A123'.
    lo_cut->validate_field( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'STATUS' iv_expected_value = 'OPEN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->has_validation_errors( ) ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

    " Testfall 3: Feld ist gültig
    ls_data-status = 'NEW'.
    lo_cut->validate_field( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'AMOUNT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->has_validation_errors( ) ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

    " Testfall 4: Nicht existierendes Feld
    lo_cut->validate_field( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->has_validation_errors( ) ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert RTTI und `cl_message_helper` für eine dynamische Feldvalidierung. Mittels `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` wird der Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur dynamisch abgerufen. Basierend auf Validierungsregeln (z.B. 'ist leer' oder 'unerwarteter Wert') werden Fehlermeldungen über `cl_message_helper=>add_message` gesammelt. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung flexibler Validierungsframeworks, die zur Laufzeit konfiguriert werden können.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Validation, Message, Error Handling, `cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_message_helper`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT`

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Vererbungshierarchie einer Klasse bis zur Basisklasse `OBJECT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_superclass` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_child_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_dynamic_executor CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_child_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_inheritance_path IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_class_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_inheritance_path.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lv_class_name TYPE string.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).

    WHILE lo_class_descr IS BOUND.
      lv_class_name = lo_class_descr->get_name( ).
      APPEND lv_class_name TO rt_class_names.
      lo_class_descr = lo_class_descr->get_superclass( ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inheritance_path FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inheritance_path.
    DATA(lo_child) = NEW zcl_child_class( 'Child' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_inheritance_tree( ).

    DATA(lt_path) = lo_cut->get_inheritance_path( lo_child ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_path ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_path[ 1 ] exp = 'ZCL_CHILD_CLASS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_path[ 2 ] exp = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_EXECUTOR' ).

Instructions: Protokollieren Sie Nachrichten aus `cl_message_helper` in das Application Log (SLG1).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_message_helper=>get_messages` und `cl_bal_log` zum Schreiben ins Application Log.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_to_app_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_messages_and_log IMPORTING iv_log_object TYPE balobj_d
                                            iv_log_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d.
    METHODS get_log_handle RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_log_handle TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_to_app_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_messages_and_log.
    DATA lo_log TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log.
    DATA ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.
    DATA lt_messages TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.

    " Nachrichten hinzufügen
    cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Log-Fehler' ).
    cl_message_helper=>add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgv1 = 'Log-Info' ).

    " Application Log initialisieren
    ls_log_header-object = iv_log_object.
    ls_log_header-subobject = iv_log_subobject.
    ls_log_header-extnumber = |{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.

    lo_log = cl_bal_log=>create( ls_log_header ).
    mv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).

    " Nachrichten aus Message Helper ins Log schreiben
    lt_messages = cl_message_helper=>get_messages( ).
    LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_msg).
      lo_log->add_message(
        i_msgty = ls_msg-msgty
        i_msgid = ls_msg-msgid
        i_msgno = ls_msg-msgno
        i_msgv1 = ls_msg-msgv1
        i_msgv2 = ls_msg-msgv2
        i_msgv3 = ls_msg-msgv3
        i_msgv4 = ls_msg-msgv4 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Log speichern
    cl_bal_log=>save_log( i_log_handle = mv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_handle.
    rv_log_handle = mv_log_handle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_to_app_log FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_to_app_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_to_app_log( ).
    cl_message_helper=>clear_messages( ).

    lo_cut->add_messages_and_log( iv_log_object    = 'ZTEST'
                                  iv_log_subobject = 'MSG_HELPER' ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_log_handle msg = 'Log-Handle sollte nicht initial sein' ).

    " Manuelle Überprüfung in SLG1 mit Objekt ZTEST, Subobjekt MSG_HELPER
    " ist hier notwendig, da das Auslesen des Logs komplexer wäre.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Nachrichten, die im `cl_message_helper` gesammelt wurden, werden mit `get_messages` abgerufen und dann einzeln in eine Instanz von `cl_bal_log` geschrieben. Instructions: Berechne die Summe einer Liste von Zahlen (als String-Tabelle), aber löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn ein Eintrag keine gültige Zahl ist.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` und eine eigene Ausnahmebehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_with_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_with_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR number IN it_numbers
                       NEXT s = s + COND #( WHEN number IS NUMERIC THEN CONV i( number )
                                            ELSE THROW zcx_invalid_number( textid = zcx_invalid_number=>default_text ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_sum FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_with_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE string_table( ( '10' ) ( '20' ) ( '30' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_with_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE string_table( ( '10' ) ( 'ABC' ) ( '30' ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_invalid_number was expected.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_number.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception zcx_invalid_number caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert `REDUCE` für funktionale Aggregation und `COND` mit `THROW` für die direkte Ausnahmeauslösung innerhalb eines Ausdrucks, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, THROW, RAISE EXCEPTION, Class-based Exceptions, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_dynamic_abap_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_add_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING

      RAISING

CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_abap_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_add_class.
    IF iv_class_name IS INITIAL OR iv_method_name IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_generated_code = |CLASS { iv_class_name } DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.\n|
                      && |  PUBLIC SECTION.\n|
                      && |    METHODS { iv_method_name }\n|
                      && |      IMPORTING\n|
                      && |        iv_num1 TYPE i\n|
                      && |        iv_num2 TYPE i\n|
                      && |      RETURNING\n|
                      && |        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.\n|
                      && |ENDCLASS.\n\n|
                      && |CLASS { iv_class_name } IMPLEMENTATION.\n|
                      && |  METHOD { iv_method_name }.\n|
                      && |    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.\n|
                      && |  ENDMETHOD.\n|
                      && |ENDCLASS.\n|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Fluggesellschaft nicht existiert.
hint: Verwende den `FILTER` Operator und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        zcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_carrier_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_db TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_db.

    IF NOT EXISTS( lt_sflights_db[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ] ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_carrier_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_carrier_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_db USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                    AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_filter_invalid_carrier.

      CATCH zcx_carrier_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception zcx_carrier_not_found caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr IMPLEMENTATION.

        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und speichere sie in einer internen Tabelle. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, löse eine Ausnahme aus.

CLASS zcl_read_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      FROM sflight

Instructions: Erstelle einen formatierten Statusbericht für einen Flug aus `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung von String Templates. Der Status soll 'Pünktlich' sein, wenn die Auslastung unter 80% liegt, sonst 'Verspätet'. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwende String Templates und `COND` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_report.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ).
    DATA(lv_status) = COND string( WHEN lv_occupancy_percent < 80 THEN 'Pünktlich' ELSE 'Verspätet' ).

    rv_report = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } Status: { lv_status } (Auslastung: { lv_occupancy_percent }%).|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_no_flights_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_no_flights_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                      FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                      NEXT s = s + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                      total_seats_occupied = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_no_flights FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_no_flights_found.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob LH in der Zusammenfassung ist
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT `NOT_FOUND` ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-carrid exp = 'NOT_FOUND' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats_occupied > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_no_flights.
    " Um diesen Testfall zu simulieren, müsste SFLIGHT geleert oder ein Mock verwendet werden.
    " Hier wird nur die Ausnahmebehandlung demonstriert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflights( ).
    " Annahme: In einem echten Szenario würde hier eine leere SFLIGHT-Tabelle simuliert.
    " Für diesen Test wird die Ausnahme ausgelöst, wenn die Tabelle leer ist.
    " Da SFLIGHT selten leer ist, ist dies eher ein konzeptioneller Test.
    TRY.
        " Hier müsste man SFLIGHT mocken oder leeren, um die Ausnahme zu provozieren.
        " Da dies in einem einfachen Unit-Test schwierig ist, wird die Logik nur geprüft.
        " cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_no_flights_found was expected.' ).
        DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).
        IF lt_summary IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH zcx_no_flights_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception zcx_no_flights_found caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Prozentsatz der freien Sitze für einen bestimmten Flug aus `SFLIGHT`. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die maximale Sitzplatzanzahl Null ist, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwende `COND` für bedingte Zuweisung und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_free_seats_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_percentage) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero
        zcx_flight_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats_percentage.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_sflight-seatsmax = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_division_by_zero=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_percentage = ( ( ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc ) * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Dauer eines Fluges in Stunden und Minuten basierend auf Start- und Endzeitpunkten. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Endzeit vor der Startzeit liegt.
hint: Verwende `TIMESTAMPL` und Datums-/Zeit-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_duration,
             hours   TYPE i,
             minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_duration.

    METHODS calculate_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_timestamp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_duration) TYPE ty_duration
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_time_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_time_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration.
    IF iv_end_timestamp < iv_start_timestamp.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_time_range
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_time_range=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = iv_end_timestamp - iv_start_timestamp.

    rs_duration-hours = lv_diff_seconds DIV 3600.
    rs_duration-minutes = ( lv_diff_seconds MOD 3600 ) DIV 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Geplant', 'Abgeflogen', 'Gelandet') basierend auf dem aktuellen Datum und der Flugzeit. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Flugdaten ungültig sind.
hint: Verwende `SWITCH` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_fltime TYPE sflight-fltime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    IF iv_fldate IS INITIAL OR iv_fltime IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_data=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_current_time) = sy-uzeit.

    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_fldate > lv_current_date THEN 'Geplant'
      WHEN iv_fldate = lv_current_date AND iv_fltime > lv_current_time THEN 'Geplant'

      WHEN iv_fldate < lv_current_date THEN 'Gelandet'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Überprüfe zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene interne Tabelle eine bestimmte Spalte enthält. Gib einen formatierten String mit dem Ergebnis zurück, der konzeptionell in einem `cl_gui_abapedit` Control angezeigt werden könnte. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn der Tabellentyp nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_table_column
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
        iv_column_name     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_type_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_type_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_table_column.
    DATA: lo_typedescr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_tabledescr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lo_tabledescr ?= lo_typedescr.
        lo_structdescr ?= lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error. "e.g. type not found or not a table type
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_type_not_found
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_type_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDTRY.

    lt_components = lo_structdescr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = iv_column_name.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_found = abap_true.
      rv_result_string = |Die Tabelle '{ iv_table_type_name }' enthält die Spalte '{ iv_column_name }'.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_string = |Die Tabelle '{ iv_table_type_name }' enthält die Spalte '{ iv_column_name }' NICHT.|.
    ENDIF.
    " This result string could then be displayed in a cl_gui_abapedit control.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten und fülle sie mit Beispieldaten. CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_dynamic_table_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_columns TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_generated_code) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_column_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_column_count DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_table_code.
    IF iv_num_columns <= 0 OR iv_num_columns > 5. " Limit for example simplicity
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_column_count
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_column_count=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_type_def) = |TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_line,\n|.
    DATA(lv_data_fill) = |DATA: lt_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_line WITH EMPTY KEY.\n|.
    DATA(lv_append_line) = |APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_line( |.

    DO iv_num_columns TIMES.
      DATA(lv_column_name) = |FIELD{ sy-index }|.
      lv_type_def = lv_type_def && |  { lv_column_name } TYPE string,\n|.
      lv_append_line = lv_append_line && | { lv_column_name } = 'Value { sy-index }' |.
    ENDDO.

    lv_type_def = lv_type_def && |END OF ty_dynamic_line.\n|.
    lv_append_line = lv_append_line && | ) TO lt_dynamic_table.\n|.

    rv_generated_code = lv_type_def && lv_data_fill && lv_append_line.
    " This generated code could then be displayed in a cl_gui_abapedit control.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere ein einfaches Observer-Pattern, bei dem ein 'Flugzeug'-Objekt Änderungen seines Status an 'Bodenkontrolle'-Objekte meldet. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn versucht wird, einen Observer zu registrieren, der bereits registriert ist.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_observer PUBLIC.
  METHODS update_flight_status
    IMPORTING
      iv_flight_id TYPE sflight-carrid
      iv_status    TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_observer
      IMPORTING
        io_observer TYPE REF TO zif_flight_observer
      RAISING
        zcx_observer_already_registered.
    METHODS unregister_observer
      IMPORTING
        io_observer TYPE REF TO zif_flight_observer.
    METHODS set_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_id TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_status TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES tt_observers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_flight_observer WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_observers TYPE tt_observers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ground_control DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_observer.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    PRIVATE SECTION.
      DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_observer_already_registered DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_observer.
    IF line_exists( mt_observers[ table_line = io_observer ] ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_observer_already_registered
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_observer_already_registered=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    INSERT io_observer INTO TABLE mt_observers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD unregister_observer.
    DELETE mt_observers WHERE table_line = io_observer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_flight_status.
    LOOP AT mt_observers INTO DATA(lo_observer).
      lo_observer->update_flight_status( iv_flight_id = iv_flight_id iv_status = iv_new_status ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ground_control IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_observer~update_flight_status.
    " In a real scenario, this would update a UI or log.
    " For this example, we just simulate the update.
    DATA(lv_message) = |Bodenkontrolle { mv_name }: Flug { iv_flight_id } Status aktualisiert auf '{ iv_status }'.|.
    " This message could be displayed in a cl_gui_abapedit control.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Bereinige einen Eingabestring, indem alle führenden/nachfolgenden Leerzeichen entfernt und mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen ersetzt werden. Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn der Eingabestring zu lang ist.
hint: Verwende String-Funktionen wie `CONDENSE`, `REPLACE` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_string_too_long.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_string_too_long DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    IF strlen( iv_input_string ) > 255. " Example limit
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_string_too_long
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_string_too_long=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string NO-GAPS.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single space (using regex-like behavior)
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_string WITH ' '.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur Einträge übernommen werden, die in der Zieltabelle noch nicht existieren (basierend auf einem Schlüssel). Löse eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Quelltabelle leer ist.
hint: Verwende `FOR ... IN ... EXCEPT` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_merge_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS merge_unique_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data
      CHANGING
        ct_target_data TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        zcx_source_data_empty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_source_data_empty DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_merge_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_unique_data.
    IF it_source_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_source_data_empty
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_source_data_empty=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    ct_target_data = VALUE #( BASE ct_target_data
                               FOR ls_source IN it_source_data
                               WHERE ( id IS NOT INITIAL )
                               ( ls_source ) EXCEPT id = ls_source-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_merge_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_source_empty FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_source_data_empty.
    METHODS test_merge_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_merge_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_merge_tables=>tt_data( ( id = 1 value = 'A' ) ( id = 2 value = 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_merge_tables=>tt_data( ( id = 3 value = 'C' ) ( id = 4 value = 'D' ) ).

    lo_cut->merge_unique_data( EXPORTING it_source_data = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_data = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 3 ]-value exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_source_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_merge_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_merge_tables=>tt_data( ( id = 1 value = 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_merge_tables=>tt_data( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->merge_unique_data( EXPORTING it_source_data = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_data = lt_target ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_source_data_empty was expected.' ).
      CATCH zcx_source_data_empty.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception zcx_source_data_empty caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_merge_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_merge_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_merge_tables=>tt_data( ( id = 1 value = 'Original A' ) ( id = 2 value = 'Original B' ) ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_merge_tables=>tt_data( ( id = 2 value = 'New B' ) ( id = 3 value = 'C' ) ).

    lo_cut->merge_unique_data( EXPORTING it_source_data = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_data = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ). " Only 1, 2, 3 (2 is not duplicated)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 1 ]-value exp = 'Original A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 2 ]-value exp = 'Original B' ). " Original B should remain
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 3 ]-value exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8-String in einen ISO-8859-1-String. Nicht darstellbare Zeichen sollen durch ein '#' ersetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` mit dem Parameter `iv_replacement`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                            iv_string = iv_utf8_string

CLASS zcl_codepage_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_codepage_validate IMPLEMENTATION.

      CATCH cx_abap_codepage_error.

  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_table_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_source_cp      TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp      TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_table_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table.
    rt_target_strings = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_source_strings
                                 LET lv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                                      iv_string = lv_string
                                                      iv_codepage = iv_source_cp
                                                      iv_replacement = '#' ) IN
                                 ( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                       iv_xstring = lv_xstring
                                       iv_codepage = iv_target_cp
                                       iv_replacement = '#' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 einzigartigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random=>create` und eine Schleife mit `get_next`, um Einzigartigkeit zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 20
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_list.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).

    DO iv_count * 20 TIMES. " Try enough times to find unique numbers
      DATA(lv_new_num) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = iv_min ip_max = iv_max ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_temp_numbers[ table_line = lv_new_num ] ).
        APPEND lv_new_num TO lt_temp_numbers.
        IF lines( lt_temp_numbers ) = iv_count.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rt_random_numbers = lt_temp_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_list( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_list( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'List should contain 5 numbers' ).

    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = lt_result.
    SORT lt_unique_check ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_check COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_check )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'All numbers in the list should be unique' ).

    " Check range
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
        act = lv_num
        min = 1
        max = 20
        msg = 'Each number should be between 1 and 20' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `cl_abap_random` mit modernen internen Tabellenoperationen (z.B. `line_exists`) ermöglicht die effiziente Generierung und Überprüfung von einzigartigen Zufallszahlen. Die `DO ... TIMES` Schleife ist hier eine einfache Möglichkeit, genügend Versuche zu unternehmen, um die gewünschte Anzahl einzigartiger Zahlen zu finden.
keywords: Random, Unique, Internal Tables, cl_abap_random, LOOP, line_exists

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random=>create` und `shuffle`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
        id   TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_data,
      ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    lo_random->shuffle( CHANGING ct_table = ct_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' )
      ( id = 5 value = 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lt_original.

    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_data = lt_shuffled ).

    " Check if the table still contains the same elements (just in different order)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled )
      exp = lines( lt_original )
      msg = 'Shuffled table should have the same number of lines' ).

    " Sort both tables and compare to ensure content is identical
    SORT lt_original BY id.
    SORT lt_shuffled BY id.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_shuffled
      exp = lt_original
      msg = 'Shuffled table should contain the same elements as original' ).

    " It's hard to assert randomness, but we can check if it's *likely* different
    " This test might fail rarely if shuffle produces the original order
    " For simplicity, we just check if it's not identical to original (most of the time)
    IF lt_shuffled = lt_original.
      " If it's identical, try shuffling again to reduce false negatives
      lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_data = lt_shuffled ).
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lt_shuffled
      exp = lt_original
      msg = 'Shuffled table should ideally be different from original (may rarely fail)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `shuffle` von `cl_abap_random` bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, die Reihenfolge der Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig zu mischen, was in Szenarien wie der Erstellung von Stichproben oder der Simulation nützlich ist.
keywords: Random, Shuffle, Internal Tables, cl_abap_random

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_random_element FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_from_empty_list FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_random_element.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_test_list) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Apple' )
      ( 'Banana' )
      ( 'Cherry' )
      ( 'Date' )
      ( 'Elderberry' ) ).

    DATA(lv_selected) = lo_cut->select_random_element( lt_test_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = line_exists( lt_test_list[ table_line = lv_selected ] )
      msg = 'Selected element must be from the original list' ).

    " Run multiple times to increase confidence in randomness
    DATA(lv_count_apple) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_banana) = 0.
    DO 100 TIMES.
      lv_selected = lo_cut->select_random_element( lt_test_list ).
      IF lv_selected = 'Apple'.
        lv_count_apple = lv_count_apple + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_selected = 'Banana'.
        lv_count_banana = lv_count_banana + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_count_apple > 0 AND lv_count_banana > 0 )
      msg = 'Multiple runs should select different elements (probabilistic check)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_from_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_list) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_selected) = lo_cut->select_random_element( lt_empty_list ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_selected
      msg = 'Selecting from an empty list should return initial value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) und geben Sie das Ergebnis als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random=>create` und `get_next` für eine Zahl zwischen 0 und 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flipper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flip_coin
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flipper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 0 ip_max = 1 ).

    IF lv_random_num = 0.
      rv_result = 'Kopf'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Zahl'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_coin_flip_results FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_coin_flip_distribution FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_coin_flip_results.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_coin_flipper( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_result = 'Kopf' OR lv_result = 'Zahl' )
      msg = 'Result must be either Kopf or Zahl' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_coin_flip_distribution.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_coin_flipper( ).
    DATA(lv_heads_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_tails_count) = 0.

    DO 1000 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).
      IF lv_result = 'Kopf'.
        lv_heads_count = lv_heads_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_tails_count = lv_tails_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Check if counts are roughly balanced (within a reasonable range for 1000 flips)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_heads_count > 400 AND lv_heads_count < 600 )
      msg = 'Heads count should be roughly around 500 (probabilistic)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_tails_count > 400 AND lv_tails_count < 600 )
      msg = 'Tails count should be roughly around 500 (probabilistic)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Simulation eines Münzwurfs wird durch die Generierung einer Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 mit `cl_abap_random=>get_next` realisiert. Eine einfache `IF`-Anweisung entscheidet dann über das Ergebnis. Dies ist eine klare und moderne Art, solche Zufallsereignisse zu modellieren.
keywords: Random, Simulation, Coin Flip, Math, cl_abap_random
