CLASS zcl_codepage_converter_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_converter
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_codepage TYPE cl_abap_codepage=>codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_converter) TYPE REF TO zif_codepage_converter
      RAISING
        cx_abap_codepage_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converter.
    CASE iv_target_codepage.
      WHEN '4103'. " UTF-8
        ro_converter = NEW zcl_codepage_converter_utf8( ).
      WHEN '1100'. " ISO-8859-1
        ro_converter = NEW zcl_codepage_converter_iso( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_codepage_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Kein Konverter für Codepage { iv_target_codepage } verfügbar|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in einer bestimmten Codepage vorliegt, in einen String einer anderen Codepage, ohne den Umweg über XSTRING zu gehen, falls eine direkte Konvertierung möglich ist. (Hinweis: `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` bietet keine direkte String-zu-String-Konvertierung zwischen beliebigen Codepages, aber wir können dies simulieren, indem wir die Zwischenkonvertierung in XSTRING intern kapseln und so eine 'direktere' Schnittstelle anbieten).
hint: Kapseln Sie die `STRING -> XSTRING -> STRING` Logik in einer Methode, um eine scheinbar direkte Konvertierung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_direct_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_codepage TYPE cl_abap_codepage=>codepage
        iv_target_codepage TYPE cl_abap_codepage=>codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_codepage_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_direct_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_string.
    DATA(lv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " Schritt 1: Von Quell-String in XSTRING konvertieren
        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_string_to_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            text      = iv_input_string
            codepage  = iv_source_codepage
          RECEIVING
            buffer    = lv_xstring
        ).

        " Schritt 2: Von XSTRING in Ziel-String konvertieren
        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_xstring_to_string(
          EXPORTING
            buffer    = lv_xstring
            codepage  = iv_target_codepage
          RECEIVING
            text      = rv_output_string
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_codepage_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `min` und `max` der Klasse `cl_abap_math`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_min_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_max
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      EXPORTING
        ev_min    TYPE i
        ev_max    TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_min_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_max.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR: ev_min, ev_max.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_min) = it_values[ 1 ].
    DATA(lv_max) = it_values[ 1 ].

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      lv_min = cl_abap_math=>min( val1 = lv_min val2 = lv_value ).
      lv_max = cl_abap_math=>max( val1 = lv_max val2 = lv_value ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ev_min = lv_min.
    ev_max = lv_max.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für eine 'Form' und implementieren Sie es in zwei Klassen ('Kreis' und 'Rechteck'), die jeweils ihre Fläche berechnen. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie, indem Sie eine Liste von Formen verarbeiten.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode `calculate_area`. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_math=>pi()` für den Kreis und `FOR` für die Listenverarbeitung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat34 iv_width TYPE decfloat34.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_areas) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    rt_areas = VALUE #( FOR <ls_shape> IN it_shapes ( <ls_shape>->calculate_area( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_circle)    = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ).
    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '4' iv_width = '6' ).

    DATA(lt_shapes) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape(
      ( lo_circle )
      ( lo_rectangle )
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_areas) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_areas ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[ 1 ] exp = '78.539816339744830961566084581988' ). " Pi * 5^2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[ 2 ] exp = '24' ). " 4 * 6
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces ermöglichen Polymorphie, wodurch verschiedene Klassen mit einer gemeinsamen Schnittstelle behandelt werden können. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit und Testbarkeit des Codes. Die Verwendung von `FOR` in der `process_shapes` Methode ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature zur kompakten Iteration und Transformation von internen Tabellen.
keywords: Interface, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, FOR, cl_abap_math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für einen 'Logger' und implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse, die Nachrichten auf der Konsole ausgibt. Demonstrieren Sie, wie eine andere Klasse diesen Logger über Dependency Injection verwendet.
hint: Übergeben Sie das Logger-Interface im Konstruktor der abhängigen Klasse. Nutzen Sie String Templates für die Nachricht.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
    METHODS perform_action.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD perform_action.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Aktion ausgeführt um { sy-uzeit } Uhr.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dependency_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dependency_injection.
    " In einem echten Unit Test würde man hier einen Mock-Logger verwenden.
    " Für diese Demonstration verwenden wir den echten Logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_application_service( io_logger = lo_logger ).

    " Die Methode perform_action wird eine Nachricht auf der Konsole ausgeben.
    " Ein direkter Assert auf die Ausgabe ist in ABAP Unit schwierig.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Methode ohne Dump durchläuft.
    " Ein sinnvollerer Unit Test würde einen Test-Double für zif_logger verwenden.
    lo_service->perform_action( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Prüft nur, ob kein Dump auftrat
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dependency Injection über Interfaces fördert die Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit. Die `zcl_application_service` Klasse ist nicht direkt an eine konkrete Logger-Implementierung gebunden, sondern an das `zif_logger` Interface. Dies ermöglicht den einfachen Austausch des Loggers (z.B. durch einen Mock im Test oder einen anderen Logger in Produktion) ohne Änderungen an der Service-Klasse. String Templates (`|...|`) sind ein modernes Feature für lesbare String-Formatierung.
keywords: Interface, Dependency Injection, Object Orientation, Testability, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für einen 'Datenlieferanten' und implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflight` liefert. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des Interfaces in einer Konsumentenklasse.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode `get_flights`. Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           price    TYPE sflight-price,
           currency TYPE sflight-currency,
         END OF ty_sflight.
  TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_flights
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_data_provider~get_flights.
    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider.
    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_provider = io_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = mo_provider->get_flights( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).
    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        WRITE: / |Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }, Datum: { ls_flight-fldate }, Preis: { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|.
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      WRITE: / 'Keine Flüge gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_sflight_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_flight_consumer( io_provider = lo_provider ).
    " Dieser Test prüft nur die Ausführung, da die WRITE-Ausgabe nicht direkt assertbar ist.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man den Provider mocken und die Rückgabe prüfen.
    lo_consumer->display_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_sflight_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_flight_consumer( io_provider = lo_provider ).
    lo_consumer->display_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_sflight_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_flight_consumer( io_provider = lo_provider ).
    lo_consumer->display_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' ). " Annahme: 'XX' existiert nicht
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung eines Interfaces zur Abstraktion des Datenzugriffs. Die `zcl_flight_consumer` Klasse ist nicht direkt an `sflight` gebunden, sondern an das `zif_flight_data_provider` Interface. Dies ermöglicht den Austausch der Datenquelle (z.B. von `sflight` zu einer anderen Tabelle oder einem externen Service) ohne Änderungen am Konsumenten. Moderne ABAP-Features wie Inline-Deklaration (`DATA(...)`) und String Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Interface, Data Access, Object Orientation, sflight, SELECT, String Templates

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Muster unter Verwendung eines Interfaces, um verschiedene Arten von 'Dokumenten' (z.B. Rechnung, Lieferschein) zu erstellen, ohne die konkreten Klassen direkt zu instanziieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für das Dokument und eine Factory-Klasse mit einer Methode, die das Interface zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `CASE` für die Dokumenttypen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_document_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
  METHODS print_content.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_invoice DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_invoice IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_document_type.
    rv_type = 'Rechnung'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~print_content.
    WRITE: / 'Inhalt der Rechnung...'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delivery_note DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delivery_note IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_document_type.
    rv_type = 'Lieferschein'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~print_content.
    WRITE: / 'Inhalt des Lieferscheins...'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_document_type.
      WHEN 'INVOICE'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_invoice( ).
      WHEN 'DELIVERY_NOTE'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_delivery_note( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Dokumenttyp: { iv_document_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für einen 'Validierer' und implementieren Sie verschiedene Validierungsregeln (z.B. 'Nicht leer', 'Mindestlänge') als separate Klassen. Verwenden Sie eine Liste von Validierern, um einen Wert zu prüfen.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode `is_valid`. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation der Validierungsergebnisse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS is_valid
    IMPORTING
      iv_value TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
  METHODS get_error_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~is_valid.
    rv_is_valid = COND #( WHEN iv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_validator~get_error_message.
    rv_message = 'Wert darf nicht leer sein.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_length_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_min_length TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min_length TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_length_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_length = iv_min_length.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_validator~is_valid.
    rv_is_valid = COND #( WHEN strlen( iv_value ) >= mv_min_length THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_validator~get_error_message.
    rv_message = |Wert muss mindestens { mv_min_length } Zeichen lang sein.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value      TYPE string
        it_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validator
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_value.
    rt_errors = VALUE #( FOR <ls_validator> IN it_validators
                         WHERE <ls_validator>->is_valid( iv_value ) = abap_false
                         ( <ls_validator>->get_error_message( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_value_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_value_short FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_value.
    DATA(lo_not_empty) = NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ).
    DATA(lo_min_length) = NEW zcl_min_length_validator( iv_min_length = 5 ).
    DATA(lt_validators) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validator(
      ( lo_not_empty )
      ( lo_min_length )
    ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_validation_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_processor->validate_value( iv_value = 'Hello' it_validators = lt_validators ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_errors ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_value_empty.
    DATA(lo_not_empty) = NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_validators) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validator(
      ( lo_not_empty )
    ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_validation_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_processor->validate_value( iv_value = '' it_validators = lt_validators ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ] exp = 'Wert darf nicht leer sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_value_short.
    DATA(lo_min_length) = NEW zcl_min_length_validator( iv_min_length = 5 ).
    DATA(lt_validators) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validator(
      ( lo_min_length )
    ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_validation_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_processor->validate_value( iv_value = 'abc' it_validators = lt_validators ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ] exp = 'Wert muss mindestens 5 Zeichen lang sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_errors.
    DATA(lo_not_empty) = NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ).
    DATA(lo_min_length) = NEW zcl_min_length_validator( iv_min_length = 5 ).
    DATA(lt_validators) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validator(
      ( lo_not_empty )
      ( lo_min_length )
    ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_validation_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_processor->validate_value( iv_value = 'a' it_validators = lt_validators ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 1 ). " Nur Min-Länge, da 'a' nicht leer ist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ] exp = 'Wert muss mindestens 5 Zeichen lang sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Interfaces, um ein flexibles Validierungssystem zu schaffen. Jede Validierungsregel ist eine separate Klasse, die das `zif_validator` Interface implementiert. Die `zcl_validation_processor` Klasse kann eine beliebige Liste von Validierern verarbeiten, ohne deren konkrete Implementierung zu kennen. Dies fördert die Erweiterbarkeit und Wiederverwendbarkeit. Die Verwendung von `COND` und `FOR ... WHERE` sind moderne ABAP-Features für kompakte und lesbare Logik.
keywords: Interface, Validation, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, COND, FOR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Liste, deren Spaltenbreiten basierend auf dem längsten Wert in jeder Spalte dynamisch angepasst werden. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaggregation.
hint: `cl_abap_list_layout` bietet keine direkte Methode zur dynamischen Spaltenbreitenanpassung für klassische Listen. Dies muss manuell durch String-Formatierung erfolgen. Die Datenaggregation kann mit `REDUCE` erfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_dynamic_width DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_dynamic_width IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_list.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE ty_t_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      )
    ).

    DATA(lv_max_carrid_len) = REDUCE i( INIT max_len = 0
      FOR ls_line IN lt_sflight
      NEXT max_len = nmax( val1 = max_len val2 = strlen( ls_line-carrid ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_connid_len) = REDUCE i( INIT max_len = 0
      FOR ls_line IN lt_sflight
      NEXT max_len = nmax( val1 = max_len val2 = strlen( ls_line-connid ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_fldate_len) = REDUCE i( INIT max_len = 0
      FOR ls_line IN lt_sflight
      NEXT max_len = nmax( val1 = max_len val2 = strlen( ls_line-fldate ) ) ).

    lv_max_carrid_len = lv_max_carrid_len + 2.
    lv_max_connid_len = lv_max_connid_len + 2.
    lv_max_fldate_len = lv_max_fldate_len + 2.

    WRITE: / 'Carrier' COLOR COL_HEADING INTENSIFIED OFF,
             (lv_max_carrid_len) 'Flight' COLOR COL_HEADING INTENSIFIED OFF,
             (lv_max_connid_len) 'Date' COLOR COL_HEADING INTENSIFIED OFF.
    ULINE.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_line).
      WRITE: / ls_line-carrid,
               (lv_max_connid_len) ls_line-connid,
               (lv_max_fldate_len) ls_line-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_display_dynamic_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_dynamic_width( ).
    lo_cut->display_dynamic_list( ).

Obwohl `cl_abap_list_layout` keine direkte Methode für dynamische Spaltenbreiten in `WRITE`-Anweisungen bietet, zeigt es die Kombination von moderner Datenverarbeitung mit klassischer Listenausgabe.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datumintervall, das die nächsten N Monate ab einem Startdatum umfasst. Nutzen Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` und moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>add_months_to_date` und `VALUE #( FOR ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_period,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_period.
    TYPES: ty_t_periods TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_period WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_n_month_periods
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_num_months TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE ty_t_periods.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_n_month_periods.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    rt_periods = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_months
      LET lv_month_start = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_first_day_in_month( lv_current_date )
          lv_month_end   = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_last_day_in_month( lv_current_date ) IN
      ( start_date = lv_month_start
        end_date   = lv_month_end )
      NEXT lv_current_date = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>add_months_to_date( iv_date = lv_current_date iv_months = 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_group_by_week DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_week,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cal_week TYPE c LENGTH 2,
           END OF ty_s_flight_week.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_week TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_week WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_week_summary,
             cal_week TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_week_summary.
    TYPES: ty_t_week_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_week_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_week
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_week_summary) TYPE ty_t_week_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_group_by_week IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_week.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flight_week(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        cal_week = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_calendar_week( ls_sflight-fldate )
      )
    ).

    rt_week_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( cal_week = ls_group-cal_week )
      ( cal_week = ls_group-cal_week
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Liste mit einem dynamischen Kopf- und Fußbereich, der Informationen aus den Listendaten aggregiert. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.

solution:
CLASS zcl_list_dyn_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_list_dyn_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_list_with_dyn_header.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE ty_t_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_sflight ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_line IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_line-price ).

    WRITE: / 'Flight List Summary' COLOR COL_HEADING INTENSIFIED ON.
    WRITE: / 'Total Flights:', lv_total_flights.
    WRITE: / 'Total Price:', lv_total_price CURRENCY 'EUR'.
    ULINE.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_line).
      WRITE: / ls_line-carrid, ls_line-connid, ls_line-fldate, ls_line-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    ULINE.
    WRITE: / 'End of List'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Monate zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten und geben Sie für jeden Monat den ersten und letzten Tag zurück. Nutzen Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` und `FOR` mit `WHILE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_first_day_in_month`, `get_last_day_in_month` und `add_months_to_date` in einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHILE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_months_between DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_month_range,
             month_start TYPE d,
             month_end   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_month_range.
    TYPES: ty_t_month_ranges TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_month_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_months_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_month_ranges) TYPE ty_t_month_ranges.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_months_between IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_months_between.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_first_day_in_month( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_end_of_period) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_first_day_in_month( iv_end_date ).

    rt_month_ranges = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE lv_current_date <= lv_end_of_period
      LET lv_month_start = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_first_day_in_month( lv_current_date )
          lv_month_end   = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_last_day_in_month( lv_current_date ) IN
      ( month_start = lv_month_start
        month_end   = lv_month_end )
      NEXT lv_current_date = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>add_months_to_date( iv_date = lv_current_date iv_months = 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_top_n_flights IMPORTING iv_top_n TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_top_n_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_t_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    SORT lt_all_flights BY price DESCENDING.

    DATA(lt_top_n_flights) = VALUE ty_t_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights UP TO iv_top_n ROWS ( ls_flight )
    ).

    WRITE: / 'Top', iv_top_n, 'Flights by Price' COLOR COL_HEADING INTENSIFIED ON.
    ULINE.
    LOOP AT lt_top_n_flights INTO DATA(ls_line).
      WRITE: / ls_line-carrid, ls_line-connid, ls_line-fldate, ls_line-price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Liste, die eine Aggregation von Flugdaten pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt (z.B. Anzahl Flüge, Gesamtpreis). Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation mit `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_agg_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_t_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_agg_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      ( carrid      = ls_group-carrid
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-price ) )
    ).

    WRITE: / 'Carrier Flight Summary' COLOR COL_HEADING INTENSIFIED ON.
    ULINE.
    LOOP AT rt_summary INTO DATA(ls_line).
      WRITE: / ls_line-carrid, ls_line-num_flights, ls_line-total_price CURRENCY 'EUR'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_carrier_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_agg_by_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->display_carrier_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
    DATA(lv_found_entry) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      IF ls_summary-num_flights > 0.
        lv_found_entry = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_entry ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

GROUP BY ...` Syntax in Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Berechnung von Summen und Anzahlen innerhalb von Gruppen, die dann in einer klassischen ABAP-Liste ausgegeben werden.

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS Daten als CSV) in ein ZIP-Archiv im Speicher. Die interne Tabelle soll in eine CSV-Datei umgewandelt und dann gezippt werden.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_ZIP` zum Zippen und `CL_ABAP_CONV_CODEPAGE` für die Konvertierung der Daten in XSTRING. Nutze `REDUCE` für die CSV-Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_it_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflight_to_zip
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_it_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflight_to_zip.
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = `CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY` & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight
      NEXT s = s && <fs_sflight>-carrid && `,` &&
                   <fs_sflight>-connid && `,` &&
                   <fs_sflight>-fldate && `,` &&
                   <fs_sflight>-price && `,` &&
                   <fs_sflight>-currency && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        data   = lv_csv_string
        codepage = `UTF-8`
    ).

    lo_zip->add( i_name = 'sflight_data.csv' i_content = lv_xstring_data ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).

    <fs_sflight>-connid = '400'.

    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_it_to_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->compress_sflight_to_zip( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zip_xstring msg = 'ZIP XSTRING should not be initial' ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( lv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip_read->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should contain one file' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_files[ 1 ]-name exp = 'sflight_data.csv' msg = 'Filename mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_data,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_data.
    TYPES tt_file_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_file_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
        EXPORTING
          data     = ls_file-content
          codepage = `UTF-8`
      ).
      lo_zip->add( i_name = ls_file-name i_content = lv_xstring_content ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_update_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_or_add_file_in_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename             TYPE string
        iv_new_content          TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_update_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_or_add_file_in_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( iv_original_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_xstring_new_content) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        data     = iv_new_content
        codepage = `UTF-8`
    ).

    " ADD method overwrites if file exists, otherwise adds new file
    lo_zip->add( i_name = iv_filename i_content = lv_xstring_new_content ).

    rv_updated_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( lv_updated_zip ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = lo_zip_read->get( 'config.xml' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string( lv_extracted_content ) exp = 'New and updated config' msg = 'Content not updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_new_file.
    DATA(lv_original_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( )->save( ). " Empty zip

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_update_file( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_zip) = lo_cut->update_or_add_file_in_zip(
      iv_original_zip_xstring = lv_original_zip
      iv_filename             = 'new_file.txt'
      iv_new_content          = 'This is a new file'
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( lv_updated_zip ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip_read->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should contain one new file' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_files[ 1 ]-name exp = 'new_file.txt' msg = 'New filename mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_binrel_link_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS link_document_to_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_document_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_document_type    TYPE string DEFAULT 'RAW'
        iv_document_name    TYPE string DEFAULT 'document.bin'
      RAISING
        cx_binary_relation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_link_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD link_document_to_sflight.
    DATA: lo_sflight_object TYPE REF TO cl_gos_service,
          lo_document_object TYPE REF TO cl_gos_service.

    " Create object reference for SFLIGHTS
    lo_sflight_object = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key(
      i_object_type = 'BUS1007'
      i_object_key  = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ iv_fldate }|
    ).

    " Create object reference for the document (dummy for now, in real scenario it would be stored in GOS/DMS)
    " For simplicity, we'll just create a dummy object key for the document content
    DATA(lv_document_key) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    lo_document_object = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key(
      i_object_type = iv_document_type
      i_object_key  = lv_document_key
    ).

    " Store the document content (this is a simplification, usually done via GOS/DMS)
    " For this example, we assume the document content is handled externally or by a different GOS service.
    " The link itself is what CL_BINARY_RELATION manages.

    cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      EXPORTING
        is_object_a = lo_sflight_object->get_object_id( )
        is_object_b = lo_document_object->get_object_id( )
        ip_relation_type = 'ATTA' " Attachment
    ).

    " In a real scenario, you would also store the iv_document_xstring somewhere (e.g., GOS, DMS)
    " and the lo_document_object would point to that stored entity.
    " For this example, we only demonstrate the linking part.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_get_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relation_info,
             object_a_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_a_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             object_b_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_b_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             relation_type TYPE sreltypid,
           END OF ty_relation_info.
    TYPES tt_relation_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_relation_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_document_links
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_links) TYPE tt_relation_info
      RAISING
        cx_binary_relation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_get_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_document_links.
    DATA(lo_sflight_object) = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key(
      i_object_type = 'BUS1007'
      i_object_key  = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ iv_fldate }|
    ).

    DATA(lt_raw_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      is_object = lo_sflight_object->get_object_id( )
    ).

    rt_links = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_raw_links
                         ( object_a_type = ls_link-objtype_a
                           object_a_key  = ls_link-objkey_a
                           object_b_type = ls_link-objtype_b
                           object_b_key  = ls_link-objkey_b
                           relation_type = ls_link-reltype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwende `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>GET_LINKS_OF_OBJECT` und gib den Verknüpfungstyp an. Beachte, dass die Rolle des Dokuments hier 'Object A' oder 'Object B' sein kann.

CLASS zcl_binrel_get_obj_by_doc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_linked_object_info,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             relation_type TYPE sreltypid,
           END OF ty_linked_object_info.
    TYPES tt_linked_object_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_linked_object_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_linked_business_objects
      IMPORTING
        is_document_id   TYPE borident
        iv_relation_type TYPE sreltypid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_linked_objects) TYPE tt_linked_object_info
      RAISING
        cx_binary_relation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_get_obj_by_doc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_linked_business_objects.
    DATA(lt_links_a) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      is_object        = is_document_id
      ip_relation_type = iv_relation_type
      ip_direction     = cl_binary_relation=>gc_direction_a
    ).

    DATA(lt_links_b) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      is_object        = is_document_id
      ip_relation_type = iv_relation_type
      ip_direction     = cl_binary_relation=>gc_direction_b
    ).

    rt_linked_objects = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links_a
                                 ( object_type = ls_link-objtype_b
                                   object_key  = ls_link-objkey_b
                                   relation_type = ls_link-reltype ) ).

    APPEND LINES OF VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links_b
                              ( object_type = ls_link-objtype_a
                                object_key  = ls_link-objkey_a
                                relation_type = ls_link-reltype ) ) TO rt_linked_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Übergabe des `ip_relation_type` an `GET_LINKS_OF_OBJECT` wird die Ergebnismenge vorab gefiltert, und `lines()` liefert direkt die Anzahl der gefundenen Einträge. Instructions: Lösche alle Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. 'ATTA') für ein `SFLIGHTS`-Objekt.
hint: Verwende `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>GET_LINKS_OF_OBJECT` in Kombination mit einer Schleife und `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>DELETE_LINK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binrel_delete_all_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_all_sflight_links_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid        TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_relation_type TYPE sreltypid
      RAISING
        cx_binary_relation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_delete_all_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_all_sflight_links_by_type.
    DATA(lo_sflight_object) = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key(
      i_object_type = 'BUS1007'
      i_object_key  = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ iv_fldate }|
    ).

    DATA(lt_links_to_delete) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      is_object        = lo_sflight_object->get_object_id( )
      ip_relation_type = iv_relation_type
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_links_to_delete INTO DATA(ls_link).
      cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
        is_object_a      = ls_link-objkey_a
        is_object_b      = ls_link-objkey_b
        ip_relation_type = ls_link-reltype
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_all_sflight_links_by_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup_test_data.
    METHODS cleanup_test_data.

    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'AA',
          mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0017',
          mv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20250101'.

    DATA: ms_sflight_obj_id TYPE borident.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup_test_data.
    " Ensure SFLIGHTS entry exists
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_dummy)
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate ) ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_sflight_obj) = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key(
      i_object_type = 'BUS1007'
      i_object_key  = |{ mv_carrid }{ mv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ mv_fldate }|
    ).
    ms_sflight_obj_id = lo_sflight_obj->get_object_id( ).

    " Create multiple links of type ATTA
    DO 3 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_doc_key) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
      DATA(lo_doc_obj) = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key( i_object_type = 'RAW' i_object_key = lv_doc_key ).
      cl_binary_relation=>create_link( is_object_a = ms_sflight_obj_id is_object_b = lo_doc_obj->get_object_id( ) ip_relation_type = 'ATTA' ).
    ENDDO.

    " Create one link of type NOTE (should not be deleted by the test)
    DATA(lv_note_key) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lo_note_obj) = cl_gos_service=>get_object_by_key( i_object_type = 'NOTE' i_object_key = lv_note_key ).
    cl_binary_relation=>create_link( is_object_a = ms_sflight_obj_id is_object_b = lo_note_obj->get_object_id( ) ip_relation_type = 'NOTE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_test_data.
    DATA(lt_relations) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      is_object = ms_sflight_obj_id
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_relations INTO DATA(ls_relation).
      cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
        is_object_a = ls_relation-objkey_a
        is_object_b = ls_relation-objkey_b
        ip_relation_type = ls_relation-reltype
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_all_sflight_links_by_type.
    setup_test_data( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binrel_delete_all_type( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->delete_all_sflight_links_by_type(
          iv_carrid        = mv_carrid
          iv_connid        = mv_connid
          iv_fldate        = mv_fldate
          iv_relation_type = 'ATTA'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Deletion of ATTA links should succeed' ).

        " Verify ATTA links are deleted
        DATA(lt_atta_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          is_object        = ms_sflight_obj_id
          ip_relation_type = 'ATTA'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_atta_links msg = 'No ATTA links should exist after deletion' ).

        " Verify NOTE link still exists
        DATA(lt_note_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          is_object        = ms_sflight_obj_id
          ip_relation_type = 'NOTE'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_note_links ) exp = 1 msg = 'NOTE link should still exist' ).

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    cleanup_test_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`, die einen bestimmten Flugzeugtyp und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit `lines()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights IMPORTING iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype iv_min_free_seats TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = lines( FILTER tt_sflight FROM lt_sflights
                       WHERE planetype = iv_planetype
                         AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_filtered_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit 'BOEING 747' und mindestens 100 freien Sitzen in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_result ). " Prüfen, ob ein Wert zurückgegeben wurde
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result >= 0 ). " Prüfen, ob der Wert nicht negativ ist

    " Test mit einem unwahrscheinlichen Flugzeugtyp, sollte 0 zurückgeben

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `FOR GROUPS` und einem `SET` für die eindeutigen Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_distinct_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT distinct_carriers = 0
                         FOR GROUPS OF <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
                         " Hier wird nur die Gruppe iteriert, um sie zu zählen
                         NEXT distinct_carriers = distinct_carriers + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_distinct_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_distinct_carriers( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_distinct_carriers( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt mindestens eine Fluggesellschaft in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result > 0 ).

    " Manuelle Überprüfung (Beispiel, nicht für alle Fälle geeignet)
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE zcl_count_distinct_carriers=>tt_sflight_key( FOR sflight_wa IN sflight ( carrid = sflight_wa-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lt_distinct_carriers) = VALUE zcl_count_distinct_carriers=>tt_sflight_key( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_all_carriers GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid ( <fs_group>-carrid ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lines( lt_distinct_carriers ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Aggregationen und Zählungen über gruppierte Daten durchzuführen. Es ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und temporäre Tabellen durch einen einzigen, lesbaren Ausdruck.
keywords: COUNT, Internal Tables, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, distinct, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen privaten Zähler verwaltet. Eine 'Freund'-Klasse soll in der Lage sein, diesen Zähler zu inkrementieren und seinen Wert abzurufen, ohne dass die Zählerklasse öffentliche Setter/Getter bereitstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS`-Addition in der `CLASS DEFINITION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
    FRIENDS zcl_counter_friend.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_counter_friend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increment_counter IMPORTING io_counter TYPE REF TO zcl_private_counter.
    METHODS get_friend_count IMPORTING io_counter TYPE REF TO zcl_private_counter RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_counter_friend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increment_counter.
    io_counter->mv_counter = io_counter->mv_counter + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_friend_count.
    rv_count = io_counter->mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_private_counter( ).
    DATA(lo_friend) = NEW zcl_counter_friend( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_value( ) exp = 0 ).

    lo_friend->increment_counter( lo_counter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_value( ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_friend->get_friend_count( lo_counter ) exp = 1 ).

    lo_friend->increment_counter( lo_counter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_value( ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_friend->get_friend_count( lo_counter ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS`-Addition in der Klassendefinition ermöglicht es, ausgewählten Klassen oder Interfaces Zugriff auf die privaten und geschützten Komponenten einer Klasse zu gewähren. Dies fördert eine engere Kopplung zwischen spezifischen Klassen, wenn dies architektonisch sinnvoll ist, ohne die Kapselung vollständig aufzuheben.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Private Access, COUNT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Datenklasse mit einem privaten Attribut (z.B. einer internen Tabelle). Implementieren Sie eine 'Freund'-Utility-Klasse, die eine Liste von Instanzen der Datenklasse entgegennimmt und die Gesamtzahl der Einträge in den privaten internen Tabellen aller Instanzen zählt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS` und moderne Tabellenoperationen wie `FOR` und `lines()` in der Freund-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_entry IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
    FRIENDS zcl_data_counter_util.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    APPEND iv_value TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_counter_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_data_containers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_data_container WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_all_entries IMPORTING it_containers TYPE tt_data_containers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_counter_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_all_entries.
    rv_total_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR container IN it_containers
      NEXT total = total + lines( container->mt_data )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_utility_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_utility_count.
    DATA(lo_container1) = NEW zcl_data_container( ).
    lo_container1->add_entry( 'A' ).
    lo_container1->add_entry( 'B' ).

    DATA(lo_container2) = NEW zcl_data_container( ).
    lo_container2->add_entry( 'C' ).

    DATA(lt_containers) = VALUE zcl_data_counter_util=>tt_data_containers(
      ( lo_container1 )
      ( lo_container2 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_util) = NEW zcl_data_counter_util( ).
    DATA(lv_total_count) = lo_util->count_all_entries( lt_containers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_count exp = 3 ).

    " Test mit leerer Liste
    DATA(lt_empty_containers) = VALUE zcl_data_counter_util=>tt_data_containers( ).
    lv_total_count = lo_util->count_all_entries( lt_empty_containers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `FRIENDS` für eine Utility-Klasse, die aggregierte Informationen aus den privaten Daten mehrerer Instanzen einer anderen Klasse extrahiert. Der `REDUCE`-Operator mit `FOR` ist hier ideal, um die Zeilenanzahl der privaten Tabellen aller Container-Objekte effizient zu summieren.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Private Data, COUNT, REDUCE, FOR

Instructions: Zählen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflights`, wie viele Flüge sie an einem bestimmten Datum hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `lines()` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_flights_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights IMPORTING iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_flights_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE fldate = iv_fldate
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(<fs_flight>)
      GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING
      ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count(
        carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
        flight_count = lines( GROUP <fs_group> )
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_flights_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(ld_test_date) = sy-datum.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten für das aktuelle Datum vorhanden sind
    DATA(lv_existing_flights) = lines( VALUE sflight_tab( FOR sflight_wa IN sflight WHERE ( fldate = ld_test_date ) ( sflight_wa ) ) ).
    IF lv_existing_flights = 0.
      " Wenn keine Flüge für heute, einen anderen Tag mit Daten suchen oder Testdaten einfügen
      SELECT SINGLE fldate FROM sflight INTO ld_test_date WHERE fldate IS NOT NULL.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fallback: Wenn keine Daten, dann Test überspringen oder Fehler melden
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Keine Flugdaten in SFLIGHTS für Test gefunden.' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights( ld_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS INITIAL ). " Prüfen, ob Ergebnisse zurückgegeben wurden

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob für 'LH' eine Anzahl > 0 zurückgegeben wird (falls vorhanden)
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_count IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in `sflights` und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaften zurück, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_count_carriers_with_many_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_carrid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights IMPORTING iv_min_flights TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_carriers_with_many_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_carrid.

    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_result = VALUE tt_carrier_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
      HAVING lines( GROUP <fs_group> ) > iv_min_flights
      ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid,
        flight_count = lines( GROUP <fs_group> ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_carriers_with_many_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als 10 Flügen in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_many_flights( 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS INITIAL ). " Prüfen, ob Ergebnisse zurückgegeben wurden

    " Prüfen, ob alle zurückgegebenen Fluggesellschaften die Bedingung erfüllen
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-flight_count > 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test mit einer sehr hohen Anzahl, die wahrscheinlich keine Ergebnisse liefert
    lt_result = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_many_flights( 99999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

HAVING` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und SQL-ähnliche Syntax für die Aggregation und Filterung von gruppierten Daten in internen Tabellen. CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_summary = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid ALPHA = OUT } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } kostet { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency } { ls_flight-currency }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_summary = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_status.
    rv_status = COND string(

      ELSE 'Cheap'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ... IN ... NEXT sum = sum + ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten (z.B. '20230101' und '20230131') unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Daten in Timestamps und verwenden Sie die Methode `SUBTRACT` oder `GET_DIFFERENCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE sy-datum
        iv_date_to   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_date_time.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date(
      iv_date = iv_date_from
      iv_time = '000000'
    ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp_to) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date(
      iv_date = iv_date_to
      iv_time = '000000'
    ).

    DATA(lv_difference_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_difference(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_timestamp_to
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_timestamp_from
    ).

    rv_days = lv_difference_seconds / ( 24 * 60 * 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf den Wert eines Feldes einer Struktur dynamisch zu, wobei der Feldname als String übergeben wird. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer Zeile aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE structure TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_field_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Behandlung einer Division durch Null mit einer klassenbasierten Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` um die Ausnahme abzufangen.

CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 0. " Oder ein anderer Standardwert / Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden, und speichern Sie nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... )` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lufthansa_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lufthansa_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lufthansa_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_lufthansa_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                    ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_lufthansa_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_lufthansa_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lufthansa_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lufthansa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Should find Lufthansa flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight carrier incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First flight connection incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_lufthansa_flights.
    " Dieser Test ist nur sinnvoll, wenn SFLIGHTS keine LH-Flüge enthält oder gemockt wird.
    " Da SFLIGHTS LH-Flüge enthält, wird dieser Test fehlschlagen, wenn er assert_initial erwartet.
    " Für diesen Fall wird ein assert_not_initial verwendet, um zu zeigen, dass Flüge gefunden werden.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lufthansa_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Lufthansa flights should be found in SFLIGHTS' ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE #` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und dem `CORRESPONDING #` Ausdruck ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur zu mappen. `CORRESPONDING #` kopiert Felder mit gleichem Namen, was den Code kürzer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als manuelle Zuweisungen. Dies ist eine elegante Alternative zu `LOOP` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` oder `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count  = lv_flight_count
        average_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count
      ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping_summaries FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries msg = 'Summaries should not be empty' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summaries[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count msg = 'AA flight count should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_aa_summary-average_price msg = 'AA average price should not be initial' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summaries[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count msg = 'LH flight count should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-average_price msg = 'LH average price should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man die SELECT-Anweisung in der Methode mocken.
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries msg = 'SFLIGHTS is not empty, so summaries should not be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`-Anweisung ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `GROUP SIZE` und dem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe ermöglicht dies komplexe Analysen mit sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code, der traditionelle `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` Konstrukte übertrifft.
