Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen aus einem gegebenen String unter Verwendung von String-Funktionen und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` oder `CONDENSE` in Kombination mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_spaces.
    rv_cleaned_string = replace( val = iv_input_string regex = '\s+' with = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_with_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_without_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_only_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_with_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_spaces( '  Hello   World  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HelloWorld' msg = 'Spaces not removed correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_without_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_spaces( 'HelloWorld' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HelloWorld' msg = 'String without spaces changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_spaces( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Empty string changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_only_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_spaces( '     ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Only spaces not removed correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `replace()` mit regulären Ausdrücken (`regex = '\s+'` für ein oder mehrere Leerzeichen) ist die modernste und flexibelste Methode, um Zeichen in Strings zu ersetzen oder zu entfernen. Sie ist wesentlich leistungsfähiger als `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` für komplexere Muster und bietet eine kompakte Syntax. Dies ist ein Beispiel für die verbesserte String-Verarbeitung in modernen ABAP-Versionen.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, Regex, String Functions

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine einzelne Zeile aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf `CARRID` und `CONNID` und verwenden Sie dabei eine Tabellenexpression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key_field = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Annahme: SFLIGHTS hat einen Sekundärschlüssel oder der Primärschlüssel wird verwendet
    " Für diesen Fall wird der Primärschlüssel von SFLIGHTS verwendet.
    rs_flight = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrier ID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'Connection ID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-price msg = 'Price should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ). "Assert that the exception was caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenexpressions (`itab[ key_field = value ]`) sind die modernste und effizienteste Methode, um auf einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. Sie sind kompakter und oft performanter als `READ TABLE` und werfen eine klassenbasierte Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND`), wenn die Zeile nicht gefunden wird, was eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht. Die Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING #` erlaubt eine direkte Zuweisung an eine Struktur.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expression, READ TABLE, SFLIGHTS, CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Flugdatum. Die Daten sollen in eine inline deklarierte Struktur gelesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight)` und Hostvariablen (`@`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    " Setup: Ensure a record exists or insert one for testing
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20250101'.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflights INTO @DATA(dummy_carrid)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                                    price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ).
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = lv_connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = lv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_data_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '19000101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE` mit Inline-Deklaration (`@rs_flight`) und Hostvariablen-Escape-Zeichen (`@`) ist seit ABAP 7.40 gängige Praxis und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes. `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` ist hier nicht zwingend modern, aber die Inline-Deklaration und Hostvariablen sind es.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, Inline Declaration, Host Variables, Database Access

CLASS zcl_select_single_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

           END OF ty_flight_price.

      IMPORTING

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Flugdatensatz. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie eine Standardstruktur zurück. Nutzen Sie moderne Konditional-Operatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und den `COND` Operator, um `sy-subrc` zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_or_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_or_default.
    DATA ls_flight_db TYPE ty_sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight_db
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rs_flight = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_flight_db
                        ELSE VALUE #( carrid = 'N/A' connid = '0000' fldate = '19000101' price = 0 currency = 'XXX' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Flugdatensatz in eine inline deklarierte Struktur, die nur relevante Felder enthält, und nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight_data)` und den `CORRESPONDING #` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             current_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    " Define a local structure that matches some fields of sflights
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_db,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_db.

    DATA ls_sflight_db TYPE ty_sflight_db.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_sflight_db
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Use CORRESPONDING to map fields from DB structure to return structure
      rs_summary = CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight_db MAPPING carrid = carrier_id
                                                           connid = connection_id
                                                           fldate = flight_date
                                                           price = current_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für einen Flug, indem Sie einen neuen Wert hinzufügen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der neue Wert den maximalen Sitzen (`seatsmax`) nicht überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE` mit `SET` und einer Sub-SELECT-Anweisung oder einer vorherigen `SELECT SINGLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_seatsocc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    METHODS update_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        iv_seats_to_add TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_seatsocc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lv_current_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
          lv_seatsmax       TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO ( @lv_current_seatsocc, @lv_seatsmax )
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_new_seatsocc) = lv_current_seatsocc + iv_seats_to_add.
      IF lv_new_seatsocc > lv_seatsmax.
        lv_new_seatsocc = lv_seatsmax.
      ENDIF.

      UPDATE sflights
        SET seatsocc = @lv_new_seatsocc
        WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
          AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
          AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    METHODS update_flight_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        UPDATE sflights
          SET price = @iv_new_price
          WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
            AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
            AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          " Record not found, not necessarily an SQL error
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Log error or handle specific SQL error scenarios
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE zcl_update_with_subquery=>ty_flight_key(
      carrid = 'DL'
      connid = '0002'
      fldate = '20250101' ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_key-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight_key-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight_key-fldate.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight_key-carrid connid = ls_flight_key-connid fldate = ls_flight_key-fldate
                                  price = 1000 currency = 'USD' planetype = '737' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 190 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_with_subquery( ).
    DATA(lv_seats_to_add) = 20. " This would exceed seatsmax
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->add_seats_if_available(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      iv_seats_to_add = lv_seats_to_add ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 0 ).

    " Verify - should not be updated
    DATA(lv_seatsocc) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflights INTO @lv_seatsocc
      WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_key-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight_key-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight_key-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_seatsocc exp = 190 ).

    " Teardown
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_key-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight_key-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight_key-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_seats_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_with_subquery( ).
    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE zcl_update_with_subquery=>ty_flight_key(
      carrid = 'XX'
      connid = '9999'
      fldate = '19000101' ).
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->add_seats_if_available(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      iv_seats_to_add = 10 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die direkte Verwendung von Feldvergleichen und Berechnungen in der `WHERE`-Klausel einer `UPDATE`-Anweisung (seit ABAP 7.40) ist eine sehr performante Methode, um komplexe Bedingungen auf Datenbankebene zu prüfen. Dies vermeidet das Laden von Daten in den Anwendungsserver und die anschließende bedingte Aktualisierung, was die Effizienz bei Massenoperationen erheblich steigert.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie ein Ereignis, das mit einer bestimmten Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 30%) eintritt. Geben Sie 'Ereignis eingetreten' oder 'Ereignis nicht eingetreten' zurück.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die generierte Zufallszahl mit der Wahrscheinlichkeit (als Float zwischen 0 und 1).
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_probability DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability TYPE f " e.g., 0.3 for 30%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_event_occurred) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_probability IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_event.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_value < iv_probability.
      rv_event_occurred = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_event_occurred = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simulate_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_probability( ).
    DATA(lv_true_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_false_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_probability) TYPE f VALUE '0.5'.
    DATA(lv_iterations) TYPE i VALUE 1000.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->simulate_event( lv_probability ) = abap_true.
        lv_true_count = lv_true_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_false_count = lv_false_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Assert that both outcomes are possible and roughly proportional
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_true_count > 0 ) msg = 'Event should occur at least once' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_false_count > 0 ) msg = 'Event should not occur at least once' ).
    " More advanced statistical assertions could be added for larger iterations
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_true_count > ( lv_iterations * 0.4 ) AND lv_true_count < ( lv_iterations * 0.6 ) ) msg = 'True count should be roughly 50%' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Simulation von Wahrscheinlichkeiten ist eine häufige Anwendung von Zufallszahlen. Indem man eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 generiert und diese mit einem Schwellenwert (der Wahrscheinlichkeit) vergleicht, kann man ein Ereignis mit der gewünschten Häufigkeit simulieren.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von Zufallszahlen vom Typ Float, die einer Normalverteilung folgen. Nutzen Sie die Box-Muller-Transformation mit `cl_abap_random_float`.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei unabhängige Zufallszahlen aus `cl_abap_random_float` und die Box-Muller-Formeln: `z0 = sqrt(-2 * ln(u1)) * cos(2 * pi * u2)` und `z1 = sqrt(-2 * ln(u1)) * sin(2 * pi * u2)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_normal_dist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_normal_distributed
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_mean  TYPE f DEFAULT 0.0
        iv_std_dev TYPE f DEFAULT 1.0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_floats) TYPE tt_floats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_normal_dist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_normal_distributed.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_u1) TYPE f.
    DATA(lv_u2) TYPE f.
    DATA(lv_z0) TYPE f.
    DATA(lv_z1) TYPE f.
    DATA(lv_pi) TYPE f VALUE '3.141592653589793'.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      lv_u1 = lo_random->get_next( ).
      lv_u2 = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Box-Muller transformation
      lv_z0 = sqrt( -2 * log( lv_u1 ) ) * cos( 2 * lv_pi * lv_u2 ).
      lv_z1 = sqrt( -2 * log( lv_u1 ) ) * sin( 2 * lv_pi * lv_u2 ).

      " Scale and shift to desired mean and standard deviation
      APPEND ( lv_z0 * iv_std_dev ) + iv_mean TO rt_floats.
      IF lines( rt_floats ) < iv_count.
        APPEND ( lv_z1 * iv_std_dev ) + iv_mean TO rt_floats.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_normal_distributed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_normal_distributed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_normal_dist( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 1000.
    DATA(lv_mean) = 100.0.
    DATA(lv_std_dev) = 10.0.
    DATA(lt_floats) = lo_cut->generate_normal_distributed( iv_count = lv_count iv_mean = lv_mean iv_std_dev = lv_std_dev ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_floats ) exp = lv_count msg = 'Table should contain correct number of entries' ).

    " Basic check: values should be somewhat centered around the mean
    DATA(lv_sum) TYPE f VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT lt_floats INTO DATA(lv_float).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_float.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_actual_mean) = lv_sum / lv_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_actual_mean > ( lv_mean - lv_std_dev ) AND lv_actual_mean < ( lv_mean + lv_std_dev ) ) msg = 'Actual mean should be close to expected mean' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Box-Muller-Transformation ist eine Methode zur Erzeugung von normalverteilten Zufallszahlen aus gleichverteilten Zufallszahlen. Durch die Verwendung von zwei Zufallszahlen aus `cl_abap_random_float` und mathematischen Funktionen wie `sqrt`, `log`, `cos` und `sin` können zwei normalverteilte Zufallszahlen erzeugt werden. Dies ist nützlich für komplexere Simulationen und statistische Analysen.
keywords: Random, Float, Normal Distribution, Box-Muller, cl_abap_random_float, ABAP 7.50, SABP_RANDOM, Float Zufallszahlen

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `cl_abap_corresponding` in einem Szenario, das dem Konzept von `SABP_DYN_MAP` entspricht, um Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle zu übertragen, wobei die Feldnamen dynamisch zur Laufzeit ermittelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding=>create` mit RTTI, um die Feldnamen dynamisch zu ermitteln und die `set_mapping_table` Methode zu verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sdbp_dyn_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             material_id TYPE string,
             quantity    TYPE i,
             unit        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             product_id  TYPE string,
             amount      TYPE i,
             measure     TYPE string,
             status      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dynamic_table_mapping
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sdbp_dyn_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_table_mapping.
    DATA: lt_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table.

    " Dynamische Definition der Mapping-Regeln zur Laufzeit
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'MATERIAL_ID' target_name = 'PRODUCT_ID' ) TO lt_mapping_rules.
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'QUANTITY'    target_name = 'AMOUNT'     ) TO lt_mapping_rules.
    APPEND VALUE #( source_name = 'UNIT'        target_name = 'MEASURE'    ) TO lt_mapping_rules.

    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table )
      target_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rt_target_table )
    ).

    lo_corresponding->set_mapping_table( lt_mapping_rules ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = it_source_table CHANGING target = rt_target_table ).

    " Zusätzliche Logik für Felder, die nicht gemappt wurden (z.B. Status setzen)
    LOOP AT rt_target_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_line>).
      IF <fs_target_line>-status IS INITIAL.
        <fs_target_line>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sdbp_dyn_map( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_sdbp_dyn_map=>tt_source_data(
      ( material_id = 'MAT100' quantity = 10 unit = 'PC' )

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->dynamic_table_mapping( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two lines should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-product_id exp = 'MAT100' msg = 'Product ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-amount exp = 10 msg = 'Amount should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-measure exp = 'PC' msg = 'Measure should be mapped' ).

Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und dynamische Datenübertragung zwischen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen, was in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Integration von Systemen oft erforderlich ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einer Liste von Feldern sortiert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` indirekt, um die Sortierfelder zu identifizieren, oder demonstrieren Sie eine dynamische Sortierung, die das Konzept der dynamischen Feldbehandlung unterstreicht.
hint: Für dynamische Sortierung ist `SORT itab BY (field_name)` oder `cl_abap_table_descr` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_corresponding` für die Feldidentifikation relevant.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field   TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE i,
             date_field  TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        it_sort_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.
    DATA(lv_sort_string) TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_sort_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      IF lv_sort_string IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_sort_string = lv_sort_string && ' '.
      ENDIF.
      lv_sort_string = lv_sort_string && lv_field_name.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_sort_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT rt_sorted_data BY (lv_sort_string).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

             value_field TYPE i,
             date_field  TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES: tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_sort_table_dynamically FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_table_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 20 date_field = '20250102' )
      ( key_field = 'A' value_field = 10 date_field = '20250101' )
      ( key_field = 'C' value_field = 30 date_field = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sort_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'KEY_FIELD' ) ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_by_key) = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_data it_sort_fields = lt_sort_fields ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_key[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' msg = 'Sorted by key_field (1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_key[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'B' msg = 'Sorted by key_field (2)' ).

    lt_sort_fields = VALUE string_table( ( 'VALUE_FIELD' ) ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_by_value) = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_data it_sort_fields = lt_sort_fields ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_value[ 1 ]-value_field exp = 10 msg = 'Sorted by value_field (1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_value[ 2 ]-value_field exp = 20 msg = 'Sorted by value_field (2)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `SORT` Anweisung mit einem dynamischen Feldnamen in Klammern `BY (field_name)` ist eine moderne und flexible Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zur Laufzeit zu sortieren.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von Zufallszahlen vom Typ Float, die eine gleichmäßige Verteilung in einem bestimmten Bereich aufweisen, und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife, um die Tabelle zu befüllen und dabei den Bereich zu skalieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_uniform_floats
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE f
        iv_max   TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_floats) TYPE tt_floats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_uniform_floats.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    rt_floats = REDUCE tt_floats( INIT result = VALUE tt_floats( )
                                  FOR i = 1 UNTIL iv_count
                                  NEXT result = VALUE tt_floats( BASE result
                                    ( iv_min + ( lo_random->get_next( ) * ( iv_max - iv_min ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_uniform_floats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_uniform_floats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10.
    DATA(lv_min) = 50.0.
    DATA(lv_max) = 100.0.
    DATA(lt_floats) = lo_cut->generate_uniform_floats( iv_count = lv_count iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_floats ) exp = lv_count msg = 'Table should contain correct number of entries' ).
    LOOP AT lt_floats INTO DATA(lv_float).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_float >= lv_min AND lv_float < lv_max ) msg = 'Each float should be within the specified range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Schleife und `cl_abap_random_float` ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Erzeugung einer internen Tabelle mit Zufallszahlen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für modernen ABAP-Stil, der imperative Schleifen durch deklarative Ausdrücke ersetzt.
keywords: Random, Float, REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, cl_abap_random_float, ABAP 7.50, SABP_RANDOM, Float Zufallszahlen

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag als Text basierend auf einer Zahl (1=Montag, 7=Sonntag). Nutzen Sie die moderne `COND` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND` Expression für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday IMPORTING iv_day TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_weekday) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday.
    rv_weekday = COND string(
      WHEN iv_day = 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN iv_day = 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN iv_day = 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN iv_day = 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN iv_day = 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN iv_day = 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN iv_day = 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_invalid_day FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weekday_resolver( ).
    DATA(lv_weekday) = lo_cut->get_weekday( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weekday exp = 'Montag' msg = 'Sollte Montag sein' ).
    lv_weekday = lo_cut->get_weekday( 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weekday exp = 'Sonntag' msg = 'Sollte Sonntag sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weekday_resolver( ).
    DATA(lv_weekday) = lo_cut->get_weekday( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weekday exp = 'Ungültiger Tag' msg = 'Sollte ungültiger Tag sein' ).
    lv_weekday = lo_cut->get_weekday( 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weekday exp = 'Ungültiger Tag' msg = 'Sollte ungültiger Tag sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_dialogbox_container` vor und demonstrieren Sie die Übergabe an ein hypothetisches Custom Control.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR` für die Datenaufbereitung. Simulieren Sie die Übergabe an ein Control.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_preparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES tt_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_display.

    METHODS display_flights_in_container
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_preparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_display.
    SELECT f~carrid, f~connid, f~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto, f~price
      FROM sflights AS f
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON f~carrid = p~carrid AND f~connid = p~connid
      WHERE f~carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights_in_container.
    DATA(lo_dialog_container) = NEW cl_gui_dialogbox_container(
      parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      width  = 800
      height = 600
      caption = 'Flugdaten'
    ).

    " Hypothetisches Custom Control, z.B. ein ALV Grid
    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_dialog_container
    ).

    " Daten an das ALV Grid übergeben (vereinfacht)
    TRY.
        lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA_PREPARER=>TY_FLIGHT_DISPLAY'
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = it_flights
        ).
        lo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.

    " In einem echten Szenario müsste der Dynpro-Flow und PBO/PAI behandelt werden.
    " Hier nur die logische Übergabe.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dialog_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             param2   TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_dialog_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_dialog_event.
    ms_last_event_data = is_event_data.

    CASE is_event_data-event_id.
      WHEN 'BUTTON_CLICK'.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Button '{ is_event_data-param1 }' geklickt mit Wert '{ is_event_data-param2 }'.| ).
      WHEN 'VALUE_CHANGE'.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Wert von Feld '{ is_event_data-param1 }' geändert zu '{ is_event_data-param2 }'.| ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Unbekanntes Ereignis: '{ is_event_data-event_id }'.| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_processed_event.
    rs_event_data = ms_last_event_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_temp_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_temp_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_temperature.
    CASE iv_temperature.
      WHEN -273 TO 0. " Absoluter Nullpunkt bis Gefrierpunkt
        rv_category = 'Kalt'.
      WHEN 1 TO 20. " Kühle bis mäßige Temperaturen
        rv_category = 'Mäßig'.
      WHEN 21 TO 35. " Angenehme bis warme Temperaturen
        rv_category = 'Warm'.
      WHEN OTHERS. " Alles darüber hinaus
        rv_category = 'Heiß'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für Flüge, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen (z.B. spezifischer Carrier oder Connection), unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `CASE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über `sflights` und `CASE` innerhalb der Schleife, um bedingt zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE sflights-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( iv_carrid IS INITIAL OR flight-carrid = iv_carrid )
        AND ( iv_connid IS INITIAL OR flight-connid = iv_connid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).

    " Alternative mit CASE innerhalb von REDUCE (falls komplexere Bedingungen nötig wären)
    " rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
    "   INIT sum = 0
    "   FOR flight IN lt_sflights
    "   NEXT sum = sum + COND i(
    "     WHEN flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND flight-connid = iv_connid THEN flight-seatsocc
    "     WHEN iv_carrid IS INITIAL AND flight-connid = iv_connid THEN flight-seatsocc
    "     WHEN iv_connid IS INITIAL AND flight-carrid = iv_carrid THEN flight-seatsocc
    "     WHEN iv_carrid IS INITIAL AND iv_connid IS INITIAL THEN flight-seatsocc
    "     ELSE 0
    "   )
    " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge vor der Aggregation. Die auskommentierte Alternative zeigt, wie `COND` (eine Form von `CASE`) direkt innerhalb von `REDUCE` für komplexere bedingte Logik verwendet werden könnte. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und kompakter Ansatz für Datenverarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_dialog_with_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine dynamische Statusmeldung basierend auf einem Statuscode unter Verwendung von `CASE` und String Templates.

CLASS zcl_status_message_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
        iv_item_name   TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_message_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_status_message.
    CASE iv_status_code.
      WHEN 0.
        rv_message = |{ iv_item_name DEFAULT 'Vorgang' } erfolgreich abgeschlossen.|.
      WHEN 1.
        rv_message = |Warnung: { iv_item_name DEFAULT 'Vorgang' } mit Problemen beendet.|.
      WHEN 2.
        rv_message = |Fehler: { iv_item_name DEFAULT 'Vorgang' } konnte nicht verarbeitet werden.|.
      WHEN OTHERS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` zur Transformation von `sflights` Daten in ein anzeigbares Format. Simulieren Sie die Datenbindung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_binding_dialog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_item,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_item.
    TYPES tt_flight_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dialog
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_flight_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_binding_dialog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dialog.
    ro_container = NEW cl_gui_dialogbox_container(
      parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      width  = 400
      height = 300
      caption = |Flugdetails für { iv_carrid }|
    ).

    DATA(lt_flight_data) = get_flight_details( iv_carrid ).

    " Hypothetisches Custom Control, das eine Liste von Key-Value-Paaren anzeigt
    " In einem echten Szenario wäre dies z.B. ein CL_GUI_LISTVIEW oder ein eigenes Control
    DATA(lo_custom_list_control) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(" Platzhalter für ein Custom Control
      parent = ro_container
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_windowborder
    ).

    DATA(lv_display_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT text = ''
      FOR item IN lt_flight_data
      NEXT text = |{ text }{ item-key }: { item-value }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
    ).

    lo_custom_list_control->set_text_as_stream( lv_display_text ).

    ro_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_flight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = '0400'. " Beispiel-Flug

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rt_items = VALUE #( (
        key = 'Carrier'
        value = ls_flight-carrid
      ) (
        key = 'Connection'
        value = ls_flight-connid
      ) (
        key = 'Date'
        value = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
      ) (
        key = 'Occupied Seats'
        value = |{ ls_flight-seatsocc }|
      ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_dialog_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dialog_size,
             width  TYPE i,
             height TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dialog_size.

    METHODS create_dynamic_dialog
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
        iv_size_preset TYPE string " 'SMALL', 'MEDIUM', 'LARGE'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_dialog_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_dialog.
    DATA(ls_size) = VALUE ty_dialog_size(
      width = 0
      height = 0
    ).

    CASE iv_size_preset.
      WHEN 'SMALL'.
        ls_size-width = 300.
        ls_size-height = 200.
      WHEN 'MEDIUM'.
        ls_size-width = 600.
        ls_size-height = 400.
      WHEN 'LARGE'.
        ls_size-width = 900.
        ls_size-height = 600.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        ls_size-width = 500. " Default
        ls_size-height = 300. " Default
    ENDCASE.

    ro_container = NEW cl_gui_dialogbox_container(
      parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      width  = ls_size-width
      height = ls_size-height
      caption = iv_title
    ).

    ro_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_logger_factory IMPLEMENTATION.

    CASE iv_logger_type.
      WHEN 'CONSOLE'.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Standard-Logger oder Fehlerbehandlung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_dialogbox_container` und einen Button darin. Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für den Button-Klick, wobei die Aktion basierend auf dem Button-Text mit `CASE` unterschieden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_button` und registrieren Sie ein Ereignis. Nutzen Sie `CASE` im Ereignishandler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_button_dialog_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_button_dialog
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    DATA mo_button_ok        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    DATA mo_button_cancel    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button
      IMPORTING
        sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_button_dialog_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_button_dialog.
    mo_dialog_container = NEW cl_gui_dialogbox_container(
      parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      width  = 400
      height = 150
      caption = iv_title
    ).

    mo_button_ok = NEW cl_gui_button(
      parent = mo_dialog_container
      text   = 'OK'
      left   = 50
      top    = 50
    ).

    mo_button_cancel = NEW cl_gui_button(
      parent = mo_dialog_container
      text   = 'Abbrechen'
      left   = 150
      top    = 50
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button_ok.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button_cancel.

    mo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    DATA(lo_button) = CAST cl_gui_button( sender ).
    DATA(lv_button_text) = lo_button->get_text( ).

    CASE lv_button_text.
      WHEN 'OK'.
        cl_demo_output=>display( 'OK-Button geklickt. Dialog wird geschlossen.' ).
        mo_dialog_container->free( ).
      WHEN 'Abbrechen'.
        cl_demo_output=>display( 'Abbrechen-Button geklickt. Dialog wird geschlossen.' ).
        mo_dialog_container->free( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Unbekannter Button '{ lv_button_text }' geklickt.| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Preis eines Produkts inklusive Mehrwertsteuer, wobei der Mehrwertsteuersatz je nach Produktkategorie variiert. Nutzen Sie `CASE` für die Bestimmung des Steuersatzes.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` zur Auswahl des korrekten Mehrwertsteuersatzes und eine einfache Multiplikation für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tax_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_product_category TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_category,
                 standard TYPE ty_product_category VALUE 'STANDARD',
                 reduced  TYPE ty_product_category VALUE 'REDUCED',
                 exempt   TYPE ty_product_category VALUE 'EXEMPT',
               END OF gc_category.

    METHODS calculate_price_with_tax
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE decfloat16
        iv_category   TYPE ty_product_category
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tax_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_with_tax.
    DATA(lv_tax_rate) = 0.0.

    CASE iv_category.
      WHEN gc_category-standard.
        lv_tax_rate = 0.19. " 19% Standard-MWSt
      WHEN gc_category-reduced.
        lv_tax_rate = 0.07. " 7% Reduzierter MWSt
      WHEN gc_category-exempt.
        lv_tax_rate = 0.0.  " 0% Befreit von MWSt
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Standard-Steuersatz oder Fehlerbehandlung
        lv_tax_rate = 0.19.
    ENDCASE.

    rv_total_price = iv_base_price * ( 1 + lv_tax_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_utilization,
             carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
             avg_util    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_utilization.
    TYPES tt_carrier_utilization TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_utilization WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_carrier_utilization
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_utilization) TYPE tt_carrier_utilization.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_carrier_utilization.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_seats_occ) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_seats_max) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsmax
      ).

      DATA(lv_avg_util) = COND decfloat16(
        WHEN lv_total_seats_max > 0 THEN lv_total_seats_occ / lv_total_seats_max
        ELSE 0
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_utilization(
        carrid   = ls_group_key-carrid
        avg_util = lv_avg_util
      ) TO rt_utilization.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_range_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_filter_flights.
    rt_carrid_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights
        WHERE ( carrid IN it_carrid_range )
        GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS carrid
        ( carrid = carrid
          count  = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Range-Tabelle als Importparameter akzeptiert und diese verwendet, um eine einfache Validierung durchzuführen. Die Range-Tabelle soll die Struktur von Konstanten aus `if_fsbp_const_range` widerspiegeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `COND` für die Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_generic,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE string,
             high   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_range_generic.
    TYPES: tt_range_generic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_generic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_value_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
        it_range TYPE tt_range_generic
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_in_range.
    " This is a simplified check. A full range check would be more complex.
    " Here, we check if the value is explicitly included (EQ) or excluded (EQ)
    " based on the range table, simulating the use of if_fsbp_const_range constants.
    rv_is_in_range = abap_false.

    LOOP AT it_range INTO DATA(ls_range).
      IF ls_range-sign = 'I' AND ls_range-option = 'EQ' AND ls_range-low = iv_value.
        rv_is_in_range = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_range-sign = 'E' AND ls_range-option = 'EQ' AND ls_range-low = iv_value.
        rv_is_in_range = abap_false. " Explicitly excluded
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      " More complex logic for BT, CP, etc. would go here
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` hierarchisch in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree` an, gruppiert nach `CARRID` und dann `CONNID`. Die Lösung konzentriert sich auf die Datenaufbereitung für den Tree Control.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` und seine Methoden `add_node` oder `add_nodes_and_item`. Für die Datenaufbereitung nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_nodes
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_sflight_node.

    " In a real report, you would instantiate cl_gui_simple_tree and call its methods.
    " For this example, we focus on data preparation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_nodes.
    DATA: lv_carrid_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_connid_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
    DATA: lv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SORT it_sflights BY carrid connid.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      lv_carrid_key = |CARR_{ lv_node_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
      APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_carrid_key
                      parent_key = ''
                      text = |Airline: { ls_sflight-carrid }| ) TO rt_nodes.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_connid_group).
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        lv_connid_key = |CONN_{ lv_node_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
        APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_connid_key
                        parent_key = lv_carrid_key
                        text = |Flight: { ls_connid_group-connid } ({ ls_connid_group-fldate })| ) TO rt_nodes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_nodes_with_details.
    DATA: lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    lv_node_key = |NODE_{ lv_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.

                    parent_key = lv_parent_key
                    text = 'Child Item 1'
                    icon = icon_led_green
                    tooltip = 'Status: OK' ) TO rt_nodes.

    lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    lv_node_key = |NODE_{ lv_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
    APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_node_key
                    parent_key = lv_parent_key
                    text = 'Child Item 2'

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES: tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_initial_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_node_data.

    METHODS update_node_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_new_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
        it_current_nodes TYPE tt_node_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_nodes) TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_nodes.
    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' parent_key = '' text = 'Tasks' status = 'O' ) " O for Open
      ( node_key = 'TASK1' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Task A' status = 'O' )
      ( node_key = 'TASK2' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Task B' status = 'O' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_node_status.
    rt_updated_nodes = it_current_nodes.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_node) = rt_updated_nodes[ KEY node_key COMPONENTS node_key = iv_node_key ].
        ls_node-status = iv_new_status.
        MODIFY rt_updated_nodes FROM ls_node INDEX sy-tabix.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Node not found, handle error or ignore
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_reduce_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights_to_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_reduce_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_to_tree.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    SORT it_sflights BY carrid connid.

    rt_tree_nodes = REDUCE tt_tree_node(
      INIT nodes = VALUE tt_tree_node( )
           carrid_key_map = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
           lv_node_count = 0
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      LET carrid_node_key = |CARR_{ lv_node_count + 1 ALPHA = OUT }| IN
        nodes = VALUE #( nodes
                         ( node_key = carrid_node_key parent_key = '' text = |Airline: { ls_flight-carrid }| ) )
        carrid_key_map = VALUE #( carrid_key_map ( ls_flight-carrid = carrid_node_key ) )
        lv_node_count = lv_node_count + 1
        FOR ls_connid_group IN GROUP ls_flight
        LET connid_node_key = |CONN_{ lv_node_count + 1 ALPHA = OUT }| IN
          nodes = VALUE #( nodes
                           ( node_key = connid_node_key parent_key = carrid_key_map[ ls_flight-carrid ] text = |Flight: { ls_connid_group-connid } ({ ls_connid_group-fldate })| ) )
          lv_node_count = lv_node_count + 1
      IN
        nodes
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Knoten für einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` generiert, wobei die Node-Schlüssel und Parent-Schlüssel mit String-Templates dynamisch erzeugt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die dynamische Erzeugung von Schlüsseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_string_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_keyed_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_name TYPE string
        iv_num_children TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_string_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_keyed_nodes.
    DATA(lv_root_key) = |ROOT_{ iv_root_name ALPHA = OUT }|.

    APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_root_key parent_key = '' text = |Root: { iv_root_name }| ) TO rt_nodes.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( rt_nodes
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_num_children
      ( node_key = |CHILD_{ iv_root_name ALPHA = OUT }_{ i ALPHA = OUT }|
        parent_key = lv_root_key
        text = |Child { i } of { iv_root_name }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR` Expressions für komplexe Hierarchien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_categories TYPE i
        iv_num_items_per_category TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR c = 1 THEN c + 1 UNTIL c > iv_num_categories
      LET category_key = |CAT_{ c ALPHA = OUT }| IN
        ( node_key = category_key parent_key = '' text = |Category { c }| )
        ( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_num_items_per_category
          ( node_key = |ITEM_{ c ALPHA = OUT }_{ i ALPHA = OUT }|
            parent_key = category_key
            text = |Item { c }.{ i }| ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        col1 TYPE string,
        col2 TYPE string,
        col3 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv_reader) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_data = iv_csv_string
      i_has_header = abap_true
      i_delimiter = ','
    ).

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_csv_reader->get_table( ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw_line>).
      " Assuming the order of columns is fixed and matches ty_data
      APPEND VALUE ty_data(
        col1 = <fs_raw_line>[ 1 ]
        col2 = <fs_raw_line>[ 2 ]
        col3 = <fs_raw_line>[ 3 ]
      ) TO rt_parsed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_sflight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_prev_month.
    DATA(lo_time_formatter) = NEW cl_abap_timefm( ).

    DATA(lv_prev_month_date) = lo_time_formatter->add_months(
      i_date   = iv_date
      i_months = -1

    " Get the last day of that previous month

      i_date = lv_prev_month_date
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_month_days_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_in_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year  TYPE syear
        iv_month TYPE sy_monat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_month_days_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_in_month.
    DATA(lo_time_formatter) = NEW cl_abap_timefm( ).

    " Construct a date for the first day of the given month/year
    DATA(lv_date_in_month) = lo_time_formatter->create_date(
      i_year  = iv_year
      i_month = iv_month
      i_day   = 1
    ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und mehr als 100 freie Sitze haben. Speichern Sie die Flugnummern und Abflugorte in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `WHERE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      ty_flight_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom DEFAULT 'FRANKFURT'
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_info_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
        WHERE ( flight-cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND
                flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc > iv_min_free_seats )
        ( carrid   = flight-carrid
          connid   = flight-connid
          fldate   = flight-fldate
          cityfrom = flight-cityfrom
          seatsocc = flight-seatsocc
          seatsmax = flight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_min_free_seats = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      msg = 'Es wurden keine gefilterten Flüge gefunden. Prüfen Sie die SFLIGHT-Daten oder die Filterkriterien.'
      cond = lt_filtered IS NOT INITIAL
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'FRANKFURT' act = ls_flight-cityfrom ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) > 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE`-Klausel und `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP`s und `APPEND`s und ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionales Programmieren in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, FILTER, VALUE, Open SQL

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Logger) über ihren Konstruktor erhält, um das Prinzip der Dependency Injection zu demonstrieren.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle für die Abhängigkeit und übergeben Sie eine Implementierung im Konstruktor.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    METHODS constructor.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde dies in eine Protokolldatei oder das Systemprotokoll schreiben.
    " Für die Demo simulieren wir es nur.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger. " Logger-Funktionalität bei Bedarf exponieren
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
    METHODS perform_action.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD perform_action.
    mo_logger->log_message( 'Service-Aktion ausgeführt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_service_with_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_service_with_logger.
    " Erstellen Sie einen Mock-Logger für Testzwecke
    DATA(lo_mock_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ). " In einem echten Test wäre dies ein Test-Double

    " Injizieren Sie den Logger in den Service
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_service( io_logger = lo_mock_logger ).

    " Führen Sie die Aktion aus
    lo_service->perform_action( ).

    " Prüfen Sie, ob die Logger-Methode aufgerufen wurde (dies würde ein Test-Double-Framework erfordern)
    " Der Einfachheit halber stellen wir nur sicher, dass kein Dump auftritt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = 1 " Platzhalter für eine echte Assertion
      msg = 'Service-Aktion sollte ohne Dump ausgeführt werden.'
      cond = 1 = 1 " Immer wahr, benötigt ein geeignetes Mock-Framework für eine echte Assertion
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein grundlegendes Prinzip der Dependency Injection, das die Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit von Code verbessert. Durch die Übergabe von Abhängigkeiten über den Konstruktor wird die Kopplung reduziert. Die Verwendung von Interfaces ist hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: Object Orientation, Dependency Injection, Constructor Injection, Interfaces, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flügen aus `SFLIGHT`, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und sortieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und `SORTED BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      ty_flight_key_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
        WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_flight_key_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid )
      SORTED BY carrid connid
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sorted_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorted_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_projection( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_keys )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flugschlüssel gelesen werden.'
      cond = lt_flight_keys IS NOT INITIAL
    ).
    " Prüfen, ob die Tabelle sortiert ist (einfache Prüfung der ersten beiden Elemente)
    IF lines( lt_flight_keys ) >= 2.
      DATA(ls_first) = lt_flight_keys[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_second) = lt_flight_keys[ 2 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ls_first-carrid LE ls_second-carrid AND
               ( ls_first-carrid LT ls_second-carrid OR ls_first-connid LE ls_second-connid )
        msg = 'Die Tabelle sollte sortiert sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und der `SORTED BY`-Klausel ermöglicht eine direkte Projektion und Sortierung von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine neue Zieltabelle. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, die explizite `LOOP`s und `SORT`-Anweisungen überflüssig macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, SORTED BY, Projection, Functional Programming

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen aus einem String und ersetzen Sie mehrere Leerzeichen innerhalb des Strings durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktionen `condense` und `replace` mit regulären Ausdrücken oder String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    " Führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernen und mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes ersetzen
    rv_output = replace( val = iv_input regex = '\s+' with = ` ` ).
    rv_output = condense( rv_output ). " Entfernt führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_test_string) = `  Dies   ist  ein   Test-String.  `.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Dies ist ein Test-String.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string( lv_test_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      exp = lv_expected
      act = lv_result
      msg = 'Der String sollte bereinigt sein.'
    ).

    lv_test_string = `Keine Leerzeichen`.

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von `replace` mit regulären Ausdrücken (`\s+` für ein oder mehrere Leerzeichen) und `condense` bietet eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit zur String-Bereinigung. Dies ist kompakter und leistungsfähiger als ältere Ansätze mit mehreren `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` oder manuellen Schleifen.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, REGEX, CONDENSE, String-Funktionen

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Ganzzahl von 10 herunterzählt, bis sie 0 erreicht. Geben Sie jeden Schritt in einer internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und `APPEND` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_countdown DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS countdown_from_ten RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_countdown IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD countdown_from_ten.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 10.
    WHILE lv_counter >= 0.
      APPEND lv_counter TO rt_result.
      lv_counter = lv_counter - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->countdown_from_ten( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 11 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 11 ] exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    ELSE IF iv_temperature <= 20.
      rv_description = 'Mäßig'.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) zeilenweise, bis ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gefunden wird oder die Tabelle endet. Geben Sie die Anzahl der verarbeiteten Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `SY-TABIX` und `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_sflights ).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
        IF ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
    " Assert that count is reasonable, e.g., less than total flights if 'LH' is found early
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_total_flights.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_than( act = lv_count exp = lv_total_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `WHILE` für die iterative Verarbeitung einer internen Tabelle, kombiniert mit `READ TABLE INDEX` und `EXIT` für eine bedingte Beendigung. `SELECT INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist ein modernes Feature.
keywords: WHILE, READ TABLE, SY-TABIX, SELECT, Interne Tabelle, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein Flug (aus sflight) sowohl eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft als auch eine bestimmte Flugnummer hat und ob die Anzahl der freien Sitze größer als Null ist. Geben Sie 'TRUE' oder 'FALSE' zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_availability
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_available) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_availability.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax.
      rv_is_available = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_available = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
