Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen String Zeichen für Zeichen verarbeitet und alle Ziffern extrahiert, bis ein nicht-numerisches Zeichen oder das Ende des Strings erreicht ist. Geben Sie die extrahierten Ziffern als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `FIND FIRST OF` oder `COND` mit `IS NUMERIC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_digit_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_digits IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_digits) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_digit_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_digits.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      DATA(lv_char) = iv_input+lv_offset(1).
      IF lv_char CO '0123456789'. " Check if character is a digit
        rv_digits = rv_digits && lv_char.
        lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_only_digits FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_no_digits FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_digit_extractor( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_digits( '12345' ) exp = '12345' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_mixed_start_digits.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_digit_extractor( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_digits( '123ABC456' ) exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_no_digits.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_digit_extractor( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_digits( 'ABC' ) exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `WHILE`-Schleife zur iterativen String-Verarbeitung. `strlen` und String-Offsets (`iv_input+lv_offset(1)`) sind Standard, aber die Kombination mit `WHILE` und `IF` für eine benutzerdefinierte Parsing-Logik ist hier der Fokus. `&&` für String-Verkettung ist modern.
keywords: WHILE, String, Parsing, Ziffern, IF, String-Verkettung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Status eines Fluges (aus sflight) basierend auf dem Datum und der Belegung bestimmt: 'Geplant' (Flugdatum in der Zukunft), 'Verspätet' (Flugdatum heute, aber noch nicht abgeflogen), 'Voll' (Flugdatum heute/Vergangenheit und Sitze belegt), 'Abgeflogen' (Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit und Sitze nicht voll).
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF` mit `sy-datum` und `COND` für die Statuszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING is_sflight TYPE sflight
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    IF is_sflight-fldate > lv_today.
      rv_status = 'Geplant'.
    ELSE IF is_sflight-fldate = lv_today.
      IF is_sflight-seatsocc < is_sflight-seatsmax.
        rv_status = 'Verspätet'. " Annahme: Heute und noch nicht voll = verspätet/offen
      ELSE.
        rv_status = 'Voll'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      IF is_sflight-seatsocc < is_sflight-seatsmax.
        rv_status = 'Abgeflogen'. " Annahme: Vergangenheit und nicht voll = abgeflogen
      ELSE.
        rv_status = 'Voll'. " Annahme: Vergangenheit und voll = voll abgeflogen
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine einfache Warteschlangenverarbeitung: Eine Methode soll Elemente aus einer internen Tabelle entfernen und verarbeiten, bis die Tabelle leer ist. Geben Sie die verarbeiteten Elemente in der Reihenfolge ihrer Verarbeitung zurück.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_queue IMPORTING it_input TYPE string_table
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_input.

    WHILE lines( lt_queue ) > 0.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_element).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_element TO rt_processed.
        DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um den Divisor zu dekrementieren, bis er nicht mehr Null ist, und führen Sie dann die Division durch. Geben Sie das Ergebnis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `IF` zur Überprüfung des Divisors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_safely IMPORTING iv_dividend TYPE i
                                    iv_divisor  TYPE i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
                            RAISING   cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safely.
    DATA(lv_current_divisor) = iv_divisor.

    WHILE lv_current_divisor = 0.
      " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier eine andere Logik haben,
      " z.B. eine Fehlermeldung oder einen Standardwert setzen.
      " Hier dekrementieren wir nur zur Demonstration.
      lv_current_divisor = lv_current_divisor - 1.
      IF lv_current_divisor < -100. " Schutz vor Endlosschleife
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Divisor could not be made non-zero'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = iv_dividend / lv_current_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_remove_leading_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_zeros IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_remove_leading_zeros IMPLEMENTATION.

      lv_temp_string = lv_temp_string+1.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Addieren Sie jede Zahl zur Summe, bis die Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Geben Sie die endgültige Summe und die Anzahl der addierten Elemente zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `LOOP AT` mit `INDEX` oder `ASSIGNING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             sum     TYPE i,
             count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.

    METHODS calculate_sum_until_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_until_threshold.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= iv_threshold AND lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ).
      READ TABLE it_numbers INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_number.
        lv_current_count = lv_current_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rs_result-sum = lv_current_sum.
    rs_result-count = lv_current_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hash-Tabelle, wobei der Fluggesellschaftscode der Schlüssel ist und die Anzahl der Flüge der Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_flights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES ty_flight_count_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_flights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE ty_flight_count_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_flight_count_tab( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET count = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_flight_count_tab( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid count = count ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
    DATA(ls_count_lh) = VALUE zcl_count_flights_reduce=>ty_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_count_lh WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge aus `sflights`, die entweder von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen oder mehr als 200 freie Sitze haben. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `COND`-Expression, um die Zählbedingung zu definieren.

CLASS zcl_cond_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_conditional_flight_count
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_flight_count.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT count = count + COND #( WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' OR flight-seatsocc < flight-seatsmax - 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze (z.B. 'Viele', 'Mittel', 'Wenige') und zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge in jede Kategorie fallen. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `SWITCH`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Kategorien zu bestimmen und zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_count_categories DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_seat_category_count,
             category TYPE string,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_seat_category_count.
    TYPES ty_seat_category_count_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_seat_category_count WITH UNIQUE KEY category.

    METHODS get_seat_category_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_category_counts) TYPE ty_seat_category_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_count_categories IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seat_category_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_category_counts = REDUCE ty_seat_category_count_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_seat_category_count_tab(
        ( category = 'Viele'  count = 0 )
        ( category = 'Mittel' count = 0 )
        ( category = 'Wenige' count = 0 )
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_seat_category_count_tab( BASE result
        ( category = SWITCH string(
                     WHEN free_seats > 100 THEN 'Viele'
                     WHEN free_seats > 20  THEN 'Mittel'
                     ELSE 'Wenige' )
          count = result[ category = SWITCH string(
                                   WHEN free_seats > 100 THEN 'Viele'
                                   WHEN free_seats > 20  THEN 'Mittel'
                                   ELSE 'Wenige' ) ]-count + 1
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_seat_category_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_seat_category_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_count_categories( ).
    DATA(lt_category_counts) = lo_cut->get_seat_category_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_category_counts ).

    DATA(lv_total_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_category_counts INTO DATA(ls_cat_count).
      lv_total_count = lv_total_count + ls_cat_count-count.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_cat_count-count >= 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_sflights_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_sflights_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_count exp = lv_sflights_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine moderne und flexible Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF-ELSE IF`-Strukturen oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. In diesem Beispiel wird `SWITCH` innerhalb eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks verwendet, um Flüge zu kategorisieren und die Zähler für jede Kategorie zu aktualisieren. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und gut lesbarem Code für komplexe bedingte Logik und Aggregationen.
keywords: SWITCH, Constructor Expressions, Conditional Logic, COUNT, REDUCE, 7.50

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in der Tabelle `sflights` existiert, und zählen Sie die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften in der Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` für die Existenzprüfung und `lines( DISTINCT ... )` oder `REDUCE` für die Zählung eindeutiger Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS count_unique_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_unique_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_unique_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( flight-carrid )
    ).
    rv_unique_count = lines( lt_unique_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für das Zählen eindeutiger Einträge wird hier eine Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle mit nur den eindeutigen Schlüsseln zu erstellen, deren Zeilen dann mit `lines()` gezählt werden. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf eine ganze Zahl. Zählen Sie auch die Anzahl der Flüge, die in die Berechnung einbezogen wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `nmax` für die Zählung, sowie `round()` für die Rundung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_seats_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE REF TO zcl_avg_seats_count=>ty_avg_result.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_result,
             avg_seats TYPE i,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_avg_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_seats_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE ty_avg_result(
      INIT total_seats = 0
           flight_count = 0
           avg_seats    = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      NEXT total_seats = total_seats + flight-seatsocc,
           flight_count = flight_count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-flight_count > 0.
      ls_aggregation-avg_seats = round( val = ( ls_aggregation-total_seats / ls_aggregation-flight_count ) dec = 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_result = NEW ty_avg_result( ls_aggregation ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie dynamisch die Anzahl der Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle, deren Typ zur Laufzeit unbekannt ist. Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Tabelle zu identifizieren und die Zeilen zu zählen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_line_count
      IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_line_count.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    CHECK ir_data IS BOUND.

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).

    IF lo_descr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
      ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lt_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_count = lines( <lt_table> ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_count( ).

    DATA(lv_count_sflights) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_line_count( REF #( lt_sflights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_sflights > 0 ).

    DATA lt_empty_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    DATA(lv_count_empty) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_line_count( REF #( lt_empty_table ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_empty exp = 0 ).

    DATA lv_single_var TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA(lv_count_single) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_line_count( REF #( lv_single_var ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_single exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` kann der Typ einer Variablen zur Laufzeit ermittelt werden. CLASS zcl_flight_seats_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_seats_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' AND fldate > sy-datum )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' text = 'Occupied Seats' ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    lo_xlsx->add_sheet_from_itab( EXPORTING

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus einer dynamisch erstellten internen Tabelle in eine XLSX-Datei. Die Struktur der Tabelle ist zur Entwicklungszeit nicht bekannt.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um die Struktur der dynamischen Tabelle zu ermitteln und an `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` zu übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_dynamic_itab_to_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_sheet_name TYPE string DEFAULT 'Dynamic Data'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_itab_to_xlsx.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_data> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF <lt_data> IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    " RTTI to get the table type description
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_data> ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_struct_descr ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = ls_component-name text = ls_component-name ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xlsx->add_sheet_from_itab( EXPORTING
      i_tab = <lt_data>
      i_sheet_name = iv_sheet_name
      i_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_xlsx_file( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften aus `scarr` enthält, deren Währung 'EUR' ist und die mindestens 3 Flüge in `sflights` haben. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `WHERE` für die Aggregation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carriers.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR carrier IN lt_scarr
                           WHERE ( currcode = 'EUR' )
                           LET flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0
                                                        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                                        WHERE ( carrid = carrier-carrid )
                                                        NEXT c = c + 1 )
                           IN WHERE ( flight_count >= 3 )
                           ( carrier ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             avg_seats_max TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                          ( carrid        = flight-carrid
                            flight_count  = GROUP SIZE
                            avg_seats_max = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                                               FOR member IN GROUP
                                                               NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax
                                                                    count = count + 1
                                                               FINAL = COND decfloat16( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

BY`-Syntax in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe, während `REDUCE` für komplexere Aggregationen wie den Durchschnitt verwendet wird.

    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_dynamic_data( ( field1 = 'Test1' field2 = 10 ) ( field1 = 'Test2' field2 = 20 ) ).
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_dynamic_table( lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' act = lv_json exp = '' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain Field1' substring = '"FIELD1":"Test1"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain Field2' substring = '"FIELD2":10' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `cl_fdt_json` zur Serialisierung dynamischer Daten. Durch die Übergabe eines Datenreferenz (`TYPE REF TO data`) kann die Methode mit beliebigen internen Tabellen umgehen. `cl_fdt_json` nutzt intern RTTI, um die Struktur der übergebenen Daten zur Laufzeit zu analysieren und korrekt in JSON zu konvertieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Schnittstellen.
keywords: JSON, Serialisierung, Dynamisch, RTTI, cl_fdt_json, Datenreferenz

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_button DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_functions.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_button.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    METHODS if_salv_events_functions~added_function.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_button IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_button.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_functions) = mo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ). " Alle Standardfunktionen aktivieren

        " Benutzerdefinierte Funktion hinzufügen
        lo_functions->add_function(
          name     = 'MY_BUTTON'
          icon     = icon_information
          tooltip  = 'Mein Custom Button'
          text     = 'Custom'
          position = if_salv_c_function_position=>right_of_salv_functions
        ).

        " Ereignisbehandler registrieren
        SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_functions~added_function FOR mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).

        mo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_functions~added_function.
    IF e_salv_function = 'MY_BUTTON'.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine bedingte Formatierung für Zeilen in einem ALV, das SFLIGHTS-Daten anzeigt. Zeilen mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert sollen farblich hervorgehoben werden.
hint: Fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte für die Farbe hinzu und verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table->set_color_column( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_colored.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             sflight TYPE sflight,
             row_color TYPE lvc_t_scol,
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.
    TYPES tt_sflight_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_colored.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflights_colored TYPE tt_sflight_colored,
          ls_sflight_colored  TYPE ty_sflight_colored.

    CONSTANTS: lc_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price VALUE '500.00'.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      ls_sflight_colored-sflight = ls_sflight.
      IF ls_sflight-price > lc_price_threshold.
        ls_sflight_colored-row_color = VALUE lvc_t_scol( ( fname = 'CARRID' color-col = 6 color-int = 0 color-inv = 0 ) ).
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_colored TO lt_sflights_colored.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights_colored
        ).

        " Farbspalte setzen
        lo_salv_table->set_color_column( 'ROW_COLOR' ).

        " ROW_COLOR Spalte ausblenden
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_color_col) = lo_columns->get_column( 'ROW_COLOR' ).
        lo_color_col->set_visible( abap_false ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_conditional_format FOR TESTING.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

CLASS zcl_alv_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_alv_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_grouped.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(

          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING

        " Sortierung für Gruppierung hinzufügen
        DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_salv_table->get_sorts( ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort(
          columnname = 'CARRID'
          position   = 1
          subtotal   = abap_true " Zwischensumme für diese Gruppe
        ).

        " Aggregation (Summe) für die Spalte 'PRICE' hinzufügen
        DATA(lo_aggregations) = lo_salv_table->get_aggregations( ).
        lo_aggregations->add_aggregation( columnname = 'PRICE' aggregation = if_salv_c_aggregation=>sum ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV mit einer benutzerdefinierten Zelle, die ein Icon basierend auf einem Wert anzeigt. Zeigen Sie SFLIGHTS-Daten an und verwenden Sie ein Icon für Flüge mit hohem Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_column_list` oder `cl_salv_column_tree` für die Icon-Spalte und `cl_salv_table->set_cell_type( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_cell DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_icon.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_icon,
             sflight TYPE sflight,
             price_icon TYPE icon_d,
           END OF ty_sflight_icon.
    TYPES tt_sflight_icon TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_icon WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_cell IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_icon.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflights_icon TYPE tt_sflight_icon,
          ls_sflight_icon  TYPE ty_sflight_icon.

    CONSTANTS: lc_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price VALUE '700.00'.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      ls_sflight_icon-sflight = ls_sflight.
      IF ls_sflight-price > lc_price_threshold.
        ls_sflight_icon-price_icon = icon_led_red.
      ELSE.
        ls_sflight_icon-price_icon = icon_led_green.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_icon TO lt_sflights_icon.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights_icon
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_price_icon_col) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE_ICON' ).
        lo_price_icon_col->set_long_text( 'Preisstatus' ).
        lo_price_icon_col->set_medium_text( 'Status' ).
        lo_price_icon_col->set_short_text( 'St' ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Um Icons in ALV-Zellen anzuzeigen, wird eine zusätzliche Spalte in der internen Tabelle vom Typ `ICON_D` (oder ähnlichem) verwendet. Das ALV erkennt diesen Typ automatisch und rendert das entsprechende Icon. Dies ermöglicht eine visuell ansprechende Darstellung von Statusinformationen oder anderen Kennzahlen direkt in der Tabelle. Die Spalteneigenschaften können wie gewohnt über `cl_salv_column` angepasst werden, was die Flexibilität des ALV-Controllers unterstreicht.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für einen Doppelklick auf eine ALV-Zeile. Zeigen Sie beim Doppelklick auf eine SFLIGHTS-Zeile die Details des ausgewählten Fluges in einem Popup an.
hint: Implementieren Sie das Interface `if_salv_events_list` und registrieren Sie den Handler für das `double_click`-Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_double_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_list.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_dclick.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS if_salv_events_list~double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF if_salv_events_list IMPORTING row column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_double_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_dclick.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = mt_sflights
        ).

        " Ereignisbehandler registrieren
        SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_list~double_click FOR mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).

        mo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_list~double_click.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) INDEX row.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flugdetails:' ls_sflight-carrid ls_sflight-connid ls_sflight-fldate ls_sflight-price DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Das `double_click`-Ereignis des Interfaces `if_salv_events_list` ermöglicht es, auf Doppelklicks auf Zeilen zu reagieren. Durch die Implementierung der entsprechenden Methode und die Registrierung des Handlers kann benutzerdefinierte Logik ausgeführt werden, wie hier das Anzeigen von Flugdetails in einem Popup. Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft ein bestimmtes Zeichen in einem String vorkommt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_string_utilities=>to_char_table` und eine Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_char_in_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_char_in_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_char.
    rv_count = 0.
    LOOP AT cl_abap_string_utilities=>to_char_table( iv_text ) INTO DATA(lv_char).
      IF lv_char = iv_char.
        rv_count = rv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    " Alternative with REDUCE (ABAP 7.50+):
    " rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR char IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>to_char_table( iv_text ) WHERE ( char = iv_char ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_count_empty_string FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Instanziierung und das Laden eines 3D-Modells mit `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer`. Beachten Sie, dass die Visualisierung nur in einer SAP GUI Umgebung sichtbar ist.
hint: Instanziieren Sie das Objekt mit einem Custom Control und rufen Sie Methoden wie `CREATE_VIEWER` und `LOAD_MODEL` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_3d_model
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_model_path     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_3d_model.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_3d_viewer        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.

    " Create a custom container on the screen (requires a screen with a custom control)
    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: Container could not be created
      MESSAGE 'Custom container could not be created.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create the 3D viewer control
    CREATE OBJECT lo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: 3D viewer could not be created
      MESSAGE '3D viewer control could not be created.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Load a 3D model (e.g., a .STEP or .JT file)
    " This path would typically point to a file accessible by the SAP GUI client
    CALL METHOD lo_3d_viewer->load_model
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_model_path
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: Model could not be loaded
      MESSAGE '3D model could not be loaded.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " The model would now be displayed in the custom control on the screen.
    " For a real application, you would need to handle screen flow,
    " event handling, and proper cleanup.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_3d_model FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_3d_model.
    " This unit test can only verify the instantiation and method calls,
    " not the actual visual display.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_viewer_demo( ).
    " Mocking cl_gui_custom_container and cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer would be ideal
    " but is complex for a simple example.
    " For demonstration, we assume successful creation and call.
    " In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_3d_model(
          iv_container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' " Name of a custom control on a screen
          iv_model_path     = 'C:\temp\my_model.step' " Placeholder path
        ).
        " If no exceptions, consider it a success for the purpose of this test.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check for no dump/exception
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Es demonstriert die Erstellung eines `cl_gui_custom_container` und die anschließende Instanziierung des 3D-Viewers darin, gefolgt vom Laden eines Modells. Die tatsächliche Anzeige erfordert eine aktive SAP GUI-Sitzung und ein entsprechendes Dynpro.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und sammeln Sie dann nur die Flugnummern (`CONNID`) in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` in einer Kette.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE tt_connid(
                   FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                   ( flight-connid )
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (`PRICE`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                       INIT sum_price = 0
                       FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                       NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_count_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

Instructions: Passen Sie die Preise für eine Auswahl von Flügen in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS zufällig an. Erhöhen oder verringern Sie den Preis um einen zufälligen Prozentsatz zwischen -10% und +10%.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT für den Zufallsprozentsatz und die moderne UPDATE-Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = -10 max = 10 ).
    rv_updated_count = 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      DATA(lv_percentage) = lo_random->get_next( ). " -10 to +10
      DATA(lv_new_price) = <fs_sflight>-price * ( 1 + ( lv_percentage / 100 ) ).
      <fs_sflight>-price = lv_new_price.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight.
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_adjustment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_adjustment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_adjust( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA',
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0017'.

    " Prepare test data (ensure it exists and has a known price)
    DATA(lv_original_price) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Insert dummy data if not found
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = sy-datum price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
      lv_original_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->adjust_flight_prices( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lv_new_price) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.

    " Assert that price has changed (within expected range)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_new_price exp = lv_original_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_new_price >= lv_original_price * 0.9 AND lv_new_price <= lv_original_price * 1.1 ) ).

    " Clean up / Revert for test isolation (optional, but good practice)
    UPDATE sflight SET price = @lv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT zur Generierung eines Seed-basierten Zufallswerts, was für reproduzierbare Tests wichtig sein kann. Die Preise werden in einer internen Tabelle angepasst und dann mit einer einzigen UPDATE FROM TABLE-Anweisung in der Datenbank aktualisiert, was effizienter ist als Einzel-Updates. Inline-Deklarationen (DATA(...)) und der `@`-Operator für Hostvariablen sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente.
keywords: UPDATE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, SFLIGHT, Inline Declaration, Database Operations

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS aus und markieren Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle als 'PROMOTION'.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren, und die FOR-Iteration, um die ausgewählten Flüge zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_promo_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_promo_flight,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             promotion   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_promo_flight.
    TYPES: tt_promo_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_promo_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_random_promotions
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i " Number of flights to select
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_promo_flights) TYPE tt_promo_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_promo_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_random_promotions.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tt( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    DATA(lv_select_count) = COND #( WHEN iv_count > lv_total_flights THEN lv_total_flights ELSE iv_count ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_total_flights ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = VALUE i_tt( ).

    DO lv_select_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Ensure unique indices (simple approach for small counts)
      WHILE line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_random_index ] ).
        lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      APPEND lv_random_index TO lt_selected_indices.
    ENDDO.

    " Use FOR to build the result table
    rt_promo_flights = VALUE #( FOR lv_index IN lt_selected_indices
                                LET ls_flight = lt_all_flights[ lv_index ] IN
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                  connid = ls_flight-connid
                                  fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                  promotion = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_more_than_available FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_promo_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_promotions) = lo_cut->select_random_promotions( iv_count = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_promotions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_promotions ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check if all selected flights are marked as promotion
    LOOP AT lt_promotions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_promo>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_promo>-promotion exp = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    " This test assumes SFLIGHT might be empty or can be mocked.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffled_flight,
             random_key TYPE i,
             sflight_data TYPE sflight,
           END OF ty_shuffled_flight.
    TYPES: tt_shuffled_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffled_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_flights) TYPE tt_shuffled_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tt( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 1000000 ).

    " Create a new table with a random key for each entry
    rt_shuffled_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                   ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
                                     sflight_data = ls_flight ) ).

    " Sort by the random key
    SORT rt_shuffled_flights BY random_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_shuffle_effect.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_1) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_2) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_shuffled_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_1 ) exp = lines( lt_shuffled_2 ) ).

    " It's highly improbable that two random shuffles result in the same order
    " unless the input table is very small or random seed is fixed.
    " For a robust test, check if the content is the same but order is different.
    DATA(lv_is_same_order) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_shuffled_1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_shuffled_1>).
      READ TABLE lt_shuffled_2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_shuffled_2>) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF <fs_shuffled_1>-sflight_data <> <fs_shuffled_2>-sflight_data.
        lv_is_same_order = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_same_order exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Two shuffles resulted in the same order, which is highly unlikely.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffler( ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHT can be empty or mocked for this test
    " For a real test, you might need to mock DB access.
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_mass_capacity_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_capacities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_capacity_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_capacities.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tt( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = -5 max = 5 ).

    " Prepare the update table using FOR expression
    DATA(lt_update_data) = VALUE sflight_tt( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                            LET lv_adjustment = lo_random->get_next( ) IN
                                            ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                              connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                              fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
                                              seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc + lv_adjustment ) ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_update_data.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das 'VALUE'-Feld in ZDEMO_RAND_UPD für Einträge, deren aktueller Wert unter dem zufällig berechneten Durchschnitt aller 'VALUE'-Felder liegt. Setzen Sie den Wert auf den Durchschnitt.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um einen Schwellenwert zu beeinflussen, REDUCE für die Durchschnittsberechnung und UPDATE mit einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_avg_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_below_random_average
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_avg_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_below_random_average.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zdemo_rand_upd_tt( ).
    SELECT id, value FROM zdemo_rand_upd INTO TABLE @lt_data.

    IF lt_data IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Calculate average using REDUCE
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_entry IN lt_data NEXT s = s + ls_entry-value ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lv_sum / lines( lt_data ).

    " Introduce randomness to the threshold
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = -10 max = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_random_offset) = lo_random->get_next( ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = lv_average + lv_random_offset.

    " Collect IDs to update
    DATA(lt_ids_to_update) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_entry IN lt_data
                                                WHERE ( value < lv_threshold )
                                                ( ls_entry-id ) ).

    IF lt_ids_to_update IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE zdemo_rand_upd SET value = @lv_average
        WHERE id IN @lt_ids_to_update.
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datfm_dt_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_datetime,
        date TYPE d,
        time TYPE t,
      END OF ty_datetime.

    METHODS convert_external_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_external_datetime TYPE string
        iv_date_format_key   TYPE cl_abap_datfm=>ty_format_key OPTIONAL
        iv_time_format_key   TYPE cl_abap_datfm=>ty_format_key OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        ev_date              TYPE d
        ev_time              TYPE t
      RAISING
        cx_abap_datfm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datfm_dt_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_external_datetime.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_external_date) = iv_external_datetime(10).
    DATA(lv_external_time) = iv_external_datetime+11(8).

    TRY.
        ev_date = lo_datfm->convert_date_to_internal(
          iv_date       = lv_external_date
          iv_format_key = iv_date_format_key ).

        ev_time = lo_datfm->convert_time_to_internal(
          iv_time       = lv_external_time
          iv_format_key = iv_time_format_key ).

      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_datfm_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_charset_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_charset_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = iv_source_encoding ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = iv_target_encoding ).

    DATA(lv_temp_string) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_in->convert(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_input_xstring
          IMPORTING
            output = lv_temp_string ).

        lo_conv_out->convert(
          EXPORTING
            input  = lv_temp_string
          IMPORTING
            output = rv_converted_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datfm_flight_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_arrival_info.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        LET lv_timestamp_dep = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                                 iv_date = ls_sflight-fldate
                                 iv_time = ls_sflight-deptime )
            lv_timestamp_arr = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
                                 iv_tstmp = lv_timestamp_dep
                                 iv_seconds = ls_sflight-fltime * 60 ) " fltime is in minutes
        IN
          ( carrid       = ls_sflight-carrid
            connid       = ls_sflight-connid
            fldate       = ls_sflight-fldate
            deptime      = ls_sflight-deptime
            arrtime      = ls_sflight-arrtime
            fltime       = ls_sflight-fltime
            arrival_date = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( lv_timestamp_arr )
            arrival_time = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_time_from_tstmp( lv_timestamp_arr )
            formatted_arrival_datetime = |{ lo_datfm->format_date( cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( lv_timestamp_arr ) ) } { lo_datfm->format_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>get_time_from_tstmp( lv_timestamp_arr ) ) }|
          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen von Daten aus einer externen Quelle (als `xstring` in UTF-16), konvertieren Sie diese in die interne ABAP-Codepage und verarbeiten Sie die Daten anschließend, indem Sie sie zeilenweise aufteilen und die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` für die Konvertierung und String-Funktionen wie `SPLIT` oder `lines()` für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_data_processing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_external_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_external_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_data_processing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_external_data.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = iv_source_encoding ).

    DATA(lv_internal_string) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_external_xstring
          IMPORTING
            output = lv_internal_string ).

        DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
        SPLIT lv_internal_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.
        rv_line_count = lines( lt_lines ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der möglicherweise Zeichen enthält, die in der Ziel-Codepage nicht darstellbar sind, und ersetzen Sie diese nicht darstellbaren Zeichen durch ein definiertes Ersatzzeichen (z.B. '?').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in` und die Methode `convert` mit dem Parameter `replacement`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_replacement DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_replacement
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
        iv_replacement     TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT '?'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_replacement IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_replacement.
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = iv_source_encoding ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = iv_target_encoding
      replacement = iv_replacement ).

    DATA(lv_temp_string) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_in->convert(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_input_xstring
          IMPORTING
            output = lv_temp_string ).

        lo_conv_out->convert(
          EXPORTING
            input  = lv_temp_string
          IMPORTING
            output = rv_converted_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter. " Catch and ignore, replacement handles it
        " Error is handled by replacement character, no re-raise needed
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_convert_with_replacement FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_replacement( ).
    " '你好' in UTF-8 hex: E4BDA0E5A5BD
    DATA(lv_chinese_utf8_xstring) = 'E4BDA0E5A5BD'.

    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_cut->convert_with_replacement(
      iv_input_xstring = lv_chinese_utf8_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      iv_replacement     = '#' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Zeitstempel von einer Zeitzone in eine andere (z.B. von UTC nach 'Europe/Berlin') und formatieren Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitzonenkonvertierung und `cl_abap_datfm` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datfm_timezone_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_timestamp_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_target_timezone TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_datetime) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_tstmp_error
        cx_abap_datfm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datfm_timezone_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_timestamp_timezone.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t,
          lv_tzone TYPE timezone.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_date_time(
          EXPORTING
            iv_tstmp   = iv_utc_timestamp
            iv_tzone   = iv_target_timezone
          IMPORTING
            ev_date    = lv_date
            ev_time    = lv_time
            ev_tzone   = lv_tzone ).

        rv_formatted_datetime = |{ lo_datfm->format_date( lv_date ) } { lo_datfm->format_time( lv_time ) } { lv_tzone }|.

      CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_error INTO DATA(lx_tstmp_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_tstmp_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_tstmp_error
            textid   = lx_tstmp_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error INTO DATA(lx_datfm_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_datfm_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_datfm_error
            textid   = lx_datfm_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datfm_timezone_conv( ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge, die an einem bestimmten Wochentag (z.B. Montag) abfliegen, und geben Sie deren Abflugdatum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA()`, `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle und `cl_abap_datfm` für die Formatierung. Der Wochentag kann über `cl_abap_datfm` oder `GET BADI` ermittelt werden.

CLASS zcl_datfm_weekday_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_weekday TYPE i " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_dates) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_datfm_weekday_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_weekday.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).

    SELECT fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_fldates)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_formatted_dates = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_fldate IN lt_fldates
        LET lv_weekday = lo_datfm->get_weekday( ls_fldate-fldate )
        WHERE lv_weekday = iv_weekday
        ( lo_datfm->format_date(
            iv_date = ls_fldate-fldate
            iv_format_key = cl_abap_datfm=>s_format_key_yyyymmdd_hyphen ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Strings, die jeweils in einer anderen Codepage vorliegen könnten, in die System-Codepage. Die Quell-Codepage wird pro String dynamisch übergeben. Sammeln Sie alle erfolgreich konvertierten Strings in einer Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife über die Eingabetabelle, erstellen Sie für jede Zeile ein neues `cl_abap_conv_obj` und nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` für individuelle Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_multi_encoding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_input_data,
        xstring_data TYPE xstring,
        encoding     TYPE string,
      END OF ty_input_data,
      tt_input_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_multiple_encodings
      IMPORTING
        it_input_data TYPE tt_input_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_multi_encoding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_multiple_encodings.
    rt_converted_strings = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_input IN it_input_data
        LET lv_converted_string = ''
        IN
          TRY.
              DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
                encoding = ls_input-encoding ).
              lo_conv->convert(
                EXPORTING
                  input  = ls_input-xstring_data
                IMPORTING
                  output = lv_converted_string ).
              ( lv_converted_string )
            CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter.
              " Skip or log errors for individual conversions
              " (empty string if conversion fails)
          ENDTRY ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_mixed_encodings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_multi_encoding( ).
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_conv_multi_encoding=>tt_input_data.

    " 'Grüße' in UTF-8
    APPEND VALUE #( xstring_data = '4772C3BCC39Fe' encoding = 'UTF-8' ) TO lt_input.
    " 'Hello' in UTF-16BE
    APPEND VALUE #( xstring_data = '00480065006C006C006F' encoding = 'UTF-16BE' ) TO lt_input.
    " Invalid sequence to test error handling (will be skipped)
    APPEND VALUE #( xstring_data = 'C328' encoding = 'UTF-8' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_cut->convert_multiple_encodings( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[ 1 ] exp = 'Grüße' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[ 2 ] exp = 'Hello' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Es iteriert über eine Tabelle von binären Daten (`xstring`) und deren zugehörigen Codepages. Für jeden Eintrag wird ein spezifischer Konverter erstellt und die Konvertierung durchgeführt. Fehlerhafte Konvertierungen werden mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen und übersprungen, was eine robuste Verarbeitung heterogener Daten ermöglicht.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Namen des Monats für ein gegebenes Datum in einer bestimmten Sprache (z.B. 'November' für '20231123' in Deutsch).

solution:
CLASS zcl_datfm_month_name DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_month_name_in_locale

        iv_date   TYPE d
        iv_locale TYPE sy-langu

      RAISING

CLASS zcl_datfm_month_name IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_month_name_in_locale.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance(
      iv_locale = iv_locale ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von der System-Codepage in eine externe Codepage (z.B. UTF-8) und geben Sie das Ergebnis als `xstring` zurück.

CLASS zcl_conv_charset_out DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_system_string TYPE string

CLASS zcl_conv_charset_out IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utf8_from_system.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,

           END OF ty_component_info.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Objektinstanz ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object()` und die Methode `get_interfaces()`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_test_interface PUBLIC.
  METHODS dummy_method.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_implementing_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_test_interface.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_implementing_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_test_interface~dummy_method.
    " Do nothing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_objectdescr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
    LOOP AT lo_objectdescr->get_interfaces() INTO DATA(ls_interface).
      IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
        rb_implements = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rb_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_implements_interface FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_does_not_implement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_interface( ).
    DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_implementing_class( ).
    DATA(lb_result) = lo_cut->implements_interface( io_object = lo_object iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lb_result msg = 'Should implement ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_does_not_implement.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_interface( ).
    DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_implementing_class( ).
    DATA(lb_result) = lo_cut->implements_interface( io_object = lo_object iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lb_result msg = 'Should not implement ZIF_NON_EXISTENT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie RTTI verwendet werden kann, um die Implementierung von Interfaces durch eine Objektinstanz zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Programmierung, bei der die Funktionalität eines Objekts dynamisch ermittelt werden kann.
keywords: RTTI, Interface, Object, cl_abap_objectdescr, Object Orientation

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT als Beispiel.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI zur Typbestimmung mit dynamischen Zuweisungen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Field not found or inaccessible'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '400'.
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Field not found or inaccessible' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturfelder, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Obwohl `cl_abap_datadescr` hier nicht direkt aufgerufen wird, ist RTTI die Grundlage für das Verständnis der Struktur und die korrekte Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Access, Field Symbol, ASSIGN COMPONENT, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Strukturdefinition und füllen Sie sie mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` in Kombination mit Field-Symbols und dynamischen Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table
        iv_num_rows   TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( it_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          " For simplicity, we'll just fill with generic values
          " In a real scenario, you'd have more sophisticated logic
        ENDLOOP.

        DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
          CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
          ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

          LOOP AT it_components INTO ls_component.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              CASE ls_component-type->get_kind( ).
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_char.
                  <fs_field> = |Char { sy-index }|.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_num.
                  <fs_field> = sy-index.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_int.
                  <fs_field> = sy-index.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_string.
                  <fs_field> = |String { sy-index }|.
                WHEN OTHERS.
                  " Handle other types or leave initial
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_type_descr cx_abap_table_creation_error.
        " Handle errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD1' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p( p_length = 10 ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD2' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_c( p_length = 20 ) ) TO lt_components.

    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( it_components = lt_components iv_num_rows = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 rows' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_line> msg = 'First row should not be initial' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field1> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = |{ <fs_field1> }| exp = '1' msg = 'FIELD1 of first row should be 1' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field2> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = |{ <fs_field2> }| exp = 'Char 1' msg = 'FIELD2 of first row should be Char 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von RTTI, um zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch definierten Struktur zu erstellen und zu füllen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Datenverarbeitung und Metaprogrammierung.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_change_count exp = 0 ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_change_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree EXPORTING parent = mo_container node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_and_expand_tree.
    DATA(lv_node_id_root) = mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Root Node' ).
    DATA(lv_node_id_child1) = mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Child 1'
                                                 i_relat_node = lv_node_id_root
                                                 i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child ).
    DATA(lv_node_id_child2) = mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Child 2'
                                                 i_relat_node = lv_node_id_root
                                                 i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = lv_node_id_root ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_tree_hierarchy( 'TEST_TREE_HIERARCHY' ).

    DATA(lt_node_table) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_table( ).
