Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` aus einer flachen internen Tabelle mit Parent-Child-Beziehungen füllt. Verwenden Sie `sflights` als Datenquelle und bilden Sie eine Hierarchie nach `carrid` und `connid` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_node` rekursiv oder iterativ mit `i_relat_node` und `i_relationship`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>name.
    METHODS fill_tree_from_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree EXPORTING parent = mo_container node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_tree_from_sflight.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             node_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate,
          lt_carrier_nodes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_carrier_key) = ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_connection_key) = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|.

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_carrier_nodes[ table_line = lv_carrier_key ] ).
        DATA(lv_root_node_key) = mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = ls_sflight-carrid i_node_key = lv_carrier_key ).
        INSERT lv_root_node_key INTO TABLE lt_carrier_nodes.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_parent_node_key) = lt_carrier_nodes[ table_line = lv_carrier_key ].
      mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = |{ ls_sflight-connid } ({ ls_sflight-fldate })|
                         i_relat_node = lv_parent_node_key
                         i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
                         i_node_key = lv_connection_key ).
    ENDLOOP.
    mo_tree->expand_tree( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_tree_sflight( 'TEST_TREE_SFLIGHT' ).
    lo_cut->fill_tree_from_sflight( ).

    DATA(lt_node_table) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_table( ).
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->mo_tree->get_nodes
      IMPORTING
        node_table = lt_node_table.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_node_table ).
    " At least one root node (carrier) and one child node (connection)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_node_table ) >= 2 ).

    " Check if a specific carrier node exists
    DATA(lv_node_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_node_table INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE parent_key IS INITIAL.
      IF ls_node-text IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_node_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_node_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie Inline-Deklarationen, `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)`, `line_exists` und String-Templates für die Knotenschlüssel. `expand_tree` sorgt für die vollständige Anzeige der Hierarchie.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>name.

    METHODS search_and_select_node IMPORTING iv_search_text TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_node_found) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree EXPORTING parent = mo_container node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_tree.
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Fruits' i_node_key = 'FRUITS' ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Apple' i_relat_node = 'FRUITS' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child i_node_key = 'APPLE' ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Banana' i_relat_node = 'FRUITS' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child i_node_key = 'BANANA' ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Vegetables' i_node_key = 'VEGGIES' ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Carrot' i_relat_node = 'VEGGIES' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child i_node_key = 'CARROT' ).
    mo_tree->expand_tree( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD search_and_select_node.
    DATA(lt_node_table) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_table( ).
    CALL METHOD mo_tree->get_nodes
      IMPORTING
        node_table = lt_node_table.

    READ TABLE lt_node_table INTO DATA(ls_found_node) WITH KEY text = iv_search_text.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      mo_tree->set_selected_node( i_node_key = ls_found_node-node_key ).
      rv_node_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_node_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_tree_search( 'TEST_TREE_SEARCH' ).

    " Test successful search and selection
    DATA(lv_found) = lo_cut->search_and_select_node( 'Apple' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_font_style DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>name.
    METHODS fill_tree_with_styles.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_font_style IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree EXPORTING parent = mo_container node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_tree_with_styles.
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Bold Node' i_node_key = 'BOLD' i_font_bold = abap_true ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Italic Node' i_node_key = 'ITALIC' i_font_italic = abap_true ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_item_text = 'Normal Node' i_node_key = 'NORMAL' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_font_styles FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_font_styles.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_tree_font_style( 'TEST_TREE_FONT' ).
    lo_cut->fill_tree_with_styles( ).

    DATA(lt_node_table) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_table( ).
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->mo_tree->get_nodes
      IMPORTING
        node_table = lt_node_table.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_node_table ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_bold_node) = lt_node_table[ KEY node_key COMPONENTS node_key = 'BOLD' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_bold_node-font_bold exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_bold_node-font_italic exp = abap_false ).

    DATA(ls_italic_node) = lt_node_table[ KEY node_key COMPONENTS node_key = 'ITALIC' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_italic_node-font_bold exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_italic_node-font_italic exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(ls_normal_node) = lt_node_table[ KEY node_key COMPONENTS node_key = 'NORMAL' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_normal_node-font_bold exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_normal_node-font_italic exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
